D66 MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether Islamic primary schools teaching that Allah abhors homosexuality, and related lesson material, are acceptable, and whether the Inspectorate will intervene. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate is investigating, that schools have constitutional freedom within the democratic rule of law, and that teaching material must respect basic democratic values, deferring judgment on the specific material until the inspection report.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen over het bericht dat ondanks extra geld mbo-docenten in de laagste salarisschaal terechtkomen

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked whether rising numbers of mbo teachers in the lowest salary scale, alongside growing institutional reserves and a critical report on medezeggenschap, reflect misuse of extra funds. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, that the Inspectorate is examining reserves, that she disagrees with the report's analysis, and that she will meet the MBO Raad and unions to review whether the convenant's goals were met.
That is why the Inspectorate of Education is currently conducting further research into this.
Daarom doet de Inspectie van het Onderwijs op dit moment hier nader onderzoek naar
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over  het bericht "Lerarentekort loopt  verder op: ‘Funest voor de kwaliteit'"

An MP asks the Minister about reported teacher shortages in primary education, including vacancy figures, the status of motions on registration, pay for substitute teachers, unemployed teachers placement, sick leave and part-time work. The Minister answers that the shortage is a real problem, outlines ongoing measures (regional approach, Participatiefonds plan, registration talks, sick-leave support) and states there is no room for extra funding.
I recognise that the teacher shortage is a problem at many schools and that it is becoming increasingly difficult to fill vacancies.
Ik herken dat het lerarentekort op veel scholen een probleem is en het steeds moeilijker wordt om vacatures te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat het basisonderwijs het meest seizoengevoelige beroep in de Werkloosheidswet (WW) is

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Meenen (D66) ask about a UWV finding that primary school teachers show the strongest seasonal unemployment pattern, with a summer peak, and whether dismissals at summer's start and contract types contribute. The minister attributes the summer peak mainly to school-year changes, notes it fell 38% in 2018, says data on contract types and WW-entry is limited, and rejects legal measures, leaving pay arrangements to employers and unions via the CAO.
I do not intend to take legislative measures.
Ik ben niet van plan om wettelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sneller over het bericht ‘NPO blokkeert mogelijkheid om programmastreams te downloaden’

MPs Van Meenen and Sneller asked the minister why the public broadcaster NPO blocks downloading of programme streams since March 2019, and whether public-funded programmes should be freely available, including for schools. The minister answered that DRM was introduced to protect copyright and for reporting reasons, that downloads are not required of public broadcasters, and that educational reuse is facilitated via Beeld en Geluid.
A public institution such as the NPO cannot be expected to disregard agreements and the rights of producers, broadcasters and makers.
Er kan niet van een publieke instelling als de NPO worden verwacht dat hij afspraken en rechten van producenten, omroepen en makers negeert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over de uitvoering van de motie Van den Hul c.s. (35 000 VIII, nr. 173) inzake het inzichtelijk maken van de ruimtebrief

Four MPs asked the government why it will only 'point to' a Parliament motion asking education employers to make the 'ruimtebrief' (budget space letter) public at collective bargaining tables, and why the letter's name is changing. The minister replied that the government cannot oblige employers to disclose the letter's contents, that collective bargaining freedom precludes forced disclosure, and that it will send employers a cover note pointing to the motion while noting it conflicts with confidentiality and negotiating freedom.
The cabinet cannot and will not oblige education employers to make the contents of the letters transparent at the negotiating table.
Het kabinet kan en wil de onderwijswerkgevers niet verplichten om de inhoud van de brieven inzichtelijk te maken aan de onderhandelingstafel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van Meenen over het bericht 'VO-raad: middelbare scholen verdwijnen in krimpregio's’

MPs Schonis and Van Meenen asked about reports that secondary schools are disappearing in shrinking regions and what the government will do to keep access reasonable. The minister acknowledges concern, says school boards are primarily responsible, points to accountmanagers and a process facilitator, and commits to working with the Interior Ministry and provinces on an integrated regional approach.
The problem of pupil decline in such regions is much broader than education alone and also concerns the liveability of the region.
Het probleem van leerlingendaling in zulke regio's is veel breder dan alleen het onderwijs, en gaat ook over de leefbaarheid van de regio.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Van Meenen en Rog over brieven waarin schoolleiders gewezen worden op de wettelijke verplichting om gegevens van leraren aan te leveren voor het Lerarenregister

MPs Bruins, Van Meenen and Rog asked whether letters pressing school leaders to supply teacher data for the teacher register, threatening inspection consequences, were unnecessary and whether the Inspectorate would enforce the obligation. The minister admitted the letter was incomplete and should not have been sent, promised corrective letters, and said he is discussing inspection oversight of professional development with the Inspectorate and will embed HRM policy in the law.
This letter should not have been sent in this form: the information it contains is incomplete.
Deze brief had niet in deze vorm verstuurd moeten worden: de informatie die er in staat is onvolledig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Bergkamp en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bestuurder reformatorische school tekende Nashville-verklaring’

MPs asked whether a board member of a reformed school signing the Nashville Statement, which denies LGBT identities, is acceptable and whether the government would act on school discrimination duties. The minister distanced the cabinet from the statement, said schools are assessed on citizenship and social safety duties, noted the hoger onderwijs discrimination rule does not apply to primary and secondary schools, and said the board was consulted and the school will keep working on an open climate.
The cabinet has distanced itself from the Nashville Statement.
Het kabinet heeft afstand genomen van de Nashville-verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het onderzoek sociale veiligheid van docenten

An MP from D66 asked the minister about a DUO survey showing many teachers face verbal and physical abuse, and about school safety measures, teacher training, reporting and support. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to VOION and SSV support initiatives and existing legal duties, and said he has no insight into teachers' willingness to file police reports.
Given the importance of this activity, I will again urge VOION to speed up the implementation.
Gezien het belang van deze activiteit zal ik er bij VOION nogmaals op aandringen haast te maken met de uitwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen inzake de zorgboerderij de Grote Brander

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked why funding for education at the Grote Brander care farm in Deventer stopped, leaving children without the schooling they benefited from. The minister answered that the location does not meet legal requirements for a school site, so it is not eligible for education funding, and that the school board and municipality are working on individual solutions.
However, it is also my responsibility to be able to guarantee the quality of education for every child.
Het is echter ook mijn verantwoordelijkheid om de kwaliteit van onderwijs voor elk kind te kunnen garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Meenen over het studievoorschot en het effect op de maximale hypotheek

Two D66 MPs asked whether mortgage lenders correctly account for student debt, how the Rijk, AFM and lenders agreed on this, and whether lenders could offer more tailored mortgages to starters. The minister replied that student loan repayments are annuity-based so current balance is not relevant, lenders weight student debt at 0.75% (pre-studievoorschot) or 0.45% (post) of principal, explain options exist, and the issue will be reviewed at the 2019 Platform Hypotheken.

At the next Platform Hypotheken in 2019, where the sector and the supervisor discuss possible bottlenecks in mortgage provision, it will be inventoried how providers use this explain option and whether bottlenecks are encountered.

Tijdens het volgende Platform Hypotheken in 2019, waar met de sector en de toezichthouder wordt gesproken over mogelijke knelpunten in de hypotheekverstrekking, zal worden geïnventariseerd op welke wijze aanbieders gebruik maken van deze explainmogelijkheid en of hier knelpunten worden ondervonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Meenen over (buitenlandse) studenten die geen onderdak hebben

MPs Van Eijs and Van Meenen (D66) asked whether foreign students lacking housing at the start of their studies could be quantified, whether a permanent solution is foreseen, how universities consider housing capacity in recruitment, and about tent accommodation in Groningen and municipal-university coordination. The minister replied that no exact figures per city exist, pointed to the national student housing monitor and a new action plan with local production agreements, and said she will inventory local cooperation and concrete housing actions with the monitor.
No data are available on the number of students who cannot find accommodation before the start of their studies.
Over het aantal studenten dat voor de start van hun studie geen woning kan vinden zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat honderden Nederlandse wetenschappers publiceerden in neptijdschriften

MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that hundreds of Dutch academics published in predatory journals that skip peer review. The minister called the practice fraud by malicious publishers, saw no consequences for the scientists involved, pointed to library checklists and repositories, and acknowledged that publication pressure may contribute.
I do not assume that the scientists involved acted in bad faith, and I see no reason to attach consequences to publishing in the journals concerned for the scientists or their institutions.

Ik ga er niet vanuit dat de betrokken wetenschappers te kwader trouw zijn geweest en zie geen aanleiding om aan het publiceren in de betrokken tijdschriften consequenties te verbinden voor de betrokken wetenschappers of hun instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Meenen over het bericht dat de NPO gaat experimenteren met nasynchronisatie van buitenlandse series

MPs Sneller and Van Meenen asked the minister about the NPO's experiment with dubbing foreign series, including the effects on language learning. The minister answered that the public broadcaster is independent in programme matters, that the experiment is for audience research, and that he is not involved in its evaluation.
The experiment falls under the NPO's programme autonomy.
Het experiment behoort tot de programma-autonomie van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht 'Hoe de digitale halsband van Magister de privacy van schoolkinderen nekt'

An MP asked the education minister about the concentration of the pupil tracking system market, retention periods for pupil data, whether marketing use is excluded under the privacy covenant, US-based hosting by Magister, and whether enforcement and investigation are adequate. The minister answered that no abuse of dominance signals are known, that the privacy covenant bans advertising use, that data is stored on Dutch servers with Akamai services provided in Europe, and that the Dutch data protection authority is responsible for oversight, with the minister promising a monitor report later this year.
It is the role of the Dutch Data Protection Authority to supervise and, where necessary, conduct investigations.
Het is de rol van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om toezicht te houden en indien nodig onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Rudmer Heerema en Van Meenen over het oppotten van geld door schoolbesturen

Four MPs asked the minister whether school boards are hoarding funds, whether a liquidity upper bound of 1.5 is desirable, and related questions on reserves, the Commissie-Don benchmarks, and the inspectorate's oversight. The minister rejected an absolute upper bound, argued that average liquidity is not a causal result of lump-sum funding and that the 'oppotten' label does not fit, and said the inspectorate uses signalling values as detection tools while committing to adjust the framework.
I see no reason to take a different position.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een ander standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over een financieel nadeel voor docenten die in België wonen en in Nederland hun beroep uitoefenen

Two MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether teachers living in Belgium but working in the Netherlands face a financial disadvantage from double tax-premium coordination, and whether the teacher clause in the Dutch-Belgian tax treaty should be changed. The government confirmed the mismatch under the treaty's two-year residence-state taxation rule, said the Netherlands no longer aims for such clauses, and stated that the issue is being raised in ongoing treaty negotiations with Belgium.
The Netherlands has already raised the issue of the professor clause with the aim of resolving the problem.
Nederland heeft de problematiek met betrekking tot de hooglerarenbepaling al aan de orde gesteld met als doel de genoemde problematiek op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Van Meenen en Westerveld over de begeleiding van leerlingen in en de kwaliteit van het particulier onderwijs

MPs Kwint, Van Meenen and Westerveld asked whether Avatar-related ideas spreading in democratic private schools, paid Avatar courses being advertised at schools, and the lack of stricter inspection and diploma requirements are acceptable. Minister Slob answered that the inspectorate will take the signals into its regular supervision of private schools, that paid services may be offered at schools, that no equalisation of inspection with publicly funded schools is planned, and that the qualification obligation remains important though students may take the state exams or pursue other routes.
The signals will be taken into account by the inspectorate in its supervision.
De signalen zullen door de inspectie worden betrokken in haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht 'Ruzie op Geldropse basisscholen, leraren melden zich massaal ziek'

An MP asked the education minister about a dispute at school board 't Nut in Geldrop, where teachers reported sick en masse, including how long the inspectorate knew, whether the supervisory board followed participation rules when appointing an interim board member, and how pupils could return to school. The minister answered that the inspectorate was alerted in April 2017, that the supervisory board did not follow the school participation law by consulting the works council in time, that the inspectorate mediated a resolution on 19 March leading to resignations and interim appointments, and that further investigation would be considered if needed.
The supervisory board did not comply with the School Participation Act (WMS) in this regard.
De raad van toezicht heeft zich daarbij niet gehouden aan de Wet Medezeggenschap Scholen (WMS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen over de begeleiding van leerlingen in en de kwaliteit van het particulier onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked whether it is acceptable that tutors and therapists recruit clients on private schools, the number of such schools, and the quality of private democratic schools, including a case where a pupil learned nothing for two years. The minister answered that schools must provide necessary support themselves, that paid extra services are permitted, that the Inspectorate monitors quality and can withdraw recognition, and that no further research or legal change is planned.
I have no insight into the number of schools where additional paid services are offered.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid scholen waarop aanvullende betaalde diensten worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Studeren vanuit een camper’

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government recognises that housing shortages affect Dutch as well as international students in student cities, asked for per-city shortage and construction figures, and asked whether the problem is addressed beyond city boundaries. The minister acknowledges shortages in many student cities, gives a 2016 monitor table and construction projections per city, and says only that some cities look beyond their boundaries (Amsterdam via a coalition appeal).
No exact figures per student city can be given.
Er zijn geen exacte aantallen per studentenstad te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, Bruins en Van Meenen over het bericht dat de Onderwijsinspectie uitleg wil over fouten in het vwo-eindexamen Frans

MPs asked the Minister about teacher complaints over errors in the VWO French final exam and whether the College voor Toetsen en Examens (CvTE) fixed them via correction-guideline additions and normering. The State Secretary answered that CvTE handled 95 signals, issued a correction-guideline addition changing three questions, and that the Inspectie found the handling correct, while declining to judge the signals substantively.
I myself do not enter into the substantive assessment or evaluation of signals about central examinations.
Zelf treed ik niet in de inhoudelijke beoordeling of waardering van signalen over centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht 'Vertrek hoogleraren Universiteit Leiden geëist om schrikbewind'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports of a climate of fear at a Leiden University institute and whether the problem was known earlier. The minister answered that working climate is a matter between employer and employees, that the university board has already acted, and that she will take no further steps.
The working climate at a university institute department is a matter between employer and employee.
Het werkklimaat bij de afdeling van een instituut van een universiteit is een zaak tussen werkgever en werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Onderwijs aan ernstig meervoudig beperkte kinderen'

Van Meenen (D66) asked the State Secretary of Education about unequal age limits (16 or 20) for special-education placements of children with severe multiple disabilities across regional partnerships, and about funding and the role of partnerships versus schools. The government answered that the law allows enrolment up to age 20 without an absolute limit, that partnerships set their own criteria, and that a joint VWS-OCW effort is underway on care funding, while ruling out excluding these children from the Passend Onderwijs Act.
Excluding pupils with severe multiple disabilities from passend onderwijs is not something I consider desirable.
Het uitsluiten van leerlingen met ernstige, meervoudige beperkingen uit passend onderwijs acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de Sint Maartenschool in Ubbergen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Education about the Sint Maartenschool in Ubbergen, which may have to dismiss a third of its staff under passend onderwijs, and how education and care for pupils would be secured. The government answered that a plan of action with municipalities and regional bodies will set out how education and care are organised and funded from the new school year, with families informed before the summer.
Before the end of this school year, parents and staff will be informed about this.
Voor het einde van dit schooljaar worden de ouders en het personeel daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over enkele berichten over de plannen van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) voor een campus in Yantai, China

An MP asked the education minister about the University of Groningen's preparations for a campus in Yantai, China, including costs of about two million euro, a trip for the university council, and whether the plans would be reconsidered after parliamentary concerns about academic freedom. The minister replied that the campus must be privately financed, that approval under a forthcoming law and AMvB will be required, that there has been no substantive contact with the university since the debate, and that the trip costs (within a 700,000 euro budget) are privately funded.
It is not for me to dictate to institutions how they spend private funds, as long as they transparently report the separation between the public and private money flows.

Het is niet aan mij om aan instellingen op te leggen waaraan zij de private middelen wel of niet besteden, zolang zij transparant verslag leggen van de scheiding tussen de publieke en private geldstroom.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Diertens en Van Meenen over de oproep om een gezonde voedselomgeving te bevorderen

MPs De Groot, Diertens and Van Meenen asked about a call by food scientists to make healthy eating the easy choice, including reported plans by Dunkin' Donuts to open outlets in schools and hospitals. The state secretary said the government supports a healthy food environment, works with schools, municipalities and food partners through existing programmes, and has no known plans for fast-food outlets in schools or hospitals.
As far as is known, there is currently no question of Dunkin' Donuts or any other fast-food chain opening outlets in schools and hospitals.
Antwoord 3, 4 Voor zover bekend is er momenteel geen sprake van een eventuele vestiging van Dunkin» Donuts of een (andere) fastfoodketen in scholen en ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jetten over de aanschaf van een Boeing 737 Business Jet als nieuw regeringsvliegtuig

Two D66 MPs asked why all four bids in the government aircraft tender were declared invalid, why negotiations went only with Boeing rather than retendering, the claimed 18 million euro price difference, Airbus's objection, and the King's role in choosing the aircraft. The minister answered that no bid met all criteria, that Airbus did not supply required documents, that the price gap is under 2 million euro once VAT is considered, that Airbus did not appeal, that the King had no role in the decision, and provided a timeline, while citing procurement-law limits on disclosing bid details.
The principles of procurement law limit me in making information about the bids public.
De beginselen van het aanbestedingsrecht beperken mij in het openbaar kunnen maken van informatie over de inschrijvingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over selectiecriteria in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about master's selection criteria in higher education, including whether programmes that only select students from outside their own university are counted as selective and why language tests are excluded. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate's definitive report and her response will follow shortly, defined selective programmes, and said the discrepancy and the question of quality uncertainty are being discussed with the universities and student bodies.
In the short term I will send the House the definitive report of the Inspectorate and my response to it.
Op korte termijn stuur ik uw Kamer het definitieve rapport van de inspectie en mijn reactie hierop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van Meenen over de berichten ‘Turkse spionage in Duitsland’ en ‘Terrorist vanwege interview met Rutte’

Two D66 MPs asked whether Turkish intelligence espionage reported in Germany also occurs in the Netherlands, including watch lists, whether Turkish-Dutch citizens are warned, whether Dutch services have enough Turkish language capacity, and how the government responds to threats against a journalist after an interview with PM Rutte. The government declined to say publicly whether such activity occurs or what services know, citing that no public statements can be made about investigations or service expertise, condemned threats against press freedom, and urged the journalist to file a police report.
No public statements can be made about investigations into activities these services might carry out without Dutch government permission, or about any resulting course of action.

Over onderzoek naar activiteiten die deze diensten zonder toestemming van de Nederlandse overheid zouden uitvoeren en over het eventuele handelings-perspectief dat uit een dergelijk onderzoek zou voortvloeien, kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jetten over de aanschaf van een Boeing 737 Business Jet als nieuw regeringsvliegtuig

MPs Van Meenen and Jetten asked why four tenders for a new government aircraft were rejected, why negotiations went exclusively with Boeing, the role of the Royal House, total costs, pricing comparisons, future rules on scheduled flights, and related matters. The minister answered most questions substantively, explaining the procedure, costs (about 89 million euro net), and that the Royal House had no say in the procurement decisions, while declining to verify external price figures.
The Royal House had no say in decision-making on the design of the tender procedure, the assessment of bids, or the negotiations with Boeing.
Het Koninklijk Huis had geen zeggenschap in besluitvorming over de vormgeving van de aanbestedingsprocedure, de beoordeling van inschrijvingen alsmede de onderhandelingen met Boeing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Studenten betalen 93 miljoen euro boete aan OV-bedrijven'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that students pay large fines to public transport companies for not stopping their student travel product on time, and what the status is of the legislation and motions on this. The minister confirmed about 93.6 million euros went to transport companies as compensation, said fines are the responsibility of the (former) student, and reported improvements to communication and an ongoing study into automatic termination, with a novelle to follow.
I understand that it is very annoying for (former) students to have to pay such a fine.
Ik begrijp dat het voor (oud-)studenten heel vervelend is om zo’n boete te moeten betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht dat er problemen zijn met het vervoer voor leerlingen met een zorgvraag of beperking

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that school transport for pupils with care needs or disabilities is badly arranged, including how many use it, quality and punctuality data, and whether a general administrative order (AMvB) like the one for disability transport should be made. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for school transport, that the ministry has no quality picture or punctuality figures, that satisfaction surveys show high ratings, and that no AMvB is possible under current law, pointing to a handbook for municipalities instead.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport does not lie with the Ministry of OCW but with the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt niet bij het Ministerie van OCW maar bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over de mogelijkheid voor (pleeg)kinderen om het inkomen van ouders bij een aanvullende beurs buiten beschouwing te laten

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked how DUO assesses requests to disregard parental income for supplementary student grants in cases of severed contact or serious conflict, including what documentation is required and whether requiring students to describe private conflicts is acceptable. The minister answered that DUO needs a range of evidence depending on the situation, that students may need to provide personal statements, that DUO can depart from professional statements, and that decisions follow the legal framework and internal work instructions.
The framework on which DUO bases a decision consists of the legal framework, made up of statutes and regulations and their explanatory notes.
Het afwegingskader op basis waarvan DUO een beslissing neemt wordt gevormd door het wettelijk kader, bestaande uit de wet- en regelgeving en de daarbij behorende toelichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de aanmeldleeftijd in het onderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about legal doubts over school enrolment procedures in several municipalities, including whether these breach the Primary and Secondary Education Acts, and what the inspectorate and ministry are doing. The State Secretary answered that schools must adapt procedures themselves, the inspectorate acts on signals rather than routine checks, and schools are given time through the coming school year.
If the inspectorate receives a signal, it takes action where necessary.
Krijgt de inspectie een signaal binnen, dan onderneemt zij zo nodig actie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Meenen over het bericht “meer uitkeringen door Syriërs en en Wajongeren”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Meenen asked about reports of rising benefit claims by Syrians and Wajong recipients, including data on Syrian welfare recipients, costs, language training and diploma recognition. The minister answered with CBS figures, describes pre-integration courses and volunteer training, and says a letter on the motion for language lessons from day one will follow before the budget debate.
The realised costs of increased welfare benefits for Syrians are not registered separately.
De gerealiseerde kosten van toegenomen bijstand door Syriërs worden niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat promotiestudenten volgens arbeidsrechtsadvocaten een arbeidscontract kunnen eisen

MPs Van Meenen and Van Dijk asked whether PhD students can enforce an employment contract in court, as some labour lawyers claim, and what this means for the experiment with PhD education. The minister answered that the employment relationship depends on actual practice, that the universities shape this themselves, and that any case where a PhD student became an employee would be considered in the evaluation of the experiment.
If the court rules that there is no PhD student but an employee-PhD candidate, the rules applicable to employee-PhD candidates apply.
Als de rechter oordeelt dat geen sprake is van een promotiestudent, maar van een werknemer-promovendus, dan gelden de voor de werknemer-promovendus geldende regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sjoerdsma over de Turkse publicatie van een lijst met Nederlandse 'Gülen-organisaties'

MPs Van Meenen and Sjoerdsma asked whether Turkey's publication of a list of Dutch 'Gülen organisations' was unacceptable interference, and what steps the government would take toward Turkey and the Dutch-Turkish community. The government answered that it has consistently told Turkish officials that direct interference from Ankara in domestic affairs is unacceptable, and referred to a cabinet letter on tensions in the Turkish-Dutch community.
In all talks with members of the Turkish government, the cabinet has consistently and critically made clear that Turkish tensions must not be exported to the Netherlands.

Het kabinet heeft in alle gesprekken met leden van de Turkse regering consequent en in kritische bewoordingen duidelijk gemaakt dat de Turkse spanningen niet naar Nederland moeten worden geëxporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Jasper van Dijk en Grashoff inzake de gevolgen van het Turkse conflict voor Nederlandse scholen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Education about school withdrawals and intimidation of Turkish-Dutch pupils linked to the Erdogan-Gulen conflict, and about the role of municipalities and the financial effects on schools. The answers report about 600 pupils switching schools, signals of pressure from within the community, extra police attention, support from the School and Safety foundation, and that funding follows enrolment counts monitored by the Inspectorate.
I am therefore pleased with the great involvement of municipalities.
Ik ben daarom blij met de grote betrokkenheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over huur- en verhuurconstructie van de stichting Calibris

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Inspectorate's finding of conflict of interest in the rent and lease arrangement between Stichting Calibris and Stichting Ondersteuningsfonds Zorg, Welzijn en Sport warrants clawing back state funds or other action. The Minister acknowledged the conflict of interest but declined to conclude misuse of funds, said recovery was not appropriate or legally possible against the foundation, and stated that such arrangements are not objectionable if transparency and conflict prevention are properly arranged.

The Inspectorate notes in its report that the former director of the KBB was also a board member of Stichting Ondersteuningsfonds Zorg, Welzijn en Sport, raising the question of whether one natural person can safeguard the opposing interests of tenant and landlord.

De inspectie constateert in haar rapport dat de voormalige directeur van het kenniscentrum beroepsonderwijs bedrijfsleven (KBB) tevens bestuurder was van de Stichting Ondersteuningsfonds Zorg, Welzijn en Sport en dat dit de vraag oproept in hoeverre één natuurlijke persoon in staat is de tegengestelde belangen van huurder en verhuurder te waarborgen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Bruins over zorgen om privacy in het onderwijs

MPs Van Meenen and Bruins asked the State Secretary for Education about psychologists' and pedagogues' concerns over careless handling of sensitive pupil data, and what has been done to improve it. The State Secretary acknowledged the signals, listed sector-wide privacy measures, planned a repeat monitor, and pointed to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie as supervisors while leaving much responsibility with schools.
I intend to have this monitor repeated still this calendar year and will inform your House of the results.
Ik ben voornemens deze monitor nog dit kalenderjaar te laten herhalen en zal uw Kamer over de resultaten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Meenen over het bericht dat zwangere vrouwen onderzoekstijd verliezen

MPs Dijkstra and Van Meenen asked the minister whether pregnant female researchers lose research time because temporary contracts are not extended, despite UWV pregnancy benefits, and what will be done about the low share of female professors. The minister answered that UWV pay is a general scheme meant to compensate wages, that universities are asked to use it flexibly, that the Wwz four-year chain rule is adequately flexible, and that she will ask universities how they will address the problem and monitor progress.
I consider the problem for female researchers urgent and will ask the universities how they concretely shape possible solutions.
Ik vind de problematiek voor vrouwelijke onderzoekers urgent en zal de universiteiten vragen hoe zij concreet vorm geven aan mogelijke oplossingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat er problemen zouden zijn bij de Groninger Buitenschool

An MP asked the state secretary about reported problems at the Groninger Buitenschool, a school for pupils with internalising behavioural and psychiatric problems, including parental complaints about care and the classroom environment. The state secretary said the inspectorate rated the education as adequate, is monitoring the board's improvement measures, and declined an independent investigation for now, citing the board's actions.
The inspectorate is following the progress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Topdocenten kraken onderwijs Nederlandse universiteiten’ inzake de lage leskwaliteit van een grote groep docenten in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that many higher-education lecturers teach poorly and value research over teaching, and about how institutions improve teaching quality and the Basic Teaching Qualification (BKO). The minister acknowledges the research-over-teaching pattern, points to universities' autonomy and existing tools such as appraisal cycles and professionalisation offers, and says she will discuss teacher professionalisation with institutions.
Universities, however, are autonomous and determine their own education and HR policy themselves.
Universiteiten zijn echter autonoom en bepalen zelf hun onderwijs- en HR-beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake de aflevering 'Eindexamens' over het uitsluiten van leerlingen door wurgcontracten van De Monitor

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Education about schools forcing pupils to sign 'wurgcontracten' that exclude them from final exams, and whether repeat offenders would be sanctioned and pupils informed. The state secretary answered that no repeat offenders are known, that the inspectorate would impose sanctions if they occurred, and that information is provided via LAKS and the inspectorate, with no extra measures planned.
As soon as a report comes in to LAKS or the inspectorate of such a contract, LAKS or the inspectorate addresses the school concerned.
Zodra er een melding komt bij LAKS of bij de inspectie van een dergelijk contract, spreekt LAKS of de inspectie de betreffende school aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Meenen inzake het intrekken van het instemmingsrecht op de faculteitsbegroting door de faculteitsraad

MPs Mohandis and Van Meenen asked whether the Leiden executive board's withdrawal of faculty-level consent rights over the faculty budget undermines student influence. The minister answers that no formal withdrawal occurred, that consent on budget outlines applies at institutional level in principle, and that she sees no reason to intervene with the board or other institutions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius, Rog en Van Meenen inzake de sluiting van het doveninternaat in Haren

MPs Siderius, Rog and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about closing the boarding school for deaf pupils in Haren, arguing it would destroy capital and expertise and that clustered classes are not a realistic alternative. The state secretary replied that alternatives in regular education are being explored with the VO-raad and Siméa, that boarding costs were never structurally funded and will be phased out for new pupils from August 2017, and that the Guyotschool need not close.
The boarding school is not needed if appropriate education can be offered nearby for these pupils within regular or special secondary education.
Het internaat is niet nodig, als er thuisnabij ook voor deze leerlingen binnen het regulier of binnen het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs passend onderwijs kan worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake het bericht 'Mbo-opleidingen weren leerlingen met een beperking'

An MP asks the education minister about reports that mbo colleges refuse students with disabilities, including whether such refusals occur and what will change. The minister answers that complaints are received but cannot be quantified or verified, that refusing students on grounds of disability is unlawful, and that a right of admission to mbo is planned from 2017 along with a complaints procedure.
I therefore cannot state how many young people have been refused entry to an mbo course because of a psychological or physical disability.
Ik kan daarom niet aangeven wat het aantal jongeren is dat vanwege een psychische of lichamelijke beperking is afgewezen voor een mbo-opleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het vergoeden van een doventolk door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why people over 30 are denied a sign-language interpreter for study, and how that fits with policy easing study for older adults. The government explains the 30-year limit for education funding, notes that UWV can fund interpreters for work-related training under conditions, and says a study has been started.
The outcome of the consultation is that a study will be started on behalf of the Ministries of Education, Culture and Science, Health, Welfare and Sport, and Social Affairs and Employment.

Uitkomst van het overleg is dat er in opdracht van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW), het Ministerie van VWS en het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) een onderzoek wordt gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sjoerdsma over de gevolgen van de bezuiniging op Nederlands onderwijs in het buitenland

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Education about the expected effects of ending direct subsidies to Dutch schools abroad, including school closures and falling quality, as predicted by an ITS study. The State Secretary maintained that parents are responsible for funding, pointed to temporary transitional funding and NOB support, and said effects will vary by school and that the government will keep working to minimise them.
The ITS study gives insight into schools' expectations of how they will act when the temporary subsidy to schools ends on 1 January 2017.
Het onderzoek door ITS geeft inzicht in de verwachtingen van scholen hoe zij zullen handelen wanneer de tijdelijke subsidie aan scholen op 1 januari 2017 eindigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake onvoldoende budget voor scholen in achterstandswijken om goed onderwijs te kunnen bieden

An MP asked the state secretary whether schools in disadvantaged neighbourhoods have enough budget for quality education, and about the criteria for disadvantage funding. The state secretary replied that the extra funding is sufficient, gave figures on pupil counts and the secretary declined to provide data on children of Central/Eastern European and asylum families, and said a reform based on individual pupil deficits was not pursued because of administrative burden.
For the Leerplusarrangement in secondary education, just over €48 million is being deployed this year.
Voor het Leerplusarrangement voortgezet onderwijs wordt dit jaar ruim € 48 miljoen ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Meenen over het bericht UvA probeert CAO te omzeilen

MPs Voortman and Van Meenen asked whether the University of Amsterdam planned to circumvent the new collective labour agreement by avoiding conversion of temporary contracts into permanent ones, as suggested in a leaked email. The minister answered that the executive board rejects such circumvention, will comply with the CAO and Wwz in letter and spirit, and has created an individual-rights ombudsperson whose opinions are binding, while noting the email was one employee's idea rather than university policy.
The Executive Board of the UvA has explicitly distanced itself from the idea that it plans to circumvent the new CAO Universiteiten.
Het College van Bestuur van de UvA (CvB) heeft laten weten nadrukkelijk afstand te nemen van het idee dat het van plan is de nieuwe CAO Universiteiten te omzeilen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen inzake de rijkssubsidie die gaat verdwijnen voor het doveninternaat in Haren

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked about the planned withdrawal of OCW subsidy for the deaf boarding school in Haren. The Secretary of State explained the funding history, said the OCW subsidy would be phased out from 2016/2017 pending a visit to the school, and described how care needs are now assessed and what the consequences for pupils would be.
At Mr Van Meenen's request, I have committed to first visit the boarding school before taking a final decision on phasing out the subsidy.
Op verzoek van de heer Van Meenen heb ik toegezegd eerst op bezoek te gaan bij het internaat, voordat ik een definitief besluit neem over de afbouw van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Leerwerkplekken in de knel door ontslagregels’

D66 MPs asked whether apprenticeship (BBL) contracts are exempt from the chain-employment rule and the transition payment, and how the transition payment affects training places. The minister answered that BBL contracts are exempt from the new chain rule, that they are not exempt from the transition payment but employers may deduct training costs under a new decree, and that the effect on training places will be monitored.
This has partly led the cabinet to decide, by general administrative order, that training costs may be deducted from the transition payment.
Dat heeft er mede toe geleid dat het kabinet heeft besloten om bij amvb te bepalen dat kosten van de opleiding in mindering kunnen worden gebracht op de transitievergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Leerling naar huis door invallerlimiet’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why school boards still resist replacing teachers despite the Wwz flexibility options, and whether the Wwz's entry into force in primary education should be delayed if the PO-Raad and unions fail to agree by 1 July 2015. The minister answers that board reactions stem from unfamiliarity with Wwz options, that the current CO primary education cao continues until 1 July 2016 under transitional law, and that boards may keep existing temporary-contract and min/max arrangements until then.
Reports from the PO-Raad and the unions of 1 May show that the parties have agreed not to conclude a new primary education collective agreement at this time.
Uit de berichtgeving van de PO-Raad en de bonden van 1 mei jl. blijkt dat partijen hebben afgesproken om op dit moment geen nieuwe cao voor het primair onderwijs af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘verwaarloosde kinderen op basisscholen’

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the state secretaries about a report that around 1,100 children arrive at school daily without basic necessities, and that many schools feed and clothe pupils themselves, asking about detection, referral to youth care and Veilig Thuis, and coordination with the VNG and PO-Raad. The government acknowledges the problem, points to municipal responsibility, the poverty-fighting funds and the verbindingsagenda, and says it will discuss the issue with partners without committing to new legal or institutional change.
Municipalities, as stated, have the means to provide the necessary support.
Gemeenten hebben zoals gezegd mogelijkheden om de benodigde ondersteuning te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg inzake de vastgelopen cao-onderhandelingen in het voortgezet onderwijs

MPs Van Meenen and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary for Education about stalled collective bargaining in secondary education, including the wage adjustment budget, whether lower ABP pension premiums created room for scholarships, and whether employers should pass the premium cut on to employees. The State Secretary answered that collective bargaining is decentralised, that employers decide how the cabinet contribution is used, and that he is not a party to the negotiations, declining to press employers and only promising to monitor developments.
That means it is up to the employers to decide how the cabinet contribution is used for the terms of employment.
Dat betekent dat het aan de werkgevers is om te bepalen op welke wijze de kabinetsbijdrage wordt ingezet voor de arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Rog over de bezorging van de centrale examens vo in mei 2015

Two MPs asked whether the Ministry's notice telling schools that closure on the exam-delivery day counts as not wishing to administer central exams was fair, and whether schools could receive redelivery. The State Secretary agreed with the substance to avoid theft risk, admitted the wording could have been clearer, but refused to guarantee redelivery except in cases of force majeure.
I regret that the notice on www.examenblad.nl led to irritation.
Ik betreur het dat de melding op www.examenblad.nl heeft geleid tot irritaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over Passend onderwijs in het mbo

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education whether the Albeda College structure class for autistic students may disappear for lack of funding, and how passend onderwijs in mbo is financed and monitored. The Minister says the college will offer the class next year, that no signals of funding shortages were received, and that institutions decide themselves how to spend the lump-sum funds without monitoring of activities.
I have not received any signals that such initiatives are threatened with disappearance due to a lack of funding.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen dat dergelijke initiatieven dreigen te verdwijnen door een gebrek aan financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het effect van de Wet Werk en Zekerheid op invalkrachten in het primair onderwijs

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Wwz labour law reform leaves primary schools without enough flexibility to cover sick-leave substitutes, and what guidance schools received. The minister said schools were informed via newsletters, listed available flexibility instruments (substitute pools, zero-hours and min/max contracts, CAO derogations), and stated pool membership and sizing figures while acknowledging it is not exactly determinable how large pools should be.
To let the transition around the amendment of the chain provision proceed smoothly, I have therefore also committed to providing information to education
Om de overgang rondom de wijziging van de ketenbepaling vloeiend te laten verlopen heb ik daarom ook toegezegd om voorlichting te geven aan het onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht dat scholen blijven werken met afgekeurde antipestmethoden

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the state secretary whether a report on rejected anti-bullying programmes exists, why it was not shared with parliament, and whether schools were being misled. The state secretary answered that no such report exists beyond the published assessment, that individual feedback to programme owners is confidential as business-sensitive, and that rejection does not mean a programme is harmful.
Regarding the individual feedback, the committee of the Dutch Youth Institute agreed with the programme owners that it would remain confidential.
Over de individuele feedback heeft de commissie van het Nederlands Jeugdinstituut met de programmaeigenaren afgesproken dat dit vertrouwelijk zou blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de dreigende teloorgang van kleinschalige, specialistische opleidingen

Van Meenen (D66) asks the Minister of Education why there is still no clarity on the future of the Dutch HealthTec Academy's small specialist vocational programmes, why the review of a national vocational institution is delayed, and what will happen to students and courses such as Onderwerkmaker, Schoenhersteller and Orthopedische Technieken. Minister Bussemaker says the consultation with stakeholders takes longer than planned, promises a letter to parliament in February with proposals, says her aim is to continue the programmes, and places first responsibility for current students on the regional colleges.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen en Schouten over de uitspraak van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden, die de Belastingdienst in het ongelijk stelde en bepaalde dat deelkwalificaties wel in aanmerking k

MPs Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen and Schouten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education about a Court of Appeal ruling that part-qualifications qualify for the education wage-tax reduction, including whether the Tax Service's corrections will be suspended, how firms are compensated, and whether bankruptcies or dropouts resulted. The government answered that it will file a cassation appeal before 29 January 2015, that corrections can be held pending the Supreme Court ruling on objection request, that refunds follow any Supreme Court outcome, and that it has no data on affected firms, students or bankruptcies.
I intend to file a cassation appeal against this ruling.
Ik ben voornemens om tegen deze uitspraak in cassatie te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de dreigende teloorgang van alfastudies

An MP asked the education minister about threatened cuts to humanities (alfa) programmes at the University of Amsterdam, the UvA holding company structure and whether student and staff participation is adequate. The minister answered that the faculty plans are still at discussion stage, denied that the holding routes teaching funds or sidelines the works council, and said she will discuss a plan with VSNU and others to protect unique language programmes.
I am of the view that the current regulations sufficiently guarantee transparency regarding the money flows within higher education.
Ik ben van mening dat de huidige regelgeving voldoende transparantie garandeert betreffende de geldstromen binnen het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het sectorplan primair onderwijs

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why the Jong en Oud subsidy in the primary education sector plan excludes young teachers who had a regular paid job in the previous six months, and whether this conflicts with teacher shortage goals. The minister answered that the condition is intended to target labour-market-vulnerable youth, that uptake so far is lagging (25.3 fte applications), and that changing the rules retroactively is undesirable.

An amendment of the Regulation as proposed is not desirable to me, because the measures for hiring vulnerable workers are specifically intended to offer opportunities to people at a distance from the labour market.

Een aanpassing van de Regeling zoals voorgesteld acht ik niet gewenst omdat de maatregelen voor indienstneming van kwetsbare werknemers, bij uitstek zijn bedoeld om personen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt kansen te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat beginnende leraren veel stress ervaren

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about research showing beginning teachers in urban schools experience high stress and whether the problem is broader and growing. The State Secretary acknowledged the research, pointed to ongoing measures in the Lerarenagenda and sector agreements to improve induction and reduce workload, and noted the promising Meesterschap programme.
The Lerarenagenda therefore includes a number of measures to improve the guidance of all beginning teachers.
In de Lerarenagenda is daarom een aantal maatregelen opgenomen om de begeleiding van alle beginnende leraren te verbeteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Rog over het bericht dat een docente de Tweede Kamer niet op de hoogte mocht stellen van fouten in rekentoetsen van het Cito

MPs Van Meenen and Rog asked whether teachers may be prevented from reporting alleged errors in Cito arithmetic tests to parliament, and whether the Wob refusal to disclose test items is justified. The Secretary of State answered that teachers may discuss errors but must not publish items online to protect reuse, that complaints go to the Examenloket, and that disclosure would harm the CvTE's statutory tasks; a fuller policy letter on access rights is promised for December.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen met betrekking tot onderwijs voor ernstig meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen, kinderen met forse gedragsproblematiek en kinderen met een (zware) verstandelijke beperki

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked how education for severely disabled children is funded from 1 January 2015, whether their right to passend onderwijs is guaranteed, and whether there is handling difficulty among providers and municipalities. The Secretary of State gave figures, explained the shift of care funding to the Jeugdwet, Zvw and Wlz, and said the government will monitor developments, without committing to new research.
I do not recognise the handling difficulty regarding referral to (v)so schools, but I will keep following developments.
Ik herken de handelingsverlegenheid ten aanzien van het doorverwijzen naar scholen voor het (v)so dan ook niet, maar ik zal de ontwikkelingen blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Schouw over de financiële problemen van scholen in het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs die te maken hebben met een grote toestroom aan asielkinderen

D66 MPs asked whether schools receiving large numbers of asylum-seeker children face financing problems linked to the funding system's limited enrolment measurement dates, and what action will be taken. The State Secretary says existing facilities are sufficient, will amend an application deadline for procedure-reception locations, is examining specific bottlenecks with the PO-raad, and is discussing intensified support with schools.
To make it possible for schools to use these facilities directly even after 1 July, I will amend this scheme so that schools can also submit an application at a later point in time.

Om het voor scholen mogelijk te maken ook na 1 juli direct van deze faciliteiten gebruik te kunnen maken, zal ik deze regeling aanpassen, zodat scholen ook op een later moment een aanvraag kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Meenen over naheffingen door de Belastingdienst over de afdrachtvermindering onderwijs

The MP asks the Minister of Education about tax back-assessments on the education wage-tax reduction (afdrachtvermindering onderwijs), including criteria, sums recovered, affected sectors, the Tax Authority's expertise, and the impact on good-faith firms. The Minister answers that back-assessments follow national enforcement of the rules, that about 70 million euro has been assessed with 80 million more announced, and that payment arrangements are available, but she declines to say how much will actually be collected or to assign expertise beyond the Tax Authority's own checks.
To what extent these assessments actually lead to payment cannot be stated at this time.
In hoeverre deze aanslagen daadwerkelijk tot betaling leiden is op dit moment niet aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de mogelijk abusievelijke verdubbeling van de vergoeding van de voorzitter van de Adviesraad voor Wetenschap en Techniek

An MP asked whether the chair of the Advisory Council for Science and Technology (AWT) received a salary increase after appointment and again in September 2014, and why a decision was published with an erroneous fee. The State Secretary answered that a temporary 0.1 FTE increase in 2013 was requested by the chair, that an erroneous calculation in an October 2014 Staatscourant publication was corrected, and that internal checks have been tightened.
Internal checks on decisions sent to the Staatscourant have now been tightened.
De interne controles op besluiten die naar de Staatscourant gaan, zijn inmiddels verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen c.s. over het bericht dat er zeer suggestieve vragen staan in de ‘Blikopener’-methode voor maatschappijleer op het VMBO

MPs asked whether the Blikopener social studies method for VMBO contains leading questions about Moroccan youth, headscarves and Islam, and reinforces gender stereotypes, and whether the method should be revised. The State Secretary answered that schools and teachers choose their own methods, that the content of methods is not for the government to judge, that there is no central quality control on methods beyond inspectorate oversight of coverage of attainment targets, and that the questions were not substantively addressed beyond referring back to the same general position.
It is not for me to assess the content of teaching methods or schools' choice of teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om de inhoud van lesmethodes of de keuze van scholen voor lesmethodes te beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake het feit dat aanbieders van een alternatieve eindtoets PO hun verantwoording voor 1 augustus 2014 moesten inleveren bij het ministerie om een goedkeuring te kunnen krijgen

An MP asked why providers of alternative primary-school final tests had to submit their documentation by 1 August 2014, the timing of the Toetswijzer, the independence of COTAN assessors and whether schools will really have a choice of tests. The Secretary of State answered that both applications are still incomplete, that the Expert Group will advise by 1 December, that a transitional arrangement and subsidy are in place, and that the central test will be checked by the CvTE, but gave no firm guarantee of choice.
Both test providers have been asked to supplement their application.
Beide toetsaanbieders is gevraagd hun aanvraag aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over naheffingen door de Belastingdienst over de afdrachtvermindering onderwijs

Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister of Education about tax authority recovery actions over misuse of the education wage-tax reduction (afdrachtvermindering onderwijs), including whether the tax authority assesses education quality without the Inspectorate. The minister answered that the Tax Authority only checks procedural and administrative requirements, that quality is the Inspectorate's responsibility, and that about 550 employers were corrected for roughly 47 million euro.
The Tax Authority checks the procedural and administrative requirements imposed on a (vocational) education programme.
De Belastingdienst controleert de procedurele en administratieve vereisten die aan een (mbo) opleiding worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over leerlingen in het vmbo en praktijkonderwijs die geen stage mogen lopen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why students without a permanent residence permit can only do compulsory internships in BOL vocational courses and not in vmbo, praktijkonderwijs or hbo. The minister acknowledged the exemption was an omission, said he would extend the exemption to praktijkonderwijs, vmbo maatwerk routes and similar tracks, but not to hbo.
This is an omission. Besides mbo, there are other secondary education routes specifically aimed at acquiring work-placement experience, so that an internship is an essential part of the course.

Dit is een omissie. Naast het mbo zijn er andere onderwijsroutes in het voortgezet onderwijs die specifiek gericht zijn op het opdoen van beroepspraktijkvorming waardoor stage een essentieel onderdeel van de opleiding vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat mbo-scholen onterecht schoolkosten in rekening blijven brengen

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Van Meenen (D66) asked the minister of Education about reports that vocational schools charge unlawful extra fees for mandatory activities, including a 600 euro trip, debt collection for voluntary contributions, and 70 complaints to JOB. The minister condemns it, says the inspectorate now checks school costs and will demand remedies, and restates the legal rule that only tuition may be mandatory and other contributions must be voluntary and clearly communicated.
Since September 2012, all regular inspections by the Inspectorate of Education examine school costs.
Sinds september 2012 wordt bij alle reguliere onderzoeken van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) naar schoolkosten gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat MBO scholen nee moeten verkopen

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether MBO schools are refusing students and introducing numerus fixus due to a shortage of internship and apprenticeship places, and what measures will address it. The Minister confirmed some schools use numerus fixus, stated that limiting intake is justified when no internships exist, said the shortage is partly temporary and regional, and pointed to existing regional approaches and the studiebijsluiter, without committing to new concrete measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de negatieve gevolgen van de geldverdelingssystematiek bij de VU voor goede bèta-opleidingen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the funding allocation at the VU that threatens good beta programmes and whether student councils have advisory or consent rights over it. The Minister said budget allocation is the university board's responsibility, cited the WHW advisory powers of the university council, and said no signals of students being unable to finish programmes had reached her.
I cannot intervene in the substantive choices made or being made and in the conclusions attached to the consultation that has taken place or is taking place.
Ik kan niet treden in de inhoudelijke keuzes die daarbij zijn of worden gemaakt en de conclusies die aan het gevoerde overleg zijn of worden verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de telsystematiek voor educatiebudgetten

MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how education budgets for municipalities are calculated, including the definition and counting of educational trajectories and whether different counting methods lead to unequal budget distribution. The Minister answered that budgets are based on four indicators, that municipalities and regional vocational colleges (roc's) define and count trajectories themselves within broad policy freedom, and that a uniform definition and new regional allocation system are being prepared in a bill for 2015.
Municipalities and roc's make mutual agreements on the content of the offered educational trajectories, for example regarding the number of teaching hours.
Gemeenten en roc's maken onderling afspraken over de invulling van de aangeboden educatietrajecten, bijvoorbeeld met betrekking tot het aantal onderwijsuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht 'Salaris bestuurder mbo wordt afhankelijk van aantal studenten'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education about a report that vocational college (mbo) board salaries would depend on student numbers, and whether this encourages enlarging institutions, how the salary bands work, and how this relates to a motion for a collective labour agreement and to rules in other education sectors. The Minister answered that the sector's self-regulatory pay code uses student numbers as a guiding framework under the statutory WNT maximum, that boards of supervision are responsible for applying it, that a table of salary bands is provided, and that the code will be monitored with possible future ministerial regulation.
The supervisory boards are responsible for applying and enforcing the norms.
De raden van toezicht zijn verantwoordelijk voor toepassing en handhaving van de normen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat het aantal laaggeletterden snel stijgt

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister about reports that functional illiteracy is rising quickly, including labour-market shortages, the role of women, and measures for 45-65 year olds. The minister replied that the Action Plan on Functional Illiteracy, municipal adult-education funding, pilots and a motion-backed €5 million annually address the issue, with no sign of executive power or oversight being at stake.
Women are unfortunately overrepresented among functionally illiterate people.
Vrouwen zijn helaas oververtegenwoordigd onder laaggeletterden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Mei Li Vos over de perverse prikkels in de wetenschap

MPs Van Meenen and Mei Li Vos asked the state secretary about the Science in Transition pamphlet on perverse incentives in academia, including publication pressure, business-science entanglement, and proposed reforms. The government acknowledged the concerns, defended quality and international rankings, said it will consider stakeholder involvement and await the IBO Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek before deciding on funding changes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Meenen over de Amsterdamse inspectie

MPs Rog and Van Meenen asked whether Amsterdam's municipal Kwaliteitsbureau, which inspects school quality alongside the national inspectorate, is an unwelcome extra layer and a limit on school freedom. The Secretary of State replied that participation is voluntary, the bureau is independent, the inspectorate's judgement remains decisive, and the bureau costs about EUR 600,000 a year, to be evaluated after four years.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het zorgwekkende rendementsdenken in het hoger onderwijs

Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister of Education about a study finding that binding study advice (BSA) does not work, about limits on the validity of exam results at Leiden and Windesheim, and about Hogeschool De Kempel's four-attempt exclusion rule. The Minister rejected the study's conclusions as limited, said the institutional validity limits are for institutions to set, and noted that De Kempel withdrew its rule as contrary to law.
I have no reason to assume that this institutional task will be placed in a different light by the above measures.
Ik heb geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat deze taak van de instelling in een ander perspectief komt te staan met bovenstaande maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis, Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat studenten van Inholland problemen ervaren bij het afronden van hun studie

MPs Mohandis, Van Dijk and Van Meenen asked whether Inholland's tightened graduation requirements are leaving students unable to finish, and what compensation is available. The minister answered that Inholland's extra support measures are adequate, that she does not expect large numbers to be stranded, and that students can seek support from the profileringsfonds or claim damages under general law.
I consider the measures taken by Hogeschool Inholland (see my answer to question 2 above) sufficient.
Ik acht de maatregelen die zijn getroffen door Hogeschool Inholland (zie hiervoor mijn antwoord op vraag 2 hierboven) voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de omvang van het vermeend oneigenlijk gebruik van de afdrachtvermindering onderwijs (WVA)

An MP asked the education minister how large the alleged improper use of the education wage-tax reduction (WVA) is, and why the planned EUR 200 million cut appears to exceed that abuse. The minister replied that no reliable estimate of excess tax relief exists, that a new study is not opportune, and that the cut restores the original budget level rather than targeting abuse.
Data on this are not available.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Van Meenen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Vanaf de gracht brallen over leiderschap in het onderwijs» (ingezonden 7 juni 201

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about a newspaper report on consultancy firms influencing school leadership, including their effectiveness, spending on external advisers, and the ministry's ties to CBE. The state secretary said school boards are responsible for hiring advisers, the ministry does not track such spending, and it reported small CBE payments and general external hiring costs.
The department has no insight into this kind of specific spending by education institutions.
Het departement heeft geen inzicht in dit soort specifieke uitgaven van onderwijsinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Meenen en Berendsen inzake het profielwerkstuk “De Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag”

MPs from D66 asked the state secretaries of Education and Justice about young people's awareness of the Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and whether education could deter crime, citing a student survey. The government acknowledges the low awareness, notes that only 650 youth applications were refused in 2012 and that the lookback period for adolescents was shortened, and commits to an information newsletter, awareness work with the CSV, and further outreach.
We endorse the importance of tailored information for young people about the existence of the VOG and the consequences a refusal may have for future study, internship or employment.
Wij onderschrijven het belang van voorlichting op maat aan de jongeren over het bestaan van de VOG en de gevolgen die een weigering hiervan kan hebben voor een toekomstige studie, stage of baan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat één op de vijf stagiairs wordt uitgescholden

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education about reports that one in five interns is verbally abused during placements, and about the adequacy of internship supervision, placement numbers and responsibility for them. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to institutions' legal duty to supervise interns and to monitoring of placement quality by the inspectorate, and said businesses and schools must act, with a broader policy response left to them.
We will therefore monitor per institution whether the supervision of placements is of sufficient quality.
We gaan daarom per instelling monitoren of de begeleiding van stages van voldoende kwaliteit is.
Antwoord vragen leden Rog en Van Meenen over het belang van Nederlandse taal- en cultuurscholen in het buitenland

MPs Rog and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about the closure of state subsidy for Dutch language and culture schools abroad, and whether this threatens access and creates later language gaps for returning children. The state secretary replied that parents and employers should bear the cost, that the subsidy cut will be absorbed by school boards and parents, and that he will talk to employers and consider a role for the Inspectorate.
The cabinet chose, in filling the spending target, to spare education at schools as much as possible.
Het kabinet heeft er bij de invulling van de taakstelling voor gekozen het onderwijs op scholen zoveel mogelijk te ontzien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Wachtlijsten op de voorschool groeien’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports that waiting lists for pre-school education for children at risk of language delay are growing, and about how many such children are affected and what will be done. The government calls the growing waiting lists worrying, says it cannot determine how many target-group children are waiting, estimates about 45,000 target children, and places the duty to provide places on municipalities, with the Inspectorate of Education supervising, promising a joint letter before summer.
It is up to the municipalities to organise this; they also hold the instruments to resolve this at local level.
Het is aan de gemeenten om dit te organiseren; zij hebben ook de instrumenten in handen om dit op lokaal niveau op te lossen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de subsidieregeling ter vervanging van de Afdrachtvermindering Onderwijs

MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the education minister about the replacement subsidy for the abolished Afdrachtvermindering Onderwijs, its timing, employment effects and the EUR 200 million cut. The minister answered that contours were sent to parliament that day, the scheme starts 1 January 2014, and the budget will be targeted to support apprenticeships and reduce youth unemployment.
Today you receive the promised letter with the outlines of the scheme.
Vandaag ontvangt u de toegezegde brief met de contouren van de regeling.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat Iraanse studenten worden gediscrimineerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Meenen asked whether Iranian students are excluded from some courses despite a Supreme Court ruling, and how the government will respond. The minister answers that the nuclear knowledge embargo implementation will be revised before summer, that 13 exemption requests were filed with 7 refused, and that she sees no reason to apologise or compensate.

We intend to work with the higher education institutions in the short term toward a comprehensive revision of the national implementation of the UN knowledge embargo, so as to address both the Supreme Court ruling and UN Security Council Resolution 1737.

Wij zijn voornemens om in overleg met de Hoger Onderwijs instellingen op korte termijn te komen tot een integrale herziening van de nationale uitwerking van het VN-kennisembargo, zodat tegemoet wordt gekomen aan zowel het arrest van de Hoge Raad als de VN-Veiligheidsraadsresolutie 1737.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen over selectie aan de poort bij steeds meer universitaire studies, naar aanleiding van het antwoord op eerdere vragen d.d. 22 maart 2013

An MP asks the minister how her earlier position that capacity limits are not used to select the best students squares with statements by universities that selection at the gate improves study success and meets performance targets. The minister answers that selection needs an objective reason, that selection is not a tool to raise instruction quality, and that law faculties' capacity limits are not yet shown to be necessary given available places.
There must be an objective reason for selection. I will come with criteria to assess that reason, as I announced in the bill 'Quality in Diversity'.
Er moet wel een objectieve aanleiding zijn voor de selectie. Ik kom met criteria om die aanleiding te kunnen beoordelen, zoals ik heb aangekondigd in het wetsvoorstel «Kwaliteit in Verscheidenheid».
Vragen van het lid Van Meenen (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over selectie aan de poort bij steeds meer universitaire studies (ingezonden 31 januari 2013).
