MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the education minister about the growing use of selection at the gate for university programmes and whether capacity limits are being used as a back door to selection. Minister Bussemaker answered that selection will only occur where applications exceed places, that she does not see capacity limits as a back door, that selection should not be used to raise teaching quality, and that she will monitor misuse and set criteria for objectively justified selection.

I will closely monitor the use of the back route through the VSNU, the HBO council and, where necessary, individual institutions, and hold them to account if capacity limits are used when quality is not under pressure.

Gebruik van de sluiproute zal ik scherp in de gaten houden door de VSNU, de HBO-raad en zonodig individuele instellingen aan te spreken op het hanteren van een capaciteitsbeperkingen als de kwaliteit niet onder druk staat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Van Meenen over het bericht dat buitenlandse studenten onterecht een aanmaning voor een zorgverzekering ontvangen

MPs Dijkstra and Van Meenen asked whether foreign students were wrongly sent demands to take out Dutch health insurance, with fines, and whether this could be changed. The minister answered that students registered with DUO are not targeted, that students who work alongside their studies are rightly insured, that fines are withdrawn or refunded once students respond, and that the government will improve communication and an English-language form but will not exempt students with small jobs.
If the student responds to the CVZ or SVB after the letter, no fine is imposed at all.
Als de student na de aanschrijving van het CVZ reageert naar het CVZ of de SVB, dan wordt er in het geheel geen boete opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat de Cito-toets 2013 te koop is via Marktplaats

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the 2013 Cito test was being sold on Marktplaats and whether its questions had leaked, how this happened, and what steps would be taken. The state secretary confirmed the leak, said the cause was unknown and under investigation by Cito, and said the government is not a party in the current arrangement, so responsibility lies with Cito; security would become a government task only if the pending bill on a central final test is passed.
In the current situation the government is not a party.
In de huidige situatie is de overheid geen partij.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Veldhoven over de kwartaalrapportage van het OV loket waarin wordt gesteld dat studenten onredelijk worden behandeld bij een defecte OV-chipkaart

Two D66 MPs asked why students get no replacement OV-chipkaart at counters while other travellers do, citing an ombudsman report calling this unequal and unnecessary. The minister answered that privacy rules prevent carriers from verifying student status, that these rules will not change, and that only faster replacement is being explored.
For students this service is not possible with any carrier, for privacy reasons.
Voor studenten is deze service om privacyredenen bij geen enkele vervoerder mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake het bericht dat studenten worden geremd in hun ambitie

An MP asked the minister about a student facing 60,000 euro in institutional tuition for a second medical degree, whether such cases stack up, whether the rule change was fair, whether it is a flaw for biomedical graduates, and whether it deters ambitious students in health and teaching. The state secretary answered that the exception for second studies in health and education is for labour market shortages, that institutions set institutional tuition with works-council advice, that the rules date from 2010 with a planned evaluation, and that the policy aims to encourage students in these sectors.
It is up to each institution to determine, with reasons, which institutional tuition it charges students.
Het is aan elke instelling om gemotiveerd te bepalen welk instellingscollegegeld zij studenten in rekening brengt.

m: Motie van het lid Albert de Vries over de kwaliteitsborging voor het verbouwen en restaureren van rijksmonumenten

The minister said the Kustpact will set zoning, that the derogation decision will be made carefully under the legal test without pre-judging outcomes, and that local procedures and the municipal council will weigh local views.
I will take a decision on the derogation request as soon as possible, carefully weighing the presence of special circumstances and the national interests to be served.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk een besluit nemen over het ontheffingsverzoek, waarbij ik de aanwezigheid van bijzondere omstandigheden en de te dienen nationale belangen zorgvuldig zal wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Albert de Vries en Brouwer over het bericht ‘Geef grenswerkers belastingkorting’

MPs Albert de Vries and Brouwer asked whether the government would tackle tax and social security differences that create uncertainty for cross-border workers and would adopt expat-style tax relief for them. The ministers answered that the government relies on information provision and existing compensation schemes, that harmonisation is not feasible, and that the action team's agenda will be followed up.

The cabinet and the border regions are strongly focusing on optimising information provision for cross-border workers on tax and social insurance differences, so that the differences become transparent.

Het kabinet en de grensregio’s zetten voor fiscale verschillen en verschillen in sociale verzekeringsstelsels fors in op het optimaliseren van de informatievoorziening voor grenswerkers, zodat de verschillen inzichtelijk worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Van der Linde, Albert de Vries en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat er chaos dreigt door nieuwe zienswijze van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

Four MPs asked the Minister for Housing and Government Service, on behalf of the Finance Minister, about the AFM's new view that mortgages must be tested against the lending norms in force when the binding offer is issued rather than at application, which could cause chaos for applicants. The Minister answered that a transition period until 1 February 2017 was agreed with the sector and the WEW for applications filed before 2017, that the AFM will take this into account in supervision, and that the timing of tests is a matter of clarifying the MCD-based rules.
For mortgage applications submitted before 1 January 2017 where the creditworthiness test for the binding offer takes place by 1 February 2017 at the latest, the 2016 lending norms may be applied.

Voor hypotheekaanvragen die zijn ingediend voor 1 januari 2017 waarbij de kredietwaardigheidstoets ten behoeve van het bindend aanbod uiterlijk 1 februari 2017 plaatsvindt, er met de leennormen van 2016 mag worden gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over huurtoeslag voor studenten

An MP asks whether student rent allowance (huurtoeslag) for students in shared-house-number accommodation is at risk because the BAG address register only records self-contained units, and whether tenants will keep their advance payments. The minister answers that entitlement does not change, that specified student complexes will be handled separately, that wrongly granted allowance will not be recovered, and that the Belastingdienst will take up the issues with priority.
As indicated in the answers to the previous questions, the right to rent allowance does not change.
Zoals in de antwoorden op de vragen hiervoor aangegeven wordt, verandert het recht op huurtoeslag niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het project Brouwerseiland

MPs Cegerek, Albert de Vries and Jan Vos asked the minister about the Brouwerseiland recreation project, covering Natura 2000 protection, nitrogen limits, the Kustpact, recreation oversupply, noise barriers, displaced recreation and participation. The minister replied that the Barro exemption and Nb-wet permit are handled by the competent authorities, with the Kustpact still pending and remaining decisions left to the province and municipality.

Beyond the national interests named in the Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte and the Barro, it is the responsibility of decentralised governments, for good spatial planning, to determine the need for space and weigh it.

Buiten de in de Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte en in het Barro benoemde rijksbelangen is het ten behoeve van de goede ruimtelijke ordening de verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden om de ruimtebehoefte te bepalen en hiervoor een afweging te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Vermue en Albert de Vries over berichten dat er steun van Europa te verwachten is voor twee goederenspoorverbindingen die de Zeeuwse havens kunnen aansluiten op het spoorwegnet v

Opposition PvdA MPs asked whether EU co-funding for two Zeeland rail links to the Antwerp and Ghent ports was realistic, and whether the government would join talks with the EU coordinator. The state secretary replied that cost-benefit analyses found the links socially unprofitable, that no EU co-funding has been signalled, and that a capacity analysis with Zeeland Seaports and ProRail is under way with results expected in early 2017.
Cost-benefit analyses were carried out for the additional rail link Axel–Zelzate (canal zone Ghent–Terneuzen) and the rail link between Antwerp and Vlissingen (VEZA arc).
Er zijn kosten baten analyses uitgevoerd voor de (extra) spoorverbinding Axel – Zelzate (kanaal zone Gent Terneuzen) en de spoorverbinding tussen Antwerpen en Vlissingen (VEZA boog).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht ‘Groot tekort aan woningbouwlocaties’

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about an EIB report finding too few 'hard' housing sites to meet household growth to 2025, including the risk of overplanning, the role of the Ladder for Sustainable Urbanisation and the government's systemic responsibility. The Minister broadly agrees with the EIB on regional shortages, says local authorities hold the primary responsibility, and points to support measures (expert teams, annual talks, simplified Ladder) without committing to mandatory overplanning targets or regional reporting.
I do not have figures on the extent to which plans have been formally adopted by the authorities. That fits the decentralised character of spatial planning policy.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over in hoeverre plannen bestuurlijk zijn vastgesteld. Dat past bij het decentrale karakter van het ruimtelijke ordeningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de verhuur van woonruimte aan studenten door “The Student Hotel”

An MP asked the minister whether Student Hotel rentals to students, which resemble regular student housing, fall outside tenant rent and eviction protection as short-term use. The minister answered that courts and the rent commission decide case by case, the state has no enforcement role, and municipalities decide on hotel versus housing permits.
The national government has no enforcement task on this point.
Het rijk heeft op dit punt geen handhavende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Albert de Vries Albert over spoedeisende medische zorg op zee

MPs Vermue and Albert de Vries asked the ministers of Health and of Justice and Security about emergency medical care at sea, including whether the Zeeland provincial government's concerns are shared and whether a RIVM norm for sea rescue should be developed. Minister Schippers replied that the government is examining with the Infrastructure minister what sea medical care can learn from land care, with a response on the Safety Board report promised before year end, and she set out existing maritime rescue care norms and the division of responsibilities.
Before the end of the year the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment will respond on behalf of the government to the Safety Board report and send that response to the House.
Voor het einde van het jaar zal de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu namens de regering reageren op het rapport van de Onderzoeksraad en deze reactie aan de Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de praktijk van verhuurdersverklaringen

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about rental landlord statements (verhuurdersverklaringen), including their evidentiary basis, duration, refusal of tenants, legal protection and the need for regulation. The Minister answers that the Dutch data protection law sets care requirements, tenants can request correction and add their own views, but sees no need for legislative or other measures.
I therefore see no reason to take legislative or other measures.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding wetgevende of andere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het aanmerken van woningen met een aardgasaansluiting als nul-op-de-meter woning

MP Albert de Vries asked the Minister for Housing about the planned extension of the energy performance allowance to homes with a gas connection, the consistency with the Stroomversnelling deal, grid costs and the risk of slowing innovation. The minister defends allowing gas-connected near-zero homes provided the gas use is compensated by on-site renewable generation, commits to periodic evaluation and to a consultation on district heat, and dismisses the innovation and grid-cost concerns.

I am willing to also enable an energy performance allowance for very energy-efficient homes that have a gas connection, on the condition that the limited fossil energy still used for heating the home is compensated by renewable energy generation.

Ik ben bereid om ook voor zeer energiezuinige woningen die een aardgasaansluiting hebben een energieprestatievergoeding mogelijk te maken, waarbij voorwaarde is dat de beperkte fossiele energie die nog voor de verwarming van de woning gebruikt wordt, wordt gecompenseerd door duurzame energieopwekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht "Woningtekort dreigt door droog koken nieuwbouwmarkt"

An MP asks the ministers whether the shortage of new housing, shown by falling building permits, requires stronger central government action, rising prices, reform of the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation, and easier land acquisition for municipalities. The minister answers that housing supply is primarily a local responsibility, cites existing measures such as tax relief, expert teams and a planned simplification of the Ladder, and rejects restricting zelfrealisatie as a route to faster construction.
Responsibility for the quantitative development of the housing stock and for taking measures on it lies at the local level.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwantitatieve ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad en het treffen van maatregelen daarop ligt op het lokale niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de beloning van directeuren van woningcorporaties boven de wettelijke norm

Two PvdA MPs asked whether housing corporation directors earning above the WNT pay norm, including those not covered by the transitional rules, would be brought under the norm and whether the norm is justified. The minister answered that accountant reports for 2015 will be checked by the Autoriteit woningcorporaties, that transitional rules protect existing contracts, and that the current maxima are considered appropriate.

When checking the 2015 accountant reports of the various corporations, it will be determined whether the top officials mentioned in the article still fall under the transitional rules based on the annual reports approved by the accountant.

Antwoord 2 Bij de controle van de accountantsrapporten over 2015 van de verschillende corporaties zal worden vastgesteld of de in het artikel genoemde topfunctionarissenvallen op grond van de door de account goedgekeurde jaarverslagen nog steeds onder het overgangsrecht vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Vermue en Bisschop over de veiligheid van binnen- en zeevaart op de Westerschelde

MPs asked whether shipping safety on the Westerschelde is adequate and whether a speed limit for sea-going vessels should be imposed after complaints from inland skippers about wash damage. The minister acknowledges the concerns, describes existing separation measures and evaluation mechanisms, argues a speed limit would not solve the problem and could worsen safety, and says the issue will be discussed in the existing nautical platform.
Imposing a speed limit may actually adversely affect safety on the Westerschelde.
Het opleggen van een snelheidsbeperking kan de veiligheid op de Westerschelde juist nadelig beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Marcouch over huuropzegging wegens langdurig verblijf in het buitenland

MPs De Vries and Marcouch asked the Minister for Housing about tenancy terminations for long stays abroad, including the term 'housing fraud', the grounds for dissolving leases, the lack of statutory minimum occupancy rules, information for tenants, and risk of arbitrary enforcement. The minister answered that the term has no legal consequence, that landlords set occupancy rules contractually and courts decide case by case, and that no new regulation is needed.
I see no need to introduce further regulation on this point.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om op dit punt met nadere regelgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de stijging van huren in de vrije sector

The MP asks the Minister about rising rents in the private rental sector, the effect of the Supreme Court ruling on intermediary fees, whether rent regulation is needed, and tenant protection and oversight. The Minister disputes the Pararius rent-rise figures, says the ruling benefits tenants, and commits to discussing rent moderation with commercial landlords and reporting later this year.
I will inform you of the outcome of this consultation later this year.
Ik zal u over het resultaat van dit overleg later dit jaar berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over de ontmanteling van kerncentrale Borssele

MPs Jan Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Borssele nuclear plant is loss-making and needs a 200 million euro capital injection, and whether a nuclear decommissioning strategy and study could be completed within two months. The minister replied that EPZ makes no loss because shareholders must buy its electricity at cost, that a study of the nuclear knowledge infrastructure is under way and will conclude in autumn, and that the cabinet will inform parliament on the plant's future shortly.
As I previously promised, the cabinet will inform your House shortly about the future of the nuclear plant in light of DELTA's financial situation.
Zoals ik eerder heb toegezegd, zal het kabinet uw Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de toekomst van de kerncentrale in het licht van de financiële situatie van DELTA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Vermue en Albert de Vries over de alternatieven voor het nieuwe hoogspanningstraject in Zeeland

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about alternative routings for a new high-voltage line in Zeeland proposed by D-Cision, including whether the existing 150 kV line will fail by 2020 and whether the minister will consult the province and municipalities. The minister confirmed awareness, argued the existing line need not be upgraded for 10 to 15 years, said the preferred route remains best, and promised to assess the proposal's effects and inform the House before summer 2016.
As I indicated during the General Consultation on 20 April 2016, I am currently working to map the effects of this.
Zoals ik tijdens het Algemeen Overleg op 20 april 2016 heb aangeven ben ik momenteel bezig om de effecten hiervan in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over onterechte huren boven de liberalisatiegrens

An MP asks the minister whether unlawfully liberalised rents above the liberalisation threshold are widespread, whether tenants are adequately informed of their rights and of the rent-check route, and whether a one-off review of liberalised contracts should be introduced. The minister answers that Huurcommissie data show a limited number of disputed cases, that existing information channels and court routes suffice, and that no extra review is needed, while noting a sector-wide reform will limit liberalisation going forward.
I do not have data on possibly unlawfully liberalised rental contracts.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over mogelijk onterecht geliberaliseerde huurcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Albert de Vries en Vermeij over de overname van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ) door het Erasmus MC

Three PvdA MPs asked the health minister about Erasmus MC's planned takeover of ADRZ hospital in Zeeland, including effects on care access, cooperation with Zorgsaam, patient information and continuity in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. The minister answered that the takeover is not yet decided, pointed to review by the NZa and ACM and to the joint Zeeland care vision, and said the outcome of the planned hospital cooperation would be clear before summer.
There is currently a planned takeover; the decision that ADRZ continues as an independent holding within Erasmus MC is not yet final.
Er is op dit moment sprake van een voornemen tot overname, de beslissing dat ADRZ als zelfstandige holding binnen het Erasmus MC door gaat is nog niet definitief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht ‘het energielabel misverstand van minister Blok’

MP Albert de Vries asked whether the Commission's withdrawal of an infringement procedure meant the Dutch energy label fully complies with EU rules and that a fine threat is gone, and whether the Commission's letter could be shared. Minister Blok answered that the procedure closed as full transposition of the EPBD, that a second fine-related phase on implementation remains, and that no separate letter on the closure exists.
No letter was provided on the closure of infringement procedure 2012/0388.
Er is geen brief verstrekt over de sluiting van inbreukprocedure 2012/0388.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermue en Albert de Vries over het inkomen van de algemeen directeur van energiebedrijf Delta

PvdA MPs asked whether the salary increase for Delta's general director, which staff opposed, is acceptable given losses and public ownership, and whether shareholders should intervene. The government answered that Delta is exempt from the WNT pay cap because it is a company, that shareholders should act, that the WNT scope will be revised, and that the company's network split leaves WNT application unchanged.
Government shareholdings in NVs and BVs have been kept outside the WNT by the legislator, on the reasoning that the government could sufficiently influence pay policy through its shareholding.

Overheidsdeelnemingen in NV's en BV's zijn door de wetgever (in algemene zin) buiten de WNT gehouden op grond van de overweging dat de overheid via de lijn van het aandeelhouderschap het beloningsbeleid voldoende zou kunnen beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de sloop van goedkope huurwoningen in Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister whether Rotterdam's plan to demolish about 20,000 cheap rental homes, and the effects on low-income access, was acceptable. The Minister confirmed the figures but said the plans are local matters for the municipality, declined to comment on substance, and gave no concrete action.
It is not my role as Minister to respond substantively to the plans as described in the Rotterdam municipality's housing vision.
Het is niet mijn rol als Minister om inhoudelijk te reageren op de plannen zoals omschreven in de Woonvisie van de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over de aankondiging van ING om te stoppen met het aanbieden van hypotheken voor woonboten

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether ING's decision to stop offering mortgages for houseboats, leaving only Rabobank, would harm buyers and owners and what would be done about it. The minister confirmed the decision, said existing customers are unaffected, and said the market is complex and new entrants may appear, with consultation of the Dutch banking association planned.
Consultation will be held with the Dutch Banking Association and they will be asked whether they have ideas on how more providers of houseboat mortgages can enter the market.

Er zal overleg worden gevoerd met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en worden gevraagd of zij ideeën hebben over hoe ervoor kan worden gezorgd dat er meer aanbieders van woonboothypotheken op de markt kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over banken die niet meewerken aan het oversluiten van een hypotheek waardoor klanten niet van de lage rente kunnen profiteren

MPs Nijboer and Albert de Vries asked the Finance Minister about banks that refuse to help mortgage holders refinance to benefit from low rates, including those with pension or benefit income, and whether banks should be obliged to accept such clients. The minister answered that refinancing can be in the client's interest but depends on individual factors, rejected a duty to accept all refinancing requests as harmful to competition, and described voluntary measures such as rate smoothing and a banking trust monitor, while the AFM had no concrete signals of advisers misinforming clients.
I would therefore not want to advocate that credit providers be obliged to accept a client who wants to refinance their mortgage.
Ik zou er dan ook niet voor willen pleiten dat kredietverstrekkers verplicht een klant moeten accepteren die zijn hypotheek wil oversluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Günal-Gezer, Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht 'Amper profijt Zeeuwse bedrijven bij bouw marinierskazerne'

Three PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers whether tender specifications for the marine barracks construction could favour regional firms in Zeeland, and why such room is possible in other public tenders but not here. The minister answered that favouring local firms through specification requirements is not permitted under procurement law, and that regional businesses can instead take part via consortia or as subcontractors.
Making room for local businesses in the programme of requirements leads to favouring those businesses and is not permitted.
Ruimte maken voor lokale bedrijven in het programma van eisen leidt tot bevoordeling van deze bedrijven en is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Albert de Vries over het gevaar van betonblokken

MPs Cegerek and Albert de Vries asked whether concrete blocks containing waste (including lead-containing cathode-ray tube glass and fluorescent tubes) pose risks to people and the environment, how many accidents occurred, and whether stricter controls are needed. The State Secretary answered that cathode-ray tube glass processing is a permitted practice, that the RIVM advises against it, that existing permits are not criminal, that new insights will be shared with the regional authorities and the third national waste plan, and that the only reported accident is with the public prosecutor, so no conclusion on stricter controls can be drawn.

I will present the new insights to the environmental services that are the competent authorities for the producers of concrete blocks and will also include these insights in the upcoming third National Waste Management Plan (LAP3).

Ik zal de nieuwe inzichten voorleggen aan de omgevingsdiensten die bevoegd gezag zijn voor de producenten van betonblokken en deze inzichten tevens opnemen in het komende derde Landelijk Afvalbeheerplan (LAP3).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Günal-Gezer en Albert de Vries over het bericht 'Amper profijt Zeeuwse bedrijven bij bouw marinierskazerne'

MPs Günal-Gezer and Albert de Vries asked the Defence Minister why the Vlissingen marine barracks tender was structured as an all-in DBFMO contract, which they said sidelined Zeeland firms, and whether regional firms could be guaranteed work. The minister answered that a PPC chose DBFMO for fair competition, that delays stem from added defence requirements and site surveys, that law prevents favouring regional firms, and that the project will create over 1,700 direct jobs.
This method of procurement guarantees fair and free competition, so favouring or disadvantaging companies in a particular region is ruled out.
Deze wijze van aanbesteden garandeert eerlijke en vrije concurrentie, waardoor het bevoordelen of benadelen van bedrijven in een bepaalde regio is uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kerstens inzake de onlangs afgesloten schikking van woningcorporatie Vestia met een oud-bestuurder

MPs Albert de Vries and Kerstens asked the minister how the settlement between Vestia and former CEO Staal was reached and whether it is an acceptable outcome given the damage. The minister acknowledges the damage and the unsatisfying outcome, but argues the settlement is the maximum achievable and that the Vestia board, under supervision, made a reasoned decision; he has no means to undo it and points to existing supervisory principles.
I have no means to undo such civil-law settlements.
Ik heb geen middelen om dergelijke civielrechtelijke schikkingen ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de vertraging in de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel kwaliteitsborging bouw

An MP asks why the building quality assurance bill has been delayed, whether regulatory burden or market signals are behind it, and what its goals and timetable are. The minister says the delay reflects pending regulatory-burden and cost-benefit studies and stakeholder talks, that the bill covers about 53% of permit-required works in the lowest consequence class (not 80%), and that he still intends to submit it soon.
I still intend to send the bill to your House soon.
Ik heb nog steeds het voornemen om het wetsvoorstel spoedig naar uw Kamer te sturen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over bouwkeurmerken in relatie tot aardbevingsbestendigheid

Two MPs asked whether earthquake risk in Groningen is factored into construction certification (KOMO, KIWA) and CE marking, and whether the sector can build earthquake-resistant. The minister answered that certificates cover material strength independent of load type, earthquake resistance is assessed through project-specific structural calculations, and a Groningen-specific regulation (NPR) is planned to be designated in the Bouwbesluit in early 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de wijze waarop hypotheekverstrekkers omgaan met herbeoordelingen van het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Kerstens and De Vries asked whether mortgage lenders are excluding the full Wajong benefit from income calculations because of possible 5% reductions under the Participatiewet, and whether the minister would negotiate with lenders. The state secretary replied that a reduction would not justify excluding the whole benefit, that the NHG website was corrected, that 53 NHG loans with Wajong income were granted in 2015, and that banks generally count benefits that are permanent or guaranteed for their duration.
I share your view that the possible reduction of the Wajong benefit from 2018 should not lead to the entire benefit no longer being counted in a mortgage granting.
Ik deel uw mening dat de mogelijke verlaging van de Wajong uitkering vanaf 2018 er niet toe zou moeten leiden dat de gehele uitkering niet meer wordt meegenomen bij een hypotheekverstrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de risico’s van koolmonoxidevergiftiging door cv-installaties

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about the risks of carbon monoxide poisoning from central heating installations, including the OvV findings, public testing data for CO detectors, a mandatory installer certification scheme, and European appliance standards. The government answers almost every question by saying a cabinet position will follow in spring 2016, while acknowledging that the OvV finding that many incidents occur in young and serviced appliances revises the existing picture.
Currently the Minister of VWS and I are working on a cabinet position that will respond to the report.
Momenteel werken de minster van VWS en ik aan een kabinetsstandpunt waarin een reactie op het rapport wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Albert de Vries over het bericht 'Zeeland beter af met een Intercity'

MPs Hoogland and Albert de Vries asked the State Secretary about a report claiming Zeeland would benefit from an Intercity stopping only at the three largest stations and about related rail options. The State Secretary called the report a rough quickscan, said the options could be discussed in the regional public transport table, and declined to endorse the claimed figures without further study.
Without research, no accurate statement can be made about this.
Zonder onderzoek is hier geen nauwkeurige uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over de splitsing van DELTA en de positie van kerncentrale Borssele

MPs Jan Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the planned split of DELTA, the one-year transition period set by the regulator ACM, and the future ownership of the Borssele nuclear plant, including the Van Gent motion and nationalisation options. The minister answered that the ACM will decide on a enforcement order with a transition period by year-end, that the state retains tools (Electricity Act, nuclear law, Borssele covenants) to block unwanted changes of control, and that he will not comment on nationalisation beyond referring to the earlier answers.
I aim to ensure that the position of the Borssele nuclear power plant remains well safeguarded in all cases.
Ik streef ernaar dat de positie van de kerncentrale Borssele in alle gevallen goed geborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Koolmees, Ronnes en Van der Linde over aankoop van Dekemahiem door Vereniging Doarpskorporaasje Jirnsum

MPs asked the minister whether housing corporation Elkien's plan to demolish 24 affordable homes for elderly and starters in Jirnsum without rebuilding, and the sale to a village cooperative, required an Inspectorate review and a residual valuation, and why the process took so long. The minister answered that local housing policy is for the municipality, that sales to third parties need the regulator's consent at no less than market value, that the residual valuation request was refused, that the earlier rules applied, and that the 12-week decision period was not exceeded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Albert de Vries over de gebrekkige doorstroming van statushouders in Arnhem

MPs Kuiken and De Vries asked why suitable rental homes in Arnhem remain empty while no refugees with status are placed there, and whether bureaucracy is the cause. The State Secretary disputes that no status holders can be found, notes 40 of 132 lack a citizen service number due to registration backlogs managed by municipalities, and announces a registration 'BRP-straat' and a support team for municipalities.
Due to the high inflow of asylum seekers a backlog has arisen, and municipalities are suffering from it.
Door de hoge instroom van asielzoekers is hierbij een achterstand ontstaan en daar hebben gemeenten last van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over het AFM-onderzoek naar de dienstverlening van hypotheekaanbieders bij betalingsproblemen met hypotheken

MPs Nijboer and Albert de Vries asked about an AFM study finding that mortgage lenders must improve their service to borrowers with payment problems, including which lenders must improve, the safeguarding of borrower interests and fees, and the timing of a follow-up study. The minister answered that most lenders still need improvements, the AFM will monitor progress and decide on follow-up research, and the EU mortgage directive will limit charges to actual damages.
Which lender falls into which category is not disclosed because this is supervisory-confidential information.
Welke aanbieder in welke categorie valt wordt niet bekend gemaakt omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de consequenties voor de aftrekmogelijkheid van de verhuurderheffing bij uitstel van sloop van woningen in krimpgebieden en Rotterdam-Zuid

Albert de Vries (PvdA) asked whether the minister would allow housing corporations in shrinking regions and Rotterdam-Zuid to postpone planned demolition of social rental homes, used temporarily for refugees, without losing the rental levy deduction. Minister Blok said he sees no reason to change the levy rules now, noting demolition can be notified until end-2017 and completed by end-2020, and that it is too early to conclude further postponement is needed.
However, I see no reason to change the rules on the levy reduction in the rental levy for this purpose now.
Ik zie evenwel hierin geen reden om nu de regels rond de heffingsvermindering in de verhuurderheffing daarvoor aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Van Dekken over het krimpbeleid in Oost-Groningen

Two MPs asked the minister whether the absence of joint population-decline (krimp) policy in East Groningen is a missed opportunity and what support the central government has given the municipalities there. The minister answers that primary responsibility lies with the municipalities and province, that a new integrated implementation plan is being prepared, and that central support has been provided through existing agreements and knowledge-sharing without any financial measures.
First, I would point out that responsibility for population-decline policy in East Groningen lies primarily with the relevant municipalities, in cooperation with the province.
Allereerst wil ik erop wijzen dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor het krimpbeleid in Oost-Groningen primair berust bij de desbetreffende gemeenten, in samenwerking met de provincie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over mogelijke risico’s van het plaatsen van windturbines aan weerszijden van de Oude Maas ter hoogte van Barendrecht en Binnenmaas

An MP asked the ministers about risks of wind turbines near the Oude Maas for shipping radar, turbulence and noise, dike safety, and whether turbines might have to be shut down. The ministers answered that Rijkswaterstaat tests radar and sightline effects, no study on sound or turbulence was done since no evidence suggests an effect, and the initiator bears the feasibility responsibility while the waterschap checks dike impacts.
As far as I am aware, no research has been carried out into the possible influence of sound waves and turbulence on the radar systems used in shipping.
Voor zover mij bekend heeft geen onderzoek plaatsgevonden naar de mogelijke invloed van geluidsgolven en turbulentie op de in de scheepvaart gebruikte radarsystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over de afsluiting van het kreeftenvang-seizoen op de Oosterschelde

Two MPs asked whether intensive lobster fishing at the end of the season on the Oosterschelde keeps prices down and causes animal suffering, and whether the government will investigate stopping it. The state secretary confirmed intensified late-season fishing and said prices fluctuate seasonally, found no evidence of greater damage, and declined to restrict fishing because only stock and nature considerations, not market prices, are decisive.
Solely stock considerations and nature interests are decisive for this, as I already informed your House in my letter of 26 March 2015 on lobster fishing in the Oosterschelde.
Uitsluitend bestandsoverwegingen en natuurbelangen zijn hiervoor bepalend, zoals ik uw Kamer reeds heb medegedeeld met mijn brief d.d. 26 maart 2015 over de kreeftenvisserij in de Oosterschelde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Henk Leenders over de 380 kV-hoogspanningslijn tussen Doetinchem en Wesel

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of a letter from the Bomenstichting Achterhoek, the number of trees to be felled for the 380 kV line between Doetinchem and Wesel, alternatives considered, and compensation and landscaping. The minister replied that no letter was sent, that the foundation accepts the plans with adequate compensation, that the route was based on the most environmentally friendly alternative in the MER, and that replanting obligations are legally binding in the landscape plan.
I am aware of the reported news item. That item contained incorrect information; no letter was sent.
Ik ken het aangehaalde bericht. Dit bericht bevatte onjuiste informatie, er is geen brief verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Haven gaat zelf treinlijn opzetten’

Two MPs asked whether the Rotterdam port authority's plan to invest in rail lines raises questions about the government's role and public control over the tracks. The minister answered that the port invests in rail services through the 'rail incubator' programme rather than in infrastructure, that the ministry has no role in strategic port choices but supports initiatives within the Havenvisie 2030, and that the port operates as an independent company with public control limited to safety rules.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment has no role in strategic choices of the Port of Rotterdam Authority.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu heeft geen rol bij strategische keuzes van het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over de vennootschapsbelasting

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about corporate tax (VpB) treatment of municipal land development companies, including whether each project is taxed separately, how land positions are valued, and when land should be written down to agricultural value. The government answered that taxation depends on case facts and that projects may be netted only where activities are interwoven, that separate valuation follows BBV rules, and that talks with the VNG resumed, with a planned BBV change from 1 January 2016.
The consultation was already ongoing again at the time the article appeared.
Het overleg was al weer gaande ten tijde van het verschijnen van het artikel

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over het voorkomen van onevenredig banenverlies in de provincies Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland en Limburg door de reorganisatie van de Belastingdienst

MPs De Vries and Fokke asked whether the Tax Authority reorganisation has been instructed to prevent disproportionate job losses in Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland and Limburg, and whether the De Vries motion will be honoured. The State Secretary answered that a detailed plan follows in autumn, that unions and the works council are consulted but municipalities are not initiated, and that regional employment effects will be reported later by the Minister for Housing and Government Employment, with the De Vries and Groot-Schouten motions taken into account.
I can commit that the De Vries motion will be taken into account in the picture the Minister intends to present to you.
Ik kan toezeggen dat de motie De Vries (Kamerstuk 31 490, nr. 126 ) wordt meegenomen in het beeld dat de Minister u wil schetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over het bericht ‘Havens verliezen hun belastingvrijstelling’

MPs Albert de Vries and Groot asked whether the European Commission has moved to a new phase and issued an ultimatum over the temporary corporate tax exemption for Dutch seaports, how the Commission treats indirect state aid to ports in other member states, and what alternatives exist. The Secretary of State declined to disclose the content or outcome of ongoing talks with the Commission and did not assess alternatives, referring instead to the earlier answers, while noting that talks aim to avoid forced recovery of the aid from 1 January 2016.
The talks between the cabinet and the European Commission are still ongoing.
Het gesprek tussen het kabinet en de Europese Commissie is nog steeds gaande.
Vragen van het lid Albert deVries (PvdA) aan de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over de verkoop van het Paleis van Justitie in Amsterdam (ingezonden 6 juli 2015).

Albert de Vries (PvdA) asked why the State sold the Amsterdam Paleis van Justitie to M7 Development despite the municipality's preferences, why only two bidders underwent a Bibob integrity screening, and whether the sale could be delayed. Minister Blok answered that the sale followed the agreed bid procedure, the buyer's bid was the most favourable, the Bibob screening was legally required and confidential, and the contract was already legally concluded.
The bids made are commercially confidential, and disclosure could harm the economic interests and privacy of third parties.
Gedane biedingen zijn commercieel vertrouwelijk en openbaarmaking zou de economische belangen en privacy van derden kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Albert de Vries over een afgewezen zorgindicatie en de bezwaarprocedure bij het Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg (CIZ)

MPs Van Dijk and De Vries asked about a rejected care indication for an MS patient in Walcheren, the patient's forced double move, the CIZ's failure to involve family, and the 21-week objection period. The State Secretary said the objection was reconsidered and access granted, that moving patients back and forth is undesirable, that the 21-week period is statutory with a 10.5-week actual duration here, and committed to asking the CIZ to review objection processing times.
I will ask the CIZ to examine the processing time of objection procedures further and to inform you about this in a next progress report HLZ.
Ik zal het CIZ vragen de doorlooptijd van bezwaarprocedures nader te bezien en u ter gelegenheid van een volgende voortgangsrapportage HLZ daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Albert de Vries over de gevolgen van de reorganisatie bij de Belastingdienst voor de provincies Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland en Limburg

MPs Fokke and Albert de Vries asked whether the Belastingdienst reorganisation would disproportionately hit Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland and Limburg, and how the parliamentary motion on regional fairness would be implemented. The state secretary replied that the effects are not yet clear and that the Minister for Housing and Civil Service will inform the House later, taking the motion into account.
The Minister for Housing and Civil Service will inform you at a later stage about the regional employment effects within central government
De Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst zal u in een later stadium informeren over de regionale werkgelegenheidseffecten bij de rijksoverheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over de financiële problemen bij onderzoeksinstituut NIOZ en de gevolgen voor NIOZ-Yerseke

MPs Jacobi and De Vries asked about NIOZ's financial problems and the reported plan to close the Yerseke branch and move staff to Texel, questioning the government's commitment to Zeeland. The Secretaries answer that the financial problems are real, that options including concentration on Texel are being studied with regional parties, that no irreversible decisions have been taken, and that a broader regional knowledge strategy is under review.
There is currently intensive consultation with the province and the municipality, and no irreversible decisions have yet been taken.
Er is inmiddels intensief overleg met de provincie en de gemeente en er zijn nog geen onomkeerbare besluiten genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Nijboer, Van Dekken en Albert de Vries over vestigingsplaatsen voor een kerncentrale

Three PvdA MPs asked whether earthquake risk in Groningen makes the Eemshaven unsuitable as a nuclear plant site and whether it should be dropped from the SEV III energy structure plan. The minister answered that the risk is premature grounds to exclude the site, that Eemshaven remains a safeguarded location, and that it will be reviewed in the second SEV III evaluation in 2016.
This will be considered at the second evaluation of SEV III, in 2016.
Dit zal worden bezien bij de tweede evaluatie van het SEV III, in 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Bosman en Visser over het strandvissen met kleine fuiken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether the ban on recreational eel fyke-netting in Zeeland's beach fishing could be reconsidered given its heritage status and the Waddeneilanden exception. The State Secretary answered that the ban applies nationwide, enforcement would be disproportionate, and the eel stock remains critical, so there is no reason to reopen the ban or consult again.
I therefore see no reason to revisit the position of my predecessors or to enter into consultation on this again.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om op het standpunt van mijn ambtsvoorgangers terug te komen en hierover opnieuw in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over een 100%-controle in de reactor van kerncentrale Borssele

Two MPs asked the minister whether hairline cracks in the Borssele reactor vessel can be excluded, whether a 100% inspection and equally sensitive equipment as in Belgium can be required, and whether the research report and standards used are adequate. The minister replied that cracks found in Belgian vessels were not present in Borssele, that the inspection was qualified in advance under ENIQ and assessed by Lloyd's Register and the regulator, and that the report is publicly available via EPZ though not physically held by the regulator.
The NRG research report is not physically in the hands of the ANVS but has been made public by the licence holder EPZ.
Het onderzoeksrapport van NRG is fysiek niet in handen van de ANVS maar is door de vergunninghouder EPZ openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht 'Sluis op losse schroeven'

MP Albert de Vries asked the minister about reports that tenders for major lock renovation projects risk delays because contractors find them too complex and risky and because many large tenders overlap, including the role of DBFM contracts. The minister denied delays are expected, said Rijkswaterstaat is consulting the market and examining tender process changes, and stated no reason yet to postpone tenders or set priorities.
Rijkswaterstaat is examining options to change the tendering process to reduce tender costs and capacity and so keep market parties interested.
Rijkswaterstaat beziet de mogelijkheden om wijzigingen aan te brengen in het aanbestedingsproces om tenderkosten en -capaciteit te beperken en daarmee de interesse van marktpartijen te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht ‘Tweede Maasvlakte niet op tijd klaar voor containervloed’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reported congestion in the Rotterdam port, delays at the new Maasvlakte 2 terminals, and requests from inland shipping and terminal operator groups for a problem analysis and mitigation. The minister attributed waiting times to a combination of growing cargo volumes and the ramp-up of new automated terminals, said the market parties should resolve peak congestion, and planned a meeting with the sector without committing to a government-led intervention.
I consider it primarily a matter for the market parties themselves to resolve congestion during peak moments.
Ik vind het overigens primair een zaak van de marktpartijen zelf om de drukte tijdens piekmomenten op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Albert de Vries en Çegerek over het verlies van banen bij het gerechtshof in Arnhem

MPs asked whether the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal may relocate from Arnhem to Zwolle, with possible job losses, and how this fits the goal of spreading government jobs. The Minister said the court board is only exploring housing scenarios with no decision taken, that some scenarios move posts out of Arnhem, and that a decision on locations would be made after the Rvdr's review rather than waiting for the 2018 evaluation.
The board of the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal is currently exploring the future housing needs of the court's organisational units.
Het bestuur van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden voert op dit moment verkenningen uit naar de toekomstige huisvestingsbehoefte van de organisatieonderdelen van het gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht «Fiasco dreigt voor Leidsche Rijn centrum»

An MP asks the government about the risk of vacancy at the Leidsche Rijn shopping centre and wider retail overcapacity, and whether provinces and municipalities are acting adequately. The minister replies that retail spatial policy is decentralised, that the government supports local action and will address the issue in the forthcoming Retailagenda.
Spatial policy regarding retail has been decentralised.
Het ruimtelijk beleid met betrekking tot detailhandel is gedecentraliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het bericht ’Hoe een illegale windmolen blijft doordraaien’

Two MPs asked whether an illegal wind turbine that the Council of State ruled must be stopped should be enforced by the municipality, and how wind energy is sited with local residents. The minister answered that the Council of State confirmed enforcement was required but the decision now rests with the municipality, which the national government has no role in, and that participation will be anchored in the Omgevingswet.
It is up to the municipality to take a new decision. The national government has no role in this.
Het is aan de gemeente om een nieuw besluit te nemen. Het Rijk heeft hierin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Albert de Vries over de rapportage van de Zeeuwse zorgverkenner

MPs Bouwmeester and De Vries asked the Minister of Health whether she shared the Zeeland care reviewer's view that regional hospital care is sick due to lack of cooperation, and whether insurer CZ should act and the Ministry and NZa should intervene as in Dokkum. The Minister acknowledged the need for cooperation, said she will consult stakeholders on a vision, and explained that insurers' duty of care is enforced by the NZa through informal and formal instruments, with the government intervening only as a last resort.
I agree with that and will soon speak with those involved (hospitals, primary care, provincial and municipal officials and the insurer) about their vision of what needs to happen.
Ik deel dat en zal betrokkenen (ziekenhuizen, eerste lijn, provinciale en gemeentelijke bestuurders en de verzekeraar) binnenkort spreken over hun visie op wat er zal moeten gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over (ver)bouwplannen voor de huisvesting van asielzoekers

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked whether local and regional firms could be given a chance in building and renovating asylum reception centres, and whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and COA could draft tenders allowing local participation. The state secretary replied that COA is responsible for works, that local involvement is encouraged within procurement rules (including a 10 percent regional sourcing requirement in framework contracts), and that mandatory local preference would breach tender rules.
Mandatory use of local or regional companies conflicts with procurement rules because it leads to distortion of competition.
Het verplicht gebruik maken van lokale of regionale bedrijven is strijdig met de aanbestedingsregels omdat dit leidt tot concurrentievervalsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de gevolgen van eenvoudiger bouwregels

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about a report of dwellings without outside views and whether simplified building rules allow extensions of existing outbuildings without a permit, and what role fire and building supervision keeps. The Minister confirmed the report, pointed to existing rules on permit-free extensions, said daylight is required in dwellings, and stated that supervision roles stay the same for permit-free projects while a new quality-assurance system is being prepared.
I hope to present the bill to your House before summer 2015.
Ik hoop het wetsvoorstel voor de zomer van 2015 aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de toename van koolmonoxidevergiftigingen door cv installaties

An MP asked the minister whether he endorses reports of rising carbon monoxide poisonings from faulty central heating installations and whether he will ban or phase out open-flue appliances and tighten installer certification. The minister deferred most substantive answers until the Safety Board report expected in spring 2015, citing EU product rules against a ban and pointing to voluntary replacement and planned quality assurance from 2016.
Once the results of this investigation are available – expected in spring 2015 – I will inform the House of Representatives further on this.
Zodra de resultaten van dit onderzoek beschikbaar zijn – naar verwachting voorjaar 2015 – informeer ik de Tweede Kamer nader hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over gevaarlijke situaties in wooncomplexen in beheer bij VvE’s

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the risk of collapsing concrete gallery floors in older flats, including whether the problem concentrates in owners' association (VvE) buildings and how VvEs with inadequate reserves can be helped. The Minister answered that the problem is not specific to VvEs, outlined planned legislation on VvE maintenance savings and borrowing, and declined an APK inspection scheme while noting a new inspection power for evident safety problems.
I am not in favour of an APK for buildings because this would lead to a higher burden for building owners.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een APK voor gebouwen omdat dit leidt tot een lastenverzwaring voor gebouweigenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert De Vries over de strijdigheid van Komo-keurmerken met Europese regels voor vrij handelsverkeer

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Central Government Affairs whether KOMO quality declarations for construction products conflict with EU free-movement rules and whether the minister would act against them. The minister acknowledged conflicts with the CE-marking rules, said KOMO has committed to splitting its documents and that enforcement by the ILT will follow from 1 January 2015, while leaving the legal robustness and the choice of certification approach largely to the market.
If KOMO and the Certification Bodies fail to adapt a specific assessment guideline in time, the quality declarations falling under that guideline will be withdrawn.

In het geval het Komo en de Certificerende Instellingen niet lukt om een specifieke beoordelingsrichtlijn op tijd aan te passen, zullen de kwaliteitsverklaringen die onder die beoordelingsrichtlijn vallen worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over het bericht dat TenneT een tracé voor hoogspanningskabels plotseling verlegt

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked why TenneT's planned 380kV cable route between Roosendaal and Tilburg was moved from the northern to the southern alignment and when the planning procedures would proceed. Minister Kamp answered that the northern route was dropped because four-circuit connections are unacceptable for grid security and international obligations, that the new route will be optimised with local stakeholders, and that formal procedures are expected in autumn 2017.
The new planned route must first be technically elaborated in consultation with regional parties and optimised where necessary and possible.
Het nieuwe voorgenomen tracé moet eerst in overleg met de regionale partijen technisch uitgewerkt worden en waar nodig/mogelijk worden geoptimaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de problemen met weekendverblijf van vrachtwagenchauffeurs in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

MPs Kerstens and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about problems with lorry drivers spending weekend rest periods on Zeeland-Flanders car parks, whether this breaches EU and municipal rules, whether the ILT will investigate, whether Belgian stricter rules cause a waterbed effect, and how municipalities will be involved. The minister answered that spending a long rest on a car park is not in itself an infringement, that the ILT checks for alternatives and warns drivers, that the ILT has consulted Belgian authorities, and that municipalities and police are primarily responsible for public order.
Within the framework of public order and safety, the municipality and police are in the first instance responsible for taking measures where necessary.
Het is in het in het kader van openbare orde en veiligheid in eerste instantie een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeente en politie om indien nodig maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het gebrek aan steun onder de Nederlandse beroepschartervaart voor het Deense voorstel voor regulering van de vaart op Denemarken

Albert de Vries (PvdA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about Danish demands that Dutch sailing charter vessels meet SOLAS standards, and whether Denmark discriminates against Dutch vessels relative to Danish ones. The Minister answered that the dispute turns on interpreting 'not mechanically propelled', that Denmark's safety concerns are substantive, that Dutch charter regulation will be modernised, and that she will contact her Danish counterpart on the main pain points.
I will contact my Danish counterpart to resolve the two main pain points.
Ik zal in contact te treden met mijn Deense collega om de twee voornaamste pijnpunten opgelost te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over ‘de belabberde kwaliteit van de indicatieve energielabels’

MPs Albert de Vries and Jan Vos asked the Minister for Housing about the poor quality of indicative energy labels, based on the WoON2006 median, the energy label atlas, and the calculation method. The minister defended the method as a cautious first indication, said the atlas is run by a private foundation, ordered an external second opinion, and explained how owners can convert the provisional label to a definitive one.
I have also decided to commission a second opinion from an external agency.
Tevens heb ik besloten een «second opinion» uit te laten voeren door een extern bureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat NLVOW de gedragscode windenergie niet ondertekent

MPs de Vries and Mulder asked whether the government would mediate toward a joint wind energy code of conduct after NLVOW refused to sign the NWEA-led code, and whether it would make the code binding. The minister answered that a joint code is the responsibility of private parties, urged all parties to keep talking, and declined to make any code mandatory, while noting that statutory participation and planning-damage compensation exist.
I call on the parties to keep talking with each other.
Ik roep partijen op met elkaar in gesprek te blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Cegerek over het bericht “Duurzaam betekent niets meer”

MPs de Vries and Cegerek asked about a report claiming that 'sustainable' no longer means anything in construction, questioning builders' attitude to environmental rules, innovation, the National Environmental Database, and the reliability of certificates. The minister rejected the claim that builders reject environmental rules, defended the Nationale Milieudatabase and Green Deals, and said the government will study how consumers use certification labels and report to parliament.
The Tweede Kamer will be informed further about the results.
Over de resultaten wordt de Tweede Kamer nader ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en de Albert de Vries over berichten met betrekking tot  de kerncentrale in Doel

MPs Wolbert and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports on incidents at the Doel nuclear plant in Belgium and their implications for Dutch safety, cross-border cooperation, and information for border residents. The minister answered that the plant is safely shut down, Dutch and Belgian authorities cooperate and exchange information, and no additional measures or resident information beyond the FANC website are currently considered necessary.
Further information beyond what is available on the FANC website is therefore currently not necessary.
Nadere informatieverstrekking dan die te verkrijgen is op de website van het FANC is op dit moment dan ook niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Albert De Vries over strijd tussen Zeeuwse ziekenhuizen

MPs Bouwmeester and De Vries asked the Minister of Health about the dispute between two Zeeland hospital organisations and how to ensure patient interests prevail. The Minister answered that hospitals and insurers bear primary responsibility, that a provincial investigator has been appointed, and that she sees no role for herself unless continuity or safety of care is at stake.
I have no role here unless the continuity of essential care or the safety of care is at stake.
Ik heb hier geen rol tenzij de continuïteit van de cruciale zorg of de veiligheid van de zorg in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht dat de gasleiding van honderdduizenden Nederlanders lekt

MPs Albert de Vries and Monasch asked about reports that gas pipes leak in hundreds of thousands of homes, including claims of explosion risk, deaths, lost gas, lapsed municipal inspections and a periodic inspection scheme. The minister answered that leaks are rare and mainly in older homes, that owners are responsible under the Building Decree, that a national inspection programme is not justified, and that a possible ministerial regulation will be explored with municipalities and report in 2015.
The Minister for Housing and Central Government Organisation will take the initiative for this exploration and will inform the House of Representatives further on its results in 2015.
De Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst zal het initiatief nemen voor deze verkenning en zal in 2015 de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over de resultaten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert De Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat het RIVM heeft geconcludeerd dat bewoners van Krimpregio’s zich gemiddeld minder gezond voelen

MPs Albert de Vries and Wolbert asked about the RIVM finding that residents of shrinking regions feel less healthy on average, and whether equal health rights, care provision and local action are being ensured. The minister acknowledges the socioeconomic link, points to primary responsibility at local level and existing programmes, and promises follow-up letters on curative care and the RIVM study after the summer.
Proximity of care, also for the patient/citizen in the shrinking regions, is one of the policy priorities.
Nabijheid van zorg, ook voor de patiënt/burger in de krimpregio’s, is één van de speerpunten van het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Jacobi en Kuiken over de plannen voor ontwikkeling van het KNSF-terrein in Muiden

PvdA MPs asked the minister about the draft zoning plan for the former KNSF site in Muiden, including very high building heights, its effect on the Kruitbos nature area, the EUR 376 million damage claim, and Schiphol flight path and Stelling van Amsterdam implications. The minister answered that zoning is the municipality's responsibility and that the Council of State is the appeal forum, while stating that nature agreements are upheld and that the damage claims are frozen pending the plan becoming final.
Under the Spatial Planning Act (Wro), it is the municipality's responsibility to adopt zoning plans for 'good spatial planning'.
Op grond van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening (Wro) is het de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om bestemmingsplannen vast te stellen ten behoeve van «een goede ruimtelijke ordening».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht dat de Nederlandse loodsen recht hebben op 7,8 miljoen euro van het Vlaams Gewest

MP Albert de Vries asked the minister whether the Antwerp court confirmed that Flanders owes the Dutch pilotage service EUR 7.8 million in compensation for underpriced pilotage tariffs, and what the minister would do to ensure payment, avoid an appeal, and secure fairer future pricing. The minister confirmed the ruling, said she had urged her Flemish counterpart to respect the arbitration decision, and stated that the 2012-2013 claim and future tariffs are matters for Flanders and the Dutch pilotage service, with new arrangements awaiting Flemish political approval.
No, this is between the Flemish Region and the Dutch Pilotage Service.
Nee, dit is tussen het Vlaams Gewest en het Nederlands Loodswezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over een uitspraak van de Raad van State over woonboten

Albert de Vries (PvdA) asked the minister about a Council of State ruling that houseboats count as buildings, with consequences for permits and local rules. Minister Blok confirmed that many existing houseboats may now be illegal, that local ordinances lose force, and that a legislative amendment with transitional rules is planned for late 2014.
I expect to send the proposal for the necessary legislative amendment to the House of Representatives at the end of 2014.
Ik verwacht het voorstel voor de daarvoor benodigde wetswijziging eind 2014 naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de Stichting Bouwkwaliteit (SBK) en de Nationale Milieudatabase (NMD)

An MP asked the minister about the resignation of the NMD's daily manager, a quaggy overlap of roles for a quality-assurance consultant who also chairs the SBK supervisory board and advised on merging NMD and SBK, and whether a subsidy to IBK for that consultant's role was properly awarded. The minister answered that the resignation stemmed from an internal disagreement, that the roles are separated across organisations, that no contracts were awarded to the consultant, and that the IBK subsidy was granted because it fits the government's policy direction.
Given the separate responsibilities as given in answer 2, there is no undesirable accumulation of functions in one person.
Gegeven de gescheiden verantwoordelijkheden als in antwoord 2 is gegeven, is er geen sprake ongewenste stapeling van functies bij één persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht ‘Groot deel van lege kantoren rijp voor de sloop’

An MP asked whether demolition is the best solution for many empty offices and what role the government sees for itself in speeding up demolition. The minister says demolition can be best for poor buildings or locations, points to regional office funds and to municipal and provincial facilitation, and welcomes 'slimme sloop' initiatives.
Although reuse possibilities are often greater than thought, for certain offices (poor building/poor location) demolition can be the best solution.
Hoewel de herbestemmingsmogelijkheden vaak groter zijn dan gedacht, kan voor bepaalde kantoren (slecht pand/slechte locatie) sloop de beste oplossing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht dat een kwart van het winkeloppervlak in de toekomst leegstaand en kansloos zal zijn

An MP asked the ministers whether the projected 25 percent reduction in retail floor space and rising shop vacancy warrant government intervention, including convening stakeholders and new regulation. The minister answered that shop vacancy is a market-driven, structural issue best handled through regional tailor-made agreements via the Winkeltop, and that existing instruments suffice, with a PBL analysis due in autumn.
For now I choose to actively facilitate the efforts from the Winkeltop to stimulate regional parties to reach tailor-made solutions
Ik kies er vooralsnog voor om de inzet vanuit de Winkeltop, om regionale partijen te stimuleren om te komen tot maatwerkoplossingen, actief te faciliteren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de sanering van het vervuilde terrein van Thermphos in Vlissingen

MP Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the best solution for cleaning up the contaminated Thermphos site in Vlissingen, the responsibility of Zeeland province and Zeeland Seaports, and the European Commission's refusal of funding, and whether national funds could co-finance the clean-up. The minister answered that a deal between the curators, Zeeland Seaports and the province is preferred, that the province and port are responsible as landowner and permit authority, that no EU funding is available, and that no national funds will be provided.
As Minister of Economic Affairs, I am not the appropriate person to form a judgment on the financial position and capacity of the province of Zeeland and Zeeland Seaports.
Ik ben als Minister van Economische Zaken niet de aangewezen persoon om een oordeel te vormen over de financiële positie en draagkracht van de provincie Zeeland en Zeeland Seaports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over het bericht dat de Raad van State een streep heeft gezet door de bouw van 700 woningen bij Schiphol

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked whether the Council of State's ruling blocking 700 homes near Schiphol affects future housing plans and the airport, and whether support was sought before the zoning plan was adopted. The state secretary answered that the municipalities bear responsibility for weighing aircraft noise in zoning decisions, that the ruling does not affect airport use, and that Haarlemmermeer ran a broad participation process linked to the A9 relocation.
This concerns the responsibility of the relevant municipalities to seek support and ensure a sound weighing of interests.
Het betreft hier de verantwoordelijkheid van betreffende gemeenten om draagvlak te zoeken en te zorgen voor een goede afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Albert de Vries over het verdwijnen van het Openbaar Ministerie uit Vlissingen

MPs Recourt and Albert de Vries asked the Justice Minister about the disappearance of the Public Prosecution Service (OM) from Vlissingen, including when the hearing room closed and how Zeeland suspects can account for traffic offences. The minister denied the hearing room was closed, said CVOM hearings remain in Vlissingen for now, and promised telehearing at one location in Zeeland by around June 2014.
The aim is an introduction date for this location in the course of June 2014.
Het streven is naar een invoeringsdatum voor deze locatie in de loop van juni 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Albert de Vries over de extra sluiskolk bij Eefde

MPs Dik-Faber and Albert de Vries asked the minister why the Midden-Noord variant for the second lock at Eefde was not chosen despite the Commission for EIA's advice, and about costs, safety, timing and the capacity outlook. The minister defended the Noord location on cost (about 20 million euro cheaper, with regional support), said the planning cannot be accelerated, and stated that no revision of the preference decision is warranted.
All things considered, I see no reason in this finding of the commission to revise my preference decision.
Alles overziend, zie ik in deze constatering van de commissie geen aanleiding mijn Voorkeursbeslissing te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Albert de Vries over de aansturing van het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam

MPs Mei Li Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Finance Minister about the governance of the Port of Rotterdam Authority, including whether public interests are safeguarded, whether statutes should be amended, comparisons with neighbouring countries, land control and dividend levels. The minister replied that the state as shareholder already protects public interests through the statutes and the Nota Deelnemingenbeleid, rejected changes such as restricting shareholders to governments, and explained that dividend payments follow fixed agreements, giving a payout ratio of around 36-46% rather than 20%.
Where that is still insufficiently the case, I will adjust the statutory purpose in consultation with the co-shareholder Municipality of Rotterdam and the company.
Waar dat nog onvoldoende het geval is, zal ik de doelomschrijving in overleg met de medeaandeelhouder Gemeente Rotterdam en de onderneming aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over een gelijk Europees speelveld voor de Nederlandse havens

MPs De Vries and Groot asked whether the government would delay or drop corporate tax for Dutch port operators until an EU study on port competition is published and EU-level state aid rules are agreed. The minister answered that no general EU-wide tax comparison is possible, that talks with the Commission on modernising corporate tax liability for state enterprises are ongoing, and that a bill is aimed for Prinsjesdag 2014 with transitional arrangements considered.
We have no insight into the progress of processing the results and the analysis thereof.
Wij hebben geen inzicht in de voortgang van de verwerking van de resultaten en de analyse daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over een stop op kantoren in Utrecht

An MP asks the minister whether the province of Utrecht's decision to scrap planned office developments, which may lead to planning-damage claims and land losses for municipalities, is acceptable and whether rules should be tightened. The minister defends the provincial approach as regional coordination, says no uniform cost-sharing system or new legislation is planned, and states that planning-damage claims would be assessed later by the courts.
I see the decision of the province of Utrecht as a fulfilment of this.
Ik zie het besluit van de provincie Utrecht als een invulling hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de PUR-schuimproblematiek

MP Albert de Vries asked the Minister for Housing and Central Government Affairs about the EU SVHC Roadmap, the classification of isocyanates used in PUR foam insulation as substances of very high concern, and whether the Health Council was asked to study PUR insulation. The minister confirmed knowledge of the Roadmap, said isocyanates have not yet been nominated for the candidate list but may be later, and said no Health Council advice was requested for sprayed PUR insulation, committing to involve the Council if new information arises.
