Should isocyanates be placed on the list in the future, there will at least be a moment to examine at European level, in consultation with industry, whether alternatives are technically and economically feasible and, if so, within what period.

Mochten isocyanaten in de toekomst op de betreffende lijst geplaatst worden, dan ontstaat in ieder geval een moment om in overleg met het bedrijfsleven op Europees niveau na te gaan of alternatieven technisch en economisch haalbaar zijn en zo ja, binnen welke periode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert De Vries naar aanleiding van het geschil tussen het Vlaams Gewest en het Nederlands loodswezen

An MP asked the minister about the Flemish region's attempt to annul an arbitration award of 7.9 million euros owed to the Dutch pilotage corporation, whether she had contacted her Flemish counterpart, and about unfair competition between Dutch and Flemish ports. The minister confirmed the dispute, said she would write to her Flemish counterpart urging compliance with the award while keeping talks open, and said she opposes unfair state aid and is working on an EU port regulation and state aid guidelines.
In the letter I will state that, in the context of successful operational cooperation between the Flemish and Dutch pilot services, it is of great importance that the parties remain in discussion.

In de brief zal ik aangeven dat in het kader van de succesvolle operationele samenwerking tussen de Vlaamse en Nederlandse loodsdiensten het van groot belang is dat betrokken partijen in gesprek blijven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Eijsink en Albert de Vries over de rapportage ‘Munitiestortplaats Oosterschelde is “tikkende tijdbom”

MPs Jacobi, Eijsink and Albert de Vries asked the ministers whether the WWII munitions dumped in the Oosterschelde pose a danger to people and nature, and whether new research is needed after a media report called it a ticking time bomb. The Minister of Defence answered that TNO research shows spontaneous detonation is practically impossible and that environmental effects are not demonstrated, while monthly water and mussel monitoring will be carried out in 2014 and Parliament will be informed of results if needed.
In 2014 the water quality above the former munitions dumping site will be measured monthly.
In 2014 wordt de waterkwaliteit boven de voormalige munitiestortplaats maandelijks gemeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Albert De Vries over de financiële gevolgen van gemeenten met hun grondpositie

MPs Albert de Vries and Fokke asked ministers whether the financial crisis hitting municipal land companies is worse than the 2012 study showed, whether the minister will allow longer write-downs, support provinces' plans to help municipalities, and agree to renegotiate Rijk-subsidised building contracts to cut building capacity. The minister replied that current rules suffice, longer write-down periods are possible only under enhanced provincial supervision, and that the Rijk no longer has partner status in the remaining housing subsidies, with a further report promised in December.
As I already reported in my letter of 14 October and as promised in the VAO of 12 November, this report will be sent to your House in December on behalf of my colleague of the Interior Ministry.

Zoals ik al in mijn brief van 14 oktober heb gemeld en zoals ook in het VAO van 12 november heb toegezegd, zal dit rapport in december mede namens mijn collega van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Albert de Vries over stremmingen op het Zeeuwse deel van de A58

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether closures on the Zeeland stretch of the A58 after accidents last too long and whether Zeeland is effectively cut off. The minister denies that closures are longer than elsewhere, explains existing incident procedures and detour routes, and offers only to consult road managers on improving traffic flow, rejecting the suggested crossover measures as ineffective.
I am willing to consult with the road managers on whether traffic flow on the detour routes during an incident can be improved.
Ik ben bereid om met de medewegbeheerders te overleggen of de doorstroming op de omleidingsroutes tijdens een incident bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de betaling van havengelden voor de recreatievaart

MP Albert de Vries asked whether berth payment and cancellation terms in marinas are set by HISWA conditions, what legal framework applies, and whether monthly or quarterly payment and monthly cancellation could be legally mandated for private boat owners. The minister explained that private marinas follow their own terms, municipal and provincial harbour fees are retributions under provincial and municipal law, and rejected national rules on this detail, preferring self-regulation by the sector.
I see no reason for national regulation at this level of detail.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nationale regelgeving op dit detailniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de bareboat-out regeling

Labour MP Albert de Vries asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment how the bareboat-out scheme, which temporarily suspends Dutch sea-vessel registration while keeping the ship on the Dutch private register, squares with the explanatory memorandum stating that such a scheme is not possible in the Netherlands, and whether it can be halted. The Minister answers that 55 ships were affected, that the suspension practice rests on a 1990s interpretation pending the RNZ bill which creates a statutory basis, and that the practice will continue until then, while labour concerns are being discussed with the seafarers' union.
It is my aim to create a statutory basis for bareboat-out as quickly as possible.
Het is mijn doel om zo snel mogelijk een wettelijke grondslag te creëren voor bareboat-out.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Albert de Vries over de kosten van een hypotheek in krimpgebieden

Two MPs asked whether mortgages are more expensive in shrinking regions, whether this lowers housing demand, and whether lenders may impose such costs given mortgage rules and the tax deduction. The minister answered that the NVM and lenders do not recognise higher rates in specific regions, that rates reflect demonstrable risk, and that lenders' code bars refusing applications solely on location.

Lenders have, through the Mortgage Lending Code of Conduct, committed to the rule that the mere fact that the mortgaged home is located in a particular district or postcode area may not be grounds to reject the application in its entirety.

Financiers hebben zich middels de Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financieringen wel gebonden aan de bepaling dat het enkele feit dat de hypothecair te verbinden woning is gelegen in een bepaalde wijk of postcodegebied geen grond mag zijn om de aanvraag in zijn geheel af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Monasch over de berichtgeving omtrent zijn werkbezoek aan Noordoost-Friesland

MPs Albert de Vries and Monasch asked minister Blok whether he told Northeast Friesland it cannot expect help from The Hague in tackling population decline, and whether rules that hinder the response will be reviewed. The minister confirmed the remark, said the regions bear primary responsibility while the state provides conditions and support, and pointed to existing tools and an inventory of obstacles.
I did indeed indicate on site that no ready-made solutions can come from The Hague for the shrinking and anticipating regions.
Ik heb inderdaad ter plaatse aangegeven dat er geen kant en klare oplossingen vanuit Den Haag kunnen komen voor de krimp- en anticipeerregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het uitblijven van werkzaamheden die nodig zijn voor de toegankelijkheid van de haven Vlissingen-Oost

An MP asked why the ministry has not removed a sill blocking access to the Sloehaven for certain ships, despite requests from Zeeland Seaports and the province, and about the lost revenue and cost. The minister answered that talks are ongoing with the province, Zeeland Seaports and Flanders, that the port company is willing to pay for the dredging, and that data on lost revenue and the cost estimate are not yet available.
I have no data on this.
Hierover zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert De Vries over het bericht dat Delta de afspraken uit het Energieakkoord dreigt te negeren

Two PvdA MPs asked the economics minister whether Delta's refusal to close its coal plant conflicts with the Energy Agreement, how compliance will be ensured, and whether he will negotiate with Delta. The minister answered that Delta, as an Energie Nederland member, is bound to the agreement, that the coal tax exemption returns in 2016 only if the plants close, and referred to a separate letter on ACM's view.
I assume these companies stand by their signature and will therefore, within the limits of competition law, work constructively towards closing their old coal plants.

Ik ga ervan uit dat deze bedrijven staan voor hun handtekening en dus – binnen de mededingingsrechtelijke mogelijkheden – op constructieve wijze zullen werken aan sluiting van hun oude kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de beslissing van Verbrugge Terminals om niet in Vlissingen-Oost maar in Zeebrugge te investeren in een containerterminal

An MP asks the ministers whether they know Verbrugge Terminals chose to invest in Zeebrugge rather than Vlissingen-Oost, whether Flemish state aid to ports distorts competition, and whether the government will raise this with the European Commission and condition its support for the EU port regulation on state-aid rules. The minister confirms the facts, calls the Flemish funding regime an unequal playing field that the Commission has already found compatible with EU rules, says the case strengthens his push for port state-aid guidelines, and makes no commitment to raise it with the Commission directly.
The Dutch view of port management and port services is a business-like one, in which users pay fully and at market-conform rates for the products and services delivered to them.

Het Nederlandse beeld van havenbeheer en havendienstverlening is een bedrijfsmatige, waarbij de gebruikers volledig en marktconform voor de kosten van de aan hen geleverde producten en diensten betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de Belgische aanmelding van de crisis in de binnenvaart

MP Albert de Vries asked whether Belgium would formally request EU recognition of the inland shipping crisis and what the Dutch government would do about overcapacity and a scrapping fund. The minister replied that Belgium is still preparing the request, that the Netherlands found no sector support for scrapping measures, and that she will reconsider her own request only if Belgium does not file.
If that ultimately does not lead to the announced submission, I will reconsider.
Als dat uiteindelijk niet leidt tot de aangekondigde indiening, zal ik mij opnieuw beraden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Vries over de bereikbaarheid van de jachthaven van Schiermonnikoog

MPs Jacobi and De Vries asked why the Schiermonnikoog marina will not be dredged in 2013, whether Natura 2000 rules prevent dumping silt for salt-marsh creation, and whether silt disposal can be restored. The minister explains the municipality stopped unpermitted dumping, its 2009 permit was refused for lack of information, and that options including a Rijkswaterstaat disposal arrangement are being explored, with clarity expected in autumn.
In the autumn, more clarity will emerge on this.
In het najaar ontstaat hierover meer duidelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over verdere problemen met PUR isolatie

An MP asked the minister for Housing about health complaints from residents linked to PUR floor insulation in Heerenveen, and whether a moratorium should be imposed. The minister said a GGD investigation and TNO research are pending, promised to inform parliament in August, and described alternative insulation materials and EU/REACH rules.
I will inform your chamber about both reports and my response to the reports in August, when the reports become available.
Ik zal uw kamer over beiden rapporten en mijn reactie op de rapporten in augustus – bij het beschikbaar komen van de rapporten – nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over de ontwikkeling en de internationale concurrentiepositie van de Nederlandse havens

MPs De Vries and Groot asked the ministers about the OECD study on Rotterdam and Amsterdam port competitiveness, corporate tax exemption for state port companies, and EU support for smaller ports. The government said the OECD study draws no competitiveness conclusions, that the consequences of ending the tax exemption are not yet clear, and that a level playing field is important to the Netherlands.
However, it is not yet clear at this moment how the revision of the corporate tax liability for state-owned enterprises will be shaped.
Het is op dit moment echter nog niet duidelijk hoe de herziening van de vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor overheidsbedrijven wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Oztürk over de ontwikkeling van winkelruimte

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about rising retail vacancy and whether municipalities should be restrained from developing new shop space, including whether the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation is applied and supervised. The minister acknowledged rising vacancy, said local tailoring and the ladder suffice, rejected intervention at a set vacancy level and new provincial instruments, and did not commission research on the ladder's application.
I will not restrict municipalities in the development possibilities included in existing zoning plans.
Ik ga gemeenten niet beperken in de ontwikkelmogelijkheden die in vigerende bestemmingsplannen zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de huisvesting van het UWV

An MP asked the minister whether UWV rents office space from companies based in tax havens, how much rent is involved, and whether the state's own leasing avoids such landlords. The government answered that UWV rents from Dutch and German owners (about 10 million euro of 81 million to German owners), that it does not investigate group structures, and that the state does not as a rule do business with criminal firms but companies may choose their seat.
UWV does not investigate this structure before concluding an agreement.
UWV verricht geen onderzoek naar deze structuur alvorens een overeenkomst te sluiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes, Kuiken en Albert De Vries over het bericht “actie ANWB tegen tolvignet België

MPs asked the government about Belgium's planned toll vignette for Belgian roads, its effects on cross-border workers and Zeeland residents, and whether the minister had raised it with Belgium. The minister confirmed the plans for 2016, said the vignette would add costs but be manageable, and reported talks with Flemish and Benelux counterparts, promising to report further developments.
If this consultation shows that further developments on the vignette can be reported, I will of course inform you of them.
Mocht uit dit overleg blijken dat er nadere ontwikkelingen rond het vignet gemeld kunnen worden, dan zal ik u daarvan uiteraard op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bereikte akkoord over crisismaatregelen in de binnenvaart in België

An MP asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister about the Belgian crisis-measures agreement for inland shipping and whether the Netherlands would join Belgium's EU structural market disruption notification. The minister said Belgium had not yet formally notified, that the Netherlands supports the initiative, will work with the sector and Commission, and urged Germany and possibly France to back it.
I have already informed my Belgian counterparts that I will support Belgium's initiative to notify the crisis to the European Commission.
Ik heb mijn Belgische ambtsgenoten al laten weten dat ik het Belgische initiatief om de crisis aan te melden bij de Europese Commissie zal steunen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Vermeij en Albert de Vries (over de planontwikkeling van een recreatiepark nabij Fort Benoorden Spaarndam)

MPs Vermeij and De Vries asked the ministers about plans for bungalows at Fort Benoorden Spaarndam within the World Heritage Stelling van Amsterdam, and whether the national government should be involved. The minister said the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had studied the plans and found no harm to the World Heritage value, that the province is the lead on the project and can request advice from the College van Rijksadviseurs which the government would support, and that the alternative plan from a heritage foundation is a matter for the province.
A request from the province of Noord-Holland I will support and submit to the college.
Een verzoek van de provincie Noord-Holland zal ik steunen en voorleggen aan het college.
Antwoord vragen Albert de Vries over de toename van de kantorenleegstand en de voortgang van de uitvoering van het convenant Aanpak Leegstand Kantoren

An MP asked the minister for Housing and Government Service, jointly with the minister of Infrastructure and Environment, about rising office vacancy and progress on the convenant tackling office vacancy, including regional office funds, regional policy frameworks, and VAT on conversions. The minister answered that the convenant partners remain committed, that eight of twelve provinces have anchored limits on new development, that no regional office funds exist yet, that a study on mandatory levies was completed and a policy response is being drafted, and that the reduced VAT rate does not apply to office conversions though options are being explored.
The relevant study has now been completed and was sent to your House by the minister of Infrastructure and Environment on 22 April 2013.
Het betreffende onderzoek is inmiddels afgerond en door de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu op 22 april 2013 naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Albert De Vries Albert en Otwin Van Dijk over mantelzorgwoningen en groepswonen

MPs asked about the savings potential of care annexes (mantelzorgwoningen) and group housing for elderly care, the status of housing experiments, deregulation under the BOR, the risk that temporary housing becomes permanent, and a barrier inventory for care providers. The government answered that savings cannot be quantified, experiments have ended and a new programme is being discussed, deregulation is planned via the BOR, enforcement remains with municipalities, and a municipal guidance note is expected after the summer.
On the subject of care annexes, a guidance note for municipalities is being prepared.
Op het terrein van mantelzorgwoningen is een handreiking voor gemeenten in de maak.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de onenigheid tussen het Rijk en het Recreatieschap Midden-Delfland over de uittreedvoorwaarden en uittreedsom die het Rijk dient te betalen bij uittreding uit het Recreat

An MP asked the state secretary about the dispute with Recreatieschap Midden-Delfland over the exit terms and the exit sum (51 million euro) the state must pay to leave the joint arrangement, and whether the state would appeal the council's decision. The state secretary answered that the state will appeal the council's decision because the sum is unreasonable and disproportionate, that negotiation is preferred but only possible if the council withdraws its decision, and that the situation differs from the De Grevelingen case in nature protection duties and finances.
I will appeal against the decision of the Midden-Delfland council.
Ik ga in beroep tegen de beslissing van de Midden-Delflandraad.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Albert de Vries over uitspraken van de president van het gerechtshof Den Bosch

MPs Recourt and De Vries asked the Justice Minister about remarks by the president of the Den Bosch appeals court suggesting higher-appeal hearings would not in principle be held in Middelburg, Zeeland, despite earlier assurances. The minister confirmed the zitting location designation, said court management decides venues, and rejected the claim that no appeal hearings would be held in Middelburg, reaffirming his commitments to Zeeland.
I cannot agree with the claim that in principle no appeal hearings will be held in Middelburg.
Met de stelling dat in beginsel geen hoger beroepzaken in Middelburg worden gedaan, kan ik mij niet verenigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch, Jan Vos en Albert De Vries over de milieuprestatieberekening bij aanvragen in het kader van de omgevingswet

Three PvdA MPs asked why some municipalities do not require environmental performance calculations under the Omgevingswet and what the minister will do about it. The minister answers that no thresholds exist yet at the request of industry, that municipalities must still check submitted documents, and that enforcement responsibilities are shared with the provinces, with binding requirements possibly set around 2015.
First-line supervision of building regulations still lies with the municipality.
Het eerstelijns toezicht op de bouwregelgeving ligt nog steeds bij de gemeente.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over doorboringen van het rioolstelsel

MPs Albert de Vries and Jacobi asked the minister about a RIONED report on sewer pipes pierced by cables and pipes, the scale of incidents, enforcement of the KLIC reporting duty, and whether concrete measures with sector parties are needed. The minister corrected the incident count from 16,000 to 4,000, described WION rules, enforcement by Agentschap Telecom with fines totalling EUR 303,250 in 2012, and said the WION evaluation (due Q1 2013) would inform any additional measures.
Article 51 of the Wion states that the Wion will be evaluated within 5 years and the House of Representatives will be informed of the results.
Artikel 51 van de Wion geeft aan dat binnen 5 jaar de Wion geëvalueerd wordt en de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd wordt over de resultaten daarvan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over het bericht «Geen doorstart voor fosforfabrikant Thermphos»

MPs Vos and De Vries asked the ministers about the failure to find a buyer for Thermphos's Vlissingen plant, job losses, and who bears liability for dismantling and remediating the site. The minister answered that no buyer or going-concern prospect exists, government actively supported the curators, job losses are being addressed regionally, and liability questions remain with the curators, with no commitment to new legal measures beyond exploring them with the infrastructure minister.
For licence holders of nuclear reactors there is currently a statutory obligation to ensure funds are available for dismantling and remediation under all circumstances.

Voor vergunninghouders van kernreactoren bestaat er op dit moment een wettelijke verplichting om ervoor te zorgen dat er onder alle omstandigheden gelden beschikbaar zijn voor ontmanteling en sanering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht minder kinderen in jeugdinstellingen in Zeeland

MPs Ypma and De Vries asked about a report that fewer children in Zeeland are placed in youth institutions thanks to the wraparound care model, and whether this model should guide the transition of youth care to municipalities. The state secretary answered that the Zeeland method is a good example for the transition, though it has not yet reduced placements, and pointed to existing models, shared learning platforms and funding for pilots.
I will further examine how we can make these good examples more visible.
Ik ga nader bezien hoe wij deze goede voorbeelden meer zichtbaar kunnen maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Hamer, Van Dekken, Albert de Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat er gevangenissen in Groningen, Drenthe Zeeland worden gesloten

PvdA MPs asked whether plans to close prisons in Groningen, Drenthe and Zeeland exist, and about the employment, visitor travel and cultural-heritage effects of such closures. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, closures cannot be avoided given budget cuts, a Masterplan on detention capacity will be presented in April 2013, and regional employment and visits will be weighed.

With a view to a careful decision-making process, I have asked the Director-General of DJI to draw up a Masterplan on DJI detention capacity, which will show the consequences of the cuts for cell capacity and staff.

Met het oog op een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces heb ik de hoofddirecteur van DJI verzocht om een Masterplan detentiecapaciteit DJI op te stellen, waarin de gevolgen van de ombuigingen voor de celcapaciteit van DJI en het personeel in beeld worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over de privatisering van het toezicht in de bouw

MPs De Vries and Fokke asked the government about privatising building inspection, including whether private checks on structural safety would be independent, who would be liable, and whether regional inspection services would be a better option. Minister Blok answered that private quality assurance is planned from 2015 with checks and balances, that liability and sanctions will be clarified by mid-2013, and that a national inspection body proposal is still under consideration.
My intention is to make private supervision possible alongside municipal supervision.
Mijn voornemen is om naast het gemeentelijk ook privaat toezicht mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Maij over het slopen van schepen op stranden in Azië

Two MPs asked the government about deaths during ship breaking on Asian beaches after a Nieuwsuur broadcast, and whether it would set minimum safety, environmental and labour conditions and engage shipowners and financiers. The minister said the Netherlands supports the Hong Kong Convention and an EU ship recycling regulation, notes voluntary industry initiatives, and sees no need to convene shipowners and financiers.
The Netherlands actively contributes to the adoption of this European regulation so that ship dismantling takes place in a safe and environmentally responsible manner.
Nederland draagt actief bij aan de totstandkoming van deze Europese verordening om het slopen van schepen op een veilige en milieuverantwoorde manier te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht “Oprichting sloopfonds kantoren loopt spaak”

An MP asked the minister about reports that a demolition fund for empty offices had stalled after some municipalities objected to public money, and whether a fund under the office vacancy convenant is compulsory or could threaten prices. The minister replied that VNG support has not been withdrawn, that the fund is voluntary and market-led, that no price distortion is expected, and that the national expert team is operating.
It is explicitly intended that the desire to establish an office fund comes from the bottom up.
Het is nadrukkelijk de bedoeling dat de wens om te komen tot een kantorenfonds «van onderop komt».
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en De Vries inzake de situatie bij Thermphos

Two PvdA MPs asked the economy minister about the Thermphos situation in Zeeland, including job losses, an anti-dumping case against Kazakh phosphorus, green investment support and help finding an investor. The minister answered that the Commission's anti-dumping decision is due by 16 March 2013, that several state instruments could support investments, and that the ministry is working with the province to help find investors.
I am actively involved in this file and therefore in consultation with the company, the Province of Zeeland and other parties to see where I can help, within my means, with a possible restart.
Ik ben actief betrokken in dit dossier en daarom in overleg met het bedrijf, Provincie Zeeland en andere partijen om te zien waar ik – binnen mijn mogelijkheden – kan helpen in een evtuele doorstart.

qa: Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het verkopen en niet accepteren van EU-regiotickets door NS (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister why NS sells but does not accept the cross-border EU regional ticket and what steps have been taken on cross-border fare systems. The minister answered that consultations are ongoing, that NS accepts the ticket only on specific cross-border sections, and that the law and concession give no power to oblige NS to accept it.
The Passenger Transport Act 2000 and the concession for the main rail network offer no possibility to oblige NS to accept the Euregio ticket.
De Wet personenvervoer 2000 en de vervoerconcessie voor het hoofdrailnet bieden geen mogelijkheid de NS te verplichten het Euregioticket te accepteren.

Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over stand van zaken rondom de studie Rotterdam Vooruit en de Nieuwe Westelijke Oeververbinding (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

MP Cramer asked the minister of Transport and Water Management about the Rotterdam Vooruit masterplan, which compares the Blankenburg and Oranje tunnel options using allegedly non-comparable packages, underplays environmental effects, may pre-select the Blankenburg tunnel, and about stakeholder participation and adherence to the Elverding advice. The minister replied that the tunnel choice is not yet made, that both alignments are being compared fully, that the stakeholder meetings were informational and widened, and that the process follows the Elverding spirit while a formal consultation will follow.
Once this information is available for both alignments, an administrative preferred direction can be determined.
Zodra deze informatie voor beide tracés beschikbaar is, kan een bestuurlijke voorkeursrichting worden bepaald.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over financiële tegenvallers bij het programma hoogfrequent spoorvervoer (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Transport and Water Management about budget shortfalls in the high-frequency rail programme (PHS), including the Almere corridor, abandoned four-tracking at Delft-Zuid to Schiedam, and the proposed Schiedam Kethel station. The minister denies that a shortfall is yet established, says alternative solutions are being sought within the budget with a decision by year-end, and states that the Schiedam Kethel station and four-tracking are not needed within PHS before 2020 and will be examined in the NMCA.
By the end of this year I want to reach a decision on this with those involved.
Voor eind van dit jaar wil ik hierover vervolgens met de betrokkenen tot besluitvorming komen.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de toelating van Talent-treinstellen (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Transport about the admission to the Dutch network of Talent train sets (types 643.2 and 644) for a Aachen–Heerlen–Sittard connection, including whether 2005 test runs covered both variants and whether the sandwich configuration could be approved without new test runs. The minister answered that no admission request has been filed, that both variants were admitted in 2004 with the diesel-electric variant's admission later lapsing, that the sandwich set needs practical detection tests coordinated with ProRail, and that the operator must apply to the Inspectorate.
It is a matter for the operator which rolling stock it deploys on a route.
Het is een zaak van de vervoerder welk materieel hij inzet op een traject.

Vragen van de leden Cramer en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over vervanging van een (bijna) defecte OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why replacing a damaged or defective student OV-chipkaart requires a paper form and surrender of the old card, leaving students without travel rights for up to three weeks, and whether replacement at reasonable cost, or deactivation of the old card, can be arranged. The state secretary answered that card responsibility lies with transport operators, that verification and anti-misuse rules require the defective card to be returned, that temporary cards are issued when delays threaten, and that service levels are being agreed with operators.
I am making agreements with the OV companies about the service levels.
Ik maak afspraken met de OV-bedrijven over de niveaus van dienstverlening.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de stand van zaken MKBA ERTMS in relatie tot het programma hoogfrequent spoorvervoer (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

MP Cramer asks the minister about the delayed MKBA on ERTMS, why it was not sent to parliament, the proven benefits of deferred braking, remaining uncertainties, and why PHS rail corridor plans ignore ERTMS. The minister answers that the MKBA was completed in January 2010 and attached, acknowledges uncertainties about deferred braking and capacity gains, and commits to a sector evaluation in 2013 informing further ERTMS implementation.
I also indicated that the Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management, on the basis of a specific safety file valid only for this route, has granted permission for deferred braking.

Ik heb daarbij ook aangegeven dat de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat op basis van een specifiek veiligheidsdossier, dat alleen geldig is op dit traject, toestemming heeft gegeven om uitgesteld te remmen.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over een energiebesparingsplan voor de spoorsector (ingezonden 29 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Transport and Water Management why ProRail's energy-saving plan for the rail sector was not sent to parliament, whether an integral study with cost-benefit analysis was done, what NS is doing on energy saving and whether to include agreements in the new concession, and about costs, CO2 savings, RouteLint and electrification. The minister declined to send the internal ProRail plan, said the April letter gave sufficient overview, gave substantive but partly undetermined answers on costs and savings, and declined to make further concession agreements with NS.
I consider this sufficient, so in my view it is not necessary to send the integral energy policy plan, which is an internal ProRail document, to the House of Representatives.
Dit acht ik voldoende, zodat het in mijn ogen niet nodig is om het integrale energiebeleidsplan, dat een intern document van ProRail is, aan de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het besluit station Lisse niet te realiseren (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asked the transport minister why NS and ProRail decided not to reopen Lisse station for Keukenhof visitors, and whether the variant study and subsidy commitment would be shared or honoured. The minister answered that NS would not guarantee service due to capacity, cost and rolling-stock constraints, that the planning study was dropped, and that the study would be shared, though no aanlegbesluit would be taken without a service guarantee.
I asked NS and the Keukenhof foundation, and they indicated they have no objection to providing this study.
Ik heb NS en de stichting Keukenhof gevraagd en zij hebben aangegeven dat zij geen bezwaar hebben tegen het verstrekken van deze studie.

The minister says the ministry gave no advice to stop, grants compensation in the four cases the Board ruled on and some later cases, but will not reopen decisions from growers who did not appeal.
It was the choice of the pot plant growers themselves whether or not to start an appeal procedure.
Het is een keuze van de kuipplantentelers zelf geweest om al dan niet een beroepsprocedure te starten.

qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dam en Monasch over de aanbesteding van elektrische bussen in Friesland

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister why Friesland awarded an electric bus tender to Chinese firm BYD rather than a Dutch producer, and whether Chinese state aid made the award unfair. The minister replied that the tender followed EU rules on price and quality, that state aid to BYD was not excessive, and that the province could not legally be ordered to cancel the award, while promising to push for a stronger EU procurement and trade policy towards China.
It is up to a contracting authority to determine whether such a case arises.
Het is aan een aanbestedende dienst om te bepalen of zo'n geval zich voordoet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over een zieke Burundese vrouw van 67 jaar die acht maanden in vreemdelingendetentie zit

An MP asked about a 67-year-old dementia-affected Burundian woman held in immigration detention for eight months, whether alternatives such as a Leger des Heils facility were considered, and whether detention of elderly sick people should be restricted. The state secretary said the detention had been lifted after a Council of State appeal ruling, declined to discuss individual cases, and described existing medical assessment and proportionality rules without committing to new limits.
I apply the principle of restraint in providing information about individual cases.
Ik hanteer het uitgangspunt om terughoudend om te gaan met het verstrekken van informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch en Van Dam over drugssmokkel naar Schiphol

Opposition MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the minister about drug smuggling via Curaçao to Schiphol, including whether Curaçao's detention facilities for swallowers are adequate and whether suspects are wrongly allowed to fly on. The minister replied that Curaçao is responsible for its own law enforcement, cells are available for non-swallowers, the swallower toilets are not working optimally, and a broader integrated approach including the Schiphol team is being reviewed with a later update promised.
Law enforcement in Curaçao is the responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
De rechtshandhaving in Curaçao betreft de verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Thieme over vrijheidsbeperking

Six MPs asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether a Hague court ruling requiring individual proportionality for restricting the liberty of rejected asylum-seeking families with children should lead to halting transfers to family locations and to a rethink of shelter provided under liberty restrictions after a Supreme Court ruling on children's rights. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case with a lack of reasoning and draws no general conclusions, that transfers are handled with care pending government formation, and that the Supreme Court ruling does not conflict with the liberty-restriction measure, which serves public order and availability for departure.
In this individual case the court concluded that insufficient reasons were given for imposing a liberty-restricting measure.
In deze individuele zaak is door de rechter geconcludeerd dat onvoldoende was gemotiveerd waarom een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, en Schouw over het uitzetten van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration whether deportations of rejected asylum seekers to Guinea rely on corrupt authorities, how travel-document delegations and payments work, and whether a specific mother and children case and related investigations will be addressed. The minister answered that cooperation is necessary but structured via MoUs and delegations from Guinean ministries, that payments follow standard return practice, and that deportations will not be suspended, with the family case to be reported by end 2012.
Your House will be informed further about the family concerned before the end of 2012.
Uw Kamer wordt over het betreffende gezin voor het eind van 2012 nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over het falen van het Hongaarse asielbeleid

An MP asked the Minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether Hungary's asylum system fails EU standards, whether Dublin transfers should stop, whether detention and sanctions are warranted, and how burden-sharing should work. The minister replied that he sees no reason to suspend Dublin transfers or to challenge Hungary in the JBZ Council, relying on Hungary's assurances and interstate trust, and pointed to the pending Common European Asylum System for burden-sharing.
In view of this response from the Hungarian government, I proceed on the basis of the principle of interstate trust, which forms the core of the Dublin system, with regard to Hungary.
Gelet op deze reactie van de Hongaarse regering ga ik ten opzichte van Hongarije uit van het interstatelijk vertrouwensbeginsel, dat de kern vormt van het Dublinsysteem.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam over onrechtmatigheden bij de verkiezingen op Curaçao

An MP asked the minister about reports of vote-buying in the 2012 Curaçao elections, the oversight of election legitimacy, and implementation of party-financing recommendations. The minister answered that election organisation and party financing are the responsibility of the autonomous Curaçao government, that the Kingdom has no role, and that international observers are now being considered.
The countries are autonomous and themselves responsible for safeguarding the democratic legal order and ensuring that elections are orderly and lawful.
De landen zijn autonoom en zelf verantwoordelijk voor het waarborgen van de democratische rechtsorde en er voor zorg te dragen dat verkiezingen ordelijk en rechtmatig verlopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Van Dam over de vele dienstreizen van Nederlandse ambtenaren naar de BES-eilanden

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior about the large number of civil servant business trips to the Caribbean Netherlands islands, asking for per-department figures, how trips are assessed, whether limits should be set, and whether trips should be reduced. The minister gave figures only for his own ministry (189 trips, purpose not recorded), said each department decides on necessity, pointed to video-conferencing and twice-yearly meetings to reduce travel, and agreed in principle that trips could be reduced while leaving implementation to each department.
No, I can only provide you with an overview of the number of business trips for my own department.
Nee, ik kan u enkel voor mijn eigen departement een overzicht van het aantal dienstreizen geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dijksma over het ‘goochelen met uitzetcijfers’

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether the enforced-removal figures in the Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen overstate the share of former asylum seekers, and why border refusals were not separated out. The minister denied any misrepresentation, explained the composite nature of the figures, and said border refusals and asylum seekers are not mutually exclusive categories.
For the total departure figures it cannot be stated exactly whether they concern enforced removals of rejected asylum seekers.
Ten aanzien van de totale vertrekcijfers is niet exact aan te geven of het gedwongen uitzettingen van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers betreft.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam en Timmermans over het feit dat bezwaarschriften voor aanvragen van visa voor Nederland in veel gevallen in een andere taal dan het Nederlands dienen te worden geformuleerd

MPs Van Dam and Timmermans asked whether Schengen partners handle Dutch visa applications on Nederland's behalf so that appeals must be filed with another country, possibly in its language, and how that burdens Dutch citizens. The minister confirmed the arrangements and language requirements, but pointed to new applications or Dutch posts as alternatives and made no commitment to change the rules.
In those cases, an appeal against the refusal of the Schengen visa must be lodged with the Schengen country concerned.
In die gevallen dient een beroep tegen de weigering van het Schengenvisum bij het betreffende Schengenland te worden ingesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over de ontvangst van radio in delen van Noord-Holland

An MP asked how the power increase of the Lopik transmitter would be verified and whether alternative measures such as relay transmitters in Noord-Holland would be used. The minister answered that transmitter power was restored to pre-fire levels on 11 April 2012, that a further increase for Radio 4 is blocked by Belgian objections, and that no adequate alternatives exist yet.
The power of all transmitters at Lopik was increased on 11 April 2012 to the level before the fire.
Het vermogen van alle zenders op Lopik is per 11 april 2012 verhoogd tot het vermogen van voor de brand.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over de persvrijheid op Curaçao

An MP asks the Interior Minister how a Curaçao party leader's call to arrest and handcuff a newspaper editor for critical reporting fits press freedom, and what the Kingdom will do about intimidation of the press. The minister says Curaçao is primarily responsible, that press freedom is a fundamental right, and that the Curaçao prime minister has affirmed press freedom, while declining to specify consequences if the trend continues.
This concerns a dispute within the country of Curaçao. This dispute falls primarily under the responsibility of the government of Curaçao.
Het gaat hier om een dispuut binnen het land Curaçao. Dit dispuut valt primair onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de regering van Curaçao.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over het ‘Bel-me-niet register’

An MP asked the minister whether the exemption allowing companies to call existing customers registered on the Bel-me-niet register could be removed, or a separate objection category added, after a TROS survey showed most registrants find such calls annoying, and whether market research should fall under the same rules as the Telecommunications Act. The minister rejected removing the exemption as disproportionate, relying instead on the right of objection per call, promised better consumer information and to examine a time limit for former customers, and declined to integrate the self-regulatory MOA research filter into the register.
My assessment is that dropping the exemption for warm contacts or adding a separate category to the Bel-me-niet register does not meet the proportionality requirement.
Mijn inschatting is dat het laten vervallen van de uitzondering voor warme contacten of het opnemen van een aparte categorie in het Bel-me-niet register niet aan de proportionaliteitseis voldoet.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Van Dam over de berichten ‘Rechten asielkinderen geschonden’ en ‘Nederland riskeert berisping VN’

MPs Voordewind and Van Dam asked the immigration minister whether the Netherlands risks a UN reprimand over children's rights of asylum-seeking children, and whether prolonged uncertainty is causing serious psychological harm. The minister said the Netherlands has not been raised before the UN committee, denied a declining reputation, acknowledged uncertainty can harm children, and pointed to faster procedures and existing exceptions rather than a new scheme.
No. The Dutch state has not been addressed.
Nee. De Nederlandse staat is niet aangesproken.
Antwoord vragen  Hamer en Van Dam over kleine ondernemers die de volledige ketenboete voor illegale arbeidskrachten in hun maag gesplitst krijgen

MPs Hamer and Van Dam asked whether clients shift the full fine for illegal foreign labour onto small contractors through contract clauses or set-off, and whether this should be stopped. The minister says the broad employer definition makes all chain parties fineable, that fines can be reduced for clients who supervise compliance, and that civil courts can prohibit or moderate such recharging, but he sees no need for statutory measures given contractual freedom.
Statutory measures to prevent recharging I do not consider necessary at this time, partly because this would infringe the contractual freedom of parties.
Wettelijke maatregelen om doorbelasting te voorkomen acht ik nu niet nodig, mede ook omdat dit de contractvrijheid van partijen aantast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de gevolgen van drie uitspraken van de Raad van State voor homoseksuele asielzoekers

An MP asks the minister for Immigration whether the Council of State's three rulings on gay asylum seekers, which referred preliminary questions to the EU Court of Justice, mean that asylum seekers should not be expected to hide their sexuality, and whether pending cases should be suspended. The minister replies that Dutch policy is careful and consistent with EU law, agrees that sexuality need not be hidden where persecution risk exists, and expects answers from the Court in 2013 without affecting case handling, leaving any suspension to the courts.
It is for the judge to decide whether appeal procedures will be suspended.
Het is aan de rechter of procedures in (hoger) beroep zullen worden aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen van Dam over haar uitspraken over het tegengaan van dubbele nationaliteiten en het boerkaverbod

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether her remarks that bills on dual nationality and a face-covering ban are effectively off the table, and that she would not mind if the Chamber scrapped the face-covering ban, were accurate, and whether she would withdraw both bills. The minister confirmed the remarks, said the initiative to declare the bills controversial lies with the Chamber, and declined to withdraw them.
As I have previously stated, the initiative lies with the Chamber to declare the bills controversial or not.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven ligt het initiatief bij de Kamer om de wetsvoorstellen al dan niet controversieel te verklaren.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam, Gesthuizen, Dibi, Schouw en Voordewind over het stopzetten van zestien hoger beroepprocedures en het niet uitzetten van zestien Somaliërs

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister why he withdrew appeals in sixteen Somali asylum cases and stopped detention and removals, given the security situation in Mogadishu. The minister replied that return to North Somalia remains possible via Mogadishu airport, that the appeals were withdrawn because forced return could not be organised in a way he considered responsible at present, that detention was lifted, and that returnees without state-funded shelter are not entitled to accommodation.
That is why the appeals were withdrawn.
Daarom zijn de hoger beroepen ingetrokken.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam en Dibi over de overplaatsing van een Afghaans gezin met kinderen uit Akkrum naar de gezinslocatie in Katwijk

MPs Van Dam and Dibi asked whether an Afghan family with two Dutch-born school-age children would be moved from Akkrum to a family detention-style location in Katwijk, and why, given the parents' willingness to cooperate on return. The minister replied that the transfer is not going ahead, the family may stay in Akkrum pending a new hardship-based application, and he generally declined to discuss individual files.
I always exercise restraint in providing information about individual files.
Ik betracht steeds terughoudendheid met het verstrekken van informatie over individuele dossiers.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dam en Gesthuizen over een Iraaks gezin met kinderen dat uit de asielopvang is geplaatst en dakloos is geworden terwiji de asiel procedure nog loopt

MPs Van Dam and Gesthuizen asked why an Iraqi asylum-seeking family with children was evicted from reception while its asylum procedure was still pending, despite a court having annulled the earlier rejection and an appeal being outstanding. The minister's answer, as far as the text goes, was delivered confidentially and the substantive reasons are placed in a confidential annex.
I request that you treat these answers confidentially.
Ik verzoek u deze antwoorden vertrouwelijk te behandelen
Antwoord vragen Van Dam over de relatie tussen uitspraken van Eurocommissaris Kroes en de aandelenemissie van Ziggo

MP Van Dam asks the minister whether Commissioner Kroes's reported remarks about blocking Dutch cable-opening amendments may have affected the Ziggo share issue, and questions Ziggo's profits, executive pay and consumer prices. The minister says Kroes personally confirmed she made no such remark, refuses to judge profits, pay or investment decisions, and sees no reason to request EU investigations or to raise the matter with Kroes.
No, answers to these questions are not called for.
Neen, antwoorden op deze vragen zijn niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam over de signaalsterkte van de radio in Noord-Holland (min ELI)

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Education, Culture and Science why radio reception in northern Noord-Holland remains poor and when it will improve, and whether other regions have similar problems. The minister said higher transmitter power is being coordinated, with Radio 1-3 ready but Radio 4 still under negotiation with Belgium, and that full restoration depends on rebuilding the Hoogersmilde mast and repairing Lopik by around summer 2012.
Since 2008, Agentschap Telecom, together with the Dutch Public Broadcasting organisation (NPO), has worked on improving reception of national public broadcasters in the area mentioned.
Er is sinds 2008 door Agentschap Telecom, samen met de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO), gewerkt aan verbetering van de ontvangst van landelijk publieke omroepen in het genoemde gebied.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Recourt en Van Dam over het Haarlems Dagblad

MPs Dikkers, Recourt and Van Dam asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Haarlems Dagblad and Gooi- en Eemlander might disappear under Telegraaf Media Groep plans, and whether legal means exist to prevent it. The minister replied that TMG and HDC Media had stated no plan exists to close titles, that the press sector is primarily responsible for its own market problems, and that the government sees no reason to intervene.
The government therefore pursues a very restrained policy towards the press sector.
De overheid voert dan ook een zeer terughoudend beleid ten aanzien van de perssector.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam en Hamer over "het ontduiken van de werkvergunningplicht voor Roemeense en Bulgaarse werknemers door Nederlandse bedrijven"

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether companies are abusing posting and self-employed constructions to evade work permit requirements for Romanian and Bulgarian workers, and about illegal employment and wage competition. The minister acknowledged rising notifications, announced higher fines, stricter data sharing between UWV and the Inspectorate, and a requirement for employers to show documentary proof, but said illegal employment figures are unknown and wage rules apply to posted workers.
Figures on Romanians and Bulgarians working illegally in the Netherlands are not known.
Cijfers over Roemenen en Bulgaren die illegaal in Nederland werken, zijn niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het blokkeren of belemmeren van VOIP door tal van Europese telecomproviders (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether reported widespread blocking of VoIP by European mobile providers conflicts with EU telecom rules, whether DPI use for VoIP detection is a privacy intrusion, whether the minister will press for stricter net neutrality rules and whether providers may block services if content firms refuse to pay. The minister replied that they lack data on other countries, that EU rules only require transparency about restrictions, that the pending Dutch net neutrality bill would forbid blocking and separate tariffing of VoIP, and that the government will raise net neutrality in the Telecom Council.
I do not have factual data on the conduct of European telecom providers regarding VoIP in other countries.
Ik beschik niet over feitelijke gegevens over de handelwijze van Europese telecomproviders met betrekking tot VOIP in andere landen.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over hatecrimes (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior about hate crimes, including reports of 158 people driven out of their homes or workplaces for who they are, and proposals for a police hate-crime unit, anonymous reporting and better registration. The minister answered by referring to the July 2011 anti-discrimination letter listing measures, said anonymous reporting is limited to exceptional threatening situations while hate crimes can be reported anonymously online, and promised a progress report on homo-emancipation policy and discussion of the motion at a committee meeting.
The discrimination letter (Parliamentary Papers II, 2010–2011, 30 950, no. 34) lists a large number of measures against hate crime.
In de discriminatiebrief (Kamerstukken II, vergaderjaar 2010–2011, 30 950, nr. 34 ) wordt een groot aantal maatregelen tegen haatcriminaliteit opgesomd
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over compensatie voor consumenten voor het uitvallen van Blackberry (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the economics minister whether BlackBerry users have a legal right to compensation for the early-October 2011 outage, how to recover subscription costs and extra charges, and whether collective compensation or a statutory compensation right should be pursued. The minister answers that consumers rely on general Civil Code remedies, that the telecom networks functioned as expected, that a collective action is possible but the parties should first settle, and that he will consult the telecom sector but sees no reason for a special statutory right.
However, I am willing to consult with the telecom sector to explore what options exist for finding solutions to these kinds of problems.
Ik ben evenwel bereid om in overleg te treden met de telecomsector om te bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om tot oplossingen voor dit soort problemen te komen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de naleving van de wet Corporate Governance op Curaçao (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about Curaçao's Corporate Governance law, its origins, and a planned change to state-company model articles that would let the government give directives and remove grounds for dismissing commissioners. The minister said the Netherlands was not directly responsible, that Curaçao bears responsibility for compliance, and that the College financieel toezicht had advised reviewing collective dismissals of commissioners.
Responsibility lies with Curaçao (Government and Estates) to observe these and act accordingly.
De verantwoordelijkheid ligt bij Curaçao (Regering en Staten) om deze in acht te nemen en daarnaar te handelen.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het besluit van de gemeente Den Haag om Turkse inburgeringsweigeraars hun boetes kwijt te schelden (ingezonden 26 septe

An MP asks the minister about The Hague's decision to waive fines for Turkish citizens who refused integration courses after a court ruling that they could not be obliged to integrate, and about whether Germany's comparable obligation is consistent with the EEC-Turkey Association Agreement. The minister confirms the decision, advises municipalities not to collect unpaid fines while stating that already paid fines are legally valid and not refunded, explains that the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling forced him to adjust policy, and says a general learning obligation is being explored with sanctions for non-compliance.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het SCP-rapport «Poolse migranten» (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister about SCP findings that many recent Polish migrants plan to stay, that about half cannot speak Dutch, and whether compulsory lifelong learning should be introduced. The minister said the findings cover only registered Poles resident up to six years, pointed to voluntary integration courses and employer obligations, and said the cabinet will explore broader lifelong learning ideas without committing to a bill.
It will be examined whether the concept of age-independent compulsory learning can be broadly grounded in social security and the fight against illiteracy.
Uitgewerkt wordt of het concept van de leeftijdsonafhankelijke leerplicht breder aan de sociale zekerheid en de bestrijding van analfabetisme ten grondslag kan worden gelegd.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, landbouw en Innovatie over hoge annuleringskosten bij online boeken van reizen (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Dam and Dijksma asked why distance-selling cooling-off rights do not apply to travel bookings, whether online bookings bind consumers, and whether excessive cancellation or correction fees should be curbed. The minister answered that travel services are excluded from the withdrawal right for cost reasons, that consumers are bound once they accept terms before confirmation, and that existing industry terms and the reasonableness principle suffice, though a Commission proposal is expected in 2012.
Given existing practice in the travel sector and the consumer's options to act against excesses, I see no reason to amend the rules.
Gelet op de bestaande praktijk in de reisbranche en de mogelijkheden voor de consument om tegen excessen op te treden, zie ik geen aanleiding om de regels aan te passen.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbreuk op de privacy door LinkedIn (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

Labour MPs Van Dam and Recourt asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about privacy intrusions by LinkedIn, including the Dutch Data Protection Authority's (CBP) guidelines for social networking sites, whether commercial use of personal data without prior consent is objectionable, and whether the CBP should be instructed to change account settings. The State Secretary answered that the CBP applies privacy-friendly default settings and strict consent standards, that consent must be unambiguous under the Wbp, and that the government has no power to instruct the independent CBP on individual supervisory matters.
In view of this, I do not have the powers to instruct the CBP on how to act in individual supervisory cases.
Gelet hierop beschik ik niet over bevoegdheden om het Cbp voor te schrijven hoe zich te gedragen in individuele toezichtszaken.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over terreur van Marokkaanse jongeren in Helmond. (Ingezonden augustus 20

MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked ministers about intimidation and harassment by Moroccan youths in the Binnenstad Oost district of Helmond, including the role of local authorities and police, the number of youths involved, parental responsibility, reporting of crimes, camera monitoring and a reported neighbourhood curfew. The ministers answered that the situation is a nuisance problem rather than uncontrollable, describing an integrated local approach with arrests, a nuisance hotline, area bans and individual trajectories, and reported falling incident and nuisance figures.
There is a nuisance situation that must be tackled. There is no uncontrollable situation as presented in the cited article.
Er is sprake van een overlastsituatie die aangepakt moet worden. Er is geen sprake van een onbeheersbare situatie zoals deze wordt voorgesteld in genoemd artikel.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over onwettige uitzendconstructies voor Poolse werknemers (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

MPs Spekman and Van Dam asked the minister about a court ruling that a transport firm's agency construction for Polish drivers was unlawful and whether such constructions are widespread, how enforcement will be handled, and whether companies are relocating abroad to avoid Dutch collective labour agreement wages and tax. The minister answered that no data exist on such constructions, that social partners and the Labour Inspectorate share enforcement responsibility with no extra inspectors planned, and that the ruling is under appeal while existing enforcement continues unchanged.
There is no data known about the number of constructions like the one the court ruled on.
Er zijn geen gegevens bekend over het aantal constructies zoals de constructie waarover de Rechtbank zich heeft uitgesproken.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over abonnementen voor mobiel internet (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

Van Dam (PvdA) asks whether mobile internet price rises by KPN, Vodafone and T-Mobile signal healthy competition, tacit coordination, and whether the government should reserve spectrum for new entrants. Minister Verhagen answers that the market is competitive, that the competition authority NMa can act against cartels but the government will not commission its own investigation, and that spectrum reservation for two entrants of 2x10 MHz is considered balanced.
I do not know how much (unforeseen) investment the mobile providers have made. This data is commercially confidential.
Er is mij niet bekend hoeveel (onvoorziene) investeringen zijn gedaan door de mobiele aanbieders. Deze gegevens zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verminderde bereikbaarheid van alarmnummer 112 en het niet functioneren van C2000 in de regio Rotterdam (ingezonden 2

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reduced reachability of emergency number 112 and failure of the C2000 network in the Rotterdam region on 27 July 2011. The minister answered that 112 itself remained reachable, the outage affected KPN customers in two safety regions, the cause is under investigation, and the Inspectorate was asked to examine the telecom infrastructure.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Spekman (PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de mogelijke strijdigheid van de Wet Inburgering Buitenland met het EU-recht (

Van Dam and Spekman (PvdA) asked whether the Wet Inburgering Buitenland conflicts with EU family reunification law, citing an Advocate General opinion and an Ombudsman finding that no case had ever qualified as hardship. Minister Donner answered that the law is compatible, that individual cases cannot be discussed, and that a handful of exceptions were made since 2008, with hardship exemptions now registered separately.
I cannot go into the individual circumstances of individual cases when answering written questions.
Ik kan in de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden in individuele zaken.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het onderzoek naar de integriteit van instituties op Curaçao (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

Rep. Van Dam (PvdA) asks the Minister of Interior about the scope, legal basis and independence of the Kingdom Council of Ministers' inquiry into institutional integrity on Curaçao, including the Central Bank dispute and Curaçao's withdrawal of consent. The minister's communication states the questions were already answered in the 29 June debate and no written answer is needed.
All these questions were raised and answered in the debate on this matter on 29 June.
Al deze vragen zijn aan de orde gekomen en beantwoord in het debat over deze materie op 29 juni jl.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de mogelijke strijdigheid van de Wet Inburgering Buitenland de Gezinsherenigingsrichtlijn (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

MPs Van Dam and Spekman asked the minister whether the Wet Inburgering Buitenland conflicts with the EU Family Reunification Directive after a Zwolle court referred questions to the European Court, and why the minister granted an exemption and visa in one case after two years of defending the policy. The minister confirmed the individual exemption was granted on case-specific grounds, maintained that the law is compatible with the directive, and said the referral was the court's own competence.
The reason for granting was a combination of several individual facts and circumstances raised on appeal that led to the conclusion that this is a very special case.

De reden voor inwilliging is gelegen in een combinatie van een aantal, in beroep opgekomen c.q. aangevoerde, individuele feiten en omstandigheden welke tot de conclusie hebben geleid dat sprake is van een zeer bijzonder geval.

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Jellinek Curaçao (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the Jellinek Curaçao clinic, subsidised under the Netherlands Antilles cooperation programme, delivers on promises to benefit local addiction care and employment and to support a local partner organisation. The minister replied that the subsidy's primary aim is economic diversification, that some knowledge transfer and eight local staff exist, that a local doctor is still missing, and that advances will be recovered if results fall short, with the final report due mid-2011.
The funds transferred to this project so far are advances, which can only be finalised after completion.
De tot nu toe overgemaakte gelden aan dit project betreffen voorschotten, die pas na afronding kunnen worden vastgesteld.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over integratie van Somaliërs (ingezonden 23 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the poor integration of Somali newcomers (cumulative problems, very low employment, dissatisfaction with integration courses) and whether current instruments are adequate. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to broader SCP research showing more positive satisfaction with courses, and said the government organises knowledge-sharing meetings with municipalities and Somali organisations rather than announcing new measures.
Therefore the national government is organising, together with the most involved municipalities, network meetings aimed at knowledge sharing and exchange of expertise.
Daarom organiseert het Rijk samen met de meest betrokken gemeenten netwerkbijeenkomsten gericht op kennisdeling en expertise-uitwisseling

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie naar aanleiding van het lek van de website van de Postcodeloterij (inge

MPs Van Dam and Bouwmeester asked ministers about a leak on the Postcodeloterij website that exposed participants' personal data, and whether the organisation acted irresponsibly, breached the Wbp, could be sued, and whether the Wbp sanctions are adequate. Minister Opstelten answered that NPL did not wilfully expose data, has since fixed the leak, that liability and Wbp breach judgments belong to the Cbp and courts, and that the sanction regime is under review with a promised letter to parliament.
It is not for me to give a judgment on whether NPL violated the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp) in this specific case.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om een oordeel te geven over de vraag of NPL in dit concrete geval de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) heeft overtreden
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de financiële problemen op Sint Maarten (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Van Dam and Recourt asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about Sint Maarten's financial problems, including the premier's rejection of the Financial Supervision College's advice to issue a binding instruction on financial transparency and budget control. The minister answered that the Kingdom Council of Ministers has not yet decided, that requesting an instruction falls within the Rijkswet financieel toezicht, and that the Kingdom's guarantee function is a last resort.
The Cft has clearly stated that it needs access in order to assess whether there are no obligations that would hinder the possible use of any reserves.
Het Cft heeft duidelijk aangegeven de inzage nodig te hebben om te kunnen beoordelen of er geen verplichtingen zijn die het eventuele gebruik van mogelijke reserves zouden belemmeren.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bestrijding van antisemitische uitingen (ingezonden 11 februari 2011

MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior about a TV item showing a youth giving a Hitler salute and shouting antisemitic slurs at an interfaith walk, whether a complaint was filed, whether police acted, and whether police should use undercover officers and how many arrests for antisemitism occurred. The minister replied that a complaint was filed, a criminal investigation is ongoing with the suspect's photo published, police can act without a complaint and prosecution follows under the discrimination directive, no police were present at the walk, undercover deployment is a local matter, and national figures will follow before summer.
As the investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make any further statements.
Aangezien het onderzoek nog loopt, kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over zijn gesprek met het COC over voornemens van het kabinet die gezinsvorming van partners van hetzelfde geslacht belemmeren

Two PvdA MPs asked the immigration minister whether he conceded to the COC that his claim about same-sex couples marrying abroad or entering on tourist visas was untenable, and whether he would find an exception for same-sex partners. The minister said the route was more complicated than thought, that he would discuss the issue within cabinet and report back, and that the COC would be informed of the outcome.
I have committed to discussing the issue within the cabinet and then coming up with a proposal for a solution.
Ik heb toegezegd de problematiek binnen het kabinet te zullen bespreken en daarna met een voorstel voor een oplossing te komen.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de doorgifte van de programmering van BVN (Beste van Vlaanderen en Nederland) in Zuid-Afrika (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science why public broadcaster BVN ended its distribution via MultiChoice in southern Africa, whether tendering was required, and why the extension and notice came so late. The minister replied that BVN was legally obliged to tender the satellite distribution, that MultiChoice did not bid, that the signal was extended to 1 May 2011, and that she cannot promise continued MultiChoice access.
BVN is a contracting authority within the meaning of Directive 2004/18/EC and the Dutch public procurement rules (Bao) implementing it.
BVN is een aanbestedende dienst in de zin van de Richtlijn 2004/18/EG en het Besluit aanbestedingsregels voor overheidsopdrachten (Bao)

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dam (beiden PvdA)aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over oneerlijke concurrentie op de arbeidsmarkt (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked whether unemployed Polish EU citizens can be expelled, why the government emphasised expulsion rather than unfair labour-market competition and exploitation by employers and agencies, and whether they would answer before 28 February. The minister confirmed that EU citizens who become an unreasonable burden on social assistance can lose residence rights, said a package of measures on labour, housing and registration will be sent by 15 April, and promised the answers by 1 March.
I will inform you about this by 15 April at the latest.
Ik zal u hierover uiterlijk 15 april a.s. informeren.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de oproep van Turkse professionals om meer aandacht te schenken aan de integratieproblematiek van Turkse jongeren (inge

The MP Van Dam asks the Minister of Internal Affairs whether the signals of Turkish-Dutch professionals about integration problems among Turkish youth are recognised, whether there is a negative trend, and whether specific policy attention and political climate matter. The minister partly recognises the signals, points to mixed trends, rejects group-specific policy in favour of generic policy with tailored measures, and agrees to continue talks with the professionals.
It was agreed to remain in discussion on this subject with the IOT and the authors of the manifesto.
Afgesproken is om in gesprek te blijven over dit onderwerp met het IOT en de opstellers van het manifest.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bedreigingen tegen religieuze gebouwen en groepen in Amsterdam (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about threats against religious buildings and groups in Amsterdam, including concrete steps taken since the November debate and whether the state should provide more protection. The minister said the government will send a letter on anti-discrimination action in the first half of 2011, that no threatened mosque is known to the municipality, and that the principle of individual and organisational responsibility for security, with the state stepping in where needed, will not change.
I promised you in the debate of 4 November that in the first half of 2011 I would send a letter on the action programme to tackle discrimination.
Ik heb u in het debat van 4 november jongstleden toegezegd om in de eerste helft van 2011 een brief te zenden over het actieprogramma aanpak discriminatie.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de mishandeling van een Nederlandse journalist in Caïro (ingezonden 27 januari
