Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign and education ministers about the beating of a Trouw correspondent in Cairo by police and whether the Egyptian ambassador would be summoned and prosecution of the perpetrators pressed. The minister said the ambassador had raised concern with Egyptian authorities and that there was no indication of targeted violence against journalists.
The ambassador in Cairo expressed to the Egyptian authorities annoyance and concern about how this and other journalists were treated.
Door de ambassadeur in Cairo is tegenover de Egyptische autoriteiten ergernis en zorg uitgesproken over de wijze waarop deze en andere journalisten zijn behandeld.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de eisen van inburgering in het buitenland voor de gezinshereniging van

MPs Van Dam and Spekman asked whether Dutch pre-departure civic integration requirements block family reunification for two refugee-family cases and whether a hardship clause should be added. The minister answered that no exemption applies to these groups, that the exam is feasible, but that a hardship clause (effective 1 April 2011) has been added and one of the cases is being reconsidered.
Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Van Dam (PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het rapport Azerbeidzjan (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

MPs Peters and Van Dam asked ministers about the ICG report on Azerbaijan, covering authoritarianism, rule of law, human rights, migration cooperation, the Nabucco pipeline, and the 2010 elections. The minister answered that democracy and rule of law are deficient, outlined Dutch-funded rule-of-law projects and EU follow-up on ECHR rulings, but gave no concrete new commitments on migration cooperation.
During this period there has been a deficiently functioning democracy and rule of law.
Gedurende deze periode is er sprake van een gebrekkig functionerende democratie en rechtstaat.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Justitie over de rechterlijke uitspraak over de uitzending van flitsen van beeldmateriaal van eredivisiewedstrijden door regi

MP Van Dam asks ministers about a May 2010 Utrecht court ruling that regional broadcasters may request Eredivisie match footage under the Mediawet but may not broadcast it under copyright limits, and what follow-up is planned, including whether the law or the EU directive causes risks for news gathering. The ministers answer that the ruling is a summary-proceedings judgment with the main case still pending, so they will not intervene before the final judgment and will inform parliament later if needed.
It is not appropriate to intervene in a dispute that is before the court.
Het gaat niet aan te treden in een geschil dat onder de rechter is.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitspraken van de Eurocommissaris over het afronden van belminuten door telecomaanbieders (ingezonden 12 november 201

An MP asks the minister whether EU rules constrain national intervention against telecom operators rounding up call minutes, and whether the telecom law must be amended. The minister says Dutch law does not prohibit such rules, that the Telecommunicatiewet imposes no per-minute billing obligations and gives OPTA no independent power to order them, and that further measures would require lower-level regulation changes.
The Telecommunications Act imposes no obligations on mobile telephony providers regarding billing method and leaves no room for OPTA to independently decide on such obligations.
De Telecommunicatiewet legt geen verplichtingen op aan aanbieders van mobiele telefonie over de afrekenmethode en laat geen ruimte voor OPTA om zelfstandig te besluiten tot dergelijke verplichtingen.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem, Heijnen en Van Dam (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitgifte van Nederlandse reisdocumenten in het buitenland

Three PvdA MPs asked why external experts are required when municipalities audit passport issuance but not when embassies do, and whether this allows abuses such as the Bangkok incidents. The minister answered that embassies are under direct central supervision, that independent accountant audits and organisational inspections apply, and that no additional measures are needed.
I therefore see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding tot het treffen van additionele maatregelen.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het optreden van de Verenigde Naties in Congo (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about UN peacekeepers' response to systematic rape by armed groups in eastern Congo, including sanctions, ICC referral, the UN's failure to react to warnings, communications gaps, and whether Congolese forces can protect civilians. The minister answered that perpetrators should be prosecuted, supports added targeted sanctions, notes existing UN measures and ICC investigations, reports the UN's internal review and reinforcements, and says MONUSCO lacks the capacity to protect all civilians everywhere.
In his report to the Security Council on 7 September, Khare openly admitted that the UN had fallen short in protecting civilians in the area.
In zijn verslaglegging aan de Veiligheidsraad van 7 september jl. gaf Khare ruiterlijk toe dat de VN tekort zijn geschoten bij de bescherming van de burgers in het gebied.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam (PvdA) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur Wetenschappen over het overdag afsluiten van uitzendinggemist.nl (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

Two MPs asked the Minister why uitzendinggemist.nl would be made unavailable during daytime hours for programmes rated 12+, asking whether the Commissariaat voor de Media's position and the law support this, whether it is circumventable, and whether the law should be changed. The state secretary answered that the Mediawet 2008 obliges the public broadcaster to protect minors on all platforms, that time-slot protection under Kijkwijzer is the default, that no legislative change is desired, and that consultation on technical alternatives such as a family lock is underway.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de recente massale verkrachtingen van vrouwen in Oost-Congo (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about mass rapes of women in Walikale, eastern Congo, whether such attacks are unusual, who is responsible, what Dutch-funded aid reaches victims, mining control, MONUC's response and whether further investigation is needed. The minister answered that the scale is exceptional, attributed the attacks to the FDLR and May-May militia on UN findings, described Dutch-funded aid and MONUSCO's limits, and said the UN Secretary-General sent an assistant secretary-general to investigate the response.

Given the seriousness of the situation, the UN Secretary-General sent the head of the UN Department of Peacekeeping Operations, Atul Khare, to the DRC to investigate further how the UN mission in the field responded to the events.

Gezien de ernst van de situatie heeft de secretaris-generaal van de VN het hoofd van het Departement voor Vredesoperaties van de VN, Atul Khare, naar de DRC gestuurd om verder onderzoek te doen naar de wijze waarop de VN-missie in het veld op de gebeurtenissen heeft gereageerd.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Eijsink (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de bewapening van lokale milities in Afghanistan (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MPs Van Dam and Eijsink asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about NATO-backed plans to arm local militias in Afghanistan, including risks of renewed tribal violence, whether the arrangement is truly temporary, and who pays. Minister Verhagen answered that the Netherlands was informed and consulted, that the plan was renamed local police under Afghan Interior Ministry command with vetting and a three-week training, and that the US will fund it.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the further formal elaboration of this plan.
Nederland zal de verdere formele uitwerking van dit plan voorts nauwlettend in de gaten blijven houden.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Pechtold (D66), Peters (GroenLinks), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de detentie van de Venezolaanse rechter A

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the detention of Venezuelan judge María Lourdes Afiuni, whether it has raised concerns with Venezuela, and whether it will raise the case at EU level. The minister called the detention an infringement on judicial independence, supported the UN call for her release, said the Netherlands will follow the case in UN and EU contexts and will ask the High Representative to raise it with Venezuelan authorities.
I will check whether High Representative Ashton has raised this with the Venezuelan authorities, and advocate that she does.
Ik zal nagaan of Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton dit bij de Venezolaanse autoriteiten heeft aangekaart, en bepleiten dat zij dat doet.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanval van Israël op een internationaal hulpkonvooi (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

MP Van Dam asked the foreign minister whether Israel's assault on an aid convoy violated naval warfare law and international law, and whether the Netherlands would push for an EU-Israel Association Council and an independent inquiry. The minister defended the legality question as still under review, backed an impartial inquiry, but declined to convene the Association Council, citing Israel's own investigation and its eased Gaza access policy.
Investigation will have to show whether in this matter the rules of naval warfare law were followed.
Onderzoek zal moeten uitwijzen of in deze kwestie conform de regels van het zeeoorlogsrecht is gehandeld.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de resolutie in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad aangaande de veroordeling van de aanval van Israël op een internationaal hulpkonvooi (ingezonden 4 jun

MP Van Dam asked why the Netherlands voted against a UN Human Rights Council resolution condemning Israel's attack on an aid flotilla, and why Belgium, France and the UK abstained. Minister Verhagen confirmed the no vote, explained that the EU amendments were not accepted and that Israel and flag states should investigate first, and declined to judge other member states' positions.
The Netherlands, together with the UN Security Council and the High Representative, is of the view that Israel and, where desired, the flag states must first carry out an investigation.
Nederland was, met de VNVR en de HV, en is van mening dat het éérst aan Israël en desgewenst de vlaggenstaten is om onderzoek uit te voeren.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over geweld tegen deelnemers aan een anti-Israëldemonstratie (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MPs Van Dam and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior about police violence against participants in an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague and about an incident involving a woman in a headscarf. The minister answered that the demonstration departed from agreed conditions, that police used force after protesters tried to break a riot-police line, and that the involved suspects had disappeared while an investigation is ongoing.
The police repeatedly ordered the demonstrators not to advance further onto the Buitenhof, but demonstrators nonetheless tried to break a riot-police (ME) line.
De politie heeft diverse malen de demonstranten gevorderd niet verder het Buitenhof op te lopen, maar toch trachtten demonstranten een ME-linie te doorbreken.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het geweld in Oost-Congo en het effect van een mogelijk vertrek van MONUC (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

MP Van Dam asks the Foreign Minister about rising violence and rapes in eastern Congo, the Oxfam-cited risks of a MONUC withdrawal, and whether the government will press for mandate renewal and oppose Kabila's push for withdrawal. The minister says the UN Secretary-General sees improved security in the west, so a phased exit may be possible there, but eastern withdrawal requires Congolese capacity; Netherlands favours renewal focused on civilian protection and has raised this bilaterally and in the Great Lakes Contact Group.
The Netherlands considers extension of the MONUC mandate very desirable, mainly with a view to protecting the civilian population in eastern Congo.
Nederland vindt verlenging van het MONUC-mandaat zeer wenselijk, vooral met het oog op de bescherming van de burgerbevolking in Oost-Congo.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de boetes op basis van de Meststoffenwet

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about fines under the Meststoffenwet, including totals for 2014–2016 and breakdowns by type of violation and fine size. The minister confirmed the figures (about €22.6 million across 2,771 decisions) and gave detailed tables, while pointing to separate derogation reports and noting that derogation alone does not trigger fines.
For this I refer to the reports on the Dutch derogation as sent to the European Commission and to your House.
Hiervoor verwijs ik naar de rapportages over de Nederlandse derogatie zoals deze naar de Europese Commissie en naar uw Kamer zijn verzonden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een veetransport naar West-Siberië

An MP asked the government about a planned road transport of around 5,000 dairy cows from the Netherlands and Germany to West Siberia, and whether it complies with EU animal transport rules. The government answered that the NVWA is not aware the transport is ordered by Danone, that a travel plan must be assessed before approval, pregnant animals are restricted, and that no permanent veterinary supervision can be enforced outside the EU.
The NVWA supervises the planning and, prior to transport, the conditions under which such transports take place.
De NVWA ziet toe op de planning en voorafgaand aan het transport op de condities waaronder dergelijke transporten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het daadwerkelijke aantal dieren dat is omgekomen bij stalbranden

MP Ouwehand asked the government why reported death tolls from the Agelo pig barn fire varied widely, whether fire services rely only on owners' figures, and whether stable fire prevention and animal welfare measures are adequate. Minister Kamp answered that fire services do not establish animal numbers themselves and rely on owners, that the fire response does not depend on exact numbers, and referred to the Actieplan Stalbranden evaluation for policy.
The number of animals involved in a fire is not established by the fire service.
Het aantal betrokken dieren bij een brand wordt niet vastgesteld door de brandweer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het gebruik van lokmiddelen bij de bestrijding van landelijk vrijgestelde soorten

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the ban on lures in culling species exempted at national level is consistent with earlier statements and the Wet natuurbescherming, and whether the government will clarify or amend the rules to allow decoy calls and lure food. The Minister answered that the Vogelrichtlijn requires named methods to be designated, that lures are now designated for the national exemption, and that a Regeling change will follow shortly.

in the short term, by amending the Regeling natuurbescherming, the methods of catching and killing using non-living decoy birds, acoustic devices that can produce lure sounds, and non-poisonous or non-narcotic bait will be designated as permitted methods for the national exemption

zullen op korte termijn door middel van een wijziging van de Regeling natuurbescherming de methoden vangen en doden met gebruikmaking van niet-levende lokvogels, akoestische middelen waarmee lokgeluiden kunnen gemaakt en niet vergiftigd of verdovend lokvoer worden aangewezen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de oplopende verschillen tussen de melkprijs voor boeren en voor consumenten

An MP asks whether the widening gap between dairy farmers' milk prices and consumer prices is due to retail concentration and the abolition of the milk quota, and whether the government will strengthen farmers' earning model for sustainability. The minister answers that the gap is a market matter, that he sees no evidence linking it to retail concentration or quota abolition, and that farmers bear primary responsibility for their earning model while the government supports sustainability through existing programmes.
I have no indications that the growing difference is due to increasing market concentration in retail combined with the abolition of the milk quota.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat het oplopende verschil te wijten is aan de toenemende machtsconcentratie in de retail in combinatie met het afschaffen van het melkquotum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Hepatitis E in varkensvleesproducten

An MP asks the Health Minister whether Hepatitis E found in Dutch pork products endangers consumers, whether labelling, recall, notification duties and export warnings are needed, and whether blood and organ donations are at risk. The minister replies that HEV RNA does not prove infectious virus, the risk is limited to defined risk groups who receive dietary advice, and a notification duty is not needed for now, while the EFSA opinion and RIVM study are awaited.
Given the international dimension of the problem, a coordinating role for the European Commission is desirable and necessary for such additional measures.
Gezien de internationale dimensie van het probleem is bij dergelijke aanvullende maatregelen een coördinerende rol van de Europese Commissie gewenst en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat een nertsenfokkerij mogelijk ongeoorloofd heeft uitgebreid

An SP MP asked whether a Putten mink farm had expanded unlawfully, whether it had been inspected, and how enforcement against mink-farm violations and relocation abuse works. The minister replied that no expansion occurred, that the farm was inspected in June 2017 without violations found, that the NVWA and OM issued enforcement reports and new inspections followed, and that permit questions fall to municipalities.
Handling, assessing and granting or refusing environmental permits is a responsibility of the decentralised governments.
Het in behandeling nemen, beoordelen en al dan niet verlenen van omgevingsvergunningen is een bevoegdheid van de decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat fipronilkippen ondanks een verbod toch verkocht zouden zijn

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a report that fipronil-contaminated hens were sold despite a ban, including how many blocked farms sold hens, whether the NVWA's permit procedure was sound, and why a quote was removed from the RTL article. The minister answered that two breeding farms supplied hens to laying farms that were then also blocked, that the exemption to move hens was granted on animal welfare grounds via a NVWA permit procedure, and that the NVWA only corrected factual errors in the article.
The blocked breeding farm submits a request for exemption to the NVWA.
Het geblokkeerde opfokbedrijf dient bij de NVWA een verzoek in voor ontheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Arissen over lange afstandswedstrijden in de duivensport, waarbij meer dan de helft van de dieren uitvalt

MPs Wassenberg and Arissen asked about high loss rates in long-distance pigeon races, animal welfare rules, enforcement, and whether a ban is needed. The State Secretary said welfare rules apply, enforcement rests with the NVWA and the Dutch pigeon federation, and no ban is planned while the federation self-regulates.
I do not have the requested data on the organised pigeon events in the Netherlands.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde gegevens met betrekking tot de georganiseerde evenementen met duiven in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Jagersvereniging waarschuwt leden: totaalverbod op het gebruik van lokmiddelen bij landelijke vrijstelling'

MP Lodders asks why the Wet Natuurbescherming regulation no longer allows lure decoys and lure sounds for hunting species under the national exemption, and what the consequences are for hunters, agriculture and protected species. The state secretary says the omission was not intended, that the regulation will be amended as soon as possible, and that a provincial exemption can be requested in the meantime.
This amendment will be realised at the earliest possible opportunity.
Deze wijziging zal op de kortst mogelijke termijn worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat gemeenten pleiten voor een verplichte bedenktijd voor de aanschaf van huisdieren

An SP MP asked whether the government would respond to 36 municipalities calling for a mandatory cooling-off period before buying pets, and about enforcement against illegal online pet and puppy trade, a 'white list' of dog sellers, and the extension of the pet species list. The Secretary of State answered that existing 2014 rules should be evaluated before adding new measures, pointed to planned evaluation under the Wet dieren, said enforcement is limited to complaints for private owners, and promised further information on Marktplaats cooperation and a white list.
I am of the view that these measures, introduced on 1 July 2014, should be given a chance and evaluated before new measures are taken.
Ik ben van mening dat deze maatregelen, die 1 juli 2014 zijn ingesteld, een kans moeten krijgen en geëvalueerd moeten worden alvorens nieuwe maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat gemeenten worstelen met de groei van het aantal geitenstallen

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how the government responds to municipalities struggling with a growing number of goat stables linked to higher pneumonia risk, including a 2,700-goat stable near Breda, and whether local authorities can refuse permits based on RIVM findings. The state secretary answered that further research is planned into the elevated disease burden, that permit decisions remain the competent authority's responsibility, that a handbook on livestock and health is being prepared, and that Noord-Brabant introduced a moratorium on expansion of goat stables.
Because the cause of the disease burden around goat farms is unclear, we will commission follow-up research on this point.
Omdat de oorzaak van de ziektedruk rond geitenhouderijen onduidelijk is, zullen wij op dit punt vervolgonderzoek uit laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doden van beschermde houtsnippen

MP Wassenberg asked about a court ruling on the killing of protected woodcocks at Duivenvoorde estate, whether a game warden with investigative powers took part, and whether such officers should be barred from hunts they supervise. The State Secretary answered that the warden's dual role is justified with strict training and supervision requirements, saw no reason for further restrictions, pointed to existing protection rules, and confirmed the public prosecutor did not appeal.
I see no reason to impose further restrictions on the game warden.
Zie ik geen reden om nadere beperkingen op te leggen aan de jachtopzichter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het alarmerend bericht over door mest verontreinigd grondwater

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that manure is contaminating groundwater used for drinking water, including exceedances at 89 abstraction points and who is responsible for protection and remedies. The government answered that agricultural nitrate is the main cause, that the provinces and Minister of Infrastructure and Environment share responsibility, and that a tailored, non-statutory approach with water companies and farmers is planned, with a review by 1 January 2019 and possible further measures.

If insufficient progress has been made by 1 January 2019, the responsible governments (central government and provinces) will jointly consider which necessary measures to take to resolve manure-related problems at drinking water abstraction points.

Indien op 1 januari 2019 onvoldoende voortgang is bereikt, dan zullen de verantwoordelijke overheden (Rijk en provincies) in samenwerking bezien welke noodzakelijke maatregelen genomen worden om mestgerelateerde knelpunten in de drinkwaterwinningen op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Visser over het bericht 'Opzeggen vissersakkoord door Britten kan ramp zijn voor Nederland'

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about the UK's notice to terminate the London Fisheries Convention and its consequences for Dutch fishers, including the 6-12 mile zone and the Brexit negotiations. The government confirmed the termination was filed on 3 July 2017, said Dutch-flagged vessels barely fish that zone, and noted the issue will be part of the wider EU-UK relationship talks.
The Convention has a two-year notice period and ceases to apply to the United Kingdom on 3 July 2019.
Het Verdrag heeft een opzegtermijn van twee jaar en verliest zijn werking jegens het Verenigd Koninkrijk op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Groot deel Klaverbank verwoest’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that bottom trawling had devastated part of the Klaverbank Natura 2000 area and why no protective measures apply yet. The State Secretary replied that the single dive covers only a small part of the area, that protective measures will be set out in a management plan and through EU channels with neighbouring countries, and that a joint recommendation to the European Commission is expected to be launched in autumn 2017.
I am working diligently and carefully on an agreement with neighbouring countries on a joint recommendation to the European Commission for the protection of the Klaverbank.
Ik werk voortvarend en zorgvuldig aan een akkoord met de buurlanden voor een gezamenlijke aanbeveling aan de Europese Commissie voor de bescherming van de Klaverbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over “Ernstige zorgen over de exportpositie van de Nederlandse paardensector”

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of export problems for the Dutch horse sector after EIA cases in Netherlands and Germany, including whether Germany has more favourable certificates and what action will be taken. The State Secretary confirmed the EIA cases and export restrictions in several countries, denied that Germany has more favourable certificates (noting only minor differences from negotiations), and said the government will seek the most favourable export conditions bilaterally and via the European Commission, in consultation with the sector.
Equal export conditions (level playing field) are achieved because the European Commission agrees veterinary export conditions with third countries on behalf of the member states.
Gelijke exportvoorwaarden (level playing field) worden bereikt doordat de Europese Commissie namens de lidstaten met derde landen veterinaire exportvoorwaarden overeenkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de gevaarlijke stof fipronil in eieren en de rol van de NVWA

An SP MP asked the government for a detailed timeline of NVWA actions on fipronil in eggs, why only farms treated since January 2017 were blocked, who traces contaminated eggs, whether egg-containing products were affected, why sampling was insufficient, and what measures will prevent recurrence. The ministers referred to earlier letters and largely described existing procedures, with a commitment to review biocide enforcement and to expand residue monitoring.
Is this issue a reason for you to step up NVWA inspection of biocides, especially when they come from abroad?
Is deze kwestie voor u aanleiding de controle door de NVWA van biociden, zeker wanneer deze afkomstig zijn uit het buitenland, op te voeren?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over honderdduizenden kippen die dreigen te worden gedood na ongefundeerde uitspraken van de NVWA in de fipronil-affaire

An MP asks whether the NVWA was right to tell poultry farmers they may decide themselves to kill fipronil-contaminated hens, and whether killing them is lawful under the Wet dieren, plus questions on hen-disease rules, treatment obligations, and NVWA oversight. The ministers answer that farmers may decide to have hens killed, that killing is not prohibited for hens under the cited provisions, that the NVWA gave no advice on the hens' fate, and that about 1.5 million hens had been killed at 47 locations by 15 August.
The NVWA indeed indicated that a poultry farmer can independently decide to have his hens killed early, without the government being obliged to do so.
De NVWA heeft inderdaad laten weten dat een pluimveehouder zelfstandig kan beslissen zijn kippen voortijdig te laten doden, zonder dat de overheid daartoe verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber en De Groot over fipronil in eieren

MPs Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber and De Groot asked the ministers about the fipronil egg crisis, including a toxicologist's claim that the Dutch limit is too strict, the RASFF notification process, when the Netherlands knew of contamination, and differing risk approaches across member states. The government defended the EU residue limit, explained the RASFF process and the ARfD and ADI tests used, admitted a date error, and said it would examine the differences in approach.
For the answer to this question I refer you to our letter of 10 August.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar onze brief van 10 augustus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Marijnissen over het bericht dat melkgeitenhouders in opmars zijn

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that goat dairy farms are expanding despite Q-fever concerns, whether expansion raises infection risk, what advice local health services gave on a specific expansion, and whether compensation for Q-fever victims will be reconsidered. The government answered that existing measures such as vaccination and milk-tank monitoring keep the risk low, that permitting is a municipal responsibility, that it does not track expansion locations, and deferred the compensation question to a separate cabinet response.
The Brabant Due Diligence Score is not public until the expansion permit is granted.
De Brabantse Zorgvuldigheidsscore is niet openbaar tot toekenning van de vergunning tot uitbreiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de verhoogde kans op longontsteking nabij pluimveebedrijven

MPs Van Dekken and Leenders asked about a study finding higher pneumonia rates near poultry farms and what the government will do about it. The state secretary cited the study's statistical association, pointed to forthcoming measures and an interim wet veedichte gebieden bill, and said emissions rose after the battery-cage ban.
Work is also underway on a proposal for an interim act on densely farmed areas.
Verder wordt gewerkt aan het voorstel voor een interim-wet veedichte gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over voedselverspilling voor energiewinning

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about food waste being diverted to anaerobic digesters for energy, including subsidy effects, energy crop land use, co-digestion controls and the SDE+ incentive. The State Secretary largely defended the policy as technology-neutral and needed for renewable energy targets, noted that enforcement by the NVWA has been strengthened, and promised follow-up through a biomass and food transition agenda.
In the programme De Monitor I said I am willing to examine whether the subsidy on biogas digestion leads to good food being used for digestion.
In het programma De Monitor heb ik gezegd dat ik bereid ben na te gaan of er door de subsidie op biovergisting goed voedsel voor vergisting gebruikt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het mesttransport naar Duitsland

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary about German restrictions on Dutch manure transport and whether the Netherlands had escalated the matter to the European Commission. The government replied that it shared its interpretation of EU rules with Lower Saxony, the Commission confirmed the Dutch view, and the new German manure policy is seen as consistent with the Nitrates Directive.
Recently I received the European Commission's position, which confirms the Dutch view.
Recentelijk heb ik het standpunt van de Europese Commissie ontvangen, waarin zij de zienswijze van Nederland bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat ijzerhoudend grondwater fosfaat in landbouwgebieden minder schadelijk maakt

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary whether iron-rich groundwater reduces phosphate's impact on water quality, and whether the WFD standards, the STONE model, the Nitrates Directive programme and EU reporting should be adjusted accordingly. The government largely maintains current policy, saying new insights will be incorporated in updates for 2022-2027 and the 7th programme, and that the 6th programme focuses on good agricultural practice.
Water managers can, on the basis of new scientific insights, adjust water quality targets for the river basin management plans 2022–2027.
Waterbeheerders kunnen op grond van nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten waterkwaliteitsdoelen voor de stroomgebiedbeheerplannen 2022–2027 bijstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een varkenshouder met beroepsverbod in Duitsland die in Nederland uit mag breiden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a pig farmer barred from practising in Germany for animal cruelty who may expand a Dutch megastable, and about the inspection history of his Dutch farms. The State Secretary said the NVWA inspected the farms repeatedly, with several warnings and one fine, that the German ban cannot by itself block an environmental permit, and that criminal courts, not administrative bodies, decide on practice bans in the Netherlands.
A practice ban imposed on an entrepreneur in another country cannot in itself be grounds for refusing an environmental permit requested by that entrepreneur.
Een beroepsverbod dat een ondernemer in een ander land is opgelegd, kan op zichzelf geen grond zijn voor het weigeren van een omgevingsvergunning die door deze ondernemer is aangevraagd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen en het uitblijven van een reactie op het verzoek van de Kamer van 13 april 2017 over de uitspraak van het College van Beroep over de Positieflijst zoogdieren 2015

MP Lodders asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how the government will respond to the Court of Appeal's ruling that the 2015 mammal positive list methodology was flawed, why a new assessment of about 300 species was done before the ruling, and whether the list should be withdrawn. The state secretary answered that the ruling restores the previous status of muntjacs and mazama with immediate effect, that the re-assessment was done because the full inventory was only completed in 2016 and no ruling was expected, and referred to earlier letters for the other questions.
The amendment of the regulations has been initiated.
De aanpassing van de regelgeving is in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over boeren in Limburg die drones gaan gebruiken in de strijd tegen criminelen die in hun maisvelden stiekem hennepplantages onderbrengen

PVV MPs Helder and Graus asked whether police helicopter flights to detect cannabis cultivation in Limburg maize fields were stopped for lack of funds, and how farmers would be protected. The Minister replied that flights were halted because detections had been very few, that helicopters can still be used on concrete indications, and that farmers share responsibility for protecting their property.
Because the number of cannabis plantations detected in this way was very small, it was decided to stop these control flights.
Omdat het aantal wietplantages dat op deze wijze werd opgespoord zeer gering was, is besloten te stoppen met deze controlevluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het uitblijven van de vermaatschappelijking van faunabeheereenheden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs why nature and animal protection organisations are absent from some faunabeheereenheden boards, despite a promised democratisation under the Nature Conservation Act, and whether provinces will be pressed or plans withdrawn. The State Secretary replied that provincial ordinances now meet the statutory requirements in all but one province, that Noord-Holland will amend its ordinance, that actual board composition is published by each unit, and that he sees no reason to pressure provinces.

I have established that in all provinces except one, ordinances with provisions on the boards of the faunabeheereenheden that meet the requirements of the Nature Conservation Act have been in force since 1 January 2017.

Ik heb vastgesteld dat in alle provincies – op één na – sinds 1 januari 2017 verordeningen van kracht zijn geworden met bepalingen ten aanzien van de besturen van de faunabeheereenheden die voldoen aan de vereisten van de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de implementatie van het Nagoya Protocol en de gevolgen daarvan voor Nederland

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the EU implementation of the Nagoya Protocol, including fears of perpetual patents, retroactive application in China, and whether commercial varieties should be excluded. The State Secretary answered that the EU cut-off date of 12 October 2014 applies, that commercial varieties are under discussion in EU expert groups, and that Dutch positions are being prepared.
Formal questions for clarification have been submitted to the relevant Chinese authorities.
Er zijn formeel vragen voor verduidelijking ingediend bij de betreffende Chinese autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het stoppen van Deense hulp aan jaarlijkse dolfijnslachtingen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government supports a Sea Shepherd request for an EU infringement procedure against Denmark over dolphin hunts in the Faroe Islands under the Habitats Directive. The state secretary replied that the Faroe Islands fall outside EU treaty scope, so the Habitats Directive does not apply and no infringement procedure is possible, though the government will keep raising the issue with Denmark.
Expressing support for a request to start an infringement procedure is therefore not possible.
Het uitspreken van steun aan een verzoek tot het starten van een inbreukprocedure is derhalve niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over misleiding bij autoverhuur aan toeristen in het buitenland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about consumers being misled by hidden extra costs when renting cars abroad, and how transparency and supervision could be improved. The minister answered that consumers must not be misled, pointed to existing EU consumer rules and the ACM's supervision, noted improvements from an EU-level joint action, and saw no need for further measures for now.
At this moment I see no need to take other measures, since the measures taken at European level have led to more transparent offers and conditions at car rental companies.

Op dit moment zie ik geen noodzaak tot het nemen van andere maatregelen aangezien de in Europees verband getroffen maatregelen hebben gezorgd voor transparantere aanbiedingen en voorwaarden bij de autoverhuurbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het nieuwbouw proefdiercentrum van het Erasmus MC

An MP asked the state secretary about a new 6,000 m2 animal research centre at Erasmus MC, funded by a 4.2 million euro interest-free loan, and whether this fits the government's goal of leading in animal-free research by 2025. The state secretary confirmed the project, said it consolidates existing facilities without increasing animal experiments, and that subsidy requests are assessed on economic, social, scientific and 3Vs criteria.
It does not concern an increase in the number of animal experiments but an improvement of the conditions for the research.
Het gaat daarbij niet om een uitbreiding van het aantal dierproeven maar om verbetering van de omstandigheden voor het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over RVO naar aanleiding van vele klachten van ondernemers

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about many complaints from entrepreneurs over RVO's registration of livestock units (GVE's) for the phosphate reduction plan, including causes of discrepancies, timing of fines, and pending files. The State Secretary answered that RVO received seven formal and 18 phone complaints, that about 5,500 files may lead to adjustments, that most farms should receive their fine letters by end of June, and that the regulation was amended on 28 April 2017.
The expectation is that by the end of June all companies will have received their letter about the fine.
De verwachting is dat eind juni alle bedrijven hun brief over de geldsom hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid De Groot over de toepassing van de MIA/VAMIL-regeling op potstallen

An MP asked whether potstallen (pot stables) improve manure quality and soil, whether MIA/VAMIL tax schemes require listing in the Rav annex or MDV certification, and what other support exists. The State Secretary answered that the potstal is excluded from the Rav and cannot be built since 2015, that MDV-certified and certain low-emission or proefstal systems qualify for MIA/VAMIL, and that no other national subsidy supports potstallen.
The potstal system is not listed as a housing system in Annex 1 of the Rav.
Het potstalsysteem staat niet als huisvestingsysteem in bijlage 1 van de Rav.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doodschieten van ontsnapte antilopes bij Hunsel (Limburg)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the shooting of two escaped eland antelopes near Hunsel, whether they could have been captured instead, the police role, and the owner's prior escapes. The State Secretary regretted the deaths, explained experts judged capture infeasible due to aggression and traffic danger, said the NVWA could not prove prior escapes came from this owner, and stated no permit is needed for eland antelope keeping.
However, it proved impossible to establish with full certainty that the animals came from the owner in question.
Het bleek echter niet mogelijk om met volledige zekerheid vast te stellen dat het dieren betrof die afkomstig waren van de betreffende eigenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over de schade aan het koraal voor de kust van Curaçao

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked about coral damage off Curaçao, whether the permit was breached, enforcement, compensation, Dutch assistance and treaty compliance. Minister Plasterk answered that investigations are ongoing, that permitting and enforcement are matters for Curaçao's own government, and that nature protection there is not the Kingdom's responsibility.
Permit granting and construction work on Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten are matters for the countries themselves.
Vergunningverlening en bouwwerkzaamheden op Aruba, Curaçao en Sint Maarten zijn landsaangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de verstoring van jacht in broedtijd

MP Ouwehand asks whether hunters who shot geese during the breeding season in a Staatsbosbeheer nature area acted lawfully, whether charges were filed, and whether a general hunting ban in breeding, moulting and nursing periods should be introduced. The State Secretary replies that the shooting took place on adjacent land under a provincial exemption, no report was drawn up, a general ban is unnecessary, stricter penalties are not planned, and that provinces can attach conditions to exemptions.
No official report was drawn up, because there was no shooting in the Arkemheen polder nature area.
Er geen proces-verbaal opgemaakt, omdat er geen sprake was van afschot in het natuurgebied polder Arkemheen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over voedsel- en landbouwbeleid voor Caraïbisch Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked about food and agriculture policy for the Caribbean Netherlands, given trade deficits and high food prices, and whether UPG status could help. The government answered that agriculture is primarily the islands' own responsibility, supported by a modest EUR 150,000 per year fund, and that UPG status would bring limited benefits and substantial burdens.
It is therefore primarily up to the islands themselves to give substance to this.
Het is daarmee primair aan de eilanden zelf om hier invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Diertens en Van Meenen over de oproep om een gezonde voedselomgeving te bevorderen

MPs De Groot, Diertens and Van Meenen asked about a call by food scientists to make healthy eating the easy choice, including reported plans by Dunkin' Donuts to open outlets in schools and hospitals. The state secretary said the government supports a healthy food environment, works with schools, municipalities and food partners through existing programmes, and has no known plans for fast-food outlets in schools or hospitals.
As far as is known, there is currently no question of Dunkin' Donuts or any other fast-food chain opening outlets in schools and hospitals.
Antwoord 3, 4 Voor zover bekend is er momenteel geen sprake van een eventuele vestiging van Dunkin» Donuts of een (andere) fastfoodketen in scholen en ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Kerstens over de recycling van afgedankte smartphones

MPs Cegerek and Kerstens asked about recycling of discarded smartphones, Greenpeace's call on manufacturers, collection volumes, repair incentives, collection actions and the role of shops, recycling targets, and jobs. The state secretary answered that roughly half of about 900,000 discarded phones yearly are estimated to be recycled through certified channels, that existing producer collection and WEEE targets apply, and that circular-economy measures are under development, with a KPMG jobs study due in 2017.
No recent figures are known for this.
Hier zijn geen recente cijfers van bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over stroperij met honden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about greyhound-based poaching: what happens to seized dogs, penalties for poachers, whether such cases are rising, and whether enforcement capacity in rural areas is adequate. The government answered that seized dogs are usually rehomed at the discretion of the Public Prosecution Service or a judge, that poaching is punishable under nature protection law, that no central registration of poachers exists, and that enforcement capacity is considered sufficient.
No central registration is kept of the number of apprehended poachers.
Er wordt geen centrale registratie bijgehouden van het aantal gepakte stropers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over het bericht ‘Alleen noodfonds kan schaapskuddes nog redden’

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how the government responds to reports that only an emergency fund can save traditional shepherd flocks, and whether it will support them. The state secretary says the financial position of shepherds is a provincial responsibility under the Natuurpact, that he is working with provinces and organisations toward a structural solution, and that an emergency fund is unnecessary if a structural solution is provided.
I am of the view that when shepherds are offered a structural solution, an emergency fund is not needed.
Ik ben van mening dat wanneer herders een structurele oplossing geboden wordt, een noodfonds niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen omtrent het stalsysteem 'koeientuin'

An MP asked the State Secretary about the 'koeientuin' cow-barn system, which has no straw bedding and therefore conflicts with EU organic rules, and whether innovative stall concepts can be blocked by existing rules. The government answered that it requested an individual exemption from the EU, which the Commission refused, and that a possible solution may come from pending revisions of the organic regulation.
The Netherlands requested the European Commission for an individual exemption from the mandatory presence of bedding.
Nederland heeft aan de Europese Commissie verzocht om een individuele ontheffing van de verplichte aanwezigheid van strooisel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verliezen van de SKAL-licentie door het innovatieve stalconcept de 'Koeientuin' op een biologisch melkveebedrijf in Groenlo

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about a Groenlo organic dairy farm losing its SKAL licence because its innovative 'Koeientuin' barn omits straw bedding, and whether rules can be relaxed. The state secretary confirmed EU organic production rules block the concept, that Nederland's request for an individual exemption was rejected by the European Commission, and referred to an earlier answer for further action.
The European organic production rule on the mandatory presence of bedding of straw or other suitable natural materials is an obstacle to producing organically with this barn concept.

De Europese biologische productieregel inzake de verplichte aanwezigheid van strooisel bestaande uit stro of andere geschikte natuurlijke materialen vormt een belemmering om met dit stalconcept biologisch te produceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat illegaal oesters rapen tot oneerlijke concurrentie leidt

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether illegal oyster raking that exceeds the 10 kg personal-use limit, and is sold, distorts competition for the professional sector, and how it will be enforced. The government replies that enforcement lies with the province of Zeeland, which is working with the sector and ministries on stronger measures.
Primary responsibility for shellfish raking lies with the provinces under the Nature Conservation Act.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor het rapen van schelpdieren ligt op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over jachtincidenten en het houden van een jachtdag tijdens een hardloopwedstrijd op Ameland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about hunting incidents and a hunting day held on the same day and place as a running race on Ameland, asking for overviews of accidents, a reporting duty, and possible bans. The State Secretary said the hunting day is a long-standing faunabeheer arrangement that the wildlife management unit and race organisers coordinate, that no central accident register exists, and that no reporting duty or statutory ban is currently warranted.
No central registers of hunting accidents are kept.
Er worden geen centrale registers bijgehouden van jachtongelukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het dreigende vertrek van onderzoeksafdelingen van veredelingsbedrijven door het uitblijven van support

An MP asked the state secretary about HZPC's threat to move its research department abroad over the lack of government support for new breeding techniques such as CRISPR-Cas, and about the government's proactive stance, the GMO classification, the risks of the techniques, and the Lodders and Remco Bosma motions. The government answered that it is monitoring the sector, keeps pressing the European Commission for clarity while treating products of new techniques as GMOs in the meantime, stresses that research with these techniques is possible in the Netherlands under conditions, and says it is still looking for a suitable way to organise a public debate.
Pending that, the Netherlands regards products obtained with these techniques as genetically modified organisms (GMOs).
In afwachting hiervan beschouwt Nederland voortbrengselen die met behulp van deze technieken zijn verkregen als genetisch gemodificeerde organismen (ggo's).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het fosfaatreductieplan 2017

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the 2017 phosphate reduction plan, including its effects on dairy farms started after 2 July 2015, the differing reference dates for dairy and non-dairy farms, the timing of RVO's reference determination, and bank forbearance. The State Secretary answered in detail, saying the scheme will be limited to dairy farms, that reference determination may take longer, and that the scheme will not be postponed.
Your House will be informed separately about this in the short term.
Uw Kamer wordt hier op korte termijn separaat over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de berichten dat ook Nederlandse bedrijven vlees van Braziliaanse vleessjoemelaars afnemen

An SP MP asked the Health and Economic Affairs state secretaries whether rotten meat from Brazilian firms JBS and BRF reached Dutch shops or restaurants, and what the NVWA was doing. The government replied that the NVWA found no sign of contaminated meat on the Dutch market, has rejected many shipments and intensified inspections, and will not recall products, while noting a possible import ban is among the options.
I do not have access to the administration of individual companies.
Ik heb geen inzage in de administratie van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uit de hand gelopen pachtprijzen bij geliberaliseerde pacht en het eindeloos trage overleg over de kwestie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about rising lease prices for liberalised short-term farmland leases (managed by the Bureau Beheer Landbouwgronden and other state bodies), whether the government steers land toward short leases, and why the lease reform consultation drags on. The State Secretary largely defends the current market-based approach, says no rule forces other landlords' lease choices, promises a policy response after the mediator reports, and rejects temporary price measures for now.
I do not want to anticipate the revision of the lease system.
Ik wil niet vooruit lopen op de herziening van het pachtstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de spieringvisserij op het IJsselmeer

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether provinces' refusal to grant Nature Conservation Act permits for smelt fishing on the IJsselmeer, and the unrevised Fisheries Act protocol, prevent smelt fishing this year. The state secretary answered that the protocol is separate from permit granting, that the protocol would have allowed fishing on the numbers, but trial fishing did not take place because applications were incomplete, and that a new study will be ready this year and discussed with the provinces.
The study referred to in the answer to question 4 will take place in consultation with the relevant provinces.
Het onderzoek waarnaar gerefereerd wordt in het antwoord op vraag 4, zal in overleg met de betreffende provincies plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over bescherming van natuurgebied ’t Merske

SP MPs asked the state secretary about chicken barns planned on the Belgian side of the Mark near natural area 't Merske, including nitrogen emissions, water quality, EU Water Framework Directive effects, and buffer zones. The government replied that the province of Noord-Brabant and Brabantse Delta water board are primarily responsible, that they raised concerns with Flemish authorities leading to extra permit conditions and an agreement to inform each other earlier, and that the buffer zone motion does not apply since the area is not a Natura 2000 site.
The natural area 't Merkske is not a Natura 2000 area. Therefore the Smaling motion (parliamentary document 31 038, no. H) does not apply to this natural area.
Het natuurgebied ’t Merkske is geen Natura2000-gebied. Derhalve is de motie Smaling (Kamerstuk 31 038, nr. H ) niet van toepassing op dit natuurgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat de fosfaat-stikstof verhouding in de Noordzee uit balans is

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the phosphorus-nitrogen imbalance in the North Sea, linked to manure and detergent policy, justifies easing or pausing phosphate reduction and the phosphate rights system, and what measures could restore the balance. The state secretary rejected the claim of a phosphate shortage, argued that nitrogen reduction (including from abroad) is the priority, and said the findings will feed into the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme and EU reporting.
There is no shortage of phosphate in the coastal zone of the North Sea.
Er is geen sprake van een tekort aan fosfaat in de kustzone van de Noordzee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Maij over het wegduiken van lidstaten bij gevoelige kwesties in Europa

MPs Van der Velde and Maij asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about member states avoiding contentious EU decisions on GMOs and pesticides, and whether the Commission's proposal to shift comitology responsibility to member states is adequate. Minister Koenders answered that impasses arise over health and safety questions, Dutch positions follow stated policy, the appraisal of the proposal is still being formed, and the next steps are not yet known.
That is why he announced that he wanted to present the proposals now on the table to place political responsibility for decisions on implementing acts more with the member states.

Daarom kondigde hij aan met de nu voorliggende voorstellen te willen komen om de politieke verantwoordelijkheid voor besluitvorming over uitvoeringshandelingen in grotere mate bij de lidstaten neer te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het Q-koorts kompas en het advies van Brabantadvies

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the Q-fever compass published by Q-support and a BrabantAdvies warning that Q-fever knowledge and experience may be lost, asking whether patients get adequate support and whether the advice will be adopted. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports but deferred substantive answers to a forthcoming letter covering all Q-fever advice.
In the letter of 21 February on the committee's request for a response to the BrabantAdvies advice, we indicated that we wish to inform the House comprehensively on all Q-fever advice.

In de brief van 21 februari jl naar aanleiding van de vraag van de vaste Kamercommissie om een reactie op het advies van BrabantAdvies is aangegeven dat wij de Kamer graag in samenhang willen berichten over alle adviezen over Q-koorts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over een voorstel voor aanpassingen van de Gecombineerde opgave

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the current Gecombineerde opgave creates a negative incentive against trees and hedges on farmland, and whether it could be changed as proposed by landscape designer Heebing. The State Secretary denied any such negative incentive, explained that landscape elements are not counted as agricultural land, and said the proposed approach conflicts with EU requirements, so it cannot be realised.
The working method proposed by Mr Heebing is not in line with the European requirements and therefore cannot be realised.
De door de heer Heebing voorgestelde werkwijze is niet in overeenstemming met de Europese vereisten en kan daarom niet gerealiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht ’11.000 handtekeningen tegen Wildlife Crime’

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about wildlife crime in the Netherlands following a broadcast and a petition, including its scale, enforcement levels, transit controls and inter-departmental coordination. The State Secretary said data on the scale of wildlife crime is lacking, that enforcement is adequately organised, that customs uses risk-based controls, and that existing training and cooperation arrangements are in place, without committing to a new programme.
I do not have figures on which animals are illegally killed or removed from nature in the Netherlands each year, or in what numbers.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over welke dieren in welke aantallen jaarlijks illegaal worden omgebracht in Nederland of uit de natuur worden weggehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het extreem doorfokken van dieren in de vee-industrie voor verhoogde productie

MP Thieme asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how the government will respond to reports that breeding in the livestock sector is pushing poultry, pigs and cattle toward extreme productivity at the cost of welfare, and whether the government will set limits on production per animal. The State Secretary calls such a direction undesirable, points to market-driven breeding programmes and existing sector initiatives, refers to earlier letters for the advisory body question, and says sector parties are primarily responsible while stronger government intervention could follow if results are insufficient.
I expect the parties involved in the chain to take concrete steps to tackle the problems you have identified and improve animal welfare. They are primarily responsible for this.
Ik verwacht van betrokken partijen in de keten concrete stappen om de door u gesignaleerde problemen tegen te gaan en dierenwelzijn te verbeteren. Zij zijn daarvoor primair verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jan Vos over SDE+ subsidie voor de gedupeerden van de hevige hagelstormen in Zuid-Oost Nederland afgelopen zomer

MPs Leenders and Jan Vos asked whether the government would guarantee SDE+ subsidy availability for hail-storm victims in south-east Netherlands, and whether it would consult the province, municipalities and sector. The minister answered that SDE+ is competitive and cannot give individual developers advance certainty, pointed to increased 2017 budgets and NIA support for Noord-Brabant, and referred back to his answer on question 2 for questions 3 and 4.
The SDE+ scheme offers no possibility to give individual project developers advance certainty about project applications.
De SDE+ regeling biedt geen mogelijkheid om individuele projectontwikkelaars vooraf zekerheid te bieden over projectaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ten Broeke over dreigende antidumpingmaatregelen van Brazilië

MPs Lodders and Ten Broeke asked about Brazil's threatened anti-dumping duties on Dutch chips exports, including whether the Brazilian authorities used improper arguments, whether the measures comply with WTO rules, and what steps the government has taken. The minister answered that the Commission considers the measures insufficiently substantiated, that the Netherlands has lobbied repeatedly through its embassy and the Commission, and that the Commission can challenge the measures at the WTO.
The cabinet shares the European Commission's view that the measures are insufficiently substantiated and motivated.
Het kabinet deelt de lezing van de Europese Commissie dat de maatregelen onvoldoende zijn onderbouwd en gemotiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over door waterkrachtcentrales gedode alen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about fish mortality at hydropower plants, the number and output of plants and mills, compliance with the Water Framework Directive, subsidies and enforcement at Linne and Lith. The State Secretary answered in detail, giving mortality figures for Linne and Amerongen, describing enforcement procedures against Lith and Linne, and stating that subsidies would not be withdrawn while recipients meet conditions.
The separate actual production figures of the hydropower plants are not known.
De afzonderlijke daadwerkelijke productiecijfers van de waterkrachtcentrales zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de mishandeling en verwaarlozing van nertsen op fokkerijen

An MP asks the government about cruelty and neglect of mink on fur farms in Alphen aan den Rijn, including the NVWA's inspection history, whether the farms should be closed, when information on individual farm inspections will be published, and the status of a proposed ban on keeping animals after cruelty. The state secretary reports few past inspections with minor findings, commits to continued NVWA inspections in 2017, and promises a framework note on the animal-keeping ban before 1 April.
If violations are found, the NVWA will take appropriate enforcement action.
Als er overtredingen worden vastgesteld, dan zal de NVWA op passende wijze tot handhaven overgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de brandbrief van LTO Nederland, Greenport Holland en de Branche Organisatie Akkerbouw over knelpunten in gewasbescherming

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how the government would respond to a joint letter from farm and horticulture organisations about eleven crop-protection bottlenecks, including minor-use approvals, emergency exemptions, biocides and EU harmonisation. The state secretary answered that work on these issues is ongoing, listed the measures and timelines under way, and agreed to consult the signatories at official level.
Yes, to start at official level. The organisations concerned will be invited for this shortly.
Ja, om te beginnen op ambtelijk niveau. De betrokken organisaties zullen hiertoe binnenkort uitgenodigd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht 'Waddenclub: stop gaswinning direct'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that seabed subsidence under the Wadden Sea was faster than NAM predicted, and whether this justified stopping gas extraction under the hand-on-the-tap principle. The government answered that the Audit Committee found the subsidence within the permitted limits and no evidence of nature-threatening change, that the anomalies stem from LiDAR measurement inaccuracy, and that NAM will follow the committee's recommendations.
The advice of the independent Audit Committee and the monitoring results give me no reason to assume there is a striking, nature-threatening decline.
De adviezen van de onafhankelijke Auditcommissie en de monitoringsresultaten geven mij geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat er sprake is van een opvallende natuurbedreigende verlaging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over uit de lucht geschoten zeldzame zeearend

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about a rare white-tailed eagle shot in Friesland, including whether a hunter could mistake it for a goose, whether prosecution and ballistic evidence were pursued, whether a reward was considered, and whether enforcement against raptor persecution is adequate. The government said police did not make the claimed statement, that a criminal investigation under the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and it cannot comment further, that a reward was not considered because the offence does not qualify, and that oversight of hunting rules is sufficient though incidents cannot always be prevented.
Because this investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make any further statements about it.
Omdat dit onderzoek nog gaande is, kan ik daar geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat de Nederlandse visser niet op bijvangst zit te wachten

An MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Dutch fishers do not want bycatch landed under the landing obligation, and about a EUR 75,000 commission to promote undervalued fish species via the VISwijzer/Good Fish Foundation. The state secretary answers that the commission is an assignment, that market improvement is only one part of a broader package for making the landing obligation workable, and that he has no reason to doubt the objectivity of the VISwijzer.
This concerns not a subsidy but an assignment, with a total value of EUR 75,000.
Dit betreft geen subsidie maar een opdracht, met een totale omvang van € 75.000.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over vragen aan het Europese Hof van Justitie over GMO-regelgeving

An MP asked the State Secretary about the French Council of State's referral to the EU Court of Justice on GMO rules for gene-edited organisms, and whether such organisms should fall outside GMO regulation. The government answered that CRISPR-Cas9 safety must be assessed case by case, that Netherlands may submit written observations, and that its position is that gene-edited organisms should be treated as GMOs until the Commission decides.
The Dutch government intends to submit observations in line with the earlier cabinet policy line.
De Nederlandse regering is voornemens opmerkingen in te dienen conform eerdere kabinetsbeleidslijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het mogelijke einde van de toelating van een actieve stof die onmisbaar is voor de bewaring en export van uien

An MP asked whether the Dutch government is aware that the EU may not renew approval of maleic hydrazide, a substance vital for onion storage and export, and what it will do to keep it available. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the sector's dependence, said the substance is under periodic EU re-assessment and that he will not anticipate the outcome, and referred back to that answer on the remaining questions.
Since the European re-assessment process is still ongoing, I do not wish to anticipate its outcome.
Aangezien het proces van de Europese herbeoordeling nog loopt, wil ik niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de problemen van agrarische ondernemers in de Oudebildtdijk

MPs Rutte, Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked whether designating the Oude and Nieuwe Bildtdijken as a protected village landscape (beschermd dorpsgezicht), including about 2,500 hectares of farmland, would restrict farmers' operations, and whether the farmland should be excluded. Minister Bussemaker replied that the designation is based on cultural-historical values, does not aim to block farming, leaves the existing zoning plan in force, and that she sees no reason to reconsider or exclude farmland, while offering a protocol with the municipality and province and awaiting a pending Council of State appeal.

I have already indicated to the municipality of Het Bildt and the province of Fryslân that I am willing to draw up, together with them and the agricultural sector, a protocol on agricultural business operations in relation to the status of the protected village landscape.

Ik heb de gemeente Het Bildt en de provincie Fryslân al aangegeven bereid te zijn om samen met hen en de agrarische sector een protocol op te stellen over de agrarische bedrijfsvoering in relatie tot de status van het beschermd dorpsgezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht “ Duitse minister: nepvlees mag geen schnitzel heten”

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked whether vegetarian products may use meat-related names such as 'schnitzel' and whether the Netherlands would follow a German proposed ban. The minister answered that such names are not per se misleading if labelling is clear, that the NVWA enforces against consumer deception including online, and that no national ban is planned because consumers have not reported problems.

When meatless products use terms that are (also) customary for meat-containing products, this is not by definition unclear and misleading, provided the labelling is clear about the absence of meat and the use of other ingredients.

Als voor vleesloze producten termen worden gebruikt die (ook) voor vleeshoudende producten gebruikelijk zijn, is dit niet per definitie onduidelijk en misleidend, als de aanduidingen helder zijn over de afwezigheid van vlees en over het gebruik van andere grondstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over stalkeuring

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the limited availability of livestock stall inspections for export, which species qualify, the status of talks with the pig sector, and when they will be reintroduced for pigs. The State Secretary answered that stall inspection is open only to individually identified animals, that pigs are largely not yet individually marked, and that it will return sector by sector once reliable identification systems are in place, without committing to a firm date.
As soon as a sector, or part of a sector, has a watertight system of individual identification, it can again make use of stall inspection.
Zodra er in een sector, of een deel van een sector, een sluitend systeem van individuele identificatie is, kan men weer gebruik gaan maken van stalkeuring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het levend strippen en half slachten van vissen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that live fish are gutted and partly slaughtered before being sold in a Nijmegen shop, and whether this conflicts with animal welfare law. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the case, said the police and NVWA are investigating, and described ongoing research into stunning methods for fish on vessels, but gave no numbers on fish killed per method.
The NVWA therefore intervenes when irregularities are found.
De NVWA treedt dan ook op als onregelmatigheden worden geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de medewerking van RVO.nl aan het akkerbouwonderzoek

An MP asked whether RVO.nl's refusal to cooperate in obtaining mandates for the arable farming research levy was jeopardising the research and why it was not cooperating. The minister confirmed the research is important and said that, within the limits of the Personal Data Protection Act, the industry body may obtain KvK numbers of non-members from RVO.nl so it can approach all levy-paying businesses.

I have decided, within the scope allowed by the Personal Data Protection Act, to enable the Arable Farming Industry Body to obtain the Chamber of Commerce numbers of non-member market participants from RVO.nl.

Een en ander afwegend heb ik besloten – binnen de ruimte die de Wbp biedt – het de Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw mogelijk te maken de Kamer van Koophandel-nummers (KvK-nummers) van de niet bij haar aangesloten marktdeelnemers van RVO.nl te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het akkerbouwonderzoek

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked why the Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) took months to respond to the Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw's request for data needed for an agricultural research levy, and whether this delay endangers EUR 1.2 million in projects. The minister confirmed the request was filed in July, cited data protection (Wbp) constraints, and said the BO may obtain KvK numbers of non-member market participants so it can ask them to authorise RVO to share acreage data.
I have decided, within the scope permitted by the Wbp, to enable the Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw to obtain from RVO the Chamber of Commerce numbers of non-member market participants.

Ik heb besloten – binnen de ruimte die de Wbp biedt – het de Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw mogelijk te maken de Kamer van Koophandel-nummers (KvK-nummers) van de niet bij haar aangesloten marktdeelnemers van RVO te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen omtrent exportcertificering van paardensperma

An MP asked the state secretary why only one laboratory is designated for export health testing of horse semen, and whether this limits competition and whether EU-equivalent labs abroad can be recognised. The state secretary answered that private labs and foreign labs can apply for recognition or equivalence, that the rules were loosened from 1 January 2017, and declined to provide a cost overview because tariffs are the labs' responsibility.
Setting the level of tariffs is a responsibility of the laboratories.
Het bepalen van de hoogte van tarieven is een verantwoordelijkheid van de laboratoria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels, Belhaj en Van Veldhoven over de berichten 'Druk aan de Poort' en 'Zelfverrijking normale gang van zaken bij Rotterdams containerbedrijf'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Infrastructure and Environment, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that many containers in Rotterdam port are not systematically scanned for nuclear material and that fraud occurred at a container firm. The government answered that customs uses a risk-based approach, that scanning and inspection capacity was adequate for the Second Maasvlakte, that radiological screening is applied where feasible, and that it cannot comment on ongoing investigations.
However, I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik echter geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht "Sinaasappels mogelijk dubbel zo duur door Europese regels"

The state secretary of Economic Affairs was asked by MP Lodders (VVD) about EU proposals to tighten import rules on citrus from countries such as South Africa to guard against the African citrus fruit moth and Citrus Black Spot, which MPs considered disproportionate and protectionist. The answer states the minister opposes prescribing a specific cold treatment, wants proportionate risk-based measures and alternatives, will ask the Commission to allow alternatives, and will not oppose the measure at the Council this January.
However, I will ask the European Commission to also allow alternative measures to prevent the introduction of the African citrus fruit moth.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie echter wel verzoeken ook alternatieve maatregelen ter voorkoming van de insleep van de Afrikaanse fruitmot toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over opbrengstafhankelijke gebruiksnormen voor de akkerbouw

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the European Commission's objections to yield-dependent manure use norms for arable farming have not been resolved after roughly two and a half years, and what will be done to allow equivalent measures in 2017.
