The State Secretary replied that the Commission was only substantively informed in October 2015, that it raised concerns about environmental effects and issued a detailed opinion in October 2016, and that the government will try to address those concerns and possibly adjust the measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de derde beoordeling voor het mogen houden van zoogdieren in drie jaar door dit kabinet

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the positive list for mammal keeping has been re-assessed three times in three years, what problems it solves, and why the criteria and method changed. The State Secretary answers that the criteria are unchanged, the method was only clarified on the legal framework, the Landsadvocaat found the framework legally correct, and stakeholders have been involved since 2014.
The criteria for designating animal species or animal categories on the positive list are set out in article 1.4 of the Besluit houders van dieren.
De criteria voor aanwijzing van diersoorten of diercategorieën op de positieflijst staan vermeld in art. 1.4 Besluit houders van dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen over het programma "Certificering op Afstand"

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the NVWA's 'Certificering op Afstand' programme, including how remote certificate fees are set, why they can exceed on-site vet visits for multiple certificates, and whether this fits NVWA efficiency goals. The State Secretary answered that remote certification costs EUR 62.59 versus at least EUR 195.74 for an on-site visit, acknowledged higher costs for more than three certificates, and said the NVWA is examining whether remote fees can be capped at on-site costs.
The NVWA is currently examining whether it can be arranged that the costs of remote certification can never exceed those of an on-site inspection.
De NVWA bekijkt momenteel of kan worden geregeld dat de kosten van certificering op afstand nooit hoger kunnen uitvallen dan een controle op de locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over vogelgriep vastgesteld in Kamperveen

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about bird flu outbreaks, the duration of the housing obligation for free-range poultry, and whether free-range egg status should be preserved after twelve weeks of confinement. The state secretary confirmed continued high risk through spring 2017, said the status of free-range eggs would lapse after twelve weeks, and undertook to lobby the European Commission to allow an extension without loss of that status.
That is why I will urge the European Commission that the Netherlands can extend the housing obligation due to bird flu risks, without companies losing their free-range egg trading status.

Daarom zal ik er bij de Europese Commissie voor pleiten dat Nederland de ophokplicht kan verlengen in verband met de risico's voor vogelgriep, zonder dat bedrijven hun handelsstatus wat betreft vrije uitloopeieren verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het gevaarlijke landbouwgif buprofezin

An MP asks the state secretaries whether the EU will ban pesticide buprofezin for food crops after it can form the carcinogen aniline, why the Dutch Ctgb authorised it recently, and whether authorisation should be suspended while doubts exist. The government replies that the EC has not yet decided, that the Ctgb is an independent body applying EU assessment methods, and that authorisations will be adjusted if the EC changes approval.

The Ctgb, the Dutch authorisation authority, is an independent administrative body that assesses applications using European harmonised assessment methods and takes decisions based on the regulations in force at the time.

Het Ctgb – de Nederlandse toelatingsautoriteit – is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan dat aanvragen toetst volgens Europees geharmoniseerde beoordelingsmethodieken en besluiten neemt op basis van de op dat moment vigerende regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de vergroeningseis van het Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid om permanent grasland te behouden

An MP asked the state secretary whether the CAP greening requirement to maintain permanent grassland is being met, including Dutch Natura 2000 protections, national monitoring, and a seemingly inconsistent earlier debate statement about ploughing grassland. The state secretary answered that the area of permanent grassland has not declined beyond the threshold, so no farm-level measures are needed, and that the earlier statement was consistent with the Commission's interpretation.
The result of this calculation was that there has been no decrease in the area of permanent grassland.
Het resultaat van deze berekening was dat er geen afname van het areaal blijvend grasland heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het arrest van het Europees Hof van Justitie inzake het achterhouden van milieu-informatie in het kader van bedrijfsbelang

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government how it would respond to two 2016 CJEU rulings on withholding environmental information for business interests, and whether it would prioritise disclosure of environmental information over companies' commercial interests under the Dutch FOI law. The government answered that the rulings require awaiting the national court's follow-up, that disclosure is the rule under the Aarhus Convention but commercial-interest exceptions still apply to non-emission data, and that the Ctgb operates an 'open unless' policy and is already disclosing pesticide dossiers, while promising to await the CBb ruling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Geurts over het mislopen van miljoenen euro’s aan GMO-subsidie voor telersverenigingen vanwege onduidelijkheid en te late bekendmaking door de Nederlandse overheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Geurts asked why only one Dutch grower association submitted an operational plan for EU fruit and vegetable GMO subsidies, and why the national strategy was published late. The Secretary of State acknowledged the shortfall, explained the strategy was agreed with the sector in April and the rules published in July, and pointed to a new expertise centre and ongoing consultation as remedies.
I agree that it is regrettable that more producer organisations have not submitted operational programmes for 2017.
Ik ben het met u eens dat het spijtig is dat niet meer producentenorganisaties operationele programma's voor 2017 hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Update vogelgriep: beperkingen jacht nog van kracht’

An MP asked whether the state's restriction on hunting during the avian flu outbreak is unique to the Netherlands, why it does not distinguish wetland from forest hunting, and whether evidence supports the measure. The State Secretary answered that the national hunting ban was based on expert advice, that no research quantifies its effect, and that the ban was lifted on 9 December 2016 except in protection and supervision zones.
There is no research data on the relative contribution of this measure to reducing the chance of avian flu introduction on farms and further spread.
Er zijn geen onderzoeksgegevens over de relatieve bijdrage van deze maatregel aan het verlagen van de kans op introductie van het vogelgriepvirus op bedrijven en op verdere verspreiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van de aanwezigheid van landbouwgif in ons voedsel

MP Ouwehand asked about a French study finding pesticide residues in non-organic muesli, including levels she said exceeded drinking-water limits, possible hormone disruptors, and availability in Dutch supermarkets. The minister answered that residues are below EU maximum limits, the RIVM finds no consumer risk, no consequences or new testing are planned, and the government aims to speed the transition to sustainable crop protection.
I therefore attach no consequences to the results of this French study.
Ik verbind daarom geen consequenties aan de resultaten van deze Franse studie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over hormoonverstorende stoffen

An SP MP asked whether the government should follow France by banning BPA in packaging and DEHP in neonatal and maternity medical devices, and whether a national biomonitoring system for hormone-disrupting substances should be set up. The minister answered that a ban is not appropriate because safer alternatives are not proven, that exposure of vulnerable groups is being reduced through talks with stakeholders, and that the RIVM participates in the European HBM4EU biomonitoring project.
A ban does not deserve to be followed, because manufacturers would then be forced to use alternatives in their products whose safety has not been well investigated.
Een verbod verdient geen navolging, omdat fabrikanten dan worden gedwongen alternatieven te gebruiken in hun producten, waarvan de veiligheid niet goed is onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht "Veehouderij kan niet zonder begrenzing"

An MP asked the state secretary whether a farewell interview by the director-general for Agro and Nature, suggesting environmental rules should not be applied too strictly, undermines farmers' trust and signals a shift in the Dutch negotiating position on derogation from the Nitrates Directive. The state secretary rejected that reading, said the director-general argued for keeping within the limits, and referred to contacts with the European Commission and promised quarterly updates to parliament.

In that debate I informed your House about the contacts at official and political level and promised to keep you informed every quarter about the progress of talks on the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme.

Daarin heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de contacten op ambtelijk en politiek niveau en toegezegd u elk kwartaal te zullen informeren over de voortgang van gesprekken over het 6 e actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘Impact fijnstof zwaar overdreven’

An MP asked the government to react to a newspaper article claiming air pollution has only a small effect on regional health differences, and whether livestock density correlates with chronic illness. The state secretary rejected the article's methodology as unsound, pointed to the VGO study and the planned air-quality measures, and promised to inform parliament about any measures.
Your House will be informed about the measures to be taken.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over de te nemen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht ‘NVWA kapittelt afslag Urk vanwege condens’

VVD MPs Lodders and Visser asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, and the answer came from Minister Schippers, about the NVWA closing three cold cells at Visveiling Urk and imposing a penalty order over condensation, which they argued is a natural phenomenon with no bacteriological danger. The government answered that condensation is a food-safety hygiene requirement that Visveiling Urk has failed to fix despite years of warnings, and it declined to intervene in the dispute between the NVWA and the company.
No, I am not willing to get involved in this discussion between the NVWA and Visveiling Urk bv.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid mij te mengen in deze discussie tussen de NVWA en Visveiling Urk bv.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Thieme over de ophokplicht en de dreigende vogelgriep

An MP asks the state secretary about animal welfare under the mandatory housing order for poultry, the risk of zoonoses from dense farming, the structure of the poultry sector since 2003, and additional measures against bird flu. The state secretary answers that housing meets EU rules, sets up a welfare commission, reports that the sector has grown in animal numbers per farm while total poultry stayed stable, and notes that bird flu risk cannot be reduced to zero.
Since measures have been taken regarding housing, I set up the welfare commission on 18 November.
Aangezien er maatregelen zijn ingesteld op het gebied van huisvesting, heb ik op 18 november jl. de welzijnscommissie ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het uitblijven van support voor nieuwe veredelingstechnieken

A VVD MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the EU has not yet clarified whether new plant breeding techniques fall under GMO rules, and why the Dutch government is not pressing harder for their free use. The State Secretary answered that Dutch pressure on the European Commission continues, that the Commission has deferred its response, and that a scientific advisory opinion is expected in the first half of 2017, while stating that the government cannot quantify the economic losses.
The cabinet has repeatedly pressed the European Commission for progress.
Het kabinet heeft bij de Europese Commissie meermalen aangedrongen op voortgang
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de evaluatie van de Jonge Landbouwersregeling door het NAJK

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the NAJK evaluation of the Young Farmers Scheme (JOLA), including its findings on the EUR 20,000 minimum investment and the limited choice of investments, and whether the scheme will be adjusted for smaller farms. The State Secretary answers that the provinces are primarily responsible for JOLA, that the evaluation is conducted by an external party with results expected in December, and that he is willing to help think about adjustments at the provinces' request.
The provinces are primarily responsible for the implementation of the JOLA.
De provincies zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de JOLA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht: te veel bacteriën in thuisbezorgmaaltijden ouderen

MP Krol asked the ministers whether they were aware of a Nutrilab study finding high bacteria levels and salt concerns in home-delivered meals for elderly people, and whether extra inspection and measures would follow. The government answered that the NVWA will treat the results as a signal in hygiene supervision and perform extra checks at the companies concerned, while noting no legal nutritional standards exist for these meals.
The NVWA will take the results of the study as a signal into account in supervising hygiene and temperature control at the producers concerned.
De NVWA zal de resultaten van het onderzoek als signaal meenemen in het toezicht op de hygiëne- en temperatuurbeheersing bij de betrokken producenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Bergkamp, Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Politie heeft geen zicht op dumpingen drugsafval’

Four D66 MPs asked the ministers whether police and partner agencies have sufficient visibility and capacity over illegal dumping and discharge of synthetic drug waste, given a report that many dumpings go undetected and carry health and environmental risks. The government answered that dumping is difficult to detect, that enforcement focuses on production, that regional protocols and projects are being developed, and that it sees no need for additional research, controls or a national approach.
At this moment I see no reason for additional actions.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Leenders over de sluiting van de Rotterdamse vestiging van het Wellant College

MPs Vermue and Leenders asked why the Rotterdam vmbo-groen department of Wellant College must close, leaving 180 pupils to find new schools, and how this affects pupils with extra support needs and local green-sector prospects. The state secretary replied that closure is a board decision, that nearby alternatives exist, and that the school has a duty of care for pupils with support needs, while leaving substantive regional planning to local partners.
Whether or not to close a branch is a decision primarily taken by the school board.
Het al dan niet sluiten van een vestiging is een beslissing die primair door het schoolbestuur wordt genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het verstrekken van viskweeksubsidies die concurreren met bestaande economische activiteiten en het manipuleren van een LEI-rapport

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about internal ministry emails showing directed edits to a LEI report, subsidies for fish farming that may compete with existing firms, and a subsidy for the Claresse fish. The State Secretary answered that the emails are internal, the LEI has an integrity inquiry pending, subsidy conditions were not tailored to one firm, and that no recovery was pursued without fully explaining why beyond the earlier answers.
I am awaiting the outcome of that investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dijkgraaf over niet uitbetalen betalingsrechten en behandeling bezwaren

MPs Geurts and Dijkgraaf asked about thousands of unresolved objections to 2015 payment-right decisions by the agricultural agency RVO, including the share upheld, extended deadlines, and the timing of 2016 payments. The state secretary answered that about 1,400 objections had been upheld in part or in full (about 0.14% of payments), that remaining cases will be settled by 1 April 2017, and that a 2016 payment schedule was sent separately.
Before 1 April 2017, all objections are expected to have been processed.
Voor 1 april 2017 zullen alle bezwaren naar verwachting zijn afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het onterecht afschieten van reeën op Terschelling

An MP asked the state secretary about the expulsion of a whistleblower from a wildlife management unit on Terschelling after reporting unlawful deer culling, and whether this undermines the law and the role of such units. The state secretary said the board decides on membership, that the province must supervise the conditions of exemptions, and saw no reason for central intervention in provincial culling permits.
It is up to the province to supervise this and, if it deems it necessary, to intervene.
Het is aan de provincie om daar op toe te zien en, indien zij dat nodig acht, in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de slachtoffers van Q-koorts

An MP asks the government whether it will compensate Q-fever victims, cites the sector's responsibility, asks for death and chronic illness figures, and questions a planned 5,000-goat stable in Maasdriel. The minister refuses individual compensation, points to the Q-support foundation, gives case figures and dispersion and emission data, and defers liability questions to the courts and the municipality.
This case is before the court. Your question on liability cannot be answered by us.
Deze zaak is onder de rechter. Uw vraag over aansprakelijkheid kan niet door ons worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van anti vlooien- en tekenmiddel Bravecto

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of illness and deaths in dogs linked to the flea and tick medicine Bravecto, and whether it should be withdrawn. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, said the EMA is reviewing a periodic safety report with priority, and said he would await that assessment before taking further action, while noting he could ban prescribing and application if needed.
I will therefore await the periodic safety report and the EMA's judgement.
Ik wacht het periodieke veiligheidsrapport en het oordeel van de EMA dan ook af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de aalbeheerplannen in relatie tot de Europese aalverordening

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether current eel fishing meets the recovery targets of the EU eel regulation and whether fishing is still viable at 40 percent escapement, and how the sector's low compliance on the IJsselmeer squares with its responsibility for control and enforcement. The State Secretary replied that the 2015 evaluation shows a slight decline in fishing mortality, that no reason to tighten the plan exists yet, and that enforcement conditions and sanctions apply under the crab scheme with annual reporting by the sector.
So far the evaluation gives no reason to tighten the eel management plans.
Tot nu toe geeft de evaluatie geen aanleiding om de aalbeheerplannen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en Graus over de Clinton Foundation

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands gave over four million euros to the Clinton Foundation's Clinton Development Initiative, what projects were funded, what evaluations exist, whether any funds went to Clinton's campaign, and whether all money was spent. The State Secretary answered at length, listing project results and impact figures, stating the foundation's audited reports show no campaign use, explaining the initiative was taken by the Netherlands within the Alliance for Climate Smart Agriculture, and confirming the funds were spent on the agreed agricultural projects, while sending correspondence and MoUs.
I hereby send you the correspondence leading up to the signing of the MoUs and the MoUs themselves.
Hierbij stuur ik u de correspondentie in de aanloop naar de ondertekening van MoU's en de MoU's zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het lot van in beslag genomen wilde dieren uit de illegale handel

MP Wassenberg asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the unknown fate of wild animals seized from illegal trade, the lack of CITES reporting obligations, and what the Netherlands would do at the CITES CoP to improve reporting. The State Secretary answered that Dutch seizure figures are given (60 to 1,290 animals per year, 2011-2015), that reporting is a national matter and CITES notification is being followed up, and that a CITES resolution on disposal of confiscated specimens was adopted, promising to inform the House on the CoP outcomes.
I will inform the House shortly about the outcomes of CITES CoP 17.
Ik zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de uitkomsten van de CITES CoP 17.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over luchtvervuiling op het platteland door de veehouderij

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked about a study linking living near livestock farms to reduced lung function, about low public awareness of air pollution, and about why EU air quality limits are looser than WHO guidelines. The government said it will inform parliament on measures and follow-up research, points to existing public information channels, and says a push for stricter EU norms is not currently realistic while it keeps working toward WHO levels.
The cabinet intends to inform parliament shortly by letter about the measures to be taken and the follow-up research.
Het kabinet is voornemens uw Kamer binnenkort per brief te informeren over de te nemen maatregelen en het vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over impulsaankopen en het welzijn van paarden en pony's

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether it is acceptable that intoxicated buyers can impulsively purchase a 3.5-month-old foal at a horse market, whether that age is suitable for weaning, and whether the voluntary Sectorraad Paarden has protected horse welfare. The State Secretary answered that such sales should be careful and considered, that 3.5 months is too young under the Besluit houders van dieren, that the responsibility for welfare lies with the owner, and that a timely answer before the committee meeting was not possible.
Do you think 3.5 months is a suitable age for a foal to be separated from its mother and handed over to the trade? Answer 3: No.
Vindt u 3,5 maand een geschikte leeftijd voor een veulen om reeds van zijn moeder gescheiden te zijn en te worden overgeleverd aan de handel? Antwoord 3 Nee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het doden van gezonde kalveren

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why about 1% of healthy calves are still slaughtered despite the sector's 'Vitaal kalf' plan, and whether regulation should be imposed. The State Secretary replied that the sector must find useful destinations for calves, that slaughter figures are around 3,400 per year, and that he will await further results and keep monitoring the situation without committing to new binding rules.
I therefore first want to await the further results of that.
Ik wil daarom eerst de verdere resultaten daarvan afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Dijkgraaf en Geurts over het persbericht ‘Innovatieve schimmel alternatief voor landbouwgif’

Three MPs asked why the Ministry of Economic Affairs press release on a fungus-based alternative used the term 'landbouwgif' rather than the statutory 'gewasbeschermingsmiddelen', and whether this framing harms agriculture. The Secretary of State acknowledged the term was chosen for a general audience, said the pilots for low-risk alternatives are still in the start-up phase, and stressed the importance of an adequate effective pesticide package.
The word landbouwgif was used as a synonym for the high-risk plant protection products.
Het woord landbouwgif is als synoniem gebruikt voor de risicovolle gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Geurts en Lodders over het bericht dat fabrikanten woest zijn over eenzijdige aanpassing van emissies innovatieve stalvloeren

MPs Dijkgraaf, Geurts and Lodders asked why the government adjusted emission measurements for innovative low-emission stable floors, whether Wageningen University's overlapping roles are independent, why the Aeromix system received no provisional emission factor, and about the professionalisation of the advisory committee TacRav. The State Secretary answered that a expert panel is reviewing the measurements, a third party will advise by November, definitive factors are expected early 2017, and the TacRav professionalisation will be audited.
I want to have the advice at my disposal in November, so that after consultation with those involved I can definitively set the emission factors in early 2017.
Het advies wil ik in november tot mijn beschikking hebben, zodat ik na overleg met betrokkenen begin 2017 de emissiefactoren definitief kan vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het afbreken door de overheid van vertrouwen en bereidwilligheid bij vissers om deel te nemen aan innovatieve projecten

MP Geurts asks whether clawbacks and reduced payments on innovative fisheries projects under the European Fisheries Fund, including retroactive application of 2015 rules, are eroding trust and innovation in the sector. The State Secretary answers that clawbacks follow strict application of EU rules after audit findings, that they are reserved for cases where beneficiaries should have known costs were ineligible, that objection and appeal remain open, and that a new innovation scheme is being explored.
As indicated, subsidies are only reclaimed from beneficiaries if the beneficiary could or should have known that the declared costs were not eligible under applicable laws and regulations.

Zoals aangegeven, worden de subsidies bij de begunstigden alleen teruggevorderd als de begunstigde kon of had behoren te weten dat de opgevoerde kosten op grond van de geldende wet- en regelgeving niet subsidiabel waren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Geurts over de vrijstelling van mestverwerking voor biologische bedrijven

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether manure transfer from organic dairy farms to organic arable farms counts as manure processing under the grassland-dependency rules, and what proof organic dairy farmers must provide for the exemption. The State Secretary confirmed that organic production is treated as manure processing, that four organic dairy farms applied for the exemption, and that financial commitments causing a disproportionate cost must be shown, while organic certification alone is not such a commitment.
Organic certification does have financial aspects, but organic certification in itself is not a financial obligation that by definition leads to a disproportionate financial burden.

Biologische certificering heeft weliswaar ook financiële aspecten, maar biologische certificering op zich is geen financiële verplichting die per definitie leidt tot een disproportionele financiële last.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over dierproeven met duizenden boerderijdieren zonder noodzaak

An MP asked why data on animal experiments with farm animals only became public after a freedom-of-information request, and whether such experiments on farm animals should be phased out. The state secretary said the CCD publishes non-technical summaries and the NVWA publishes annual figures, that licences cover five years so permitted numbers differ from actual use, and that a phase-out schedule is being prepared with the NCad.
I am in favour of as much transparency as possible when it comes to animal experiments.
Ik ben voorstander van zo veel mogelijk transparantie als het gaat over dierproeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de geplande grootschalige bomenkap in de Schoorlse Duinen

MP Wassenberg asked the State Secretary whether the planned 141-hectare tree felling in the Schoorlse Duinen, a PAS measure, could free up room for intensive livestock farming and whether the issue would be considered in the PAS evaluation. The State Secretary answered that felling is primarily a measure to restore wind and water dynamics in the Natura 2000 area, that PAS does not single out specific economic activities, and that the effects of felling will be included in the PAS evaluation.

In the evaluation of the PAS, the effects of ecological restoration measures such as tree felling and experiences with granting permits based on allocated development space will be taken into account.

Bij de evaluatie van het PAS worden effecten van ecologische herstelmaatregelen zoals het kappen van bomen en ervaringen met uitgifte van vergunningen op basis van het toedelen van ontwikkelingsruimte, meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over enkele zorgwekkende berichten rondom landbouwgif

MP Wassenberg asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the EU approval of cyantraniliprole, the Netherlands' stance on neonicotinoids and systemic insecticides, the withdrawal and phase-out periods for glyphosate with tallowamine, Italy's glyphosate restrictions, and changes to maximum residue limits linked to Codex and TTIP. The government answered that EU and EFSA assessments found cyantraniliprole safe, that the Ctgb assesses authorisations under harmonised methods, that a withdrawal with a six-month sell-off period is planned, and that it will examine pre-harvest glyphosate use while maintaining the principle of the lowest attainable residue levels.
The Ctgb is now processing the submitted views and preparing the final decision.
Het Ctgb is nu bezig met het verwerken van de zienswijzen en het voorbereiden van het definitieve besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over problematiek rondom onveilige scootmobiels

An MP asked the State Secretaries about accidents with three-wheeled mobility scooters, whether councils wrongly issue them instead of safer five-wheeled models, and how scooters are checked for safety. The government answered that causes are multifactorial, a SWOV study is ongoing with results expected end 2017, and that scooters are not type-approved for road use, with councils responsible for individual suitability.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gevolgen van de fusie tussen Bayer en Monsanto voor de voedselproductie

The MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the effects of the Bayer-Monsanto merger on food production, market dominance, the Dutch seed sector, patents and farmers' protection. The State Secretary shares concerns, says the European Commission will assess the merger's competition effects, notes the Dutch seed sector is strong, and says the patent-breeder's rights imbalance must be fixed, while the Commission's decision is awaited.
I will therefore continue to follow developments closely.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen daarom met zorg blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Dijkgraaf, Visser, Geurts, Graus, Bruins, Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over het bericht dat een groot deel van de Noordzee nauwelijks bevist wordt

MPs asked the minister whether the finding that nearly 40% of the North Sea is barely fished changes the government's commitment to closing 10% of Dutch waters to bottom-trawling and the proposed extra closures on the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden. The minister answered that the study does not address protected ecological areas, which is the focus of the Dutch ambition, that the proposal remains a valid implementation of the 10-15% goal, and that she will inform parliament on how the Bisschop motion is executed, but could not answer before the committee meeting.
Soon I will, on behalf of the State Secretary for Economic Affairs as well, inform your House how I have executed the Bisschop motion.
Binnenkort zal ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, uw Kamer informeren hoe ik de motie Bisschop heb uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Bosma en Lodders over het inzichtelijk maken van marktbelemmeringen voor de export van agri-producten

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the value of the Dutch onion sector, the number of trade missions involving agri-food and horticulture, the effect of the Russian import ban, and how export markets will be expanded. The State Secretary answered that the Dutch onion sector holds a strong world market position, that agri-food was represented on most economic missions in 2015 and 2016, and referred to earlier letters for the broader export strategy without listing concrete new commitments.

At 14 of the 21 economic missions organised by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency in 2015, the Agri & Food and/or Horticulture & Propagation Materials top sectors were represented; in 2016 this was the case at 13 of the 18 economic missions.

Bij 14 van de 21 economische missies die door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland zijn georganiseerd in 2015, waren de topsectoren Agri & Food en/of Tuinbouw & Uitgangsmaterialen vertegenwoordigd, in 2016 bij 13 van de 18 economische missies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen omtrent de  fytosanitaire keuringen door de  NVWA

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the NVWA's cancellation of phytosanitary inspections a day in advance, the costs passed to importers, the 50% inspection rate versus the EU 15% minimum, and whether Germany's approach causes trade diversion. The State Secretary answered that cancellations are possible for priorities such as calamities while the 15% annual EU minimum is met, that costs are recovered via a levy spread across all consignments, that the 50% rate for certain stone codes reflects higher pest risk, and that no evidence of trade diversion was found.
The NVWA informs the businessman concerned as soon as possible if the inspection has to be cancelled.
De NVWA bericht zo snel mogelijk de betrokken ondernemer als de inspectie geannuleerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat islamitische slachthuizen tijdens het Offerfeest een slachtverbod opgelegd hebben gekregen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the NVWA imposed bans on unstunned cattle slaughter at Islamic abattoirs just before Eid al-Adha, whether this breaches the 2012 convenant, and about expertise and fines. The State Secretary answered that NVWA inspections found shortcomings, that abattoirs were given time to fix them, that the NVWA acted within law, and that any sanctions are still being assessed.
The NVWA's conduct is in line with the applicable laws and regulations.
Het optreden van de NVWA is conform de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de kritiek op de Wet dieraantallen

MP Dijkgraaf asks the state secretaries whether criticism of the Wet dieraantallen (animal numbers law), including from IRAS researcher Heederik, the provinces of Gelderland and Limburg, and a Brabant longkanker correlation analysis, undermines the bill and its link to public health. The government answers that a joint approach is needed, that animal numbers caps remain useful for overburdened areas, that the bill will be pursued, and that further research on endotoxins and health will be reported this autumn.
Therefore the cabinet will, in addition to this approach, further advance the previously announced animal numbers bill.
Daarom zal het kabinet aanvullend op deze aanpak het eerder aangekondigde wetsvoorstel dieraantallen verder in gang zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel 'Veehouderij kan niet zonder begrenzing’

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary whether the government supports a phosphate rights system and comments in an interview suggesting relaxing the Nitrates Directive, and whether contacts with the European Commission undermine farmers' trust. The State Secretary said the phosphate ceiling is a condition of the derogation, that the government will argue in Brussels for dropping an absolute production limit if manure processing secures the surplus, and declined to disclose details of talks with the Commission.
Partly in the interest of the results to be achieved, it is not desirable or customary to make detailed information about the talks public.
Het is, mede in het belang van de te bereiken resultaten, niet wenselijk of gebruikelijk om gedetailleerde informatie over de gesprekken openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het op grote schaal illegaal couperen van paardenstaarten

Wassenberg (PvdD) asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why tail-docked horses were shown at the national draft horse exhibition despite the ban, how many official reports the NVWA drew up, how enforcement will be made more effective, and whether the sector can be pressed to voluntarily end docking. The State Secretary confirms the exhibition reports, says the NVWA is investigating via administrative enforcement rather than criminal reports, will inform parliament this autumn on enforcement effectiveness, and calls the sector's failure disappointing and says administrative enforcement was started for that reason.
The NVWA is currently investigating tail-docked horses displayed at exhibitions.
De NVWA doet momenteel onderzoek naar aanleiding van tentoongestelde, gecoupeerde paarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het nog steeds couperen van paardenstaarten ondanks het verbod sinds 2001

An SP MP asked why horses with docked tails still appear at national exhibitions despite the 2001 ban, and asked about inspection, enforcement, and whether the KVTH breed association can exclude docked horses in its rules. The state secretary answered that enforcement responsibility and proof of veterinary necessity apply, that the KVTH may exclude docked horses in its rules, and that the matter is in progress via earlier answers.
I refer you to my answer to the question earlier asked by member Wassenberg, question 4.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn antwoord op de eerder door het lid Wassenberg gestelde vraag 4
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het couperen van paarden

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the ban on docking horses' tails, in force since 2001, is widely evaded and why enforcement is ineffective, and about inspection and sanctions at horse markets and exhibitions. The State Secretary says docking without veterinary necessity is prohibited and amounts to animal cruelty, that the number of docked horses is unknown, and refers to earlier answers for enforcement, while promising to report on an administrative enforcement track before year-end.
On the progress of the administrative enforcement track I have initiated, I will inform your House before the end of this year.
Over de voortgang van het bestuursrechtelijke traject dat ik heb ingezet, zal ik uw Kamer voor het eind van dit jaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het transport van dieren bij hoge temperaturen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal transport at high temperatures, including NVWA inspection numbers, EU temperature and water rules for short journeys, and planned measures. The government reported 78 inspections on hot days with 23 non-compliant situations, said EU rules leave room for member states, and pointed to the national heat protocol and six-monthly evaluations as progress.
A limited number of inspections had not yet been administratively processed at the time of answering these questions.
Een beperkt aantal controles zijn ten tijde van de beantwoording van deze vragen nog niet administratief verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het opnieuw onterecht afschieten van beschermde dieren op Terschelling

An MP asked whether the province of Friesland permits culling of protected roe deer on Terschelling without meeting the legal necessity test of the Flora- and faunawet, and whether this repeats fact-free wildlife policy after a Council of State ruling on rabbits. The State Secretary replied that the province granted an exemption on public-safety and crop-damage grounds under an approved management plan, that he sees no fact-free policy, and that the province says the Terschelling culling falls outside the exemption's scope and it will prevent recurrence.

The province of Friesland has indicated that the culling of roe deer as carried out on Terschelling by the Wildbeheereenheid does not fall within the purpose and conditions for which the exemption was granted.

De provincie Friesland heeft laten weten dat de afschot van reeën zoals dat op Terschelling door de Wildbeheereenheid is uitgevoerd, niet valt binnen het doel en de voorwaarden waarvoor de ontheffing is verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat bij RVO geld zoek is geraakt

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why RVO had not fully paid the 2015 farm direct payments despite a 1 July 2016 deadline and why the budget was underspent, and whether the reported full payment conflicted with this. The State Secretary answered that all applications were decided by 15 July 2016, with six farmers still lacking bank details, that the underspend stemmed from applicants not meeting conditions, and that unpaid funds would be used for objections and the 2016 budget.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Hoogland over tunnels voor dassen en otters

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about badger and otter tunnels, noting that 12 of 13 otter crossing problems ordered by a 2014 court ruling for 2015-2016 remain unresolved, and who is responsible for maintenance. The government answered that the problems are complex, responsibility for most tunnels lies with provinces and municipalities, one problem is solved and others are being investigated, with some targeted for 2017-2018.
The Court set phased deadlines within which measures, such as construction or repair of ledges, fences or culverts, must be implemented.
Het Hof stelde gefaseerde termijnen vast waarbinnen voorzieningen, zoals aanleg of herstel van looprichels, rasters of duikers, getroffen dienen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het afdwingen van vijf aanvullende landbouwenquêtes door het CBS

An MP asked whether the statistics office CBS may compel farmers to take part in five additional agricultural surveys beyond the annual census, and on what EU basis and whether registers or extrapolation could replace them. The government answered that EU regulations require the data, that CBS already uses registers where possible, and that it will keep limiting the survey burden without committing to specific new steps.
The CBS has for decades strongly focused on reducing both the actual and the perceived administrative burden on businesses.
Het CBS zet al decennialang sterk in op het verlagen van zowel de feitelijke als de ervaren lastendruk bij het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de voorgenomen sancties door het CBS en het bericht «Verplichte deelname aan CBS-telling Varkensstapel van de zotte»

An MP from the CDA asked the government about mandatory CBS agricultural surveys with fines, the added administrative burden, the low response rates and the lack of prior communication. The ministers answered that the obligation follows from a 2015 AMvB consultation, that the CBS director-general decides independently on fines, and that a meeting with LTO is planned for 19 September.
The director-general of the CBS, as an independent administrative body, is independent in his choice whether or not to enforce a fine.
De directeur-generaal van het CBS is als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan onafhankelijk in zijn keuze om een boete wel of niet tot uitvoering te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het onterecht toestaan van het afschieten van damherten door de provincie Zeeland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how he views the court annulment of Zeeland's permit for culling fallow deer, whether protected-species culls are being authorised without the statutory public-interest test, and whether decentralising fauna policy to provinces risks unequal treatment. The State Secretary answered that the court ruling is for the province to follow up, that provincial executives decide culls under the Flora and Fauna Act and the forthcoming Nature Conservation Act with appeal to the courts open, and that some inter-provincial variation is an intended effect of decentralisation, subject to national frameworks.
It is up to the province of Zeeland to act on the court's ruling.
Het is aan de provincie Zeeland om gevolg te geven aan de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de landelijke uitbraak van een dodelijke konijnenziekte

An MP asked the state secretary about the nationwide RHDV2 rabbit disease outbreak, its expected impact on wild rabbit populations, and whether rabbit hunting should be halted. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, expected populations to recover based on expert judgement, and declined to list rabbits as threatened or close hunting for now, while promising ongoing monitoring.
Therefore there is currently no urgent reason to proceed to closing the hunt for rabbits.
Derhalve is er thans geen dringende reden over te gaan tot sluiting van de jacht op het konijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het nieuwe Europese steunpakket aan boeren

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the EU's new EUR 500 million farm support package, including how Dutch funds will be spent, whether pig farmers' exit is being delayed, and whether national top-ups risk unfair competition. The State Secretary answered that about EUR 23 million goes to the Netherlands via a national envelope, to be spent on sustainability, restructuring and market stabilisation measures agreed with the dairy and pig sectors, with a pig sector action plan to be finalised later.
Once I have determined the package of measures, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra ik het maatregelenpakket heb vastgesteld, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dode dieren bij de brand van een pluimveebedrijf in het Drentse Orvelte

An MP asked about 15,000 chickens killed in a barn fire in Orvelte, including whether fire prevention in existing barns is adequate, whether asbestos roofs should be removed faster, and how many animals died in barn fires in 2015. The Secretary of State says the barns date from the 1970s, municipal inspections found nothing, the cause is under investigation, the fire-prevention action plan will be evaluated in early 2017, and the asbestos-roof removal goal is 2024 with a subsidy scheme and a versnellingsaanpak; he refers to an earlier report for the 2015 animal death figures.
I will take the outcomes of this investigation into account in the barn fire action plan.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek meenemen in het actieplan stalbranden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de uitspraak van het College van Beroep over de leefomstandigheden van kuikens in broederijen

An MP asked the state secretary about a Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal ruling that the 2014 WUR report on withholding food and water from chicks in the first 72 hours after hatching was insufficiently founded, and whether he would revoke his position, act on it, and share new research. The state secretary answered that WUR will conduct a literature study and new observations within six months, will assess the findings before deciding on any changes to supervision and enforcement, and will share results with parliament.
I will await the outcome of the research mentioned in the answer to question 2 and will based on that consider whether changes in supervision and enforcement are needed.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek, genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 2, af en zal op basis daarvan bezien of er wijzigingen qua toezicht en handhaving nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de verwaarlozing van dieren in Caribisch Nederland (Herdruk)

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal neglect and roaming livestock on Sint Eustatius, including a petition by 500 residents and whether the local government had failed to act. The government answered that the island government is taking steps (2014 project funding, July 2016 bylaw changes, preventive measures) and that animal neglect is primarily the island government's responsibility, so a meeting is not currently needed.
Animal neglect is primarily the responsibility of the Public Body of Sint Eustatius, and given the steps the local government has taken, a meeting is not currently on the agenda.
Verwaarlozing van dieren is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam Sint Eustatius en gezien de stappen die de lokale overheid heeft gezet, is een gesprek nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de tuinwallen op Texel

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the Texel garden walls, which have ecological and cultural value, are not eligible as greening elements under EU agricultural policy, and whether measures could be taken. The State Secretary answered that the walls are not on the EU list of eligible landscape elements, so no notification to the Commission is possible for 2017, and that the walls could be raised in future CAP discussions.
I see no possibilities to make garden walls part of the greening measures in the short term because they are not included in the Commission's proposal.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om tuinwallen op korte termijn onderdeel te laten zijn van de vergroeningsmaatregelen omdat ze niet opgenomen zijn in het voorstel van de Commissie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders, Graus, Dik-Faber, Dijkgraaf,  Van Klaveren en Houwers over het bericht van Cumela om voor 24 augustus 2016 duidelijkheid te geven over het verzoek van Cumela voor uitstel

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to clarify before 24 August 2016 whether he would postpone the manure spreading ban, as requested by the trade association Cumela. The State Secretary answered that he had asked the Technical Committee Soil for advice on a possible exemption under the Soil Protection Act, expected to decide within the week and communicate it promptly.
I expect this advice to be received shortly and will then decide on an exemption.
Ik verwacht dit advies op korte termijn te ontvangen en zal daarna besluiten over een vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Proef met koeien in de wei zonder fysieke afrastering’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a trial in which cows are kept in pasture by a GPS-based virtual electric fence with sound and shock signals. The State Secretary answered that the government is not involved, that the method is a virtual electric fence that should be treated like conventional electric fencing under the draft exemption, and that animal welfare effects will be studied before judging.

In the text of the draft decree submitted to the Council of State, the said exception will – if the project proves successful – be clarified so that virtual electric fences such as the Cow Guide are explicitly included in the exception.

In de tekst van het ontwerpbesluit zoals dat aan de Raad van State wordt aangeboden, zal de genoemde uitzondering – indien uit het project blijkt dat het succesvol is – worden verduidelijkt, zodanig dat virtuele elektrische afrasteringen zoals de Cow guide expliciet in de uitzondering zijn begrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ‘grote schade door hagel Zuid-Oost Brabant’

MP Van Gerven asked about the government's response to hail and storm damage in south-east Brabant, including coordination with insurers, asbestos clean-up, solar panel schemes, declaring a disaster area, and hardship cases. The Secretary of State answered that a national working group with the province, municipalities, insurers and ministries is addressing the damage, refers to earlier letters for progress, notes that the disaster compensation law does not apply, and says hardship cases are handled case by case.
Although this situation is far-reaching for the entrepreneurs involved, the Disaster Damage Compensation Act does not apply.
Hoewel deze situatie ingrijpend is voor betrokken ondernemers, is de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de controle van biologische bedrijven met het Skal-keurmerk

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Skal relies mainly on one private firm, Control Union, for organic inspections, and whether this concentration is acceptable under EU rules on impartiality. The government answered that Skal keeps responsibility for and control over Control Union, that the single-authority structure is deliberate and efficient, and it declined to open talks with Skal to allow multiple inspection bodies.
Skal is at all times responsible for the work and direction of CU, including the impartiality of the contracted inspectors and the absence of conflicts of interest.
Skal is te allen tijde verantwoordelijk voor de werkzaamheden en aansturing van CU, ook voor wat betreft de onpartijdigheid van de ingehuurde inspecteurs en het ontbreken van belangenconflicten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het voornemen van de EU om zich te verzetten tegen een totaalverbod op ivoorhandel

An MP asks the state secretary whether the EU opposing a total ivory trade ban, and the risk to African elephants, is accurate and whether the Netherlands influenced the EU position. The state secretary denies that a global ivory ban is being lifted, says the Commission proposal keeps the existing ban and that member states had no input on the first draft, and says Dutch involvement is possible but not currently considered necessary.
In the proposal that the European Commission sent to the Council, that ban remains in place.
In het voorstel dat de Europese Commissie aan de Raad gestuurd heeft, blijft dat verbod gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Illegale inzet koper in biologische aardappel’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether illegal use of copper oxychloride by organic potato growers against Phytophthora, and the failure of inspection body Skal to enforce it, was acceptable and whether controls would be tightened. The government answered that such use violates the law since copper oxychloride products were banned in the Netherlands in 2000, that enforcement falls to the NVWA which applies the same inspection regime to organic and conventional farming, and that it considers the practice unacceptable and is funding resistant potato breeding.
This means that potato growers who use copper oxychloride products against Phytophthora are violating the law.
Dit betekent dat aardappeltelers die middelen met koperoxychloride gebruiken ter bestrijding van Phytophthora de wet overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de heropstart van de oliewinning in Schoonebeek en de hervatting van de injectie van productiewater in Twente

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about resuming injection of production water in Twente, including whether pipelines cross Natura 2000 and water-protection areas, public unrest, a petition of 30,000 signatures, and whether permits are in place. The minister said the water is classified as non-hazardous, pipelines are mostly 800 to 2,500 metres from Natura 2000 areas with three exceptions, NAM holds the correct permits, and SodM supervises compliance through systemic, risk-based inspection.
Supervision of the correct implementation of the permits falls under the responsibility of SodM.
Toezicht op de juiste uitvoering van de vergunningen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van SodM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving inzake Amerikaanse rivierkreeftjes

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the upcoming EU ban on commercial catching of American crayfish, including past subsidies, why the management plan is not yet ready, and what enforcement and transition arrangements apply for fishers. The State Secretary answers that management plans for crayfish and Chinese mitten crab are being prepared with the sector and will be adopted soon, that current fishing may continue in the meantime as the NVWA acts in line with the coming plans, and that the policy line has been published on the NVWA website.
Other authorities or organisations may provide subsidies or contributions. These are not known to me because these money flows are not registered by my ministry.
Mogelijk worden door andere overheden of organisaties subsidies of bijdragen verstrekt. Deze zijn mij niet bekend omdat deze geldstromen niet door mijn ministerie worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘het dierenleed door miljoenen subsidies voor luchtwassers’

An MP asked the state secretary about animal suffering linked to subsidised air scrubbers in pig and poultry barns, including claims of EUR 38 million in public money, lower animal welfare, fewer bronmaatregelen and reduced grazing for cows. The government answered that scrubbers reduce ammonia and fine dust, that roughly EUR 3.5-4.0 million went to about 650 farms via fiscal schemes and EUR 24 million in subsidies to about 300 farms, that inspections found four shortcomings, and that it will not remove scrubbers from the Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij.
Over the past 5 years about EUR 3.5-4.0 million has been allocated to scrubbers for about 650 farms.
De afgelopen 5 jaar is voor luchtwassers circa € 3,5 – 4,0 mln toegekend aan circa 650 bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders over het bericht "Onkruidverdelger glyfosaat niet kankerverwekkend" en het persbericht van FAO/WHO

An MP asked the state secretaries about reports that glyphosate is not carcinogenic and the consequences for the ban on its use on paved surfaces and for municipal weed control. The government answered that the ban on professional use on paved surfaces stands independently of glyphosate's classification, that ECHA has not yet ruled, and that the approval extension is still pending at EU level.

The ban, announced several years ago to protect the aquatic environment, applies to all plant protection products and is entirely separate from recent developments concerning the active substance glyphosate.

Dit verbod, dat al enige jaren geleden is aangekondigd ter bescherming van het aquatisch milieu, geldt voor alle gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en staat geheel los van de recente ontwikkelingen rondom de werkzame stof glyfosaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat twee apen geëuthanaseerd zullen worden na afloop van de dierproef

MPs Van Gerven and Jasper van Dijk asked whether two research monkeys at Radboud University face euthanasia after an animal experiment and whether they could be rehomed, and raised related questions on water restriction, rehoming costs and the rationale for ape research. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, rehoming is for the licence holder to decide, the NCad advice and a Code of Practice on rehoming are being implemented, and funding for rehoming and alternatives is being arranged.
The decision on whether a former laboratory animal is eligible for rehoming or adoption is taken by the licence-holding institution.
De beslissing of een voormalig proefdier in aanmerking komt voor herplaatsing/adoptie wordt genomen door de vergunninghoudende instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het aan Brussel voorgelegde gebruiksverbod voor imidacloprid in de glastuinbouw

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the draft ban on imidacloprid use in greenhouse horticulture, notified to Brussels, had not been shared with Parliament, and challenged its legal basis, its effectiveness and the claimed improvement in surface water concentrations. The State Secretary replied that Parliament had been informed earlier, that the draft was submitted to the Council of State and the EU TRIS notification procedure, that it would be sent to Parliament once adopted, and that entry into force is on hold pending a temporary measure by the Ctgb, without addressing the substance of the legal and water-quality arguments.
If and when this AMvB is adopted and published, your House will receive it.
Indien en wanneer deze AMvB is vastgesteld en gepubliceerd ontvangt uw Kamer deze.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht “Alterra ziet minder imidacloprid in water” en het ter notificatie voorgelegde ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden

An MP asked the State Secretary about Alterra findings that imidacloprid concentrations in surface water fell in 2015-2016, whether this breaks the trend, and about the notified draft ban on imidacloprid in greenhouse horticulture areas, including why notification was not mentioned earlier and on what EU basis the areas were designated. The State Secretary largely referred to a separate letter and parallel answers, committed to sending the Ctgb advice-based letter, and did not reverse the ban.
I asked the Ctgb to draw up advice on imidacloprid based on the follow-up analysis of the Leiden Centre for Environmental Sciences.
Ik heb het College voor de toelating van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden (Ctgb) gevraagd een advies op te stellen over imidacloprid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het gebruik van antibiotica door boeren

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretaries whether they were aware of the SDa report on antibiotic use in livestock in 2015, why the 58% reduction since 2009 falls short of the 70% target and what further steps will be taken, and whether more demanding targets, further analysis and binding measures are planned for farms that show no reduction. The government welcomed the reduction, announced additional measures for high-use farms and vets, committed to a sector analysis of critical success factors and a pilot at high-use farms, and promised to inform parliament before the summer recess.
Before the summer recess we will inform you about this follow-up policy.
Voor het zomerreces informeren wij u over dit vervolgbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat een akkerrand is afgekeurd door de RVO omdat deze twee meter te breed is

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the RVO rejecting a field margin for being two metres too wide, questioning the bureaucratic approach and the ecological rationale. The State Secretary answered that the European rule is strict, that he has asked the European Commission to change it, and that until then Dutch authorities must reject field margin parts wider than 20 metres.
As long as that has not happened, the Netherlands is bound to reject (parts of) field margins wider than 20 metres.
Zolang dat niet is gebeurd, is Nederland eraan gehouden (de delen van) akkerranden breder dan 20 meter af te keuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over besmette zandbakken in speeltuinen

An MP asked the government about contamination of playground sandpits with dog and cat faeces that can carry toxoplasmosis and toxocariasis, including infection rates, disease course, and whether the NVWA oversees sandpit surfaces. The Minister replied that infection rates are not tracked, the NVWA supervises owners' duty to keep surfaces safe, and advised parents and owners on hygiene and sand use without committing to new measures.
There is no notification obligation for Toxoplasma or Toxocara. There is therefore no overview of the number of cases.
Er bestaat geen meldingsplicht voor Toxoplasma of Toxocara. Er is dus geen overzicht van het aantal gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het bericht ‘Nederlandse vogels massaal uit de natuur geroofd’

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mass illegal bird trapping and trade in the Netherlands, and whether NVWA enforcement capacity and bird markets are adequately supervised. The State Secretary could not confirm the figures but acknowledged such illegal practices occur, admitted no separate statistics are kept, judged NVWA's 20 inspectors sufficient, and saw no reason to tighten supervision of bird markets beyond asking NVWA to pay more attention to them.
I do not have such figures, because the registrations of police, justice and the NVWA do not record these poaching offences separately.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers, want in de registraties van politie, justitie en de NVWA worden deze stroperijdelicten niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over massale illegale vogelvangst en vogelhandel in Nederland en over het ontbreken van toezicht hierop

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mass illegal trapping and trade of wild birds in the Netherlands, the lack of enforcement, the Flora- and faunawet exemption for captive-bred birds, and whether bird markets should be closed. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA carries out risk-based inspections of bird markets, that police and NVWA run criminal investigations, that existing enforcement capacity is sufficient, and that closing markets would drive trade underground.
I remain of the view that within the existing capacity and scope of the NVWA sufficient attention is paid to enforcement of and supervision over nature legislation in the Netherlands.
Ik blijf van mening dat binnen de bestaande capaciteit en ruimte van de NVWA voldoende aandacht wordt besteed aan de handhaving van en het toezicht op de natuurregelgeving in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de noodzaak tot het verduurzamen van voedsel, mede via prijsprikkels

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether the government will act on an international panel's call for sustainable food systems, including pricing externalities via taxes, ending subsidies for unsustainable production, and a national awareness campaign. The state secretary agrees the government has a role, says true-pricing research is underway with results due in late 2016, rejects broadening taxation for now, and points to existing awareness efforts by other bodies and schools.
The cabinet is not in favour of broadening the instrumental use of taxation at this time.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander om het instrumentele gebruik van belastingheffing op dit moment te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het onderwerp geen compensatie dubbele heffingen voor pluimveehouders voor het Diergezondheidsfonds door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland

An MP from the CDA asks why poultry farmers with multi-year animals were charged twice for the Animal Health Fund levy in 2014 and 2015 and whether they will be compensated. The State Secretary acknowledges about 1,800 farms were disadvantaged, commits to refunding the double charge against the final 2015 assessment, and explains the calculation rules.
Therefore I will compensate the poultry farmers concerned.
Daarom zal ik de betrokken pluimveehouders tegemoet komen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de plofkipfabriek in Veenendaal

The MP asks whether a Ukrainian poultry firm's meat-cutting plant in Veenendaal, its welfare and hygiene oversight, and the labelling of its meat as Dutch comply with Dutch and EU rules, and whether the state can stop it. The State Secretary answers that live poultry imports from Ukraine are banned, that EU-approved Ukrainian plants are supervised by Ukraine and audited by the EU, that origin labelling rules apply, and that the plant already complies with Dutch law so no intervention is warranted.
The cutting plant in Veenendaal currently complies with the laws and regulations, so there is no ground or reason for the Dutch government to intervene.
De uitsnijderij in Veenendaal voldoet op dit moment aan de wet- en regelgeving en daarmee is er geen grond of reden voor ingrijpen vanuit de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over misstanden in de Nederlandse vogelhandel

An MP asked the state secretary and the health minister about animal welfare, illegal trade and disease risks at Dutch bird markets after a broadcast, including whether bird markets should be abolished. The government acknowledged the abuses and pointed to existing rules and NVWA enforcement, but said it could not verify the trade claims, gave limited answers on enforcement, and promised to draw attention to the psittacosis reporting duty with the veterinary association and to ask the NVWA to focus on illegal trade and welfare at such events.
I regret the abuses shown in the broadcast.
Ik betreur de misstanden die worden getoond in de uitzending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over alarmerende bijensterfte in de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that US beekeepers lost half their bees, whether this signals risk for the Netherlands and Europe, and its consequences for food security and biodiversity. The state secretary answered that the US situation is not representative because of large-scale commercial beekeeping, that Dutch winter losses were very low, and referred back to the answer on the consequences.
The report gives no cause for concern since the situation in the United States is not representative of the Dutch or European situation.
Het bericht geeft geen aanleiding voor bezorgdheid aangezien de situatie in de Verenigde Staten niet representatief is voor de Nederlandse of Europese situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de omstreden komst van een gigastal voor 5.100 geiten

An MP asked whether the municipality of Maasdriel would involve the council in a permit for a 5,100-goat stal, whether a family link to a CDA leader raises integrity concerns, and whether the government would act on Q-fever risks and impose a moratorium. The State Secretary answered that the municipality decides on the permit and bestemmingsplan, family ties play no role, the GGD gave a positive advice, and no moratorium is planned, pointing to earlier answers.
The municipality will make a substantive judgment on this application, in which family relationships play no role.
De gemeente zal een inhoudelijk oordeel vellen over deze aanvraag, waarbij familierelaties geen rol spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de stikstofuitstoot van de intensieve veehouderij als sluipmoordenaar voor Nederlandse natuur

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether nitrogen emissions from intensive livestock farming are endangering Dutch nature, including the Veluwe, and whether reducing livestock is needed. The State Secretary answers that nitrogen deposition is a major problem in many Natura 2000 areas, that deposition has fallen and the Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) with monitoring and restoration measures is adequate, and that no decision on reducing the livestock stock is taken.
With the PAS the downward trend in nitrogen deposition is strengthened.
Met de PAS wordt de dalende trend van de stikstofdepositie versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht “grutto of kraai, voor wie moet je kiezen?”

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports on predation of meadow bird nests by foxes, crows and other predators, including whether predation is rising and whether predator control is needed for meadow bird conservation. The government answered that predation is monitored nationally without a clear rising trend, that predator control is one factor within a broader habitat approach, and that legal options exist under the new nature conservation law, with no commitment to new action.
As can be seen, no rising trend can be discerned in the figures, although predation has increased over the past few years after several years of low predation.
Zoals te zien is er geen stijgende trend te ontdekken in de cijfers, al is predatie de afgelopen paar jaar na enkele jaren met weinig predatie wel toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over koeherkenning

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the planned ban on cold-branding cows, which dairy farmers use for identification in milking parlours and pastures, and whether the ban will be suspended and why the NVWA's concerns were not shared. The State Secretary confirms awareness of the sector's objections, refers to the draft decree for the substance, states the NVWA's concerns were not formally raised as far as known, and says cold-branding remains allowed until the ban takes effect.
I refer you for the answer to the explanatory memorandum accompanying the draft amendment decree to the Animal Keepers and Veterinary Decree, which was submitted to your House on 1 June.
Ik verwijs u voor het antwoord naar de nota van toelichting bij het ontwerpbesluit wijziging Besluit houders van dieren en Besluit diergeneeskundigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over de uitvoering van het programma Stroomlijn, deelgebied 1 en 2)

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the minister about public opposition to the Stroomlijn flood-safety vegetation-clearing programme, the balance with nature protection, the role of residents and organisations, the beaver habitat, the mid-term evaluation and the lack of compensation for felled trees. The minister answered that the programme is proportionate, consulted stakeholders, that the mid-term evaluation was completed and found the goals achievable, and that compensation is limited because most protected nature is spared.
Yes, the mid-term evaluation of the Stroomlijn programme has now been carried out.
Ja, de tussenevaluatie van het programma Stroomlijn is inmiddels uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van een olifant als publiekstrekker voor circus Freiwald, ondanks een wettelijk verbod

The MP Wassenberg asks why circus Freiwald is allowed to keep and display elephant Buba and zebras despite the ban on wild animals in circuses and the conditions of its exemption, and why exemptions were renewed without a shelter being found. The State Secretary answers that the NVWA is investigating compliance with the exemption conditions, that the exemptions run until 15 January 2017 on condition of cooperating with an independent assessment, and that finding shelter is difficult and the ministry will mediate where needed, while noting that the animals are owned by the circuses.
Following this report and other notifications, the NVWA has launched an investigation.
Naar aanleiding van dit bericht en andere meldingen heeft de NVWA een onderzoek ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht 'Nederlandse overheid wil meer visgebied sluiten dan nodig van Europa'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the Dutch government wants to close more fishing ground than EU law requires on the Frisian Front and Central Oyster Grounds, and what the consequences are for the Dutch fleet. The government replies that the measures serve the Marine Strategy Framework Directive, that the economic impact on fisheries is limited (under 1% of yearly catch value), and promises to send a letter on the outcomes of the 10 May meeting.
I disagree with the claim that the Dutch government wants to close more fishing ground than necessary.
Ik ben het niet eens met de stelling dat de Nederlandse overheid meer visgebied wil sluiten dan nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over Q-koorts en een geitenstal in Rossum

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Health whether a large goat stall in Rossum, which the GGD warned could pose risks if operations deviate even slightly, is acceptable given the Q-fever outbreak history, and why residents' objections were overridden. The government answered that the GGD gave positive advice, that Q-fever measures and vaccination mean no raised risk, that the municipality is responsible for the zoning plan and emissions, and that objections were handled in the normal zoning process.
For the environmental measures the municipality is responsible in its capacity as competent authority for the environmental permit.
Voor de milieumaatregelen is de gemeente verantwoordelijk in zijn hoedanigheid van bevoegd gezag voor de omgevingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders over de berichten ‘Wijziging NVWA-tarieven per 1 mei 2016’ en ‘NVWA zet nertsenhouders en hun gezinnen mes op de keel’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the May 2016 increase in NVWA inspection fees, whether it anticipates the pending review of the agency, and whether daily inspections of mink farms without findings are proportionate. The State Secretary answered that the fee increase follows existing cost-recovery policy independent of the review, that the review results were sent to Parliament that day, and that the inspections are based on several laws with enforcement findings still under analysis.
The results of this have been sent to your House today.
Over de uitkomsten hiervan is uw Kamer vandaag geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over de risico’s voor de volksgezondheid die de groei van de melkveestapel met zich mee brengt en heeft gebracht

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked whether growing dairy herds and farm sizes pose public health risks, including infectious disease and Streptococcus agalactiae, and whether hard caps on cow numbers should be set.
