The minister answered that farm size is only one factor among many, that no link to S. agalactiae in humans is established, that the VGO study on livestock and resident health will report before summer, and that no hard caps are planned.
A possible link between livestock farming and public health, however, I take very seriously.
Een mogelijk verband tussen veehouderijen en volksgezondheid neem ik echter zeer serieus.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Vogelmarkten moeten stoppen’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about bird markets, zoonotic disease risks, illegal trade in protected birds and animal welfare, following a media report and petition calling for bird markets to be stopped. The State Secretary defended the current regime (health checks, registration with the NVWA, CITES rules), gave limited data, and declined a ban but promised to ask the NVWA to pay closer attention to illegal trade and welfare at such events.
However, I will ask the NVWA to pay explicit attention at such events to both possible illegal trade and welfare aspects.
Wel zal ik de NVWA vragen om bij dergelijke evenementen nadrukkelijk aandacht te besteden aan zowel eventuele illegale handel als welzijnsaspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de wettelijke overtredingen op paardenmarkten

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about repeated animal welfare violations at horse markets (Zuidlaren), the Protocol Welfare Horse Markets, whether horse trade should be banned, municipal payments to traders, and disease spread. The state secretary said the sector and municipalities must ensure welfare, asked the Animal Affairs Council to update the protocol, rejected a ban, and said disease was not a designated notifiable disease.
I am of the view that the parties involved must themselves be able to guarantee the welfare of the animals.
Ik ben van mening dat de betrokken partijen zelf in staat moeten zijn om het welzijn van de dieren te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jacobi over de bescherming van broedvogels in het waddengebied

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about declining breeding bird populations in the Wadden Sea, the consistency of cross-border monitoring figures, the need for stronger trilateral cooperation, and whether current protection policy should be revised. The State Secretary answered that the figures are consistent with national monitoring, pointed to the trilateral Action Plan for breeding birds and a national offensive under the 'Naar een Rijke Waddenzee' programme, and stated that multiple parties' involvement does not hinder effective policy.
My aim is that the managers and governments involved will, each within their own responsibility, make efforts to reverse this decline in breeding success.
Mijn inzet is dat de betrokken beheerders en overheden vanuit ieders verantwoordelijkheid zich zullen inspannen om deze achteruitgang van het broedsucces te keren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het jaarlijks uitzetten van korhoenders op de Sallandse Heuvelrug die vervolgens een hongerdood sterven

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked whether the government would halt the annual release of Swedish capercaillies on the Sallandse Heuvelrug, which died of starvation due to nitrogen-depleted insect food, and how this fits the state's duty to protect nature. The State Secretary replied that nature policy is a provincial responsibility, that the releases are a last-resort bridging measure justified by Overijssel's provincial executive, and that the government will not halt them.
Policy on the capercaillie is a responsibility of the province, which I do not wish to interfere with.
Het beleid ten aanzien van het korhoen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie, waar ik niet in wil treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over aanhoudende misstanden rondom zwanendrifters in het Groene Hart

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice about persistent abuses in swan herding (zwanendrifters) in the Groene Hart, including whether convicted offenders should lose hunting permits, protection for the complainant, and a ban on collecting swan eggs for commercial purposes. The government answered that the police chief decides on withdrawing permits, that police increased surveillance around the complainant's home, and that egg collection is allowed only for damage control under provincial permit, while hatching and selling swans is not permitted.
It is up to the chief of police to decide on any withdrawal of hunting permits he has granted when violations of the Flora and Fauna Act are established.
Het is aan de korpschef van politie om te beslissen over een eventuele intrekking van door hem verleende jachtakten bij geconstateerde overtredingen van de Flora- en faunawet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Bosma naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Strijd tegen kiloknaller gaat nieuwe ronde in’

MPs Lodders and Bosma asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal welfare group Wakker Dier changing its definition of 'kiloknaller' (cheap-meat promotions), which produced a 40 percent rise in such promotions in 2015. The State Secretary said Wakker Dier may adapt its definition but must communicate the change clearly to avoid misleading consumers, and that the public debate concerns the desirability of such promotions rather than the definition used.
It is not desirable that Wakker Dier misleads consumers.
Het is echter niet gewenst dat Wakker Dier consumenten op het verkeerde been zet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Volp over de verschuiving van drugsdumpingen van Noord-Brabant naar Gelderland

PvdA MPs Cegerek and Volp asked about the shift of illegal drug-waste dumping from Noord-Brabant to Gelderland, including enforcement capacity and the role of environmental services. The Minister largely referred to earlier answers, said he lacks an overview of enforcement capacity per province, attributed dumping patterns to the location of synthetic drug labs and offenders' choice of distant dumping sites, and described existing cross-agency cooperation in Brabant and Limburg.
I do not have an overview of the requested ratios in enforcement capacity.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de gevraagde verhoudingen in handhavingscapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht “Toenemende sterfte van biggen”

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about rising piglet mortality, the reliability of Varkens in Nood and Agrovision data, the failure of the Stuurgroep Bigvitaliteit plan, and whether breeding for more piglets per sow should end. The State Secretary largely referred to the standvanzakenbrief on animal welfare and to earlier answers, and said the stuurgroep's latest results were recently added to the website.
No figures are known on the killing of animals at primary farms by non-veterinarians.
Over het voorkomen van het doden van dieren op het primaire bedrijf door niet-dierenartsen zijn geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de investeringen van verzekeraars in bedrijven die bont en exotisch leer verkopen

An MP asked whether insurers' indirect investments in fur and exotic leather firms are regulated, whether the government will create rules, ensure transparency and talk to insurers to phase these investments out. The government answered there is no current regulation, relies on self-regulation via a planned multistakeholder CSR convenant with the insurance sector that may cover animal welfare and transparency, and noted two insurers are willing to engage on animal welfare.
Within the framework of (international) corporate social responsibility, the government relies on self-regulation.
In het kader van (internationaal) maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen (iMVO) zet de overheid in op zelfregulering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de handhaving van de aanlandplicht door inspectiediensten in de visserijsector

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about enforcement of the landing obligation by inspection services in the fishing sector, including perceived distrust, equal enforcement with other countries, efficiency of the electronic logbook, inspection frequency, discard registration, warnings, and inspector conduct. The State Secretary replied that inspections in the first half of 2016 are informative, that enforcement is comparable across member states, that no sanctions or formal warnings have been issued, and that inspection intensity is not disproportionate, while refusing to cut inspections or relax daily discard registration.
The informative character consists of the NVWA entering into discussion with the individual fisher when an infringement is found.
Het informerend karakter bestaat er uit dat de NVWA bij constatering van een overtreding het gesprek aangaat met de individuele visser.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een jager die ongeboren reekalfjes uit moeder snijdt

An MP asked whether a certified hunter who shot a pregnant roe doe and removed the unborn fawns should be prosecuted, and whether a general ban on shooting protected animals during gestation is planned. The State Secretary answered that the shooting was lawful under a provincial exemption within the permitted February-March season, no report was drawn up, and no general ban is planned, while acknowledging that shooting suckling does is undesirable.

Inquiries with the national police and the Faunabeheereenheid Noord-Brabant showed there was no poaching, but that the roe doe was shot by a certified hunter acting in accordance with the conditions of the exemption granted by the Noord-Brabant provincial executive.

Uit navraag bij de Nationale politie en de Faunabeheereenheid Noord-Brabant, is gebleken dat hier geen sprake is van stroperij, maar dat de reegeit is geschoten door een gecertificeerde jager die conform de voorwaarden uit de door gedeputeerde staten van Noord-Brabant verleende ontheffing heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de behandeling van uitgelegde hennen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the NVWA supervises the catching and transport of laying hens, including the slaughterhouses abroad, and whether the EFSA should investigate and the sector invest in better transport. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA carries out unannounced checks, that foreign slaughterhouses are supervised by their own authorities, and that the sector is being engaged on improvements and possible stricter enforcement.
The Netherlands has no data on this.
Nederland heeft hier geen gegevens over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Uitgelegde kippen vaak als oud vuil behandeld'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports that spent laying hens are mistreated during catching and transport, asking whether the government condemns the abuses, how it will prevent them, and whether inspectors and training can be required. The State Secretary condemns the abuses, points to existing EU transport rules and NVWA supervision, awaits an NVWA chain analysis, and refers several questions to answers given to a parallel PvdD question, while promising to ask the sector to add a mandatory welfare course and to consider accelerating it.
The NVWA supervises compliance with this legislation and has insight into violations.
De NVWA houdt toezicht op de naleving van deze wet- en regelgeving en heeft inzicht in overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over misstanden rondom het vangen en transporteren van leghennen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reported animal suffering when laying hens are caught and transported, including injuries, lack of protection from weather, long transports to Poland, and too many inspection violations. The government says existing rules apply, an NVWA chain analysis is underway with results due in Q3 2016, it will not unilaterally ban long transports but will press for EU changes, and it finds long transport for cost reasons unacceptable and will discuss this with the sector.
I will inform your House in the third quarter of this year about the results of the chain analysis.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van dit jaar informeren over de resultaten van de ketenanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Dekken naar aanleiding van de stalbrand in Oirschot

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how many animals were in the Oirschot barn fire, whether injured animals stayed alive for many hours, the cause of the fire, whether the building fell under the updated building code, and how such fires can be prevented. The state secretary answered that about 9,000 animals were likely present, that asbestos delayed entry until about 20 hours after the fire, that the cause is still under investigation with a report expected mid-June, and pointed to the existing Action Plan on barn fires with an evaluation planned for late 2016.
The official report with the results of this investigation is expected around mid-June.
Het officiële rapport met de resultaten van dit onderzoek worden rond half juni verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het aanmerken van een paardenmarkt als erkende verzamelplaats

An MP asked whether a horse market can be designated an approved assembly point under EU law, and on what conditions. The State Secretary answered that EU Directive 2009/156 allows only direct transport or transport via an approved assembly centre, sets requirements referenced from Directive 64/432, and that no approved horse assembly centres currently exist in the Netherlands while national rules are being developed in consultation with the sector.
At present, under European regulations, there are no approved horse assembly centres in the Netherlands.
Op dit moment zijn er op grond van Europese regelgeving geen erkende paardenverzamelcentra in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat zes miljoen varkens sterven nog voor de slacht

SP MP Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about a report claiming six million pigs die before slaughter, the withholding of Rendac mortality figures, killing of piglets on farms, piglet mortality and whether Rendac can detect live animals in carcass containers. The State Secretary answered that the Wageningen report will be sent to parliament after a decision, that Rendac is not obliged to publish mortality figures and that its publication is being considered, and referred to a separate letter on animal welfare for several questions.
Once a decision has been taken, I will send this decision, together with the advice of the expert group and the Wageningen UR report, to your House.
Zodra besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden zal ik dit besluit, vergezeld van het advies van de expertgroep en het rapport van Wageningen UR, aan uw Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Geurts en Koser Kaya over het rapport van de Raad voor Regionaal Veevoer over de kansen en knelpunten voor eiwitrijke veevoergrondstoffen

MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Raad voor Regionaal Veevoer report on increasing regionally grown protein feed and whether he would adopt its recommendations and a protein vision. The State Secretary agreed that regional protein production has potential, committed to exploring public-private initiatives, topsector focus and raising EU-level barriers, but said direct state steering of cultivation is not the preferred route and the transition will proceed more slowly than the report envisages.
I agree that regional cultivation and sale of protein crops can contribute more to improving the regional cycle.
Ik onderschrijf dat met de productie van regionale teelt en afzet van eiwitgewassen meer kan worden bijgedragen aan het verbeteren van de regionale kringloop
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘BLHB wil prijstoetsing geliberaliseerde pacht’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Dutch landlords' and tenants' association BLHB's proposal to introduce price review for liberalised farmland leases, and about related concerns on price rises, soil fertility, lease duration and government landlord conduct. The State Secretary declined to act for now, pending the stakeholder talks on the Spelderholt deal, agreed to have LEI model the BLHB proposal, and gave the average lease price table.
I want to give the parties the opportunity to finish this consultation before I consider proposals.
Ik wil de partijen de gelegenheid geven dit overleg af te ronden voordat ik voorstellen in overweging neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht dat zwanen massaal worden afgeschoten in het Groene Hart

SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mass shooting of swans in the Groene Hart, including the justification for provincial permits, whether the permits are dubious, measures against the hunt, and legal options against mistreatment shown on television. The State Secretary replied that about 1100 swans were killed this winter, in line with the average, that provinces are responsible for permits under the Flora- and faunawet and he will not intervene, that the courts remain open, and that enforcement bodies oversee permit conditions while a possible criminal investigation is being considered and cannot be discussed.
Under the Flora- and faunawet, it is the responsibility of the provinces to approve fauna management plans and grant permits based on them.
Het is ingevolge de Flora- en faunawet de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om faunabeheerplannen goed te keuren en daarop gebaseerde ontheffingen te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over de jacht op zwanen

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about EenVandaag footage of swan hunting, provincial culling permits, enforcement and compensation paid for swan damage. The state secretary answered that provinces grant and supervise the permits, no violations were recorded, police are assessing the footage, and provinces remain responsible, so no permits will be withdrawn.
Under the Flora and Fauna Act it is the responsibility of the provinces to approve wildlife management plans and grant the permits based on them.
Het is ingevolge de Flora- en faunawet de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om faunabeheerplannen goed te keuren en daarop gebaseerde ontheffingen te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de zware mishandeling van knobbelzwanen door jagers

An MP asked the government how it would respond to a broadcast showing hunters seriously mistreating wounded mute swans, why police did not act on complaints, and whether it would ban swan hunting and hagel shot. The state secretary said police checked hunting requirements and that a criminal investigation into possible mistreatment is being considered, but declined to say more, and defended provincial discretion on swan culling without committing to a ban.
Regarding possible criminal offences, such as mistreatment, it is currently being considered whether a criminal investigation should be launched.
Ten aanzien van eventuele strafbare feiten, zoals mishandeling, wordt op dit moment bezien of een strafrechtelijk onderzoek moet worden ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het Franse voornemen een verbod af te kondigen op neonicotinoïden in verband met hun rol in de zorgwekkende bijensterfte

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government about a French parliamentary move to ban neonicotinoid pesticides from 2018 and whether the Netherlands would pursue a total ban. The Secretary of State answered that the French proposal is not final and not yet notified to the EU, that the Dutch government considers the earlier motions unenforceable under EU regulation 1107/2009, and that a total ban is not appropriate given recent EFSA reassessments, while promising to inform parliament of relevant developments.
A total ban is, in my view and based on recent reassessments of the active substances in the neonicotinoid group, not an option.
Een totaalverbod is naar mijn inzicht en op basis van recente herbeoordelingen van de werkzame stoffen uit de neonicotinoïdengroep niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het visserijplan Oostzee

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the Baltic Sea fisheries plan, through FMSY ranges, allows structural overfishing and whether Dutch policy on it is sound. The government replied that the plan stays within scientific MSY advice with safeguards, denies it enables overfishing, and commits only to advocating scientifically based catch limits in future plans.
That the plan offers possibilities for structural overfishing is therefore an incorrect claim.
Dat het plan mogelijkheden biedt tot structurele overbevissing, is derhalve een onjuiste stellingname.

Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders over het persbericht van de Europese Commissie van 14 maart, de toespraak van Commissaris Hogan tijdens de Landbouw- en Visserijraad van 14 maart jl. en het verslag van deze raad

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the European Commission's new agricultural market measures for dairy and pig farmers, the state aid increase, and the effect on the level playing field. The government answered that the Dutch presidency pushed for market-oriented measures, that the state aid rules are strict and require Commission approval, and that it sees no unfair distortion from the package.
There is no question of an additional support package of 500 million euros.
Er is geen sprake van een aanvullend steunpakket ter grootte van 500 miljoen euro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het hoge aantal gevallen van longkanker in Brabant en het effect hierop van de intensieve veeteelt

Two MPs asked whether the government will act on reports of high lung cancer rates in Brabant linked to intensive livestock farming, including research, registration and a moratorium on new permits pending study. The minister replied that the ongoing VGO study does not cover lung cancer, that the GGD has started an exploratory study with results expected end of April, and that the Health Council may be asked to revise its 2012 advice, but no permit moratorium is accepted since no scientific indications of risk are known.
Following the report, the GGD in the Brabant region is immediately starting an exploratory study into the relationship between lung cancer and livestock farming.
Naar aanleiding van het genoemde bericht start de GGD in de regio Brabant per direct een verkennend onderzoek naar de relatie longkanker en veehouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over een vergunning voor een nertsenhouderij in Bergeijk

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about a permit for a mink farm in Bergeijk, whether it is a new farm, and how it fits the 2024 fur farming ban. The State Secretary answers that the permit is a Natuurbeschermingswet permit for relocating an existing mink farm, that relocation is allowed under the ban if animal numbers do not increase and the old site is closed, and that the permit is separate from the ban.
The granted permit concerns a permit under the Nature Conservation Act 1998.
De verleende vergunning betreft een vergunning in het kader van de Natuurbeschermingswet 1998.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Jonge Landbouwersregeling pakt totaal verkeerd uit’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs for a response to a press report that the Young Farmers scheme (EU CAP support) is going to family partnerships rather than individual young farmers, and where the subsidy ends up and how it reaches the right target group. The State Secretary says the EU definition allows partnerships, that the Netherlands voted against that clause, that changing it requires CAP reform, and that the provinces now run the scheme and can adjust it at the next opening.
Adjusting the definition will therefore only be possible with a revision of the CAP.
Aanpassing van de definitie zal derhalve pas mogelijk zijn bij een herziening van het GLB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf met betrekking tot de regeling voor jonge landbouwers

An MP from the SGP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the model scheme and investment list for the young farmers subsidy (under the third rural development programme) are built so that farmers who took over a farm struggle to use it, and whether the scheme should be adjusted. The State Secretary rejected that reading, explained that the scheme is open to all farmers under 41 and that the EU age definition is the cause of complaints, and said adjustments are for the provinces to consider.
It is up to the provinces to consider adjusting the scheme or reopening it.
Het is aan de provincies om aanpassing van de regeling danwel hernieuwde openstelling te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verlenen van het predicaat ‘Koninklijk’ aan Vee & Logistiek Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary whether the trade association Vee & Logistiek Nederland, which represents livestock transport firms with many recorded welfare and inspection violations, should be denied the royal predicate 'Koninklijk'. The state secretary confirmed the application, explained the procedure via the mayor and the commissioner of the King, and declined to pre-judge the decision.
Pending the assessment of the application, I do not consider it opportune to anticipate the decision that will be taken on this.
Hangende de beoordeling van de aanvraag acht ik het niet opportuun vooruit te lopen op het besluit dat hierover genomen zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de huisvestingseisen van runderen in de veehouderij

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about housing requirements for cattle after a court ruled the NVWA's penalty against an overcrowded dairy farm was not properly imposed and that the law does not explicitly require an individual lying place per cow. The government answered that it will not amend the legislation, arguing the CBb ruling gives enough grounds to prove future violations, and that the enforcement order was reformulated to require a clean, dry lying place for each animal.
I do not intend to amend the legislation.
Ik ben niet voornemens de wetgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over verborgen dierenleed bij het Dolfinarium Harderwijk

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how to end alleged hidden animal suffering among show dolphins kept in chlorinated pools at Dolfinarium Harderwijk, and why NVWA inspections are announced in advance. The State Secretary answered that a 9 March 2016 NVWA inspection found no violations, water quality meets EAZA guidelines, dolphins are not moved for genetic and social reasons, and unannounced inspections are not always required.
Therefore I do not share your view that inspections on animal welfare should always take place unannounced.
Ik deel daarom niet uw mening dat inspecties op dierenwelzijn te allen tijde onaangekondigd dienen plaats te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over de stand van de wilde eend

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether he knew of a sharp decline in wild duck numbers, whether hunting or damage control was ongoing, and whether the hunt should be suspended until a Sovon study is published, and whether he would urge provinces to do so. The State Secretary answered that hunting is closed until 15 August, that provinces may grant exemptions only in exceptional damage cases, that he will review the Sovon results before reopening the season, and that he sees no reason to urge provinces to refrain since the decision is a provincial competence.
On the basis of that, I will consider whether these give cause to open the hunting season for the wild duck after 15 August or not.
Op basis daarvan zal ik bezien of deze aanleiding geven om na 15 augustus het jachtseizoen met betrekking tot de wilde eend al dan niet te openen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het staken van jacht op de wilde eend

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether he would halt recreational hunting of wild ducks given their declining population, and whether he would press provinces to stop culling. The State Secretary declined to pre-empt a Sovon population study due before summer and referred to earlier answers on the same question.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of this research into the population development of wild ducks among others; the report is expected before the summer.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek naar de populatieontwikkeling van onder meer wilde eenden, naar verwachting verschijnt het rapport voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bestrijden van wildlife crime

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the enforcement of wildlife crime, the adequacy of penalties and detection, the use of the EUR 4 million budget, and the EU action plan. The State Secretary answered that existing rules and enforcement by NVWA, police, Customs and the Public Prosecution Service suffice, that penalties are relatively high, and that he will report on the conference results and the EU action plan later.
I will send you my response to the EU action plan together with the results of the conference.
Ik zal u mijn reactie op het EU-actieplan toesturen tezamen met de resultaten van de conferentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de rol van Europa in de illegale dierenhandel

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the EU's role in illegal wildlife trade, the need for more budget and priority, and Europol's claim that wildlife crime lacks priority. The State Secretary answers that Dutch capacity is sufficient, that existing funding (4 million from EZ and 2 million from BZ) was reprioritised, and that the Netherlands will push for strong Council conclusions on the EU action plan.
In my view, the Netherlands' efforts and capacity to combat wildlife crime are sufficient, partly because of intensive cooperation between enforcement authorities at European and global level.

Naar mijn mening is de inzet en capaciteit van Nederland om wildlifecriminaliteit aan te pakken voldoende, mede vanwege de intensieve samenwerking op Europees en mondiaal niveau tussen de handhavingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Rudmer Heerema over Nederland als knooppunt van wildstropers

MPs Thieme and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the Netherlands as a hub for wildlife trafficking, the enforcement of import exemptions, and the motion on banning hunting trophy imports. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the Netherlands is a key trafficking hub, described enforcement and priorities, and promised to inform the House later on the conference outcomes and trophy import ban options.

I will inform you shortly about the outcomes of the conference 'Save Wildlife: Act Now or Game Over' and about the options for introducing a ban on hunting trophies in response to the Thieme/Heerema motion.

Ik zal u op korte termijn informeren over de uitkomsten van de conferentie «Save Wildlife: Act Now or Game Over» en over de mogelijkheden om een verbod voor jachttrofeeën in te stellen in reactie op de motie Thieme/Heerema.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de berichten dat Nederland en Europa een grote rol spelen in de illegale dierenhandel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands and Europe play a major role in illegal wildlife trade, including enforcement capacity, penalties, international cooperation and aid to African countries. The government replied that Dutch enforcement capacity is sufficient, penalties are substantial, and it is pursuing CITES, EU and aid-based measures, while rejecting claims of inadequate capacity.
In my view the Netherlands' efforts in this area are good and I am making sufficient resources available for them.
Naar mijn oordeel is de inzet van Nederland op dit terrein goed en maak ik daar voldoende middelen voor vrij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over een met het verboden bestrijdingsmiddel Aldicarb vergiftigd persoon

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the banned pesticide aldicarb used on a chrysanthemum grower and whether NVWA knew of its use in the Netherlands. The government answered that NVWA had no indication of wide use, that a criminal investigation is ongoing and that it cannot comment on its status.
A criminal investigation under the direction of the Public Prosecutor of the Zwolle Office is ongoing.
Een strafrechtelijk onderzoek onder leiding van de Officier van Justitie van Parket Zwolle is gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht "Het geringe broedsucces van broedvogels in het Waddengebied”

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the poor breeding success of coastal birds in the Wadden Sea, the causes, and what measures are being taken. The state secretary answered that causes are complex, fishing is not clearly the cause, and listed a trilateral action plan and the Rijke Waddenzee programme as measures.

By continuing this breeding success monitoring and gathering more knowledge, including from the projects named in my answer to question 5 and discussed and shared at trilateral level, I want to try to gain more insight into this complex subject in this dynamic area.

Met het continueren van dit reproductiemeetnet en met het vergaren van meer kennis, die onder meer wordt opgedaan in de projecten die bij mijn antwoord op vraag 5 zijn benoemd en op trilateraal niveau worden besproken en gedeeld, wil ik trachten meer inzicht te verkrijgen in deze veelzijdige materie in dit dynamische gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het feit dat bij de hengstenkeuring van de KVTH bijna alleen maar paarden met gecoupeerde staarten meedoen, terwijl couperen sinds 2001 verboden is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why almost all stallions at the KVTH stallion inspection had docked tails despite the 2001 ban on docking, and what action would be taken against the KVTH. The State Secretary answered that the 2002 CBb ruling limits the exhibition ban for legally docked foreign animals, that enforcement under administrative law will be pursued and effectiveness studied, but no commitment was made to a reporting duty for vets or a ban on transport.
In view of this, I intend to enforce the exhibition ban under administrative law in the coming period.
Gelet hierop ben ik voornemens de komende periode bestuursrechtelijk te gaan handhaven op het tentoonstellingsverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het illegaal couperen van staarten bij veulens

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about illegal tail docking of foals, the KVTH association's tolerance of it, and whether the government would act on it. The State Secretary said the NVWA runs no specific inspections, recorded one report and one warning in two years, regretted the KVTH's stance, and will raise the issue bilaterally in Europe without new EU legislation.
The NVWA does not carry out specific inspections on the ban on tail docking.
De NVWA voert geen specifieke inspecties uit op het verbod op het couperen van staarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de plannen voor een megastal met grootschalige embryowinning in Wichmond en de gevolgen daarvan voor hormoonemissies naar het milieu

An MP asked the government about hormone emissions from the planned Wichmond cattle farm with embryo harvesting, including whether an environmental impact assessment and permits should block it. The state secretaries answered that no hormone-specific study or specific emission rules exist for the farm, that no MER is required for the first two phases, and that the municipality and province hold the relevant planning and permit powers.
For phase 3, it is up to the municipality to assess whether the final farm fits within the zoning plan.
Voor fase 3 is het aan de gemeente ter beoordeling of het uiteindelijke bedrijf inpasbaar is in het bestemmingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Thieme over het doden van honderden gezonde kalveren

MPs Van Dekken and Thieme asked the State Secretary about hundreds of healthy under-weight calves being killed for economic reasons, including whether the government would intervene given dairy expansion, transport and antibiotic problems, and the reliability of industry registrations. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to a sector plan and NVWA enforcement, and stated that industry registrations show about 200 calves per week euthanised, with the photographed dead calves being illustrative only.
I will still study the plan, but I am mainly pleased that these sectors are taking their joint responsibility here and have come up with an integrated action plan.
Ik ga het plan nog bestuderen maar ik ben vooral blij dat deze sectoren hier hun gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid nemen en zijn gekomen met een integraal plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de massale wetsovertredingen tijdens diertransporten naar Turkije

An MP asked the State Secretary about reported systematic violations of EU animal transport rules on live animal transports to Turkey, including Dutch carriers, and whether the NVWA would act and whether the Netherlands would end or time-limit such transports. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, said the NVWA can investigate Dutch carriers and an ongoing investigation will be reported on, and said unilateral national limits are not possible but that he will push the EU to ban slaughter-animal transports longer than 8 hours and to press Turkey on border conditions.
The investigation into this is still ongoing. Once this investigation is concluded I will inform you of the outcome.
Het onderzoek hierover is nog lopende. Als dit onderzoek is afgerond zal ik u over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie jarenlang te makkelijk nieuwe bestrijdingsmiddelen heeft toegelaten

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's lax approval of pesticides, flagged by the European Ombudsman, endangers health and environment and what the Netherlands will do about it, including holding producers liable. The State Secretary answered that there is no reason to believe safety is at risk, that the Ctgb assessed the confirmatory data positively, that the Commission has accepted the Ombudsman's recommendations, and that no further tightening of authorisation policy is currently needed.
I consider this ruling a reason to tighten the current procedures.
Ik vind deze uitspraak aanleiding om de huidige procedures aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Krijgt vermeende subsidiefraude in vissector toch een strafrechtelijk staartje’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about alleged subsidy fraud in the fisheries sector (the Van Rijsingen fish-farming subsidy), high error rates in EU fisheries subsidies, recovery of funds, conflicts of interest and the Topteam Agri & Food. The State Secretary answered that no evidence of fraud was found, that recovery follows legal principles and EU rules, that the Auditdienst Rijk and Algemene Rekenkamer oversee the process, and that the Topteam members are appointed in a personal capacity with safeguards against conflicts of interest.
I have no indications that there is fraud here.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat er hier sprake is van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over het bericht ‘Gedumpte hangbuikzwijntjes afgeschoten in Hoenderloo’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the shooting of dumped potbellied piglets in Hoenderloo, asking why no animal-capture experts were used, who requested and approved the killing, and what action would be taken against the dumpers and to prevent such treatment. The government answered that police expertise was used, Staatsbosbeheer requested removal on safety and welfare grounds, three piglets were caught and two shot after capture failed, and that tracing and prosecuting the owners is for the police and Public Prosecution Service, referring to a separate letter on animal-keeping bans.
Tracing and possible prosecution of the owners of the animals in question is a matter for the police and the Public Prosecution Service.
Opsporing en eventuele rechtsvervolging van de eigenaren van betreffende dieren is een zaak van de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Van Gerven over uitbreiding van nertsenhouderijen en bont

MPs Van Dekken and Van Gerven asked why Zeeland provincial authorities allowed mink farm expansion despite the Fur Farming Ban, how enforcement works, and how consumers can identify real versus synthetic fur labelling. The State Secretary answered that municipalities cannot refuse permits on this ground, the ban prohibits starting or expanding mink farming regardless of permits, enforcement is initiated by municipalities and cassation is pending, and that EU labelling changes are unlikely while the Commission is reluctant.
The Fur Farming Ban Act prevents starting or expanding a mink farm even with an environmental permit obtained.
De Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij verhindert het starten of uitbreiden van een nertsenhouderij met de eventueel verkregen omgevingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het uitvoeren van equivalente maatregelen in het kader van het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the equivalent measures under the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme were not yet implemented for arable farming, and about the timing of the WUR study, the European Commission's response, and whether a regulation would be ready for the 2016 growing season. The State Secretary answered that the regulatory amendments are being prepared and expected to take about 6 to 9 months, that the Commission raised concerns but requires no formal approval, and that soil-improvers cannot be included due to lack of environmental evidence.
The procedures to anchor these measures in regulation will be started soon.
De procedures om deze maatregelen in regelgeving te verankeren zullen spoedig gestart worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over de situatie bij het Europees Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about the dismissal of union members who criticised conditions at the European Patent Office, the letter from the Administrative Council chair to the EPO president, and whether the Netherlands will support it. The State Secretary confirmed Dutch concern, said the Netherlands co-sponsors a draft resolution to be voted on in the Administrative Council, and reported a meeting with the EPO president that did not change his position, while declining to share the confidential letter's details.
Dit document heeft de status confidentieel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het aanbieden van jachtarrangementen in Nederland

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked whether hunting arrangements allowing foreign hunters in the Netherlands can be banned under current or new nature law, and what this would require. The state secretary replied that a legal amendment to the Wet natuurbescherming is needed, provinces currently lack such powers, and that talks with provinces and the hunters' association are ongoing.
No, introducing a ban on hunting arrangements for foreign hunters requires an amendment to the Nature Conservation Act.
Nee, voor de invoering van een verbod op jachtarrangementen voor buitenlandse jagers is een wijziging van de Wet natuurbescherming nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over hernieuwbare energie in Noordwest-Europa en regelgeving voor de visserijsector

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government to respond to a European Parliament manifesto on North Sea renewable energy and to address fishing-sector rules around offshore wind farms, including transit for vessels over 24 metres. The minister agreed to strengthen North Sea cooperation, to broaden its scope to include fisheries, and to review transit rules after a two-year trial period from 2017.

Yes. It is important that the scope of North Sea cooperation on renewable energy is broadened, integrating among other things maritime spatial planning, including the fisheries and environmental dimensions.

Ja. Het is belangrijk dat de reikwijdte van de Noordzeesamenwerking rondom hernieuwbare energie wordt verbreed, waarbij onder andere maritieme ruimtelijke ordening, inclusief de visserij- en milieudimensie, integraal wordt meegenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over toenemend onderwatergeluid door onder meer olieplatforms, scheepvaart en militaire activiteiten als oorzaak van strandende potvissen en andere walvisachtigen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether rising underwater noise from platforms, shipping and military activity contributed to the stranding of sperm whales and dolphins on the North Sea coast, and what the government is doing about it. The government answered that a causal link cannot be confirmed, that the cause of stranding is not yet known, and that it is pursuing existing permit regimes, monitoring and international initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Koolmees over het bericht dat de pachttermijn van zes jaar voor landbouwgrond te kort is

MPs Koşer Kaya and Koolmees asked about reports that six-year farm lease terms are too short to protect soil fertility in Flevoland and elsewhere, and about lease prices, farm incomes, Rijksvastgoedbedrijf practices and possible lease discounts for sustainable soil management. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of the soil concerns, describes the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf's soil-quality checks and building plans, provides lease price and income data, and declines to introduce a lease discount while exploring a broader review of the lease system.
I am not prepared to introduce a lease discount.
Ik ben niet bereid een pachtkorting te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het toestaan van het doodschieten van konijnen, terwijl schadeonderzoek ontbreekt

An MP asks the state secretary how the government responds to a Council of State ruling that Staatsbosbeheer may not allow rabbit culling on Terschelling without adequate damage research, and how it will prevent culling decisions on an insufficient legal basis. The state secretary answers that Staatsbosbeheer withdrew its permission, that the responsible bodies will take the ruling's interpretation of article 65 of the Flora- en faunawet into account, and that the new Wet natuurbescherming will require approved fauna management plans based on population counts.

The Division noted in this ruling that the law requires, as one of the conditions for this exemption, that the land user can demonstrate that they are trying to prevent significant damage at the moment they act.

De Afdeling heeft in deze uitspraak erop gewezen dat uit de wet volgt dat één van de voorwaarden waaronder deze vrijstelling geldt is dat de grondgebruiker kan aantonen dat hij belangrijke schade tracht te voorkomen op het moment dat hij optreedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Koser Kaya over het suikergehalte in drinkpakjes voor kinderen

MPs Dijkstra and Koşer Kaya asked about Foodwatch findings that children's drink cartons contain more sugar than Coca-Cola, the child-targeted marketing of these products, and whether the 2020 sugar-reduction target is adequate. The minister points to the Product Composition Agreement, a stepwise approach to sugar reduction, EU-level action, and existing health education programmes, without committing to a stricter target.
A stepwise approach is needed to achieve sustainable results, both because of consumer taste adaptation and because of feasibility for industry.
Een stapsgewijze aanpak is nodig om duurzaam resultaat te behalen, zowel vanwege smaakgewenning bij de consument als vanwege haalbaarheid voor het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Çegerek over het feit dat de geloofwaardigheid van keurmerken onder druk staat

MPs Dikkers and Çegerek asked the State Secretary about the ACM finding that eco-label credibility is undermined by proliferation and unclear meaning, and whether government should define criteria and coordinate a framework. The State Secretary referred to his earlier letter, declined to set criteria himself but invited parties to act on ACM and Milieu Centraal recommendations, and noted an agreement to achieve an ordering of robust sustainability labels by end 2016.
I therefore do not consider it reasonable for the government to formulate the requirements itself.
Ik vind het dan ook niet in de rede liggen om vanuit de overheid de eisen te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Houwers over de circulaire economie

Representative Houwers asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs about circular economy measures: phosphate recovery pilots in the Achterhoek, research on crop phosphate uptake and on reduced phosphate fertiliser use, recycled phosphate markets, other scarce nutrients, compost from household waste, nutrient synergies between sewage sludge and organic waste, and ammonia scrubber certification. The state secretary answered largely by describing existing research, regulations and sector developments, declining to add a new pilot site, and referring some matters to other ministries or to a forthcoming letter.
No, there is currently no room to add a company to the mineral concentrate pilot.
Nee, er is momenteel geen ruimte om een bedrijf toe te voegen aan de pilot mineralenconcentraat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Graus over het bericht “Weer dode potvissen gezien bij Texel”

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether electromagnetic radiation from undersea power cables could disturb whale navigation, whether this is considered in new cable permits, and whether it will be included in the investigation into stranded sperm whales. The state secretary replied that research has not shown that such cables cause measurable effects on marine mammals, that stranding causes remain unknown, and that the cause of death is generally suffocation under their own weight.
It is noted that it is not known that magnetic fields from undersea power cables cause demonstrable effects on marine mammals.
Geconstateerd wordt dat het niet bekend is dat magnetische velden van onderzeese stroomkabels aantoonbare effecten veroorzaken op zeezoogdieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over drugsafval in landbouwakkers

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about drug waste dumped in farmland and gierkelders, including health risks, soil contamination, cost of cleanup, and enforcement capacity. The minister answered that detected amphetamine/MDMA levels pose no health danger, that no evidence yet shows dumping at other farms, that cleanup costs fall on polluters or landowners with a €1 million annual national fund for provinces, and that Intensivering Zuid strengthens anti-drug enforcement in Brabant.
Strong efforts are therefore being made to combat drug crime and the dumping of drug waste.
Er wordt dan ook stevig ingezet op het bestrijden van drugscriminaliteit en dumping van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Bergkamp over de vondst van MDMA-resten van XTC-productie in maïsplanten

MPs Koşer Kaya and Bergkamp asked about MDMA residues from ecstasy production found in maize plants on a Someren farm, including risks, NVWA oversight, police cooperation and whether regulation of the market would reduce risk. The state secretary replied that the detected levels pose no health risk, outlined the division of responsibilities between police, municipality and NVWA, and rejected market regulation from a public health perspective.
If the situation gives cause for it, as also happened in this specific case, the NVWA is called in.
Als de situatie daar aanleiding voor geeft, zoals ook in dit specifieke geval is gebeurd, wordt de NVWA ingeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya, Verhoeven, Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Bontkragen van kinderjassen vol schadelijk gif’

D66 MPs asked whether mislabelling of fur-trimmed children's jackets and possible toxic substances warranted action, and whether the NVWA should have flagged the issue proactively. The minister said labelling rules are already set at EU level, toxic levels were below legal norms per NVWA and RIVM, and a formal NVWA risk assessment is pending with advice expected end of March.
I have asked the NVWA to have its risk assessment of the Kassa research reviewed by the RIVM.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht haar risico-inschatting van het onderzoek van Kassa te laten toetsen door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘NVV, NVP en NMV stappen uit overleg PAS met ministerie van Economische Zaken’

MP Lodders asks why the agricultural unions NVV, NVP and NMV walked out of PAS talks with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and why a reserve package of generic measures was kept from the sector until late 2015 and not in the 2015 covenant. The State Secretary says the unions broke off the process before the planned spring 2016 administrative meeting, that the reserve package was only developed after the covenant, and that the covenant commitments on emissions and deposition space will be honoured, with a PAS progress report promised for April 2016.
I intend to inform the House in April of this year about the progress of the PAS.
Ik ben voornemens de Kamer in april van dit jaar te informeren over de voortgang van de PAS.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Veel fouten bij uitgaven EU-subsidies voor platteland’, de ‘Verdeling nationale envelop Europese middelen melkvee- en varkenshouderij.’ en de EU-trendrapportage va

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that most EU rural-development spending errors occur in rural and regional funds (estimated error rate 6.2%, against a 2% target), about the Court of Audit's EU trend report, and about how the national dairy and pig envelope is justified to the Commission. The State Secretary answered that the error rate is slightly declining, that error rates do not necessarily mean unlawful spending, that the Netherlands will push for the trend to continue, and that effectiveness and efficiency accountability is being developed under the Commission's Budget for Results agenda.
I will ask for attention to continuing the trend and further reducing the error rate in the Rural Development Committee.
Ik zal aandacht vragen voor het doorzetten van de trend en verdere verlaging van het foutenpercentage in het kader van het Plattelandscomité.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over nieuwe technieken om genetisch gemodificeerde organismen (ggo’s) te ontwikkelen

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about new gene-editing techniques for GMOs, including whether they fall under GMO rules, whether labelling should apply, whether they will be linked to pesticides, and when a national framework for GMO cultivation will be available. The State Secretary answered that the techniques are currently treated as genetic modification pending a European Commission legal analysis, that labelling applies until the techniques are listed in Annex IB, that the techniques are not inherently tied to herbicide use, and that a Rathenau Institute consultation report will inform a national framework.
The Rathenau Institute is preparing a report on this consultation and on that basis I will inform you further about the framework for decision-making on GM cultivation.
Het Rathenau Instituut stelt een rapport op van deze consultatie en op basis daarvan zal ik u nader informeren over het afwegingskader voor besluitvorming over gg-teelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Boer en adviseur vissen achter subsidienet

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a report claiming agricultural subsidies mostly go to research institutes rather than farmers, and whether subsidies for sustainable farm investment have declined since 2012. The State Secretary disputes the report's completeness, notes that most farm subsidies are EU income support and that about 80% of ministry agricultural subsidies go to innovation and research, reports that rijkssubsidies were cut after 2012 with provinces taking over co-financing, and declines to bring forward evaluations or a subsidy-efficiency study.
I see no reason to bring these evaluations forward.
Ik zie geen reden om deze evaluaties naar voren te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Dijkgraaf en Geurts over de controle op de aanlandplicht

MPs Visser, Dijkgraaf and Geurts asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a confrontation between Dutch North Sea fishers and German inspectors over the landing obligation and reported widespread ignorance among inspectors. The State Secretary replied that German protocols matched EU rules, that Germany acted quickly, and that harmonisation of enforcement across North Sea states is ongoing but slow.
I have asked the other North Sea member states to share their inspection instructions more widely with one another.
Ik heb de andere lidstaten rondom de Noordzee verzocht om de controle-instructies breder met elkaar te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Bureaucratie verdrijft jacht uit Groene Hart’

An MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs about conflict between nature conservationists, farmers and hunters over the Natura 2000 management plan for De Wilck, and whether new administrative requirements (dynamic zone, prior notification, post-hunt reporting) are unworkable and contrary to the Wet natuurbescherming and the Heerema/Leenders amendment. The secretary replies that the plan balances hunting and nature goals, is limited in scope and workable, and that the requirements are set by the competent authorities (provincial executive and himself), not Staatsbosbeheer.
In my view, these additional requirements are limited in scope and workable.
Naar mijn oordeel zijn deze aanvullende eisen beperkt van omvang en goed werkbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Houwers over gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about biological soil disinfection pilots, procedures for new active substances, metam-sodium rules, purification of greenhouse wastewater, fertiliser buffer zones, glyphosate reassessment and research on soil reset. The government answered each question, describing ongoing research, approval procedures, existing restrictions and pilots, and declined to shift purification costs to society.
I do not consider it desirable that these costs would be passed on to society.
Ik vind het niet gewenst dat deze kosten zouden worden doorbelast aan de maatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over misleiding bij voedselproducten door supermarkten

An MP asked the ministers whether supermarkets misleading consumers on food labels (e.g. diluted juice priced above full juice) is known, what sanctions apply, and what instruments exist to enforce labelling rules. The minister answered that the NVWA assesses case by case, warnings and fines are available, no fines were recently issued for juice labelling, and a plan of action on labelling is promised for spring 2016.
Furthermore, I have committed to come up with an action plan in spring 2016 on the basis of this research and the NVWA's experience regarding food labelling.
Daarnaast heb ik u toegezegd op basis van dit onderzoek en de ervaringen van de NVWA voor wat betreft etikettering van voedingsmiddelen in het voorjaar van 2016 met een plan van aanpak te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Uitbraak Zikavirus: miljoenen besmettingen verwacht’ en ‘Experts waarschuwen: Zikavirus deze zomer in Zuid-Europa’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports of Zika virus outbreaks and the risk of spread to the Netherlands, including mosquito control, pregnancy advice and wetland effects. The minister answered that Aedes mosquitoes cannot establish in Europe, that monitoring by RIVM and WHO continues, and that a RIVM/NVWA policy advice on native mosquitoes is delayed to around March 2016.
As soon as I have received this policy advice, I will send it to the House of Representatives.
Zodra ik dit beleidsadvies ontvangen heb zal ik deze de Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Dit is wat teveel energiedrank met je lichaam doet’

MPs Koşer Kaya and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister how consumers, including minors, can learn from energy drink packaging that heavy consumption may cause serious health effects, and whether labelling and corporate responsibility are adequate. The minister replied that mandatory high-caffeine warnings already apply under EU rules, that industry's voluntary code adds further labelling and marketing limits, and that the government promotes information via the Voedingscentrum and school programmes.
Yes, see answer 2. In addition, I am focusing, for example, via the Voedingscentrum and school programmes on targeted information about healthy and unhealthy food
Ja, zie antwoord 2. Daarnaast zet ik bijvoorbeeld via het Voedingscentrum en schoolprogramma's in op gerichte voorlichting over gezonde en ongezonde voeding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het bericht ”Bron drinkwater deel Randstad vervuild met gif”

MP Grashoff asked the ministers about reports that dimethoate contaminated the source water for drinking water in the Randstad, the health risks to residents, support for the Waterschap Rivierenland investigation, cost recovery from polluters, and additional agricultural measures under the Water Framework Directive. The minister answered that residents faced no health risk because intake was halted and treatment removes such substances, that the water board is responsible for the source investigation with Rijkswaterstaat offering help, that cost recovery powers exist but cannot yet be confirmed, and that no new agricultural measures beyond the existing policy are planned unless targets are missed.
They have not run any health risks.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Hachchi over de vervuiling van een drinkwaterbron in Zuid-Holland

MPs Koşer Kaya and Hachchi (D66) asked about pesticide pollution of a drinking water source in Zuid-Holland, including incident frequency, substances and health risks, and what support and enforcement measures exist against the polluter. The minister answered that pesticide norm exceedances cause near-annual intake stops at several Maas and Lekkanaal intake points, that the source lies in the Bommelerwaard under the Waterschap Rivierenland's responsibility, and that the waterschap has administrative enforcement tools, with Rijkswaterstaat offering help.
The Waterschap Rivierenland has administrative enforcement instruments available to address the discharge in the Bommelerwaard.
Het Waterschap Rivierenland heeft voor de aanpak van de lozing in de Bommelerwaard bestuurlijke handhavingsinstrumenten tot haar beschikking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over de gevolgen van het Besluit huisvesting

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked why small extensions of traditional barns were not exempted from the new emission requirements in the final Besluit huisvesting, and whether the government will consult the sector on exempting them. The State Secretary confirmed the change from the draft was made after consultation, explained that traditional barns cannot use the alternative, and promised to check the reported problems with the sector and consider adjusting the technical requirements in the leaflets.
I will consult with the sector to see whether they have proposals for amending these leaflets
Ik zal in overleg met de sector na gaan of zij wijzigingsvoorstellen hebben voor deze leaflets
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de verspreiding van een besmettelijke konijnenziekte via de jacht

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether the rabbit disease VHD, which killed tame and wild rabbits, threatens wild rabbit populations and whether rabbit hunting should be halted to prevent spread. The state secretary answered that the impact on wild rabbits is unknown, that hunting may spread the virus but stopping it would have little effect given other routes, and that a temporary hunting ban is not considered useful.
A (temporary) ban on rabbit hunting is therefore not considered meaningful by me.
Een (tijdelijk) verbod op de konijnenjacht acht ik dan ook niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het ontstaan van een winstgevende industrie rondom het doden van ganzen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether a commercial goose-shooting industry for foreign hunters, and Friesland's request to allow sale of shot geese, reflects a flawed goose policy and whether alternatives should be promoted. The State Secretary defended the legal framework and provincial control, rejected commercial hunting trips, and committed to consult provinces and the hunters' association on ending such practices.
I disapprove of organising commercial hunting trips and the associations this evokes.
Het organiseren van commerciële jachtreizen en de associaties die dit oproept keur ik af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het aanbieden van jachtarrangementen in Nederland

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about websites advertising goose hunting in the Netherlands for foreign hunters, and how the Nature Conservation Act and related rules allow, condition and control such visits. The government answered that foreign hunters may hunt under a time-limited guest permit only when accompanied by a Dutch licence holder and with landowner or wildlife-unit permission, and it said it will consult provinces and the hunters' association on ending commercial hunting trips.
I disapprove of organising commercial hunting trips and the associations this raises. I will therefore consult with the provinces and the Royal Hunters Association about ending such practices.

Het organiseren van commerciële jachtreizen en de associaties die dit oproept keur ik af. Ik zal daarom met provincies en de Koninklijke Jagersvereniging in overleg treden over de beëindiging van dergelijke praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het mishandelen van merries en hun ongeboren veulens voor de productie van hormoonmiddelen voor de Europese en Nederlandse zuivel- en vleesindustrie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about horse mistreatment in the production of PMSG fertility hormone used in dairy and livestock industries, and about import chains, veterinary hormone use and a possible ban. The government answered that the product is authorised under EU rules, that animal welfare is not a Good Manufacturing Practice criterion but will be raised when those rules are updated, and that a WUR study on hormone use is expected in spring.
I will therefore raise the criterion of animal welfare when the Good Manufacturing Practice requirements are updated.
Ik zal daarom het criterium van dierenwelzijn aan de orde stellen, wanneer de eisen van Good Manufacturing Practice worden geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Vlaamse minister Ben Weyts de Nederlandse aanpak van de malafide puppyhandel te laks vindt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports that Flemish minister Weyts considers Dutch enforcement against puppy trafficking too lax, including the claimed 50,000 unregistered dogs imported in 2014, possible whitelists and enforcement capacity. The government disputes the trend claim, points to existing measures and EU cooperation, and promises an evaluation of measures in spring 2016 to decide on further steps.
Your House will receive the evaluation presumably in the spring.
Uw Kamer ontvangt de evaluatie naar verwachting in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Garnalenvisser in clinch met overheid’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that a shrimp fisher faces restrictions because his environmentally friendly catch method conflicts with current rules, and what the government will do to help him. The State Secretary said the company's exemption request was incomplete and is being assessed, that innovation will be accommodated where possible, but that an exemption requires careful analysis and may be limited by directly applicable EU rules.
Of course I want to offer room for meaningful innovations. We are studying the request and will give room for it where possible.
Uiteraard wil ik zinvolle innovaties ruimte bieden. We bestuderen het verzoek en zullen als het mogelijk is daartoe ruimte geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Bergkamp over mesthuwelijken

MPs Koşer Kaya and Bergkamp asked whether limiting transfer of the dairy phosphate reference to relatives in the first to third degree forces farms to shrink, whether it encourages sham marriages or adoptions, and how this fits modern family forms. The government replied that the limit already applies since 1 January 2015 under the Fertilisers Act, does not force shrinkage but may raise manure-processing costs, follows the Dutch civil code definition of blood and affinal relatives, and that it has no concrete signals of 'manure marriages' or problematic adoptions.
I have no concrete signals of the occurrence of so-called manure marriages.
Ik heb geen concrete signalen over het voorkomen van zogenaamde mesthuwelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Van Gerven over de uitbreiding van nertsenhouders

MPs Van Dekken and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about mink farms expanding after the Fur Farming Ban was suspended and about video showing mink being thrown and kicked into a gas chamber, including inspection frequency and a promised independent-offence measure. The government said it is still consulting the Public Prosecution Service, that inspections are unannounced but mink-killing dates are reported in advance, that cameras cannot be mandated, and that a policy response on a standalone ban will follow soon.
At present I am still consulting the Public Prosecution Service about the consequences of this ruling for enforcement.
Op dit moment ben ik nog in overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie over de gevolgen van deze uitspraak voor de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het gooien van jonge nertsen in gaskisten

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether a Rosmalen fur farm treated mink cruelly, whether it should be closed as a notorious offender, and when a permanent fur-farming ban would be added to the Criminal Code. The government reported two welfare inspections showing no violations, four NVWA inspections in five years with one fine, found no basis to call the firm a notorious offender, and promised the evaluation and policy response of the criminal ban to Parliament soon.
Actively making the inspection results of an individual company public is currently not possible.
Het actief openbaar maken van de inspectieresultaten van een individueel bedrijf is op dit moment niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de implicaties van het bericht volgend jaar op meer wegen 130 kilometer per uur

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the 2016 raise of speed limits to 130 km/h on motorways was justified given extra nitrogen and CO2 emissions, how PAS nitrogen headroom is monitored, and how Urgenda and emissions data were considered. The government answered that the PAS already accounts for the 130 km/h limit, that the increase is part of existing policy, that monitoring and evaluation are planned, and that it does not expect new NO2 exceedances.
With the annual monitoring of the NSL, however, the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment keeps a close eye on the situation.
Met de jaarlijkse monitoring van het NSL houdt de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu echter een vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over ‘de manipulatie van de natuurstatistieken van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretaries whether the PBL's biodiversity indicator (MSA) and its graph presentation give a skewed picture of Dutch nature, and whether investments in nature can be measured per euro. The government defended the MSA as an international instrument used for long-term and cross-regional comparison, pointed to the PBL's independent supervisory committee, and referred to existing technical documentation and evaluations, without committing to new action.
In addition, an advisory committee of the PBL made up of independent members is responsible for supervising the scientific quality and social relevance of the planning agency's work.

Daarnaast is een uit onafhankelijke leden bestaande Begeleidingscommissie van het PBL verantwoordelijk voor toezicht op de wetenschappelijke kwaliteit en de maatschappelijke relevantie van het werk van het planbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Geurts over de heffing van btw op subsidies voor rietlandbeheerders in de Weerribben en Wieden

Two MPs asked whether the government will help secure a VAT-free subsidy arrangement for reed-land managers in the Weerribben and Wieden after a tax inspector ruled them VAT-liable. The Secretary of State confirmed the ruling, said the arrangement cannot avoid VAT under EU rules as proposed, and pointed to alternative structures (a collective or a combined entity) and possible amendment of the provincial subsidy scheme while giving no firm commitment to a specific fix.

Within the framework of laws and regulations there is willingness to look, on a proposal from the parties involved, at a sector proposal for reed-land management under which no VAT is levied on the reed-land managers.

Binnen het kader van wet- en regelgeving bestaat de bereidheid om op voorstel van betrokken partijen te kijken naar een voorstel van de sector om te komen tot rietlandbeheer waarbij geen heffing van btw plaatsvindt bij de rietlandbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het inspectierapport van Eyes on Animals over paardenmarkten

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an Eyes on Animals inspection report on horse markets, including welfare concerns, transport times, body condition assessment, and night-time NVWA enforcement. The State Secretary acknowledged the welfare risks, said no ban is planned, and promised to revise the horse market protocol, tighten NVWA supervision and export rules, while describing existing inspection staffing and the body condition scoring method.

I will consult with the Horse Sector Council and other stakeholders, including the Animal Protection Society and Eyes on Animals, to consider how the horse market protocol should be revised and tightened.

Ik zal in overleg met de Sectorraad Paarden en de andere stakeholders, waaronder de Dierenbescherming en Eyes on Animals, bezien op welke wijze het paardenmarktenprotocol dient te worden herzien en te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de ingrediënten die aan wijn worden toegevoegd

An MP asked the ministers about additives in wine after a consumer programme, and why wine is exempt from full ingredient labelling. The ministers said EU rules allow certain winemaking processes and exempt drinks above 1.2% alcohol from ingredient labelling, and that they await a Commission report before deciding on mandatory labelling.
As regards possible future mandatory listing of ingredients on alcoholic drinks, I am awaiting the Commission's report.
Voor wat betreft een eventuele toekomstige verplichte vermelding van de ingrediënten op alcoholische dranken wacht ik het verslag van de Commissie af
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de verkoop van wildklemmen en vangnetten

An MP asked whether the online sale of gin traps and nets for protected mammals and birds, and their use, is illegal and how the government will act against it. The State Secretary answered that such non-selective traps are prohibited under the Flora- and faunawet, that possession outside buildings is banned, and that the law does not prohibit trading them, though carrying one outside without an exemption is punishable.
Against that background, the Flora- and faunawet does not provide for a ban on trading these devices.
Tegen die achtergrond voorziet de Flora- en faunawet niet in een verbod op het verhandelen van deze middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het nieuwsbericht “Kampen denkt na over extra bypass naast Reevediep”

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the government accepts that Overijssel and Kampen are seeking alternatives to a navigable Reevediep after the Council of State ruled it may not be a through shipping route, and about related zoning annulment. The minister answered that recreational shipping is part of an integrated area development, that the channel's construction does not depend on a shipping route, and that no concrete bypass plan yet exists.
As far as I am aware, there is (as yet) no concrete plan.
Voor zover mij bekend is er (nog) geen sprake van een concreet plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over bouwen in de duinen

An MP from D66 asked how the planned removal of the general ban on new building outside built-up areas in the coastal zone fits with the Van Veldhoven amendment on protecting landscape values, and whether coastal provinces plan to designate their coast as provincial landscape. The minister answered that provinces may pursue landscape policy under the new Nature Conservation Act and that it is not yet clear whether coastal provinces will designate their coast.
Under the draft amendment to the General Rules for Spatial Planning Decree (Barro), provinces and municipalities can pursue policy in the coastal area in the interest of spatial quality.

Ingevolge het ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit algemene regels ruimtelijke ordening (Barro) kunnen provincies en gemeenten in het belang van de ruimtelijke kwaliteit beleid voeren in het kustgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over de lange afstandstransporten van kalveren
