MPs asked the State Secretary about long-distance calf transports, including reported welfare problems, the number of animals and violations, and whether maximum transport times should be tightened. The government answered that it lacks centralized data on health complaints and violation types, has stopped certifying export of unweaned calves over long distances since December 2015 because vehicles do not meet EU requirements, and has commissioned Wageningen UR research on conditions for such transport.
I am not aware of any figures on complaints regarding the health or possible mortality of the animals imported.
Er zijn mij geen aantallen bekend van klachten met betrekking tot de gezondheid of eventuele sterfte van de dieren die aangevoerd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over Gelderland megastallenland

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the growth of mega-stables in Gelderland, the number of applications, monitoring, and a promised law letting authorities cap stable sizes on public health grounds. The State Secretary reported rising numbers of large stables, said that permit applications are handled by provinces and municipalities and that the central government does not track them, declined to monitor numbers structurally, and promised to inform the House in early 2016 on the proposed animal numbers law.
Applications for permits to build new stables are submitted under spatial planning, environmental and nature legislation for which municipalities and provinces are the competent authority.

Aanvragen voor vergunningen voor de bouw van nieuwe stallen worden ingediend in het kader van de wetgeving op het vlak van ruimtelijke ordening, milieu en natuur waarvoor gemeenten en provincies het bevoegd gezag zijn.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Thieme over hondsdolheid bij vossen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether culling foxes, which the reporting suggests creates vacancies refilled from neighbouring countries carrying rabies, is counterproductive, and whether the fox should be removed from the national exemption list. The State Secretary answers that rabies cases in the Netherlands were all acquired abroad, that Dutch and Belgian foxes are rabies-free, that the risk of infected foxes entering is negligible, and that no reason is seen to remove the fox from the list.
In view of the answers given to questions 2, 3 and 4, I see no reason to remove the fox from the national exemption list.
Gelet op de antwoorden gegeven op de vragen 2, 3 en 4, zie ik geen aanleiding om de vos van de landelijke vrijstellingslijst te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Krijgt vermeende subsidiefraude in vissector toch een strafrechtelijk staartje’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about alleged subsidy fraud in the fisheries sector, whether subsidies were recovered, why no criminal complaint was filed, the error rate in EU fisheries subsidies, recovery policy, OLAF findings, and sustainability conditions. The State Secretary answered that recovery was not pursued in the specific case for reasons of legal certainty, no criminal indications were found, error rates were revised to 22.2%, and remedial measures were deemed sufficient by the European Commission.
I have no indications that there are criminal offences here.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat er hier sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de erbarmelijke situatie van olifant Carla bij Circus Renz Berlin

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the conditions of elephant Carla at Circus Renz Berlin, citing expert concerns about housing, welfare, possible hook injuries, and the slow NVWA response, and asks for seizure and an expert-accompanied inspection. The State Secretary answers that the NVWA inspected on 14 December with a veterinarian and an external elephant expert, found no violations of the Animal Act, so there is no reason to seize the animal, rejects the claim that Carla is a needy animal, and explains that the earlier 2014 inspection was timed to the start of the tour.
During the inspection no violations of the Animal Act were found.
Tijdens de inspectie zijn geen overtredingen van de Wet Dieren vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over elektronische monitoring van ammoniak

MP Lodders (VVD) asked why the government will not grant pig farmers a few months' delay in mandatory electronic monitoring of ammonia scrubbers, given their financial distress and sector revitalisation effort, and whether the Minister would stop new measures. The State Secretary refused the delay, saying it would reward non-compliance with long-known rules, while pointing to the sector's structural problems, a 30 million euro EU support envelope and ongoing dialogue on reducing regulatory burden without compromising environmental standards.

Even though the request would be broadly supported, it is a wrong signal to reward, a few weeks before the end of the transition period, those who did not prepare for new regulations that have been known for a long time.

Ondanks dat het verzoek breed gedragen zou zijn, is het een verkeerd signaal om enkele weken voor het einde van de overgangstermijn degenen te belonen zich niet hebben voorbereid op nieuwe regelgeving die al geruime tijd bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over een vergunningsaanvraag voor een megastal in Dinkelland

MPs Van Dekken and Leenders ask the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a permit application for a large pig farm in Dinkelland, including whether the municipality can block it given its own land-use vision, grandfathering and salvage rules, the PAS nitrogen scheme, and what residents, the municipality, province or national government can still do. The government answers that the municipality and province are competent for land-use and the permit was handled under PAS transitional law, that the 2013 vision could not alone bar the farm under provincial rules, and that residents retain ordinary legal remedies while no national interest warrants a directive.
The Programme for Addressing Nitrogen (PAS) has no consequences for this case because the application for the Nature Conservation Act permit was submitted before 1 July 2015.
Het Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) heeft geen gevolgen voor deze casus omdat de aanvraag voor de Natuurbeschermingswetvergunning was ingediend vóór 1 juli 2015
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bejagen en serveren van beschermde zwanen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a restaurant serving shot protected swans lacks the required permit, whether the Zuid-Holland permit allows commercial use, and about damage figures, shooting numbers and alternatives. The State Secretary answered that provinces make their own permit decisions within legal limits, that the Zuid-Holland permit does not allow commercial use or consumption, and that the figures must be obtained from the province.
The requested factual data can be obtained from the province of Zuid-Holland.
De gevraagde feitelijke gegevens zijn te verkrijgen bij de provincie Zuid-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de brand op Chemiepark Chemelot

An MP asked the state secretary about a fire at Chemelot chemical park, its cause, health effects, whether safety rules were met and enforced, and whether incidents there are above average. The answer says no casualties occurred, the cause is not yet known pending the operator's and external reports, RIVM found no health concern though local nuisance occurred, the permits were in order and the site was inspected, and inspection frequency will be raised in 2016.
I am awaiting the results of the ongoing investigations. Your House will be informed of the outcomes of those investigations as promised.
Ik wacht de resultaten van de lopende onderzoeken af. Uw Kamer wordt zoals toegezegd over de uitkomsten van die onderzoeken geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts inzake het vergoeden van telers bij plantenziekten naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Onderzoek bruinrot rozen uitgebreid’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the NVWA's handling of brown rot (Ralstonia solanacearum) in rose cultivation, including the slow pace toward eradication orders, whether growers should be compensated for costly destruction of plants, and the need for a plant health scheme. The State Secretary explained the NVWA's investigation steps and timelines, stated that compensation under Article 4 of the Plantenziektenwet is only granted in exceptional cases which do not apply here, and said he is intensively negotiating a plant health convenant and possible risk-coverage fund with the sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over aanscherping van mestregels van GlobalGap

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether GlobalGap's plan to restrict use of untreated animal manure would substantially raise costs for (organic) arable farmers, conflict with agricultural and manure policy, and whether the ministry would intervene and how competition law applies. The government answered that the measure is a market-initiated food safety precaution, that the ministry has no seat or advisory role in the platform, that the platform should address the issue, and that the ACM can act on abuse of market power.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs has no seat here and also no advisory role.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken heeft hier geen zitting en heeft ook geen adviserende rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dik-Faber inzake het Wob-verzoek over zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Jacobi and Dik-Faber asked why the Minister had not yet answered a Wob (freedom of information) request on salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, which was more than five months old. The Minister replied that the information was provided on 18 November 2015, after an inventory of 558 documents required considerable review and coordination.
The Wob request submitted on 29 May 2015 was picked up immediately at the time.
Het op 29 mei 2015 ingediende Wob-verzoek is indertijd direct opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de ethische aanvaardbaarheid van het houden van dieren in dolfinaria

Thieme (PvdD) asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether dolphinaria should be banned in the Netherlands given closures abroad, animal welfare reports and a Loro Parque breeding plan involving the wild-born orca Morgan. The State Secretary declines a ban, says the Dolfinarium Harderwijk treats its dolphins responsibly and is inspected by the NVWA, and promises to answer the Free Morgan Foundation letter soon.
No. The Dolfinarium in Harderwijk treats the dolphins responsibly, including during training.
Nee. Het Dolfinarium in Harderwijk gaat op verantwoorde wijze om met de dolfijnen, ook tijdens de trainingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het overdragen van de melkveefosfaatreferentie aan opvolgers in de eerste, tweede of derde graad en wijzigen van de rechtsvorm van de onderneming

MP Geurts (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the dairy phosphate reference should remain transferable to heirs in the first to third degree of kinship even when the farm's legal form changes, and whether transfer to third parties could be broadened. The State Secretary answered that transfer within kinship is permitted, including via a partnership, but that the reference is lost on transfer to non-relatives or a legal entity, and declined to broaden transferability because of the policy aim and state aid concerns.
No, for the reasons given in the answers to the previous questions, in particular the answer to question 4.
Nee, vanwege de redenen zoals deze in de antwoorden op de voorgaande vragen en dan met name in het antwoord op vraag 4 zijn gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders over het bericht ‘Uitleg over de discardban’

MPs Visser and Lodders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about fishing-sector uncertainty over the landing obligation (discard ban) from 1 January 2016 and about NVWA statements that it would not disclose enforcement strategy in advance. The State Secretary replied that a step-by-step plan and information sessions provide clarity, that the NVWA's enforcement details are not disclosed in advance as usual, and that the NVWA engages constructively with the sector.
It is not customary to provide information about this in advance.
Het is niet gebruikelijk dat hierover vooraf informatie wordt verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht dat visverwerkers oude vis oplappen met verboden middelen met waterstofperoxide

MP Koşer Kaya asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers whether fish processors use banned hydrogen peroxide agents to disguise old fish, and why the NVWA did not detect it. Minister Schippers replied that the NVWA cannot confirm the practice but will pay more attention to it, that hydrogen peroxide is lawful as a processing aid, and that she cannot rule out unsafe fish reaching consumers pending NVWA investigation.
The NVWA cannot confirm this suspicion, but takes the signal seriously and will pay attention to it during inspections.
De NVWA kan dit vermoeden niet bevestigen, maar neemt het signaal wel serieus en besteedt hier bij de controles aandacht aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het gebruik van het middel Mucusol door visverwerkers

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health whether the NVWA had knowingly allowed Mucusol, a disinfectant, to be used as a fish de-slimming agent in 2008-2009 and why enforcement only started in 2016. The Minister answered that the NVWA has no inspection data showing improper use, that use as a de-slimming agent is permitted, and that the NVWA will check for misuse in regular inspections, without giving a full account of past decisions.
I have no reason to assume that the NVWA did not act correctly in this case.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat de NVWA in deze casus niet juist zou hebben gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitspraken van het Europees Hof dat reistijd gezien moet worden als werktijd

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how the European Court ruling that travel time to and from a job counts as working time affects the NVWA food safety authority, its tariffs, inspection numbers and efficiency. The State Secretary answered that the ruling has no direct effect on the NVWA, its tariffs or its inspection volume, that the consequences will be considered in negotiations with unions, and that efficiency measures such as team reductions and regionalisation are ongoing.
The ruling in question as such has no significance for the NVWA.
De onderhavige uitspraak als zodanig heeft geen betekenis voor de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht “Foute melding claimt ruimte”

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that about 70 percent of PAS notifications in Overijssel were incorrect, incomplete or unjustified, and about the reasons, national scope, and consequences. The government attributes the errors mainly to initiators' unfamiliarity with PAS rules, says incorrect entries will be removed and corrected notifications submitted, and says controls will continue.
Responsibility for the correctness and completeness of the notification lies primarily with the submitter.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de juistheid en volledigheid van de melding ligt primair bij de indiener.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Van Dekken over de toename van het aantal kiloknallers

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the rise in supermarket 'kilo bargain' meat promotions and whether harder measures were needed. The State Secretary said such promotions are undesirable and shares concern about price pressure, but declined to verify the NGO research and pointed to the sector's sustainability agreement and voluntary commitments.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs does not conduct its own research into supermarket promotions.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken voert geen eigen onderzoek uit naar aanbiedingen van supermarkten.

m: Motie van de leden Smeulders en Van Eijs over een nationaal plan voor de transformatie van bedrijfsruimten naar woningen
Motion asks the government to draw up a national plan for converting vacant office, shop and business premises into housing and to inform the House soon.
requests the government to draw up a national transformation plan
verzoekt de regering, een nationaal transformatieplan op te stellen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 28 over opkoopbescherming
Lets municipalities require a permit before owner-occupied affordable homes are rented out, with the mayor and aldermen able to grant exemptions.
The municipal council may, in the housing ordinance, give the mayor and aldermen the power to grant exemption from that prohibition.
De gemeenteraad kan in de huisvestingsverordening aan burgemeester en wethouders de bevoegdheid geven om ontheffing van dat verbod te verlenen.
Amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over opkoopbescherming
Adds a temporary municipal regime for buy-to-let protection in the Housing Act, requiring permits for renting out certain homes after sale.
It is prohibited to rent out a dwelling in a category designated by the municipal council for housing stock composition without a permit
Het is verboden om een woonruimte behorend tot een met het oog op de samenstelling van de woonruimtevoorraad door de gemeenteraad in de huisvestingsverordening aangewezen categorie van woonruimten
Motie van het lid Van Eijs over een onderzoek naar vormen van huurprijsregulering in de vrije sector
Motion asking the government to start research into possible forms of rent regulation in the free rental sector and their effects.
requests the government to start research into possible forms of rent regulation in the free sector
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek te starten naar mogelijke vormen van huurprijsregulering in de vrije sector
Motie van het lid Van Eijs over het aanpassen van het woningverdeelsysteem ten gunste van lage middeninkomens
Asks the government to urge housing corporations to adjust allocation systems so that low middle-income households are not automatically rejected.
requests the government to make maximum efforts toward housing corporations to adjust the allocation system
verzoekt de regering, zich er richting de woningcorporaties maximaal voor in te spannen dat zij het woningverdeelsysteem zo aanpassen
Motie van het lid Van Eijs over de vrije toewijzingsruimte voor corporaties
Asks the government to propose more frequent agreements on the free allocation space of housing corporations in performance agreements.
requests the government to make a proposal on including more often agreements on the free allocation space by housing corporations in performance agreements
verzoekt de regering, een voorstel te doen over het vaker opnemen van afspraken over de vrije toewijzingsruimte door corporaties in de prestatieafspraken
Motie van het lid Van Eijs over het Versnellingshuis
Asks the government to use the Versnellingshuis as a reporting point for restrictive regulation in the circular economy, investigate reports and inform the House, and continue its funding after 2024.
requests the government to deploy the Versnellingshuis as a reporting point for restrictive regulation in the circular economy
verzoekt de regering, het Versnellingshuis in te zetten als meldpunt voor knellende regelgeving op het gebied van circulaire economie
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Eijs over uitwerken van regelgeving voor uitgebreide producentenverantwoordelijkheid
Asks the government to draft regulation for extended producer responsibility in the textile sector with recycling targets and design requirements.
requests the government to develop regulation for extended producer responsibility in the textile sector
verzoekt de regering, regelgeving uit te werken voor uitgebreide producentenverantwoordelijkheid van de textielbranche
Motie van de leden Van Eijs en Dik-Faber over het voorkomen van het verbranden van textiel
Asks the government to work toward a ban on burning textiles by explicitly defining in the national waste plan when textile suitable for recycling must not be incinerated.
requests the government to work toward a ban on burning waste
verzoekt de regering, om toe te werken naar een verbod op verbranden van afval
Motie van het lid Van Eijs over meer onaangekondigde controles bij BRZO-bedrijven
Asks the government to work toward more unannounced inspections at BRZO companies and to report the share of unannounced inspections to the House each year.
requests the government to work toward more unannounced inspections and to inform the House annually of the share of unannounced inspections

verzoekt de regering, om toe te werken naar meer onaangekondigde controles, en de Kamer jaarlijks bij de publicatie van de Staat van de Veiligheid Brzo-bedrijven te informeren over het percentage onaangekondigde inspecties
Motie van de leden Van Eijs en Dik-Faber over aanzienlijke vergroting van het aandeel innovatief gebouwde woningen
Motion asking the government to draw up a concrete plan to substantially increase the share of innovatively built homes and inform the House by spring 2021.
to draw up a concrete plan on how the share of innovatively built homes can be substantially increased in coming years.
een concreet plan uit te werken waarin staat hoe het aandeel innovatief gebouwde woningen de komende jaren aanzienlijk kan worden vergroot
Motie van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over meer ruimte voor gemeenschappelijke woonvormen
Asks the government for an improvement agenda for shared housing forms and to weigh their effects in new housing legislation.
Also requests the government to explicitly weigh the consequences for shared housing forms in new housing laws and regulations.
verzoekt de regering tevens, om bij nieuwe woonwet- en regelgeving de gevolgen voor gemeenschappelijke woonvormen nadrukkelijk mee te wegen
Motie van het lid Van Eijs over toegang voor innovatieve bouwbedrijven tot garantiefondsen
Motion asking the government to ensure innovative construction firms can access guarantee institutions such as Woonborg and BouwGarant.
to ensure, together with the relevant guarantee funds, that innovative construction firms also gain access to guarantee funds
om in samenwerking met de betreffende garantiefondsen ervoor te zorgen dat ook innovatieve bouwbedrijven toegang krijgen tot garantiefondsen
Motie van het lid Van Eijs over instellen van een transformatiebrigade
Asks the government to set up a transformation team to help municipalities convert vacant offices and shops into student and starter housing and to report to the House.
requests the government to set up a transformation team that actively maps opportunities with municipalities for converting vacant property into housing
verzoekt de regering, een transformatiebrigade in te stellen die actief met gemeentes de kansen in kaart brengt voor transformatie van leegstaand vastgoed tot woningen
Amendement van de leden Nijboer en Van Eijs ter vervanging van nr. 38 over breed verbod om te vaak verhuurd huis te adverteren met bestuurlijke boete
Lets municipalities ban platforms from advertising holiday rentals once a dwelling has reached the night limit, backed by administrative fines on providers.
may also prohibit in that housing ordinance that a service provider publishing holiday rental offers displays an offer for holiday rental

kan hij in die huisvestingsverordening tevens verbieden dat degene die een dienst verleent gericht op het publiceren van aanbiedingen voor toeristische verhuur van woonruimte een aanbieding voor toeristische verhuur toont
Amendement van de leden Nijboer en Van Eijs ter vervanging van nr. 24 over breed verbod om te vaak verhuurd huis te adverteren met bestuurlijke boete
Allows municipalities to ban platforms from advertising short-term holiday rentals of homes that have reached the night limit, with administrative fines for violations.
may also prohibit in that housing ordinance the provider of a service aimed at publishing offers for tourist rental from showing an offer
kan hij in die huisvestingsverordening tevens verbieden dat degene die een dienst verleent gericht op het publiceren van aanbiedingen voor toeristische verhuur
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Eijs ter vervanging van nr. 14 over blokkeren aanbod van te vaak verhuurd huis door platform

Lets municipalities allow platforms to block short-term rental listings for the rest of the year once a municipal night limit has been exceeded, with municipalities required to justify the limit and notify platforms.
Municipalities must further sufficiently justify in their notice to a platform that the night criterion has been exceeded.
Gemeenten moeten verder in de kennisgeving die zijn doen aan een platform voldoende motiveren dat het nachtencriterium is overschreden.
Motie van het lid Van Eijs over een onderzoek naar het potentieel prijsopdrijvende effect van toeristische verhuur
Asks the government to research the possible price-raising effect of tourist rentals on house prices and inform the House.
requests the government to conduct research into the potential price-raising effect of tourist rentals in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek te doen naar het potentiële prijsopdrijvende effect van toeristische verhuur in Nederland
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Eijs ter vervanging van nr. 13 over vermelding registratienummer door het platform
Requires digital platforms publishing short-term rental offers to show the host's registration number where municipalities have adopted the registration rule.
If the municipal council has applied the first paragraph, a digital platform publishes only offers for tourist rental of housing that show a registration number.

Indien de gemeenteraad toepassing heeft gegeven aan het eerste lid, publiceert een digitaal platform slechts aanbiedingen voor toeristische verhuur van woonruimte waarin een registratienummer als bedoeld in dat lid is vermeld.
Amendement van het lid Van Eijs over blokkeren aanbod van te vaak verhuurd huis door platform
Lets municipalities require digital platforms to block tourist rental listings for the rest of the year once a home has reached the local night limit.
that a platform blocks an offer for tourist rental for the rest of the year
dat een platform een aanbieding voor toeristische verhuur blokkeert gedurende de rest van het jaar
Amendement van het lid Van Eijs over vermelding registratienummer door het platform

Replaces a rent-tribunal fee amendment so that fees become cost-covering from the third ruling against a landlord, with a count of rulings against landlords.
provided that from the third time a landlord is the losing party, the amount is each time cost-covering
met dien verstande dat met ingang van de derde maal dat een verhuurder de in het ongelijk gestelde partij is, het bedrag telkens kostendekkend is
Motie van de leden Eijs en Koerhuis over kostendekkende leges
Asks the government to charge cost-covering leges to landlords from the third rather than fourth time they are found in the wrong.
requests the government not to charge cost-covering leges from the fourth time a landlord is found in the wrong, as in the bill, but from the third time.

verzoekt de regering niet, zoals in het wetsvoorstel is opgenomen, vanaf de vierde keer dat een verhuurder in het ongelijk is gesteld kostendekkende leges te rekenen, maar dit vanaf de derde keer te doen
Amendement van de leden Van Eijs en Koerhuis ter vervanging van nr. 12 over een gedifferentieerd tarief voor veelgebruikers in de afgelopen vijf kalenderjaren
Extends the period for raising housing-rental permit fees for repeat offenders from one calendar year to five consecutive years.
'in one calendar year' is replaced by 'in five consecutive calendar years'
wordt «in een kalenderjaar» vervangen door «in vijf achtereenvolgende kalenderjaren»
Amendement van het lid Van Eijs over een gedifferentieerd tarief voor veelgebruikers in de afgelopen vijf kalenderjaren
Amendment extending the look-back period for the differentiated housing-leges surcharge on repeat rent-overcharging landlords from one calendar year to five consecutive years.
'in one calendar year' is replaced by 'in five consecutive calendar years'.
wordt «in een kalenderjaar» vervangen door «in vijf achtereenvolgende kalenderjaren».
Amendement van de leden Van Eijs en Ronnes over gedifferentieerde en kostendekkende leges
Amendment makes the tenant-tribunal leges for landlords differentiated: after the third case a landlord loses against tenants in a calendar year, the fee becomes cost-covering (€1,400 each time).
the amount is each time cost-covering
Motie van het lid Ronnes c.s. over excessen in tijdelijke huurcontracten
Asks the government to consult municipalities, landlords and housing corporations on preventing excesses of temporary rental contracts and report the results to the House.
requests the government to quickly consult the municipalities, landlords and corporations concerned to further prevent undesirable excesses
verzoekt de regering, om spoedig met betrokken gemeenten, verhuurders en corporaties te overleggen om ongewenste excessen verder te voorkomen
Motie van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de besteding van de meeropbrengsten van de verhuurderheffing
Asks the government to examine how unexpected extra revenue from the landlord levy can be invested in the housing market, sustainability of social housing and mobility instruments.
requests the government to examine how the unforeseen additional yield of the landlord levy
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de onvoorziene meeropbrengst van de verhuurderheffing
Motie van het lid Van Eijs c.s. over het meefinancieren van de NHG-premie in de hypotheek
Asks the government to investigate how the NHG premium can stay financed within the mortgage and send a letter with a proposal.
to investigate how the NHG premium can continue to be financed within the mortgage
te onderzoeken hoe de NHG-premie meegefinancierd kan blijven worden in de hypotheek
Motie van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over een "ouderenwoonakkoord"
Asks the government to remove regulatory obstacles to senior co-housing and to agree an elderly housing accord with municipalities, housing associations and other parties.
remove any regulatory obstacles and reach an elderly housing accord
eventuele belemmeringen in regelgeving weg te nemen en te komen tot een «ouderenwoonakkoord»
Motie van het lid Koerhuis c.s. over de evaluatie van de NHG-regeling
Asks the government to complete the evaluation of the NHG mortgage guarantee scheme before the 2019 budget and consider options for lowering the NHG premium.
requests the government to complete the evaluation of the NHG scheme before submission of the 2019 budget
verzoekt de regering, de evaluatie van de NHG-regeling af te ronden voor de indiening van de begroting voor 2019
Motie van de leden Van Eijs en Ronnes over het aanpakken van huisjesmelkers
Asks the government to meet with aldermen and the LSVb on giving municipalities that want them more enforcement powers, including fines, against landlords who overcharge tenants.
requests the government to sit down as soon as possible with these aldermen and the LSVb to look at how landlords can be better tackled by giving municipalities that need it more powers

verzoekt de regering, zo snel mogelijk om de tafel te gaan met deze wethouders en de LSVb om te kijken hoe huisjesmelkers beter kunnen worden aangepakt door gemeenten die daar behoefte aan hebben meer bevoegdheden te geven
Motie van de leden Van Eijs en Dik-Faber Faber over het meenemen van ILUC in de emissieberekeningen
Asks the government to push in EU negotiations for indirect land-use change (ILUC) to be taken seriously in CO2 emission calculations for biofuels.
requests the government, in the European negotiations on revising the Renewable Energy Directive, to make every effort to take ILUC seriously
verzoekt de regering, in de Europese onderhandelingen over de herziening van de Richtlijn hernieuwbare energie zich er maximaal voor in te spannen om ILUC serieus mee te nemen
Motie van de leden Von Martels en Van Eijs over sturen op CO2-reductie van verschillende biobrandstoffen
Asks government to pursue, in renewable energy directive negotiations, the ability after 2020 to steer on CO2 reduction of different biofuels.
requests the government, in ongoing negotiations on the renewable energy directive, to pursue making it possible after 2020 to steer on CO2 reduction of different biofuels

verzoekt de regering, bij de lopende onderhandelingen over de hernieuwbare-energierichtlijn erop in te zetten dat het na 2020 mogelijk is om te sturen op CO 2 -reductie van verschillende biobrandstoffen
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over vanaf 2021 geen palmolie en soja meer gebruiken voor biobrandstoffen
Asks the government to join the EU environment committee's goal of phasing out palm oil and soy in biofuels from 2021 and to pursue other instruments.
requests the government, in European context, to align with this goal of the environment committee
verzoekt de regering in Europees verband zich aan te sluiten bij dit doel van de milieucommissie
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Eijs over beperken van zwerfafval
Asks the government to consult businesses, local authorities and NGOs and present by early 2018 a package of measures to reduce litter.
requests the government to consult the named parties with the aim of presenting to the House by early 2018 a proposal for an effective package of measures against litter
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met de genoemde partijen, met als doel begin 2018 een voorstel aan de Kamer voor te leggen voor een effectief pakket van maatregelen tegen zwerfafval
Motie van het lid Van Eijs c.s. over het nationaal actieplan luchtkwaliteit
Asks the government, with provinces and municipalities, to investigate what is needed to start a national air quality action plan and inform the House in spring 2018.
Requests the government, together with provinces and municipalities, to investigate what is needed to start the national air quality action plan.
verzoekt de regering om, in samenwerking met provincies en gemeenten te onderzoeken wat er nodig is om een start te maken met het nationaal actieplan luchtkwaliteit
Motie van het lid Van Eijs c.s. over de transitieagenda consumptiegoederen
Asks the government to give specific attention to textiles within the consumer goods circular economy transition agenda.
calls on the government to give separate attention to textiles when implementing the consumer goods transition agenda
roept de regering op, om bij de uitvoering van de transitieagenda consumptiegoederen apart aandacht te besteden aan textiel
Motie van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over duurzame inkoop van voertuigen
Asks the government to map how minimum sustainability criteria for vehicle procurement can be raised, to lead by example, and to consult the VNG on it.
requests the government to map how the minimum criteria for sustainable vehicle procurement can be gradually raised
verzoekt de regering: • in kaart te brengen op welke wijze de minimumcriteria voor duurzame inkoop van voertuigen stapsgewijs kunnen worden verhoogd
Motie van de leden Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over alle gemeenten deel laten nemen aan de Benchmark Huishoudelijk Afval
Motion urges municipalities not yet participating to join the household waste benchmark and report results to the Chamber.
requests the government to strongly urge all non-participating municipalities to join the 2017 benchmark
verzoekt de regering, alle nog niet deelnemende gemeenten met klem aan te sporen om deel te nemen aan de benchmark peiljaar 2017
Motie van de leden Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over streefwaarden voor luchtkwaliteit
Asks the government to have the Health Council propose air quality target values to guide a new national air plan.
requests the government to ask the Health Council, based on the study to be completed in November, to come up with target values for air quality
verzoekt de regering, de Gezondheidsraad op basis van het in november af te ronden onderzoek alsnog te verzoeken te komen met streefwaarden voor luchtkwaliteit
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Bij recycling van asfalt komt veel te veel kankerverwekkend benzeen vrij’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that benzene emissions from asphalt plants exceed limits, the health risks, enforcement by competent authorities, and calls for relaxed norms. The government answered that 10 of 29 active plants exceed the emission limit, that exposure at ground level has not exceeded the EU limit, that competent authorities are enforcing, and that it will inform parliament after an industry study.

It is important that the competent authority has emission data so that it becomes clear whether there is an exceedance situation and on the basis of which follow-up steps can be determined by the competent authority.

Het is van belang dat bevoegd gezag over emissiegegevens beschikt zodat duidelijk wordt of sprake is van een overschrijdingssituatie en op basis waarvan vervolgstappen kunnen worden bepaald door bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Eijs over recht op reparatie van apparatuur

MPs Dik-Faber and Van Eijs asked about the right to repair, reparation costs and access to spare parts for volunteer repairers, and about structural funding for Repair Café. The State Secretary said EU Ecodesign rules are a step forward, that a broader study on professionalising the repair sector is pending, and that structural subsidy to a single foundation is not possible under state aid rules.
I will inform your House about the results of the study.
Over de resultaten van het onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sneller en Schonis over het bericht 'Particuliere beleggers slepen notarissen voor de rechter vanwege rol in dubieuze grondhandel'

MPs asked whether land speculation rules changed since 2019, whether notaries adequately protect private investors, and how buyers are protected against speculators. The minister replied that no relevant legislative changes occurred, that fragmentation is limited (about 0.13% of farmland), that notaries' independence rules and disciplinary oversight apply, and that consumer protection and AFM oversight exist, promising a further answer.
Since May 2019 there have been no legislative amendments aimed at bringing land positions under AFM supervision or at countering land speculation.
Sinds mei 2019 zijn geen wetswijzigingen geweest die erop gericht waren grondposities onder het AFM-toezicht te brengen of gericht waren op het tegengaan van grondspeculatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het artikel 'Nederland liet dieselsjoemelaars onterecht gaan'

An MP asked the government about a Follow the Money report that the Netherlands wrongly let diesel 'cheat' vehicles pass, and about the implications of a 2020 EU Court of Justice ruling on defeat devices. The government answered that the ruling tightens the rules, that the RDW is reviewing approvals and past investigations against it, that reopening cases will be communicated if needed, and that it will push for stricter EU emission standards.
If reopening of the investigations proves necessary, I will inform your House of this.
Indien heropening van de onderzoeken noodzakelijk is, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Eijs over de pilot Speaksee

MPs from D66 asked whether the positive UWV pilot of the speech-to-text tool SpeakSee could be reimbursed for deaf and hard-of-hearing workers, since it is classed as a hearing aid and falls to health insurers rather than UWV. The minister agreed the tool is valuable, said the Zorginstituut indicated speech-recognition software may fall under the Zorgverzekeringswet, and promised to monitor and discuss access with representatives of people with disabilities.

As part of the one-counter approach from the cabinet response on POC KOT, I will discuss with VWS and representatives of people with disabilities whether they encounter obstacles when applying for these provisions.

Ik zal in het kader van de een loket gedachte uit de kabinetsreactie POC KOT, samen met VWS, met (vertegenwoordigers van) mensen met een beperking bespreken of zij bij het aanvragen van deze voorzieningen tegen belemmeringen aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de machtsstrijd bij de nieuwe Milieudatabase

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked the Minister of Interior whether the transfer of management of the national environmental database (NMD) to the Stichting NMD raised concerns about governance, objectivity and stakeholder representation. The minister answered that the ministry's responsibility is the same as for other norms, that the foundation's governance adequately represents stakeholders and science, and that communication was adequate.
The ministry provides a financial contribution to the Stichting NMD.
Het ministerie geeft een financiële bijdrage aan de stichting NMD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over fysieke woningbezichtigingen ten tijde van de coronapandemie

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about physical versus digital home viewings during the pandemic, the rules for physical viewings, and whether the number of viewings should be capped. The minister said no such figures exist, digital viewings are meant to reduce physical ones rather than replace them, and the industry associations' agreed protocols govern viewings, with the government staying in contact with them.
Such figures are not known to me.
Dergelijke cijfers zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht "Bouwers in opstand tegen norm duurzaam bouwen: Hout dupe van oneerlijke rekensom"

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked the Minister of Interior whether CO2 storage in biobased materials such as wood should count in the MPG environmental calculations, given the 2050 climate-neutral ambition. The minister confirmed storage is not credited because the EN 15804 method, which follows EU norms, counts end-of-life emissions, but committed to examine how CO2 storage in biobased materials could be included within EU frameworks and to evaluate the calculation method with the NMD.
I therefore undertake to determine how the valuation of the environmental effects of CO2 storage in biobased materials, including wood, can be incorporated into our national system.
Ik zeg u daarom toe te bepalen hoe de waardering van de milieueffecten van de opslag van CO 2 in biobased materialen, waaronder hout, kan worden opgenomen in onze nationale systematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht 'Rapport van Vrije Ondernemers Noordwijk (VON): GOM blijkt zelf de grootste onttrekker van 1e klas bollengrond'

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that the Greenport Ontwikkelingsmaatschappij is itself the largest taker of first-class bulb land, that councils are enforcing against gardens and pastures to keep bulb acreage, and whether this fits the National Spatial Strategy. The minister answered that land-use and enforcement decisions are a matter for the municipalities, that the national interest concerns agricultural land and open landscape only in general terms, and that she would not intervene in local powers.
It is not for me to intervene in the application of local powers where no national interest is at stake.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de toepassing van lokale bevoegdheden als daarmee geen nationaal belang gemoeid is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de petitie 'Terug naar schoner gft-afval voor nog schonere compost'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a petition for cleaner green-waste (gft) to produce higher-quality compost, including whether a maximum 2% contamination standard and recycling targets for municipalities should be introduced. The State Secretary says existing tools, the Aanvalsplan and handreikingen, are supported by the chain, that contamination limits are left to contracts, and that recycling targets for municipalities are not the right instrument, while promising to examine measures against misleading packaging logos.
I will investigate which measures, including legal ones, are possible.
Ik zal onderzoeken welke maatregelen, inclusief wettelijke, mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van Eijs over het bericht ´Hoogleraren: stop de strijd tegen permanente bewoning van vakantiehuizen´

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are still enforcing against permanent residence in holiday homes and how this fits with the adopted motion on applying the human touch. The minister answered that municipalities should apply the human touch, that a quality and weighing framework is coming, and that municipalities should be cautious with enforcement and penalty payments during the second COVID wave.
Later this year I will come with a quality and weighing framework for municipalities.
Later dit jaar kom ik met een kwaliteits- en afwegingskader voor gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Tovenaars met rommel’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about reports that failed waste-processing firms caused large public costs and that criminals operate in the sector. The government confirmed cost estimates in general terms, declined to give criminal records of owners, and announced a planned Omgevingsbesluit change allowing authorities to require financial security before granting permits.

This question cannot be answered. The criminal records of the natural persons referred to in the question who are in any way linked to companies prosecuted for environmental offences cannot be retrieved with an automated search.

Deze vraag kan niet worden beantwoord. De antecedenten van de in de vraag bedoelde natuurlijke personen die op enigerlei wijze zijn gelieerd aan bedrijven die strafrechtelijk zijn vervolgd voor milieudelicten, zijn niet met een geautomatiseerde zoekslag op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en De Groot over het bericht ‘Fundering van 1 miljoen huizen bedreigd door laag grondwaterpeil’

MPs Van Eijs and De Groot (D66) asked about a report that about 1 million homes risk foundation damage from low groundwater, and about the responsibilities of water boards, farmers, municipalities and the state. The Minister answered that the damage estimate is per owner and largely modest, that government supports owners through viewers, funding funds and knowledge centres, and that owners are responsible for their foundations, while referring several questions to other levels and ministries.
This problem does not primarily lie with the water boards.
Deze problematiek ligt niet primair bij de waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Deurnese twintigers willen bouwen in villawijk: ‘Maar de buurt wil ons er niet bij hebben’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a news report on young people in Deurne whose housing plan in a villa neighbourhood was blocked by residents, and about how to promote mixed neighbourhoods, starter housing and municipal land availability. The minister answered that housing supply is mainly a local and regional matter, outlined general measures such as the Omgevingswet, the Expertteam Woningbouw and the woningbouwimpuls, and gave no specific commitment on the Deurne case.
Unfortunately I do not have factual information on the extent to which resistance from residents plays a delaying role in housing projects.
Helaas beschik ik niet over feitelijke informatie over de mate waarin weerstand van bewoners een vertragende rol speelt in woningbouwprojecten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het exporteren van Nederlands schroot

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the export of Dutch metal scrap for recycling abroad under poor environmental conditions, and whether CO2 and non-financial impacts are considered. The state secretary answered all ten questions, explaining that most scrap is exported because domestic recycling capacity is limited, that CO2 abroad is outside Dutch targets, and that a landfill ban on asbestos-containing steel scrap and support for stricter EU waste shipment rules are planned.
I am committed to a revision of the EVOA that gives the possibility to attach the condition of environmentally sound treatment to the export of metal scrap.
Ik zet mij in voor een herziening van de EVOA die de mogelijkheid geeft om aan export van metaalschroot de voorwaarde van milieuverantwoorde verwerking te verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het gebruik van data door middel van de Leefbaarheidseffectrapportage, bewonersparticipatie en de Omgevingswet

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the Leefbaarheidseffectrapportage (LER) tool, its role in citizen participation under the Omgevingswet, and whether it should be improved or made more widely used. The Minister answered that the LER is a useful participation tool, that existing open-data platforms already support it, and that no specific review of this commercial instrument is planned.
I see no reason to investigate this specific (commercial) instrument for possible improvements.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om dit specifieke (commerciële) instrument op mogelijke verbeteringen te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over ‘het dienen van twee heren’ bij woningmakelaars

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether estate agents may charge both landlords and tenants, how the rule against charging tenants is enforced, and what victims can do. The minister answered that enforcement is partly through civil courts and partly through ACM, which has fined or ordered rental agents to stop charging fees, with an ongoing check and no answer on timing within three weeks.
In 2019 the ACM addressed four intermediaries for wrongly charging brokerage fees to tenants.
De ACM heeft in 2019 4 bemiddelaars aangesproken op het ten onrechte in rekening brengen van bemiddelingskosten aan huurders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over 'de rol van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf bij door Covid-19 getroffen huurders’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary how the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, as a model landlord, treats tenants in Veenhuizen affected by COVID-19 measures, including the share of horeca tenants, whether rent is reduced or only deferred, and what other solutions exist. The state secretary answered that individual tenants received three-month rent deferrals and some received a second deferral, with repayment arrangements agreed case by case, and no rent reductions or waivers.
Where deferral of rent payment was requested, this was granted.
Waar uitstel van huurbetaling is gevraagd, is dat gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht 'Eindhoven gaat windhinder bij nieuwe woontorens te lijf'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about wind nuisance from high-rise buildings, whether national rules exist, and whether Eindhoven's pre-testing approach and the lessons from Rijksvastgoedbedrijf incidents should be applied more broadly. The Minister answered that municipalities may regulate wind nuisance through their own rules and the NEN 8100 standard, that no national instruction rules exist for this aspect, and that the building-code wind-load requirements cover structural safety.
It is up to municipalities to include the prevention of wind nuisance in their municipal regulations.
Het is aan gemeenten om in hun gemeentelijke regelgeving het tegengaan van windhinder mee te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs inzake 'Privacywaakhond AP verhuist naar historisch hart Den Haag om uit te kunnen breiden'

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior why the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) needs a 400-staff building in a costly central Hague location despite smaller staffing scenarios and understaffing, and asked about office norms, rental pricing and why the building had earlier been sold off. The State Secretary answered that the building is needed under the government's office masterplans, that an external study on the AP's tasks and resources is due in summer 2020, that surplus space would go to other state services, and that the rent was validated as market-conform by an external valuer.
A external study into balancing the AP's tasks and resources, promised to the House, is currently underway.
Op dit moment loopt er een aan uw Kamer toegezegd extern onderzoek naar het in evenwicht brengen van de taken en middelen van de AP
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Paternotte en Van Eijs over de berichten dat studenten boetes ontvangen voor groepsvorming in eigen huis

MPs from D66 asked the Justice Minister whether fines for student house gatherings under emergency COVID-19 ordinances are proportionate, consistent and correctly applied. The minister answered that the ban applies only to public space, that the Leiden fines were withdrawn, that enforcement guidance is national but allows local discretion, and that a bill is being prepared to clarify household definitions.
The fines imposed in Leiden mentioned above have been withdrawn, because it later became clear that the emergency ordinance was not applied correctly.
De bovengenoemde boetes die zijn opgelegd in Leiden zijn ingetrokken, omdat achteraf is gebleken dat de noodverordening niet op juiste wijze is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Eijs over het bericht 'Regio vraagt minister om hulp bij verkoop Vestia-woningen'

MPs Ronnes and Van Eijs asked about the stalled sale of Vestia housing in six municipalities and the transfer-tax treatment of corporation takeovers. The minister reported intention agreements signed in May 2020, explained conditions for the transfer-tax exemption for task transfers, and said the Rijk will examine remaining facilitating measures.

Whether the transaction price in the planned transactions in the custom-made municipalities is expected to be at least market value in rented condition cannot currently be assessed, because the planned transactions still need to be worked out.

Of bij de voorgenomen transacties in de maatwerkgemeenten de transactieprijs naar verwachting minimaal marktwaarde-in-verhuurde-staat is, kan op dit moment niet worden beoordeeld, omdat de voorgenomen transacties nog moeten worden uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, De Groot, Van Eijs, Paternotte en Schonis over het bericht ‘Dutch spell out green ideas for EU recovery fund’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture about a Dutch non-paper proposing a green EU recovery, including conditioning state aid on the national climate plan, early energy and circular investments, and an exclusion list for the Just Transition Fund. The government said the non-paper was an informal civil-servant document, declined to share such papers routinely, and gave largely non-committal answers, deferring concrete national plans until after the Commission's proposals and an August decision.
However, the cabinet considers sharing all such informal civil-servant lobbying documents at all times neither opportune nor desirable for effective Dutch advocacy in Brussels.
Echter, het kabinet acht het te allen tijde delen van al deze ambtelijke beïnvloedingsdocumenten niet opportuun noch wenselijk voor effectieve Nederlandse belangenbehartiging in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Eijs over de Gemeentelijke VerduurzamingsRegeling

MPs Van der Lee and Van der Eijs asked the Minister of Interior about the Gemeentelijke VerduurzamingsRegeling (GVR), a municipal home-insulation financing scheme, its legal soundness, and its role in the energy transition. The Minister answered that building-linked financing is planned for 2022, that the GVR's use of the municipal betterment levy is legally problematic and advised against, and that the Klimaatakkoord measures are the preferred route.
I therefore advise municipalities not to use the GVR, and advise them to point homeowners to the existing range of financing options.
Ik raad gemeenten daarom af gebruik te maken van de GVR, en raad hen aan woningeigenaren te wijzen op het bestaande palet van financieringsopties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Miljoenen koffiebekers Rijk niet gerecycled maar verbrand’

MPs asked whether about 85 million government coffee cups were incinerated instead of recycled, contrary to policy ambitions, and what steps would prevent this. The minister acknowledged this breaches the contracts, said the contractor was contacted, and committed to new contracts from 2021 with direct recycler arrangements.
However, this is not in line with the concluded contracts.
Dit is echter niet in overeenstemming met de afgesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Eijs, Kröger en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Onderzoek: in één schep Noord-Hollands compost zitten duizenden microplastics’

An MP asks the minister about a report finding thousands of microplastics per scoop of compost, the role of biobased and biodegradable plastics, verification of packaging claims, and health research. The minister answers that consumer sorting is the main driver, that teabags belong in residual waste and the sector is being approached to move to compostable materials, and that claims are verified through independent certification schemes while health research is due by summer 2020.
It is not checked whether packaging that is biobased, biodegradable or has an organic component actually is so.
Er wordt niet gecontroleerd of verpakkingen die biobased zijn, bioafbreekbaar zijn of een organische component hebben dit ook zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Wethouder: ‘niet eens met Talis over energietransitie’’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a municipal alderman's objection to a housing corporation renovating homes while keeping gas connections, and about whether corporations are refusing aardgasvrij renovations and are aware of subsidies. The minister answered that renovation rules allow gas reconnection, that gemeenten have sufficient legal tools to steer new gas connections, and that corporations are reached via subsidy schemes and information campaigns.
Given the options that article 10(7) of the Gas Act provides, in my view municipalities have sufficient options to steer where no new gas connections may be made.
Door de mogelijkheden die artikel 10 lid 7 van de Gaswet biedt, hebben gemeenten naar mijn mening voldoende mogelijkheden om te sturen waar geen nieuwe gasaansluitingen mogen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden lid Van Eijs en van Meenen over het bericht ‘5000 huizen maar geen scholen of sporthal: vrees voor spookwijk Binckhorst’

MPs Van Eijs and Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about reports that the Binckhorst district in The Hague will get 5,000 homes but no schools or sports hall. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for schools and that the Binckhorst facilities programme, though self-binding rather than legally binding, guides development, and saw no reason to consult The Hague.

The facilities programme for the Binckhorst, adopted by the municipal executive in November 2019, shows which facilities are needed for a liveable neighbourhood and which locations are available for them.

Het voorzieningenprogramma, zoals dat in november 2019 door het college van burgemeester en wethouders is vastgesteld, geeft inzicht in welke voorzieningen noodzakelijk zijn voor een leefbare wijk en welke locaties daarvoor beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Van Eijs en Schonis over het artikel ‘Duurzaamheid blijft ondergeschoven kind bij aanbestedingen in de bouw’

D66 MPs asked whether sustainability plays too small a role in public construction tenders and whether this jeopardises the 2050 climate goals. The government answers that sustainability can be included in many tender criteria, outlines Rijksoverheid purchasing strategy, Klimaatakkoord measures, CO2-Prestatieladder and MKI/MPG instruments, and the status of motion Schonis on smart maintenance pilots.
For central government this has led to drafting a new procurement strategy for Rijk purchasing, aimed at sustainable, social and innovative purchasing.
Voor de rijksoverheid is dit aanleiding geweest voor het opstellen van een nieuwe inkoopstrategie voor de inkoop van het Rijk, gericht op duurzaam, sociaal en innovatief inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Bergkamp over de onbereikbaarheid van aangepaste rolstoelwoningen

Two D66 MPs asked why a patient was refused an accessible wheelchair home due to age, and about accessibility policy under the UN disability convention and related housing rules. The minister said the patient has since been offered a suitable home, that corporations may label dwellings for specific groups on objective grounds, and that no further signals of wrongful refusals were received, while promising to discuss any such cases with Aedes and stating that no national definition of a wheelchair home exists.
I have not received any further signals.
Er hebben mij niet meer signalen bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Schonis over het bericht 'Mogelijk 14 miljard minder aan woningbouw en wegen door stikstofuitspraak'

MPs Van Eijs and Schonis asked about reports that the Council of State's PAS ruling could cost the construction sector billions, including whether provinces paused nature permits, how many homes are affected, and how the ADC test applies to housing. The minister answers that permitting has resumed step by step, that roughly 25,000 homes are affected though projects are not halted, and that an overview of affected infrastructure projects will follow.
The Minister of IenW will inform the House before the MIRT consultation about the consequences of the PAS ruling for national infrastructure projects.
De Minister van IenW zal de Kamer voorafgaand aan het Nota-overleg MIRT informeren over de gevolgen van de PAS-uitspraak voor de nationale infrastructuur projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Ramen in gebouw ministerie springen kapot’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Interior about cracked windows at a Rijnstraat 8 government building in The Hague, including safety risks, causes, inspection and regulation gaps, and links to the AFAS stadium roof collapse. The government answered that there is no danger to occupants, that the outer panes were replaced with a calamity plan in place, that the cause is still under investigation, and that the Minister will consider steps once the AFAS investigations conclude.
Because of this ongoing investigation, it is still too early to conclude that regulations need to be amended.
Vanwege dit lopende onderzoek is het nog te vroeg om te concluderen dat regelgeving aangepast moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over ‘Problemen in Amsterdam brengen afvalverwerking in heel Nederland in gevaar’

An MP asked the state secretary about the shutdown of four waste-incineration lines at AEB in Amsterdam and the resulting strain on national waste processing, including vulnerability, public ownership, circular economy and recycling options. The state secretary answered that the problem is mainly local, that the market is responsible for capacity allocation, that an import cap took effect, and that she will inform parliament in the autumn on making waste management more robust, while withholding some company financial information as confidential.
This is company information that is mostly confidential.
Dit is bedrijfsinformatie die veelal vertrouwelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over bodemwende

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked whether the government finds the bodemwende erfpacht-based financing model acceptable, whether the erfpacht canon should be tax-deductible when used for home improvement, and when clarity on this would be given. The minister said the Klimaatakkoord research into erfpacht financing will be reported to parliament in autumn, and declined to comment on the tax treatment of an individual provider's product, which lies with the Belastingdienst.

This factual assessment is reserved for the Belastingdienst and, under the duty of confidentiality, I cannot comment on or anticipate the outcome of the assessment of the position on an individual provider's product.
Deze feitelijke beoordeling is voorbehouden aan de Belastingdienst en in het kader van de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet ingaan of vooruitlopen op de uitkomst van de beoordeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sienot over het bericht ‘Huizenkopers haken af, omdat nieuwbouw te duur wordt’

MPs Van Eijs and Sienot asked the Minister of Interior about rising new-build home prices, the role of sustainability measures such as heat pumps, land prices, municipal incentives for housing sites, and support for gas-free homes. The minister answered that causes are still unclear, promised research on costs and benefits of gas-free new build by early 2020, and outlined housing deals, a climate-agreement innovation programme, and a public campaign.
In doing so, I also want to have the costs and benefits of gas-free new construction mapped out.
Daarbij wil ik ook de kosten en baten van aardgasvrije nieuwbouw in kaart laten brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Gevaarlijke gasleidingen in Nederland versneld vervangen na explosie Den Haag’

MPs Sienot and Van Eijs asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of the Interior about the accelerated replacement of risky grey cast-iron gas pipes after an explosion in The Hague, why some network operators acted slowly, and whether gas-free housing could help. Minister Wiebes answered that SodM supervises an accelerated plan, that the cause of the third incident is not yet explained, that safety is leading, and that he will support network operators where needed.
Now that the precise underlying cause of the third incident, a crack in the gas pipe in The Hague, cannot be explained, it is (still) not possible to establish a link with the earlier incidents.

Nu de precieze achterliggende oorzaak van het derde incident, een scheur in de gasleiding in Den Haag, niet kan worden verklaard, is het (nog) niet mogelijk een relatie te leggen met de eerdere incidenten.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘800.000 Nederlanders kregen kanker, na ‘genezing’ houden zij problemen’

Three D66 MPs asked the health, finance and social affairs ministers about reports that many cancer survivors face lasting problems, including ongoing fatigue, lack of aftercare and advice, difficulties returning to work, and problems obtaining mortgages and insurance. The ministers answered that care providers should be doing more, that existing initiatives such as a no-risk insurance pilot and a Taskforce Cancer Survivorship are underway, and that the government sees little need for its own intervention, while promising to review mortgage and insurance issues with the sector.

In preparation for the next Platform meeting in 2020, I will ask how lenders handle the life insurance requirement and whether parties experience other bottlenecks in mortgage provision to (ex-)cancer patients.

Ik zal in voorbereiding op de volgende Platform bijeenkomst in 2020 uitvragen hoe kredietverstrekkers omgaan met de overlijdensrisicoverzekering en of partijen andere knelpunten ervaren op het gebied van hypotheekverstrekking aan (ex)kankerpatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sneller inzake de groeiende maatschappelijke zorgen over de plannen voor Paleis Soestdijk

MPs Van Eijs and Sneller (D66) asked whether the Paleis Soestdijk redevelopment by Made by Holland, which now adds a 120-room hotel and about 33 extra homes beyond the original bid, is still within the sale concept and how the municipality and province should be involved. The Secretary of State answers that the changes fit the original concept under the sale contract, that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf consented, and that planning decisions and conditions such as the number of homes and use of proceeds are the responsibility of the province and municipality.
Since this concerns a further elaboration of the plan area, the province and municipality are the competent authorities because of its public-law character.
Aangezien het om een nadere invulling van het plangebied gaat, zijn de provincie en de gemeente vanwege het publiekrechtelijke karakter het bevoegde gezag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sneller over de berichten ‘Grondspeculant belemmert bouwplannen van gemeenten’, ‘Dubieuze handel in kavels veel omvangrijker dan gedacht en ‘Niemand wil bouwen op versnipperde

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Finance and of the Interior about reports that land speculation obstructs municipal building plans, that land trading in plots is more extensive than thought, and that fragmented land is hard to build on, asking about municipal pre-emption rights, the reach of the Wvg after the Omgevingswet, and AFM supervision of speculative land offerings. The minister acknowledged speculation can delay projects but could not assess how many municipalities are affected, said the pre-emption right is an effective tool and that she had received no signals of municipal unawareness, and explained that land offerings structured as leases or self-managed fall outside AFM supervision, with a bill on investment objects planned for late 2019.
However, I cannot assess to what extent and in how many municipalities concrete (firm) building plans are actually obstructed by land speculation.
Ik kan echter niet beoordelen in hoeverre en in hoeveel gemeenten daadwerkelijk door grondspeculatie concrete (harde) bouwplannen worden bemoeilijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Koerhuis over het bericht 'ABN-AMRO-economen: bouw is miljarden kwijt door fouten'

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked the minister how the government will reduce the high failure costs in Dutch construction, citing an ABN-AMRO report. The minister answers that the Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen bill, along with stricter contractor liability and the Bouwagenda, is the main route, and commits to answering the questions within the time frame.
The bill on quality assurance for construction aims at such a system, which may also contribute to the necessary cultural change in the sector.
Het wetsvoorstel Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen beoogt zo'n stelsel, dat tevens kan bijdragen aan de noodzakelijke cultuuromslag in de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de uitzending van Tegenlicht omtrent Ruimtepuinruimer

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about space debris, international law on removing it, Luxembourg's commercial space law, liability for satellites, and Dutch positions in UN space programmes. The State Secretary answered that no UN treaty requires debris removal, that the Netherlands prioritises debris reduction within the UN and ESA frameworks, and that no new legal regime is currently planned.
The Netherlands endorses the importance of the guidelines developed within the UN, and has designated reducing and preventing space debris as one of its priorities.
Nederland onderschrijft het belang van de binnen de VN ontwikkelde richtlijnen, en heeft het verminderen en voorkomen van ruimtepuin als een van zijn prioriteiten aangemerkt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Eijs over het artikel 'Soap rond architecten verbouwing Binnenhof'

MPs Middendorp and Van Eijs asked the State Secretary about press reports of turmoil among architects for the Binnenhof renovation, including the replacement of the Eerste Kamer architect and the search for new architects. The State Secretary answered that the timeline and budget are unaffected, that architect Pi de Bruijn will be commissioned for building N, and that governance will be reviewed with the House's user groups.
That is why I want to examine with the users of the House of Representatives whether it is possible to make changes to the existing project structure
Vandaar dat ik met de gebruikers van de Tweede Kamer wil bezien of het mogelijk is om wijzigingen in de bestaande projectstructuur aan te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Van Eijs over de Nationale Landschap Enquête van Natuurmonumenten

MPs Smeulders and Van Eijs asked the minister about Natuurmonumenten's National Landscape Survey, its concerns over landscape protection amid spatial pressures, biodiversity loss, and the role of government as landscape steward. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to provinces as primarily responsible, referred to the NOVI principles and the LNV vision, and committed to informing the House on the motion about quantifying soft values.
Yes, I will inform the House about this in writing.
Ja, ik zal de Kamer hierover schriftelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Van Eijs en Ronnes over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het tracé van buizen voor ondergronds transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Smeulders, Van Eijs and Ronnes asked for the current status of the indicative pipeline route Laarbeek-Echt/Susteren, why it remains in the Structuurvisie Buisleidingen, and whether it should be removed or subjected to a cost-benefit analysis. Minister Ollongren answered that the definitive route procedure is being stopped because insufficient information exists, that the indicative route will stay in the structure vision, that no MKBA will be made, and that the Chamber will be informed through the upcoming Nationaal Programma Energiesysteem.
An indicative route cannot be established as a definitive route without consultation with the Chamber about it.
Een indicatief tracé kan niet als definitief tracé worden vastgesteld zonder overleg daarover met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Eijs over het bericht dat bedrijven websites als MijnBelastingdienst hebben ontdekt als jachtgrond voor persoonlijke gegevens

MPs Verhoeven and Van Eijs asked about reports that companies harvest personal data from government portals such as MijnBelastingdienst, and about data requirements for rental applicants. The State Secretary answered that the GDPR applies and that he is concerned about tenants' dependence on landlords, is exploring further legal frameworks for citizen control over personal data, and sees a government portal as not necessarily required.
I am currently examining whether further (legal) frameworks are needed for this.
Ik onderzoek momenteel of hiervoor nadere (juridische) kaders nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Corporaties laten vele miljoenen euro’s voor nieuwbouw ongebruikt liggen'

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked whether housing corporations leave large unused investment capacity for new social rental homes and sustainability, and whether they should be pressed to use it. The minister confirmed the indicative investment capacity figures, said local parties decide how it is deployed, and promised to report on the sector in the annual Staat van de Volkshuisvesting.
It is therefore up to tenant organisations, housing corporations and municipalities to make local agreements on the deployment of the available housing resources.
Het is dan ook aan huurdersorganisaties, corporaties en gemeenten om lokaal afspraken te maken over de inzet van de beschikbare volkshuisvestelijke middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht omtrent schadelijke stoffen in lippenbalsem

MPs De Groot and Van Eijs asked the health minister about a Belgian study finding possibly carcinogenic mineral oil fractions (MOSH/MOAH) in children's lip balms sold in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch regulation and NVWA inspection were adequate. The minister replied that the Cosmetics Regulation prohibits carcinogenic mineral oils, that the NVWA had requested the study data and saw no reason for additional research or inspection, and that the ingredients are labelled as paraffinum liquidum and similar terms.
The NVWA therefore sees no reason to carry out additional research.
De NVWA ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Eijs over het bericht dat Nederland investeringen in gentherapie misloopt

MPs Dijkstra and Van Eijs asked whether the Netherlands applies an extra environmental procedure and stricter interpretation to gene therapy, whether Dutch patients treated abroad need an import permit, and whether Dutch procedures are slower and could be streamlined. The minister replied that gene therapy falls under the GMO environmental release directive as in other states, that no import permit is needed, that procedural differences stem from EU rules, and that two rounds of streamlining already removed national bottlenecks, with an evaluation due in 2019.
The Netherlands has no extra environmental procedure for gene therapy and likewise does not choose to interpret the European rules for gene therapy more strictly than other member states.
Nederland kent voor gentherapie geen extra milieuprocedure en maakt evenmin voor gentherapie de keuze om Europese regels voor gentherapie strenger te interpreteren dan andere lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht dat Nederland na de Duitse vuile dieselauto’s nu de vervuilende houtkachels importeert

An MP asked whether Dutch wood stoves that are banned in Germany and Belgium can still be sold in the Netherlands, and why stricter emission norms are not introduced sooner despite industry and NGO calls. The state secretary answered that most stoves sold follow German standards, and committed to a regulation bringing the EU Ecodesign requirements into force by 1 January 2020 at the latest.
