I therefore want to introduce a regulation so that as quickly as possible, but no later than 1 January 2020, the new Ecodesign Directive requirements also apply in the Netherlands, as in our neighbouring countries, to newly sold stoves.

Ik wil daarom komen tot een regeling om zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk per 1 januari 2020, de nieuwe eisen van de Ecodesign-richtlijn ook in Nederland net als in onze buurlanden van kracht te laten zijn voor nieuw verkochte kachels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over gesjoemel met energie-indexen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about manipulated energy indices in Groningen rentals, how tenants can challenge them, and how certifiers and EPA advisers are controlled and sanctioned. The minister explained the Huurcommissie and court routes, the certification oversight chain (certificate holders, certification bodies, Raad voor Accreditatie, KvINL), and that the BENG system will tighten quality control, but gave no figures on prosecutions and did not commit to new measures beyond the planned system change.
I am not aware whether parties have been prosecuted for issuing or committing fraud with incorrect energy indices.
Het is mij niet bekend of partijen zijn aangeklaagd voor het afgeven van of fraude met onjuiste energie-indexen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over erfpacht

An MP from D66 asked for a full history of the leasehold (erfpacht) situation on the Wadden islands, including the Groothuis, Van der Werf and RVB valuation reports, the commitments made to parliament and leaseholders, the scientific-integrity assessment of the RVB valuation method, and the legal protection of leaseholders. The State Secretary answered that Staatsbosbeheer has offered most leaseholders a sale or continued lease, that the LOWI complaints were declared unfounded so the RVB method is not in question for the government, and that leaseholders' interests are protected by civil law and general principles of good governance.

There is now a court case brought by a number of leaseholders in which the valuation method used by the RVB is being challenged. I am awaiting the outcome of this procedure and will inform you about it in due course.

Thans is sprake van een door een aantal erfpachters aangespannen gerechtelijke procedure waarin de door het RVB gebruikte taxatiemethode ter discussie wordt gesteld. Ik wacht de uitkomsten van deze procedure af en zal u er te zijner tijd over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Meenen over het studievoorschot en het effect op de maximale hypotheek

Two D66 MPs asked whether mortgage lenders correctly account for student debt, how the Rijk, AFM and lenders agreed on this, and whether lenders could offer more tailored mortgages to starters. The minister replied that student loan repayments are annuity-based so current balance is not relevant, lenders weight student debt at 0.75% (pre-studievoorschot) or 0.45% (post) of principal, explain options exist, and the issue will be reviewed at the 2019 Platform Hypotheken.

At the next Platform Hypotheken in 2019, where the sector and the supervisor discuss possible bottlenecks in mortgage provision, it will be inventoried how providers use this explain option and whether bottlenecks are encountered.

Tijdens het volgende Platform Hypotheken in 2019, waar met de sector en de toezichthouder wordt gesproken over mogelijke knelpunten in de hypotheekverstrekking, zal worden geïnventariseerd op welke wijze aanbieders gebruik maken van deze explainmogelijkheid en of hier knelpunten worden ondervonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Jetten over het bericht dat Hardenberg in alle nieuwbouwwijken gasaansluitingen toelaat

Two MPs from D66 asked ministers whether Hardenberg's blanket exemption from the gas connection obligation for all new-build neighbourhoods was lawful and in line with the law's intent. The minister answered that the municipal exemption power is limited to specific projects or locations, that he cannot judge whether Hardenberg complied with the rules, and that objection and appeal are open to affected parties.
Whether the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Hardenberg took this decision in accordance with the provisions of the law, I cannot assess.
Of het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Hardenberg dit besluit conform de bepalingen in de wet heeft genomen, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Meenen over (buitenlandse) studenten die geen onderdak hebben

MPs Van Eijs and Van Meenen (D66) asked whether foreign students lacking housing at the start of their studies could be quantified, whether a permanent solution is foreseen, how universities consider housing capacity in recruitment, and about tent accommodation in Groningen and municipal-university coordination. The minister replied that no exact figures per city exist, pointed to the national student housing monitor and a new action plan with local production agreements, and said she will inventory local cooperation and concrete housing actions with the monitor.
No data are available on the number of students who cannot find accommodation before the start of their studies.
Over het aantal studenten dat voor de start van hun studie geen woning kan vinden zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de inspectie van gevaarlijk roestvrijstaal (RVS) in zwembaden

MP Van Eijs asked the Minister of Interior whether the inspection regime for dangerous stainless steel fixtures in swimming pools is adequate, including the number of compliant pools, whether provinces acted on a request to remind municipalities of their duties, and whether the Bouwbesluit and NPR 9200 are aligned. The minister answered that municipal first-line and provincial interbestuurlijk supervision are sufficient, that all provinces have followed up, that the two rule sets cover different scopes, and that pool owners bear primary responsibility.

As I reported in my letter of 5 January 2018, I consider supervision of the remaining work to complete the inspection duty sufficiently secured through first-line supervision by municipalities and additional interbestuurlijk supervision by provinces.

Zoals ik mijn brief van 5 januari 2018 heb gemeld, acht ik het toezicht op de nog resterende werkzaamheden met betrekking tot het afronden van de onderzoeksplicht voldoende geborgd met het eerstelijns toezicht door gemeenten en het aanvullend interbestuurlijke toezicht door provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Echtpaar gooit tuinhuis op Airbnb. Hoe worden de huurinkomsten belast?’

MPs Van Eijs and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance how short-term rental income from a home (e.g. Airbnb, garden house) is taxed, and whether partial room rentals should be taxed. The State Secretary explained the existing rules under the Wet IB 2001 (article 3.113, room rental exemption, box 3 and VAT treatment), estimated about 8,000 households declared such income, and said no new measures were currently planned while a court case is on appeal.
The Tax Administration's records do not show how large the group is that should declare income from temporary rental of their own home in the income tax return.
Uit de administratie van de Belastingdienst is niet af te leiden hoe groot de groep is die inkomsten uit tijdelijke verhuur van de eigen woning moet aangeven in de aangifte inkomstenbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Nieuwe diesels stoten veel te veel stikstofoxiden uit’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that new Euro-6 diesel cars emit too much nitrogen oxides on the road, about the causes, enforcement options, air quality effects, and the lawful switching-off of emission controls. The State Secretary answered that the ICCT tests are not type-approval tests, that EU Real Driving Emissions rules now apply, that enforcement via type-approval authorities is possible, and that emission-control switch-offs should be limited, while committing to tighter RDE rules expected in January 2019.
I share your view that it is undesirable for manufacturers to switch off emission-limiting systems.
Ik deel uw opvatting dat het onwenselijk is dat fabrikanten emissiebeperkende voorzieningen uitschakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Dit keer dumpen de boswachters zelf afval, als statement’

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security, Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and Infrastructure and Water Management about fly-tipping in rural areas after rangers dumped waste as a protest. The minister acknowledged the problem, said a joint plan of action on supervision and enforcement in rural areas would be sent to parliament before the budget debates, and noted that cleanup costs and enforcement capacity are burdens but gave no national data on causes or environmental damage.
As promised in the Nature committee debate of 8 March 2018, I am working with the Minister of LNV on an action plan to improve supervision and enforcement in rural areas.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuur van 8 maart 2018 werk ik samen met de Minister van LNV aan een plan van aanpak om het toezicht en de handhaving in het buitengebied te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Veiligheidsregio verzweeg fout jodiumpillen in Limburg’

Two D66 MPs asked the government whether errors in distributing potassium iodide tablets left some families without them, why the error was not communicated, and whether distribution and registration methods should change. The minister acknowledged distribution problems could not be fully traced, described a remedial scheme for affected Limburg households, and promised an evaluation by RIVM due in 2019 while rejecting a registration system.
Unfortunately I cannot determine where errors may have been made or how many families did not receive the tablets.
Ik kan helaas niet achterhalen waar mogelijk fouten zijn gemaakt en hoeveel gezinnen de tabletten niet hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht “Companies sign up to pledge to cut plastic pollution” en “UK supermarkets launch voluntary pledge to cut plastic packaging”

An MP asked the state secretary whether the UK Plastics Pact targets are achievable for the Netherlands and whether comparable targets for single-use plastics can be set. The state secretary said Dutch recycling rates are already higher than the UK's, pointed to the existing packaging framework agreement, and said single-use plastic measures should preferably be developed at EU level, with a broader policy response to follow in the cabinet reaction on transition agendas.
In the context of the cabinet's response to the transition agendas, I will address policy to reduce the use of disposable products.
Antwoord 7, 8 In het kader van de kabinetsreactie op de transitieagenda’s zal ik ingaan op het beleid om het gebruik van wegwerpproducten te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sienot en De Groot over het bericht 'Onderzoekers: plasticsoep in Stille Oceaan komt vooral van visserij en scheepvaart'

D66 MPs asked whether the government shares researchers' view that cleaning up the Pacific plastic soup is futile and that production should be tackled, and what Dutch fishing and shipping sectors contribute and what agreements exist nationally, in the EU and globally. The minister answered that prevention via a circular economy is the primary policy, cites national green deals with the fishing and shipping sectors, EU port reception facility revision, and international initiatives, while noting the Pacific findings cannot be directly transferred to the North Sea.
Results of beach litter surveys on North Sea beaches in OSPAR's 2017 Intermediate Assessment show that in the southern North Sea in 2014/2015 packaging material had the largest share of items found.

Uit de resultaten van zwerfvuilmetingen op Noordzeestranden in het Intermediate Assessment 2017 van OSPAR blijkt dat in de zuidelijke Noordzee in 2014/2015 de categorie verpakkingsmateriaal het grootste aandeel heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘De Volkswagens zijn nog altijd veel te vies’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether the Volkswagen diesel software update really brings emissions into compliance, given press reports that cars remain far above the norm on the road, and whether the RDW omitted odd results. The government answered that the German approval authority judges the update compliant, emissions fall slightly, and it will commission TNO tests on a Polo before and after the update, with results promised to parliament.
To nevertheless gain more insight into the effects of the software update, I will have a Volkswagen Polo examined, both before and after the software update.
Om toch nog meer inzicht in de effecten van de software-update te vergaren zal ik een Volkswagen Polo laten onderzoeken, zowel voor als na de software-update.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de nasleep van de brand in de Grenfell Tower in Londen

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the Hogeschool Rotterdam building closure over cladding fire risk, lessons from the Grenfell Tower inquiry, and how building material fire safety and quality are ensured in the Netherlands. The minister answered that municipalities and builders are responsible under the Bouwbesluit 2012, that no large-scale deviations in fire-safety cladding are known, and pointed to the pending Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen bill.
However, I have no indications that this occurs on a large scale when it comes to the fire safety of facades.
Ik heb echter geen aanwijzingen dat dit op grote schaal plaatsvindt als gaat om de brandveiligheid van gevels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het door de bouwsector stelselmatig negeren van adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked whether construction firms systematically ignore Dutch Safety Board (OvV) recommendations after fatal accidents, about accident registration, use of lead structural engineers, and whether the minister will consult the sector and OvV. The minister denies systematic neglect, explains existing reporting duties and the Storybuilder tool, notes that a lead engineer role is recommended but implementation is unknown, and declines a separate consultation with OvV as unnecessary.
From my previous answers you can conclude that the OvV's recommendations are being followed up and that consultation with the construction sector is taking place in this context.
Uit mijn voorgaande antwoorden kunt u opmaken dat de aanbevelingen van de OvV worden opgevolgd en dat er in dat kader met de bouwsector overleg plaatsvindt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over pvc in verpakkingen

An MP asked the state secretary why PVC packaging still appears in household waste despite its known harms, and what can be done to phase it out and make packaging more recyclable. The government answered that there is no legal ban, that supermarkets have agreed under the Raamovereenkomst Verpakkingen to phase out PVC packaging, and that producer responsibility and essential requirements are the main tools, with some innovation commitments but no new binding measures.
There is no ban or any other legal obligation to phase out PVC, but the aim is of course to keep poorly recyclable packaging on the market as little as possible.
Er is geen sprake van een verbod of enige andere wettelijk verplichting om pvc uit te bannen, maar de wens is uiteraard om slecht recyclebare verpakkingen zo min mogelijk op de markt te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Eijs over schade door rubberkorrels kunstgras

MPs Diertens and Van Eijs asked about reports that water boards did not study rubber granulate contamination near artificial turf pitches and whether standards should be reviewed. The State Secretary disputed the claim of dozens of seriously contaminated fields, said heavy metals and PAHs may be present, ordered a RIVM study and promised to raise the concern with the water boards.
I have instructed the RIVM to map the environmental effects of the spread of rubber granulate into the surroundings.
Ik heb het RIVM opdracht gegeven de milieueffecten van de verspreiding van rubbergranulaat naar de omgeving in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Kröger over de bloedtest die beschikbaar gesteld wordt voor omwonenden van chemieconcern Chemours

MPs Van Eijs and Kröger asked why the Chemours blood test for residents is limited to the RIVM blue zone, whether financial barriers exist, and whether former workers and wider residents can participate. The State Secretary defends the zone as based on the RIVM sample, states there are no costs, promises to ask municipalities to offer tests to former workers without a traceable employer, and says municipalities will communicate the offer.

To prevent these people from having no opportunity to be tested, I will ask the municipalities of Dordrecht, Sliedrecht and Papendrecht to also make a test available for those cases where no former employer can be traced.

Om te voorkomen dat deze mensen geen mogelijkheid hebben om zich te laten testen, zal ik de gemeenten Dordrecht, Sliedrecht en Papendrecht vragen om, voor die gevallen waarin geen voormalige werkgever meer traceerbaar is, ook een test beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Studeren vanuit een camper’

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government recognises that housing shortages affect Dutch as well as international students in student cities, asked for per-city shortage and construction figures, and asked whether the problem is addressed beyond city boundaries. The minister acknowledges shortages in many student cities, gives a 2016 monitor table and construction projections per city, and says only that some cities look beyond their boundaries (Amsterdam via a coalition appeal).
No exact figures per student city can be given.
Er zijn geen exacte aantallen per studentenstad te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Van Eijs over de Redichemse Waard en de bredere problematiek van verondieping van Nederlandse (diepe) waterplassen

MPs Jetten and Van Eijs asked the government about the planned shallowing of the Redichemse Waard lake with contaminated sludge and soil, its recreational and ecological value, and the legal basis for dumping, including imported waste. The minister answered that shallowing is not automatically a useful application, that Rijkswaterstaat assesses the draft plan without approving it, and that existing rules and the Omgevingswet give limited scope for further protection.
Shallowing a deep lake is not by definition a useful and functional application.
Het verondiepen van een diepe plas is niet per definitie een nuttige en functionele toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over angst op werkvloer van Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports of fear among staff at the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw (WSW), its governance and culture, the risks to its guarantee function, and its director capacity. The Minister answered that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) has flagged trust and culture problems and that WSW is taking steps, with the Aw monitoring follow-up and the Minister informed and responsible for the housing system.
The Aw, as supervisor, will closely monitor the follow-up of the recommendations and their effects in the coming period, and can where necessary independently give instructions to WSW.
De Aw volgt als toezichthouder de follow-up van de aanbevelingen en de effecten daarvan in de komende periode nauwgezet en kan daarbij indien nodig zelfstandig aanwijzingen geven aan WSW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Eijs over de permanente bewoning van vakantieparken

MPs asked the government about people living permanently in holiday parks, including the size of such groups, the blacklist of landlords, and solutions for people without housing. The minister said there is no national overview of permanent residents, that the government is studying the housing need for temporary housing, and that municipalities are responsible for housing supply and enforcement.
At national level there is no overview of the number of people who permanently live in a holiday park and the reasons why they stay there.
Op landelijk niveau is er geen overzicht van het aantal mensen dat permanent op een vakantiepark verblijft en om welke reden zij er verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Bergkamp over de financiering van bijzondere woonvormen.

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior and Health ministers about financing options for collective self-build and supported living projects, including mortgage terms, municipal support, land acquisition and loan-to-value rules. The minister answered that details are largely unknown or case-specific, pointed to municipal subsidies and a Expertteam Eigenbouw review, and described no binding obligations for the executive.
I do not have an overview of how often this happens, which types of projects are involved, or what conditions are attached to such financing.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van hoe vaak dit gebeurt, om welke type projecten het gaat, en welke voorwaarden aan een dergelijke financiering gesteld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de uitstoot van GenX-stoffen en PFOA door Chemours

An MP asks the government about GenX and PFOA contamination around the Chemours plant, including health risks from home-grown produce, control mechanisms and blood testing. The state secretary answers that the VU study is only indicative, that the RIVM second opinion cannot establish risk from garden produce, that PFOA emissions from the process are excluded, and that blood testing for residents will be offered.
In consultation with the province of Zuid-Holland and the directly involved municipalities, I have asked the RIVM to carry out a second opinion to interpret the results of the VU study.
Ik heb, in samenspraak met de provincie Zuid-Holland en de direct betrokken gemeenten, het RIVM gevraagd om een second opinion uit te voeren om de resultaten van het VU-onderzoek te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over de brand bij de olieraffinaderij Isla op Curaçao

MPs from D66 asked the government about the fire at the Isla refinery on Curaçao, including health risks from smoke, the cause of the fire, past safety incidents and the refinery's non-compliance with permit requirements per an inspection report. The minister replied that responsibility for the Isla refinery lies with Curaçao, so he cannot answer the substantive questions, though he notes Curaçao has commissioned an inspection and audit and that the Netherlands stands ready to continue assistance on request.
Because responsibility for the Isla refinery rests with the country of Curaçao, the questions have not been answered individually.
Omdat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de Isla-raffinaderij bij het land Curaçao berust, zijn de vragen niet afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de brandveiligheid van Nederlandse gebouwen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior, after the Grenfell Tower fire in London, how fire safety in Dutch buildings is ensured, who checks compliance, and whether gevel and insulation rules are adequate. The minister answered that the Bouwbesluit 2012 sets requirements, that municipalities are responsible for enforcement and the provinces for supervision of municipalities, that he would await the English investigation report before considering additional measures, and that rules for buildings above 70 metres are set through the Bouwbesluit and a technical guidance document.
I do not have this information. As answered under question 3, each municipality can shape its own supervision of fire safety.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie. Zoals geantwoord bij vraag 3 kan iedere gemeente zelf invulling geven aan het toezicht op brandveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat in nieuwbouw nog steeds vaak aardgas wordt aangesloten

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that new homes are still often connected to the gas grid, including the cost of connections and alternatives, and how this fits the Energy Agenda's plan to end the gas connection obligation. The Minister estimated that over 80% of new homes are still gas-connected, said a law change to remove the obligation will follow via an amendment, and pointed to existing municipal and Green Deal options while giving no firm timeline.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Von Martels over berichten dat consumenten problemen met hun voertuig ondervinden na het toepassen van de software-update van Volkswagen

MPs Van Eijs and Von Martels asked whether the Volkswagen software update causes higher fuel use, power loss and EGR valve failures, whether EGR removal is adequately regulated, and how consumers are compensated. The minister replied that independent tests (KBA, RDW, TNO) found no negative effects on fuel use or power, that a ban on removing emission controls is being prepared, and that PON handles complaints individually while the recall is voluntary for consumers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over berichten dat Duitsland en andere lidstaten in Europa verbetervoorstellen naar aanleiding van het dieselgateschandaal blokkeren

An MP from D66 asked the ministers whether Germany and other member states are blocking EU proposals to strengthen type-approval and market surveillance after the diesel emissions scandal, including EU retesting and fining powers, and what the Dutch position is. The ministers replied that negotiations are ongoing, the Dutch position broadly supports the Commission proposal with alternative methods, and they will report on RDW follow-up investigations and the D66 and European Parliament recommendations later.

To prevent a potential new diesel scandal, I am committed to strengthening the system of market surveillance of, and type approval for, motor vehicles and the uniform application of regulations throughout the EU.

Om een potentieel nieuw dieselschandaal te voorkomen zet ik me in voor versterking van het systeem van markttoezicht op – en typegoedkeuring van motorvoertuigen en de uniforme toepassing van de regelgeving in de gehele EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Paternotte over een gemeentelijke meldplicht voor verhuur van woningen via digitale platforms

MPs Van Eijs and Paternotte (D66) asked the Minister of the Interior whether a planned consultation with Amsterdam on a municipal reporting obligation for platform rentals would take place, whether results would be shared with Parliament and other municipalities, and whether a reporting duty would reduce the enforcement burden. The minister replied that no consultation is scheduled yet because Amsterdam must first add its day-count criterion to its housing ordinance, that existing law suffices and enforcement is a municipal matter, and that a reporting obligation would be disproportionately burdensome and ineffective, promising to inform Parliament only if concrete steps are taken.
If concrete steps have been taken, I will inform your House about this.
Als er concrete stappen zijn genomen, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.

m: Motie De Pater-van der Meer en Heijnen over uitvoering van de Europese verordening coördinatie sociale zekerheid grensarbeiders en zelfstandigen
Asks the government to assign implementation of the EU social security coordination regulation for cross-border workers and self-employed to the Belastingdienst office in Heerlen.
requests the government to assign implementation of the said European regulation to the Foreign Office of the Tax Administration in Heerlen
verzoekt de regering de uitvoering van de genoemde Europese verordening op te dragen aan het kantoor Buitenland van de Belastingdienst in Heerlen
Motie Heijnen en De Pater-van der Meer over het bijdragen van reorganisaties van de rijksoverheid aan de economische structuur van krimpgebieden
Asks the government to have reorganisations of central government contribute as much as possible to the economy and jobs in shrinking regions.
requests the government to have reorganisations of central government contribute as much as possible to strengthening the economic structure and employment in shrinking areas
verzoekt de regering reorganisaties van de rijksoverheid zo veel mogelijk te laten bijdragen aan versterking van de economische structuur en werkgelegenheid in krimpgebieden
Motie De Pater-van der Meer over normering van topinkomens voor consultants die worden ingehuurd door de overheid

Asks the government to cap hourly rates for external consultants and interim managers hired by central government and agencies, based on a €181,000 income norm, and to encourage local governments to follow.
requests the government to introduce a maximum hourly rate for external hiring by central government and autonomous administrative bodies
verzoekt de regering voor externe inhuur door rijksoverheid en zelfstandige bestuursorganen een maximumuurtarief in te voeren
Motie Timmer c.s. over een evaluatie van de Wet landelijk bureau inning onderhoudsbijdragen
Asks the government to evaluate the LBIO law in all its aspects two years after entry into force and send the results to the House.
requests the government to evaluate this law in all its aspects two years after this bill enters into force
verzoekt de regering na twee jaar na het inwerking treden van dit wetsvoorstel deze wet in al zijn facetten te evalueren
Motie Heijnen c.s. over de gevolgen van een krimpende bevolking voor gemeenten
Asks the government, together with affected municipalities, to study the consequences of a shrinking population for municipalities and propose solutions if needed.
requests the government to examine together with the municipalities concerned the consequences of the shrinking population for those municipalities
verzoekt de regering om samen met de betrokken gemeenten de gevolgen van de krimpende bevolking voor deze gemeenten te onderzoeken
Motie Anker c.s. over wijziging van de kinderalimentatiewetgeving
Asks the government to amend child maintenance law so that norms become more transparent, the ability-to-pay principle is relativised, and maintenance claims get priority.
requests the government to amend child maintenance legislation so that the norms become more transparent
verzoekt de regering de kinderalimentatiewetgeving zodanig te wijzigen dat de normen transparanter worden
Motie Van Haersma Buma c.s. over verhoging van de leeftijd waarop prostitutie is toegestaan
Asks the government to raise the minimum age for legal prostitution from 18 to 21 to fight coercion and loverboy exploitation.
requests the government to raise the age at which prostitution is permitted from 18 to 21 years
verzoekt de regering de leeftijd waarop prostitutie is toegestaan te verhogen van 18 naar 21 jaar
qa: Vragen van de leden De Pater-van der Meer en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over wachtgeld van een oud-wethouder (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about a former alderman in Meerssen who received about EUR 61,715 too much in severance pay due to a municipal error, and whether the error was properly handled and why the matter was not made public. The state secretary confirmed the overpayment, said the municipality is responsible for administering it, that the error was an isolated administrative failure now addressed by improvements, that repayment rules limit recovery, and that the case was kept private for privacy reasons.
In my view, there is no need for further measures.
Een noodzaak tot verdere maatregelen is naar mijn mening niet aan de orde.

m: Motie van het lid Boutkan over onderzoeken of de jaarlijkse afdracht van de plastictaks op niet-gerecycled plastic kan worden afgedragen door de producenten
Asks the government to examine whether producers under extended producer responsibility could pay the annual plastic tax levy on non-recycled plastic.
requests the government to examine whether the annual payment of the plastic tax on non-recycled plastic can be paid by the producers
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken of de jaarlijkse afdracht van de plastictaks op niet-gerecycled plastic kan worden afgedragen door de producenten
Motie van het lid Boutkan over bijmengen van biobrandstoffen pas toestaan na onderzoek naar het effect hiervan op de veiligheid in de luchtvaartsector
Asks the government not to apply the biofuel blending obligation for aviation until field research on safety effects has been carried out.
requests the government not to apply the blending of biofuels earlier than after field research has been carried out
verzoekt de regering om het bijmengen van biobrandstoffen niet eerder toe te passen dan nadat er een (veld)onderzoek heeft plaatsgevonden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over het bericht ‘Rivaal Qatar Airways mag meer vliegen op Schiphol ondanks krimpplan: ’KLM moet kapot’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Qatar Airways may fly more from Schiphol despite a shrinking plan, including slot allocation rules, fair competition in the EU-Qatar air agreement, Qatari crew rest rules, and the Qatargate investigation. The minister answered that slot allocation is the independent slot coordinator's responsibility, that the EU-Qatar agreement contains enforceable fair-competition clauses, that no concrete evidence of safety risk has been found, and that the government will reraise the issue if evidence emerges.
If not, why not? Answer 5: I do not share this view.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 5 Ik deel deze mening niet.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een negatief advies van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg met betrekking tot de aanvraag van het Admiraa

SP MPs asked the minister whether the Inspectorate for Health Care gave a negative opinion on Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital's application to perform cardiac catheterisation at Goes, why the advice is not published, and whether the minister will implement a unanimously adopted motion limiting Zeeland to one such centre. The minister confirmed the negative advice, declined to publish it citing detailed information about the hospital and staff, and said an independent third party will be commissioned to examine patient flows before a final decision, with the Chamber to be informed.
The advice contains detailed information about the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital and about persons working there.
Het advies bevat gedetailleerde informatie over het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis en over personen die daar werkzaam zijn.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het dottercentrum in Goes (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about claims that the NMa made a cardiac catheterisation (dotter) centre in Goes a condition of the Ziekenhuis Walcheren/Oosterscheldeziekenhuizen merger, whether the centre can start immediately once licensed, and how the minister will implement the unanimously adopted motion for one shared dotter centre in Zeeland. The minister confirmed the NMa conditions were based on IGZ advice, explained that the NMa left partner and location choices to the hospital, said IGZ found the hospital did not yet meet all licence conditions, and announced an independent review of patient numbers before deciding.
I cannot assess within what period the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital will be able to meet all the conditions.
Ik kan niet beoordelen binnen welke termijn het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis in staat is aan alle voorwaarden te voldoen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Gerven en De Roos (allen SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over inkomens boven de Balkenendenorm van bestuurders in de zorg (ingezonden 7 juni 2010).

SP MPs asked the health minister about hospital and mental health directors earning above the Balkenende norm, including interim directors at Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis and a crisis manager and departing director at GGZ Delfland, and what can be done. The minister said interim pay should follow the BBZ code (which took effect after the appointments), declined to precisely calculate the salary component and referred to earlier answers, deferred 2010 salary data to the annual report, and said supervisory boards must act lawfully on departures.
That is why I also find the approach of the BBZ appealing, which I referred to in my answer to question 2.
Daarom spreekt mij ook de benadering van de BBZ zo aan waar ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 aan refereerde.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ontmanteling van het ziekenhuis in Vlissingen door het bestuur van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (in

MPs Van Gerven and De Roos (SP) asked the health minister about the downsizing of the Admiraal De Ruyter hospital in Vlissingen, including bed cuts, job losses, specialist disagreements, emergency care criteria, whether financial motives drove the plans, and a delayed decision on cardiac dilation permits. The minister largely defended the hospital's plans as a relocation of functions, said the Gezondheidsraad advice was not needed before acting, and promised an independent review before deciding on the permit.
Before taking a final decision on the permit application of the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital, I want to have some questions examined further.
Alvorens een definitieve beslissing te nemen over de vergunningaanvraag van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis wil ik nog enkele vragen nader laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Becker, Erkens, Paternotte en Bamenga over ‘het bericht dat de nieuwe partij NL Plan steunt op organisaties verbonden aan de Chinese Communistische Partij’

MPs from VVD and D66 asked ministers about reports that the new party NL Plan received support from organisations linked to the Chinese Communist Party, and about foreign interference and the effectiveness of the ban on foreign donations under the Dutch party financing law. The minister answered that NL Plan reported no donations above the threshold, that enforcement and oversight of the ban are still being assessed, and that a study on Chinese interference and a new political parties law are in preparation.

I would like to refer to the extensive media coverage of the recently arrested employee of German AfD lead candidate Maximilian Krah, who allegedly spied for China, and to the Belgian politician Filip de Winter, who allegedly worked for years on behalf of the Chinese Communist Party.

Ik verwijs hier graag naar de uitgebreide berichtgeving in de media over de recent gearresteerde medewerker van de Duitse AfD-lijsttrekker Maximilian Krah die gespioneerd zou hebben voor China en over de Belgische politicus Filip de Winter die jarenlang in opdracht van de Chinese Communistische Partij gewerkt zou hebben.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het intrekken van vergunningen bij onderbezetting van stallen

An MP asked the ministers whether the Omgevingswet's one-year period for partially withdrawing permits for underoccupied barns (versus three years under the Wabo) puts farms in Beter Leven programmes at risk of losing permit capacity, and whether rules should change. The minister answered that withdrawal is discretionary for the competent authority after a weighing of interests, that the shorter period is not meant to increase withdrawals, and that no rule change is planned while monitoring continues.
It is up to the competent authority to weigh the interests.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om een belangenafweging te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de brief van de regering, Herziening Wet bijzondere maatregelen grootstedelijke problematiek; Nationaal Programma Leefbaarheid en Veiligheid van 7 december 2023

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the minister about municipal problems with sharing personal data for the national neighbourhood liveability and safety programme, the use of confiscated criminal money in deprived neighbourhoods, and waste containers jamming. The minister answered that data sharing needs a legal basis and points to ongoing legislation and best-practice support, that a model agreement alone is insufficient, and that waste problems are primarily municipal matters, with the issue to be raised with the VNG.
The ministry does not have national data on how often municipalities face jamming underground waste containers.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over landelijke gegevens over hoe vaak gemeenten te maken hebben met klemmende ondergrondse containers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valize, Six Dijkstra en Rajkowski over de kabinetsbrief Gemelde kwetsbaarheid Cisco Webex vergadervoorziening

MPs Valize, Six Dijkstra and Rajkowski asked about a Cisco Webex vulnerability that exposed metadata of government meetings, whether calls could be joined by phone, and which classification levels may be discussed on Webex. The State Secretary answered that Webex may be used up to Departementaal VERTROUWELIJK, that no Dutch cases of misuse are known, and that the Cisco vulnerability disclosure process will be discussed with Cisco.
However, no cases are known in the Netherlands in which unauthorised users attended confidential video meetings of the national government.
Binnen Nederland zijn echter geen gevallen bekend waarbij ongeautoriseerde gebruikers vertrouwelijke videovergaderingen van de Rijksoverheid hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het onderzoek «De keuze voor warmtenetten of andere warmteoplossingen»

An MP asks the ministers how the government reacts to a Berenschot study finding district heating cheaper than heat pumps from a societal perspective, whether the cost-plus tariff method in the Wet collectieve warmte will raise consumer prices, how the WIS subsidy and tariff protection will help consumers and projects, and whether cost sharing and financing can be improved. The minister acknowledges the cost-distribution issue, expects cost-based tariffs to lower prices for roughly 45-64% of consumers with phased introduction and a possible tariff cap, and describes subsidy changes, a planned guarantee fund and forthcoming studies, mostly promising further letters and evaluations without firm commitments on the specific demands.
The cabinet is preparing a letter exploring complementary policy options (in addition to the Wcw) to safeguard the affordability of collective heat.
Het kabinet bereid een Kamerbrief voor waarin flankerende beleidsopties (in aanvulling op de Wcw) worden verkend om de betaalbaarheid van collectieve warmte te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over de personele bezetting bij de Commissie Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (CTIVD)

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Interior Minister how oversight of the AIVD and MIVD will be ensured when the temporary law on cyber programmes and bulk datasets takes effect on 1 July, given the CTIVD's stated lack of capacity, and when the CTIVD will get the workspace needed to hire 10 promised FTE. The government replied that the CTIVD will be temporarily housed from 1 January 2025 and permanently from 1 July 2026 with enough space for the expansion, but that the CTIVD has said it cannot oversee the other provisions of the law until its move is complete, so those powers will only be used after that or earlier if agreed with the CTIVD.
The CTIVD has indicated it cannot oversee the other provisions of the Temporary Act because the cyber specialists needed for this are largely occupied with work on the housing problem.

De CTIVD heeft aangegeven geen toezicht te kunnen houden op de overige bepalingen uit de Tijdelijke wet, omdat de daarvoor benodigde cyberspecialisten voor een groot deel belast zijn met werkzaamheden voor de huisvestingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over te weinig personeel voor het toezicht op de AIVD en MIVD, in aanvulling op eerdere vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp van het lid Six Dijkstra (NSC)

An MP asks why oversight of the AIVD and MIVD is understaffed and under-resourced just as the Temporary Act is being introduced, and whether ministers' earlier promises were sincere. The government answers that oversight is not being scaled down, that the Temporary Act is an accent shift rather than a new oversight system, that the CTIVD is responsible for recruiting its own staff, and that application of new powers will be phased in to match the CTIVD's capacity.

When applying the Temporary Act, account is taken of the capacity problems the CTIVD faces, so that the use of powers under the Temporary Act's conditions matches the practice of implementation and oversight.

Bij de toepassing van de Tijdelijke wet wordt rekening gehouden met de capaciteitsproblemen die de CTIVD ondervindt zodat de toepassing van bevoegdheden onder de condities van de Tijdelijke wet aansluit bij de uitvoerings- en toezichtspraktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekkoek over het niet op orde hebben van het toezicht op de geheime diensten

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the CTIVD, which oversees the intelligence services, still lacks workspace and 10 additional staff, and whether the new Temporary Act can responsibly take effect without a fully equipped overseer. The government answers that housing is being sought with strict security requirements, a temporary solution is available from January 2025 and permanent housing by mid-2026, and that the Act's powers will be phased in as oversight capacity grows.

As stated in the letter of 26 June 2024 on the entry into force of the Temporary Act, the Act contains provisions that must become available as soon as possible but that create no additional work for the CTIVD.

Zoals in de brief van 26 juni 2024 over de inwerkingtreding van de Tijdelijke wet is aangegeven, bevat de Tijdelijke wet voorzieningen waarvan het van groot belang is dat deze zo spoedig mogelijk beschikbaar komen, maar waar geen extra werkzaamheden voor de CTIVD uit voortvloeien.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht «Toezichthouder is dakloos en onderbezet», in aanvulling op eerdere vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp van het lid Six Dijkstra (NSC), het lid Van Nispen (SP) en het li

An MP asks why the CTIVD, which will gain extra tasks under the new intelligence law, lacks capacity and shares a building with the AIVD, and whether the law should be delayed. The government mostly refers back to earlier letters, states the CTIVD will be temporarily housed from January 2025 and permanently from July 2026 with room for 10 extra staff, and says recruitment is the CTIVD's own responsibility.
The CTIVD will be temporarily housed from 1 January 2025 until 1 July 2026.
De CTIVD wordt per 1 januari 2025 tot 1 juli 2026 tijdelijk gehuisvest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht “Betaalbare Krapte” uit de Leeuwarder Courant

An MP asked the minister whether the government should pursue high object subsidies to steer housing supply, given criticism that demand-side stimulation fails to add homes. The minister rejected the demand-only framing, weighed the costs and risks of object subsidies, and promised to consider them in drafting the coalition government programme.
I am including object subsidies in the considerations on how to deploy the five times one billion from the Main Lines Agreement to stimulate housing construction.
Ik neem objectsubsidies mee in de overwegingen hoe de vijf keer één miljard uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord om de woningbouw te stimuleren te gaan inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Vrouw op poster krijgt doodverwensingen en racistische reacties: ‘Dit mag je niet negeren’'

An MP asked the Interior Minister about hateful and racist online reactions to a woman shown on a poster, including whether the perpetrators will be prosecuted quickly and whether the government will act against extreme-right accounts. The minister answered that discrimination is condemned, that prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service, that a national plan against online discrimination is coming after the summer, and that a national study on Muslim discrimination is underway.
It is not for the cabinet to make statements about individual cases, or to give instructions to the police and the Public Prosecution Service in specific cases.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om uitspraken te doen over individuele zaken, of in concrete zaken instructies te geven aan de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Deen over een protest op 19 juni 2024 buiten de Tweede Kamer

PVV MPs Boon and Deen asked the ministers whether they knew of a 19 June 2024 protest outside the Tweede Kamer where chants allegedly called for violence against Jewish people, and whether demonstrators dressed as Al-Qassam Brigades members amounted to glorification of terrorism. The minister confirmed awareness, said prosecution of such expressions is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts to assess case by case, and noted the cabinet plans to make glorification of terrorism a separate criminal offence.
Whether publicly uttering certain wording qualifies as a criminal offence ... is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the court to assess.
Of het in het openbaar uiten van bepaalde bewoordingen te kwalificeren valt als strafbaar feit ... is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en in laatste instantie aan de rechter om te beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk en Palmen over de artikelen 'Zeventig plekken in Limburg erbij voor woonwagenbewoners, maar die zijn er lang niet allemaal blij mee: ‘Lijkt op chantage'' en 'Rechter oordeelt dat G

MPs Zeedijk and Palmen asked the minister about press reports on new caravan pitches in Limburg and a court ruling that The Hague discriminates against caravan dwellers, and about antiziganism, the value of caravan camps, federal monitoring and a standplaatsenbeleid vision with municipalities. The minister answered that antiziganism and structural obstacles slow pitch creation, that the government is monitoring development and supporting municipalities, and that a 2018 policy framework was delivered in response to the Ombudsman.
The stigma must therefore be combated, because discrimination is not permitted.
Het stigma dient dan ook bestreden te worden, omdat discriminatie niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Westerveld over het onterecht verwijderen van foto’s en video’s van mensen met een zichtbare beperking

MPs Kathmann and Westerveld asked whether large platforms like Facebook may remove photos and videos of people with visible disabilities and whether this breaches Dutch and EU rules, and what remedies exist. The government answered that DSA transparency and appeal duties and the Dutch equal-treatment law (Wgbh/cz) prohibit disability discrimination by platforms, pointed to complaint routes via platforms, the ACM and the College voor de rechten van de mens, and said it is exploring a dispute-settlement body and a knowledge centre.
On the case you mention I have not received any signals.
Over het door u genoemde geval heb ik geen signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Idsinga over het bericht ‘Britse belegger sluist uitpondwinst Nederlandse woningen weg naar Bermuda’

Two MPs asked whether Dutch rental homes bought by a British investor and sold off to owner-occupiers via Luxembourg and Bermuda vehicles constitute tax avoidance, and what the government will do. The minister says Dutch treaties allocate tax on Dutch property income to the Netherlands, sees no reason for intervention or new rules, and declines to discuss individual tax files.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Welzijn over het bericht ‘Erfpacht oneerlijk, CDA-Raadslid wil ACM dwingen naar systeem te kijken’

MPs asked whether municipalities should inform residents better about erfpacht (leasehold) formulas, whether general erfpacht conditions favour municipalities, and whether the guidance should be binding and supervised by the AFM. The minister replied that the existing guidance is voluntary and sufficient, that the ACM rightly declined an enforcement request, that erfpacht is a private-law matter, and that the AFM is not the appropriate supervisor.

Intervening in the local trade-offs, the local autonomy and contractual freedom of municipalities (within the general principles of good governance) are very far-reaching measures and I see no need for them at this time.

Ingrijpen in de lokaal te maken afwegingen, de lokale autonomie en contractvrijheid van gemeenten (uiteraard binnen de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur) zijn zeer vergaande maatregelen en ik zie daar op dit moment niet de noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Paternotte en Sneller over de Twintigste Penning in Emmer–Compascuum

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked about the twentieth penny, a perpetual erfpacht condition requiring 5% of sale value to be paid to the bare owner in Emmer-Compascuum, including its legal basis, market effects, possible abolition like the thirteenth penny, other support for residents, and similar arrangements elsewhere. The minister answered that the condition rests on the Burgerlijk Wetboek and acquired rights, sees no market distortion, rejects legislative abolition as impractical given EVRM compensation duties, and treats the matter as a private civil-law issue with no government advisory role.
This concerns a matter between the private bare owner(s) and private erfpachters over a possible adjustment of the erfpacht conditions.
Het gaat hier om een zaak tussen de particuliere bloot-eigenaar(s) en de particuliere erfpachters over een eventuele aanpassing van de erfpachtvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de uitzending van Radar van 1 april jl. en artikelen inzake speculatieve grondhandel

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked ministers about speculative land trade in farmland shown on Radar, including misleading sales practices, the AFM and ACM supervisory roles, notary duties and the number of victims. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited a Kadaster study of about 7,000 owners and 2,000 hectares split into investment plots, and said a working group is examining options such as a splitting ban, AFM supervision and notary obligations, with results due in autumn.
You will be informed about this in the autumn.
Hierover zult u in het najaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Fiches over digitalisering in de door de informateurs aangeboden formatiestukken

An MP asked whether the 27 underlying fiches referenced in the formation document on digitalisation exist and whether they can be published now. The state secretary confirmed the 27 fiches, said other departments may have produced related fiches but she is not aware of any, and said publication is excluded under the Wet open overheid until formation concludes, with later publication left to the responsible ministers.
Under article 5.4 of the Open Government Act, documents prepared for the formation are in principle excluded from disclosure until the formation is concluded.

Antwoord 3 Uit artikel 5.4 van de Wet open overheid (Woo) volgt dat in beginsel geldt dat documenten die ten behoeve van de formatie zijn opgesteld – zoals de onderhavige fiches – uitgezonderd zijn van openbaarheid totdat de formatie is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Beckerman en Grinwis over het bericht ‘Sterke stijging aantal zaken over servicekosten, bezwaar vaak succesvol’

MPs Beckerman and Grinwis asked the Minister of Interior about reports that tenants win most service-cost and defect disputes, especially against private landlords, and what is being done about landlords who push the limits of service charges. The Minister says the rules on service charges are being tightened through a bill (limited list of cost categories, lower thresholds for collective claims), that municipalities can now enforce against misuse under the Good Landlordship Act, and that the bill is expected after the summer; on several points, such as refusing optional services and the 6.4 billion euro repayment reports, the answer is limited or refers back to existing law.
The Huurcommissie currently does not track which defects occur most often.
Door de Huurcommissie wordt op dit moment niet bijgehouden welke gebreken het meest voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over mijn gesprek met Gedeputeerde Staten van Zuid-Holland over de woningbouwafspraken

An MP asked the Minister of Interior which legal instruments he could use against Zuid-Holland's housing deadlock (130% plan capacity, extra 3 ha sites, 40% social housing, and affordable purchase price), and whether he would act on Bleizo-West. The minister said he would use an instruction under the Environment and Planning Act only if needed, that the province's revised proposal largely meets his demands so no instrument is needed now, and that he sees no need for legal steps on Bleizo-West, preferring negotiated agreement.
I therefore see insufficient reason to deploy my legal instruments now.
Ik zie daarom onvoldoende aanleiding om mijn juridisch instrumentarium nu in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over ombouwen van onzelfstandige studentenkamers

The MP asks whether private landlords are converting shared student rooms into studios, whether studio rents are lower net of rent allowance, and why rent allowance is unavailable for shared rooms, plus related questions on welfare and eligibility. The minister acknowledges signals of conversion but lacks national data, says shared rooms should be preserved for welfare and cost reasons, and explains that rent allowance for shared rooms is blocked by missing BAG registration and budget costs, with an ongoing study of a rental register and a promised letter on new shared-room housing.
I am of the view that shared (non-self-contained) units must be realised and preserved.
Ik ben van mening dat onzelfstandige eenheden moeten worden gerealiseerd en behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Chakor, Van Nispen over Juridische analyse(s) van het hoofdlijnenakkoord

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether civil servants had made a legal analysis of the coalition agreement, whether it would be shared under Article 68 of the Constitution, and whether analyses from other ministries would be shared. The answer refers to a separate letter on civil-service analyses of the coalition agreement dated 7 June 2024, rather than answering the questions directly in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sneller, Chakor and Van Nispen on legal analysis(es) of the coalition agreement (submitted 30 May 2024) were answered by way of a letter on civil-service analyses of the coalition agreement.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sneller, Chakor, Van Nispen over Juridische analyse(s) van het hoofdlijnenakkoord (ingezonden 30 mei 2024) zijn beantwoord middels een brief over Ambtelijke analyses hoofdlijnenakkoord
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht Nieuwe water-eisen veroorzaken schok: ‘De bouw van zo’n half miljoen woningen staat op losse schroeven’

An MP asks the minister whether the national spatial framework map for climate-adaptive building (water and soil guiding housing sites), which shows many yellow or orange areas, will slow housing construction, cut plan capacity, raise costs and regulatory burden, and whether an impact study or a pause is needed. The minister rejects the claim that the framework blocks housing, states it has no legal status, gives approximate capacity figures, declines a separate impact study for now, and promises to keep the House informed of its further elaboration and possible legal anchoring.
For now I do not intend to commission a separate impact study.
Vooralsnog ben ik niet voornemens een aparte impactstudie te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het buurtinitiatief grijpt naast de opdrachten voor energiebesparing’

An MP asked whether neighbourhood initiatives tackling energy poverty are being crowded out of municipal tenders by commercial parties, and whether municipalities can use other allocation methods. The minister answered that municipalities have broad discretion to spend the funds (tendering, subsidies, in-house, open house), that tender rules allow weighting of sustainability and social impact, and promised a meeting on sharing best practices under the MVOI manifesto.
No, I do not have that overview.
Nee, dat overzicht heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over verduurzamen van VvE’s lijkt onmogelijk door kosten en rompslomp

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether greening owners' associations (VvE) is stalling due to costs and bureaucracy, and about financing options, surélévation and building-linked finance. The minister answered that the VvE acceleration agenda addresses the barriers, outlines subsidy and loan improvements, and promises further work on simplifying amendments to the deed of division and a building-linked finance arrangement with conclusions expected later in the year.
I am looking into the possibilities for a robust legal basis for building-linked financing.
Ik ben bezig met het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheden voor een robuuste juridische basis voor gebouwgebonden financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Veel woningen met (te) weinig bewoners: corporaties willen vaker huizen delen'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a news report on housing associations wanting more shared housing, questioning the 61% under-occupation figure, the scope for setting occupancy norms in allocation, the effect of the cost-sharing norm on single benefit recipients, and the potential savings on rent allowance. The minister answered that shared housing suits some groups but not all, disputed the 61% figure as an artefact of the Eurostat definition, and deferred most substantive questions to a broader exploration on shared housing due in the third quarter of 2024.
I am working on a broader exploration of shared housing.
Ik werk aan een bredere verkenning van woningdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Groter brandgevaar bij flexwoningen en verduurzaming, vrees voor dodelijke slachtoffers’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a report on fire risks in flexible housing (flexwoningen) and façade/roof fires, including who is liable for damage and whether the building rules are adequate. The minister said the NIPV report concerns façade and roof fires for all buildings, not flexwoningen specifically, announced a dialogue with the sector and updated guidance, and rejected pausing flexwoningen or changing the permit regime.
There is no national database of fires. I therefore cannot provide an overview of the number of fires in different types of housing.
Er bestaat geen landelijke database van branden. Ik kan daarom geen overzicht geven van het aantal branden in verschillende typen woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en White over het bericht dat honderd oudere Surinamers een verblijfsstatus aanvragen

MPs Piri and White asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that about a hundred elderly former Dutch-Surinamese residents were applying for residence status, and about a possible scheme for this group. The state secretary said a targeted one-off scheme was examined but not developed, that the caretaker cabinet would leave new policy to its successor, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
Given the caretaker status of the current Cabinet, I am of the view that it is no longer for me to develop policy.
Gelet op de demissionaire status van het huidige Kabinet ben ik van oordeel dat het niet meer aan mij is beleid te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Mila woont met haar pasgeboren baby in een auto in Noord, urgentieverklaring afgewezen'

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked the ministers how they view Amsterdam refusing an urgency declaration for a mother and newborn living in a car, and whether they would act against such policy. The minister answered that municipalities hold discretion over urgency criteria, that Amsterdam says it tried to prevent the situation, and that he will not discuss the case specifically for privacy reasons.
It is up to the municipal council to set criteria for determining which housing seekers qualify for urgency.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om criteria vast te stellen aan de hand waarvan kan worden bepaald welke woningzoekenden in aanmerking komen voor urgentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over deelname aan de Europese verkiezingen door EU-burgers uit een andere lidstaat die in Nederland wonen

An MP asked whether EU nationals living in the Netherlands were adequately and timely informed about how to register for the 2024 European Parliament elections, and whether all municipalities did so. The minister answered that information is available online and municipalities are responsible for informing voters, that the ministry lacks data from all 342 municipalities, and that the Kiesraad will survey municipalities in its evaluation.
The ministry does not have information from all 342 municipalities on informing voters.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over informatie van alle 342 gemeenten over het informeren van kiezers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Chakor over verbieden van hoofddoekjes en andere religieuze uitingen bij boa’s

MPs Lahlah and Chakor asked whether a national ban on headscarves and other religious symbols for municipal enforcement officers (boa's) conflicts with municipal autonomy and the Code of Interadministrative Relations, and whether the Council of State should advise. The Minister said municipalities have not followed the neutrality guideline since November 2023, so a statutory basis will be sought, while noting no boa is known to wear religious symbols.
That is why I feel compelled to enshrine the neutrality requirement in legislation or regulation, as a majority of the House has requested.
Daarom zie ik mij genoodzaakt om de eis van neutraliteit in wet- of regelgeving vast te leggen, zoals een meerderheid van Uw Kamer heeft verzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot  over het bericht 'Pandeigenaren zijn vernielingen door krakers zat: ‘Met een moker heb ik de deur ingebeukt’'

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Interior ministers about squatting, including whether the 2022 anti-squatting law works, how many squats have been evacuated, whether squatting equals theft, and whether online calls to squat amount to incitement. The minister answered that the law's effectiveness will be assessed in an evaluation due in 2025, that existing criminal tools suffice for now, and that prosecution and courts decide on incitement.
Legislation works as a norm and provides a basis for action.
Wetgeving werkt normerend en biedt een grondslag om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de financiële situatie van de gemeente Vlissingen

An SP MP asked ministers about the financial distress of Vlissingen municipality, including cuts affecting care, income support and children's activities such as swimming lessons, and whether minimum-level provision can be guaranteed. The minister answered that individual cases are the municipality's responsibility, that municipalities have policy discretion, that the inspector's list of options was not a recommendation, and that a new cabinet must decide on the division of responsibilities; most answers were substantive but several deflected or declined to guarantee outcomes.
It is up to the municipality of Vlissingen to decide how it deals with this.
Het is aan de gemeente Vlissingen om te bepalen hoe zij hiermee omgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het onderzoek naar het toekomstbestendig maken van uitvoeringsorganisaties

Sneller (D66) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about low productivity and rising labour intensity at implementing agencies, the failure to act on 28% of evaluation recommendations, and the gap with CPB productivity assumptions. The State Secretary acknowledged the urgency, described IPSE productivity trends and recruitment projections, and promised a broader approach to reduce labour demand, with further information to the Chamber around September.
I will inform the Chamber, if possible in September, further about the options for steering on this.
Ik zal de Kamer, zo mogelijk in september, nader informeren over de mogelijkheden om hierop sturend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht 'Halsema wilde Extinction Rebellion bij blokkade A10 'zoveel mogelijk tegemoet komen''

MPs Diederik van Dijk and Flach asked whether the Amsterdam mayor's tolerance of a banned Extinction Rebellion motorway blockade on the A10, and the prosecution policy of not pursuing single Wom offences, weakens enforcement of the law. The ministers answered that the mayor has primary responsibility for demonstration rules, that the public prosecutor decides on prosecution case by case, that six demonstrators received 200 euro penalties, and that the ministry will address the legal framework in a letter on the right to demonstrate.
We take this responsibility seriously and have therefore reported to your House extensively on it in the letter on the right to demonstrate that you recently received.
Wij nemen deze verantwoordelijkheid serieus en hebben uw Kamer hier dan ook uitgebreid over bericht in de Kamerbrief over het demonstratierecht die u onlangs heeft ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Meulenkamp over het mogelijk maken van resomeren

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior and the State Secretary for Infrastructure about delays in legalising alkaline hydrolysis (resomation) and the planned modernisation of the Burial Act. The Minister agrees with the urgency, says the bill is delayed by complexity and will be consulted in the first half of 2024, and refuses to tolerate the practice in advance of legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het verlagen van de NHG-premie

MPs Madlener and Tony van Dijck asked whether the NHG mortgage guarantee premium should be lowered, whether NHG's guarantee capital is larger than needed, and whether NHG should use its capital for wider social goals. The minister answered that the premium must stay low but sufficient to protect the state as backstop, that a large fund remains necessary, that a revised premium methodology will be applied for 2025, and that NHG will study a broader role in sustainability while protecting its core purpose.
After this elaboration, I want to arrive at an improved premium methodology that can be applied when calculating the premium for 2025.
Na deze uitwerking wil ik komen tot een verbeterde provisiemethodiek die kan worden toegepast bij de berekening van de premie voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight. The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Sneller en Veldkamp over het artikel 'Gemeenten bereiden zich voor op ‘paspoortpiek’, vacatures staan open en noodplannen liggen klaar'

MPs Paternotte, Sneller and Veldkamp asked about a expected peak in passport renewal applications, its effect on applications from abroad and voting in the European elections, and whether a French digital passport renewal experiment could be adopted in the Netherlands.
