The State Secretary answered that demand will be two to three times higher through 2028, capacity and information campaigns have been expanded, voters need only a valid ID by 31 May, and remote biometric renewal is not yet secure enough, with the government monitoring developments.
The French government website states that from 1 March 2024 an experiment takes place in Canada and Portugal.
Antwoord 8 Op deze website 3 van de Franse overheid is te lezen dat met ingang van 1 maart 2024 een experiment plaatsvindt in Canada en Portugal.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Piri en Kathmann over nieuwssites die al jaren pro-Chinese desinformatie verspreiden

MPs Piri and Kathmann asked the government about a network of news sites spreading pro-Chinese disinformation, including reach, platform promotion, and whether EU rules (DSA, disinformation code) can address it. The government answered that the sites have negligible reach, fall largely outside DSA scope, that it will report on its disinformation strategy in spring, and that further EU regulation is not yet needed.
The cabinet is in close contact, both bilaterally and multilaterally, with friendly countries on foreign interference and Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI).

Het kabinet staat zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband in nauw contact met bevriende landen over de problematiek van buitenlandse inmenging en Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over de lokale lastendruk

A VVD MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and Minister De Jonge about local tax burdens, the split between waste, sewage and parking levies, and rules on parking charges. The minister answered with COELO figures on rising local levies from 2020 to 2024, the tariff systems used for waste charges, and stated that parking charge decisions lie with municipal councils.
It is for the municipal councils concerned to decide whether and where parking charges are levied.
Het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraden zelf om te beslissen of en waar parkeerbelastingen worden geheven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de plotselinge sloopaankondiging van 46 woningen in Boskoop

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the sudden demolition announcement for 46 social rental homes in Boskoop by Woonforte, covering foundation failures, resident support, relocation, and prevention policy. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter on the national demolition and renovation statute (Kamerstuk 29 453, nr. 570) rather than answering the questions directly.

A further answer: the written questions of MP Beckerman on the sudden demolition announcement for 46 homes in Boskoop (submitted 12 March 2024) have been answered by means of the letter on the National Demolition and Renovation Statute.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Beckerman over de plotselinge sloopaankondiging van 46 woningen in Boskoop (ingezonden op 12 maart 2024) zijn beantwoord middels brief Nationaal sloop- en renovatiestatuut
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Welzijn over de Atlas van de lokale lasten, die is opgesteld door het instituut COELO van Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs Van Hijum and Welzijn asked the Minister of Interior about rising local taxes and charges per the COELO Atlas, including whether increases reflect autonomous choices or statutory obligations, their effect on rents, the large municipal surpluses, and the share of specific grants versus the municipal fund. The minister answered that local councils and water boards set their own charges democratically, that the data on the cause of increases is not known, and provided tables on grants and tax shares.
It is not known to what extent the increase in charges is related to autonomous choices by municipalities or results from statutory obligations.
Het is niet bekend in hoeverre de lastenstijging samenhangt met autonome keuzes van gemeenten dan wel het gevolg zijn van wettelijke verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over verschillende sloopprojecten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about many demolition projects, including Berghem, Oss, Den Bosch, Winschoten and Rotterdam, questioning whether renovation was considered, tenants' participation and rights, and the role of municipalities and social rental stock. The Minister's answer refers the reader to a separate letter on the national demolition and renovation statute (Kamerstuk 29 453, nr. 570) rather than answering the questions substantively.

Further answer: The written questions from MP Beckerman about various demolition projects (submitted 6 November 2023) have been answered by means of the letter National demolition and renovation statute (Kamerstuk 29 453, no. 570).

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Beckerman over verschillende sloopprojecten (ingezonden op 6 november 2023) zijn beantwoord middels brief Nationaal sloop- en renovatiestatuut (Kamerstuk 29 453, nr. 570 )
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over verschillende sloopprojecten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the planned demolition of affordable post-war social housing in the Osse Vogelwijk, the loss of community, renovation as a more sustainable option, and alleged discrimination between tenants in different parts of the neighbourhood. The document is a short note stating that the questions were answered in a separate letter on the national demolition and renovation statute, without the substance being reproduced here.
The written questions from MP Beckerman on various demolition projects (submitted 13 November 2023) have been answered by letter on the national demolition and renovation statute.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Beckerman over verschillende sloopprojecten (ingezonden op 13 november 2023) zijn beantwoord middels brief Nationaal sloop- en renovatiestatuut
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Zeedijk over de Chinese cyberaanvallen op Nederlandse Kamerleden

MPs Sneller and Zeedijk asked the government about Chinese cyberattacks on Dutch MPs and on journalists, activists and businesses, including the APT31 group, and whether state secrets or information from Dutch politicians were obtained. The government answered that it cannot discuss the methods and knowledge of the intelligence services in public, referred to the public threat reports, and said it shares concerns and raised them with Chinese authorities.
The working methods and level of knowledge of the intelligence and security services are not discussed in public.
Er wordt in het openbaar niet ingegaan op de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heutink en Madlener over het bericht in diverse media dat drinkwaterbedrijf Vitens de noodklok luidt vanwege het toenemende tekort aan drinkwater in Nederland

MPs Heutink and Madlener asked the ministers about reports that Vitens warns of a drinking water shortage that could block connections for new housing and businesses, and about refusals of business clients, planned measures, and whether permit refusals should be eased. The minister answered that water supply concerns are recognised, pointed to the Actieprogramma beschikbaarheid drinkwaterbronnen 2023–2030 and a drinking water saving plan, said Rijk intervention is not preferred but not excluded, and that permit decisions rest with the competent authority, while committing to further work with provinces.
I do not rule out intervention by the national government, but given the administrative relationship this is not the preferred option.
Ingrijpen door het Rijk sluit ik niet uit, maar dit heeft gezien de bestuurlijke verhouding niet de voorkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Krul over dat in New Towns als Almere “het sociale cement het stenen cement nauwelijks kan bijbenen”

CDA MPs asked the government to respond to a report on social resilience in Almere and to reflect on how New Town problems such as debt, loneliness, teacher shortages and youth crime relate to rapid growth and national financing, and what action is needed. The minister replied that the report was commissioned by Almere and that the government points to existing programmes (NPLV, GALA, IZA, regional deals) and will await a broader WijkWijzer study before reflecting further.
For a reflection on the problems in the New Towns, the results of that study will be awaited.
Voor een reflectie op de problematiek in de New Towns, worden de resultaten van dat onderzoek afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Politie pakt waker op bij abortuskliniek’

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether a single-person protest outside an abortion clinic, which led to a six-hour detention, was lawful and protected by freedom of expression, and what municipalities are told about such protests. The minister answered that the police act under local authority, that single-person protests fall under Article 7 of the Constitution rather than the Wom, that content cannot justify a ban though municipalities may set form rules, and that only courts can judge the lawfulness of local restrictions.
It is not for me or the Minister of Justice and Security to intervene in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij of aan de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om te treden in individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Corporaties blijven ver achter met de bouw van betaalbare huizen, als gevolg van sloop en verkoop'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a press report that housing corporations lag far behind on affordable construction due to demolition and sales, and about the feasibility of the housing target, land prices and land availability. The minister says the national agreements remain binding, that corporations have the financial room to build, that demolition is largely followed by rebuilding, and gives no figures on municipal land holdings or prices.
I do not have figures on what share of municipal building land is made available for social housing.
Ik heb geen cijfers van welk deel van de bouwgronden van gemeente beschikbaar worden gesteld voor sociale woningbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het gebruik van de handtekeningstempel als volwaardige ondertekening van aktes

An MP asked whether the signature stamp used by people with physical disabilities lacks a legal basis and whether identity documents with a 'not able to sign' notation are valid. The state secretary answered that stamp signatures are legally valid for contracts and deeds, that identity documents with the notation are valid, and that no new measures are planned.
No additional measures therefore need to be taken for this.
Er hoeven hiervoor dus geen aanvullende maatregelen te worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat ‘buitenlandse beleggers een flat in Den Bosch laten verslonzen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether foreign investors neglecting maintenance of a Den Bosch flat, and the planned sale of social rental homes, were acceptable and what would protect tenants. The minister acknowledged the neglect, pointed to the Wet goed verhuurderschap, planned extension of Huurcommissie access to middle-segment tenants, and municipal enforcement, while calling resale to starters acceptable and leaving corporation purchases to local decision-making.
That is why I intend, with the affordable rent bill, to extend tenants' options to request a rent reduction from the Huurcommissie in case of defects to the middle rental segment.

Daarom ben ik voornemens om met het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur de mogelijkheden voor huurders om – in geval van gebreken – bij de Huurcommissie een huurverlaging te vragen, uit te breiden naar het middenhuursegment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over de nieuwe corruptie-index van Transparency International

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about Transparency International's corruption index showing Nederland falling a point, linking this to organised crime undermining institutions, lobbying and revolving-door ties, and Dutch companies' foreign bribery. The minister answered that the index measures perception, outlined ongoing risk inventories, anti-undermining measures, planned post-office-holder rules and existing OECD and UN anti-corruption commitments, but gave no new binding action beyond planned bills and evaluations.
This is, in my view, an important signal that we must not let up our attention to combating corruption in the Netherlands and protecting our institutions.
Dit is wat mij betreft een belangrijk signaal dat we onze aandacht voor het tegengaan van corruptie in Nederland en het beschermen van onze instituties niet moeten laten verslappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het afwijzen van sociale huurwoningen aan woningzoekenden met een verleden als cliënt in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the state secretary and minister whether housing corporations refusing social rental homes to former youth-care clients is acceptable, and what will be done to prevent exclusion. The minister says the case was resolved, that a new urgency rule for youth-care leavers is planned via the Wetsvoorstel versterking regie volkshuisvesting, and that programme progress will be reported, while declining to find a violation of equal-treatment law.
With the Housing Governance Strengthening Act I want to ensure the government takes back control to steer how much, where and for whom housing is built now and in the future.
Met de Wet versterking regie op de volkshuisvesting wil ik regelen dat de overheid de regie herneemt om nu en in de toekomst te sturen hoeveel, waar en voor wie er gebouwd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de aanpak van malafide verhuurders

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Interior Affairs how to tackle systematic, business-like malafide landlords, strengthen tenants' legal protection and collective claims, reduce barriers to the Rent Tribunal, and address neglected maintenance and municipal enforcement capacity. The Minister pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap Act in force since July 2023, municipal enforcement tools, an information campaign, the upcoming betaalbare huur bill, planned collective-claim and service-cost reviews, and financial support for municipalities.
I recognise the picture that there are landlords active who put tenants under pressure and break the rules.
Ik herken het beeld dat er verhuurders actief zijn die huurders onder druk zetten en de regels overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de invloed van Russisch geld op de Nederlandse politiek

MP Omtzigt asked whether the government requested declassification of Czech intelligence on Russian financing of Dutch politicians, how the information could be made public, whether prosecution is possible, and for an overview of signals of Russian financing of Dutch politicians or parties. The minister answered that the Czech government decides on publication, that the AIVD cannot disclose specific cases for national security and prosecution reasons, that prosecution can follow an AIVD report to the OM, that since 2023 foreign donations to parties are banned and no direct Russian gifts appear in party disclosures, and that the AIVD cannot give an overview of its signals.
Regarding the intelligence domain, I cannot give you an overview of signals and evidence within that domain.
Waar het gaat over het inlichtingendomein, kan ik u geen overzicht geven van signalen en bewijzen die zich binnen dat domein bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht 'VVD pleit voor Duits huurplafond als alternatief voor reguleren woninghuren'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government analysed a German Mietspiegel-style rent cap and WOZ-value based rent regulation as alternatives to the Wet betaalbare huur, and asked for related calculations to be shared before a committee debate. The Minister answered that the German model is unsuitable because it perpetuates high market rents and high turnover, that ministry of Finance calculations on WOZ-based rent caps were made but would be sent only with the response to the bill's parliamentary report, and that a 2021 Stec study on WOZ-based regulation is attached.
I informed the House by letter on 21 March that it was not possible to answer these questions before the committee debate on 21 March 2024.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 21 maart per brief laten weten dat weten dat het niet mogelijk is gebleken om deze vragen voor het commissiedebat Woningbouwopgave en koopsector op 21 maart 2024 te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en De Hoop over de uitspraak van de kantonrechter in Amsterdam om enkel glas als gebrek te erkennen

MPs Beckerman and De Hoop asked the Minister of Interior about a Amsterdam cantonal court ruling recognising single glazing as a defect, and whether the minister's letter was misused and whether a national deadline for phasing out single glazing should be set. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case with appeal pending, that policy on integral sustainability renovation remains, that tenants should not be forced to litigate, and that existing housing-corporation performance agreements and 2029 label requirements will be pursued without extra funding.
The court ruling concerns one case; given the specific aspects, it cannot be said that this requires reconsidering the general policy.
De uitspraak van de rechter heeft betrekking op 1 zaak; gegeven de specifieke aspecten kan niet worden gesteld dat die heroverweging nodig maakt van het algemene beleid
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Nederlandse geheime dienst maakte decennia gebruik van naziapparaat’

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the Minister knew that the BVD used Gestapo and Sicherheitsdienst files, including torture confessions, to spy on former resistance fighters, and whether such use should be condemned and independent research allowed. Minister De Jonge answered that the BVD's use of Nazi documents is described in a 1995 study, that torture is categorically rejected, that the BVD did not use Nazi methods, and that the AIVD will cooperate with any NIOD research while rejecting claims of a broader loss of trust or the need for large-scale investigation.
It goes without saying that I reject torture.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik folteringen verwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de publicatie van de internetconsultatie Huisvesting Nederlandse evacués

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing rules for evacuated Dutch citizens from the Middle East, a ministerial regulation under the Housing Act 2014, were adequately considered against waiting lists, family-reunion effects, and parliamentary involvement. The Minister answered all ten questions in substance, stating the regulation only covers non-self-sufficient evacuees, that Parliament has no formal role but could debate it after consultation closes, and that no irreversible steps have been taken.
There is therefore no formal procedural involvement for the House of Representatives.
Er is derhalve geen formele procedurele betrokkenheid voor de Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Brekelmans over de ministeriële regeling tot aanwijzing van evacués uit het Midden-Oosten met een Nederlandse verblijfsstatus wier huisvesting bijzondere zorg van rijkswe

Two VVD MPs asked why a ministerial regulation was needed to house non-self-sufficient evacuees from the Middle East with Dutch status, how many are affected, and whether it will burden municipal housing quotas and social rental waiting lists. The minister answered that the rule covers a very small group of evacuees who cannot arrange housing themselves, that it is applied case by case, and that municipalities can count these cases toward their statushouder quota; he also agreed to answer urgently and to refrain from irreversible steps until parliament can debate it.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Grinwis over de noodkreet van de gemeente Krimpenerwaard, Molenlanden en zestien andere Zuid-Hollandse gemeenten om te kunnen blijven 'bouwen voor behoefte'

Grinwis (ChristenUnie) asks Minister De Jonge whether he shares the call of Krimpenerwaard, Molenlanden and sixteen other South Holland municipalities to keep building for local need, and why he considers the province of South Holland to be 'not delivering' on housing, including its 3-hectare rule blocking new sites above 3 hectares. The minister shares the concern about the housing shortage and the rural municipalities' worries, says the blanket 3-hectare rule is undesirable, and states he has raised the matter with the province and informed the House of the meeting of 12 March.
A generic measure to allow no new location larger than 3 ha is, in this time of housing shortage, undesirable in my view.
Een generieke maatregel om geen enkele nieuwe locatie groter dan 3 ha toe te staan, vind ik in deze tijd van woningnood ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekoek over het niet op tijd invoeren van de Uitvoeringswet digitaledienstenverordening (DSA)

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the Dutch Digital Services Act implementation law (Uitvoeringswet DSA) was not in force by the EU deadline, what legal powers the ACM has meanwhile, and how to avoid future delays. The minister answered that the 15-month deadline was too short for a formal law, that the ACM was provisionally designated by ministerial order, that the bill would be submitted around March 2024, and that the Commission alone supervises very large platforms.
The bill itself contains no further rules that intermediary service providers must comply with.
Het wetsvoorstel zelf bevat geen nadere regels waar aanbieders van tussenhandeldiensten zich aan moeten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Dekker-Abdulaziz over strijd tegen Islamofobie

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister about rising Islamophobia, protection of mosques and Muslim communities, support for victims, and demonstrations, referencing press reports. The minister answered that discrimination figures for 2023 will be published in April 2024, pointed to existing measures (antidiscrimination services, the national programme, a Regioplan/Utrecht study) and said protection decisions are local and based on threat information, without committing to new Islamophobia-specific instruments.
Decisions on the implementation of these security measures are never publicly disclosed.
Over de invulling van deze veiligheidsmaatregelen worden nooit uitspraken in het openbaar gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over 438 studentenwoningen op Kronenburg

MPs Paternotte and Bamenga asked why only about 438 student homes will be built at Kronenburg instead of the planned 2,500-plus, and about short-stay and self-contained housing. The minister says 438 is a first phase chosen for noise and safety reasons under the Schiphol flight path, that short-stay units may be added, and that a new plan and an adjustment of the LIB are still needed, with progress reported by mid-2024.
The aim is to inform the House of progress by mid-2024.
Het streven is uw Kamer medio 2024 over de voortgang te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de huisvesting van de YMCA-vakantiekampen

An MP asked the State Secretaries for Health and Interior whether they would act on the YMCA holiday camps' lost lease in Leusden, including mediating with the province and Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and seeking alternative premises. The State Secretary answered that the matter is local and regional, that the government will not take a role, and pointed to the municipality's stated willingness to help find a location.
It is therefore up to the locally and regionally involved parties to seek a solution.
Het ligt daarom op de weg van de lokaal en regionaal betrokken partijen om een oplossing te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over olievervuiling op Bonaire

An MP from the SP asked the cabinet about oil pollution on the coast of Bonaire, including the environmental damage, the source (possibly the abandoned tanker Gulfstream), and whether the owner can be held liable. The government answered that the impact on nature appears limited for now, the long-term damage is not yet known, the situation is said to be under control, and liability is still being examined because the ship's owner has not been identified.
It is being examined whether there are possibilities to recover the damage.
Er wordt bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om schade te kunnen verhalen.
Antwoord op vragen 5, 6 en 11 van het lid Welzijn over de brief van de VN-rapporteur van 21 december 2023 getiteld Statement at the conclusion of the country visit to the Netherlands

An MP (Welzijn, NSC) asked the Minister of the Interior about the UN Special Rapporteur's finding that government levels lack concrete housing targets and steering power, the number of planned homes lacking locations per province, and how the government will speed up building permits and planning/objection procedures. The Minister replied citing the National Housing and Construction Agenda, the Versterking Regie Volkshuisvesting bill, a province-by-province table showing 129% planned capacity against housing targets, and procedural acceleration measures, but did not commit to a crisis plan and promised a fuller response in May.
I hope to be able to inform the House about this soon.
Ik hoop uw Kamer hier snel over te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘NS verbiedt christelijke jongeren flyers uit te delen op Utrecht Centraal: ‘Dit is propaganda’’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether NS's ban on Christian youths handing out evangelism flyers at Utrecht Centraal, which NS called propaganda, restricts religious and expression freedom, and why pro-Palestine demonstrations there were not stopped. The minister replied that NS and ProRail may enforce station house rules requiring permission for distributing texts regardless of content, that the assessment belongs to NS and local authorities, and that he will not comment on their earlier decisions.
It is not for me to enter into the assessment that NS security and service staff made on site.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afweging die de veiligheid- en servicemedewerkers van NS ter plaatse hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Temmink over de lobby-activiteiten van oud-bewindspersonen bij de IND

MPs Marijnissen and Temmink asked about IND lobbying meetings with former ministers Verdonk and Teeven on Indonesian nurse visas, whether procedures changed, the ministry's whistleblower cases, ministers' agenda transparency, and a lobby register. The government answered that the IND's decision was based on rules and not affected by the meetings, that no procedures were changed, and that agenda publication will be improved while a lobby register is deferred pending research.
The cabinet recognises the importance of transparent representation of interests.
Het kabinet onderkent het belang van transparante belangenvertegenwoordiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het Didam-arrest

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the Didam ruling by the Supreme Court has made it legally and practically harder for municipalities to select one-on-one buyers for land with public added value, and whether the ruling should be restricted. The minister answers that legal room is unchanged, that objective selection criteria can still favour socially valuable plans, and that he sees no reason to restrict the ruling's application.
I have no concrete figures on the extent to which the Didam ruling has in practice led to plans not going ahead.
Ik heb geen concrete cijfers in hoeverre het Didam-arrest in de praktijk ertoe heeft geleid dat plannen niet zijn doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de acuut onveilige situatie van de Vlamovenflat in Delfzijl

An MP asked the State Secretary about the acutely unsafe Vlamoven flat in Delfzijl, where bricks are falling and residents feel unheard, and about damage claims, timelines, and support for residents. The State Secretary answered that IMG has secured the building with fencing, that the structure meets the earthquake safety norm, that the damage claim is prioritised but no timeline can yet be given, and that residents can seek support or contact the Huurcommissie.
IMG cannot yet make any statements about the exact processing time of the damage claim.
Het IMG kan op dit moment nog geen uitspraken doen over de precieze doorlooptijd van de schademelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over vermogensgrenzen voor kwijtschelding van lokale belastingen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a Utrecht council motion to align wealth limits for local tax waivers with the Participatiewet bijstand limits, and about raising the thresholds generally. The minister declined substantive comment, pointed to the controversial declaration of earlier Chamber correspondence, noted the 2022 regulation allowing municipalities to raise the limit by up to 2,000 euro, and confirmed the Kroon annulled the Utrecht decision for conflict with law and the public interest.

Given the controversial declaration by your Chamber and the many policy effects linked to a possible increase in the wealth norm for waivers, the cabinet does not consider it opportune to respond substantively to this now.

Gezien de controversieelverklaring door uw Kamer en gelet op de vele beleidsmatige effecten die samenhangen met een eventuele verhoging van de vermogensnorm voor kwijtschelding vindt het kabinet het niet opportuun hier nu inhoudelijk op te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het artikel 'Signalen van institutioneel racisme tegen ambtenaren in zes gemeenten'

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Interior about press reports of signals of institutional racism and nepotism in municipal hiring and promotion of civil servants with migrant backgrounds, asking whether procedures should be standardised and sanctions imposed. The minister said municipalities are responsible for their own employment policy, rejected the nepotism conclusion, pointed to existing anti-discrimination law, an anti-discrimination complaints point for municipal staff in Amsterdam as an example, and planned reviews of the anti-discrimination voluntary-organisation system.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for their employment policy and therefore also for combating discrimination and institutional racism in it.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun werkgeversbeleid en daarmee ook voor het tegengaan van discriminatie en institutioneel racisme hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Milieuorganisatie stapt naar de rechter om renovatie Binnenhof te stoppen’

MPs Flach and Van Dijk asked about an environmental group's court appeal to halt the Binnenhof renovation over nitrogen permits, its standing as a cooperative, and possible delays. The minister answered that the appeal is pending before the court, that a nature permit was granted in January 2024, that delay effects will be reported in the next progress report, and that the court decides on standing.
I cannot go into the substance of this appeal procedure or the arguments to be made, because this case is before the court.
Op de inhoud van deze beroepsprocedure en de te voeren argumenten kan ik nu niet ingaan, omdat deze zaak voorligt bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Gemeenteraad Baarn wil spoedberaad over Paleis Soestdijk nadat Raad van State het bestemmingsplan voor het landgoed vernietigde’

An MP (Krul, CDA) asked the Interior Minister, after the Council of State annulled the zoning plan for the Paleis Soestdijk estate, about the consequences, the burden on Baarn municipality and whether the national government would provide financial or staff support. The minister answered that the plan reverts to the 2009 rural-area plan, that the owner and Baarn must decide next steps, and that additional funding or staff support is not appropriate because municipalities are expected to handle such files.
Additional funding and/or staff support is not an option.
Aanvullende bekostiging en/of personele ondersteuning is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel ‘FvD maakt doneren in bitcoin mogelijk: ‘Dit gat moet gedicht worden’’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether political donations in cryptocurrency, such as Forum voor Democratie's bitcoin donation option via ForumPay, undermine the transparency of the Wfpp donor register, how donor identity is verified and audited, and whether crypto donations are regulated and anti-money-laundering rules are enforced. The Minister replied that parties must register donors above €250, that crypto donations are treated as monetary contributions within the Wfpp, that the Wpp draft contains no extra safeguards yet but is under review, that ForumPay is not registered with DNB (a matter for DNB to assess), and that the donation option on the FvD website is no longer active.
I cannot make any statements about this.
Ik kan hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tseggai en De Hoop over het bericht 'Woondiscriminatie: Studentenhuis vaak niet beschikbaar voor mbo’ers'

MPs Tseggai and De Hoop asked how the government responds to reports that student housing is often unavailable to MBO students, and whether education level should become a protected discrimination ground. The minister answered that most social student housing corporations admit MBO students, pledged to urge the remaining ones to do so, and will request advice from the College voor de Rechten van de Mens on banning distinction by education level.
All partners in student housing, by signing the LAS, have endorsed the accessibility of education for MBO, HBO and WO alike and stand for equal opportunity in education.

Alle samenwerkingspartners bij studentenhuisvesting hebben met het ondertekenen van het LAS de toegankelijkheid van onderwijs, voor zowel mbo, hbo als wo, onderschreven en staan voor kansengelijkheid in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de afgelasting van diverse Sinterklaasintochten

An MP asked ministers whether the cancellation of Sinterklaas parades in Enter and Rijswijk due to threatened protests by KOZP and Extinction Rebellion should be prevented, whether such groups receive subsidies, and how they can be dealt with. The minister answered that the groups may protest peacefully under freedom of assembly, that local mayors can restrict demonstrations when necessary, and that no state funds were received by these groups at the latest reference date, while declining any ministerial role in restricting association rights.
KOZP and Extinction Rebellion, like any other organisation, have the right to freedom of association.
KOZP en Extinction Rebellion hebben net als iedere andere organisatie recht op vrijheid van vereniging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Postma over het artikel 'De bouw van snelle flexwoningen ligt mijlenver achter op schema'

MPs Welzijn and Postma asked the Minister of the Interior about a newspaper report that flexible housing lags far behind schedule, including causes such as grid congestion, objection procedures, site availability and optimistic planning. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, attributed it to multiple factors, and listed measures including a legislative amendment to speed up appeals and several support and subsidy schemes.
No data are available on the number of objection and appeal procedures concerning flexible housing or the number of flexible homes delayed as a result.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures aangaande flexwoningen of het aantal flexwoningen dat daardoor wordt vertraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een mogelijk onrechtmatige werkwijze bij RIEC & LIEC

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Interior about the Fort Oranje closure, a RIEC project, a claimed meeting with a court and contacts with German authorities. The Minister answered that the ministry is unaware of the project, meetings and contacts, and referred questions about the municipality's approach to Zundert.
It is up to the municipality of Zundert to respond to the approach to recreation park Fort Oranje in Rijsbergen.
Het is aan de gemeente Zundert om in te gaan op de aanpak van recreatiepark Fort Oranje in Rijsbergen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht dat de stijgende WOZ-waarde de sociale huurder hard treft

Rep. Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior whether rising WOZ property values hit social tenants hard, how this affects rent burdens, and whether municipalities, housing corporations and the Waarderingskamer will act to prevent pass-through and better inform tenants about objections. The minister answered that WOZ increases do not directly raise rents under the rent regulation system, that tenants pay no OZB, that corporations cannot pass WOZ increases through, that the Waarderingskamer supervises municipalities and promotes tenant objection rights, and that no new contact with housing associations was needed.
Also, as of 1 July 2023, around 600,000 tenants of housing corporations in the regulated segment received a rent reduction to € 575.
Ook hebben per 1 juli 2023 circa 600.000 huurders met een huurwoning van een woningcorporatie in het gereguleerd segment een huurverlaging naar € 575 gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over Woningdeling door meerdere eenouderhuishoudens

MP Paternotte asked the Minister of Interior about co-housing by single-parent households, the Tax Office treating two friends sharing a home as a partnership for allowances, and the effects on families and the housing market. The Minister acknowledged the housing shortage, said the partner definition in allowance rules is objectified and that changes for first-degree relatives apply from 2025, and committed to reviewing barriers and sending the Toekomst Toeslagen report to parliament.
I am aware that there is household dilution in the Netherlands.
Het is mij bekend dat er in Nederland sprake is van huishoudensverdunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Hoe kon het zo misgaan voor de veelgeprezen Amsterdamse Fixbrigade?‘

An MP asked the Interior and Climate ministers why Amsterdam awarded a 5,050-home insulation tender to Energiebox rather than the locally praised FIXbrigade, and about criteria, impact on tenants, and support for public fix teams. The minister answered that the municipality runs the tender and the national government lacks insight into bids, points to the municipality's criteria and its willingness to help FIXbrigade, and says the state funds municipalities with discretion without setting detailed requirements.
We therefore have no insight into the submitted documents and the assessment, beyond what the municipality of Amsterdam publicly reports about it.
Wij hebben daarmee geen inzicht in de ingediende stukken en de beoordeling, buiten wat de gemeente Amsterdam daar publiekelijk over rapporteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bijenhof over het bericht “Europese regio’s Oost-Nederland en Noordrijn-Westfalen versterken economische banden voor innovatie en duurzaamheid”

MP Bijenhof asked the Minister of Interior about the intensified Dutch-German cross-border cooperation in Twente and North Rhine-Westphalia, the status of the Dutch-German Innovation and Technology Pact, and how bottom-up regional initiatives can link to it. The minister confirmed awareness, referred to the Twente Regio Deal II and the pact's themes, and said cooperation is coordinated through ROMs, government consultations and the Regions at the Border programme, without committing to new concrete steps.
Yes, I am aware that the border regions of East Netherlands and North Rhine-Westphalia are going to cooperate more intensively to accelerate innovation for a sustainable future.
Ja, het is voor mij bekend dat de grensregio's Oost-Nederland en Noordrijn-Westfalen intensiever gaan samenwerken om innovaties te versnellen voor een duurzame toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Geen plek meer in daklozenopvang in Utrecht en Amersfoort: 'Mensen slapen noodgedwongen op straat'

MP Kat asks how landlords select tenants, whether they may run credit checks and BKR queries, and whether people under protective administration (beschermingsbewind) are wrongly refused housing and how this is protected. The minister answers that landlords must follow the Wet goed verhuurderschap and anti-discrimination law, that protective administration is not a protected characteristic and is not a valid reason for refusal per sector bodies, and that no legal change is needed.
Having a protective administrator is moreover not discrimination. It is not a legally protected personal characteristic.
Het hebben van een beschermingsbewindvoerder is bovendien geen discriminatie. Het betreft geen persoonskenmerk dat wettelijk is beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over woningen met Energielabel A die desondanks niet goed geïsoleerd zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about homes with energy label A that are nonetheless poorly insulated, and how such labels are quality-controlled, including pre-2021 labels. The minister acknowledged the concern, described the private quality-assurance system and planned public oversight, reported that no label-A dwelling in the database is poorly insulated on all components, and pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie and landlords.
I want this to be examined further, and I can inform you that Woonconcept has indicated that an independent qualified energy adviser will check the registered energy labels.
Ik wil dat dit nader onderzocht wordt en kan u melden dat Woonconcept heeft laten weten dat een onafhankelijke vakbekwame energieadviseur de geregistreerde energielabels gaat controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Paternotte over het bericht 'Mbo’er Sem (20) zoekt al drie jaar een studentenwoning in Amsterdam: ‘Ik wil hier mijn eigen leven beginnen’'

MPs Beckerman and Paternotte asked whether it is acceptable that MBO students are refused student housing and how the government will ensure access, including whether this counts as housing discrimination and whether landlords will be engaged. The minister answered that MBO students should have access, that a Human Rights Institute advice on banning distinction by education level is being requested, and that 11 of 13 Kences corporations admit MBO students, with the rest being asked to change.

On behalf of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, I will shortly request advice from the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights on the desirability of a ban on distinction by education level in the General Equal Treatment Act.

Mede namens de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap zal ik op korte termijn advies vragen aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens over de wenselijkheid van een verbod op onderscheid naar opleidingsniveau in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling (Awgb).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Verhuurders zien het massaal niet meer zitten en zetten hun huis te koop’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the falling share of rental homes and landlords selling up, and the planned middle-segment rent regulation, are problematic for first-time buyers and movers. The minister answers that selling is not in itself a problem, that Kadaster data show no selling wave, and that the Wet Betaalbare Huur and new-build commitments keep investment attractive and middle-segment supply growing.
I will send the Affordable Rent bill to your House shortly, so that it can enter into force on 1 July 2024.
Het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur zal ik op korte termijn aan uw Kamer sturen, zodat de inwerkingtreding per 1 juli 2024 kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht 'Rendement particuliere verhuurders onder druk'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked about a study showing that the net return for private landlords falls sharply due to rising interest rates, the Wet betaalbare huur and tax measures, and whether this threatens rental supply. Minister De Jonge answered that the dataset is not representative, that the bill keeps investment in middle-rent attractive, and that the WWS will be made binding with stronger enforcement against overpriced rentals.
I will send the Wet betaalbare huur bill to your House shortly, so that it can take effect on 1 July 2024.
Het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur zal ik op korte termijn aan uw Kamer sturen, zodat de inwerkingtreding per 1 juli 2024 kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Viruswaarheid

An MP (Van Haga) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about intelligence monitoring of the Viruswaarheid group, police data collection, withheld court evidence, and alleged political prosecution of activist Engel. The minister answered that monitoring of Viruswaarheid was denied or not confirmed, that intelligence services do not comment on their methods, that withholding of case documents is governed by procedure, and rejected claims of political motivation and misconduct.
In general terms I can state that article 34 of the Code of Criminal Procedure applies to the addition of documents.
In algemene zin kan ik aangeven dat op het voegen van stukken artikel 34 van het Wetboek van Strafvordering van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over bericht ‘Sabotage in Iran: een missie in duisternis’

An SP member asked the Interior and Foreign Ministers for a timeline of the alleged AIVD operation sabotaging Iran's nuclear program, when the AIVD was approached by the CIA and Mossad, whether Parliament was informed, and whether AIVD agents routinely join foreign services' operations. The government declined on substance, citing the statutory duty of secrecy on service methods, and pointed to CTIVD oversight and the CIVD channel for any future briefing.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the services' methods, I cannot respond substantively to the alleged Dutch involvement.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de betrokkenheid van een AIVD’er bij het saboteren van het Iraanse kernwapenprogramma

MP Sneller asked the government whether the AIVD was involved in a 2007 sabotage operation against Iran's nuclear programme, who approved it, whether parliament's intelligence committee was informed, and whether the CTIVD should investigate. The minister declined to answer on the specific operation citing the statutory duty of secrecy, stated that the same rules apply abroad as at home, and said the CTIVD decides itself whether to investigate.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the methods of the services, I cannot respond substantively to the alleged involvement of the Netherlands.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de berichten 'Affaires, ruzies, gesprekken met de psychiater: Amsterdamse politici decennialang bespioneerd door de veiligheidsdienst', 'Leden van het Nederlands Auschwitz C

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior about press reports that the domestic security service BVD spied on politicians, Auschwitz Committee members and others for decades, including whether this was lawful, proportionate, and subject to political control. The minister answered that the BVD operated under a then-applicable, thinly codified legal framework in a different threat context, that the BVD kept no records of its information exchanges, and that the files were transferred to the National Archives with partial access restrictions.
The BVD did not keep track of what those services did with the information they received.
De BVD hield geen overzicht bij van wat er door die diensten met de door hen ontvangen informatie werd gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Six Dijkstra over het volgen van holocaustoverlevenden door de BVD

Six Dijkstra asked the Interior Minister how long the BVD has known it monitored Nationaal Auschwitz Comité members and survivors, whether the investigation was politically steered, whether it was justified, and whether the remaining files will be fully declassified. The minister answered that the investigations fell under ministerial responsibility, were framed by Cold War communism concerns and the historical legal context, and that the person files are partly restricted on privacy grounds but become fully public after 75 years.
This was done because the content of the personal files may affect the interests of living persons.
Dit is gedaan omdat de inhoud van de persoonsdossiers de belangen van nog levende personen kunnen raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel "'Per direct' geen stroomaansluitingen mogelijk voor nieuwbouwwoningen Almere, gemeente is geschokt"

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about reports that grid operators would stop new electricity connections in parts of Almere, and about the grid measures, communication and waiting list involved. The minister answered that small-consumer connections remain possible until 2026, that grid congestion is being addressed through the national programme with new measures and local pilots, and that a waiting list of about 210 businesses in Flevoland exists and is being worked on.
To begin with, power connections for new housing remain possible for the municipality of Almere.
Om te beginnen blijven stroomaansluitingen voor nieuwbouwwoningen mogelijk voor de gemeente Almere.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over vocht en schimmelproblematiek, enkel glas, slecht uitgevoerde renovaties, foute energielabels en flexwoningen

An SP MP asks the Minister of the Interior about damp and mould, single-glazed windows, poor renovations, incorrect energy labels and flex housing, raising tenant burdens and the adequacy of enforcement tools. The Minister answers that tenant-focused energy measures and an integrated renovation approach are pursued, that existing rules (Huurcommissie, courts, municipal enforcement) are sufficient, and rejects a national APK inspection, a national reporting point and a list of affected dwellings, while promising some follow-up such as a participation bill and survey monitoring.
As I explained in my answer to question 17, my impression is that landlords generally act timely and adequately when problems with damp and mould arise.
Antwoord 23 Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 17 heb aangegeven, heb ik het beeld dat verhuurders over het algemeen tijdig en adequaat optreden bij problemen met bij vocht en schimmel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de wenselijkheid van politieke peilingen vlak voor verkiezingen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether pre-election opinion polls distort voter behaviour (bandwagon and strategic voting) and whether they should be restricted or banned, and asked for impact analyses and media-influence studies. The Minister replied that polls are unregulated, the government has no knowledge of or intention to study their impact, does not oversee polling methods, and has no plans to regulate them.
The cabinet has no intention to submit a proposal to regulate polls.
Antwoord 14 Het kabinet heeft geen voornemens om een voorstel voor het reguleren van peilingen in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over het vertrek van demissionaire ministers

SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why he agreed to early departures of caretaker ministers, whether such exits harm continuity and public trust, and whether pensions continue. The government answered that the PM does not grant or refuse such departures, that staying is generally desirable but a personal decision, and that continuity is handled case by case; it gave no new commitment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de brief van 19 december 2023 aan de Provinciale Regietafel (PRT) Noord-Holland

Keijzer (BBB) asks whether a December 2023 letter to the Noord-Holland Provincial Regietafel, supporting an Amsterdam offer to house 1,200 extra asylum seekers in exchange for other municipalities taking statushouders, amounts to steering under the not-yet-enacted Spreidingswet, and questions the legal basis, transparency, consultation of councils and residents, and related funding. The government answers that the arrangement is voluntary under the existing Huisvestingswet, denies pre-empting Parliament, promises to send the communication and the meeting report later, and gives partial or deferred answers on several points.
We will inventory the communication between the municipality and the central government and send it to you.
Wij zullen de communicatie tussen de gemeente en het rijk inventariseren en u doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Van Esch en Van Raan over Vergunning, Toezicht en Handhaving op de BES-Eilanden

Green MPs asked the government whether permit, supervision and enforcement (VTH) on Bonaire is adequate in light of a critical Inspectorate (ILT) report, covering coastal hotels without permits, coral damage, unpermitted businesses in the marine park, and related questions on delegation to regional environmental services and planned development at Bolivia plantation. The state secretary acknowledged serious shortcomings and announced a VTH improvement programme and written responses from the island authorities, but declined to call it neglect of duty, said no binding instruction would be issued, and gave largely non-committal or deferred answers on specific sites.
I will inform the chamber shortly about the process for arriving at an assessment of the conclusions and recommendations of the ILT report.
Ik zal de kamer op korte termijn informeren over het proces om te komen tot een waardering van de conclusies en aanbevelingen van het ILT-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot, De Hoop en Soepboer over het bericht 'Hoe komt het met het Frysk in de Kamer, nu zoveel voorvechters van het toneel verdwijnen?' van 13 december 2023

MPs asked whether the duty of care for the Frisian language and culture is maintained during a change of minister, and how to finalise the delayed new Frisian language and culture administrative agreement (BFTK). The minister answered that the duty remains in force, that the existing agreement and visibility accord continue until a new one is signed (expected spring 2024), and that the successor will be briefed on the file.
A change of guard may not lead to reduced commitment to the duty of care for Frisian language and culture.
Wisseling van de wacht mag niet leiden tot een verminderde inzet voor de zorgplicht voor de Friese taal en cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over oproep tot ambtenarenprotest tegen de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a LinkedIn call for civil servants to protest the election result, questioning whether such participation is permissible and whether it constitutes refusal of work. The state secretary answered that civil servants have freedom of expression and assembly subject to Article 10 of the Civil Service Act, that the event was framed as signalling commitment to the constitution, that the government will not monitor social media or censor such calls, and that it is for employers to assess individual cases.
I am not aware of any active calls to participate in this gathering by departments, units or political office holders within the central government.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van actieve oproepen tot deelname aan deze bijeenkomst door departementen, afdelingen of bewindspersonen binnen de Rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op van vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht Bewoners de Olmenhof over vertrek uit flat: ‘Ik kan bij Leger des Heils gaan aanbellen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether tenants of De Olmenhof, who must leave a flat rented under the Leegstandwet (temporary vacancy law), are protected against homelessness, whether the law should be changed, and related questions on housing rights and the mental health effects of such rentals. The Minister answered that tenants knew the lease was temporary, that the Leegstandwet has no tenant protection by design, and that he has no intention to amend it, while pointing to municipal responsibility and planned housing-regulation legislation.
I do not intend to amend the Leegstandwet.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de Leegstandswet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de plannen voor het huisvesten van arbeidsmigranten in de gemeente Bergen op Zoom

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior about a planned housing site for 425 migrant workers on Havendijk in Bergen op Zoom, objecting to the lack of prior community dialogue and the strain on GP and police capacity. The minister answers largely by pointing to municipal responsibility, describes outreach to residents before the 2023 purchase agreement, and cites the forthcoming effect-report instrument for new business without committing to halt the project.
I am of the view that the weighing of economic interests from the establishment of businesses and safeguarding liveability must be done by the municipality concerned.
Ik ben van mening dat de afweging tussen economische belangen door vestiging van bedrijvigheid en het bewaken van de leefbaarheid door de desbetreffende gemeente moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de onafhankelijkheid van peilingorganisaties

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether government-funded or government-linked polling organisations (EenVandaag/Ipsos) exclude parties and whether this affects voters' information and independence. The minister replied that there is no regulation of polls, the government does not influence them, public broadcasters set their own content under the Mediawet, and government is not involved in poll design.
The central government exercises no influence whatsoever over polls.
De Rijksoverheid oefent geen enkele invloed uit op peilingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over het artikel 'Gelekte documenten bewijzen tot nu toe onbekende connecties tussen Rusland en de PVV'

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the Minister of Interior whether foreign donations, including from Russia, could still reach Dutch parties via intermediaries, and about follow-up to a motion and advisory report on investigating Russian financing. The minister said the ban on non-Dutch donations applies since 2023, that a penetration test of the party financing law is underway, and that the motion on investigating Russian financing is a matter for the House Presidium, not his ministry.
I expect to receive the results of this test this year.
Naar verwachting zal ik nog dit jaar de beschikking krijgen over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Temmink over ‘de financiering van politieke partijen’

Opposition MPs Marijnissen and Temmink asked the Interior Minister about political party donations from BVs, whose ultimate beneficial owners were not disclosed, and whether the EUR 100,000 donation cap and transparency rules are being circumvented. The minister answered that beneficial-owner registration applies only from 2024, that the cap is checked via accountant certification and fines, and that the rules are normative and left to parties to apply, while promising to enforce registration from 2024.

Because the obligation to also record the address details of the ultimate beneficial owner(s) for a donation from a legal entity only applies from subsidy year 2024, those details did not yet have to be provided or made public in subsidy year 2023.

Omdat de verplichting om bij een bijdrage van een rechtspersoon ook de adresgegevens van de uiteindelijk belanghebbende(n) te registreren pas van toepassing is vanaf het subsidiejaar 2024 – zie het antwoord op vraag 1 – hoefden die gegevens in het subsidiejaar 2023 nog niet te worden verstrekt noch openbaar te worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over beïnvloeding van en door de overheid op social media m.b.t. de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether government contacts with social media platforms, trusted flagger reports and campaign advertising around the 22 November 2023 elections amounted to improper interference with election content. The ministers answered that contact was limited and mainly concerned platform risk assessments, a correction of a Facebook election-date message, and a single trusted flagger report, denying any agreements on content or reach restrictions.
The Ministry of BZK uses the trusted flagger status very sparingly, and only when there is a risk to the organisation, conduct and integrity of the electoral process.
Het Ministerie van BZK zet de trusted flagger status zeer terughoudend in, en alleen wanneer er een risico bestaat voor de organisatie, uitvoering en integriteit van het verkiezingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over openbare pachtveilingen van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf

An MP asked the ministers why public tenders by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (government property agency) of farmland, including an organically farmed plot in Almere, did not state organic use and allowed bulb cultivation, and how this fits the 15% organic farming target. The minister answered that a binding crop plan applied, organic use was not known to the agency because the outgoing tenant did not provide it, the agency rewards organic bids, and that a joint study will examine stimulating organic farming on regular leases, while the buffer-zone question falls outside any binding rule.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de 'Borselse voorwaarden voor een kerncentrale'

MP Grinwis asked the government how it views the 39 'Borsele conditions' for new nuclear plants, the process behind them, and whether it will meet them on landscape, cooling towers and underground cabling. The minister answered that the conditions are still being consolidated with the municipality and province, that substantive assessment is premature, and that the government will weigh them in the siting decision.
At this moment it is too early to respond substantively to the conditions.
Het is op dit moment te vroeg om inhoudelijk in te gaan op de voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een kwart van de speeltuinen binnen vijf jaar dreigt te verdwijnen

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether they would act on reports that a quarter of playgrounds may close within five years and whether a sports/play norm, a statutory basis for playgrounds, and more support for volunteers were planned. The minister said the data cannot establish the severity, that playground policy is a municipal responsibility, that the government is studying the added value of statutory anchoring, and that it cannot guarantee playgrounds will survive.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de GDV bekostiging voor apotheken

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the NZa's revised GDV pharmacy payment, whether it encourages deprescribing, and the pharmacist's role in deprescribing medicines prescribed by specialists. The minister agreed that drug use is multifactorial and that deprescribing matters, noted that the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven suspended the revised payment rule for lacking evidence it promotes deprescribing, and said talks with the sector on pharmacist-GP collaboration continue with an update promised this year.
The College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (CBb) ruled that the NZa had not substantiated that the new declaration rule actually promotes deprescribing of medicines.
Het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (CBb) heeft geoordeeld dat de NZa niet heeft onderbouwd dat met het nieuwe declaratievoorschrift afbouw van medicijnen daadwerkelijk wordt bevorderd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Tot hoever kan XR gaan met snelwegblokkades?’

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about Extinction Rebellion motorway blockades and whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) was right not to prosecute arrested protesters under the Public Assemblies Act, given the disruption to police capacity. The minister answered that the OM decides prosecution independently, that arrests and registration were made, that registration was dropped due to disproportionate capacity strain, and that the local triangle handles demonstrations.
The OM has decided not to prosecute persons arrested for violating the Public Assemblies Act.
Het OM heeft besloten om geen strafvervolging in te stellen tegen personen die zijn aangehouden voor overtreding van de Wet openbare manifestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het per direct invoeren van een asielstop en stoppen met de voorrang van statushouders op woningen

Mr Van Haga asks whether, since all asylum reception locations are full, a immediate asylum stop should be introduced and priority housing for status holders ended. The government answers that international and EU law prevent an asylum stop, that it will keep asking municipalities for reception places, and that municipalities legally must house status holders in time and may decide on urgency status themselves.
In addition, international treaties and European law prevent an asylum stop from being introduced.
Daarnaast beletten internationale verdragen en Europees recht om een asielstop in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over het advies van het Adviescollege Openbaarheid en Informatiehuishouding (ACOI) over de Wet open overheid (Woo)

Temmink (SP) asked the government how it will respond to the ACOI report showing journalists distrust the handling of Woo freedom-of-information requests, and whether a culture of obstruction exists in ministries. The state secretary acknowledged late handling and the need for improvement, promised a government response to the Woo implementation test in the first half of 2024, and denied recognizing a pattern of acting outside Woo rules but accepted that obstruction concerns warrant attention.
I am asking the government commissioner for information management and the ACOI to reflect on the Woo implementation test and issue advice in response.
Ik vraag de regeringscommissaris Informatiehuishouding en het ACOI te reflecteren op de Woo-invoeringstoets en een advies uit te brengen naar aanleiding hiervan
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over het artikel ‘Het CBR weet al jaren van fraude bij theorie-examens. Het doet bijna niks tegen “turbo-opleiders”, wel tegen klokkenluiders.’
