An SP MP asked the ministers about CBR knowledge of exam fraud by 'turbo' driving schools, the CBR's response to whistleblower evidence, and whether whistleblowers were prosecuted. The minister answered that CBR has taken many anti-fraud measures, filed a complaint and report against an individual, denied prosecuting whistleblowers under the Whistleblower Act, and said consultations on further measures are ongoing.
It is incorrect that the CBR would have taken the persons who supplied the evidence to court.
Het is onjuist dat het CBR de personen die het bewijs aanleverden voor de rechter zou hebben gedaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het Woo-verzoek m.b.t. het noodbevel van de Driehoek Den Haag aangaande de demonstratie van Farmers Defence Force van 29 juni 2023

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Interior about the Hague mayor's emergency order and the restriction of a 29 June 2023 farmers' protest near parliament, including whether the Speaker of the House interfered, the use of tractors, the lack of advance notice, and whether mayors should be the ones to restrict demonstrations. The minister answered that the Speaker only discussed the scenario and had no decision-making role, that each demonstration is assessed individually by the local authority, and that mayors are accountable to the municipal council.
That the Speaker of the House was consulted about this is not unusual.
Dat hierover is gesproken met de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer is niet vreemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Koerhuis, Van der Plas enWesterveld over dreigende huisuitzettingen van weeskinderen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she knew of threatened evictions of at least five orphaned young adults from social rental homes before the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act takes effect, and how to prevent them and hold housing corporations to the law's spirit. The minister agreed such evictions must be prevented, said corporations should already act in the spirit of the law and that she is in close contact with Aedes to find solutions, and targets entry into force on 1 January 2024.
I am in close contact with Aedes to ensure a suitable solution in the spirit of the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act in the situations mentioned.
Ik heb nauw contact met Aedes om in de genoemde situaties te zorgen voor een passende oplossing in de geest van de Wet huurbescherming weeskinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het voorgenomen besluit om arbeidsmigranten te huisvesten in het buurtschap Vrilkhoven, gelegen in Liempde (gemeente Boxtel)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing 400 migrant workers for slaughterhouse Vion in a hamlet near Boxtel should be opposed, whether the national government's lawyer should have been deployed against concerned residents, and whether the business model relying on mass labour migration is acceptable. The Minister replied that the decision rests with the municipality, pointed to ongoing municipal dialogue, a complaint-management system and the BER instrument under development, and said the Landsadvocaat review found the permit process was carefully conducted.
I am of the view that the weighing of economic interests from establishing business activity against safeguarding liveability must take place at the relevant municipality.
Ik ben van mening dat de afweging tussen economische belangen door vestiging van bedrijvigheid en het bewaken van de leefbaarheid door de desbetreffende gemeente moet plaatsvinden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot, Erkens, Bontenbal en Geurts over het bericht ‘Verduurzaming van koopwoningen komt bij gedeeld huizenbezit slecht van de grond’

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the minister why energy-efficiency upgrades in shared-ownership apartment buildings stall when homeowners' associations (VvE) do not approve them, and what could be done. The minister answered all eleven questions, citing a VvE acceleration agenda with lower decision thresholds, support tools, subsidies, and possible future legislation, while rejecting a rule giving VvEs unconditional competence over sustainability.
I do not intend to prepare legislation to that effect.
Ik ben niet voornemens wetgeving met die strekking te gaan voorbereiden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen inzake het artikel ‘Nederlandse gemeenten overtreden massaal de wet door achterkamertjes in te duiken’

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that municipalities hold informal closed meetings bypassing public council rules, and whether such meetings should be regulated under open-government principles. The Minister replied that council and committee meetings are public by law and closed sessions are an exception requiring justification and a majority vote, that informal gatherings outside the Municipal Act are not prohibited but must not replace formal meetings, and that he will issue a circular on committee types and consult the VNG and council associations rather than seek Raad van State advice.

This starting point emerges, among other things, in the college's duty to inform that applies towards the council as a whole, even when the information is requested by one or more individual council members.

Dit uitgangspunt komt onder meer naar voren in de inlichtingenplicht van het college die jegens de raad als geheel geldt, ook als de inlichtingen door een of meer individuele raadsleden worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over dreigende sluiting ziekenhuis Parkstad

MP Van Haga asks whether the minister knows that Zuyderland/Parkstad hospital may lose its inpatient beds and emergency department by 2030, whether the minister will work to keep it, and how Parkstad's poverty and health problems bear on this. The minister replies that two options are under consideration, that the region's care must be reorganised within the IZA framework with the hospital and insurers deciding, and that he will follow the regional plan closely without committing to a specific step to preserve the hospital.
I will continue to follow the elaboration of the regional plan and the scenarios closely.
Ik blijf de uitwerking van het regioplan en de scenario's nauw volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de hertellingsprocedure bij de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how recounts for the 2022 Tweede Kamer election are made public, which safeguards and protocols apply, and whether audits, sealing and documentation ensure transparency. The Minister answered that counting and recounts are public, that procedures are set by the Kieswet with multiple checks, that counting is manual with independently tested software, and that recounts and corrigenda are documented and published.
The counting of the votes is public.
De telling van de stemmen is openbaar voor publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski en Minhas  over het bericht ‘Ernstig lek bij Kadaster: miljoenen woonadressen door iedereen op te zoeken’

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked the minister about a leak at the Kadaster that let anyone look up residential addresses by name, and about the measures taken, the planned law change, data-breach notification and access logging. The minister answered that the leak has been closed, that verification of existing business accounts is nearly complete, that a Kadasterbesluit amendment restricting name search is being prepared, and that affected persons are being informed.
The leak in the registration procedure has now been fully closed.
Het lek in de aanmeldprocedure is inmiddels volledig gedicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht 'Stress en zenuwen maken eigenaar haringkraam Binnenhof kapot: ‘Met herseninfarct in ziekenhuis’'

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior about the owner of a herring stall near the Binnenhof whose business has suffered from renovation works, asking what happened to his objections, why his suggestions (distance of hoarding, walkway through the stall, transparent hoarding) were not adopted, and whether a viewing tower for tourists outweighs his wellbeing. The minister answered that consultation continues, that some suggestions were adopted (relocated entrance, transparent hoarding facing the stall), that further relocation is not possible for construction safety, and that the viewing tower is part of agreed measures to keep visitor numbers up.
At the request of Mr Buutveld, the construction hoardings placed opposite his stall will be made transparent.
Op verzoek van de heer Buutveld worden de bouwschuttingen die geplaatst worden tegenover zijn kraam transparant gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat ecologisch onderzoek nodig is bij het isoleren van spouwmuren

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers about the Council of State ruling that ecological research is required before insulating cavity walls, including effects on costs, speed and energy poverty. The minister acknowledges the ruling, outlines a medium-term plan of municipal species management plans and a task force, and refers several questions to a Kamerbrief without giving concrete figures on individual research costs.
See the letter to the House of Representatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Experts: adviesbureaus nemen taak ambtenaren over bij energietransitie’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities and provinces lack expertise for the energy transition, whether consultancies are awarded contracts without public tender, whether Klimaatroute (a subsidiary of Essent) can claim independence, and how local civil servants are being supported. The minister acknowledged capacity shortages, pointed to a 1.04 billion euro CDOKE scheme, a forthcoming ROB review, and the NPLW programme, and said tenders below EU thresholds are not mandatory and that customers must be able to trust independent advice without committing to new rules.
Households must be able to trust that they receive independent and good advice – especially when this is carried out under the responsibility of a municipality.
Huishoudens moeten er op kunnen vertrouwen dat hen onafhankelijk en goed advies wordt gegeven – zeker indien dit onder de verantwoordelijkheid van een gemeente wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het NRC-artikel inzake de uitspraak van de Raad van State aangaande vleermuisbescherming en de gevolgen hiervan t.a.v. woningisolatie

An MP asked the Minister whether a Council of State ruling on bat protection, which complicates cavity-wall insulation of private homes, would be countered by exemptions from ecological research, changes to the general duty of care, or recognition of provincial species management plans. The Minister answered that existing exemptions continue, that a separate letter sets out a route for homeowners, and that the target for 2030 is not expected to be endangered, while largely deferring details to that letter.
For the short-term and long-term course of action I refer you to the letter to the House 'approach to nature-inclusive insulation: guidance and next steps'.
Over het handelingsperspectief op korte termijn en lange termijn verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief «aanpak natuurinclusief isoleren: handvatten en vervolgstappen».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Canadese vastgoedbelegger zet duizenden Nederlandse huurhuizen te koop'

The MP Beckerman asks the Minister about reports that Canadian investor ERES is selling thousands of Dutch rental homes, and about whether investors should be relied on for affordable housing versus public or social landlords. The Minister says ERES is only conducting a strategic review, defends a mixed system of corporations and investors, and declines to change ownership or to take steps beyond monitoring the situation.
As stated in the answer to question 2, ERES REIT is conducting an internal review and no decision has yet been taken on what it intends to do with its housing portfolio.
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 doet ERES REIT een intern onderzoek en is er nog geen besluit genomen over hetgeen zij met hun woningportefeuille willen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Temmink over het bericht dat de gemeente Den Haag, in navolging van de gemeente Deventer, cameradrones toepast bij het inspecteren van dakkapellen en uitbouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Temmink asked about municipalities using camera drones to inspect dakkapellen and extensions, raising privacy, DPIA, aviation permit, retention, anonymisation and legality concerns. The Minister answered that municipalities are responsible for privacy compliance, that Deventer and Den Haag have taken steps (DPIA, notices, blurring, limited retention), and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and courts will judge lawfulness.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for compliance with privacy legislation.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over ‘Gelderse woondeals dreigen te mislukken: niet door stikstof, maar door ambtenarentekort’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that Gelderland's housing deals risk failing due to a shortage of municipal civil servants, and about federal capacity support (flexpool funds) and the reduction of planning complexity. The Minister answered that the province estimates a shortage of 100 to 204 FTE, that the ministry supports housing projects through various teams and funds, and that a plan of action on faster procedures is underway, while stating that a commitment on the shortfall had been made to regional provinces without concrete new structural funding.
When drafting the housing deals, the housing construction target was used as the starting point.
Bij het opstellen van de woondeals is de volkshuisvestelijke bouwopgave als uitgangspunt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over niet toegestane huurstijgingen

The MP asks the minister whether rent increase clauses in private-sector leases may be unlawful under the EU unfair terms directive, and whether the government will analyse, quantify and remedy possibly excessive rents. The minister says the matter is for courts and parties to the contract, that he lacks data to analyse individual leases, and that he is monitoring developments and talking with tenant and landlord representatives, leaving redress to tenant organisations.
Rental contracts are a matter between landlord and tenant; they require no registration with a third body and are therefore known only to the landlord and tenant concerned.

Huurcontracten zijn een aangelegenheid van en tussen verhuurder en huurder; huurcontracten vereisen geen registratie bij een derde instantie en zijn dus alleen bekend bij de betreffende verhuurder en huurder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Kabinet blijft onvermurwbaar: geen broodnodige studentenhuizen of woningen onder aanvliegroute Schiphol’

Opposition MP Boulakjar (D66) asked ministers why the government blocks student and other housing at Kronenburg under the Schiphol flight path, despite the regional housing shortage, and why an advisor's options were not adopted. The minister answers that noise and safety rules under the LIB restrict housing there, that a 438-home first phase or short-stay units could be explored with Amstelveen, and that no quick route to building is available.
The national government asked in an official-level meeting with the municipality of Amstelveen to examine whether housing plans for Kronenburg could be made that address this complex problem.
Het Rijk heeft hierop in een ambtelijk gesprek met de gemeente Amstelveen gevraagd om te kijken of er woningbouwplannen voor Kronenburg zijn te maken die recht doen aan deze complexe problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Zaltbommel zet alle nieuwe bouwplannen een jaar lang in de ijskast'

MPs Minhas and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Minister for Housing about reports that the municipality of Zaltbommel would freeze new building plans for a year because of the Environment and Planning Act, given the housing shortage. The minister replied that Zaltbommel still processes permit applications, only pausing new zoning plans, that a temporary stop of permit applications is legally impossible, and that he is working with the VNG and regional implementation supporters to prevent further delays.
For municipal councils there is room to temporarily refrain from adopting new zoning plans.
Voor gemeenteraden bestaat er wel ruimte om tijdelijk af te zien van het vaststellen van nieuwe bestemmingsplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Huisbazen kunnen meer huur vragen door regels te omzeilen'

MP Nijboer asks whether the government will act on reports that landlords evade rent-regulation rules through group contracts and that property lawyers advise this without consequence. The minister replies that contract form does not avoid the WWS/WWSO point system, that group contracts are not banned but misuse is undesirable, and that the Wet betaalbare huur will strengthen tenants' position.
With the Affordable Rent Bill I am strengthening the position of tenants.
Met het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur versterk ik de positie van huurders.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Woningcorporatiebazen privé actief als vastgoedbelegger, sector scherpt integriteitscode aan’

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about reports that housing corporation executives privately rent out homes for profit, sometimes near corporation projects and with linked contractors, and how conflicts of interest can be prevented. The Minister called such conflicts undesirable, endorsed the sector's stricter governance code with a 'no, unless' rule on profit-driven rental, and said the regulator Aw sees no need for additional measures for now.
Conflicts of interest (or the appearance of them) must be prevented at all times.
Belangenverstrengeling (of de schijn daarvan) moet te allen tijde worden voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk (CDA) en Van Baarle (DENK) over het bericht dat commissarissen en bestuurders bij zo'n twintig woningcorporaties privéhuizen blijken te verhuren voor persoonlijk rendement

Two MPs asked the minister about a report that board members and supervisory directors of about twenty housing corporations rent out private homes for personal profit, and whether this is incompatible with their roles. The minister says conflicts of interest must be prevented, endorses a stricter 'no, unless' governance code rule drafted by Aedes and VTW, and says the Autoriteit woningcorporaties sees no reason yet for its own additional measures.
Conflicts of interest (or the appearance of them) must be prevented at all times.
Belangenverstrengeling (of de schijn daarvan) moet te allen tijde worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over van het bericht ‘Woningcorporatiebazen privé actief als vastgoedbelegger, sector scherpt integriteitscode aan’

An MP asked the housing minister about reports that housing corporation executives also own private rental property, whether this constitutes a systemic integrity problem, whether the sector's integrity code is adequate, and whether the Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) failed to detect it. The minister answered that the corporations' supervisory boards and the Aw are responsible for follow-up, that the sector's governance code is being tightened to a 'no, unless' principle, and that the Aw sees no reason yet for additional measures.
In the first instance it is up to the corporations themselves, and in particular their Supervisory Boards (RvC), to further investigate the cases raised in the Nieuwsuur research.

Het is in eerste instantie aan de corporaties zelf, en in het bijzonder de Raden van Commissarissen (RvC) om de casussen die in het onderzoek van Nieuwsuur naar voren zijn gebracht verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over niet-toegelaten instellingen

MPs asked why tenants with low incomes of non-admitted housing providers were excluded from the one-off rent reduction given to social housing tenants of admitted housing associations, and whether this could be changed. The minister answered that the rent reduction is a legal duty only for admitted associations, that extending it to private landlords would infringe property rights and is impractical, and that other landlords may voluntarily grant it on tenant request.
Other landlords other than housing associations are free to lower rent for low-income tenants to €575.03, like housing associations, but they are not legally obliged to do so.

Het staat andere verhuurders dan woningcorporaties vrij om net als woningcorporaties de huur voor huurders met een laag inkomen naar € 575,03 te verlagen, maar zij zijn daartoe niet wettelijk verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het schieten met een pistool en mitrailleur op een foto van mijn hoofd

The MP Wilders asks whether the government is aware of a video showing a threat against him, whether the AIVD and NCTV were informed, what steps are taken to trace the perpetrator, and whether diplomatic measures will be taken if the video comes from Pakistan. The minister condemns the threat, declines to comment on intelligence and protection matters or on the individual investigation, and says the Pakistani ambassador would be informed of concerns and that a legal assistance request is possible.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I cannot go into individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘De notaris, de katvanger en de waakhond’

An SP MP asks the housing minister, after a Groene Amsterdammer article alleging large profits and weak oversight in the sale of about 1,100 social rental homes by housing corporations, whether the sales harmed tenants, whether oversight failed, and whether sales should stop. The minister rejects the allegations as unproven (noting a court ordered the article rectified), defends a well-considered sales policy, says the Aw and BFT oversight was adequate, and commits to an evaluation of appraiser independence due end 2023.
I have no indications that board members generally fall short in this regard.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat bestuurders hierin in het algemeen tekort schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Nijboer over de Amsterdamse voorrangsregeling op woningen voor docenten, die nog altijd onvoldoende merkbaar is voor onderwijspersoneel dat daar werkt

MPs Mohandis and Nijboer asked whether Amsterdam's priority housing scheme for teachers is effective given housing scarcity, what national rules hinder it, and how teacher shortages can be tackled. The government answered that 99 social and 29 mid-rent homes were allocated to teachers, that scarcity persists, that a law change lets municipalities allocate up to 50% of freed affordable rentals to vital professions, and that regional teacher-shortage convenants and wage measures are being pursued.
It is up to the municipalities to weigh the interests of the different groups of housing seekers carefully when making policy.
Het is aan de gemeenten om de belangen tussen de verschillende groepen woningzoekenden goed te wegen bij het maken van beleid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurders die na verhuizing naar een andere woningcorporatiewoning niet in aanmerking komen voor de huurverlaging op basis van de Wet huurverlaging voor huurders met een lager i

An MP asked why tenants who moved to another housing corporation dwelling after 1 March 2023 lose the right to the 2023 rent reduction, and what would be done for them. The minister confirmed that only sitting tenants on 1 March 2023 qualify, that people who moved are therefore excluded, and that the rent in the new dwelling is already passend for their income, while committing to no change.
Tenants who now switch corporation dwellings therefore do not meet the statutory requirements for the rent reduction.
Huurders die nu van woningcorporatiewoning wisselen voldoen daardoor niet aan de wettelijke vereisten voor de huurverlaging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Nieuwbouwprojecten geschrapt, bedrijven zoeken manieren om door te bouwen’

An MP from the VVD asked the housing minister about reports that building projects were being cancelled, the expected drop in housing construction, the Startbouwimpuls subsidy, and how to secure locations and flexible housing in the face of local resistance. The minister answered in detail, pointing to regional housing deals, planning and versnellingstafels, the Startbouwimpuls scheme, and the upcoming Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting, while noting that overruling municipalities would be a lengthy legal process.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het mogelijk verbod op onderkeldering in Amsterdam

SP MP Beckerman asked the housing minister about a possible ban on basement excavation in Amsterdam after subsidence damage, the ombudsman's criticism of compensation-based redress, and the role of Blackstone. The minister answered that the municipality reports no link between the damage and the excavation and no Blackstone involvement, points to legal aid and private-law recourse against contractors, and notes Amsterdam's groundwater permit policy without committing to a new ban or compensation scheme.
Unless the damage can be demonstrably attributed to the government, there is no liability or obligation to compensate by the government.
Tenzij eventuele schade aantoonbaar aan de overheid te wijten is, is er geen sprake van aansprakelijkheid of een plicht tot compensatie door de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurders die via de intermediaire verhuur niet in aanmerking komen voor de huurverlaging op basis van de Wet eenmalige huurverlaging 2023

Deputy Nijboer asked whether tenants renting corporation homes via care organisations (intermediary rental) are excluded from the one-off rent reduction under the 2023 law, and whether the minister would act to extend it to them. Minister De Jonge confirmed the exclusion, explained that care organisations fall outside the statutory income-check obligation and that tax data cannot be shared with them, said he sees no legal means to enforce it, and only encouraged corporations and care providers to make voluntary arrangements.
I currently have no insight into the extent to which housing corporations and care institutions make such agreements.
Ik heb op dit moment geen inzicht in de mate waarin woningcorporaties en zorginstellingen dergelijke afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Rijk kan kant-en-klare flexwoningen niet kwijt'

The MP Beckerman (SP) asks the Minister for Housing about reports that the state cannot place pre-ordered prefab flex-homes, and about their quality, location, tenancy security, cost and risks. The Minister acknowledges slow uptake, gives stock and placement figures, defends flex-homes as a quick way to add social housing and a flexible buffer, and largely refuses to concede the criticisms.
I am aware of this report. I acknowledge that practice has proven more stubborn than hoped.
Ik ben bekend met dit bericht. Ik erken dat de praktijk weerbarstiger is gebleken dan gehoopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het bericht dat de provincie Zeeland geen geld ontvangt uit het Volkshuisvestingsfonds

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg asked whether Zeeland received no money from the Volkshuisvestingsfonds despite submitting eligible projects, and how regional distribution is decided. The minister replied that Zeeland's 2021 applications scored too low on effectiveness and efficiency, that Utrecht was similarly affected, and that prioritisation for border and shrinkage regions was raised for 2023.

It is important to take regional differences into account, and in line with the answer to question 4 this is further elaborated in the multi-year specific grant scheme for housing restructuring underlying the 2023 Housing Fund.

Het is van belang om rekening te houden met regionale verschillen en in lijn met het antwoord op vraag 4 is dat nader uitgewerkt in de Meerjarige regeling specifieke uitkering herstructurering volkshuisvesting
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht ‘Martin botst met woonstichting om oneerlijke compensatie energiekosten: het is ons geld’

MPs De Groot and Erkens asked the minister why a housing corporation planned to credit the energy compensation for shared connections only in June 2024, and what tools exist to make landlords apply and pass on the subsidy. The minister answered that crediting must follow the existing payment periodicity and cost-allocation key, that landlords must apply and tenants can use the Huurcommissie or courts, and that a Kadaster application will show applications per connection.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Iedere wijk een straatje erbij’

An MP from the CDA asked the housing minister whether municipalities should be made able to add small clusters of affordable homes to neighbourhoods and villages, and how to remove barriers. The minister agreed in principle, said EIB research on practical obstacles is due in August, and said the Ladder for sustainable urban development may be revised, without committing to a firm timetable beyond sending that review before summer.
I am also examining whether an adjustment of the Ladder for Sustainable Urban Development is needed to remove obstacles to building on the edges of cities and villages.
Daarnaast onderzoek ik ook of een aanpassing van de Ladder voor Duurzame verstedelijking nodig is om belemmeringen weg te nemen om te kunnen bouwen aan de randen van steden en dorpen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over aan de minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening over het bericht dat minister van staat Sorgdrager en oud-minister Van Aartsen oproepen om de Omgevingswet niet i

An MP asked the housing minister how he responds to calls by Minister of State Sorgdrager and former minister Van Aartsen to scrap the Environment and Planning Act before its 2024 entry into force, and whether he will investigate scrapping it. The minister rejects scrapping, says the law was democratically adopted and that implementation will be monitored, with progress letters and annual monitoring after entry into force.
On the state of implementation you will receive a progress letter on 30 June 2023 and in October 2023.
Over de stand van zaken van de implementatie ontvangt u op 30 juni 2023 en in oktober 2023 een voortgangsbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het wegnemen van obstakels om recreatiewoningen te bestemmen voor permanente bewoning

An MP asked the minister whether recreational homes converted to permanent dwellings count as new housing under the Schiphol airport zoning decree (LIB), and whether obstacles to such conversion would be removed. The minister answered that conversions of existing recreational homes are not new housing locations under the LIB, that obstacles are being discussed with provinces and gemeenten, and that he will talk with Nieuwkoop and Zuid-Holland.

In view of this, existing recreational homes that are converted into dwellings do not fall under the concept of a new housing location and therefore not under the prohibition in article 2.2.1d, first paragraph, of the LIB.

Gelet hierop vallen bestaande recreatiewoningen die worden getransformeerd naar woningen niet onder het begrip nieuwe woningbouwlocatie en dus evenmin onder het verbod van artikel 2.2.1d, eerste lid, van het LIB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Statushouders niet tevreden met flexwoning: weigeren contract te tekenen'

MPs De Groot and Brekelmans asked about refugees in Rijswijk refusing flex housing contracts, how many are in reception, and what measures the government will take. The minister says refusal is unacceptable, that under 3% of refusals led to eviction, that no ultimatum can be set since municipalities decide, and that a handreiking for municipalities is being prepared.
The cabinet is not in a position to set such an ultimatum in situations such as in Rijswijk.
Het kabinet is niet in de positie om een dergelijk ultimatum te stellen in situaties zoals in Rijswijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over voortdurend nalatig onderhoud van Woonbron

MP Nijboer asked the minister about persistent neglected maintenance at Woonbron, including heating failures and mould in the Oostblok complex, and whether the minister would act. The minister said the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties reports agreements have been reached to fix the heating before the season, that tenants can use the Huurcommissie, courts or municipal enforcement, and that corporations must invest more in housing quality.
I take tenant complaints seriously, but ultimately it is up to the landlord to act.
Ik neem klachten van huurders serieus, maar het is uiteindelijk aan de verhuurder om iets te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de jarenlange wachtlijsten voor sociale huurwoningen voor Nederlanders

An MP asks the housing minister how he responds to Dutch social-rent applicants who wait for years because urgency categories such as status holders get priority, and whether he will end this. The minister says he shares the goal of enough affordable housing, points to the national housing agenda and a programme for priority groups, rejects the claim that about 150,000 homes went to status holders, and states that refusal of homes by status holders is unacceptable with strict policy applied.
Everyone must be able to live well.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Almere krijgt laatste kans om zelf woningen aan te wijzen voor statushouders'

An MP asked the Minister for Housing why Almere missed its quotas for housing status holders, whether the central government will help, and whether flexible housing can speed up placements. The minister explains the pressures on Almere's social housing stock, notes provincial supervision of quota compliance, lists support instruments and says he is already in contact with Almere and Flevoland on flexible housing.
The central government in principle has no role in individual conversations with municipalities.
Het Rijk heeft in principe geen rol in individuele gesprekken met gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Boucke over het artikel 'Lenen voor zonnepanelen levert vaak gratis geld op: 'Jammer dat mensen dit niet weten''

MPs Boulakjar and Boucke asked the Minister for Housing about homeowners' limited awareness of subsidies and green loans for home insulation and solar panels, following a news report. The minister replied that the government is improving information via Verbeterjehuis.nl, mortgage advice rules and municipal programmes, without a detailed timeline for every measure.
The intention is to take the energy label of the home into account in mortgage lending norms from 1 January 2024.
Het voornemen is om bij de leennormen voor de hypotheek vanaf 1 januari 2024 rekening te houden met het energielabel van de woning
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Eigen Huis: subsidieaanvraag voor groen huis rompslomp'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about reports that homeowners find the ISDE green subsidy application cumbersome. The minister acknowledged the procedure can be simpler, pointed to RVO website and form improvements and planned work with stakeholders and behavioural insights, but offered no formal change to the process.
Following the results of the Vereniging Eigen Huis complaints desk, I want to investigate further, using behavioural insights, how the application process can be simplified further.

Naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten van het meldpunt van de Vereniging Eigen Huis wil ik met gebruikmaking van gedragsinzichten nog beter onderzoeken hoe het aanvraagproces verder vereenvoudigd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het Nationaal Fonds Betaalbare Koopwoning

MP Nijboer asks why the planned Nationaal Fonds Betaalbare Koopwoningen targets starters at 1.5 to 2 times average income rather than the 1 to 2 times group proposed by OpMaat, and what the government will do for single starters earning too much for social rent but too little for the fund. Minister De Jonge replies that 1.5 to 2 times modal is the group most likely to use the fund given the price cap and discount, that lower-income starters are not excluded, and points to rent regulation and a municipal housing-permit bill as measures for middle incomes.
It is not a condition that future buyers must have at least 1.5 times modal as household income. It is not a lower limit.
Het is geen voorwaarde dat toekomstige kopers minimaal 1,5 modaal als huishoudinkomen moeten hebben. Het is geen ondergrens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de totstandkoming van de prijs van het Paleis Soestdijk

An MP asked the minister for Housing and Spatial Planning whether the sale price of Paleis Soestdijk was too low relative to land value and why the valuation behind it is still not disclosed six years on. The minister replied that the price was set through an open tender with the highest bid accepted, that the RVB checked it against an external valuation, and that this valuation is commercially confidential and will not be published.
This valuation is commercially confidential and not public.
Deze taxatie is commercieel vertrouwelijk en niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over strandbebouwing en de toestemming voor de exploitatie van stranden door het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, met name het Zuiderstrand in Den Haag

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about state-owned beaches, including The Hague's Zuiderstrand, and whether municipalities may rent beach space to commercial operators under the lease framework and Kustpact. The minister answered that the State owns the beaches, that a long-standing lease with The Hague remains in force and is lawful, that permanent beach buildings remain subject to permits and provincial zoning, and that the State has no direct role in new municipal plans.

I assume that developments arising from the municipality's study will be discussed with all involved Kustpact partners and that the choices fit within the zoning and agreements set under the Kustpact.

Ik ga ervan uit dat ontwikkelingen die voortkomen uit het onderzoek door de gemeente met alle betrokken kustpactpartijen besproken worden en de keuzes passen binnen de zonering en de afspraken die in het kader van het kustpact zijn vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het vervolg van de financiële impuls huisvesting grote gezinnen

An MP asked about the results of the earlier pilot grant for housing large refugee families, its distribution across municipalities, and why the new subsidy is run by RVO and open first-come first-served rather than via a specific grant. The minister answered that 24 municipalities were selected, 17 large families were housed by January 2022 with no measurable acceleration, the new scheme opens in July 2023, and it deliberately avoids a fixed application window while monitoring regional spread.
That is why it is logical for municipalities to submit the application.
Daarom ligt het voor de hand dat gemeenten de aanvraag indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de onduidelijkheid voor VvE’s om digitaal officiële vergaderingen te beleggen

An MP asked about uncertainty for VvEs (homeowners' associations) over holding digital meetings, the status of the consultation on the digital general meeting law, and debt-collection practices by state agencies that may breach subsistence minimums. The minister answered that the digital meeting law is pending, that agencies will improve communication and criteria for bespoke payment arrangements, and that a uniform subsistence norm and possible legislation are being explored.
I want to examine whether it is possible to safeguard the subsistence minimum based on the attachment-free amount or the free amount.
Ik wil onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om het bestaansminimum te borgen op basis van de beslagvrije voet of het vrij te laten bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de tweet 'Wat zóu het helpen als dit soort kwaadaardigheid geen podium meer zou krijgen'

An FvD MP asked Minister De Jonge whether his tweet calling for a critical Telegraaf journalist to be denied a platform meant he wanted her dismissed or cancelled, and whether this was government policy given press freedom. The minister denied calling for dismissal, said he was urging responsibility in public speech, and affirmed press freedom is untouchable.
I want to emphasise that in the tweet, as you can read, I did not call for the dismissal of a journalist.
Ik wil benadrukken dat ik in de tweet, zoals u kunt lezen, niet heb opgeroepen tot het ontslag van een journaliste.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over Microsoft datacentrum zonder bouw- en stikstofvergunningen

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning how Microsoft could continue building a data centre without building and nitrogen permits, and what the roles of the state, province and municipality are. The Minister answered that the province of Noord-Holland, via regional environmental services, granted an environmental permit on 19 April 2023 (not yet irrevocable) after provisional tolerance decisions allowed construction to start, and that an independent study of nature permit enforcement will be conducted.
The competent authority for permit granting, supervision and enforcement is the province of Noord-Holland.
Het bevoegd gezag voor vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving is provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Microsoft bouwt al een jaar aan een datacentrum zonder bouw- en stikstofvergunningen’

MP Bromet asked the ministers whether Microsoft may continue building a data centre and high-voltage substation without permits, why construction was not halted after a Council of State ruling, which nature areas suffer nitrogen overload, whether the central government can halt the works, and how the confusion over permitting between Hollands Kroon and the province arose. The ministers answered that tolerance decisions were issued before the ruling, the environmental permit was granted on 19 April, the central government can intervene only in extreme cases under the Provinciewet, and the permitting confusion arose from new IPPC interpretations.
The central government, through inter-governmental supervision, is the supervisor of the provincial administrative bodies.
Het Rijk is vanuit het interbestuurlijk toezicht toezichthouder op de bestuursorganen van de provincies

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot, Boulakjar en Van Ginneken over de Kaderrichtlijn Water (hierna: KRW) en het rapport ‘Een KRW-risicoanalyse voor de vergunningverlening voor de bouw- en infrasector’

MPs from D66 asked the government whether the Water Framework Directive (KRW) targets will be met, and about the construction-sector risk analysis claiming large losses if permits are restricted by missed targets. The minister answered that no guarantee can be given, disputes the report's conclusions and scale of risk, and says the government will consult the European Commission on possible exceptions.
However, guarantees that all KRW targets will be met cannot be given.
Garanties dat alle KRW-doelen gehaald worden kunnen echter niet gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over de financiering van de Stichting Schooldakrevolutie

SGP MPs asked whether central government funding for the Stichting Schooldakrevolutie (a foundation supporting schools with solar panels) is being stopped and why. The minister denies that funding stops, explains the subsidy is being phased out with a final one-off payment in 2024 and that the foundation must operate independently from 2025, while pointing to the Maatschappelijk Vastgoed programme and agreeing to the value of continued work.
A one-off subsidy will still be granted for the year 2024.
Er wordt nog eenmalig subsidie toegekend voor het jaar 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over het bericht dat in de wijk van de toekomst plek is voor 10.000 mensen, 21.500 fietsen en 0 auto’s

Two VVD MPs asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Housing ministers about a report on the car-free Merwede neighbourhood in Utrecht, including emergency access, affordable housing share, completion timing and use of national housing-impulse funds. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for local mobility, that the neighbourhood is not fully car-free (underground parking and car hubs are planned), that emergency access is ensured through consultation, that 55% of homes are affordable, and that construction timelines are monitored under funding agreements.
The choice of transport mode is made by the residents themselves. The municipality is responsible for local mobility policy.
De keuze voor de vervoerwijze maken de bewoners zelf. De gemeente is daarbij verantwoordelijk voor het lokale mobiliteitsbeleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over het bericht 'Nederlands beste boerengrond – in Flevoland – maakt plaats voor woningen en natuur: ‘Maar bos kweken werkt hier niet’'

MPs Boswijk and Geurts asked about a newspaper report that the most fertile farmland in Flevoland is being converted to housing and nature, and about how such land is protected. The government replied that a 'right function in the right place' principle applies, that a framework for land-use changes on farmland is being developed within the National Programme Rural Area, and that provinces and municipalities hold the decisive powers.
The national government has a broad coordinating role to ensure all spatial tasks find a place and to prevent agriculture from being the last resort in the spatial debate.
Het Rijk heeft een brede regiefunctie om ervoor te zorgen dat alle ruimtelijke opgaven een plek krijgen en om te voorkomen dat landbouw het sluitstuk is in de discussie rondom ruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de weigering van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf de in 2017 getaxeerde waarde van het Landgoed Paleis Soestdijk openbaar te maken

An MP asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf refuses to publish the 2017 appraised market value of Paleis Soestdijk estate sold for EUR 1.71 million, and whether the process was transparent. The minister defends the sale as properly conducted and says appraisals are withheld because disclosure could harm the state's financial and economic interests in future property negotiations, refusing to release the figure.
The appraisal report was not made public following the Woo request because the interest in disclosure does not outweigh the state's financial and economic interests.

Het taxatierapport is naar aanleiding van het verzoek op grond van de Wet open overheid (Woo) niet openbaar gemaakt omdat het belang van openbaarmaking niet opweegt tegen de financiële en economische belangen van de Staat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over woningweigering door statushouders

MPs Kops and Wilders asked how often refugee status holders refused housing, why, how many evictions followed, and who handles refusals under the hotel and accommodation scheme. The government answered that initial refusals were about 140 to 300 a year, mostly reversed, with COA and municipalities handling procedures and a guidance document in preparation.
Because status holders have left COA, it is not centrally recorded how many status holders under the hotel and accommodation scheme refuse a home.
Omdat statushouders zijn uitgestroomd bij het COA, wordt niet centraal bijgehouden hoeveel statushouders onder de Hotel- en accommodatieregeling een woning weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het alleen voor Chinees riet aanvragen van subsidie

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why the ISDE insulation subsidy's product listing covered Chinese reed but not Dutch reed, raising level-playing-field, sustainability and EU state-aid concerns. The minister answered that a registration code was granted only because Chinese reed met the insulation threshold, that Dutch reed can apply once its performance declaration is ready, and that sustainability criteria for bio-based inputs are being developed.
It is correct that a registration code was requested and granted for Chinese reed and not yet for Dutch reed.
Het klopt dat er een meldcode is aangevraagd en verleend voor Chinees riet en nog niet voor Nederlands riet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Vestering, Van Esch en Van Raan over het adequaat beschermen van kwetsbare en unieke natuur en koraal op en rondom de BES-eilanden

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked how a motion to halt irreversible building steps at Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, port expansion near Hato, coral damage, and enforcement against coastal construction on Sint Eustatius were being implemented. The government answered that no irreversible steps are legally possible before the environmental impact assessment is complete, that the port and coral issues will be examined in the MER, and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport report on local enforcement capacity and related follow-ups will be sent by end May 2023.

Since the revision of the Bonaire spatial development plan will not be started in procedure until the MER has been established and assessed, I note that it is currently not legally possible to take irreversible steps.

Aangezien de herziening van het Ruimtelijke Ordeningsplan Bonaire (ROB) niet in procedure worden gebracht, zolang de MER niet is vastgesteld en beoordeeld, constateer ik dat het op dit moment juridisch niet mogelijk is om onomkeerbare stappen te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen ontvangen van het lid Van Esch over de situatie in de Lutkemeerpolder en de consequenties van het kabinetsbeleid dat water en bodem sturend moet worden

An MP asked whether the Lutkemeerpolder, a low-lying fertile clay polder, should be developed mainly into distribution warehouses under the water-and-soil-guiding policy, and whether the government would curb warehouse growth and cooperate on a local food park. The minister acknowledged the risks and noted the polder is a local and provincial decision, with the national government holding no role in the Amsterdam warehouse decisions and declining to work on the food park.
The national government has no role in the decision-making on business locations in the Lutkemeerpolder in Amsterdam.
Het Rijk heeft geen rol in de besluitvorming rondom de bedrijfsvestigingen in de Lutkemeerpolder in Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de tijdelijke verrekenfactor voor nieuwbouw vanwege de hoger uitgevallen milieubelasting van warmtepompen

Two MPs (SP) asked why a temporary calculation factor for heat pumps' environmental impact was introduced without informing parliament, whether legal advice was obtained, and what the consequences are for the climate goals. The minister replies that the factor was developed by the independent Stichting NMD, that the government did not seek legal advice because the method itself was unchanged, that parliament was not informed since the database is managed by the sector, and that heat pumps remain climate-friendly overall.
If the calculation method or requirement designated in the building regulations is changed, your House will be informed of this.
Als de in de bouwregelgeving aangewezen bepalingsmethode of eis wordt gewijzigd, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de rampzalige renovatie van het Binnenhof

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about the costly, delayed Binnenhof renovation, including governance, accountability for cost overruns, a plan of action, economic compensation for The Hague, the Hofgracht and nitrogen-permit constraints. The minister confirms the cost and delay news, refers to earlier progress reports, states the ministry and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are responsible for budget and time frames, and promises a ninth progress report soon.

As described in the Remkes Review on Binnenhof renovation governance of 14 June 2021 and the letter to the House on the same subject of July 2021, the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are responsible for the time and budget frameworks.

Zoals beschreven in de Review Governance Renovatie Binnenhof van de heer Remkes d.d. 14 juni 2021 en de brief aan de Kamer over datzelfde onderwerp van juli 2021 zijn de Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening en het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf verantwoordelijk voor de kaders van tijd en budget.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het duurder worden van woningen als gevolg van de invoering van de Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen

An MP from ChristenUnie asks the Minister for Housing about fears that the Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen (Wkb) will raise housing prices, with too few inspectors and high supervision costs. The Minister responds that start-up concerns are recognised, that enough quality assurers are expected, that lower permit fees should offset costs, and that the Act will take effect on 1 January 2024 together with the Omgevingswet.
So I do not expect there to be a shortage of quality assurers.
Ik verwacht dus niet dat er sprake zal zijn van een tekort aan kwaliteitsborgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet halen van de doelen voor sociale huurwoningen

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the minister why the stock of social rental housing is shrinking and whether the 30% social rental target in all municipalities can be met. The minister answered that corporations will build 250,000 social rental homes by 2030, that less-than-target municipalities will be required to allocate 30% of new construction to social rent, and that sales and demolition are a necessary part of corporate operations, so no action to curb them is planned.
I furthermore want the social rental stock to be distributed more evenly among municipalities.
Ik wil bovendien dat de sociale huurvoorraad evenwichtiger verdeeld wordt tussen gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het position paper Omgevingswet-DSO van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the Council of State's position paper warning that the Omgevingswet digital system (DSO) may not yet let citizens and courts trace environmental plans and amendments reliably. The Minister answered that the viewers and time-travel functions are adequate, that a dedicated mechanism for processing court rulings will follow after entry into force, and that testing with courts and users continues.
Following the Division's letter, I have invited them to keep testing the system this year and to keep practising with it.
Naar aanleiding van de brief van de Afdeling heb ik hen uitgenodigd om dit jaar het stelsel te blijven beproeven en hiermee te blijven oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de herziening van de Capital Requirements Regulation (CRR) door de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the government about the EU revision of the CRR requiring banks to provide for non-performing loans even when fully guaranteed by the state, which affects NWB and BNG lending to housing corporations via the WSW guarantee fund, and whether a carve-out can be pursued in trilogue. The minister acknowledges the cost and financing risks for housing corporations, says the impact cannot be quantified because the data is confidential, and commits to pursuing a targeted exemption in the trilogue.
Information on expected NPLs that have been or could be on the balance sheets of the banks for more than seven years is not public, competitively sensitive information.
Informatie over de verwachte NPL's die langer dan zeven jaar op de balans van de betreffende banken staan of in de toekomst zou kunnen staan is niet publieke, concurrentiegevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Citadelhof in Den Bosch opent eigen 'museum'' in het Brabants Dagblad (BD) van 24 januari jongstleden

An SP MP asked the housing minister about the demolition of the Citadelhof flats in Den Bosch for a museum, asking about heritage value, tenant participation under the Overlegwet, and whether urgent own-use eviction is misused. The minister said heritage is one factor among others, that demolition is a local decision, that no direct link exists with the museum, and that existing tenant consultation rules are adequate.
I do not agree that there is a lack of control for residents.
Ik deel niet dat er sprake is van het ontbreken van zeggenschap van bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over het kamertekort voor studenten naar aanleiding van recente uitzendingen van Pointer en Spraakmakers

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked about the student housing shortage, loneliness among students, the lack of rent allowance for rooms versus studios, and the decline of non-self-contained rooms. The minister responded that the WWSO reform is a step but not sufficient, that a regional housing coordinator is in place, and that a new WWSO proposal is expected around summer 2023.
I aim to be able to present a new proposal for the WWSO to your House around the summer of 2023.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer rond de zomer van 2023 een nieuw voorstel voor het WWSO aan te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat tijdelijke huurders Peperstraat Zaandam snel moeten verkassen omdat hun contract niet kan worden verlengd

An SP MP asked the housing minister about temporary tenants in the Peperstraat in Zaandam who must move quickly because their temporary contracts cannot be extended, raising questions about displacement, consultation, urgency status, and the planned national social statute. The minister answered that such temporary contracts cannot be extended after two years by law, that no legal terugkeergarantie exists but local agreements are possible, and that a national social statute for housing corporations will be finalised before summer.
I see no reason to enter into discussion with the parties involved.
Ik zie geen aanleiding met de betrokken partijen het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het illegaal in rekening brengen van screeningskosten aan huurders

An MP asked the housing minister about a Rotterdam letting agency charging prospective tenants about 75 euro for screening, which the MP argued violates the ban on double brokerage fees. The minister agreed such fees are unacceptable, explained tenants can reclaim them, and pointed to the Good Landlordship bill and municipal complaint points as the planned remedy.
I agree with you that brokers may not charge double brokerage fees to tenants, and I therefore disapprove of this conduct.
Ik ben het met u eens dat makelaars geen dubbele bemiddelingskosten bij huurders in rekening mogen brengen en keur dit gedrag dan ook af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over diefstal bij huiseigenaren

An MP asked the minister about the EUR 600 fee in Haarlem that homeowners must pay to rent to their children, and asked for a list of similar municipal permits elsewhere. The minister confirmed the fee, listed over 20 municipalities with purchase protection, and said municipal permit fees may not exceed cost recovery under the EU Services Directive, noting Haarlem's fee covers 63% of costs and that Haarlem has been informed it must review this; no new national measure is announced.
I have however informed the municipality of Haarlem that the fees may not be higher than cost-covering.
Wel heb ik de gemeente Haarlem geïnformeerd over het feit dat de leges niet hoger dan kostendekkend mogen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Lage inkomenshuishoudens in de knel op de woningmarkt door Rotterdams woonbeleid' namens de Gezamenlijke Overleg Huurdersorganisaties (GOH)

Beckerman (SP) asks the Minister for Housing about a Rotterdam tenant organisation's criticism of city housing policy, a Rotterdam Audit Office report on unreliable social housing figures, the conduct of the municipality and private market influence, and the reliability of national funding based on local data. The Minister answers that Rotterdam housing policy is a local democratic matter, that he will agree a regional housing deal and a national definition of social rent, and that he sees no need for a national investigation or a moratorium on sales and demolition.
However, it is not for me to judge Rotterdam's housing policy: this is shaped in the local Rotterdam democratic process.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te oordelen over het Rotterdamse woonbeleid: dit komt tot stand in het lokale Rotterdamse democratische proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over de rol van notarissen bij dubieuze grondhandel

MPs Boulakjar asked the ministers about notaries' role in dubious land speculation, including duty of care, use of powers of attorney, disciplinary rulings, and ACM/AFM oversight. Minister De Jonge answered that the notarial disciplinary judge assesses duty of care case by case, that the existing framework is sufficient without legal change, and that regulators receive few reports but will act in individual cases.
The assessment of the role of notaries and the associated duty of care in light of land trading is reserved for the notarial disciplinary judge.
De beoordeling van de rol van notarissen en de daarbij behorende zorgplicht in het licht van grondhandel is voorbehouden aan de notariële tuchtrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over particuliere verhuurders van appartementencomplexen die de verlichting in algemene ruimten (deels) niet willen uitzetten om energie te besparen

An MP asks the housing minister about private landlords who keep common-area lighting on in apartment buildings, passing high energy costs to tenants who cannot control consumption, and asks about the impact and planned action. The minister answers that tenants can influence service charges via the WOHV consultation rules and courts, that the energy price cap excludes common areas, that no national data exists on the financial impact, and points to sustainability subsidies and performance agreements.
There is no national data on energy consumption in common areas and no insight into whether households fall into financial difficulties because of these extra energy costs.
Er is geen landelijke data voor energieverbruik in algemene ruimten en ook geen inzicht in of huishoudens door deze extra energiekosten in financiële problemen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ‘De latente stikstofruimte en extern salderen’

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the ministers about buy-outs of farms for nitrogen permit space, unregistered latent permit capacity, the unrecorded 30% deduction in external netting, and the AERIUS model update, requesting lists and data. The minister answered that the external netting evaluation is ongoing with results expected mid-2023, that stricter external netting rules and registration of freed space are being pursued, and that a complete picture of latent space cannot be obtained.
I expect to be able to share the results of the evaluation with the House around mid-2023.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van de evaluatie medio 2023 met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over voorrang asielzoekers

Van Haga asks whether he is aware that status holders get priority for rental housing in Horst aan de Maas, whether he considers this discrimination against Dutch residents, and whether he sees immigration as the driver of the housing shortage and will restrict it. Minister De Jonge confirms awareness, rejects the discrimination framing, and says the government wants more grip on migration, pointing to a pending advisory report and a broader asylum policy review without committing to specific measures.
Partly in view of the current housing shortages, this cabinet wants to gain more grip on migration.
Mede gezien de huidige woningtekorten, wil dit kabinet meer grip krijgen op migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over fraude met huurlabels

An MP asked the housing minister about widespread tenant overcharging in Groningen caused by incorrect energy labels, and whether such fraud should be criminalised and handled by municipalities. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Huurcommissie pilot, the goed verhuurderschap bill and a planned binding WWS, but rejected criminal law and said municipalities have no role in label quality control.
Tackling this problem through criminal law is not desirable in my view, because enforcement of rent levels would thereby become a task of the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het aanpakken van dit probleem via het strafrecht acht ik niet wenselijk, omdat handhaving op huurprijzen daarmee een taak wordt van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Woningbouw loopt vast: kopers én bouwers haken af’

An MP asks the housing minister about reports that housing construction is stalling, covering 2023 output forecasts, the effect of middle-segment rent regulation, institutional investors, inner-city versus outer-city building, and the role of housing corporations and regional housing deals. The minister gives substantive answers on most points, mostly describing policy plans and promising further information in the second quarter of 2023.
On the forecasts for 2023 and beyond, I will inform the House mid-year.
Over de prognoses over 2023 en verder, informeer ik uw Kamer medio dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over conflicten tussen woningeigenaren en aannemers

The MP asked the minister whether the rise in disputes between homeowners and contractors is worrying, what homeowners can do against unreasonable cost increases, and whether he will act to protect them. The minister agreed the rise is worrying, advised careful contractor selection and written agreements, and pointed to the Wkb, which will require insurance disclosure and stricter post-completion liability, with monitoring and evaluation after three years.
From entry into force I will monitor the effects and evaluate after three years.
Vanaf inwerkingtreding zal ik de effecten monitoren en na drie jaar evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Sociale huurwoningen entrepotdok: ‘Stop de massale uitverkoop’

An SP MP asked the housing minister about the sale of social rental flats at Entrepotdok in Amsterdam by De Alliantie, questioning whether it breaches national and local agreements and the right to adequate housing. The minister answered that sales are part of sound management, that the Alliantie has paused the sale and a mediation process with the municipality has started, and that the government's policy aims to grow the social rental stock.

By mutual agreement, it was decided to enter a mediation process together to examine whether the Samenwerkingsafspraken agreed between the municipality and housing corporations were actually followed.

In goed overleg is besloten om samen een mediation-traject in te gaan om na te gaan of er daadwerkelijk conform de Samenwerkingsafspraken, zoals vastgesteld in het overleg tussen gemeente en de woningcorporaties, is gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Stijging erfpacht wekt wrevel: 'Waarom geen plafond, net als bij huren?'

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about media reports that Amsterdam's inflation-linked ground-lease (erfpacht) increases are steep, and whether national rules can cap them as with rents. The minister replied that erfpacht is a private-law instrument governed by contracts, that he has no legal basis to intervene, that the municipal executive (college) holds that power and can be questioned by the council, and that he will issue a guidance document on modern erfpacht conditions.
For erfpacht, unlike rental agreements, I have no legal basis on which to intervene in the inflation correction in the agreed erfpacht canon.
Voor wat betreft erfpacht heb ik, in tegenstelling tot bij huurovereenkomsten, geen wettelijke basis waarop ik een ingreep in de inflatiecorrectie in de overeengekomen erfpachtcanon kan baseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en Peter de Groot over de serie 'Kraken doe je zo' van NPO 3

MPs Van Strien and Peter de Groot asked whether the NPO 3 series 'Kraken doe je zo', which explains how to squat, should be removed and investigated under the Mediawet, and asked about squatting enforcement and evictions. The government answered that it does not judge individual programme content, that the Commissariaat voor de Media supervises the Mediawet, that the courts decide on criminal matters, and that existing criminal and municipal tools suffice, while promising a later data update on squatter numbers.
It is not for the cabinet to judge the content of individual programmes or statements made in them.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van afzonderlijke programma's of uitlatingen die daarin worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Raad van State zet streep door nieuwe woonwijk bij Schiphol’

An MP asked the housing minister about a Council of State ruling that blocked a 700-home neighbourhood near Schiphol after KLM appealed over aircraft noise, and whether state-owned KLM's litigation endangers the 900,000-homes target. The minister confirmed the ruling, said the noise issue falls under noise law not aviation caps, and argued the national housing target is not directly jeopardised because provincial planning capacity exceeds the quota.
That means the societal task of building 900,000 homes is not directly endangered if a project falls through or is delayed.
Dat betekent dat de maatschappelijke opgave van het bouwen van 900.000 woningen niet direct in gevaar komt als een project uitvalt of vertraging oploopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de negatieve effecten van het reguleren van de middenhuur

An MP (Van Haga) asked the Minister for Housing about the negative effects of regulating mid-market rents, citing the Stec report and projects stalled such as The Grace, and questioned the policy's impact on new supply, renovation and rental stock. The Minister answered that the Stec figures are indicative and do not support general conclusions, that a temporary 5% rent surcharge will be allowed for new-build units, that the effects on supply will be monitored, and that stakeholder concerns will be considered during the consultation on the bill.
Based on the results of the Stec study and the other studies, I adjusted the outline of the regulation and discussed it with various stakeholders.
Op basis van de resultaten van het Stec-onderzoek en de andere onderzoeken heb ik de contouren van de regulering aangepast en besproken met verschillende stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Veel minder huurwoningen, verhuursite ziet verkoopgolf onder beleggers'

An MP from the VVD asked the housing minister about reports that landlords are selling rental homes, and whether this undermines the planned rent regulation for mid-range rentals. The minister answered that the data are not yet conclusive, that municipal tools and the Wet goed verhuurderschap are aimed at excesses rather than at investors, that sales may partly reflect the regulation, and that he will monitor the effects and send a study on the stacking of measures in the first quarter.
I expect to be able to send the study to your House in the first quarter.
Ik verwacht het onderzoek het eerste kwartaal naar uw Kamer te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat nieuwe daglichteisen de bouw onbetaalbaar maken

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about reports that new daylight requirements based on NEN-EN 17037 make construction unaffordable, questioning the method's cost, complexity and conflict with building-regulation principles. The minister answered that the change is not yet in force, that cost studies show no added cost, that the method will be simplified through fixed parameters in the Omgevingsregeling, and that enforcement concerns do not arise.
These requirements have not yet entered into force. The moment of entry into force is still to be determined by me.
Deze eisen zijn nog niet werking getreden. Het moment van inwerkingtreding wordt door mij nog nader bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijkheid voor VvE’s om digitaal vergaderingen te beleggen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked whether VvEs should be allowed to hold digital meetings permanently, and whether repeated extensions of the temporary COVID law create uncertainty and disadvantage less digitally skilled owners. The minister answers that a permanent digital-meeting option is desirable, that a Wet digitale algemene vergadering is in consultation, and that the COVID-based option will not be extended past 1 February 2023 unless circumstances change, with a machtiging-based safeguard for members.
I agree that in practice there appears to be a need to make digital meetings permanently possible.
Ik ben het met u eens, dat in de praktijk behoefte blijkt te bestaan aan het permanent mogelijk maken van digitaal vergaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Veluws vakantiepark wil woonwijk worden, maar dat mag niet: ‘Onbegrijpelijk’’

An MP asks the housing minister whether the government will push municipalities to allow a Veluwe holiday park, whose residents want it converted into a residential area, and asks how the motion on national steering of such transformations is being implemented. The minister answers that municipalities weigh transformation themselves, that an inventory of transformation potential is being done via provinces with a report promised by end of Q1, and that the expert team supports transformations only once a decision has been made.
I am following up on your motion by means of an inventory of the transformation potential of holiday parks.
Ik geef opvolging aan uw motie door middel van een inventarisatie naar het transformatiepotentieel van vakantieparken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Missende rookmelders en enige vluchtroutes vol spullen: veiligheid ver te zoeken in oude portiekflats’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about press reports on fire safety in old walk-up flats in Amersfoort, including missing smoke detectors, single escape routes blocked by belongings, and a complaint about housing association De Alliantie. The Minister answered at length that building fire safety is primarily the owner's responsibility and the municipality's as competent authority, that existing buildings need not meet new-build standards, that a planned amendment to the building decree and a NIPV study are under way, and that tenants can turn to the Huurcommissie, rechter, or the municipality.
I take tenants' complaints seriously, but ultimately it is up to the landlord to act.
Ik neem klachten van huurders serieus, maar het is uiteindelijk aan de verhuurder om iets te doen.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over betalingen aan de heer Johan Vollenbroek (voorzitter van Mobilisation for the Environment)

An FvD MP asked whether Johan Vollenbroek, chair of Mobilisation for the Environment, was paid by the ministry for advice, including on a 'goat path' for construction. The minister answered that Vollenbroek was not paid, that he sent an unsolicited letter advising a building exemption based on an ADC-test, which the minister considered and decided against, and described further measures on nitrogen permitting.
No, Mr Vollenbroek was not paid for his advice.
Nee, de heer Vollenbroek heeft niet betaald gekregen voor zijn advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Wuite over de Nationale aanpak Klimaatadaptatie gebouwde omgeving fase 1

MPs Boulakjar and Wuite asked why the national climate adaptation approach for the built environment (phase 1) excludes the Caribbean Netherlands and its public bodies, and when a spatial development agenda for the islands will be sent to parliament. The minister answers that the strategy covers European Netherlands only, that the island bodies bear primary responsibility with national support, and that the spatial agenda will reach parliament in January 2023 and a programme after summer 2023.
That is why it was chosen to have the National Climate Adaptation Approach for the built environment also cover European Netherlands.
Daarom is er voor gekozen ook de Nationale aanpak Klimaatadaptatie gebouwde omgeving betrekking te laten hebben op Europees Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Boulakjar en Kat over het bericht 'BKR wil hypotheken registreren en gegevens delen met belwinkels en postorderbedrijven'

MPs from D66 asked the Finance Minister, on behalf of other ministers, about BKR's plan to register mortgages and share data with phone-shop and mail-order firms, including its legal basis, public oversight, proportionality and privacy. The minister answered that no positive mortgage registration is planned for now, that a bill will be consulted on in early 2023 to give credit registration a statutory basis and ministerial powers, and that the government is in talks with BKR.
In the bill, credit registration becomes a statutory task, with corresponding powers for the Minister of Finance.
In het wetsvoorstel wordt kredietregistratie een wettelijke taak, met overeenkomstige bevoegdheden voor de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen die zijn gesteld door het lid Kops over het bericht dat Utrecht bewoners dwingt van het gas af te gaan

An MP asked the housing minister about Utrecht forcing residents off gas, the alleged cost burden and electricity impact, and whether forced transition is justified. The minister defended the neighbourhood approach, said the Utrecht experiment saves residents money, and called compulsion a justified last resort for those opposing the transition, while declining to answer some questions and referring others to the municipality.
What the exact costs and benefits per home or resident are in the Utrecht neighbourhood Overvecht-Noord, and on what calculations they are based, you would best ask the municipality itself.
Wat de exacte kosten en baten per woning of bewoner zijn in de Utrechtse wijk Overvecht-Noord en waar zij deze berekeningen op hebben gebaseerd kunt u het beste vragen aan de gemeente zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de gebrekkige antwoorden aangaande stikstof
