Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the ministers why the minister said building exemptions meant nothing was permitted, how many projects proceeded under the exemption despite significant nitrogen effects, and whether resulting deposition would be compensated. The minister conceded the wording should have been more precise, said no overview of such projects exists and their nitrogen contribution cannot be determined, and pointed to a later letter on emission reductions.
It is not possible to provide such an overview.
Het is niet mogelijk om een dergelijk overzicht te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Vraagtekens over brandveiligheid Riekerhaven: ‘Als dit ’s nachts was gebeurd, was de ellende niet te overzien’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Housing about fire safety of container homes at Riekerhaven in Amsterdam, after a fire and fire brigade concerns, including whether containers should be investigated, whether the brigade should be involved in unit construction, and whether the housing corporation Lieven de Key is culpable. The minister answers that the municipality is the competent authority, that existing Building Decree rules apply, that the outcomes of Amsterdam investigations will be studied with experts before deciding on national action, and that residents are not his responsibility.

I want to study the outcomes of the Amsterdam investigations and then, in consultation with fire safety experts, the Association of Building and Housing Supervision Netherlands and the Fire Brigade Netherlands, assess whether further (national) action is needed.

Ik wil de uitkomsten van de Amsterdamse onderzoeken bestuderen en aansluitend in samenspraak met brandveiligheidsdeskundigen, de Vereniging Bouw- en Woningtoezicht Nederland en Brandweer Nederland bezien of nadere (landelijke) acties nodig zijn.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Kops (PVV) over het bericht ‘Woede over WOZ gluurders- Gemeente wil interieurfoto’s”.

An MP asked the Minister about municipalities requesting photos of home interiors for WOZ property valuation, questioning their necessity, legal basis, storage, and whether the pilots should stop. The Minister answered that interior condition can only be obtained from owners, that self-made photos are an optional alternative with privacy safeguards and Waarderingskamer oversight, and that data is retained seven years.
Self-made photos are an option and not an obligation.
Zelfgemaakte foto's zijn een optie en geen verplichting.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bespioneren van mensen thuis met de eis om voor het bepalen van de WOZ-waarde foto’s van de binnenkant van huizen naar diverse gemeenten moeten worden gestuurd

An MP asked whether municipalities requiring photos of home interiors for WOZ property valuation go too far and how this relates to privacy law. The minister answered that photos are an optional alternative to on-site inspection, that the Waarderingskamer supervises municipalities' conduct, that data is kept seven years, and that the pilot in Enschede was stopped.
I consider this supervision by the Waarderingskamer important, also because of respecting the fundamental right to protection of private life.
Dit toezicht van de Waarderingskamer acht ik van belang, ook vanwege het respecteren van het grondrecht van eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Strolenberg over het eisen van foto’s van de binnenkant van huizen voor de vaststelling van de WOZ

Two VVD MPs asked whether municipalities may demand photos of the interior of homes for WOZ property valuation and whether this should stop. The minister answered that photos are an optional alternative to inspection visits, that the Waarderingskamer supervises municipalities' conduct and privacy safeguards apply, and that the practice will not be banned.
Moreover, my impression is that there is no question of demanding photos, but of offering an option of self-made photos.
Overigens is mijn indruk dat er geen sprake is van het eisen van foto’s, maar van het aanbieden van een optie van zelfgemaakte foto’s.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over afkeuring bouwvrijstelling en de gevolgen voor de herbeoordeling van milieuvergunningen voor bouwprojecten

MP Koekkoek asked the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the court ruling striking down the construction exemption from nitrogen permit requirements, its effect on permit reassessments, and municipal and regional environmental service capacity shortages. The minister answered that the ruling does not in principle require new environmental permits, that nitrogen permit impacts fall mainly on provinces, that no overview of backlogs or affected projects is available, and that capacity-building measures are being pursued through existing programmes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht ‘Kritiek op (on)toegankelijkheid Langeveldgebouw voor mensen met functiebeperking’

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about reports that the Erasmus University Langeveld building is inaccessible for people with various disabilities, and about the diversity of accessibility standards. The minister acknowledged the problem, noted the university chose the stricter NEN-ISO 21542 standard, said formal inspection is due early next year, and described a forthcoming national NEN accessibility norm expected end 2023.
I have given NEN the assignment to do so.
Ik heb daartoe opdracht gegeven aan NEN.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Paul over het bericht ‘Helft van scholen aan nieuwbouw of renovatie toe, extra geld onzeker’

MPs Peter de Groot and Paul (VVD) asked the ministers for Housing and for Primary and Secondary Education about a report that nearly half of Dutch schools need renovation or replacement and that extra funding is uncertain. Minister Wiersma answered that a national picture is still being compiled, that responsibilities are split across municipalities, school boards and the central government, and promised a funding task force reply and further information in Q1 2023.
In the first quarter of 2023 I will inform you of the outcomes of the research.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2023 zal ik u informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een grote stijging van de bouw van recreatiewoningen en hotels vlakbij beschermde natuur

An SP MP asked the government about a reported 90% rise in holiday homes and hotels near protected Natura 2000 areas, asking for data, regulation, appeal figures, nitrogen effects and whether more building should be restricted. The minister answered that she lacks most of the requested data since provinces are the competent authority, considers the existing rules sufficient, and will examine with BZK whether the monitoring instruments suffice, without committing to new restrictions.
In our decentralised system, the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten) is the competent authority for permit granting and enforcement concerning Natura 2000 areas.
In ons gedecentraliseerde bestel zijn gedeputeerde staten bevoegd gezag voor vergunningverlening en handhaving met betrekking tot Natura 2000-gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Bouw van duizenden woningen op pauzeknop door stijgende bouwkosten’

An MP asks the housing minister about reports that thousands of homes are being paused due to rising construction costs, and about the causes of delays, including long procedures, nitrogen issues and the mix of homes built. The minister acknowledges long project lead times and economic uncertainty, promises a plan to shorten procedures and a Plan van Aanpak, but declines to estimate how many projects will be affected.
I will send you a plan early next year to structurally shorten the lead time of housing projects.
Ik stuur u begin volgend jaar een plan om de doorlooptijd van woningbouwprojecten structureel te verkorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'In deze studentenflat is de stank ondraaglijk, huurders lijden onder bedwantsen, ratten en schimmel’

An MP asked the minister about reports of severe living conditions in a Den Haag student flat (odour, bedbugs, rats, mould, fire alarms) and about the rights of tenants on temporary and campus contracts, including the handling of landlord misconduct by the municipality. The minister answered that tenant protection is insufficient, pointed to the Wet goed verhuurderschap as the instrument to strengthen municipal enforcement, said the municipality already acts against defects, and declined to commit to new national rules or a separate investigation.

In addition, once the Wet goed verhuurderschap takes effect, the municipality of Den Haag can introduce a rental permit in areas where liveability is under pressure, on condition that landlords have and carry out a maintenance plan.

Daarnaast kan de gemeente Den Haag, zodra het wetsvoorstel goed verhuurderschap inwerking treedt, in gebieden waar de leefbaarheid onder druk staat een verhuurvergunning instellen met als voorwaarde dat verhuurders een onderhoudsplan hebben en uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Minhas over het bericht 'Zonder ingrijpen valt nieuwbouw terug naar 45.000 woningen per jaar' in de Cobouw van 31 oktober 2022

Two VVD MPs asked the housing minister about a report that housebuilding could fall to 45,000 homes per year, and about delays in approved projects, subsidies, binnenstedelijk building, VINEX-style regional planning and the spatial planning instrument. The minister acknowledged the risks, pointed to the Programma Woningbouw, planned a plan of action on speeding up building, promised to revisit the Woningbouwimpuls subsidy rules in spring, and gave partial, policy-restating answers on figures and planning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het falen van het laten meewegen van de verstrekking van energiecertificaten in het woningwaarderingsstelsel (WWS)

An MP asks the minister about EU energy-label rules for rental housing and whether failure to hand over an energy certificate is sanctioned in the rent-points system (WWS), citing court rulings. The minister says the energy-label obligation is enforced by the ILT inspectorate rather than the WWS, that no legislative change is needed, and that the label copy will be made available to tenants via MijnOverheid.
The WWS is not a sanction on the energy label obligation.
Het WWS betreft geen sanctie op de energielabelplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het inzetten van Rijksvastgoed en provinciaal vastgoed voor asielopvang

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about using national and provincial real estate for asylum reception, including plans in Zwaagdijk-West (Medemblik) and whether the municipality was informed. The government said the spatial planning instrument is not currently being deployed, that a feasibility study is underway with the municipality cooperating, and that the Provincial Executive's compliance with Provinciewet article 167 is for the provincial states to judge.
We would prefer to leave the assessment of that to them.
Oordeelsvorming daarover laten wij graag aan hen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Je starterswoning is opeens 35 mille duurder’

An MP asked the housing minister about reports that timber prefab starter homes were 35,000 euros more expensive because they fell outside NHG and SVn starter loan coverage, and whether this stalls projects. The minister answered that these homes can be financed with NHG and the starter loan given a guarantee certificate, that startups may struggle with solvency requirements so he asked insurers to look into it, and that he sees no evidence of stalled projects and no need for regulatory change.
That is why I have asked the completion insurers whether they can look at how innovative startups building can be helped to obtain a certificate nonetheless.
Daarom heb ik de afbouwverzekeraars gevraagd of zij kunnen kijken naar hoe startups die innovatief bouwen geholpen kunnen worden om toch een certificaat te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Lening duurder bij kant-en-klare woning, starters dupe’

An MP asked the housing minister whether buyers of factory-built homes are excluded from the NHG mortgage guarantee, why certificates are hard to obtain, how factory construction will be scaled up, and about the status of a universal label and standard permit. The minister replied that factory-built homes can get NHG and the SVn starter loan via a certificate, acknowledged startups may struggle with solvency requirements, and pointed to forthcoming action plans and the postponed Wkb.
Factory-built homes can indeed be financed in combination with NHG and the SVn starter loan.
Fabrieksmatig gebouwde woningen kunnen wel degelijk gefinancierd worden in combinatie met NHG en de starterslening van SVn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het artikel in NH Nieuws ‘Amsterdamse studentenvakbond eist meer aandacht voor veiligheid na verwoestende brand’

An MP asked the housing minister about a series of student-housing fires in Amsterdam, whether other student cities are affected, how safe student housing can be guaranteed, and what measures and facade fire-safety testing are needed. The minister answered that the three Amsterdam fires are not comparable and no similar problems are known elsewhere, and pointed to the national student housing action plan, fire-safety measures, and planned building-code amendments due for consultation and parliamentary submission in 2023.
I am working on tightening the fire-safety requirements for facades in the Bbl.
Ik werk aan een aanscherping voor de brandveiligheidseisen voor gevels in het Bbl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘De Jonge: gemeenten moeten een ‘tandje erbij doen’ om statushouders aan een woning te helpen’

An MP from the PVV asks the housing minister whether it is acceptable that refugees with residence permits receive priority access to social housing and furnishing allowances while Dutch housing seekers wait, and whether the minister is doing enough for Dutch citizens. The minister rejects the framing, explains that municipalities have discretion over urgency categories and furnishing credit, and says the housing of permit holders is a national agreement to relieve asylum reception.
Municipalities can themselves determine which categories of housing seekers they can include as an urgency category.
Gemeenten kunnen zelf bepalen welke categorieën woningzoekenden zij als urgentiecategorie kunnen opnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Straatje erbij in elk dorp oplossing woningcrisis'

An MP from the VVD asked the housing minister whether he endorses the EIB's suggestion that building small extensions at the edges of every village could yield 300,000 homes, and about related plan capacity, flex-housing locations and the ladder for sustainable urbanisation. The minister answered that the proposal supports his policy, that plan capacity figures are not broken down to edge-of-municipality locations, that the ladder is under evaluation with results expected in Q1 2023, and that the questions were answered one by one.
Therefore, based on the provincial agreements, it is not possible to calculate the number of homes at the edges of municipalities.
Daarom is op basis van de provinciale afspraken geen doorrekening te maken van het aantal woningen aan randen van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het rapport ‘onderzoek opkopen vakantieparken’

An SP MP asks the ministers about a report on the buy-up of holiday parks, raising criminal and speculative investors, stikstof, intimidation of tenants, weak tenant protection under RECRON terms, and the role of municipalities. The minister answers that the government sees no need for a moratorium, buy-up protection, Bibob mandatory checks or a revolving fund, while pointing to municipal tools, the Actie-agenda and a dialogue with the sector on tenant information.
In the first place it is up to the local competent authority, the municipality or province, to determine whether buying up and restructuring a given holiday park is desirable or possible.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan het lokale bevoegd gezag, de gemeente of provincie, om te bepalen of het opkopen en herstructureren van een gegeven vakantiepark wenselijk danwel mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van der Molen over het bericht dat het leegstaande Leeuwarder belastingkantoor alleen kan worden ontwikkeld met steun van het Rijk

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about the vacant former Tax Office building in Leeuwarden, owned by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, and what obstacles block its reuse and whether the agency will speed up a concrete plan. The minister answered that technical and heritage obstacles affect feasibility, that the municipality and agency aim for a reuse approach by Q1 2023, and that the agency is accelerating temporary reuse of vacant buildings for asylum and status-holder housing.
The aim is for an approach to the reuse to be ready in the first quarter of 2023, based on a joint feasibility study.
Inzet is in het eerste kwartaal van 2023, op basis van een gezamenlijk haalbaarheidsonderzoek een aanpak voor de herbestemming gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitspraken inzake het indammen van de bevolkingsgroei

MP Van Haga asked the housing minister, De Jonge, how his statements about curbing population growth fit with cabinet policy and the record immigration of recent years. The minister replied that he wants more grip on demographic developments in line with the coalition agreement, pointed to a state commission due to report in late 2023, and gave no concrete measures to curb population growth.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht 'Nieuwe dreun voor boeren: burgers die last hebben van stank hebben recht op schadevergoeding'

CDA MPs asked ministers about a Hague court ruling holding the State liable to residents exposed to excessive odour from livestock farms, and its effects on farms, permits, and costs. The government replied that the ruling is still being studied, promised a letter before the 10 November debate, and gave no cost estimate.
At this moment the ruling is being studied.
Op dit moment wordt de uitspraak bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Werkvloer wil nieuw uitstel Omgevingswet’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister about a survey showing many local authority staff want to postpone the Environment and Planning Act, including concerns about testing, support and the 1 January 2023 date. The minister acknowledges the signals, points to the implementation progress letter and existing support programmes, and argues the Act is already law and a clear start date is needed.
I take all signals about the entry into force of the Environment and Planning Act seriously.
Ik neem alle signalen over de inwerkingtreding van de Omgevingswet serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht 'Vijfde keer uitstel Omgevingswet dreigt na negatief ICT-advies'

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about a report that a negative ICT review of the Digital Environment Act system (DSO) could force a fifth postponement of the Act. The minister confirmed awareness, said the final advisory opinion was received and would be addressed in a forthcoming progress letter, and explained which DSO components are essential for entry into force while describing the rest as continuing development.

In the progress letter on implementation of the Environment Act that I sent to your House and the Senate on 14 October, I will address the conclusions of the adopted advice of the Advisory Board in substance.

In de voortgangsbrief implementatie Omgevingswet die ik op 14 oktober naar uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer heb gestuurd, ga ik inhoudelijk in op de conclusies van het vastgestelde advies van het Adviescollege.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het lamleggen van de woningbouw

JA21 MP Pouw-Verweij asked Minister De Jonge whether excessive regulation is stalling large housing projects, what he did after developers warned that his housing targets were unrealistic, and how he will restore investor confidence. The minister denied that projects are stalled by too many rules, pointed to market and capacity problems, promised provincial housing agreements in October, and said he would present rent-regulation contours in the autumn after talks with market parties.
This sometimes requires adjusting plans, but there is by no means any question of large housing projects being nearly brought to a standstill by too many rules.
Dit vraagt soms om aanpassing van plannen maar van het nagenoeg stil komen te liggen van grote woningbouwprojecten door teveel regels is geenszins sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Onveilige situaties voor 2 op de 5 jonge huurders door wooncrisis: 'Mijn huisbaas weet dat ik nergens anders heen kan'’

Two MPs asked the housing minister about reports that young tenants face unsafe situations and exploitation by landlords amid the housing crisis, and about interim protections before the Goed Verhuurderschap bill takes effect. The minister said the bill will give municipalities enforcement tools and a reporting point, declined a national reporting point and national tenant teams for now, and promised to examine expanding the Huurcommissie's remit and regulating mid-rent housing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Van Esch en Vestering over de mogelijke bouw van huizen ten kosten van waardevolle natuur op Bonaire

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether housing construction on Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, a valuable nature area, can be prevented and how the zoning plan and intent agreement are handled. The minister answered that the island authority is responsible for the zoning plan, that the current zoning protects the area, and that the national government will review any draft plan and can issue a reactive direction if needed.
Once the (draft) plan has been released, it will be assessed by the national government and a response will be given.
Nadat het (voor)ontwerp is vrijgegeven, zal dit door het Rijk worden beoordeeld en zal daarop worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aangekondigde aanwijzing van een locatie in Albergen als asielzoekerscentrum

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about communication with Tubbergen municipality, the procedure for siting an asylum centre in Albergen via the national-interest route, and the consultation and objection rights of residents and the council. The government answered in detail on the procedure, the absence of required council consent, and the ex-post objection route, but declined to deliver the requested full documents now (pending a Woo request) and said it could not answer within two weeks.
There is no legally prescribed prior consultation round.
Er is geen wettelijk voorgeschreven voorafgaande inspraakronde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht '650 nieuwe procedures tegen Change=' van 16 juni jongstleden van Stichting Woon

An MP asked the minister about reports of hundreds of rent-service-cost procedures against landlord Change= and whether the government would intervene, including on alleged intimidation, withheld deposits and negative landlord references. The minister answered that existing rules already allow collective handling, that the motion is superfluous, that he has talked with both parties but will not intervene while the Huurcommissie case is pending, and that the leges and related rules are under evaluation.
As long as no ruling has been made, it is not appropriate for me to interfere in the situation.
Zolang er nog geen uitspraak is gedaan, ligt het niet in de rede dat ik mij in de situatie meng.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘onderhandse financiering van vakantiewoningen baart experts zorgen’

SP MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked ministers about reports that private, non-bank mortgage financing of holiday parks and homes raises money-laundering and undermining risks, and about regulation of park takeovers and oversight of gatekeepers. The government answered that such financing can be a risk indicator, that the Actie-agenda vakantieparken and existing Wwft and FIU measures apply, that no regulation of individual transactions is planned, and that it will report the results of the Actie-agenda and a banks/gatekeeper dialogue later.
It is important that all parties that may have insight into this are alert to it in performing their tasks.
Het is belangrijk dat alle betrokken partijen die hierop zicht kunnen hebben, daar alert op zijn bij de uitoefening van hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Blijf weg als je geen kamer hebt’

MPs Boulakjar and Van der Laan asked whether universities advising international and Dutch students without housing to stay away, and how the government ensures sufficient student housing. The ministers acknowledged the advice, pointed to shared responsibility with municipalities and housing providers, and referred to a national action plan, forthcoming legal steering instruments and the Kronenburg short-stay question under study.
Question 1: Is the Minister aware that the Vrije Universiteit and the University of Amsterdam urge international students not to come to the Netherlands if they have no housing?
Vraag 1 Is de Minister ervan op de hoogte dat de Vrije Universiteit en de Universiteit van Amsterdam internationale studenten oproepen om niet naar Nederland te komen als zij geen huisvesting hebben?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ruimtelijke ordening in de gemeente Katwijk

MP Nijboer asks the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the Valkenhorst development in Katwijk, including the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf's alleged obstruction of affordable housing, loss of green space, strained relations with the municipality, and whether it should be steered toward social goals rather than financial criteria. The minister denies obstruction, explains the dual financial and housing mandate, notes the 2020 agreement adding 600 affordable homes, and says a study on more affordable housing on state land is underway, while declining to commit to a change in the agency's mandate.
In response to the adopted Grinwis motion, my ministry has started a study into the possibilities of realising more affordable housing on state land.
Als reactie op de aangenomen motie Grinwis is mijn ministerie een onderzoek gestart naar de mogelijkheden om op rijksgronden meer betaalbare woningbouw te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Investeringen in huurhuizen ingestort: 'Woningbouw stil door plannen Minister''

An MP asks the housing minister about a report that investment in rental housing construction collapsed, and whether planned rent regulation and uncertainty will deter private investors from building mid-rent homes. The minister answers that no hard data exists on investment amounts, that uncertainty is hurting the market, and that the contours of mid-rent regulation will be published in autumn with consultations and studies in the meantime.
No hard public data is available on how much is invested in rental housing.
Over hoeveel investeringen worden gedaan in huurwoningen zijn geen harde publieke gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Aanbod nieuwbouwwoningen terug bij niveau kredietcrisis’

An MP asks the housing minister why new-build homes offered and sold have stagnated, why permits fell, and what measures will speed up construction and match supply to housing demand. The minister attributes the slowdown to high build costs, long lead times, interest rises, nitrogen uncertainty and capacity shortages, and lists measures such as regional housing deals, funding tranches and a taskforce.
Yes, because of rising construction costs it has become harder to realise housing projects with sufficient affordable homes.
Ja, door de gestegen bouwkosten is het vooral moeilijker geworden om woningbouwprojecten met voldoende betaalbare woningen te realiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de oproep van provincies en gemeenten aangaande het realiseren van passende juridische kaders voor gebouwgebonden financierings- en ontzorgingsinstrumenten

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister for Housing about a joint call by provinces and municipalities for legal frameworks enabling building-linked financing and turnkey renovation instruments, and whether legal obstacles exist and will be addressed. The Minister agrees such instruments could help meet renovation targets, says a study of the obstacles is under way with a promised follow-up, and answers the questions on the Wijk bij Duurstede and Amersfoort schemes only in general terms, promising to return later.
At the committee debate on the Climate Agreement for the built environment on 6 April, I undertook to examine whether and how these obstacles can be resolved.
Ik heb in het Commissiedebat Klimaatakkoord gebouwde omgeving van 6 april jl. toegezegd te zullen bezien of en hoe deze knelpunten kunnen worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over de intimidatie van klokkenluiders na kritiek op de Omgevingswet

An MP asks the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning what steps follow up on reports of intimidation of civil servants critical of the Omgevingswet, whether the ministry's climate and the DSO progress were presented too favourably, and whether the 1 January 2023 start date is still feasible. The minister says a conversation process with four reporters is underway, denies rosier reporting, and states the 1 January 2023 date remains the starting point with further information promised in October.
I expect to be able to inform the House about this in more detail in early October.
Ik verwacht begin oktober de Kamer hierover nader te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Bouwbranche trekt aan de bel: Gemeenten grootste horde bij aanpak wooncrisis'

An MP asked the housing minister about municipal bottlenecks in meeting the 100,000 homes-per-year target, including slow permit handling, capacity shortages and standardisation options. The minister outlined support instruments (flexpool, expert team, financing) and promised further letters on speeding up procedures, while stating that no Woningbouwimpuls money was spent on extra permit staff.
I expect to be able to inform your House further on this in the autumn.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hier in het najaar nader over te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Bouw flexhuizen schiet niet op, zegt Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving’

An MP asked the housing minister how the slow construction of flexible homes, flagged by the PBL, squares with new funding, and what would give them a better image and clearer rules. The minister acknowledges the PBL's points, raises the flexible-home targets, and promises a guarantee scheme and a national quality framework, though many details are left for later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over met het bericht Nieuwbouw daalt in wooncrisis – Opnieuw minder vergunningen afgegeven

An MP from the PVV asks why building permits for new housing keep falling during the housing crisis, whether the minister's own targets are being met, how many projects are stalled by nitrogen rules, and whether migration is crowding out Dutch home seekers. The minister answers that capacity, construction prices and nitrogen uncertainty are the causes, points to funding and monitoring measures and an unchanged 900,000-home target, admits nitrogen stalls cannot be fully quantified, and rejects the claim that housing is prioritised for asylum holders.
The central government does not have a central overview of (planned) housing construction projects in the Netherlands.
De rijksoverheid beschikt niet over een centraal overzicht van (beoogde) woningbouwprojecten in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over vakantieparken die mogelijk misbruikt worden door criminelen om hun geld wit te wassen

Two MPs from the SP asked ministers about holiday parks possibly misused by criminals for money laundering, including the role of municipalities, BIBOB screening and intimidation of officials. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the problem is known, that an interdepartmental action agenda and guidance exist, that a Kadaster registration change is being evaluated, and that no mandatory BIBOB screening will be imposed, leaving this to municipalities' discretion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Utrechtse sociale huurwoningen zes weken lang met voorrang naar statushouders’

An MP asked the housing minister whether Utrecht's six-week priority allocation of social rental homes to status holders, and its effect on other waiting groups and the 30 percent social housing target, is acceptable. The minister defended the temporary measure as a response to the national call to house status holders quickly, said it was limited to six weeks with alternatives kept for urgent cases, and pointed to flex housing and the regional programming as the way to increase supply.
The national government asked municipalities to quickly house status holders and to give priority to their legal task in this regard.
Het Rijk heeft gemeenten verzocht om versneld statushouders te huisvesten en hun wettelijke taak hierin met voorrang op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het aantal woningtoewijzingen aan statushouders

The MP Eerdmans asked the minister for the share of social housing allocations going to refugee status holders in the first half of 2022, by month, by municipality, and during the six-week accelerated outflow measure. The minister gave estimated figures of about 7.2% for the first half of 2022 (around 5,400 homes, based on assumed vacancy numbers), declined to provide municipal-level data, and said he lacked figures for the accelerated outflow measure.
I do not have the exact number of homes allocated to refugee status holders in the first six months of 2022.
Ik beschik niet over het exacte aantal woningen dat in de eerste zes maanden van 2022 is toegewezen aan statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de problematische renovatie van het Rijkswaterstaatkantoor in Utrecht

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked about defects in the renovation of the Rijkswaterstaat office in Utrecht, including broken windows, a leaking pond, total costs and who bore responsibility. The minister answered that the windows posed no safety risk, that costs were around 8.2 million euro after updated figures, and that the Chamber was informed through the regular process, while declining to itemise costs per defect due to confidential contractor repair costs.
The repair costs incurred by the building consortium are not public in accordance with the WOB decision reference 4279186 dated 4 April 2022 concerning the Westraven government office.
De herstelkosten die de bouwcombinatie heeft gemaakt, zijn niet openbaar conform het WOB besluit kenmerk 4279186 d.d. 4 april 2022 inzake het rijkskantoor Westraven.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Esch en Vestering over de recreatieve plannen bij het Henschotermeer

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked whether a YMCA complex relocating to the Henschotermeer area, within the Natuurnetwerk Nederland, conflicts with nature protection rules, including land use, species protection and a planned climbing forest. The minister confirmed the relocation is in process via a zoning plan revision, said compensation and ecological assessments are still being worked out, and that the municipality and province will assess the plan.
It is known that YMCA is developing plans to relocate to a site near the Henschotermeer. The zoning plan must however be amended for this.
Het is bekend dat YMCA plannen ontwikkelt om te verhuizen naar een locatie nabij het Henschotermeer. Daarvoor moet wel het bestemmingsplan worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'de tijd tikt door in het Klokkenhof’

MPs Beckerman asked the minister about reports that Vesteda and Amsterdam let tenants on generic temporary contracts become homeless or be moved within the same complex to avoid permanent contracts, questioning the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt and related rights. The minister defended the temporary contract regime, said the cases fall within the law, pointed to planned measures (WWS extension, municipal powers in vulnerable areas, the goed verhuurderschap bill) and declined to abolish the law or track homelessness effects precisely.
I am not aware whether there were parents with children housed in the Vesteda building who did not find suitable housing after their temporary tenancy ended.
Het is mij onbekend of er in het gebouw van Vesteda ouders met kinderen gehuisvest waren die geen passende huisvesting hebben gevonden nadat hun tijdelijke huurovereenkomst eindigde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Brekelmans, Ceder en Slootweg over actuele problemen van Oekraïense ontheemden

MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about problems faced by Ukrainian displaced persons, including education, income, childcare, information and housing. The government answered that municipal education choices are acceptable, rejected a fully Ukrainian curriculum for children in the Netherlands, and described existing benefit, childcare and housing measures.
It is essential that children receive a full educational offer that suits their development.
Het is namelijk essentieel dat kinderen een volwaardig onderwijsaanbod krijgen dat past bij hun ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat Nederland geen gezonde leefomgeving biedt aan kinderen

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a UNICEF report finding that the Netherlands does not offer children a healthy living environment, covering air pollution, energy poverty, breakfast, noise, lead, pesticides and damp/mould. The government replied that the situation is not 'very worrying' but that there are attention points, pointed to the forthcoming National Environmental Programme, the Clean Air Agreement, energy allowances, lead-pipe measures and a broad mould-prevention approach, and promised to answer each question individually.
For that reason I would not call the situation in the Netherlands very worrying, although there are certainly points of attention that the Netherlands wants to address.
Om die reden zou ik de situatie in Nederland niet zeer zorgelijk willen noemen, al zijn er zeker aandachtspunten waar Nederland een been bij wil trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Boulakjar en Podt over het bericht ‘Vluchteling mag wel in herrie’

MPs Boucke, Boulakjar and Podt asked why student housing is blocked near Schiphol under the LIB noise rules while refugee housing at Kronenburg is allowed, and about the duration, permit (vvgb) and planned LIB revisions. The minister replied that temporary stays up to six months are exempt from LIB rules, longer stays need a vvgb which the ILT is assessing, and a LIB revision decision is targeted for year-end.
The ILT will assess whether a vvgb can be issued.
De ILT zal beoordelen of een vvgb kan worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Wel minimum inkomen, uitgesloten van compensatie: de eindjes aan elkaar knopen is voor studenten nu wel heel lastig'

MPs Kwint asked the ministers about reports that students struggle to make ends meet and whether government will raise support, cap student loan interest, extend energy allowances and housing benefit, or address student housing costs. The government answered that the basic grant returns from 2023/2024, the minimum wage will rise, a national student housing action plan is being drafted, and it sees no room to increase funding or extend housing benefit to rented rooms for now.
I am always willing to enter into discussion with students.
Ik ben altijd bereid om in gesprek te gaan met studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het toepassen van de Wet voorkeursrecht gemeenten op een woonwijk in Arnhem, en de bewoners die daartegen in opstand komen

An SP MP asked the housing minister about the municipality of Arnhem applying the pre-emption right (voorkeursrecht) under the Wet voorkeursrecht gemeenten to an entire residential neighbourhood before any plan exists, causing resident protests, and whether such use should be restrained. The minister answered that the right only restricts sale, does not affect use or cause demolition by itself, and that he has confidence in the municipality to engage residents, while declining to urge Arnhem to withdraw it.
A pre-emption right therefore only restricts the transferability of the immovable property (the land and buildings on it) and of certain limited rights on the property.
Een voorkeursrecht beperkt dus alleen de overdraagbaarheid van de onroerende zaak (de grond en de bouwwerken daarop) en van enkele beperkte rechten op de onroerende zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de schrijnende situatie van EU-arbeidsmigranten

MP Marijnissen asks the government about the dire situation of EU labour migrants exploited by temp agencies and landlords, citing a newspaper series, and asks about enforcement, housing standards, EU free movement and inspectorate criticism. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to pending bills on temp agency certification and Goed Verhuurderschap, a plan for vulnerable EU citizens, and says data on overcrowding are not available.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het intimideren van kritische ambtenaren van BZK

An MP asked whether BZK staff critical of the Omgevingswet were pressured or intimidated, and whether officials feel free to dissent. The minister acknowledged signals of pressure on staff, said four people had come forward and a complaint is being examined, but denied knowing of such signals within BZK and could not rule out intimidation of dissenting officials.
In addition, in response to the signals received, the secretary-general is holding discussions within the organisation on conduct and the limits of integrity-compliant escalation behaviour.
Daarnaast voert de secretaris-generaal naar aanleiding van de ontvangen signalen binnen de organisatie het gesprek over omgangsvormen en de grenzen van integer escalatiegedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het toezenden van adviezen van de Landsadvocaat met betrekking tot de WOZ-cap en de middenhuur

An MP asked the housing minister to disclose Landsadvocaat advice on the WOZ cap and mid-rent regulation, arguing that Article 68 of the Constitution requires full information unless state interests are harmed. The minister refused, citing the state's procedural interest in possible litigation and the confidentiality of legal advice, while stating that no advice on mid-rent had yet been issued.
The procedural interest of the state – and therefore the state's interest – also precludes making the Landsadvocaat's advice available to the House confidentially for inspection.
Het procesbelang – en daarmee het belang van de staat – verzet zich ook tegen het vertrouwelijk bij de Kamer ter inzage leggen van het advies van de Landsadvocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Streven versnelling extra woningen uit zicht: huizenbouw loopt juist terug’

An MP asked the housing minister how a report of falling building permits fits the goal of building more homes, whether the drop is structural, and what steps will be taken. The minister said the permit figures are only one imperfect indicator, that it is too early to call a decline, that permit trends vary by municipality, and that a national Versnellingstafel will be set up to spot and address bottlenecks.
It is too early to conclude that home construction is declining.
Het is te vroeg om te kunnen constateren dat de huizenbouw terugloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de warmtepompplicht

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning, with the Minister for Climate and Energy, about the planned heat pump obligation, questioning its cost to households, its feasibility for pre-1995 homes, its savings and climate effect, and whether it distracts from the housing shortage. The government rejects the framing, stresses that households remain free to choose the installation with exceptions for unsuitable homes, and argues hybrid heat pumps save money and cut gas use, while describing the enforcement and suitability criteria as still to be worked out.
We will further elaborate on the enforcement of the standard in the coming period.
De handhaving van de normering gaan we de komende tijd verder uitwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht 'De warmtepompen van Hugo de Jonge besparen geen aardgas en geen CO2'

Van Haga asks the minister about a report claiming heat pumps save neither gas nor CO2 when electricity is counted, and questions the rising electricity demand, costs of insulation and the 2026 obligation. The minister rejects the claim, citing heat pump efficiency and cost savings, and refuses to reverse the 2026 obligation.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Eerdmans over het verplicht aanschaffen van (hybride) warmtepompen door huishoudens

MPs Van der Plas and Eerdmans asked the Minister whether the planned norm requiring heat pumps instead of single CV boilers after 2026 amounts to coercion of homeowners, and questioned subsidies, loans, costs, supply, grid capacity and tenant rent increases. The government answered that the norm applies only where economically, technically and functionally feasible, that heat pump investments generally pay back within their lifetime, and that the matter will be further studied, with commitments to inform the House and address tenant and supply concerns.
Further research will be carried out in the coming period to determine the exact scale and design of the norm and the exceptions described above.
Er zal in de komende periode nader onderzoek worden gedaan om de exacte maatvoering en vormgeving van de norm en de uitzonderingen die hierboven beschreven zijn te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel 'Bewoners in schimmelende horrorflat zijn het spuugzat’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Housing about reports of mould, collapsing balconies and neglected maintenance at a Vreeland flat owned by housing corporation De Alliantie, and about wider housing-quality and tenant-protection issues. The minister says the balconies are propped and not in imminent danger, that tenants can use the Rent Tribunal or courts, and that no landmark new oversight or APK-style inspection is planned.
I cannot make a statement on that in general terms.
Ik kan daar in algemene zin geen uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het Acantus-arrest en de gevolgen daarvan voor de warmtetransitie

An MP asked the minister whether the Supreme Court's Acantus ruling, which treats collective heat installations as inseparable from dwellings so that capital and maintenance costs must be recovered through the rent, will undermine housing corporations' sustainability investments and the heat transition. The minister answered that corporations can factor the ruling into their business cases, that he is not changing the rules, and that he expects the abolition of the landlord levy to provide enough funds, with national performance agreements to follow.

I do not intend to change the laws and regulations on this point, because I am convinced that corporations have sufficient funds for an ambitious sustainability effort following the abolition of the landlord levy.

Ik ben niet voornemens de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt te wijzigen, omdat ik ervan overtuigd ben dat corporaties met de afschaffing van de verhuurderheffing voldoende middelen hebben voor een ambitieuze verduurzamingsinzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bromet over het bericht 'Is de vezelhennepteelt ten dode opgeschreven?'

MPs Boswijk and Bromet asked whether the greening subsidy of 150 euro per hectare would end in 2023, what this means for farmers, and what the new nitrate rules mean for hemp and sustainable crops. The minister answers that the greening payment lapses at EU level and is replaced by the eco-scheme, with hemp cultivation counting as one of 21 eco-activities, and that the ecoregeling and the autumn cover-crop rules are still being developed.
The greening premium will lapse at European level in the new CAP period from January 2023.
De vergroeningspremie komt op Europees niveau te vervallen in de nieuwe GLB-periode vanaf januari 2023
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Verstrekkend stikstofvonnis zet bouwvergunningen voor meer dan 30 duizend woningen op losse schroeven’

Two VVD MPs asked the housing and nitrogen ministers how a court ruling blocking nitrogen permits for about 30,000 homes affects housing permits, who is responsible for mitigation measures, and how natuurinclusief building could help. The minister answered that finalized permits remain in force, that nitrogen space from the speed-reduction measure is no longer allocated, that responsibility for national mitigation lies with the Rijk while initiators handle project-level measures, and that a binding nature-inclusive construction scheme is too early to develop.
No, permits that have become irrevocable remain in force.
Nee, onherroepelijk geworden vergunningen blijven in stand.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel in het AD met als titel ‘Hugo de Jonge is dolblij met deze huizen, maar het is net een sauna: ‘Het is hier 27 graden’’ van 27 maart jongstleden

An SP MP asked Minister De Jonge about flex housing, its security of tenure, durability, business case, and the Groningen container student housing controversy, including high energy bills, abusive subletting, and poor landlord conduct. The minister largely defended flex housing as a supplement to regular supply, said tenant protection remains via existing rules and local action, and declined to answer several detailed questions, deferring to municipalities and others.
As stated in the coalition agreement, fixed-term rental contracts must remain the norm.
Zoals in het coalitieakkoord is opgenomen, moeten vaste huurcontracten de norm blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de bouw van het Datacentrum Zeewolde

The MP Grinwis asked ministers about the planned Meta hyperscale data centre in Zeewolde, including the government's ability to stop it, the sustainability conditions for selling state land, and the use of farmland and grid capacity. The minister answered that a preparatory decision restricts new hyperscale data centres, that TNO found the plan does not yet meet the sustainability conditions so the state land cannot be sold yet, and that legal tools to block the already adopted zoning plan are currently unavailable.
I myself asked the State Advocate for advice on my legal options to still stop the hyperscale data centre in Zeewolde.
Zelf heb ik de Landsadvocaat om advies gevraagd over mijn juridische mogelijkheden om alsnog het hyperscale datacenter in Zeewolde tegen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Boulakjar over de situatie rondom de Regeling Huisvesting Aandachtsgroepen

Two D66 MPs asked the housing minister why funds under the Regeling huisvesting aandachtsgroepen remained unspent, whether legal deadlines and start-date rules hinder realisation, and what the Ukraine crisis changes for municipalities. The minister answered that nearly all applications were granted, that a mid-term evaluation and 2021 accountability are pending, that deadlines are meant to ensure timely delivery, and that no formal signals of spending problems or financial strain have been received.
At the end of June I will share the outcomes of an interim evaluation of this scheme with you by letter.
Eind juni zal ik per brief de uitkomsten van een tussenevaluatie op deze regeling met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de peperdure renovatie van het Binnenhof

An MP asks the minister why the Binnenhof renovation budget rose from 475 to 734 million euros, who is accountable, what compensation was agreed with The Hague for the closed Binnenhof, and what the restored moat costs. The minister attributes the increases mainly to higher security requirements and extra sustainability wishes of the House plus price-level adjustments, promises a fuller account of possible external-cause disclaimers in the next progress report, and says compensation costs are commercially confidential.
Regarding any reliance on the disclaimers shared with your House, i.e. causes influenced by external factors, I will inform you in the next progress report, as has always been the case.

Over het eventuele beroep op de met uw Kamer gedeelde disclaimers, dat wil zeggen de oorzaken die door externe factoren worden beïnvloed, zal ik u zoals steeds het geval is geweest in de volgende voortgangsrapportage informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘huurders die tegen de afspraak in op straat worden gezet’

MP Nijboer asks whether landlords may withdraw fixed-term leases without reasons despite promises to extend, whether tenants who invoke their rights face non-renewal, and whether the law should make permanent leases the norm again. Minister De Jonge answers that landlords need not extend fixed-term leases or give reasons, that oral promises are enforceable only if the tenant proves them in court, and that the government will extend the housing point system to more rentals and give municipalities tools against misuse of temporary contracts.
If oral agreements have been made between a tenant and landlord about extending a fixed-term lease, the landlord is bound to honour them.
Indien tussen een huurder en verhuurder mondeling afspraken zijn gemaakt over de verlenging van een huurovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd is de verhuurder gehouden om deze na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de onacceptabele uithuiszetting van huurders in Capelle aan den IJssel

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the housing minister how to stop landlords from using temporary leases in Capelle aan den IJssel to evict tenants and re-let at higher starting rents, and whether such caps could apply to starting rents. The minister said permanent leases should remain the norm, promised to extend the points-based rent system and make it binding, and said municipalities may get tools to curb misuse of temporary leases, while rejecting a cap on starting rents for liberalised homes.
As stated in the coalition agreement, fixed-term rental contracts must remain the norm.
Zoals in het coalitieakkoord is opgenomen, moeten vaste huurcontracten de norm blijven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het kwartaalbericht van de Nationaal Hypotheek Garantie (NHG); 'minder verlies en lagere restschulden, maar hogere risicobereidheid consument om een huis te kopen' en het bez

An MP asks the minister about NHG's quarterly report on higher consumer risk appetite for buying homes, starter mortgages, cooperative housing, support for vulnerable owners, and energy-saving subsidies for low incomes. The minister answers largely by pointing to existing and planned measures (basisbeurs, Nibud advice in autumn, Warmtefonds, NIP, NPLV) and declines to launch several proposed studies or funds.
I see that consumers tend to show riskier behaviour, such as buying without a financing contingency.
Ik zie ook dat consumenten geneigd zijn om risicovoller gedrag te vertonen, zoals het kopen zonder voorbehoud van financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar en Romke de Jong over btw op zonnepanelen

MPs Boulakjar and Romke de Jong asked whether the planned zero VAT rate on solar panels should extend beyond homeowners to postcode-rose members, public and community buildings, and tenants. The state secretary answered that the zero rate covers panels on or near homes including for landlords and housing corporations, but not on public buildings (still under study) and not for rental of panels.
Further research must determine whether it is possible and desirable to facilitate solar panels on public and other buildings, and if so, whether a zero VAT rate is a sensible policy route for that.

Verder onderzoek moet plaatsvinden of het mogelijk en wenselijk is zonnepanelen op openbare en andere gebouwen te faciliteren, en zo ja, of een btw-nultarief daarvoor beleidsmatig een verstandige route is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over het bericht 'Demonstratie tegen 'verpretparking' Henschotermeer: 'Willen duidelijk signaal afgeven''

MPs Van Esch and Wassenberg asked whether recreation plans at the Henschotermeer would erode protected nature and landscape, and whether the government would intervene. The minister replied that the plans do not touch the Natuurnetwerk Nederland, that no concrete initiatives have yet been submitted, that the province will test any plans under nature law, and that the government will not urge the municipalities or province to block them.
As stated in the answer to question 3, these recreation developments will not convert any hectares within the boundary of the Natuurnetwerk Nederland into recreation land.
Er worden, zoals gemeld in het antwoord op vraag 3, als gevolg van deze recreatieontwikkelingen geen hectares binnen de begrenzing van het Natuurnetwerk Nederland omgevormd naar recreatiegebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Change= verlengt contract lastige huurders niet’

MP Beckerman (SP) asked whether landlord Change= refuses to renew tenancy contracts of tenants who object to service charges, deducts deposits wrongly, withholds positive landlord references, uses bailiffs and intimidates tenants, and whether the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt undermines tenants' housing rights. Minister De Jonge answers that tenants can refer service-charge disputes to the Huurcommissie, that landlords may decline renewal of temporary contracts, that the Wet goed verhuurderschap will give municipalities enforcement powers, and that the temporary-contract regime is being reweighed.
It is up to the landlord whether a temporary tenancy agreement is extended.
Het is aan de verhuurder of een tijdelijke huurovereenkomst wordt verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'EU: aardgas is duurzaam'

An MP asks the government how its stance on natural gas squares with the EU's classification of gas as sustainable and with its policy to phase out gas in homes, and questions the effect of Dutch CO2 cuts given emissions elsewhere. The minister rejects the view that the EU label is good news, says inclusion in the taxonomy is temporary and conditional and does not alter Dutch climate ambitions, and maintains that the gas phase-out in buildings continues.
The taxonomy is neither a prohibition nor a requirement, does not detract from the climate targets applying to the Netherlands, and therefore does not conflict with Dutch climate policy.
De taxonomie is verbod noch gebod, doet niets af aan de klimaatdoelen die gelden voor Nederland en staat daarmee niet haaks op het Nederlandse klimaatbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Kabinet overweegt met dwang bouwlocaties aan te wijzen’

An MP asked whether the minister will use coercive designation of building locations if local and provincial authorities stall housing construction, and about criteria, infrastructure, affordability and transformation. The minister answered that local and provincial authorities are primarily responsible, that coercive designation would only be considered after failed negotiation, and set out existing plans on housing targets, accessibility funding and flexible housing.
Should a deadlock arise over an important building location, it may sometimes be necessary to make a decision.
Mocht het zijn dat er een impasse ontstaat over een belangrijke bouwlocatie dan kan het soms nodig zijn om een knoop door te hakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas, Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht "Sanctie-experts: Nederland niet doeltreffend met opsporen Russisch vastgoed"

VVD MPs asked the government why sanctions enforcement on Russian-linked real estate in the Netherlands was unclear, whether other countries were more effective, and when concrete results would be reported. The minister answered that roles are divided among ministries, the Kadaster checks found no sanctioned persons as registered owners so far, and the government will continue reporting on progress.
From time to time the cabinet will continue to do this.
Op gezette tijden zal het kabinet dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht in het Financieele Dagblad ‘Aedes wil landelijke toets voor fabriekswoningen’

An MP asked the minister whether a national approval framework for prefabricated homes is needed, since municipalities currently assess each factory-built home separately against the Bouwbesluit, causing delays. The minister agreed the issue is real, said the Wkb (quality assurance) due on 1 January 2023 will allow one-off national approval of standard designs, and said pilot projects are under way.
With the introduction of the Wkb quality assurance act for construction, national approval of factory-built homes as Aedes proposes will already be largely possible.
Met de komst van de Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen (Wkb) wordt het landelijk goedkeuren van fabriekswoningen zoals Aedes voorstelt al grotendeels mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Gekkenhuis op markt voor zonnepanelen en warmtepompen’

MPs Erkens and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about a news report on a surge in demand and long waiting times for solar panels and heat pumps, covering possible government actions, installer shortages, suitability of heat pumps and insulation of rented homes. Minister Jetten answered that the demand increase reflects higher energy prices, that supply and installer capacity issues are largely for the market and labour policy, and that the government is pursuing a programmatic insulation approach with housing associations and landlords.
The shortage is a consequence of a global market disruption caused by strong fluctuations in demand and in the transport chain.
Het tekort is een gevolg van een wereldwijde verstoring van de markt, veroorzaakt door sterke schommelingen in de vraag en in de transportketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over huurdersvoordracht

An MP asked the housing minister whether he would act against existing tenants demanding key money from new tenants via tenant referral, and whether he would ban the practice or add a ban to the good landlordship bill. The minister agreed the practice is undesirable, but saw no basis for a ban or large-scale investigation, pointing instead to a broader rights programme and continued dialogue with the sector body.
I have no insight into the number of cases in which tenants demand key money.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de aantallen waarin het vragen van sleutelgeld door huurders voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de berichtgeving dat de woningbouw in gevaar komt door te weinig grind en zand

An MP asked whether a sand and gravel shortage threatens housing construction because permits are not renewed or granted, and about national oversight of extraction permits. The minister acknowledged the importance of raw materials, said a national monitoring system is being set up, and noted that national steering was abandoned in 2003 and the role lies with provinces and the market.
To regain a national overview, a new national monitoring system is currently being developed.
Om het landelijk overzicht opnieuw te verkrijgen wordt momenteel gewerkt aan het opzetten van een nieuw landelijk monitoringssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort, Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over de uitzending van EenVandaag over mogelijke tekorten in industriezand en grind

VVD MPs asked the government whether extraction permits for sand and gravel are expiring, whether shortages will arise, and how supply will meet the infrastructure and housing ambitions. The minister answered that a monitoring system and a national demand forecast are being developed, that circularity measures are underway, and that talks with provinces and the sector are ongoing.
At present, the need for sand and gravel is being mapped in cooperation with knowledge institutes and industry organisations. The House will be informed of the results before the end of the year.

Op dit moment wordt – in samenwerking met kennisinstituten en brancheorganisaties – de behoefte aan zand en grind in beeld gebracht. De Kamer zal voor het eind van het jaar over het resultaat worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Vewin: drinkwater voor 900.000 nieuwe woningen niet zeker’

MPs Minhas and Peter de Groot asked the ministers about reports that drinking water supply for 900,000 new homes to 2030 is uncertain, and about the state of water sources, coordination with the housing sector, and planned measures. The minister answers that supply is secured for at least 10 years through supply plans supervised by the ILT, and points to ongoing studies, strategic reserves, a 800 million euro Deltaplan and a planned water-saving exploration, but gives no concrete figures on new sources.
RIVM is working on a supplementary report on the availability of sources, to be completed by mid-2022.
RIVM werkt aan een aanvullend rapport over de beschikbaarheid van bronnen, dat medio 2022 zal worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over regels in het Bouwbesluit 2012 die in de weg staan bij de opvang van Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the minister whether municipalities are uncertain about applying Bouwbesluit 2012 building rules to temporary crisis shelter for Ukrainian refugees, and what flexibility exists. The minister confirmed the uncertainty, pointed to equivalence provisions and a joint VNG guidance handbook, and said no further clarification or consultation commitment was made beyond existing cooperation.
Invoking equivalence, a municipality can always assess whether, in a given case, the functional requirement of the Bouwbesluit 2012 is met in a different way than the performance requirement.

Met een beroep op gelijkwaardigheid kan een gemeente altijd beoordelen of in een bepaald geval ook op een andere manier (dan de prestatie-eis) voldaan wordt aan de functionele eis die het Bouwbesluit 2012 stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over knelpunten en drempels bij de boostercampagne

An MP asked the health minister about bottlenecks in the COVID booster campaign, including GGD refusing help from GPs and pharmacists, temporary staff contracts, and long waits for older people. The minister answered that no national rule blocked outside help, that GGDs managed staffing and booster scheduling, and that evaluation and further scenario planning were underway.
There is no national regulation that has obstructed the deployment of these professionals.
Er is geen landelijke regelgeving die de inzet van deze professionals in de weg heeft gezeten.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het onafhankelijk worden van Russisch gas

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about the EU's independence from Russian gas, including energy-saving scenarios, the Nationaal Isolatieprogramma, enforcement of existing energy-saving duties, SDE++ subsidies, and Gazprom's activities and contracts in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports ambitious EU energy-saving targets, announced a campagne and insulation programme, gave limited commitments on new duties while rejecting some proposals, and explained the sanctions framework that limits action against Gazprom entities.
It is undesirable that we as European countries contribute in this way to the Russian state coffers.
Het is onwenselijk dat we als Europese landen op deze manier bijdragen aan de Russische staatskas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Boucke over maatwerkafspraken voor woningbouw

MPs Boulakjar and Boucke asked about maintenance-style exceptions (maatwerk) allowing housing near Schiphol under the airport zoning decree (LIB), the student housing at Kronenburg, and whether a revised LIB should follow the new noise and enforcement rules. The minister answered that only a limited number of exemptions have been granted, that a revised LIB will follow the pending LVB change and could free some land for housing, and that talks with the regional authority are ongoing.
In the LIB 4 area the noise exposure is such that caution must be exercised when adding housing.
In het LIB 4 gebied is de geluidbelasting dusdanig dat er terughoudend moet worden omgegaan met het toevoegen van woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de berichten 'Ik ben ziek geworden van mijn huis' en 'Trees woonde 1,5 jaar in hotel vanwege huurhuis vol schimmel, nu moet ze 11.000 euro betalen'

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the housing minister, citing newspaper reports on tenants made ill by mould and legionella and a tenant who lived in a hotel and was then billed, why the government does not force landlords to fix damp and mould faster, and asks about a national approach, an APK-style inspection, and faster procedures. The minister answers that landlords are primarily responsible, that a broad approach (priorities, TNO handbooks, funding, Aedes agreements) is in place, that no national reporting point, compulsory inspection, ultimatum or new legislation is planned, and that tenants can use the Huurcommissie, the courts or the municipality.
I am not in favour of a mandatory general periodic inspection for rented homes.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een verplichte algemene periodieke keuring voor huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het snel opschalen van het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma

An MP asks the ministers to scale up and programmatically reshape the National Insulation Programme, including targeting the worst-insulated homes, coordinating with municipalities, and adding a voucher scheme. The government answers by referring to a separate letter presenting the National Insulation Programme, without addressing the questions in substance.

The written questions from MP Grinwis (ChristenUnie) to the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning on rapidly scaling up the National Insulation Programme have been answered by means of the letter 'Presentation of National Insulation Programme'.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Grinwis (ChristenUnie) aan de Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening over het snel opschalen van het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma ( 2022Z00970 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «Aanbieding Nationaal Isolatieprogramma» (Kamerstuk 30 196, nr. 787 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de toediening van injecties met een experimentele gentherapie aan (gezonde) Nederlanders en de communicatie daarover

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health about an Instagram post on coronavirus vaccination, whether mRNA and vector vaccines count as gene therapy, the conditional approval status and long-term safety of the vaccines, pregnancy effects, the QR-code (CoronaCheck) regime, and the government's communication. The Minister answers that vaccines are not gene therapy, that conditional authorisation does not mean skipped steps, that no link to neonatal disorders was found, that the QR-code is proportionate and temporary, and declines to engage with comparisons to historical exclusion.
I will not go into comparisons with earlier events.
Ik ga niet in op vergelijkingen met eerdere gebeurtenissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Geurts over het bericht 'Hallo, wij hebben 125 mille studieschuld, hoeveel hypotheek krijgen we?'

Two CDA MPs asked whether student debt under the loan system, which reduces mortgage capacity, is fair, whether students were aware it counts, and whether municipalities could guarantee student loans. The minister acknowledged students were not always aware, defended including student debt under the consumer-protection rules, said guarantees add little, and saw no clear state role.
I find it important that the student debt is still taken into account.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de studieschuld wel wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over PCR-testcapaciteit die in te zetten is voor grootschalig testen

MPs Bikker and Westerveld asked why LAMP test lines used successfully by GGD Amsterdam were not rolled out nationally, and about costs, capacity and high-throughput PCR options for mass testing. The minister explained that LAMP lines need highly qualified staff and produce more errors at volume, gave cost figures, and said further assessment is pending; for many questions she said the data are unknown.
Before the test lines can be used again, a research process must first be carried out.
Voordat de testlijnen weer kunnen worden ingezet, moet eerst een onderzoekstraject worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Van der Woude over het bericht ‘student zoekt studentenwoning, internationale investeerders net zo goed’

MPs De Groot and Van der Woude asked about rising competition for student housing from international students and investors, and about the link to the housing shortage, sizes of rooms, and loneliness. The minister acknowledged a link but cited multiple causes, described existing monitoring, linked shared-room regulation to the housing points system, and promised a report and an additional monitoring module.
I consider it important to get a better picture of this from the perspective of student housing.
Ik vind het belangrijk om dit vanuit studentenhuisvesting beter in beeld te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Boulakjar over de kamerverhuurvrijstelling

MPs Romke de Jong and Boulakjar asked whether the room-rental tax exemption (kamerverhuurvrijstelling) should be raised to better use the housing stock, and about its rationale, budget and tax effects. The government answered that better use of existing housing can help, referred to the National Housing and Construction Agenda, explained the exemption's conditions and rationale, and argued that raising it would have negligible effects on the housing shortage and could push up rents.
Because the exempt amount per month is already higher than the average cost of a room with shared facilities, I consider the chosen level of the room-rental exemption defensible
