Omdat het vrijgestelde bedrag per maand reeds hoger is dan de gemiddelde kostprijs voor een kamer met gedeelde voorzieningen vind ik de gekozen hoogte van de kamerverhuurvrijstelling verdedigbaar
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het Duitse onderzoek naar de werking van mondkapjes tegen besmetting met corona

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister for the government's reaction to a German study on FFP2 mask protection and how it would affect the reproduction number, daily positive tests and transmission risk indoors. The minister answered that masks are one part of a broader measure package, that the effect of individual measures was not calculated, and that the OMT advises medical masks indoors in high-risk settings.
It was not calculated per measure and per setting how large the effect on the reproduction number is.
Er is niet per maatregel en per setting berekend hoe groot de het effect op het reproductiegetal is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het besluit van de voorzieningenrechter dat een zwembad in Hilversum voorlopig geen coronatoegangsbewijs hoeft te controleren voor zwemles

An MP asked the health and justice ministers whether the rules requiring parents to show a COVID pass at swimming pools should change after a court ruled that swimming lessons are not sport and a pool need not check passes for them. The minister answered that the CTB requirement for sports venues was lifted on 25 February, that swimming lessons remain sports-regime activities, and that the court ruling did not change the obligation, so no rule change was made.
I therefore saw no reason to give parents the option to enter swimming pools without a CTB, since the safety of other parents, staff and swimmers present is paramount.
Ik zag daarom geen aanleiding om ouders de mogelijkheid te geven om zonder CTB zwembaden te betreden, de veiligheid van de daar aanwezige andere ouders, personeel en zwemmers staat immers voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de werking van mondkapjes naar aanleiding van het coronadebat van 1 december jl.

An MP asked the health minister how much the face-mask rules and advice reduced the reproduction number in each setting according to RIVM modelling, and whether a single mask rule should replace the patchwork. The minister answered that the measures were assessed together, no per-setting effect was calculated, and the mask requirement was relaxed from 25 February while keeping advice on type II masks.
It was not calculated per measure and per setting how large the effect on the reproduction number is.
Er is niet per maatregel en per setting berekend hoe groot het effect op het reproductiegetal is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over het artikel 'Huisarts mist ruimte voor uitbreiding'

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Housing about the LHV survey showing generalpractice premises shortages, whether municipalities share responsibility, and related questions on costs, inventories and acute care notification rules. The Minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities share responsibility for adequate premises through land-use planning, declined a separate regional inventory, and pointed to digitalisation and coalition measures.
I will therefore not carry out an additional inventory.
Ik zal daarom geen aanvullende inventarisatie uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Warmtepomp of zonnepanelen verplicht bij grote verbouwing door nieuwe EU-regels' van 10 februari jl.

An MP asked why EU rules require renewable energy measures such as heat pumps or solar panels during major renovations of owner-occupied homes, whether Belgium omits this rule, and how cost and affordability are safeguarded. The minister answered that EU directive REDII must be implemented, explained the differing Belgian implementation and the Commission's infringement procedure, noted the economic-feasibility exemption with a ten-year payback criterion, and said a programme on support for homeowners will follow.
As a member state of the European Union, the Netherlands is obliged to ensure compliance with European law.
Nederland is als lidstaat van de Europese Unie verplicht de nakoming van het Europees recht te verzekeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de opzegging van de overeenkomsten van de standplaatsen op het Vakantiepark Berkenven

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about the termination of pitch agreements at Het Berkenven campsite, where residents live permanently, and whether children and elderly residents risk homelessness. The minister answered that the termination is a private-law matter, that most residents have found other housing, that the owner has committed to preventing homelessness, that no legal rehousing duty exists, and that a study on investor takeover of holiday parks is underway.
It is not for me, or for my colleague minister of EZK, to assess whether the landlord has complied with the agreements and conditions in this case.
Het is niet aan mij, of aan mijn collegaminister van EZK, om te beoordelen of de verhuurder zich in dit geval aan de afspraken en voorwaarden heeft gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over "aanhoudende briefjes van beleggers voor het opkopen van woningen"

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about investors using door-to-door notes and posing as a couple to buy homes, and whether NVM broker conduct rules and disciplinary law are enforced. The Minister acknowledges the practice may be misleading, points to a verbal improvement plan with brokers and a planned April 2022 review, and outlines tax and buyer-protection measures against investors.
If however the names are only used to win the seller's sympathy, and the house is not actually bought by them, that may be misleading.
Indien de namen echter enkel gebruikt worden om de sympathie van de verkoper te wekken, en de woning niet daadwerkelijk door hen wordt aangekocht, kan dat misleidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over werkenden en studenten met Long Covid

Two MPs from D66 asked ministers about workers and students with long-covid, covering occupational care for self-employed, WIA disability inflow, paramedical recovery care coverage, and university support. The government answered that research on long-covid is ongoing, WIA inflow is partly explained by structural factors while UWV investigates the rest, paramedical care is capped at two six-month periods, and it will not extend this limit.
I do not intend to extend the maximum treatment period of twice six months.
Ik ben niet voornemens de maximale behandeltermijn van tweemaal zes maanden te verlengen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Hijink, Omtzigt, Van der Plas en Pouw-Verweij over de positie van zorgverleners die als gevolg van long covid lange tijd thuis zitten

Four MPs asked the health minister about healthcare workers off work for long periods with long COVID, including compensation, income loss and whether those costs are covered. The minister replied that no special social security regime exists for long COVID, that a temporary subsidy for employers retaining such workers was introduced, and that causation from workplace infection cannot be established in many cases.
No registration is kept of the number of healthcare workers who are partly or fully off work after a coronavirus infection.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van het aantal zorgverleners dat na een coronabesmetting deels of volledig thuiszit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over servicekosten

MP Nijboer asked about the rules on service charges on top of the net rent, whether landlords advertise low net rents while charging high service costs, and why the cabinet plans to exclude service costs from the rent used for housing allowance, plus the minimum that may be charged. Minister De Jonge replied that service charges must be a reasonable reimbursement of actual costs, with tenants able to object to the rent commission or landlord, that he finds misleading advertising undesirable and will address it in the Goed verhuurderschap bill, and that he will not narrow the definition of service costs.
I find it undesirable when tenants are surprised by having to find that they actually have to pay much more for a rental home than initially indicated.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als huurders verrast worden doordat zij moeten vaststellen dat zijn in werkelijkheid totaal veel meer voor een huurwoning moeten betalen dan in eerste instantie is aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Aanpak woningnood op drijfzand: planning 1,2 miljoen huizen is wensdenken'

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Housing about reports that housing plan capacity is unreliable, including inconsistent counting across provinces, the treatment of demolitions, overprogramming of 30%, and the need for task forces and better data. The Minister acknowledges monitoring problems, promises unified definitions and a more accurate demolition estimate in June, and points to ongoing programme and expert support for municipalities.
I have now made agreements with the other governments on the use of unambiguous definitions for, among other things, hard and soft plan capacity and plan type.
Ik heb inmiddels met de medeoverheden afspraken gemaakt over het gebruik van eenduidige definities voor o.a. harde en zachte plancapaciteit en plantype
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Peter de Groot en Minhas over woningbouw binnen bestaand stedelijk gebied en de gevolgen voor sportvoorzieningen

MPs from the VVD asked the housing and health ministers whether housing construction in dense cities is squeezing sports facilities, and how municipalities plan space for sport. The minister answered that data on squeezed sports space is unavailable, that no standard norms exist, that he will not mandate a sports paragraph in spatial plans, and that the government will compile examples of multifunctional sports facilities.
A specific obligation regarding including a sports paragraph does not seem desirable given municipalities' own responsibility in this, and in my view is also not necessary.
Een specifieke verplichting m.b.t. het opnemen van een sportparagraaf lijkt niet wenselijk gezien de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten in deze, en is m.i. ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over testen voor toegang en amateursporten

An MP asked the health minister about the impact of COVID certificate requirements on amateur sport, the treatment of unvaccinated staff and visitors, and alleged vaccination fraud at GGD. The minister pointed to studies showing limited disruption to competitions, explained which activities require the certificate, and said a police investigation into staff fraud was ongoing, declining to share details.
In the interest of the investigation, GGD GHOR Nederland shares no further information.
In het belang van het onderzoek deelt GGD GHOR Nederland geen verdere informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Strolenberg over het artikel 'Een rol bij de lijkschouw'

MPs Van den Hil and Strolenberg asked whether task reallocation could let PAs and nurse specialists perform death inspections, easing shortages of elderly-care physicians and municipal inspectors. The minister replies that a careful study starting spring 2022 will assess whether such task shifting adds value, with results shared with the House around summer, and that temporary emergency solutions for municipal inspections are being discussed.
In spring 2022 the study will start, and around the summer the results will be shared with your House.
Voorjaar 2022 wordt gestart met het onderzoek en rond de zomer zullen de resultaten hiervan met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Bouw van zeker tienduizend huizen bedreigd door geldtekort'

An MP asked the housing minister whether a funding shortfall threatens the Transformation Facility managed by SVN, which could stall the construction or conversion of 10,000 to 12,000 homes, and what options exist to keep it funded. The minister answered that repayments are on schedule and that demand is higher than expected, that the Rijk has allocated 58 million euros of which 43 million is committed, and that a broader plan for the coming years is being explored.
As part of the housing construction programme, I will explore what is needed to keep the Transformation Facility running well in the coming years.
Ik ga in het kader van het woningbouwprogramma verkennen wat nodig is om de Transformatiefaciliteit ook de komende jaren goed te laten draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over coronazelftesten en coronamedicatie

An MP asks the health minister about quality differences between COVID-19 self-tests, validation standards, supply shortages, free distribution and the decision not to order extra Ronapreve. The minister answers that CE marking and notified body review apply, cites independent studies and stricter EU rules from May 2022, says there is no current shortage and no government role in pricing, and explains the choice not to reorder Ronapreve.
Nevertheless, I share the view that insight into the performance of widely available self-tests is important.
Desondanks deel ik de opvatting dat inzicht in de prestaties van ruim verkrijgbare zelftesten belangrijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Janssen covid-19 vaccin en aansprakelijkheid

An MP from FvD asked the health minister about the phone line for booking Janssen COVID-19 vaccinations, the call script, the age-based policy change after June 2021, informed consent, and who is liable for thrombosis-related harm. The minister answered in detail that the script exists and is described, that the Janssen vaccine remained available on request after informed consent, and that people who chose it after being informed cannot hold others liable for the disclosed side effects.

For people who contacted the Janssen choice line, which only started after June 2021, and chose to be vaccinated with Janssen, it applies that they repeatedly declared before administration that they were aware of the possible side effects of the Janssen vaccine.

Voor mensen die contact opnamen met de Janssen-keuzelijn, die pas na juni 2021 startte, en ervoor hebben gekozen om zich te laten vaccineren met Janssen, geldt dat zij voor de toediening van het vaccin meermaals verklaard hebben zij bekend waren met de mogelijke bijwerkingen van het Janssen-vaccin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de Zembla uitzending over de uitstoot van giftige stoffen op Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked the government about the Zembla broadcast on toxic emissions at Schiphol and the health risks for platform workers, including accountability, Arbowet compliance, and liability. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to sector-wide steps and ongoing Labour Inspectorate investigation, but largely placed responsibility on employers and stated that data on life expectancy and some emission assessments are unavailable or pending.

It is up to the employer and the client to ensure this. The Netherlands Labour Inspectorate started an investigation at the end of 2021 into compliance with working conditions legislation at Schiphol.

Het is aan de werkgever en de opdrachtgever om daar zorg voor te dragen. De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie is eind 2021 onderzoek gestart naar de naleving van de arbeidsomstandighedenwet- en regelgeving op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ‘Coronavirus tijdlijn’ op de website van de rijksoverheid

An MP asks why the government's Coronavirus timeline has not been updated since June 2021 despite promising quarterly updates, and requests a visual, searchable timeline showing measures, durations, vaccinations and ICU capacity. The Minister answers that the timeline is a chronological reference work updated quarterly with a lag, that the requested interactive tool and searchable features do not fit its purpose, and that the information is available elsewhere (Coronadashboard, Wettenbank) while committing to publish the Q3 2021 update in Q1 2022.
Because the timeline is a chronological reference work, it is drawn up afterwards, coordinated and published every quarter.
Vanwege het feit dat de tijdlijn een chronologisch naslagwerk is, wordt deze naderhand opgesteld, afgestemd en elk kwartaal gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over de voorwaarden voor het ontvangen van huurtoeslag

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked whether rent allowance (huurtoeslag) can only be claimed from the first full calendar month of residence and why partial-month payment is not allowed, arguing this creates a barrier for tenants who may struggle with the first month's rent. Minister De Jonge replied that the rule applies to all income-dependent schemes for simplicity and administrability, that changes can be processed per month, and that landlords or payment arrangements can help, while declining to commit to a systemic change.
I do not consider it desirable to change the current system to one in which changes are processed immediately.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk om de huidige systematiek aan te passen naar een systeem waarbij wijzigingen per direct verwerkt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Nieuwste oplichterstruc: koophuis te huur aanbieden’

An MP asked the housing minister about fraudsters advertising for-sale homes as rentals, and what can be done about it, including platform responsibility. The minister confirmed the practice, pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap bill and existing ACM enforcement, and said platforms should take their own measures.
Furthermore, I am working on further regulation of the rental process through the Goed Verhuurderschap bill.
Voorts werk ik aan een verdere regulering van het verhuurproces via het wetsvoorstel Goed Verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de voorlichting van kinderen en ouders over de coronamaatregelen en -vaccinatie

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Health about information for children aged 5-12 and parents on COVID vaccination, communication plans, reaching non-Dutch-speaking or digitally excluded parents, combating disinformation, and vaccination-certificate validity for under-18s. The minister answered that information packages, multilingual and visual materials, a RIVM project plan, a disinformation handbook and certificate-validity rules are in place or being developed, and that a decision on boosters for 12-18 year olds would follow shortly.
I will take a decision on this very shortly.
Ik zal op zeer korte termijn een besluit hierover nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Thuiszorghulp heeft voortaan ook recht op sociale zekerheidsregelingen’

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Van der Laan asked the government about a court ruling that personal care helpers paid via a PGB (personal budget) are entitled to unemployment insurance (WW) under indirect sex discrimination, and about its consequences for premiums, informal work, and social security for domestic workers. The minister answered that the ruling is under appeal at the CRvB and should not be extrapolated, that UWV continues to apply the exemption pending the appeal, and that extending WW coverage would have far-reaching implications for the system, so no change is planned.
This concerns a ruling by one court in an individual case. There is therefore no settled case law.
Het betreft hier een uitspraak van één rechtbank in een individuele casus. Daarmee is geen sprake van bestendige jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het sluiten van kinderhartcentra

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the health minister why two rather than one children's heart centres are being closed, what criteria and financial motives lay behind the choice of Rotterdam and Utrecht, and whether more specialist care will be centralised. The minister answers that concentration in two intervention centres is needed to meet volume norms, staffing and succession problems, that financial considerations play no role, and that other care and emergency services remain available, promising a separate letter on the selection criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het voornemen om het kindhartcentrum in Groningen te sluiten

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the Minister of Health why the child heart centre in Groningen should close, given the regional impact, the loss of expertise and the pressure on intensive care staff. The Minister replies that concentration of child heart interventions in two centres is needed for quality and continuity, that regional centres keep diagnostic and aftercare roles, that the NZa will conduct an impact analysis, and that he would reconsider only if a UMC-backed alternative with two intervention centres or substantive grounds from the impact analysis emerge.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over nijpende tekorten aan forensische artsen

An SP MP asks the health and justice ministers about acute shortages of forensic doctors, including reliance on temporary contractors, retirements, pay, and whether the EUR 20 million per year needed should be decided now or left to a new cabinet. The government acknowledges the acute and long-standing shortage, describes recruitment, training and reorganisation measures, and says the funding decision is for the new cabinet.
It is up to the cabinet to take a definitive decision on this, including securing the necessary funding.
Het is aan het kabinet om hierover een definitief besluit te nemen, waaronder ook het borgen van de benodigde dekking.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken en Kathmann over het veilige verloop van de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen en de gevolgen van de snelle toename van het aantal besmettingen voor de organisatie van de gemeenteraadsverkiezin

Two PvdA MPs asked how rising COVID-19 infections affect the safe organisation of the municipal elections, including adequacy of measures, mobile polling stations, polling staff and contacts with municipalities. The minister answers that the Temporary COVID-19 Elections Act provides sufficient powers, that voter turnout is not expected to fall, that municipalities decide on mobile polling stations, and that a national recruitment campaign is not needed but support materials are provided.
The Temporary COVID-19 Elections Act (Twv) provides the legal basis for taking the measures needed to keep elections safe during the coronavirus pandemic.
De Tijdelijke wet verkiezingen covid-19 (Twv) biedt de grondslag voor het nemen van maatregelen die nodig zijn om verkiezingen veilig te houden tijdens de coronapandemie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Gündoğan, Simons en Omtzigt over het behoud van personeel bij de GGD’en

MPs asked the health minister about GGD staffing shortages, the medium-term outlook for testing and contact tracing, and whether temporary staff can be retained given rising demand. The minister replied that GGDs are responsible for their own personnel policy, that enough staff exist for the booster campaign, and that cost compensation and permanent contracts for essential staff provide assurance, though long-term plans are still under review.
Each GGD is responsible for its own personnel policy, and the way its staff is organised can vary considerably.
Elke GGD is verantwoordelijk voor zijn eigen personeelsbeleid, waarbij de manier waarop het personeelsbestand is vormgegeven sterk kan variëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een Engels COVID-onderzoek

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a UK study claiming vaccinated deaths are misclassified as unvaccinated and about a blog analysis suggesting no excess mortality under 65 in the Netherlands, asking whether the vaccination policy should change. The minister answered that the blog is non-peer-reviewed, that the vaccine status classification follows manufacturer-recommended periods, that Lareb and RIVM monitor deaths after vaccination, and that the evidence gives no reason to change vaccination policy.
No, this research gives no reason to change the vaccination policy.
Nee, dit onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding om het vaccinatiebeleid te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht ‘Medewerkers van GGD moeten weg na drie tijdelijke contracten’

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the ministers about reports that GGD staff on test and vaccination sites must leave after three temporary contracts, and whether covid financing could allow permanent contracts. The government answered that GGD organisations are responsible for their own personnel policy, that permanent contracts and redundancy procedures are possible, that VWS will finance certain extra costs under a cost-reimbursement scheme, and that talks will continue.
I have asked the GGDs whether they can quickly map the size of the group(s) of employees, as well as the financial implications that follow from this.
Ik heb aan de GGD’en gevraagd of zij op korte termijn de omvang van de groep(en) werknemers in kaart kunnen brengen, evenals de financiële implicaties die hieruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Strolenberg over het bericht 'Tekort aan lijkschouwers dreigt: ‘Weinig geneeskundestudenten kiezen ervoor’'

MPs Van den Hil and Strolenberg asked about a reported shortage of forensic doctors who perform death inspections (lijkschouw), including timelines for a new capacity forecast, a recruitment campaign, IGJ roundtable and the appointment procedure. The minister answered each question with expected timelines (forecast end 2022, campaign start Q2 2022, Wlb bill end 2022) and described regional measures including temporary emergency solutions.
To this end, a round-table meeting will be organised in spring 2022.
Hiertoe wordt in het voorjaar van 2022 een rondetafelbijeenkomst georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de booster en de medische onderbouwing voor de combinatie van Janssen met een mRNA-vaccin

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health, in 37 numbered questions, to justify the medical basis for offering mRNA boosters after a Janssen primary vaccination, given the absence of EMA registration and the cited sources being preprints or UK statements. The Minister replies that the Health Council's advice rests on multiple sources pointing the same way, that boosters are offered by age-based preference, and that the questions are answered by reference to Health Council advice and public information channels.
Advice from the Council is based on an independent weighing of the scientific data, facts and expert views available at the time from the committee members.
Advisering van de raad is gebaseerd op een onafhankelijke weging van de op dat moment beschikbare wetenschappelijke gegevens, feiten en deskundige opvattingen van de commissieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Bikker, Ceder en Pouw-Verweij over het bericht 'Nederland grote abortussponsor'

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and JA21 asked whether the Netherlands funds over 250,000 abortion services per year in poorer countries, how many were actual abortions, and how oversight, reporting and SRGR budgets are handled. The minister says abortion services are not consistently defined or counted, so the figures cannot be verified, and that partners report under general indicators without a separate abortion-service requirement, though audits, evaluations and monitoring apply.
For these methodological reasons, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs decided to stop adding up and tracking the numbers of abortion services from 2017 onward.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft er om deze methodologische redenen voor gekozen om vanaf 2017 de aantallen abortusdiensten niet langer bij elkaar op te tellen en bij te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Agema over aerosole transmissie en het belang van ventilatie

Opposition MPs Kuzu and Agema asked the health minister about aerosol transmission of SARS-CoV-2, the role of ventilation, and why COVID policy did not focus more on it. The minister answered that transmission is mainly droplet-based at short range, that aerogenic transmission is addressed through ventilation advice and measures, and that existing ventilation rules and funding for schools remain the policy.
We have adjusted the government website for this specific passage, because it is not in line with current insights.
Wij hebben de website rijksoverheid.nl aangepast voor deze specifieke zinsnede, want dat is niet conform de huidige inzichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de coronamaatregelen voor rijscholen

An MP asked why driving lessons faced passenger and time restrictions during COVID-19 measures while taxis did not, and whether the 17:00 cutoff and two-person limit were mandatory and harmful. The minister answered that the restrictions were lifted (three persons allowed, lessons allowed after 17:00 since 18 December 2021), that the lesson car is a public place under the rules, and that the branch is kept informed.
The regulations have since changed following the decision of 18 December 2021, so driving schools can give lessons during their regular opening hours.
Inmiddels is de regelgeving veranderd door de besluitvorming op 18 december 2021, waardoor de rijscholen gedurende hun reguliere openingstijden les kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat VGZ en Menzis draconische bezuinigingen vragen aan het HMC

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views insurers VGZ and Menzis demanding large cuts from Haaglanden Medisch Centrum, and whether she will engage insurers over their demands on hospitals. The minister replied that contract negotiations are ongoing, that patients should not be unsettled by negotiations, and that the Hoofdlijnenakkoord growth cap for 2022 will be applied with flexibility for COVID-related care.
It is undesirable to conduct these negotiations at the expense of patients/insured persons, because I believe patients are thereby unnecessarily and prematurely worried.
Het is onwenselijk om deze onderhandelingen over de rug van patiënten/verzekerden te voeren omdat ik van mening ben dat patiënten hierdoor voorbarig en nodeloos ongerust worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de resultaten van de pilot vergoeding eigen risico zorgverzekering voor slachtoffers van seksueel geweld

An MP asked whether the government would scrap the health insurance deductible for sexual violence victims seeking help, after a pilot study found victims experience compensation as recognition and the seven-day cutoff is questioned. The minister answered that a policy response will follow in spring 2022 after consultation with stakeholders, explained the seven-day rationale (acute care and evidence collection), and pointed to a campaign and a new study on barriers to help-seeking.
A substantive policy response on the follow-up will be sent to the House of Representatives in spring 2022.
Een inhoudelijke beleidsreactie ten aanzien van het vervolg wordt in het voorjaar van 2022 naar de Tweede Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over een omstreden middel tegen corona

An MP asked the health minister about an unproven COVID-19 drug (ivermectin) prescribed by doctors and about how the IGJ inspectorate can sanction it, including criminal referral and BIG-register removal. The minister explained the IGJ's fines, disciplinary and criminal routes, and that disciplinary judges decide on removal from the register case by case.
This is for the judgement of the disciplinary judge.
Dit is ter beoordeling van de tuchtrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van den Berg over de boostercampagne voor mensen onder de 60 jaar met een kwetsbare gezondheid

MPs Bikker and Van den Berg asked the minister why the booster campaign for under-60s with vulnerable health moved from the planned 'seventh month after last vaccination' timing to an age-based order and was later accelerated, leaving some people without the promised schedule. The minister answered that rising vaccine effectiveness loss and the omicron variant led to an accelerated, simplified campaign in which everyone aged 18 and over could book a booster from 4 January, abandoning the earlier seventh-month rule.
To enable everyone to get a booster vaccination as quickly as possible, the implementation has been simplified.
Om zo snel mogelijk iedereen in staat te stellen een boostvaccinatie te halen is de uitvoering vereenvoudigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Maeijer over de Europese coronareispas

Opposition MPs Agema and Maeijer (PVV) asked the Minister of Health why the EU COVID digital certificate was limited to nine months after full vaccination, questioning the scientific basis, the consistency with earlier promises of free travel for fully vaccinated people, and the logic of requiring boosters while outbreaks occurred among triple-vaccinated staff. Minister Kuipers defended the nine-month validity as an EU-wide uniform rule based on waning protection against omicron, said boosters improve protection, and acknowledged that policy must sometimes be reconsidered as circumstances change.
The Netherlands agreed on 16 December 2021 to the maximum validity of the EU digital COVID certificate (DCC) of 9 months after full vaccination.
Nederland heeft op 16 december 2021 ingestemd met de maximale geldigheid van het digitale EU-covidcertificaat (DCC) van 9 maanden na volledige vaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Antibody-Dependent Enhancement

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) risks for COVID-19 vaccines, citing Pfizer's FDA submission and the Dengvaxia precedent, and questioned the adequacy of animal challenge studies and the advisory role of the Health Council and OMT. The Minister replied that ADE has not been observed in real-world data, that waning immunity does not show an ADE pattern, that challenge studies serve efficacy rather than duration, and that no additional animal studies are needed, while defending the advisory bodies.
As I indicated in the answer to question 4, the decline in immunity is a gradual process.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 4 heb aangegeven is de afname van immuniteit een geleidelijk proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eppink over het bericht van 1 december 2021 in het NRC dat ‘bij defensie duizenden boosterprikkers klaarstaan’

Two JA21 MPs asked the health minister, on behalf of defence, about reports that thousands of military staff were available to administer COVID booster shots, and about the pace of the booster campaign. The minister answered that the campaign had been accelerated, that 2,000 military personnel were made available for support tasks, and that the GGD and GP involvement was being arranged, but largely restated the campaign's objectives and did not give a full account of why the military capacity was not used sooner.
Unfortunately, that was not possible due to pressure of work.
Dat is helaas door drukte niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over oversterfte

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether there is an explanation for higher excess mortality in provinces with high vaccination rates (Limburg, Gelderland, Noord-Brabant) and lower excess mortality in provinces with low rates (Noord-Holland, Zuid-Holland, Friesland). The Minister answered that explaining excess mortality requires rigorous research and that speculation without evidence is unwise, pointing to factors such as age structure and health, and to the RIVM and CBS study announced following a motion by MP Omtzigt.
Explaining excess mortality requires rigorous scientific research.
Het verklaren van oversterfte vergt gedegen wetenschappelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de recente mediabriefing van de Wereld Gezondheidsorganisatie

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how the government responds to the WHO's December 2021 call for more monitoring, testing and sequencing, and what share of tests is sequenced. The minister answered that Dutch sequencing exceeds the ECDC norm, cited the RIVM monitoring network, and argued that self-tests make variant detection harder only in the sense that a positive result needs PCR confirmation.
The RIVM follows the ECDC norm for germ surveillance, comfortably meets it and can, if necessary, scale up.
Het RIVM volgt de ECDC-norm voor kiemsurveillance, haalt deze ruimschoots en kan, indien noodzakelijk, opschalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het artikel 'ASR-topman waarschuwt verzekeraars voor tweedeling in de maatschappij'

An MP asks the health minister about an ASR executive's warning that insurers risk a two-tier society, and whether health-based conditions and age-based premiums in supplementary cover should be banned and insurers' profits required to lower premiums. The minister replies that solidarity in basic cover is secured by the acceptance duty and premium ban, that medical selection in supplementary cover is rare (2.4%), and that no extra profit rules are needed since insurers do not distribute profits.
I do not recognise the picture that a two-tier divide is emerging in the health insurance market.
Ik herken het beeld dat er een tweedeling ontstaat op de zorgverzekeringsmarkt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekoek over de Kamerbrief 'Update Nederlandse vaccindonaties'

MP Koekkoek asked the ministers why the 22.55 million vaccine doses committed to COVAX differ from the 27 million donation target, and about delivery delays, infrastructure, mutation risks and licensing. The ministers answered that 26.78 million doses were donated in total, that 14.2 million had been delivered, and that the bilateral donation was delayed by the booster campaign, while declining to commit to compulsory licensing.
The Netherlands will fulfil this commitment as soon as this is possible.
Nederland zal deze toezegging nakomen zodra dit mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Wat 61 positieve PCR-testen op Schiphol ons kunnen leren’

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about 61 positive PCR tests among arriving passengers at Schiphol from South Africa, including the high share of vaccinated passengers, the testing rules, CT values and the GGD Kennemerland testing. The minister answered that the findings reflect reduced protection against Omicron, that the test rules were not a full 1G setting, that the testing and CT practices are not linked to the vaccine pass, and that research is ongoing.
These tests were not carried out for the purpose of the corona access certificate and therefore do not provide information about it.
Deze testen zijn niet gedaan ten behoeve van het coronatoegangsbewijs en geven hier dus ook geen informatie over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Hijink over financiële tekorten en gevolgen in de ouderenzorg

MPs Simons and Hijink asked the minister whether structural financial shortfalls in elderly care, such as job cuts at Hilverzorg, reflect low insurer payments, and whether corona-related costs will be compensated. The minister answered that rates have risen overall, that the 97-96% reimbursement level is in line with other insurers, that welfare activities remain part of care profiles, and that corona costs are covered by an NZa scheme, but declined to commit to renegotiation with insurers.
There is no decrease in reimbursements, but a reduction in the percentage of the maximum NZa tariffs that is reimbursed.
Er is geen sprake van een daling van de vergoedingen, maar van een verlaging van het percentage dat van de maximum NZa-tarieven wordt vergoed.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Kuiken, Agema, Tellegen, Bikker, Van der Laan en Werner over bescherming medische gegevens in de intensieve kindzorg

MPs asked whether insurers sharing medical data of chronically ill children with third parties for efficiency checks, without parental consent, complies with GDPR article 9, and whether a consent requirement is needed. The minister answered that insurers remain controllers responsible for processors, that the AVG applies, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that no consent requirement is planned.
It is not for me to assess a specific data processing operation. That is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van een specifieke gegevensverwerking. Dit is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over de mogelijke uitbreiding van het coronatoegangsbewijs (ctb), dat als bijlage was verstopt in een reactie van 21 december 2021 van de minister op de motie-Den H

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked why the government did not send the critical advice of the Begeleidingscommissie on expanding the corona access pass (ctb) to Parliament before deliberating on the related bills, and why it was attached as an annex to another letter. The minister answers that the advice concerns technical app matters outside the bills' scope, that it was addressed in the reply to the Den Haan motion, and that he sees no consequences, while largely restating existing policy.

It is not obvious that the Begeleidingscommissie should advise on the bills, because both the expansion of the ctb and the introduction of 2G are policy choices outside the scope of the commission's mandate.

Het ligt niet voor de hand dat de Begeleidingscommissie adviseert over de genoemde wetsvoorstellen, omdat zowel de uitbreiding van het ctb, alsook de invoering van 2G, beleidskeuzes zijn die buiten de reikwijdte van de opdracht van de Begeleidingscommissie liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vaccinatieschade, het voorzorgsbeginsel en informed consent

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about reported COVID-19 vaccine adverse events and deaths, the precautionary principle, antibody-dependent enhancement and informed consent. The minister rejected the claimed link between reported deaths and vaccination, said the precautionary principle was correctly applied by the EMA, and denied that informed consent had been breached, pointing to ongoing monitoring and information materials.
The figures you refer to concern the number of reports made. This is not the number of people who have died as a result of COVID-19 vaccination.
De cijfers waar u naar verwijst betreffen het aantal meldingen dat is gedaan. Dit is niet het aantal mensen dat door COVID-19 vaccinatie is komen te overlijden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Kuiken over de laatste stand van zaken in de aanpak tegen zorgverleners die corona ontkennen, bagatelliseren, nepnieuws verspreiden of bewust medicatie/behandelingen voorschrij

MPs Paulusma and Kuiken asked the health minister about the government's approach to healthcare professionals who deny or downplay COVID-19, spread misinformation, or prescribe ineffective treatments, including a call by a doctors' group against vaccinating pregnant women. The minister answered that the advice contradicts professional guidance, that IGJ has taken action against some doctors and imposed one fine, but declined to name other organisations and said tuchtrecht sanctions are for the disciplinary judge to decide.
I see no need to name these organisations explicitly.
Ik zie geen noodzaak deze organisaties expliciet bij naam te benoemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de plannen om de ambulancezorg in Limburg te fuseren en daarbij de ambulancezorg in Zuid-Limburg te privatiseren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the planned merger of ambulance services in Limburg, which would privatise the south of the province, is acceptable, and about public control and local oversight of ambulance care. The Minister answered that no formal merger request has been received yet, that public quality standards and supervision apply regardless of legal form, and that a decision will follow advice from IGJ, NZa, insurers and regions.
Once I receive the formal request from the RAVs, I will among other things seek advice from the IGJ, NZa, health insurers, safety regions and ROAZ.
Zodra ik de formele aanvraag van de RAV's ontvang, zal ik mij onder meer laten adviseren door de IGJ, NZa, zorgverzekeraars, veiligheidsregio's en ROAZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over zwemles

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked about long swimming lesson waiting lists caused by COVID-19 restrictions, the classification of swimming lessons, child safety, and the COVID pass requirement at swimming schools. The minister answered at length, estimating 69,000 to 92,000 children lost lesson time and stating the lessons are now possible again, but declined to give exact figures and did not commit to re-seeking OMT advice.
It is difficult to say how many children have not obtained a diploma as a result of the restrictions.
Het is moeilijk te zeggen hoeveel kinderen nu geen diploma gehaald hebben als gevolg van de beperkingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Intensive Care en tevens OMT-lid stelt dat de modellen van de modelleurs nu veel optimistischer zijn terwijl Neder

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of the NVIC chair and OMT member's claim that modeller projections were now much more optimistic, whether she was aware of the severe lockdown, and whether she would send the new models to parliament immediately. The minister confirmed awareness of the interview and of the measures, and explained the RIVM's two models and that the advice based on the 135th and 136th OMT meetings had already been sent to parliament.
I sent your House the advice based on this 135th OMT on 24 December.
Ik heb uw Kamer het advies dat gebaseerd is op dit 135e OMT op 24 december doen toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het verkrijgen van een coronatoegangsbewijs voor Nederlanders die niet de optie hebben zich te laten vaccineren

MPs Paternotte asked the minister how people who cannot be vaccinated for medical or trial-participation reasons can obtain a COVID access certificate, and whether serology could serve as proof. The minister answered that a medical exemption route is being developed, that testing remains an alternative, that serology is not yet accepted, and that trial participants can receive certificates after vaccination with an approved vaccine.
How people who cannot be vaccinated for medical reasons can become eligible for a QR code is currently being worked out.
Hoe mensen die zich om medische redenen niet kunnen laten vaccineren in aanmerking kunnen komen voor een QR-code wordt op dit moment uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de verwachte groei van de geitenhouderij in Noord-Brabant

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about expected growth of goat farming in North Brabant, its links to lung infections in nearby residents, and whether national measures are needed. The minister replied that the moratorium blocks new stables and expansions, that the cause of the health risk is still under study, and that provinces hold the power to impose goat stops while the government supports them.
The authority for this lies with the provinces.
De bevoegdheid hiervoor ligt bij de provincies.

Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Van den Berg, Inge van Dijk  en Van der Laan over het volgens het kabinet benodigde onderzoek om de sportsector toe te voegen aan de groep van essentiële sectoren

MPs asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the research needed before adding the sports sector to the essential sectors (per the Van den Berg motion) is finished, and what additional research is still required given existing studies on fitness and sport participation. The minister said the government considers sport a high priority, cites its own consideration of existing studies and OMT advice, and reports that a large part of sport was allowed again from 14 January 2022.
That is why the cabinet has stated that sport is a high priority, even though it does not fall under the definition of essential retail and/or services.
Daarom heeft het kabinet uitgesproken dat sport een hoge prioriteit heeft, ook al valt het niet onder de definitie van essentiële detailhandel en/of dienstverlening.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de berichten ‘Verbazing bij leden corona-commissie VWS: Kamer krijgt onze adviezen pas als debat al is gevoerd’ en ‘Hoe de Kamer keer op keer adviezen over corona-apps a

The SGP MP asked the Health Minister whether the Covid advisory committee's advice on digital tools was sent to parliament too late, and whether the minister restricted the committee to advice only when requested. The minister denied political motives for timing, confirmed the committee will now advise only on request, and said the mandate and membership are still under discussion.
Political considerations play no role in the timing of sending the advice.
Politieke overwegingen spelen geen rol bij het moment van verzenden van de adviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries en Kuiken over boostervaccinaties voor Nederlanders die met AstraZeneca of Janssen gevaccineerd zijn

MPs Paternotte, Aukje de Vries and Kuiken asked why booster vaccination for people vaccinated with AstraZeneca or Janssen was not prioritised, and whether the Health Council and EMA positions justify delay. The minister answered that the Health Council found no medical grounds for prioritising by vaccine type, that mRNA boosters are preferred, and that the booster campaign is being accelerated, while several questions about Europe-wide certificate validity were answered only in outline.
The RIVM does not have data on people belonging to a risk group and recipients of a 'waste-bin vaccine' and their vaccination status at the time of a positive test.
Het RIVM beschikt niet over data van personen die behoren tot een risicogroep en ontvangers van een «prullenbakvaccin» en de vaccinatiestatus op het moment van een positieve test.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zelfredzaamheid productie mondkapjes’

MPs Van den Berg and Palland asked the health minister how the government will keep domestic face-mask production viable, including whether a Sittard firm could be kept on standby and whether the LCH could keep buying masks. The minister said no subsidies were given, the state will not rescue firms at risk of bankruptcy, and a study and innovation competitions are underway, with a ready-stock plan to follow later this year.
It is not for the government to support these companies in case they threaten to go bankrupt.
Het is niet aan de overheid om deze bedrijven te ondersteunen in het geval ze failliet dreigen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Studenten hekelen ‘prikkel’ om maatregelen niet na te leven rond tentamens’

MPs Van der Woude and Aukje de Vries asked whether students who miss exams due to illness or quarantine lose a test opportunity under standard resit policy, and how the government will ensure they are not penalised for following COVID rules. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that institutions must offer tailored solutions in consultation with students, as set out in new service documents, but acknowledged that alternatives may not be immediate and that students must actively report missed exams.
It is up to the institution to offer tailored solutions when a test opportunity is missed.
Het is aan de instelling om bij het missen van een toetsmoment maatwerk te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de kwaliteitscontrole van Covid-19-vaccins

An FvD MP asked whether the Netherlands independently checks the quality and composition of purchased Covid-19 vaccines, and why fabricants with past court convictions are considered reliable, and requested test results or doses for independent analysis. The minister answered that each batch is independently tested by the national OMCL laboratory (RIVM) before release, that the US court cases concern fraud and marketing rather than vaccine quality, and that test results are commercially confidential and no doses will be provided.
Because of the commercially confidential nature of this information, test results and production details cannot be shared with a wider public.
Vanwege de commercieel vertrouwelijke aard van deze informatie zijn testuitslagen en productiedetails niet met een breder publiek te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat veel gepensioneerde verpleegkundigen bereid zijn te helpen in de boostercampagne, maar daarvoor eerst een BIG-opfriscursus van drie maanden moeten volgen

An SP MP asked the minister whether it is undesirable that retired nurses must first complete a three-month refresher course before helping with booster vaccinations, and whether a temporary licence could be granted. The minister answered that non-registered nurses may vaccinate under supervision of a registered professional if competent, that a short refresher suffices rather than three months, and that no licence is needed.
It is therefore possible to deploy non-BIG-registered nurses in the booster campaign, provided they are competent to vaccinate.
Het is dus mogelijk om niet-BIG-geregistreerde verpleegkundigen in te zetten in de boostercampagne, mits zij bekwaam zijn om te vaccineren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de voorraad vaccins en de inzet van boosters in 2022

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health why the Dutch vaccine stock is no longer shown on the corona dashboard, how many vaccines are in stock and whether they suffice for possible additional booster rounds and the Omicron variant, and whether Janssen could be used as booster. The Minister answered that the stock chart was archived because it is less relevant to the public, that stock is sufficient for the current booster campaign with preparations for further rounds and adapted vaccines expected at the earliest in late April 2022, and that the Janssen vaccin will be used only for individual health reasons.
That is why we have made agreements with BioNTech/Pfizer and Moderna on the need to adapt their vaccines, should protection prove insufficient.
Daarom hebben we afspraken gemaakt met BioNTech/Pfizer en Moderna over de noodzaak om hun vaccins aan te passen, mocht blijken dat de bescherming niet afdoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de verwijdering van Marion Koopmans van het WHO SAGO-team

An MP asked the health minister whether Professor Marion Koopmans was removed from the WHO SAGO team due to Chinese Communist Party ties and whether her independence on the OMT is compromised. The minister answered that the WHO made a different composition choice without integrity concerns, denied CCP funding, saw no conflict of interest, and declined to remove her from the OMT.
I do not decide on the composition of the OMT, and there are no such ties as you mention.
Ik ga niet over de samenstelling van het OMT en er is geen sprake van de door u genoemde banden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de modellering (en sterftekans) bij de omikronvariant van het coronavirus

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister whether the RIVM model underlying the lockdown accounted for omicron's milder severity, shorter hospital stays and lower hospitalisation risk, and what the current fatality risk of omicron is compared with delta and seasonal flu. The minister confirmed the model assumes higher transmissibility but not the milder severity, calling the assumptions highly uncertain, and said there is too little data yet for a sound judgement on omicron's fatality risk.
The data on the possibly milder nature, smaller chance of hospital admission and shorter length of hospital stay are not yet included in this modelling.
De gegevens over eventueel mildere aard, kleinere kans op ziekenhuisopname en kortere verblijfsduur in het ziekenhuis zijn in deze modellering nog niet meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over motie van het lid Pouw-Verweij c.s. inzake een snelle toelaatbaarheid van serologische testen (Kamerstuk 25295-1436)

An MP asked why the unanimously adopted motion on recognising serological tests for COVID certificates has not yet been implemented and when such tests might be allowed. The minister answered that the OMT advised against using serological tests as a basis for a coronavirus certificate, citing the inability to date infection, lack of internationally accepted protection thresholds and EU disagreement, and said the motion is being implemented with further analysis including the omicron variant.
In short, the motion is being implemented.
Kortom de motie is in uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het item dat de druk op de thuiszorg nog nooit zo groot is geweest en het bericht van Actiz met betrekking tot hun waarschuwing voor een coronatsunami

MP Den Haan asked the health minister about reports that home-care pressure is at a record high, Actiz's warning of a 'corona tsunami', and rising infections among home-dwelling elderly. The minister acknowledged the pressure, described measures such as ROAZ coordination, the Nationale Zorgreserve and bed scale-up, and said the questions could not be answered before the next plenary debate.
Question 14: Are you willing to answer these questions before the next plenary debate on the developments surrounding the coronavirus? Answer 14: Unfortunately this has not been possible.
Vraag 14 Bent u bereid deze vragen voor het volgende plenaire Kamerdebat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus te beantwoorden? Antwoord 14 Dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het artikel 'Regering en OMT onderbouwen QR-code met onbetrouwbare modellen'

An MP asks the Minister of Health about press reports that the government and OMT based the COVID vaccination-pass (CTB) on weak models, and whether the CTB and its extension to 2G and wider use are scientifically validated. The Minister rejects the claim that the models are unreliable, says the CTB is supported by several models and field research, and promises further TU Delft research before the bills are debated.
I aim to share that research with your House in January 2022, before the bills on the wider use of the corona access certificate and 2G are debated.
Ik streef ernaar dat onderzoek op januari 2022 met uw Kamer te delen, voor de behandeling van de wetsvoorstellen over de bredere inzet van het coronatoegangsbewijs en 2G.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de VASCO-studie

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health about the VASCO vaccine effectiveness study, questioning its independence from the OMT and RIVM, the exclusion of care home residents, and the scope of side-effect monitoring. The Minister defends RIVM's independence, states the protocol was approved by the METC, and explains that the study focuses on effectiveness with side effects handled by other studies.
The Outbreak Management Team (OMT) is not part of the RIVM, but an independent advisory body.
Het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) is géén onderdeel van het RIVM, maar een onafhankelijk adviesorgaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij en Gündugan over opschalingsplannen voor de IC en de tekorten aan Coronamedicijnen, terwijl een week geleden gemeld werd dat er een voorraad van drie maanden was

MPs Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij and Gündugan asked the health minister about ICU expansion plans (LNAZ, the 350-bed figure, outsourcing and concentration of ICU care) and about shortages of COVID medicines despite a reported three-month stockpile. The minister answered by describing the timing of the LNAZ reports, the scenarios in the Aanpak Najaar, the Corona Crisis Voorraad composition, and declined to answer question 9 about splitting the answers for the supplementary budgets.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over het vernietigende advies van de Raad voor de rechtspraak over de wetsvoorstellen 2G en 3G op de werkvloer, dat vlak voor kerst, met vijf weken vertraging, aan

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked why the Council for the Judiciary's critical advice on the 2G/3G workplace bills was sent to parliament late, why its criticisms (necessity, proportionality, dismissal risk, privacy) were not summarised in the explanatory memorandum, and why ministers may not have seen it. The minister answers that the advice was omitted by error and sent later, that the bills were substantially amended in response, and that the government considered the advice fully.
The advice was mistakenly not sent to the House of Representatives together with the other advice issued on the two bills.
Het advies is abusievelijk niet tezamen met de andere over de twee genoemde wetsvoorstellen uitgebrachte adviezen naar de Tweede Kamer gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de aankoop van 11,6 miljoen mondkapjes bij DSM als compensatie voor het niet afgeven van een garantie aan DSM

An MP asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers why 11.6 million FFP2 masks were ordered from the DSM-VDL joint venture without competitive tendering, and whether this was justified by urgency, given large existing stocks and a withdrawn DSM guarantee. The government answered that urgency from expected demand justified direct award, denied that a commercial disagreement was the reason, declined to disclose the price as commercially confidential, and said there is currently no formal state involvement in domestic mask production.
A price was paid to Dutch PPE Solutions that was market-conform at the time. The amount is commercially confidential information.
Er is een prijs betaald aan Dutch PPE Solutions die destijds marktconform was. De hoogte daarvan is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de brief Overwegingen 1G

An MP asks the Health Minister about the modelling behind the 1G, 2G and 3G coronavirus access-pass options, questioning the assumed vaccine effectiveness and whether the figures are up to date. The minister answers that effectiveness figures are based on the latest studies, that the TU Delft modelling will be shared early 2022, and that the data will be updated regularly, without agreeing to a fixed two-week limit.
I aim to share that research with your House early 2022, before the parliamentary debate on the bills on the broader use of the coronavirus access pass and 2G.
Ik streef ernaar dat onderzoek begin 2022 met uw Kamer te delen, voor de behandeling van de wetsvoorstellen over de bredere inzet van het coronatoegangsbewijs en 2G.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over grootschalige fraude in het onderzoek naar het Pfizer-vaccin

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister about alleged data fraud, unblinding and inadequate adverse-event follow-up in a Pfizer vaccine trial site, and whether the vaccine rollout should be suspended. The minister answered that EMA and FDA reviewed the site, found shortcomings that did not compromise data integrity or the benefit-risk balance, and saw no reason to suspend use.

The European Medicines Agency (EMA), following this article, together with the FDA (the US regulator), examined the reported course of events and concluded that the shortcomings at this research centre do not endanger the quality and integrity of the research data from this location.

Het Europees Medicijnagentschap (hierna: EMA) heeft naar aanleiding van dit artikel samen met de FDA (de toezichthouder in de Verenigde Staten) naar de gerapporteerde gang van zaken gekeken en heeft geconcludeerd dat de tekortkomingen in dit onderzoekscentrum de kwaliteit en integriteit van de onderzoeksgegevens uit deze locatie niet in gevaar brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de dure betalingsregeling van Infomedics de tandarts onbetaalbaar maakt

MP Hijink (SP) asked the minister whether it is acceptable that Infomedics charges extra servicekosten for payment plans, which can make dental care unaffordable for financially vulnerable patients, and whether Infomedics' profits and the fees are legally sound. The minister answered that private debt-collection services are a free choice, that the fees are within legal limits, that he has no insight into Infomedics' accounts, and that talks with the parties on solutions are ongoing, without ruling out the practice.
I do not have insight into Infomedics' complete accounts.
Ik heb namelijk geen inzage in de volledige boekhouding van Infomedics.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Agema over de Kamervragen die op 29 november jl. werden beantwoord

The PVV MP Agema asked the health minister about vaccine effectiveness against hospital admission for people aged 80 and over, and the share of vaccinated patients admitted in November 2021. The minister answered with RIVM figures for those aged 70 and over, showing a slight decline in effectiveness from 86% to 84%, and noted that the RIVM reports over at least 8-week periods.
The RIVM cannot determine how strong this decline exactly is, due to uncertainties and the confidence intervals used.
Het RIVM kan niet bepalen hoe sterk deze afname exact is, vanwege onzekerheden en de betrouwbaarheidsintervallen die gebruikt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat het Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix in Winterswijk en zorgverzekeraar Menzis het niet eens kunnen worden over het contract van 2022

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the failed 2022 contract talks between Winterswijk hospital SKB and insurer Menzis, and whether Covid costs and the hospital growth cap hinder negotiations. The minister said parties must keep within the macro framework while Covid-related spending, including catch-up care, is not capped, and that the NZa is checking communication transparency.

The main-lines agreement on medical-specialist care contains numerous actions across many areas: quality, cooperation, the labour market, digitalisation, the right care in the right place, and appropriate care.
Het hoofdlijnenakkoord medisch-specialistische zorg bevat tal van acties op veel terreinen: kwaliteit, samenwerking, arbeidsmarkt, digitalisering, Juiste Zorg op de Juiste Plek en gepaste zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Weigermigranten buiten corona uit: 'Dit blijft een grote frustratie'' en 'GGD’s mogen binnenkort vaccinatiebewijzen afgeven aan mensen zonder BS

MPs Valstar and Aukje de Vries asked about asylum seekers refusing COVID tests, vaccination coverage in reception centres, and GGD-issued vaccination certificates for undocumented people. The government answered that all arrivals are tested but refusal has no sanction, that roughly half of centre residents are recorded as vaccinated, and that deportations were cancelled for test refusals, with the government exploring legal options for compulsory testing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis roept patiënten op zich niet meer te verzekeren bij Menzis en VGZ'

An MP asks the Health Minister about a hospital (HMC) urging patients not to insure with Menzis or VGZ amid contract disputes, and about the risk of unpaid care in 2022. The minister replies that negotiations are ongoing, insurers have a duty of care, most insurers will reimburse care without a contract, and that such pressure on patients is undesirable.
It is undesirable to conduct these negotiations at the expense of patients/insured persons, because I believe patients are unnecessarily and prematurely worried by this.
Het is onwenselijk om deze onderhandelingen over de rug van patiënten/verzekerden te voeren omdat ik van mening ben dat patiënten hierdoor voorbarig en nodeloos ongerust worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de beschikbaarheid van locaties testen voor toegang op de Waddeneilanden en dunbevolkte gebieden

An MP asked the Health Minister whether COVID test-for-access locations on the Wadden islands and sparsely populated areas remain reliably available, and what the government will do about closures and the cost model. The minister acknowledged the problem, said 99.9% of the Netherlands can reach a test site within 30 minutes, and pointed to a structural solution for the Wadden islands via Stichting Open Nederland without giving specifics.
At this moment, again 99.9% of the Netherlands can get tested at Testen voor Toegang within 30 minutes, including all people on the Wadden islands.
Op dit moment kan opnieuw 99,9% van Nederland zich binnen 30 minuten bij Testen voor Toegang laten testen, waaronder alle mensen op de Waddeneilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Agema over de Franse aanbevelingen ter bescherming van mensen die niet of onvoldoende op coronavaccinatie reageren

Agema (PVV) asked the minister about French recommendations for people who respond poorly to COVID vaccination, including the antibody therapy Evusheld, and whether the Netherlands should pre-order it. The minister answered that the medical profession decides on use, data are insufficient, no pre-order is placed yet, and that the number of non-responders is unclear.
I remain in discussion with the professional group and the manufacturer.
Ik blijf met de beroepsgroep en fabrikant in gesprek.
Antwoord op de vragen van  het lid Paternotte over het verschil in regelgeving tussen een evenement op een terras of op een andere locatie

An MP from D66 asked the Health Minister why a small outdoor event with ticketed access and loud music was permitted under one COVID rule set on a terrace but not under another at other locations, and whether this was intended. The minister answered that the difference followed from the terrace-versus-event distinction rather than location, explained the applicable conditions, and largely deferred on municipal permitting, with the answer delayed and no separate consultation held.
