At the time of the reported news, these measures were not linked to the difference in location, but followed from the distinction between a terrace and an event.
Ten tijde van het aangehaalde bericht hingen deze maatregelen niet samen met het verschil in de locatie, maar volgden deze uit het onderscheid tussen een terras en een evenement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over mondkapjes

An MP asks the Minister of Health why a mask mandate in public transport and indoor spaces remains in force despite studies questioning mask effectiveness, and asks RIVM to review and respond to numerous cited studies. The Minister replies that the mandate follows OMT, WHO and ECDC advice, that OMT (not RIVM) advises on masks, and declines to ask RIVM for new research or a study list, while noting OMT advice and documents are already public.
I see no added value in additionally asking the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) to conduct research into the usefulness of face masks.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde om het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) daarnaast te vragen onderzoek te doen naar het nut van mondkapjes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de entertainment- en evenementenbranche

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Health about the impact of COVID-19 closures on the entertainment and events sector, the lack of outdoor event permissions, the Fieldlab research programme and the absence of structural consultation. The minister answered that support measures, Fieldlab research and sector consultation are in place, but gave generic answers and declined to commit to reopening events or a dedicated compensation scheme.
The cabinet holds talks with all sectors so that the support measures align as well as possible with the affected sectors.
Het kabinet voert gesprekken met alle sectoren, zodat de steunmaatregelen zo goed mogelijk aansluiten op de getroffen sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over het afnemen van het aantal restitutiepolissen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister about the decline in restitution health insurance policies, premiums, conversions to combination policies, uninsured numbers, coverage details, and whether insurers can cut reimbursement or change conditions for mental and physical care providers. The minister answered with figures on policy counts and premiums, said insurers set their own policies and must inform insureds of changes, and stated that selective contracting by insurers is important for steering to appropriate care.
In the spring I can inform your House about the definitive figures for 2022.
In het voorjaar kan ik uw Kamer informeren over de definitieve cijfers voor 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over code zwart

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Health whether statements by ICU leaders and the LCPS chair that ICU capacity is effectively exhausted and that triage on non-medical grounds (code black) is already occurring are accurate, and whether the ICUs are in phase 3a. The Minister answers that the ICU capacity remains available, that phase 3 has not been declared since the criteria are not yet met, that the system is in phase 2d, and that the existing phase-3 policy framework is reiterated to care providers.
Therefore there cannot yet be a declaration of phase 3, because a phase 3 declaration only occurs once all care capacity is fully used.
Daarmee geldt dat er nog geen sprake kan zijn van (afkondiging van) fase 3, want van (afkondiging van) fase 3 is pas sprake als alle zorgcapaciteit volledig is benut
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ellemeet over polio in Bilthoven

MP Ellemeet asked the Health Minister how often poliovirus has been found in Bilthoven over ten years, whether other municipalities were affected, and what measures, and roles for water boards, municipalities and the IGJ, exist to prevent such incidents. The minister reported six detections in Bilthoven since 2020, outlined surveillance, a planned Gezondheidswet and Wpg amendment with a WHO-certification route, and explained that water boards need no extra powers while municipal powers and voluntary IGJ inventories are described.
I therefore see no added value in extra powers for the water boards.
Ik zie dan ook geen toegevoegde waarde van extra bevoegdheden voor de waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Paulusma over het bericht 'Dure betalingsregeling van Infomedics maakt de tandarts onbetaalbaar'

MPs Kat and Paulusma asked whether dental-clinic payment arrangements run by billing firm Infomedics, which charge patients service fees, are acceptable, and whether such fees should be banned. The minister said such fees should be avoided, that a ban is not under consideration, and that the sector and Infomedics will be consulted on practical solutions.
The cabinet has set itself the goal of preventing collection costs as much as possible and acting quickly on early payment arrears.
Het kabinet heeft wel als doel gesteld om incassokosten zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen en snel te acteren bij beginnende betalingsachterstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over de maatschappelijke behoefte van verkoop van cannabisolie als medicijn

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the health minister about a court ruling that did not sentence a cannabis oil seller despite illegal sales, about patient need for medicinal cannabis oil, and about the barriers to researching its quality. The state secretary answered that patient need is not yet fully mapped, that a research study is planned for early 2022, that BMC rejected Suver Nuver's research exemption in 2019, and that policy changes will be considered after the BMC evaluation.
Together with the Bureau for Medicinal Cannabis and the Trimbos Institute, a study is currently being prepared to gain more insight into this.
Samen met het Bureau voor Medicinale Cannabis en het Trimbos Instituut wordt daarom momenteel gewerkt aan een onderzoek om hier meer inzicht in te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Onverzekerdenkwestie lijkt veel op toeslagenaffaire’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that the uninsured-care scheme resembles the childcare benefits scandal, including bureaucratic burdens for providers, numbers of people whose insurance was cancelled after leaving the BRP, and compensation for uninsured people. The State Secretary defends the existing schemes as working well, denies the administrative burden is excessive, states the number of cancelled insurance cases is unknown, and rejects compensation because care was provided.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Meenen en Boulakjar over coronamaatregelen in het funderend onderwijs

Three D66 MPs asked the education minister why the government departs from OMT advice on school COVID measures, including testing, the Christmas holiday timing, masks, CO2 meters and air purifiers. The minister confirmed the departures, explained the reasons and pointed to ventilation funding and existing measures, without committing to new national devices.
Naturally the epidemiological situation is monitored and the Cabinet takes the decisions that are necessary.
Vanzelfsprekend is de epidemiologische situatie gemonitord en neemt het Kabinet besluiten die nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘De Jonge: Nederlander op tijd geboosterd voor reisbewijs’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Health about whether all Dutch citizens would receive boosters in time to keep their EU travel certificates valid, covering slot availability, staffing, travel rules and the scope of the COVID pass. The minister's answer is a referral: the questions were answered in a separate letter, the 'Stand van zaken covid-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1638), so no substance is given in this document.

The written questions from MP Aukje de Vries to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the report 'De Jonge: Dutch citizens boosted in time for travel pass' (2021Z22995) have been answered by letter 'Stand van zaken covid-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 1638).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «De Jonge: Nederlander op tijd geboosterd voor reisbewijs» ( 2021Z22995 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken covid-19» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1638 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de brief waarin de Minister schrijft dat het klassieke Valneva-vaccin geen onderdeel uitmaakt van de vaccinportefeuille en de aangenomen motie Bikker c.s

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about the classic Valneva protein vaccine, which the minister said was not part of the vaccine portfolio and was only reserved pro forma, and about a motion urging faster availability of protein vaccines. The minister answered that such vaccines await EMA approval, no steps can be skipped, and no faster route exists, while promising to ask the Health Council for advice once approved.
No steps may be skipped and will not be skipped. I currently see no possibilities to speed up this process.
Er mogen en worden geen stappen overgeslagen. Ik zie op dit moment geen mogelijkheden om dit proces te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van de begroting Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2022

An MP asks the Minister of Health why the answer to an earlier written question did not contain the calculation behind the claim that a 'code black' (ICU capacity shortage) remained possible, and requests the underlying sums with sources. The Minister says the figures come from RIVM occupancy projections, describes the method and points to the technical briefing slides, but does not provide a full written calculation.
Can you have the calculation written out in full and provided with source references?
Kunt u de som helemaal uit laten schrijven en voorzien van bronvermeldingen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht dat de toename van coronabesmettingen in Goes veroorzaakt is door een uitbraak in de noodopvang

MPs Podt and Paternotte asked the Health Minister, on behalf of the Justice State Secretary, about reports that a rise in COVID-19 cases in Goes was caused by an outbreak in an emergency asylum reception centre, and about vaccination, quarantine, distancing and information in asylum locations. The minister answered each question in general terms, stating that current measures and protocols are in place, vaccination is offered and quarantine capacity is sufficient, and admitted that answering each question separately before the plenary debate was not achieved due to workload.
Unfortunately, that has not been achieved due to busy schedules.
Dat is vanwege drukte helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Valneva

MP Van Haga asked the health minister whether the government would study offering inactivated or subunit COVID-19 vaccines to people unwilling to take mRNA or vector vaccines, and why it declined the Valneva contract announced on 3 November 2021. The minister answered that the portfolio was chosen for supply and diversity, bought 840,000 Novavax doses and 10,000 Valneva doses, and would review the RIVM research on alternatives and buy more if demand warrants.
I will also in future factor the interpretation of available research results into my further considerations.
Als aangegeven zal ik ook in de toekomst de duiding van beschikbare onderzoeksresultaten betrekken bij mijn nadere afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over serologische tests

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about serological (antibody) tests, the EU's position on them, whether vaccination willingness played a role in excluding them, and whether natural immunity offers better long-term protection. The Minister answered that the government has not yet concluded serology can play a role in the coronavirus access pass, citing the lack of a known protective antibody level, the inability to date infection, and test variability, and denied that vaccination willingness influenced the decision.
Whether or not serological tests are used for access is not influenced by a possible effect on vaccination willingness.
Het wel of niet inzetten van serologische testen voor toegang wordt niet beïnvloed door een mogelijke invloed op de vaccinatiebereidheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een onlangs verschenen pro-vaccin campagnefilmpje van de Minister van VWS

An FvD MP asked the Minister of VWS about a pro-vaccination campaign video aimed at young people, questioning its cost, the absence of information on long-term risks and natural immunity, and why YouTube comments were disabled. The minister answered that production cost about 159,000 euros and media about 205,000 euros, that the videos give evidence-based information with more detail on a dedicated website, that pretests were positive, and that YouTube serves mainly as a landing page with commenting available on other platforms.
Our YouTube channel is mainly used by us as a landing page.
Ons YouTube-kanaal wordt door ons vooral gebruikt als landingspagina.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over corona

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about how many people use the corona access certificate, ten years of ICU admission figures, and how many cabinet members are vaccinated. The minister said exact CTB usage is not tracked for privacy reasons but gave download and QR-code figures, provided ICU admissions for 2013–2020 from Stichting NICE, and declined to share cabinet members' medical data.
I cannot share the medical data of cabinet members.
Medische gegevens van kabinetsleden kan ik niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Ellemeet en Ploumen over het artikel "De Deense zaad-invasie: hoe Deense klinieken profiteren van een ongereguleerde markt"

MPs Jetten, Ellemeet and Ploumen asked the health minister about a Follow the Money article on Danish sperm clinics exploiting an unregulated market, including the donor-limit rules, cross-border donor supply, monitoring, and the Wdkb amendment. The minister answered that the Wdkb amendment is pending (expected March 2022), that a 12-family cap per donor applies under the national standard, that monitoring is by individual clinics with no central oversight yet, and that internet/private donation is not regulated.
There is currently no central monitoring in the Netherlands of the maximum number of children per donor.
Er is op dit moment geen centrale monitoring in Nederland van het maximumaantal kinderen per donor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de uitzending van Undercover in Nederland over de misstanden bij zorginstelling Zuster Norma

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how the government would respond to abuses at care home Zuster Norma shown on Undercover in Nederland, including neglect of dementia patients and unqualified staff performing medical tasks, and how the IGJ missed these after earlier clearing the home. The minister said the IGJ has conducted follow-up on-site research and will publish its report, while declining to comment on the ongoing inquiry, deferring finances to the provider's annual report, and affirming that reserved medical tasks may only be performed by qualified staff.
The IGJ will publish the research report on its website once it has been finalised.
IGJ zal het onderzoeksrapport op haar website publiceren, zodra dit is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een slogan (‘wijk voor wijk, deur voor deur, arm voor arm’) die de minister gebruikte tijdens de (afgelopen) persconferentie

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health why his slogan 'wijk voor wijk, deur voor deur, arm voor arm' resembles phrasing used abroad in COVID vaccination campaigns, and requested all documents about the slogan's origin. The minister answered that any similarities are coincidental and that no documents exist beyond draft press-conference texts.
Apart from drafts of the text spoken during this press conference, there are no documents referring to the statement you refer to.
Anders dan concepten voor de uitgesproken tekst tijdens deze persconferentie zijn er geen documenten refererend aan de uitspraak waar u op doelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Nederland gedraaid over geldigheid coronapas EU’

An MP asked the Health Minister whether the Netherlands had reversed its position on the EU COVID certificate validity period (proposed at nine months) and why the Chamber had not been consulted before the EU Health Council. The minister confirmed the cabinet supports the nine-month proposal for EU coordination, explained the position was set out in an appreciation sent to the Chamber on 3 December, and said the Chamber could discuss it with the cabinet if it wished.

The cabinet considers the proposed nine months (six months for the booster interval plus three months for member states to organise implementation) sufficiently substantiated and an safe and effective way to promote EU coordination of rules and keep travel in Europe possible, and therefore supports this proposal.

Het kabinet denkt dat de voorgestelde 9 maanden (zes maanden t.b.v. de interval plus drie maanden voor lidstaten om de uitvoering te organiseren) voldoende onderbouwd is en een veilige en doeltreffende manier is om EU-coördinatie van regels te bevorderen en reizen in Europa mogelijk te maken en houden, en steunt daarom dit voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de geldigheidsduur van een vaccinatiecertificaat voor reizen

An MP from JA21 asks the Health Minister why the Netherlands supports a nine-month validity for EU travel vaccination certificates instead of twelve months, and why it moved in Brussels before negotiations began. The minister answers that nine months (six-month booster interval plus three months for implementation) is well-founded and supports EU coordination, while stating that serology is not yet ready as a basis for recovery certificates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het programma Undercover in Nederland

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the IGJ had previously supervised care provider Zuster Norma for risky care, whether the same problems recur as shown in a Undercover in Nederland broadcast, and what the IGJ has done since. The Minister confirms the earlier supervision and lifting of the admission stop, says follow-up supervision took place in September 2021 and is ongoing, and states the IGJ applied hear-and-counter-hear and inspected both locations, with a report to be published once finalised.
In September 2021 follow-up supervision took place. This is an ongoing process, in which the images from the broadcast are being taken into account.
In september 2021 heeft vervolgtoezicht plaatsgevonden. Dit is een nog lopend traject, waarbij de beelden uit de uitzending worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verlenging van de geldigheid van het coronaherstelbewijs

An MP asked the Minister of Health when the extension of the COVID recovery certificate's validity from 180 to 365 days after a positive test would appear in the CoronaCheck app. The minister answered that the extension took effect on 30 November, users with an app recovery certificate will be notified they can renew it, while paper certificates keep the 180-day validity.
This amendment entered into force on 30 November.
Deze wijziging is op 30 november jl. in werking getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de oproep van de FNV om Black Friday dit jaar over te slaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs and the Minister for Health whether Black Friday should be cancelled given FNV's call and last year's crowding and infection risks for retail staff. The government answered that employers remain responsible for safe workplaces, that retailers spread Black Friday over longer periods, that burgemeesters retain intervention powers, and that this year's Black Friday proceeded safely without needing intervention.
Intervention by the mayors has therefore not proven necessary.
Ingrijpen door de burgemeesters is daardoor niet nodig gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Testafspraak maken (bijna) onmogelijk bij GGD: 'De rek is eruit''

MP Aukje de Vries asked the health minister about reports that booking COVID tests at the GGD had become nearly impossible, and what capacity, personnel and advice measures exist. The minister answered that capacity was scaled up sharply, explained booking bottlenecks, and described plans and the new testing advice, though further capacity depends on recruiting staff.
When I have received the new roadmap, I will share it with your House.
Wanneer ik de nieuwe roadmap heb ontvangen, zal ik deze met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de nieuw in te kopen vaccins volgend jaar

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health why fewer Novavax doses were ordered than the Sanofi and Valneva vaccines were not ordered at all, why new vaccines are bought for 2022, and whether this signals the pandemic is not over. The minister explained a portfolio approach based on mRNA, vector and protein vaccines, citing ample supplies and booster needs, and called the purchases a precautionary measure.
I view the purchase of these vaccines as a precautionary measure that helps us face this pandemic for as long as necessary.
De aankoop van deze vaccins zie ik als een voorzorgsmaatregel die ons helpt deze pandemie zo lang als nodig is het hoofd te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van den Berg over de blijvende problemen van het ophalen van de QR-code voor het coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs Paternotte and Van den Berg asked the health minister about persistent problems obtaining QR codes for the coronavirus access certificate, including helpdesk volumes, unresolved cases, staffing, and access for people vaccinated abroad. The minister answered that about 7% of helpdesk calls concerned QR-code problems, most are resolved, capacity is sufficient, and expansion of foreign-vaccination services is under discussion without firm commitments on new locations.
Precise numbers and percentages of the types of problems occurring are not recorded.
Precieze aantallen en percentages van de soorten voorkomende problemen worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Bikker, Kuzu, Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over eiwit-vaccins

MPs asked the health minister about people who want a protein-based COVID-19 vaccine, the cancellation or reduction of Sanofi and Novavax orders, and vaccine efficacy data. The minister said the government has no data on the size of this group, chose Novavax over Sanofi and bought fewer Novavax doses because mRNA vaccines were already sufficient, and gave efficacy figures while noting approval and procurement decisions rest with EMA and the Gezondheidsraad.
I therefore see no need to investigate this in further detail, but will ask the RIVM to keep paying attention to this in its monitoring.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om dit in verder detail uit te zoeken, maar zal het RIVM vragen ook hier in de monitoring aandacht voor te blijven houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kuiken en Aukje de Vries over de uitvoering van de boostervaccinatiecampagne

MPs Paternotte, Kuiken and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister about booster vaccination rollout: uptake numbers, speeding up the campaign, whether relatives can book appointments for elderly people, consent procedures for residents in care homes, eligibility of partners, and vaccinating the wider population. The minister answered that booster figures were provided, that relatives may book only with the person's own consent by phone, that consent practices are workable in care homes, and that the campaign follows age-based priorities per Health Council advice, with a December offensive being prepared.
I will receive the plan for this offensive at the end of this week.
Het plan voor dit offensief ontvang ik aan het eind van deze week.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over vaccindonaties aan de WHO voor lage-inkomenslanden

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Health and Development ministers why the Netherlands had not made firm vaccine donation commitments to COVAX, how it compared with other rich countries, its stockpile and fair share, and what it would do about low vaccination rates in low-income countries. The government answered that firm donation mandates of 22 million doses were already in place, that it would meet 'Get one – Give one', and that it would keep pursuing supply, local production and TRIPS-waiver negotiations, while declining to swap its place in the queue.
Netherlands has thus done what it promised for this year and will continue to make efforts in this regard.
Nederland heeft daarmee gedaan wat het voor dit jaar heeft beloofd en zal zich hiervoor blijven inspannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de handhaving van het coronatoegangsbewijs en zwemles

An MP asked why swimming lessons require a coronavirus pass (CTB), leading to waiting lists, and how sports participation and disabled athletes are protected, and how clubs will enforce the CTB. The state secretary answered that the CTB applies to public indoor sports venues, that children whose parents cannot show a CTB may miss lessons but the effect on waiting lists is expected to be limited, and that clubs can get enforcement support via municipalities.
For the public indoor area of a sports facility (including the changing rooms) a CTB requirement applies to the public from age 18.
Voor de publieke binnenruimte van een locatie voor de beoefening van sport (waaronder ook de kleedkamers) geldt vanaf 18 jaar een CTB-plicht voor het publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zelfstandige klinieken graag meer patiënten zouden behandelen die op inhaalzorg wachten, maar daarvoor niet de ruimte krijgen

An SP MP asks whether independent clinics could treat up to 100,000 more patients waiting for postponed care, and why their capacity is not used, possibly because insurers would pay twice. The minister says insurers and providers must cooperate under the agreed framework, that the NZa is supervising and surveying insurers on how they contract independent clinics, and that the 100,000 estimate cannot be assessed.
The NZa is also conducting, in response to these signals, a survey of health insurers on how care at independent clinics is contracted.
De NZa doet daarnaast naar aanleiding van deze signalen een uitvraag bij de zorgverzekeraars over de manier waarop zorg bij de zelfstandige klinieken wordt ingekocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van de begroting Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2022

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Health about earlier answers on the 2022 budget, including whether ICU expansion to 1,700 beds needs extra nurses, vaccination rates and a claimed ICU maximum of 680 COVID patients, and why elective surgery must still be postponed. The Minister confirms the earlier answers, explains that ICU expansion to 1,150-1,350 beds requires scaling back planned care because of staff shortages, and points to the existing temporary policy framework and the LNAZ contingency plan.
To enable scaling up ICU bed capacity and the associated scaling up in the clinic, regular care, including planned operations, must be scaled down.
Om opschaling van de beddencapaciteit op de IC en de bijbehorende opschaling in de kliniek mogelijk te maken moet reguliere zorg, waaronder geplande operaties, worden afgeschaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Aukje de Vries, Van den Berg, Kuiken en Bikker over de afschaling van reguliere zorg en de extra wachttijdproblematiek

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the renewed scaling-down of regular hospital care, uneven burden across hospitals, underuse of independent clinics, digital care, cross-border treatment, and publication of waiting-time data. The minister answered that national allocation agreements apply, that NZa and IGJ monitor compliance, that planned care in all hospitals has been halted under phase 2d, and that waiting-time information is being updated more often, while declining to commit to specific structural changes beyond existing frameworks.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) monitor that the agreements are being complied with.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) zien er op toe dat de afspraken worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over het EMA-rapport inzake onder andere de beoordeling en voorlopige goedkeuring van het Pfizer-vaccin

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health about an EMA assessment report on the conditional marketing authorisation of the Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine, questioning its legal basis, safety and efficacy evidence, quality control location, and the continued grounding of the vaccine and of COVID-19 A-status in Dutch public-health law. The Minister rejects most premises, states the vaccine meets EU legal requirements, reports on the status of specific obligations and safety follow-up, and says EU rules since 2001 govern the authorisation and controls are now carried out within the EU.
Yes, I am aware of the assessment report you refer to.
Ik ben bekend met het beoordelingsrapport waar u naar verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over het artikel ‘Zuid-Afrika slaat alarm: nieuwe virusvariant grijpt om zich heen’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers whether they knew of the new Omicron variant spreading in South Africa, whether incoming flights from there face adequate entry rules, and whether quarantine or double PCR testing could be imposed as a precaution. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament on the Omicron measures, without addressing the questions in the reply itself.

The written questions from MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh to the ministers of Health and of Infrastructure and Water Management about the article 'South Africa sounds the alarm: new virus variant spreading' (2021Z21731) are answered by letter <Status of the measures on the omicron variant of the coronavirus>.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat over het artikel «Zuid-Afrika slaat alarm: nieuwe virusvariant grijpt om zich heen» ( 2021Z21731 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken over de maatregelen omikronvariant van het coronavirus>
Antwoord op vragen van leden Paternotte en Hagen over de snelle opmars van een nieuwe virusvariant in Zuid-Afrika

Two D66 MPs asked the health and transport ministers about a new COVID variant spreading fast in South Africa, including monitoring, travel testing, vaccine donations and border checks. The minister answered by referring the parliament to a separate letter on the omicron measures, without answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MPs Paternotte and Hagen to the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the rapid rise of a new virus variant in South Africa (2021Z21733) have been answered by way of a letter.

De schriftelijke vragen van leden Paternotte en Hagen aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de snelle opmars van een nieuwe virusvariant in Zuid-Afrika ( 2021Z21733 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het tweetbericht dat de kans dat een volledig gevaccineerd persoon door corona in het ziekenhuis moet worden opgenomen twintig keer kleiner is dan iemand die niet volledig gevacc

An MP asked the Health Minister about his tweet claiming vaccinated people are twenty times less likely to be hospitalised with COVID, and why Belgian figures show a much smaller gap. The minister acknowledged the tweet, explained the Belgian comparison covered only one week and used different methods, and cited RIVM data showing lower but still substantial protection over longer periods.
For determining vaccine effectiveness it is better to look at a longer period, as the RIVM also does.
Voor de bepaling van de vaccineffectiviteit is het beter te kijken naar een langere periode, zoals het RIVM ook doet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de tabel gebaseerd op NICE-data waaruit blijkt dat er nu meer tachtigplussers met corona zijn opgenomen in onze ziekenhuizen dan vóór de start van de vaccinatiecampagne

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister to explain a tabulated NICE dataset showing more elderly COVID-19 hospital admissions than before vaccination began, and why the Chamber must rely on citizens for such data. The minister argued the rise reflects high infection pressure and waning vaccine effectiveness, denied the age-80 figure is higher than before vaccination, refused to share the table daily since the data are publicly available and incomplete, and said the 48-hour deadline was too short.
The RIVM has no information on whether a person is a nursing home resident in the hospital and IC admission data from Stichting NICE.
Het RIVM heeft geen informatie over of een persoon een verpleeghuisbewoner is in de data over ziekenhuis- en IC-opnames van Stichting NICE.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Hil over het bericht dat de IGJ neptherapeuten te vaak ongemoeid laat

An MP asks the Health Minister about a report that the health inspectorate IGJ leaves fake therapists unpursued too often, and asks how many title-misuse reports were received and acted upon. The minister answers that about 700 reports were received in five years, 90 warnings or fines were issued, and that IGJ investigates reports on a case-by-case basis while stressing the importance of protecting the BIG register.
The IGJ has received approximately 700 reports regarding alleged title misuse over the past five years.
Er zijn door de IGJ de afgelopen vijf jaar circa 700 meldingen ontvangen in relatie tot vermeend titelmisbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de oproep van de WHO om geen boostervaccins aan te bieden en de conclusie van de Gezondheidsraad om dit slechts voor een kleine groep te doen

An MP asked the ministers about the WHO call to withhold booster vaccines and the Health Council advice limiting boosters to a small group, and how this affects donation and procurement policy and motion Bikker-Hammelburg. The government answered that the advice concerns only a small group of severely immunocompromised patients, has no implications for donation or procurement, and that Nederland still aims to donate as many vaccines as it uses, with 22 million doses committed to COVAX.
The Health Council's advice on severely immunocompromised patients concerns a small group and therefore has no implications for the Dutch donation policy.
Het advies van de Gezondheidsraad aangaande ernstig immuun gecompromitteerde patiënten betreft een geringe groep, en heeft dus geen implicaties voor het Nederlandse donatiebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Besmet, maar de QR-code blijft geldig'

An MP asks the Health Minister whether it is acceptable that people who test positive for COVID-19 can still use their QR-code (coronatoegangsbewijs) for access, and why these codes cannot be temporarily blocked as is done for fraudulent codes. The minister answers that personal responsibility and isolation rules apply, that technically revoking codes would conflict with strict privacy design, that advice on the matter will follow after a motion, and that the advisory committee is being consulted.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over geconstateerde ernstige misstanden op de dierenbeurs in Houten

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about serious animal welfare and public health concerns at the Houten reptile fair, including cramped housing, stress, zoonosis risk and NVWA inspections. The minister acknowledged the welfare concerns, reported NVWA findings and inspection history, and said a broader exploration of animal fairs and legal analysis is underway, without committing to a ban.
I have started an exploration into animal fairs in the Netherlands.
Ik ben een verkenning gestart over beurzen met dieren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het weigeren van Statenleden

Opposition MP Van Esch asked why Limburg provincial state members were refused entry to a committee meeting for lacking a corona pass, and whether the governor selection procedure should have been halted. The minister agreed access must not be denied, said meetings should be held elsewhere when the pass is required, and undertook to clarify the rules to decentralised governments, though the appointment proceeded.
Being able to take part in deliberations is, after all, the essence of being an elected representative.
Het kunnen deelnemen aan de beraadslaging is immers de essentie van het zijn van volksvertegenwoordiger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over abortus voor ongedocumenteerden

GroenLinks MP Ellemeet asked whether abortion access should be guaranteed for undocumented women, whether they can afford the roughly 700 euro cost, and whether the CAK reimbursement scheme or the abortion clinic subsidy should be extended to cover them. Minister De Jonge answered that uninsured women can be charged flexible lower rates, that a survey of clinics found only limited contact with undocumented women, that extending the schemes would be legally difficult and open to abuse, and that he will ask clinics to record such cases.
I am willing to ask abortion clinics to keep track of whether, and if so how often, they encounter undocumented women who are financially unable to pay for abortion care.
Ik ben bereid abortusklinieken te verzoeken om bij te houden of, en zo ja, hoe vaak, zij te maken krijgen met ongedocumenteerde vrouwen die financieel niet in staat zijn abortuszorg te bekostigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de Britse toezichthouder een coronapil heeft goedgekeurd

An MP asked the health minister about the UK approval of molnupiravir, the expected EMA decision timing, reported UK and US order volumes, EU joint procurement, and why the Netherlands does not buy directly. The minister said the EMA rolling review has started, could not confirm the order volumes, stated that the terms of the EU procurement are confidential, and justified joint procurement as securing a stronger negotiating position and fair distribution.
The agreements made on this are confidential.
De afspraken die hierover gemaakt zijn, zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het basispakket van Pro Life

MPs Ellemeet asked whether Pro Life's basic health policy excluding abortion, euthanasia, donor insemination, IVF for same-sex couples and transgender care, and related questions about stigma, legal limits, and palliative care, is acceptable. Minister De Jonge replied that the exclusions are permitted under article 11(5) Zvw, that the NZa judges compliance case by case, that Pro Life will clarify its website, and that no legislative change is planned.
I do not intend to prepare a legislative amendment.
Ik ben niet van plan een wetswijziging voor te bereiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht “PUR-cowboys hebben vrij spel”

MPs asked the government about reports that spray PUR insulation is applied carelessly, the number of complaints, certification, worker protection and the reliability of the GGD protocol. The minister answered that compliance with rules and certification is the responsibility of companies and supervisors, promised an evaluation of work practice with a proposal in summer 2022, and provided complaint figures and an explanation of the protocol's funding.
With the evaluation of work practice I want to gain more insight into how regulations, rules and private certification are applied in practice.
Met de evaluatie van de werkpraktijk wil ik meer inzicht krijgen hoe de regelgeving, voorschriften en private certificering in de praktijk worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over oversterfte sinds mei 2021

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about excess mortality reported by Statistics Netherlands since May 2021, its explanation, and how it compares internationally. The Minister said the excess is almost entirely attributable to COVID-19 deaths and that an international comparison is not reliable due to differing methods.
Statistics Netherlands states that the excess mortality, meaning the difference between observed and expected deaths, is almost entirely caused by deaths from COVID-19.
Het CBS stelt dat de oversterfte, ofwel het verschil tussen het waargenomen aantal en het verwachte aantal overledenen, bijna in z’n geheel wordt veroorzaakt door sterfte aan COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over een commandant die zijn bemanning niet wil laten testen

SP MPs asked whether a navy commander refusing to test crew with Covid-19 symptoms on Zr.Ms. Rotterdam was acceptable and what Defence policy is. The Minister says medical care aboard is the commander's responsibility, Defence follows government policy with exceptions for operational readiness, and crew were quarantined and tested only on return.
That is why Defence chooses, also because of the high vaccination rate, not to test routinely but to treat patients based on the actual clinical picture.
Daarom kiest Defensie ervoor om, ook vanwege de hoge vaccinatiegraad, niet standaard te testen, maar patiënten te behandelen op basis van het daadwerkelijke ziektebeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Van Nispen en Westerveld over het sterker, gerichter en efficiënter fixen van matchfixing

Three MPs (Van der Laan, Van Nispen, Westerveld) asked the ministers about matchfixing, including its prevalence, prosecutability under Dutch criminal law, information sharing between betting operators, investigators and sports bodies, and funding for prevention. The minister answered that the government is reviewing the anti-matchfixing structure, that existing offences like fraud and bribery only partly cover matchfixing, and that monitoring and the Kansspelwet evaluation will follow, with no clear commitment to new legislation yet.
The nature and extent of matchfixing in the Netherlands is not known.
De aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Inge van Dijk over wederom een bericht over matchfixing

MPs Van der Laan and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government will act on KNVB calls for further investigation into possible matchfixing in youth football, whether betting operators monitor these competitions, and whether an OM study on criminalising matchfixing will be shared with parliament. The minister says the Signalenoverleg Sportfraude will discuss the signals, that betting on the Onder 21 competition is prohibited, and that the OM study is still being advised on, with parliament to be informed later.
Your House will be informed about the advice afterwards.
Uw Kamer wordt daarna geïnformeerd over het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE)

An MP asks the Minister of Health about antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) risks for COVID-vaccinated people, citing scientific articles and expert warnings, and asks whether OMT discussed it and whether further animal studies are needed. The Minister answers that ADE has not been observed in vaccinated people, the risk is theoretical, the Health Council advises on vaccination, no OMT documents on ADE exist, and no new animal studies are considered necessary.
The OMT has not discussed ADE.
Het OMT heeft niet gesproken over ADE.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked about the COVID coronatoegangsbewijs (CTB) being required at a Deventer inloophuis, in lawyers' training, for journalists and officials, and whether the Van der Staaij amendment exempts public buildings. Minister Grapperhaus replied that CTB obligations apply only to specified venues, that buurt- en wijkcentra are largely exempt, that the occupational exemption in article 58ra covers journalists and officials when their work requires presence at a venue, and that no CTB applies at the town hall.
Buurt- and wijkcentra are exempt from the CTB requirement for events that form part of regular operations.
Voor buurt- en wijkcentra geldt een uitzondering op de CTB plicht voor evenementen die tot de reguliere exploitatie behoren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Grondwet, het coronatoegangsbewijs – en de wetenschappelijke onderbouwing daarvan – en lessen die Nederland kan trekken uit van de aanpak in Corona in Noorwegen, Zweden en D

An MP asked the ministers about constitutional review of COVID measures, the scientific basis for the corona access certificate, and lessons from Norway, Sweden and Denmark. The government replied that constitutional review is applied to new laws and measures, that the certificate is justified by vaccine effectiveness, that little scientific study exists yet and a research question has been set out, and that the OVV has sent no interim report.
It is not the cabinet's task to request an interim report from the OVV. It concerns independent research.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet om een tussenrapportage bij de OVV op te vragen. Het gaat om onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de vondst van zeehonden met hoogpathogene vogelgriep in Duitsland

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the ministers about avian flu (H5N8) found in seals in Germany, its spread to wild animals, monitoring, and protocols for dead wild birds. The minister answered all 14 questions, mostly on substance, noting monitoring and protocols are being developed while rejecting a hunting ban and some measures.
We do not share that view. We do not pursue a policy to combat the disease in wild birds.
Die mening delen wij niet. Wij voeren geen beleid om de ziekte bij wilde vogels te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Kuiken en De Hoop over de samenwerking tussen Nederland en China bij onderzoek naar DNA

MPs Kathmann, Kuiken and De Hoop asked whether Dutch scientists collaborated with Chinese researchers on DNA techniques that could predict appearance and whether results could be misused against Uyghurs and Tibetans, and asked about ethics review and risk screening. The minister said Erasmus MC and LUMC denied involvement in the specific China-linked studies, promised a meeting with institutions and an update in early 2022, and pointed to ongoing knowledge-security measures.
I will inform you in early 2022 about the outcomes of that.
Ik zal u begin 2022 informeren over de uitkomsten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over het besluit om coronatoegangsbewijzen verplicht te stellen voor ouders die hun kind naar zwemles komen brengen

Two MPs from the SP asked why the government extended the COVID certificate requirement to parents bringing children to swimming lessons, and whether exemptions could be made. The Minister defended the measure as an OMT-advised step to reduce transmission, noted parents can obtain a QR code by vaccination, recovery or testing, and refused to create an exemption.
I choose not to make an exception for this.
Ik kies ervoor om hier geen uitzondering voor te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over infecties versus injecties

An MP from the FvD asked the Minister of Health about the comparative protection of natural COVID-19 infection versus vaccination, referencing various studies and a newspaper interview, and questioned continued vaccination. The Minister answered at length, stating that natural infection carries serious risks, that vaccination is the safest route to lasting immunity, and rebutting the cited studies and claims point by point.
Vaccination is therefore the safest option for building long-lasting immunity and preventing serious illness and death.
Vaccineren is daarom de veiligste optie om langdurige immuniteit op te bouwen en ernstige ziekte en sterfte te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat de kosten van valincidenten zullen verdubbelen naar 2,4 miljard euro

MP Den Haan asks the health minister about projections that fall-related costs will double to 2.4 billion euros, what measures are being taken, the status of the Zorginstituut assessment on fall prevention in the basic insurance, and monitoring of fall prevention uptake among older people. The minister acknowledges the concern, says the Zorginstituut assessment is delayed to early 2022, outlines ongoing preventive initiatives, and says structural monitoring and further funding decisions are left to the next cabinet.
It is not known how many municipalities offer cost-effective forms of interventions in fall prevention.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten (kosten)effectieve vormen van interventies aanbieden op het gebied van valpreventie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij , Omtzigt, Den Haan, Gündoğan, Hijink en Westerveld over het tijdspad van boostervaccinaties

MPs asked the Dutch health minister why the Netherlands had not yet started voluntary COVID-19 booster vaccinations for over-65s and care residents, citing declining vaccine effectiveness, rollouts in Denmark, Sweden and the UK, and vaccine stock. The minister answered that vaccine effectiveness remained high, that the Health Council had advised boosters for the oldest groups and institutional residents, that a start date of 19 November was set, and that preparation (staffing, invitations, GGD capacity) required time.
From 19 November, booster vaccination will start.
Met ingang van 19 november start het vaccineren met de booster.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het coronabeleid

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Health about whether IC capacity had been sufficiently expanded before new COVID measures were introduced, which hospitals and emergency departments had reopened, how IC beds and healthcare staff had changed over ten years. The Minister replied that IC capacity can be scaled to 1,350 beds for a short peak with a refreshed plan, that the ministry does not hold data on reopened hospitals or emergency departments, and gave NICE bed counts and CBS staffing figures.
No. I do not have this information.
Nee. Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de plannen van het Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen om deel te willen nemen in een zonnepark

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether a hospital in Groningen (OZG) should take part in a solar park, given reports it would receive a EUR 20 million donation if the park is built. The government answered that the hospital does not invest in the park, is not dependent on the donation, and that hospitals should primarily provide care, though on-site renewables are acceptable; it declined to give a financial rescue guarantee and said oversight of insurers' duty of care is with the NZa.
It is not among the tasks of a hospital to be financially involved in a solar park to be developed on third-party land.
Het behoort niet tot de taken van een ziekenhuis om financieel betrokken te zijn bij een te ontwikkelen zonnepark op gronden van derden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Alarmerende verschuivingen'; Succescoach Jac Orie luidt de noodklok over fysieke ontwikkeling nieuwe generatie sporters’

An MP asked the state secretary about reported declines in youth physical development, its effects on health and elite sport, and the government's response, including physical education and monitoring of funds. The government acknowledged a downward trend in motor skills, said no studies link it to elite sport careers, and pointed to subsidies, a RIVM study on care costs, and a broad-development approach.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis OZG door deal met PowerField in de armen van commercie geduwd en het unieke Oldambtster landschap wordt vermarkt: 'Onoorbaar en amoreel''

Two SP MPs asked whether a deal in which a solar park developer offers EUR 20 million to a Groningen hospital, conditional on a solar park being built, amounts to commercialising care and the landscape. The government answered that spatial development is bound by existing law and policy, that the hospital is not dependent on the donation, that no care funds are involved, and that local authorities make the public interest assessment.
Moreover, I point out that there is no legal obligation to return proceeds to the surrounding area.
Overigens wijs ik erop dat er geen sprake is van een wettelijke verplichting om opbrengsten terug te laten stromen naar de omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat kinderfysiotherapeuten door zorgverzekeraar Zilveren Kruis verplicht worden een scholing op het gebied van datarapportage te doen

Hijink (SP) asked the minister about insurer Zilveren Kruis requiring physiotherapists to take a data-reporting e-learning course, and whether this is compatible with reducing bureaucracy. The minister answered that the module is a voluntary contract choice paired with a tariff increase, that the course counts toward registration, and that the insurer's contractual requirements are a matter for the insurer and the profession.
It is not an obligation but a voluntary choice for a practice to add the module 'Continuous Improvement' to the contract.
Het is geen verplichting, maar een vrijwillige keuze voor een praktijk om de module «Voortdurend Verbeteren» aan het contract toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de distributie van jodiumtabletten

An MP asked the health minister about the distribution of iodine tablets: the status of the July 2021 redistribution near nuclear plants, and why pregnant women and families with young children 20-100 km away are not actively and structurally informed. The minister said the redistribution was completed, that pregnant women already receive information via the 'Zwanger!' leaflet and professional channels, and that he will consider extending outreach (e.g. to apps) in standard consultations with RIVM.
I will consider in the standard consultation structure with RIVM and the partners whether it is necessary and desirable to extend this to, for example, widely used apps.
Ik zal in de standaard overlegstructuur met het RIVM en de partners bezien of het nodig en wenselijk is om dit uit te breiden naar bijvoorbeeld veelgebruikte apps.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hijink over het bericht dat driekwart van de huisartsen de werkdruk te hoog vindt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that three-quarters of GPs find their workload too high, including longer consultation times, administrative burden and training places. The minister said he is in ongoing talks with the LHV, pilots on longer consultations will be rolled out, administrative burden reductions are underway with the precise follow-up left to the next cabinet, and training places are being increased within capacity limits.
The precise design of a follow-up approach to further reduce administrative burden is up to the next cabinet.
De precieze invulling van een vervolgaanpak om de administratieve regeldruk verder te verminderen is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat er bij een derde van de bezoeken aan restaurants en cafés geen check op de coronapas plaatsvindt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that a third of restaurant and café visits involved no check of the corona pass, and whether the pass's effect on infections can be measured. The minister acknowledged the risk, pointed to enforcement by municipalities and safety regions with €45 million support, and said the pass's effect cannot be isolated, while providing a cluster analysis; he did not send answers before the next debate.
To check whether citizens and businesses comply with the law, enforcement services are deployed.
Om burgers en ondernemingen te controleren op het naleven van de wet, worden handhavingsdiensten ingezet.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Hijink over de brief die het Ministerie van VWS stuurde aan het LNAZ

An SP MP asked why the Ministry of Health sent a letter asking the LNAZ to find ways to reach more than 1,350 ICU beds after earlier saying this was not feasible, and what this means for measures. The minister explained that the LNAZ concluded a short peak of up to 1,350 ICU beds is feasible, while going beyond that is not, mainly due to staff shortages, and that measures follow OMT advice, but declined to answer all questions before the next debate.
Antwoord op vragen van lid van Houwelingen over over ivermectine, hydroxychloroquine en testen op antilichamen

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asks the Health Minister whether treatment guidelines on ivermectin, hydroxychloroquine and antibody testing rest on scientific consensus, and whether critical doctors are being silenced by warning letters and complaint channels. The minister says guidelines are set by professional bodies weighing the literature, that critique belongs in those bodies, and declines to ask RIVM for substantive responses to the submitted articles.
As I have indicated in earlier answers, RIVM does not lead in drafting the treatment guidelines; the professional groups are leading in weighing the information in relation to these guidelines.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in eerdere antwoorden, is het RIVM niet leidend in het opstellen van de behandelrichtlijnen, maar zijn de beroepsgroepen leidend in het wegen van de informatie in relatie tot deze richtlijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over de beschikbaarheid van testcapaciteit buiten de randstad

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister why COVID test locations outside the Randstad had closed and whether accessibility within 30 minutes' travel was guaranteed, as coronavirus access passes expanded. Minister De Jonge answered that coverage had reached 99.9%, that the new per-test payment system had tripled locations, that the government would monitor and prepare for new gaps, and that pharmacies could join the scheme.
Stichting Open Nederland, however, can no longer require that a test provider establish itself at a particular location.
Stichting Open Nederland kan echter niet meer eisen dat een testaanbieder zich op een bepaalde plek vestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de vaccinatiegraad

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health about a claim of 75% first-dose and 50% full vaccination coverage, and how it squares with other figures. The Minister answered that the quote dates from 6 July 2021 rather than 15 October, that current RIVM figures are given, and that the discrepancies follow from the wrong date.
The fragment the Algemeen Dagblad cites on its website dates from 6 July 2021.
Het fragment dat het Algemeen Dagblad aanhaalt op zijn website dateert van 6 juli 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het journalistieke televisieprogramma Propaganda over de besluitvorming rond ‘Dansen voor Janssen’

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked the Health Minister about the decision-making behind the 'Dansen met Janssen' campaign after a TV programme alleged misleading information and a changed advice on the Janssen vaccine for young people. The minister answered that the age limit was not changed, that the Health Council advice was followed, and that the information given was objective, while rejecting claims of misleading communication.
I have not provided misleading information.
Ik heb geen misleidende informatie verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over uitblijven resultaten onderzoek mondkapjesdeal

MP Van Haga asks the minister about delays in the investigation into the face-mask deal with Sywert van Lienden, the foundation's removal of financial accountability promises, possible ministerial integrity concerns, the separation of investigation parts, and whether the state will recover profits or punish officials. The government says the investigation takes longer due to complex data handling under privacy law, that two separate parts with results delivered separately are planned for early 2022, and that the state will not join the planned criminal complaint while awaiting the investigation outcome.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het onderzoek naar en het verdere verloop van de gang van zaken rond de zogenoemde mondkapjesdeals van Sywert van Lienden

An MP asked sixteen questions about the delayed independent investigation into the face-mask purchases involving Sywert van Lienden, including why data collection is slow, the role of the ministry in the RGA order, and when the reports and documents will be published. The State Secretary answered that results are expected by year-end at the earliest, attributed delays to data complexity and privacy rules, and deflected several questions to ongoing procedures or the investigators.

Should the results of the first part of the investigation, concerning the agreement with Hulptroepen Alliantie (HA) / Relief Goods Alliance B.V. (RGA), not be final by the first quarter of 2022, I will at the latest in that quarter share the status at that time.

Mochten de resultaten van het eerste deel van het onderzoek – de overeenkomst met Hulptroepen Alliantie (HA) / Relief Goods Alliance B.V. (RGA) nog niet in het eerste kwartaal van 2022 definitief zijn dan deel ik uiterlijk in dat kwartaal de stand van zaken van dat moment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de vaccinatie van Nederlanders in het buitenland

An MP asked the health minister whether Dutch nationals abroad are being left out of COVID-19 vaccination programmes, how France runs its own vaccination campaigns for citizens abroad, and what the government is doing to simplify access. The minister replied that Dutch expatriates generally participate in local programmes, outlined diplomatic and COVAX efforts, described simplified options for vaccination in the Netherlands, and explained how vaccination certificates for those vaccinated abroad will be handled.
The cabinet currently has no indications that Dutch nationals are systematically disadvantaged compared with the local population in other countries' vaccination programmes.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat Nederlanders stelselmatig worden achtergesteld ten opzichte van de lokale bevolking in de vaccinatieprogramma's van andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Bikker over vaccindonatie

Two MPs (Hammelburg, D66, and Bikker, ChristenUnie) asked the health minister about donating COVID-19 vaccines via GAVI, legal obstacles, the EU Team Europe approach, and comparisons with Germany, the US, Sweden and Norway. The minister answered that the Netherlands has signed donation mandates for AstraZeneca, BioNTech/Pfizer and Janssen doses and aims to donate roughly 25-27 million doses, but the answers largely restate policy and give limited detail on legal barriers and comparative figures.

The Netherlands has now signed the donation mandates under which all remaining AstraZeneca doses (about 7.9 million) and all remaining BioNTech/Pfizer doses for 2021 (about 2.8 million) will be donated to Covax.

Nederland heeft inmiddels de donatiemandaten ondertekend waarmee alle nog te ontvangen doses van het AstraZeneca vaccin (circa 7,9 miljoen doses) en alle nog te ontvangen doses uit de contracten met BioNTech/Pfizer voor 2021 (circa 2,8 miljoen doses) aan Covax zullen worden gedoneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over ic-capaciteit en opleiding van ic-verpleegkundigen

An FvD MP asks the health minister why ICU capacity is being cut due to staff shortages, why UMC Maastricht trained far more ICU nurses than other hospitals, and what is being done on pay, retention, a COVID-only short ICU training and whether questions can be answered one by one. The minister lists investment, training programmes, retention and wage measures, rejects a COVID-only short training as harmful to care quality, and answers each question in turn.
Training ICU nurses is a top priority.
Het opleiden van IC-verpleegkundigen is topprioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de noodzaak van consistent beleid ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid en het stellen van de juiste prioriteiten

An MP asks the Health and Justice ministers about the coronavirus entry pass, the government's protection of public health against pollution, pesticides, fast-food expansion and zoonotic risks from intensive livestock farming, and whether policy priorities are consistent. The minister defends the entry pass as a mitigating measure, says the government is strengthening zoonosis policy following an expert group report, and largely declines to characterise its own policy.
The cabinet is working on implementing the Clean Air Agreement.
Het kabinet werkt aan de uitvoering van het Schone Lucht akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries en Kuiken over internationale ontwikkelingen rond boostervaccinaties en vaccinatie van kwetsbaren

MPs Paternotte, Aukje de Vries and Kuiken asked the Minister of Health about EU and German decisions on booster vaccinations, Janssen and AstraZeneca booster eligibility, booster age groups, children aged 5-11 and off-label use for vulnerable children, and school absence due to COVID risk. The Minister answered that the Gezondheidsraad was asked for additional advice by 2 November on boosters and on Pfizer for children, and that the Dutch child-vaccination and school-absence questions are being monitored or left to advisory and EMA processes.
I asked the Health Council on 15 October to provide additional advice on using mRNA vaccines as a booster
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 15 oktober jl. is gevraagd een aanvullend advies te geven over het inzetten van mRNA-vaccins als booster
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over een mogelijke griepprik voor alle kinderen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health why the government is not offering flu vaccination to all children, and about child flu hospitalisation, hospital capacity during a flu and COVID wave, and needed investment. The minister answered that the Health Council sees no reason to extend flu vaccination to healthy children given low disease burden, gave estimated child hospitalisation rates, described capacity-planning measures with a review due in November, and said staffing investment is being addressed through existing and planned instruments.
There is no registration of the number of children hospitalised with flu each year.
Er vindt geen registratie plaats van het aantal kinderen dat met griep opgenomen wordt in het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de geluidsoverlast van motoren

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about noise nuisance from motorcycles, including health effects, EU-level and national noise norms, roadside acoustic cameras, municipal road closures and the regulation of non-certified exhausts. The minister replied that noise policy is being developed in an integrated response expected after a new cabinet, that municipalities may close roads case by case, and that EU and national rules on exhausts and inspections are being reviewed or enforced.
For this reason an integrated policy response is expected to be drafted and sent to the House after a new cabinet takes office.
Om die reden zal een integrale beleidsreactie naar verwachting na aantreden van een nieuw kabinet kunnen worden opgesteld en naar de Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel 'Wij geven passende zorg zonder dat de gemeente iets hoeft te doen'

An MP asks whether the Omgevingswet will restrict the permit-free construction of care dwellings (mantelzorgwoningen) on a relative's land, and whether municipalities will be required to allow them. The minister says the current rules are carried over unchanged, that no municipalities are known to restrict them, and that an instructieregel is not yet needed; instead local pilots on caregiver access are planned.
It is my preference to wait for developments in municipal practice and later assess whether national steering on this point is needed.
Het heeft mijn voorkeur de ontwikkelingen in de gemeentelijke praktijk af te wachten en later te bezien of er op dit punt van rijkswege sturing nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Paulusma over de voortgang in de inhaalzorg

An MP asked the Minister of Health about differences between hospitals in delivering catch-up care after the COVID-19 backlog, the spreading of patients, the role of UMCs, primary care and treatment centres, and whether untreated patients have simply recovered. The Minister answered that waiting times vary by region and treatment, referred to NZa monitoring and existing agreements, stated no further broad regional patient transfers are planned, and said monitoring and communication efforts continue.
No percentage is known for what share of care in UMCs cannot be transferred to other hospitals.
Over welk deel van de zorg door umc's niet kan worden overgedragen aan andere ziekenhuizen is geen percentage bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een Bloedtest

The MP asked whether GPs may perform antibody blood tests to issue a recovery certificate and, if not, why, when that might change, and on what criteria the validity of recovery and vaccination certificates is reviewed. The minister answered that serologic tests cannot currently be used for individual certificates, citing the inability to date infection, lack of accepted protection thresholds, and test diversity, and said the cabinet will consider OMT advice on extending recovery certificate validity in early November.
No, it is currently not (legally) permitted for doctors or others to issue a recovery certificate based on a serological blood test.
Nee, het is momenteel niet (wettelijk) toegestaan voor artsen of anderen om een herstelbewijs aan te maken op basis van een serologische bloedtest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de bereikbaarheid van testlocaties als gevolg van nieuw beleid van de Stichting Open Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Health about gaps in COVID test-location coverage in rural regions after the Stichting Open Nederland switched to paying per test, and whether this breaches a motion requiring a test within 30 minutes' travel. The minister acknowledged temporary gaps, reported 99% national coverage with new sites opened, said Zeeland was still being addressed, and stated the current system suffices and will be monitored without committing to reinstate per-location payment.
At present the system is sufficient and I will continue to closely monitor the situation.
Op dit moment volstaat het systeem en ik blijf de situatie nauwkeurig volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over berichten dat op meerdere plaatsen in Nederland, maar in ieder geval in de Achterhoek, West-Brabant en in Zeeland, het momenteel niet mogelijk is om binnen 30 minuten een

MP Van der Plas asks the health minister about closed Testen voor Toegang test sites in Zeeland, the Achterhoek and West-Brabant, the new per-test payment system, and how the 30-minute travel-time motion will be implemented. The minister says 99% of the population is now within 30 minutes of a test site, reopened sites in Renesse, Winterswijk and Roosendaal, and refuses to suspend CoronaCheck app enforcement.
This is no longer necessary. On 14 October a test location was opened in Terneuzen.
Dit is niet (meer) noodzakelijk. Op 14 oktober is er een testlocatie op Terneuzen geopend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de sluiting van de verloskamers in het Gelre Ziekenhuis te Zutphen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the temporary closure of the delivery rooms at Gelre hospital in Zutphen, including its consultation with stakeholders, the safety of care, possible wider closures and the role of insurers. The Minister said the closure is temporary due to staff shortages, that the 45-minute access norm and regional agreements are being met, that stakeholders are being consulted, and that no decision on further closures has been taken.

In addition, on the instruction of the ROAZ and coordinated by the NAZZ-regio Zwolle bureau, a chain process has been started to make arrangements on how continuity of maternity care can be safeguarded in the future.

Daarnaast is in opdracht van het ROAZ en onder coördinatie van het bureau NAZZ-regio Zwolle een ketentraject gestart om afspraken te maken hoe de zorgcontinuïteit binnen de geboortezorg toekomstbestendig geborgd kan blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de uitzending van Omroep Gelderland ‘In het vizier van de Jager’ en het artikel ‘Dit is moderne slavernij: politiek wil vrouwen van brandmerk afhelpen'

An MP asks the health and justice ministers about women branded or tattooed by loverboys and whether they must pay for removal, plus data on victims and insurance coverage. The minister answers that no victim counts exist, that victims can claim compensation via the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, and that removal is not covered by basic insurance without a medical indication, while promising to consider alternative funding.
It is terrible when a young woman is exploited and, under pressure, has a tattoo or brand applied.
Het is vreselijk als een jonge vrouw wordt uitgebuit en onder druk een tatoeage of brandmerk aangebracht krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Ellemeet over de onrechtmatige staatssteun aan Siriz

MPs Jetten and Ellemeet asked the state secretary about Siriz's unlawful state aid, its subsidy history, contacts with the ministry, and the Court of Audit's findings. The state secretary acknowledged that the subsidy constituted unlawful state aid, gave a year-by-year payment table, but declined to make the 2019 state-aid assessments available and said recovery is not possible while no Commission or court ruling exists.
There are no documents containing full state-aid assessments that can be sent to your House.
Er zijn geen documenten met integrale staatssteuntoetsen die aan uw Kamer kunnen worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ploumen over de pilot Testen voor Toegang

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about costs, test reliability, operator payments, data handling and the 40-hour validity window of the Testen voor Toegang pilot. The minister answered that the cost estimate will be revised to about 500 million euros, that testing is paid per test with a 12.77 euro rate, that the Stichting Open Nederland is non-profit, and that a 40-hour validity was later reduced to 24 hours.
The House will shortly be informed about the actual realised figures for phases 0, 1, 2 and 3a through 3d, as the post-calculation is currently being carried out.
De Kamer zal binnenkort geïnformeerd worden over de daadwerkelijke realisatiecijfers voor fase 0, 1, 2 en 3a t/m 3d aangezien de nacalculatie hier momenteel over plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over coronatoegangsbewijzen en de deltavariant

The MP asks the health minister how to interpret infections linked to events admitted with a COVID certificate, whether the 116th and 117th OMT advice accounted for certificate or testing failures, which scientific source supports issuing certificates immediately after a Janssen dose, and for quantified risk reasoning behind the Janssen waiting period. The minister admits enforcement and technical problems, says the OMT was not informed of these failures in its advice, and reports that the 14-day rule was adopted (28 days for Janssen) without a specific scientific source, after reconsideration.

No, in the 116th and 117th OMT advice on accelerating step 5 of the reopening plan, the combined effect of the then almost absent more contagious delta variant, changed behaviour at 1.5 metres, the attack on the SON systems and its consequences, poor enforcement at the door and its supervision, and young people avoiding valid QR codes, was not taken into account.

Nee, bij het 116e en 117e advies van het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) aangaande het versneld zetten van stap 5 van het openingsplan, was de optelsom van de (toen nog vrijwel afwezige) besmettelijkere delta-variant, de verandering in het gedrag van mensen op de 1,5m in het algemeen, de aanval op de systemen van SON en de gevolgen daarvan, de slechte handhaving aan de poort en het toezicht daarop, het ontwijken van het gebruik van geldige QR codes door met name jongeren, niet verdisconteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Leaseplan: alleen volledig gevaccineerden weer welkom op kantoor’

MP Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked the ministers of Health and of the Interior about a report that Leaseplan would admit only fully vaccinated staff to the office, raising concerns about coercion, bodily integrity, remote work options, transmission data and employers' legal basis for recording vaccination status. Minister De Jonge answered that vaccination is voluntary, employers may ask but not require vaccination or register status under the GDPR, and that the government is consulting sectors and will ask the OMT for advice if policy changes are warranted.
An employer may not require an employee to be vaccinated against corona.
Een werkgever mag een werknemer niet verplichten om zich te laten vaccineren tegen corona.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de schending van grondrechten door vaccinatiedwang door bedrijven

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether Leaseplan's vaccination pressure on employees, which lacks a clear legal basis, violates fundamental rights, and whether the government will act and inform parliament.
