The minister replied that there is no vaccination obligation in the Netherlands, that compliance with rights depends on the situation and would be decided by courts, pointed to earlier letters and website guidance, and did not comment on Leaseplan specifically.

In case of disagreement, the judge will rule on whether the infringement is provided for by law, whether the employer pursued a legitimate aim, and whether the measures taken were justified, proportionate and subsidiary.

In geval van onenigheid zal de rechter uitspraak doen of de inbreuk bij wet is voorzien, of de werkgever een legitiem doel nastreefde en of de door de werkgever getroffen maatregelen het te bereiken doel rechtvaardigden en proportioneel en subsidiair waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over vaccinatiedrang- en dwang en coronatoegangsbewijzen

An MP (Van der Staaij, SGP) asked the health minister whether companies such as Leaseplan may pressure staff and customers to get vaccinated, whether employees can be asked for their vaccination status, and about the proportionality of extending COVID certificates and the rules on natural immunity and transmission. The minister replied that there is no vaccination obligation, that employers may ask about vaccination status under conditions, that he cannot comment on Leaseplan based on press reports, and that the government is consulting sectors and working on the motions regarding recovery certificates.
These motions are currently being worked out, with the OMT asked for advice.
Deze moties worden op dit moment uitgewerkt, waarbij het OMT om advies is gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van der Laan over het WRR-rapport: Kiezen voor houdbare zorg

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the WRR report on sustainable healthcare, including quick wins, citizen forums, foreign care workers and prevention. The minister answered that hard political choices are needed but largely deferred concrete responses on the recommendations to a next cabinet, pointing to existing policy documents.
It is up to a next cabinet to make choices on this and to respond substantively to the WRR recommendations.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om daar keuzes in te maken en inhoudelijk te reageren op de aanbevelingen van de WRR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Fraudeurs houden toch groen vinkje’

MP Aukje de Vries asked whether fraudulent vaccination-based COVID certificates (groene vinkje) in the CoronaCheck app could be revoked and whether the app should be changed to remove the green tick for vaccinated people who become infected. Minister De Jonge answered that privacy-by-design choices mean issued Dutch QR codes cannot be revoked remotely, that GGD will void proven fraudulent certificates from its own records, and that no change to remove the green tick for infected persons is planned.
The coronavirus access certificate contains too little information to actually be able to do this.
Het coronatoegangsbewijs bevat namelijk te weinig informatie om dit daadwerkelijk te kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over de drukte bij de Formule 1 in Zandvoort

MPs Van Esch and Teunissen asked the health and education ministers about crowding at the Formula 1 event in Zandvoort, the rules for seated versus unseated events, and whether this was foreseen and would be evaluated. Minister De Jonge answered that the event followed the rules in force, that seated and unseated events differ in risk, that about 90 infections were traced to the event, and that the government aims to lift restrictions when the epidemiological situation allows.
It turned out that this was not possible at all times.
Het is gebleken dat dat niet op alle momenten mogelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Kuiken en Van den Berg over doelgroepen die aanzienlijke moeite hebben met het verkrijgen van een coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs from D66, VVD, PvdA and CDA asked the health minister which groups struggle to obtain a COVID certificate, including people vaccinated abroad, people without a BSN, and those medically unable to test, and about waiting times and access at GGD Utrecht. The minister answered that the Utrecht service is limited to non-EU vaccinees resident in the Netherlands or Dutch nationals, that solutions for other groups are being explored, and that additional locations (such as Groningen) are being prepared.
It is currently being explored whether people from this group who can make it plausible that they live in the Netherlands and do not yet have a BSN can also be helped.
Er wordt momenteel verkend of mensen uit deze groep die aannemelijk kunnen maken dat zij woonachtig zijn in Nederland en nog geen BSN hebben, ook geholpen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de begroting van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2022 en het financieel beheer

An MP from FvD asked the health minister about the validity of a guarantee for the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen, unusable corona goods, improvements to financial management, procurement rules at the consortium and ministry, the Deloitte investigation timeline, and large severance payments to hospital directors. The minister answered that the guarantee ran until 24 June 2021, promised a separate letter on financial management, explained exemptions from procurement rules for storage contracts, said the Deloitte research would take longer than planned, and noted that the WNT regulator has started an investigation into the hospitals.
I will inform the House with a separate letter about the progress of the programme 'Improving Financial Management VWS'.
Ik zal uw Kamer met een separate brief informeren over de voortgang van het programma «Verbetering Financieel Beheer VWS».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Plas en Bikker over het bericht ‘coronatoegangsbewijzen voor mensen met een meervoudige beperking’

Three MPs asked the health minister how people who can neither be vaccinated nor tested will get a COVID access certificate, and why no route existed when certificates took effect on 25 September, despite a Bikker amendment. The minister answered that a three-week GGD Utrecht pilot started on 6 October to define the group and test a less burdensome method, with exemption certificates as the eventual fallback, and that the answers were late.
After the pilot ends, it will be evaluated on whether it has found a structural solution.
Na afloop van de pilot wordt deze geëvalueerd op de vraag of met de pilot een structurele oplossing is gevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het verloop rond het ontslag van oud-staatssecretaris Mona Keijzer en de afwezigheid van kabinetsleden bij de hoofdelijk stemming over de invoering van de QR-toegangspas

An MP asked several ministers how they were informed of and consented to the dismissal of State Secretary Mona Keijzer, whether the cabinet's rules of procedure were followed, and why a minister was absent from a vote on the QR access pass. The government answered that the dismissal was materially in line with cabinet procedure via consultation with the vice-prime ministers, and that the ministers' disagreements were part of normal cabinet deliberation.
This materially guarantees that the decision was taken in accordance with the sense of the Council of Ministers and does justice to its rules of procedure.
Hiermee is materieel gewaarborgd dat het besluit is genomen in overeenstemming met het gevoelen van de ministerraad en recht gedaan aan het reglement van orde van de ministerraad.
Antwoord op vragen van lid van Houwelingen over Ivermectine, hydroxychloroquine en testen op antilichamen

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about the effectiveness of ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine against COVID-19, the availability of antibody tests and recovery certificates, and free home medicine kits. The minister declined to ask RIVM for a new literature review, deferred to professional bodies and EMA on drug assessment, and said serological tests are not sensitive enough for individual immunity certificates.
The OMT has not advised on ivermectin as a COVID medicine, since the OMT does not deal with treatments.
Het OMT heeft niet geadviseerd over ivermectine als coronamedicijn, aangezien het OMT niet gaat over behandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vaccinatiestatus van diegenen die zijn overleden

An MP asked the health minister why the RIVM is reluctant to publish the vaccination status of people who died from COVID-19, and about privacy, employer vaccination questions and data completeness. The minister answered that COVID deaths are not reportable to the RIVM so the data is incomplete, that privacy plays no role in that decision, and that employers may ask about vaccination status only with a good reason, while promising to explore data linkage and to review whether the certificate exemption for workers can be lifted.
The RIVM is indeed reticent about making statements on the vaccination status of deceased persons.
Het RIVM is inderdaad terughoudend met het doen van mededelingen over de vaccinatiestatus van overleden personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over 'Geef jongeren nu toegang tot de sneltesten'

GreenLeft MPs Klaver and Kröger asked the health minister about an opinion piece calling for youth access to rapid tests, and about OMT advice and the reopening of secondary schools in February 2021. The minister confirmed the questions were put to the OMT, that a generic framework exists for secondary education, and listed the OMT advice issued, but could not answer each question one by one in time due to a system migration.
The cabinet bases itself on the adopted OMT advice.
Het kabinet baseert zich op de vastgestelde OMT adviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het testevenement 538 Oranjefeest

Two MPs asked the government about the 538 Oranjefeest test event, including resale of tickets at high prices, subsidies, selection, health-worker staffing and ticket fraud controls. The minister answered that the event was a research pilot, that the ticket auction was not intended and gave a wrong impression, that tests were required before entry and recommended afterwards, and that a national resale ban was not effective, pointing to a pending EU-based consumer law implementation.
The cabinet financed the research carried out at the field tests.
Het kabinet financierde het onderzoek dat wordt gedaan bij de praktijktesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Kuiken over artsen die corona ontkennen, bagatelliseren, nepnieuws verspreiden of alternatieve behandelingen aanbieden

MPs Paulusma and Kuiken asked the Health Minister about doctors and groups denying or downplaying COVID-19, spreading misinformation and offering unproven treatments, and how the IGJ supervises them. The minister condemned the rhetoric, said the IGJ has sent around fifty corrective letters and about ten warnings of possible sanctions, and that the IGJ is preparing a disciplinary complaint, while stating that the tuchtrechter's threshold for acting against doctors' public statements is high.
Over the past months the IGJ has sent roughly fifty corrective letters to doctors who gave evidently incorrect information about the coronavirus or vaccinations.
De IGJ heeft de afgelopen maanden ongeveer vijftig keer een corrigerende brief gestuurd naar artsen die evident onjuiste informatie gaven over het coronavirus of vaccinaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een aantal medewerkers van GGD-regio’s op non-actief is gesteld vanwege mogelijke fraude met vaccinatiebewijzen

MP Hijink asked the Health Minister about reports that GGD staff were suspended over suspected fraud with vaccination certificates, including how it was discovered, how easy it is to create false records, and what controls exist. The minister answered that the staff were suspended and reported to police, that the GGD cannot yet give numbers because the investigation is ongoing, and that controls exist and detected the fraud, though full prevention cannot be guaranteed.
GGD GHOR indicates that, in the interest of the investigation, no statements can yet be made about this.
GGD GHOR geeft aan dat hierover in het belang van het onderzoek nog geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de medische uitzondering voor het dragen van een mondkapje in het buitenland

An MP asked whether a medical exemption from mask-wearing exists abroad, whether the Dutch self-declaration form is valid there, why it is not uniform in the EU, and why the government website does not say so. The minister answered that mask rules are national, foreign requirements vary and travellers should check local rules via Wijs op Reis, without committing to new steps.
Listing all the countries where the medical exemption applies would produce an unworkable list.
Het noemen van alle landen waar de medische uitzondering geldt, levert een niet werkbare lijst op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de gevaren voor de gezondheid van borstimplantaten

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a study finding silicone particle migration from breast implants and the risks to women's health, and asked about approval, long-term effects, a possible ban, monitoring, screening, information and insurance coverage for removal. The state secretary said the RIVM is assessing the study and a ban would be disproportionate for now, pointed to tighter EU device rules, ongoing research and reporting, and that removal is covered when medically necessary.
I have asked the RIVM to study and assess the relevant research in more detail.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd het betreffende onderzoek nader te bestuderen en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het rapport waarin de lockdown werd ontraden

An MP asks the Prime Minister and Health Minister about an internal report, reportedly obtained under FOI, that advised against a lockdown while estimating 520,000 QALYs lost, and whether the cabinet and OMT knew of it. The government answers that the note was an early-2020 internal discussion paper, was not shared with the Health Minister, Prime Minister or OMT, and that it rejects claims of concealment, while acknowledging the minister of Economic Affairs saw it.
This internal note was shared neither with the Minister of VWS nor with the Prime Minister.
Deze interne notitie is noch met de Minister van VWS noch met de Minister-President gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Druk op de geboortezorg: met moeite bemannen we de bedden'

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about strain on maternity care, the regional capacity shortages, causes such as staff shortages and a birth peak, and what the government will do. The minister answered that shortages exist in several regions, pointed to regional cooperation and a NICU bed-tracking initiative, referred to a planned intensification of measures and the labour-market programme, and agreed to answer before the labour-market debate.
An up-to-date overall overview does not exist.
Een actueel totaaloverzicht is er niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen op ramkoers met artsen die cashen op coronatesten’

SP MPs asked the health minister how he reacts to reports that private microbiologists at Microvida earn large profits from corona lab tests and how this fits with the medical profession and public funds. The minister said he lacks a full picture and it is not his role to judge the dispute, that the Kluytmans conflict of interest is not in question, and that he has no overview of the hospitals or amounts involved, while noting the test fee caps and that excessive earnings from the crisis should be reconsidered.
Moreover, it is not for me to pass judgement on this conflict between an individual partnership and a number of hospitals.
Het is bovendien ook niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over dit conflict tussen een individueel maatschap en een aantal ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Spoedeisende hulp ook in Friesland vaker even op slot vanwege tekort aan personeel

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that emergency departments in Friesland, Groningen and Drenthe increasingly close temporarily ('time-outs') due to staff shortages, asking about hours, patient effects, rules, and solutions. The minister answered that time-outs do not mean closure, that life-threatening cases are always accepted, that the NZa sees no harm to patients, and that regional measures and workforce initiatives are underway.
The NZa has informed me that it is not aware of any signals of adverse consequences or negative health effects for patients as a result of time-outs.
De NZa heeft mij laten weten geen signalen te kennen over nadelige gevolgen of negatieve gezondheidseffecten voor patiënten als gevolg van time-outs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat mensen met dementie na de lockdown nog steeds thuiszitten

An MP asks the health minister about reports that people with dementia remain housebound after the lockdown, and about support for carers, day-care transport, municipal Wmo budget cuts, monitoring and the role of dementia case managers. The minister answers that municipalities are responsible and compensated, that most people with dementia are vaccinated, that transport rules were eased, that monitoring is limited to general developments, and promises an inspiration guide, funding for about 30 municipalities and a possible ZonMw scheme.
From VWS we do not monitor the use of day care at local or regional level.
Vanuit VWS monitoren we de inzet van dagbesteding niet op lokaal – of regionaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer het artikel ‘Ambulances Noorden komen vaker te laat’

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister whether ambulances in the North of the Netherlands miss the 15-minute response norm, whether everyone is entitled to timely emergency care, and what will be done, with details on how often and where the norm was missed. The minister confirmed that response-time percentages fell in 2020 in most regions including the North, attributed this to COVID-19, said no signs of risk to access or quality were found, and pointed to existing action plans and earlier letters without listing individual incidents.
When an emergency department imposes a time-out, this signals to the ambulance service that the emergency department is very busy.
Wanneer een SEH een time-out instelt, is dit voor de ambulancedienst een signaal dat het erg druk is op de SEH
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over schatkistbankieren door zorginstellingen

An MP asks whether care institutions such as youth care providers can join voluntary treasury banking as education institutions can, and whether conditions could be relaxed to shield them from negative interest. The Minister answers that care institutions generally are not statutory-task legal persons and that legal form, care commissioning structure and EU state aid rules preclude participation, so no broader conditions are planned.
Given these criteria and national and European regulations, we also see no possibilities to further broaden the conditions for treasury banking.
Gegeven deze criteria en nationale en Europese regelgeving zien wij ook geen mogelijkheden om de voorwaarden voor het schatkistbankieren verder te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het bericht dat er mogelijk tientallen miljoenen publieke gelden voor coronatesten naar bedrijven in belastingparadijzen zouden zijn gevloeid

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and finance ministers whether public funds for COVID tests reached tax-haven companies, and whether the ministry had acted on information from two entrepreneurs. Minister De Jonge replied that there was no evidence of misuse, that invoices are checked and that the ministry did not investigate because no factual proof was provided.
This conversation gave no reason to investigate whether public money had leaked away, because no factual evidence was presented in the conversation.
Dit gesprek heeft geen aanleiding gegeven om te onderzoeken of publiek geld is weggevloeid, omdat in het gesprek geen feitelijk bewijs is overlegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over onterechte brieven van het CAK aan gedupeerde ouders in het toeslagenschandaal

MP Alkaya asked whether parents affected by the childcare benefits scandal wrongly received CAK letters demanding premium payments, how many were affected, and how the error would be corrected. The State Secretary confirmed that four parents were wrongly sent letters, fourteen others were identified as victims, and the government will contact them and reverse any payments, while keeping the policy of resuming premium collection for parents not entitled to restoration.
Contact will be made with these parents and the erroneous action will be corrected.
Er zal contact opgenomen worden met deze ouders en de foutieve actie zal worden hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Nispen over rammelende feitenonderzoeken in de jeugdbescherming

MPs Kwint and Van Nispen asked about unreliable fact-finding reports in youth protection, including a reported case of a wrongly placed child and complaints procedures. The Minister of Justice replied that the case did not rest on a wrong file, that a Dutch action plan on fact-finding runs to end 2021, that the existing checks are adequate in his view, and that a future youth protection scenario is under consultation.
Imposing a youth protection measure may under no circumstances be based on faulty fact-finding.
Het opleggen van een jeugdbeschermingsmaatregel mag overigens nooit gebaseerd zijn op foutief feitenonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hagen over de quarantaineplicht voor gevaccineerde reizigers

Two D66 MPs asked why vaccinated travellers from very-high-risk areas without a variant of concern must quarantine while vaccinated household contacts of positive cases need not, and whether the government will reconsider. The minister answers that from 22 September vaccinated travellers from such areas are exempt from quarantine (a negative test is still required), that quarantine remains for unvaccinated travellers, and that the amendment Paternotte/Kuiken provides the legal basis.

Given the strongly increased vaccination rate in the Netherlands and the limited risk that vaccinated travellers pose to public health for transmission of the coronavirus, the cabinet has decided to exempt vaccinated travellers from the quarantine obligation from 22 September.

Gezien de sterk toegenomen vaccinatiegraad in Nederland en het beperkte risico dat gevaccineerde reizigers voor de volksgezondheid vormen voor de transmissie van het coronavirus, heeft het kabinet besloten gevaccineerde reizigers per 22 september uit te zonderen van de quarantaineplicht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel 'Zij moest naar België voor de abortus van haar ernstig gehandicapte kind, omdat artsen verzwegen dat het ook in Nederland kon'

An MP from the VVD asks the Health Minister why Dutch women with severely disabled fetuses must go to Belgium for late abortion, why few late terminations are reported in the Netherlands, and whether doctors fear prosecution. The minister answers that Dutch law provides legal safeguards, that the reporting gap partly reflects differing gestational age definitions, that the commission was expanded, and that he will await the 2022 evaluation before acting.
I will await the results of the evaluation of the LZA/LP Regulation, because then I can possibly take targeted action in consultation with the professional group.
Ik zal de resultaten van de evaluatie van de Regeling LAZ/LP afwachten, omdat ik dan eventueel gericht actie kan ondernemen in samenspraak met de beroepsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Laan over de capaciteit bij de GGD’en

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about GGD capacity, outbreak preparedness, staffing shortages, contact tracing gaps, and the public-private testing and appointment arrangements during the COVID-19 period. The minister responded that GGDs had been assessed as generally capable, that preparedness was coordinated via RIVM and existing programmes, and that capacity and scheduling were adequate, though he gave limited detail on some preparedness contacts and did not commit to new concrete steps.
The GGD appointment system functions adequately.
Het afsprakensysteem van de GGD'en functioneert adequaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het coronabeleid

The MP Westerveld asks the ministers about COVID-19 policy, including presymptomatic transmission of the Delta variant, school reopening, vaccination status checks in schools, the use of coronavirus certificates, mask recycling and support for the cultural sector. The minister answers that transmission by asymptomatic people is already taken into account, that the reopening plan was guided by epidemiological data, and that generic support schemes will not be extended after 1 October 2021 while targeted support for night-time hospitality and unseated events is being prepared.
On the elaboration of these support measures, EZK and OCW are in discussion with the sector.
Over de uitwerking van deze steunmaatregelen zijn EZK en OCW in gesprek met de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over de CoronaCheck voor toeristen en andere buitenlanders of Nederlanders die in het buitenland hun vaccinatie hebben gehaald

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked how non-EU vaccinated travellers and Dutch citizens vaccinated abroad can obtain a Dutch CoronaCheck, given that in-person identification in Utrecht is required. The minister answered that GGD Utrecht issues digital certificates after in-person identification, that other locations and an online solution are being explored, and that Dutch residents without a certificate are being looked into.
I am in discussion with GGD GHOR Nederland to see whether this service can also be offered at a number of other GGD locations.
Ik ben met GGD GHOR Nederland in gesprek om te kijken of het mogelijk is om deze service ook op een aantal andere GGD-locaties te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het kabinet ondanks Kamermeerderheid nog geen verbod op homogenezing wil

An SP MP asks why the cabinet will not criminalise conversion therapy (homogenezing) despite a parliamentary majority, what concrete action it will take, and whether a code of conduct and support centres are enough. The minister replies that a broad exploration of effective measures, including a possible legal ban, will be carried out with results expected in early 2022, while a code of conduct and support points are being developed.
For that reason the cabinet will carry out a broad exploration of possible effective further measures, including the option of some form of legal ban.
Om die reden zal het kabinet een brede verkenning uitvoeren naar mogelijke, effectieve nadere maatregelen, inclusief de optie voor enige vorm van wettelijk verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gündoğan, Simons en Kathmann over het bericht “Kabinet wil ‘homogenezing’ ‘krachtig tegengaan’ maar komt niet met een verbod”

MPs Gündoğan, Simons and Kathmann asked the Health Minister whether conversion therapy should be banned, given that it harms minors and that a legal ban was part of the COC Rainbow Accord. The minister agreed that conversion therapy is unacceptable and noted it can already be prosecuted under existing criminal and civil law, but declined to commit to a specific ban, promising a broader exploration of further measures first.
For this reason the cabinet will carry out a broad exploration of possible effective additional measures, including legislation and regulation, including the option of some form of a legal ban.

Om die reden zal het kabinet een brede verkenning uitvoeren naar mogelijke, effectieve nadere maatregelen, waaronder wet- en regelgeving, inclusief de optie van mogelijkheden voor enige vorm van een wettelijk verbod.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over het factsheet voor GGD-medewerkers van test- of vaccinatiestraten, van klantcontactcentra (KCC), van bron- en contactonderzoeken en van vaccinatiesessies t.b.v.

CDA MPs Peters and Van den Berg asked the State Secretary for Health about a GGD factsheet for staff at test, vaccination, contact-centre and contact-tracing sites on recognising and reporting child and domestic abuse, questioning under-reporting, the number of reports, and the burden of reports handled by Veilig Thuis. The State Secretary answered that no figures exist on reports from GGD sites, that the factsheet does not steer staff toward reporting, that Veilig Thuis triages most reports to local support, and that a more transparent child protection system is being developed.
There are no figures known on the number of reports made via GGD test or vaccination sites.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend van het aantal meldingen dat via GGD test- of vaccinatiestraten is gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht dat een kapotte koelkast vol Janssenvaccins in Nieuwegein tot het besluit leidde om jongeren ermee in te enten en ze zo een vrijbrief te geven om te gaan stapp

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Health whether a broken fridge with Janssen vaccines in Nieuwegein, rather than an advisory decision, led to vaccinating young people and whether this misled them. The minister denied any link, stating the choice line was based on Health Council advice, the Nieuwegein incident was separate and approved by RIVM, and the factors were not the cause of rising infections.
The RIVM gave the green light to use these vaccines to prevent them having to be thrown away.
Het RIVM gaf groen licht deze vaccins in te zetten om te voorkomen dat ze weggegooid moesten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitgelekte contracten met Pfizer

An MP from FVD asked the health minister about leaked Pfizer supply contracts with Albania and Brazil, including confidentiality, liability, quality control and prices. The minister answered that he had not analysed the leaked documents, that the Dutch contracts are confidential, and that the state would bear any liability as usual.
The agreements are subject to confidentiality.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over het vaccineren van arbeidsmigranten

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how migrant workers in the Netherlands are being vaccinated against COVID-19, including how many have been vaccinated, what outreach exists, and whether employers and GGDs can vaccinate on site. The minister answered that there is no separate registration for this group, describes multilingual outreach, cooperation with employers' organisations and GGDs, on-site and mobile vaccination options, and a working group led by RIVM, while declining to introduce in-company vaccination.
There is no separate registration for this target group.
Er is geen aparte registratie voor deze doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Plas over coronatoegangsbewijzen voor mensen met een meervoudige beperking

MPs Westerveld and Van der Plas asked whether people with multiple disabilities who can neither be vaccinated nor regularly tested have any route to a COVID certificate, and whether case-by-case solutions exist. The minister answered that no alternative route exists yet because the procedure is complex, that it would apply only to domestic use and not travel under EU rules, that the group is believed to be very small, and that a decision is aimed for autumn.
At this moment there is therefore still no route for people who cannot be vaccinated and cannot be tested.
Op dit moment is er dus nog geen route voor mensen die zich niet kunnen laten vaccineren en niet kunnen laten testen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat de dementiestrategie nog niet leidt tot zinvolle dagbesteding

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that the national dementia strategy is not yet producing meaningful day care for people with dementia, and about how municipalities can be pushed and financially supported. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible under the Wmo 2015, that a Movisie study and an inspiration guide, one-off funding for over 30 municipalities and a possible ZonMw scheme are planned, and that municipal councils supervise local policy.
Municipalities are responsible under the Wmo 2015 for providing social support to people who cannot participate independently and/or have a psychosocial disorder.
Gemeenten zijn op grond van de Wmo2015 verantwoordelijk voor aanbieden van maatschappelijke ondersteuning voor mensen die niet zelfstandig kunnen participeren en/of een psychosociale stoornis hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het bericht ‘mogelijk meer vluchten met besmette passagiers dan gedacht’

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the ministers whether a Canadian-data analysis (36% of July flights from Amsterdam to Canada carried an infected passenger, versus 9% in an NLR/RIVM study) reveals underestimated in-flight infection risk, and whether testing, mask and distancing rules are adequate. The minister answered that the NLR/RIVM study only covered aerosol inhalation in flight, used early-June prevalence and the original variant, that the government sees insufficient reason for stricter measures now, and that it will monitor the situation and reconsider if needed.

The cabinet currently sees insufficient reason, compared with the current policy on testing, the passenger health declaration, triage, masks on board and the quarantine declaration, to take additional measures.

Het kabinet ziet op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding ten opzichte van het huidige beleid ten aanzien van testen, de gezondheidsverklaring van de passagier, triage, mondkapjes aan boord en de verklaring van de quarantaineplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het stoppen van WMO- en leerlingenvervoer in verband met Formule 1-race in Zandvoort

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether WMO and school transport in Zandvoort and neighbouring municipalities was stopped for the Formula 1 weekend, and whether essential care transport may be cancelled for events. The minister replied that the provider reversed the decision and will continue transport with possible delays, that transport should in principle continue, and that organising this transport is a municipal responsibility.
The organisation of school transport and WMO transport has deliberately been assigned to municipalities.
Het organiseren van leerlingenvervoer en Wmo-vervoer is bewust bij gemeenten belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de datadiefstal bij de GGD veel groter is dan gemeld en dat gedupeerden niet zijn geïnformeerd

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the GGD data theft was larger than reported and whether victims were not informed, and asked why the House was not told. The minister answered that no evidence so far shows the theft is larger, that about 1,250 victims were identified and all informed by letter, and that RTL refused to share its files, so the claim cannot be verified.
As far as is currently known, this concerns 1,250 victims.
Voor zover nu bekend gaat het om 1.250 gedupeerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over ventilatie

Two CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers about ventilation in schools and buildings, including past instructions, the SUViS subsidy, the Bouwbesluit compliance, and studies such as the Binnenklimaat label. The minister answered that guidance and webinars were provided, that compliance data is not centrally held, that the SUViS funds were exhausted, and that the RIVM advice has not changed; the research motion on air purifiers is still being scoped.
There is no central picture of how many schools comply with the Bouwbesluit.
Er is dus geen centraal beeld hoeveel scholen voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie harde kritiek heeft op de euthanasierichtlijn

An SGP MP asked ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service's criticism of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees' revised code, and rising euthanasia notifications with few 'careless' rulings, were acceptable. The government answered that it will not publish the prosecutor-general's letter, that the RTE acted without the OM and IGJ, and that a new code, a fourth law evaluation and discussion with the OM are planned, though transparency and independent research were deferred.
It is not fitting for my colleague the Minister of Justice and Security to make public letters from the procurator-general addressed to him.
Het past mijn ambtgenoot van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om brieven van de procureur-generaal die aan hem zijn gericht, openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Meerdere mensen overleden door zelfdoding-middel, verkoper uit Eindhoven (28) opgepakt’

An ChristenUnie MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about reports of deaths from a suicide agent (Middel X) sold via the Coöperatie Laatste Wil and an Eindhoven seller, and whether sale to individuals should be banned. The government answers that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that existing voluntary industry monitoring is kept, that a ban is not pursued because legal regulation is complicated and possibly counterproductive, and that the VWS ministry will consult the industry code parties again.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide any information on this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Van der Staaij over de verkoop van zelfmoordpoeder

Two MPs asked the health and justice ministers why suicide powder sold on Marktplaats and by a Eindhoven seller was not restricted despite deaths, and whether the ban or criminal law should be tightened. The minister answered that the industry code is being reviewed, that new legislation would be counterproductive and disproportionate, that the criminal penalty for assisting suicide is justified, and declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation into the Coöperatie Laatste Wil network.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, we cannot make any statements about this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kunnen wij hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de coronamaatregelen in het onderwijs en de start van het nieuwe studiejaar

MP Kwint (SP) asked the ministers how the government prioritises reopening schools and universities for the new school year, and about ventilation, vaccination, self-testing and quarantine rules for children. The ministers answered that in-person education has been a top priority, that the 1.5-metre rule was lifted in higher education, and that additional funding for ventilation and vaccination outreach has been arranged.
The monitoring study into the use of self-tests in education is still ongoing.
Het monitoringsonderzoek naar het gebruik van de zelftesten in het onderwijs loopt op dit moment nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'GGD-directeur laat naam Tata Steel uit longkankerrapport schrappen'

SP MP Leijten asked ministers about reports that a GGD director had removed Tata Steel's name from a lung cancer report in Beverwijk, and whether trust in authorities has been damaged. The government answered that an independent investigation found the director acted with integrity, cited the Schone Lucht Akkoord and a ministerial working group on Tata Steel, and pointed to Tata Steel's own Roadmap Plus, while committing to a nulmeting and possible further measures.
The investigation report, carried out by researcher and former Hague ombudsman Peter Heskes, concluded that the director and his staff acted with complete integrity.

In het onderzoeksrapport, dat door onderzoeker en voormalig ombudsman van Den Haag Peter Heskes is uitgevoerd, is geconcludeerd dat er volstrekt integer is gehandeld door de directeur en zijn medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over het bericht ‘Grijs goud: Europese ouderenzorg is goudmijn voor internationale investeerders’

MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister of Health about reports that commercial and private-equity investors are profiting from elderly care, including profit extraction, tiered access, and care-cost shifting. The minister answered that profit-distribution rules do not cover extramural home-care packages, that a Wibz bill may add conditions on profit distribution, and that diversity of providers is acceptable, while leaving open possible tightening of public conditions and declining to state a preferred policy given the caretaker cabinet.
I have no information on the level of these specific results.
Over de hoogte van deze specifieke resultaten heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over 'RIVM houdt rapport over gezondheid rond Tata Steel nog lang onder de pet.'

MP Leijten asked why the RIVM health report on Tata Steel is not yet public, whether the timing was deliberate, whether it can be shared before the 9 September debate, and which ministries received drafts. The government replied that the provincial and IJmond municipal clients, together with RIVM, decided to publish mid-September, that the minister is not the client and cannot commit to sharing it earlier, and that only the GGD Kennemerland received a draft.
I am not the client. The province of Noord-Holland and the IJmond municipalities are the clients.
Ik ben geen opdrachtgever. De provincie Noord-Holland en de IJmondgemeenten zijn opdrachtgever.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de berichten 'Flinke toename aantal nieuwe besmettingen, ook aantal coronapatiënten in ziekenhuis toegenomen' en 'Reizigers verbazen zich over coronacontrole op luchthaven

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of rising COVID-19 infections and weak checks on travellers at airports. The minister answered that infections among returning travellers rose, that check procedures at Schiphol are mainly random spot checks, and that the GGD vaccination drive for travellers at Schiphol was stopped due to low uptake.
On arrival in the Netherlands, for example at Schiphol, random spot checks are carried out to see whether travellers with a valid corona certificate have travelled.
Bij aankomst in Nederland wordt, bijvoorbeeld op Schiphol, steekproefsgewijs gecontroleerd of reizigers met een geldig coronabewijs gereisd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het eisen van vaccinatiebewijzen door ondernemers en andere organisaties

An MP asked the health minister whether private businesses demanding vaccination certificates for entry amounts to vaccination pressure, whether this is lawful and consistent with fundamental rights, and whether the government's goals and inclusion of the unvaccinated are still sound. The minister answered that vaccination is voluntary, that private parties may not request vaccination certificates under the temporary Covid access-pass law, that the rights concerned can be limited proportionately, and that the courts will judge private businesses' justifications case by case.
I refer you to my answer to question 6.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 17.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat enkele Limburgse zorginstellingen niet blijken te zijn verzekerd tegen overstromingsschade

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether it is acceptable that some Limburg care institutions lacked flood insurance, may be paid more slowly if insured via pool consortia, whether displaced residents can return quickly, and whether damage will be compensated via the disaster fund. The minister replied that insurance is the institutions' own responsibility, that the government will generously apply the Wts disaster compensation act because the damage was not reasonably insurable, and that this is a one-off case.
The cabinet wants to assist residents and organisations in Limburg affected by the floods by generously applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet wil de door de overstromingen getroffen inwoners en organisaties in Limburg graag bijstaan door de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) ruimhartig in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat kinderrechters alarm slaan vanwege de groeiende wachtlijsten

An MP asked the minister about reports that children's judges sound the alarm over growing waiting lists in youth care, and whether children at risk are being left without protection. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, cited inspection findings that 67% of children under a measure received timely suitable help, and committed to intervention and supervision in several regions.
The Minister for Legal Protection and I take the inspectorates' signal very seriously and intend to take steps in the regions concerned within the framework of inter-administrative supervision.

De Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en ik nemen het signaal van de inspecties zeer serieus en zijn voornemens in de desbetreffende regio's stappen te zetten in het kader van het interbestuurlijk toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over afschalen van bron- en contact onderzoek bij GGD GHOR

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about scaling down contact tracing (BCO) capacity at GGD GHOR amid reports of job cuts at regional services and staffing agencies. The minister said capacity will be kept for now given new variants, that GGDs must be able to perform 4,400 regular BCOs per day, and that staffing-agency contracts will be reduced from 1 July and 1 August 2021, while declining to give exact per-GGD staffing figures before 1 May.
No instruction has been given to scale down.
Er is geen opdracht gegeven om af te schalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over valse toegangsbewijzen met de app CoronaCheck

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a data breach at test provider Testcoronanu, which let people obtain fake CoronaCheck access certificates, was serious and whether such leaks could be ruled out. The minister acknowledged a serious security flaw, said access for that provider was cut and no other leaks were found, and committed to a further investigation and tighter accession conditions if warranted.
The Ministry of Health is starting a further investigation into the accuracy of the evidence documents submitted by Testcoronanu BV.
Het Ministerie van VWS start een nader onderzoek naar de juistheid van de aangeleverde bewijsstukken door Testcoronanu BV.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Aukje de Vries over het incident Testcoronanu BV en de ernstige tekortkoming in de informatiebeveiliging

MPs Rajkowski and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers about the Testcoronanu BV data breach, affected travellers, the audit of the provider's security and the vetting of test providers before connection to CoronaCheck. Minister De Jonge answered that 17,638 people had appointments, that the provider is investigating whether others accessed the database, and that the ministry checks pentest reports before connection, but declined to share the providers' DPIAs and pentest reports.
However, I cannot commit to also sharing with your House the DPIAs and pentest reports submitted by the test provider.
Ik kan echter niet toezeggen dat ook de door de testaanbieder aangeleverde DPIA’s en pentestrapportages met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ventileren overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked the government about ventilation in government buildings and schools, citing calls to air homes and school ventilation survey results showing only 38% compliance. The minister answered that most of the ~1,000 state buildings meet ventilation norms, outlined remedial measures, and described SUViS funding and ongoing work on a parliamentary motion for schools.
For the other (semi-)government buildings, the information is not centrally maintained.
Voor de overige (semi-) overheidsgebouwen wordt de informatie niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over testaanbieders die alsnog geld vragen voor een reizigerstest of te laat een uitslag doorgeven

An MP asked the government about private COVID test providers charging for travel tests or delivering results late, and about contractual deadlines, customer service and enforcement. The minister answered that contracts require results within 24 hours for PCR and 3 hours for antigen tests, that enforcement occurs via complaints and possible non-payment, and that a standard contract will be provided.
Test providers that do not deliver the test result on time or at all must offer an appropriate solution to the traveller concerned.
Indien testaanbieders de testuitslag, niet op tijd of niet leveren moeten zij een passende oplossing bieden aan de betreffende reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel: ‘Krimpen voert inkomenstoets Wmo in’

MP Tellegen asked the Minister of Health whether the municipality of Krimpen aan den IJssel's income test for domestic help under the Wmo, and similar moves by Leusden, are lawful and whether the minister will intervene. The minister says these municipal measures conflict with the Wmo 2015, that income policy is a national responsibility, and that he has demanded compliance by 15 October and will consider escalation under interbestuurlijk toezicht.
In my role as system manager I am obliged to hold municipalities to account when they continue their policy and do not keep within the frameworks of the Wmo 2015.
Vanuit mijn rol als systeemverantwoordelijke ben ik genoodzaakt om gemeenten hierop aan te spreken, wanneer zij hun beleid doorzetten en zich niet aan de kaders van de Wmo 2015 houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vaccinatiedrang, het vaccineren van jongeren en het ‘trolleyprobleem’

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about pressure to vaccinate youth, claims that unvaccinated teens become second-class citizens, reported myocarditis risks from mRNA vaccines, long-term auto-immune risks, and the ethics of exposing minors to risk for others. The Minister answered that vaccination is voluntary for young people, that the Health Council advised vaccinating those aged 12 and over for their own health benefit, and that the government will avoid restricting choice while monitoring side effects through Lareb and the CBG.
vaccination against COVID-19 is voluntary for everyone, including young people
vaccinatie tegen COVID-19 voor iedereen vrijwillig is, dus ook voor jongeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Paternotte over het gele boekje en de berichtgeving hierover op www.minvws.nl

MPs Kuiken and Paternotte asked the health minister about the legal status of the yellow vaccination booklet for international travel, its recognition abroad, and whether it can be used for COVID-19 vaccination proof. The minister answered that the booklet has official status only for yellow fever under the IHR, that other vaccination records are not governed by IHR standards, and that the EU digital certificate (DCC) with a paper version is the official COVID-19 proof, while acknowledging a late reply.
The yellow booklet has no official status for other vaccinations, in accordance with the International Health Regulations (IHR) (incl. Annex 6 and 7).
Het gele boekje heeft voor andere vaccinaties, conform de regelgeving van de International Health Regulations (IHR) (o.a. Annex 6 en 7) geen officiële status.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Neem ons verhaal serieus, scheep ons niet zomaar af’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper report on relatives of a woman who died after COVID-19 vaccination, who felt dismissed, and about rights to request autopsies, reporting to Lareb and registration of post-vaccination deaths. The minister answered that autopsy requires consent and cannot be enforced, that reporting duties apply to clinicians when a link is suspected, and that Lareb assesses cases with limited information.
It is not always possible to establish the cause of death.
Het niet altijd mogelijk om te achterhalen wat de oorzaak is van overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het overlijden van een 28-jarige vrouw door het dodelijke poeder van de Coöperatie Laatste Wil

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health and justice ministers about the death of a 28-year-old woman who took a lethal powder recommended by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about the cooperative's activities, data on deaths, criminal liability and possible prohibition. The minister answered that a criminal investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, that the NVIC data are only partially shared on advice, and that existing chemical-sale measures and a 2019 monitoring code remain in place, while noting that providing mere general information is not necessarily punishable.
Regarding this criminal investigation, I cannot make any further statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel 'De 28-jarige Marjolein had spijt van de Laatste-Wil-pil. Justitie doet nu onderzoek naar haar zaak'

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about a case in which a 28-year-old woman who regretted using a lethal substance supplied by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil died, and about related court cases, mental health care, information access and contacts with the cooperative. The minister answered that a civil case against the state is pending with no date set, that a criminal investigation has been opened and cannot be discussed, that mental health policy is under review pending a new cabinet, and that the ministry has withheld the substance's name and declined a request for a test-garden arrangement.
However, regarding the criminal investigation started by the public prosecutor of the The Hague parquet, I cannot make any further statements because of the importance of the investigation.
Over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat door de officier van justitie van het parket Den Haag is gestart kan ik echter vanwege het belang van het onderzoek verder geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over overgebleven AstraZeneca-vaccins

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister how many leftover AstraZeneca vaccines would expire, whether they could be donated abroad, and why waste was occurring. The minister answered that expected leftovers are well below 200,000, that donations go mainly via COVAX with limited bilateral donations, and that repacked or opened stock cannot be donated under EU pharmaceutical rules.
It is currently difficult to estimate exactly how many AstraZeneca vaccines will be left over.
Het is op dit moment moeilijk in te schatten wat er precies overblijft aan AstraZeneca-vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de VS achter het voorstel staat om de patenten van de coronavaccins vrij te geven

MPs Hijink and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government supports the US position backing a waiver of COVID-19 vaccine patents, the EU's role as a blocker in the WTO, and whether Netherlands will back patent suspension. The minister answered that the government supports broad vaccine access, will press the European Commission to engage constructively in the WTO, but does not endorse the India/South Africa waiver as proposed and rejects several premises of the questions.

In line with the Piri et al. motion (Kamerstuk 35 663, no. 21), the cabinet will urge the European Commission to engage constructively within the WTO on proposals for temporary suspension of patents on COVID-19 vaccines.

In lijn met de motie Piri c.s. (Kamerstuk 35 663, nr. 21 ) zal het kabinet er bij de Europese Commissie op aandringen dat de EU constructief engageert binnen de WTO wat betreft voorstellen tot tijdelijke opschorting van patenten op coronavaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Bisschop over invoer van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara via Marokko naar de EU

MPs Segers and Bisschop asked why the Israel Producten Centrum was fined for labelling wine from the West Bank, whether such fines have occurred before, which occupied territories the rules apply to, and about export data for Western Sahara products imported via Morocco. The government answered that the labelling was misleading under EU food information rules, that the rules apply regardless of territory, that no overview of occupied areas exists, and provided tables of Moroccan export data, while stating that the NVWA's enforcement must remain objective.
It occurs very infrequently that a company is fined for an incorrect description of a product's origin.
Het komt zeer incidenteel voor dat een bedrijf wordt beboet voor een verkeerde omschrijving van de herkomst van een product.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Alarmerende situatie: Braziliaanse virusvariant drie keer dodelijker voor twintigers'

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that the Brazilian (P.1/Manaus) coronavirus variant is more contagious and about three times deadlier for people in their twenties, asking about its spread in the Netherlands, travel restrictions and vaccination strategy. The minister answered that causality is not yet proven, the variant's share in the Netherlands is falling, travel measures follow EU risk assessments, and no change to the vaccination campaign is needed for now.
The share of this variant is now declining in the Netherlands.
Het aandeel van deze variant daalt inmiddels in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over besluiten die mede oorzaak zijn van het hoge aantal besmettingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about COVID-19 measures that contributed to high infection numbers, including BCO staffing, the 24/40-hour validity of tests, post-vaccination waiting periods, and the handling of the Delta variant. The minister answered that BCO capacity was reduced in the low-infection period, that the government deviated from OMT advice in places, that it published Catshuis documents for 9 July, and that a further Intra Action Review would await ongoing evaluations.
I have chosen that, after completion of vaccinations from 10 July for all vaccine types, the corresponding corona access certificates only become valid after 14 days.
Ik heb er voor gekozen om na afronding van vaccinaties vanaf 10 juli jl, voor alle type vaccins, de bijbehorende coronatoegangsbewijzen pas na 14 dagen geldig te laten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Gehandicaptenzorg in gevaar door tekort aan testcapaciteit'

Mr Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that disability care is endangered by a shortage of COVID-19 test capacity, including five-day waits for care workers' results, travel to distant test sites, and priority testing for care providers. The minister referred to a letter on temporary changes to the COVID-19 testing policy as the answer.

The written questions from Mr Hijink (SP) to the Minister of Health about the report 'Disability care endangered by shortage of test capacity' were answered by way of the letter 'Temporary adjustment of COVID-19 testing policy'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Hijink (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Gehandicaptenzorg in gevaar door tekort aan testcapaciteit» ( 2020Z16043 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief «Tijdelijke aanpassing testbeleid covid-19» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met prioriteit voor zorgverleners bij testen

MP Hijink (SP) asked the health minister whether healthcare workers who are refused a priority COVID-19 test slot cannot book a regular slot through the same number, how often this happens, whether such bureaucracy will be addressed, whether mental health and youth care workers are excluded from priority testing, and what other problems with priority testing are known. The minister answered by referring to the letter 'Stand van zaken brief COVID-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 656) rather than answering the questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bron- en contactonderzoek van de GGD

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health whether GGD contact tracing for positive COVID-19 cases is voluntary and whether staff are told this only when asked. The Minister confirmed contact tracing is voluntary, said the GGD work instructions do not require informing people only upon request, and promised to further publicise the voluntary nature on the government website.
Participation in contact tracing is voluntary. I will again bring this to attention on www.rijksoverheid.nl.
Deelname aan het bron- en contactonderzoek is vrijwillig. Dat zal ik op www.rijksoverheid.nl nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over vaccinatiebeleid van Nederlanders in het buitenland

MP Paternotte asked whether Dutch nationals living outside the EU without a BRP registration can be vaccinated in the Netherlands, what options exist where vaccines are unavailable, how other EU states handle this, and what happens to second doses. Minister De Jonge answered that since 18 June 2021 Dutch nationals with a passport and BSN can be vaccinated in the Netherlands without a one-month stay, that vaccine supply is limited so donations via COVAX are the primary route, and that other member states' rules are for them to decide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Neef en Ouwehand over het manifest toegankelijke festivals dat op 8 juni jl. is gelanceerd

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, VVD and PvdD asked ministers whether festivals should be more accessible for people with disabilities under the UN convention, why many are not, and whether the government will engage with the sector and international examples. The minister answered that the Onbeperkt Meedoen programme addresses accessibility, that gemeenten can set accessibility conditions in event permits, and that the government will raise the manifesto with VNG and VNO-NCW but gave no concrete new measures.
I will put this manifesto and the accessibility of festivals and events on the agenda in the talks I hold with the VNG and VNO-NCW.
Ik zal dit manifest en de toegankelijkheid van festivals en evenementen agenderen tijdens de gesprekken die ik voer met de VNG en VNO-NCW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het coronavirus

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health and education ministers about COVID-19 school self-test uptake, the end of the school self-test ordering scheme, vaccination of homeless people, serological tests for certificates, and the origin of the virus. The government answered that test uptake data is still incomplete, the ordering scheme was under review, vaccination of vulnerable groups is underway, and it would not use serological tests for the certificate, while not fully answering the virus-origin question and missing the deadline.
Answer 8: No, unfortunately, due to the diversity of topics affecting two ministries, it has not proven feasible to answer the questions by 1 July 2021.
Antwoord 8 Nee, helaas is het vanwege de diversiteit aan onderwerpen die twee ministeries raken niet haalbaar gebleken om de vragen voor 1 juli 2021 te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de luchtspiegeling van een luchtbrug

The MP asks whether the minister knows that the KLM air bridge Van Lienden cited as part of his mask deals was a false claim, and why the government kept that claim in place knowing the air bridge was reserved for the government. The minister confirms awareness of the article and says how the ministry assessed the KLM claim is part of an ongoing forensic audit by Deloitte, referring to an earlier letter.

How the Ministry of VWS assessed and handled the claim that KLM was involved as a partner in Van Lienden's alliance is part of the investigation being carried out by forensic accountant Deloitte into this case.

Hoe het Ministerie van VWS de claim dat de KLM als partner betrokken was bij de alliantie van Van Lienden en partners heeft beoordeeld en behandeld is deel van het onderzoek dat de forensisch accountant Deloitte uitvoert naar deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de ICcapaciteit

An MP asked the Minister of Health how much IC capacity was added since January 2020, how many beds may be needed in future, and why no large pandemic centres or emergency IC nurse training were set up. The minister answered that IC capacity rose to 1,700 beds (1,550 used at peak), that future bed needs are still being considered, and that separate COVID-only centres were rejected by hospitals as unworkable.
Decision-making on this is up to the new cabinet.
Besluitvorming hierover is aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over onrecht in de jeugdbeschermingsketen en een verborgen gehouden onderzoek van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked about alleged injustice in the youth protection chain and an unpublished ministry review on a father's case. The Minister answers that complaint and appeal routes exist, the action plan on fact-finding continues, and the department did not share the review because the problem was already being addressed and it cannot judge individual cases.

Given the nature of the review and because it showed the problem was already known and being addressed, there was no reason to inform me about the review and therefore also not to share it with your House.

Gezien de aard van de verkenning en doordat uit de verkenning bleek dat de problematiek reeds bekend was en werd opgepakt, is geen aanleiding gezien om mij te informeren over de verkenning en daardoor ook niet om de verkenning met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving rondom de Fauci-mails

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports from released Fauci emails suggesting early consideration of a Wuhan lab leak, the role of Dutch virologist Marion Koopmans, and whether her work on OMT and the Health Council should be suspended. The minister said the lab-leak hypothesis was a legitimate scientific question, that publication of the emails and related advice constitutes transparency, and that he sees no reason to suspend Koopmans.
I see no reason whatsoever for what you request, and I would like to take this opportunity to express my explicit support for Professor Koopmans and other scientists.
Ik zie geen enkele aanleiding voor het door u gevraagde en ik wil graag van de gelegenheid gebruik maken om mijn expliciete steun uit te spreken voor professor Koopmans en andere wetenschappers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kuiken over het artikel ‘Ikke prikken – en de rest kan stikken'

MPs Westerveld and Kuiken asked the health minister about a report on the vaccination rollout, including why the most vulnerable were not invited first and why medical-risk invitations were delayed. The minister defended the prioritisation as based on Gezondheidsraad and OMT advice and scarce supply, and said the strategy and sequencing were discussed in parliament.
Because of the limited available quantity of vaccines, the cabinet had to make choices in the order in which people could be vaccinated.
Vanwege de beperkte beschikbare hoeveelheid vaccins heeft het kabinet keuzes moeten maken in de volgorde waarin mensen gevaccineerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Houwelingen en Van Haga over de succesvolle toepassing van Ivermectine, het mogelijk beperkte effect van vaccineren en de prijs van uitgestelde zorg

MPs asked the minister about reported success of ivermectin for COVID-19, why GPs do not prescribe it, customs seizures, the threatened fine for off-label prescribing, trends in ICU admissions and deaths, and years of life lost from postponed non-COVID care. The minister answered that studies are for professional bodies to assess, that customs seizures follow the lack of licence, that fines follow the off-label rules, and that a reliable estimate of lost life-years is not possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over sneltestpilots in het PO en VO

An MP asked the Ministers of Health and Education about rapid antigen test pilots in primary and secondary schools, including test sensitivity, expected false positives and negatives, and safeguards. The government answered that the pilots ran until April, were then discontinued on expert advice in favour of self-tests, and that false negatives are addressed by repeat testing.
The research outcomes are expected in June and will be sent to your House.
De onderzoeksuitkomsten worden in juni verwacht en zullen aan uw Kamer worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de zogenoemde mondkapjesdeal

MPs Kuiken, Paternotte and Bikker asked the Minister about the face-mask deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including stock levels, objections raised by the LCH, alternative suppliers, contacts between ministers and RGA, and advance payments. The Minister answered mostly by pointing to a forthcoming Deloitte review, shared some documents, withheld details of the other large contracts pending receipt, and committed to passing many questions to the researchers.
I will ask the research bureau to include this question in the supplementary investigation and also to address the reason why protest was lodged where this happened.
Ik zal het onderzoeksbureau vragen om deze vraag mee te nemen in het aanvullende onderzoek en dan ook in te gaan op de reden waarom er protest werd aangetekend indien dit gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over fraude met coronaverklaringen

An MP asked the health and justice ministers about fraud with forged COVID test certificates and how it is being tackled, including whether sites offering them can be taken offline and whether certification is needed. The minister acknowledged the fraud risk, said the IGJ supervises testing providers and that the Public Prosecution Service would assess concrete signals, and pointed to the EU Digital COVID Certificate as the main fix.

Fraud with test certificates is in a sense easy as long as a test result is a document without fixed form and it is not feasible for countries to verify the authenticity of a test certificate from another country.

Fraude met testverklaringen is in zekere zin eenvoudig zolang een testuitslag een vormvrij document is en het niet goed mogelijk is voor landen om de authenticiteit van een testbewijs uit een ander land vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het dragen van mondkapjes en de mondkapjesverplichting

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about harms of face masks, the litter they create, possible unintended behavioural effects, and why the mask obligation was introduced despite earlier advice against it. The minister replied that masks contribute together with other measures, that the obligation was chosen for clarity and enforceability, and that no further research on side effects is planned, though mask use is being phased back.
I see no reason for further research into side effects and/or the dangers of bacterial growth on face masks after prolonged use.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar neveneffecten en/of de gevaren van bacteriële groei op mondkapjes na langdurig gebruik.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Paternotte en Kuiken over het besluit het AstraZeneca-vaccin alleen in te zetten bij 60-plussers

MPs Paternotte and Kuiken asked why the government restricted AstraZeneca vaccination to people aged 60 and over, given the Health Council's risk comparison and EMA's benefit-risk conclusion, and asked about related rollout, risk and supply questions. Minister De Jonge answered at length, defending the age limit with mortality risk figures, stating that alternative vaccines were arranged for under-60s, and describing vaccine supply and donation plans.
After advice from the Health Council, the cabinet decided to use the AstraZeneca vaccine only for people aged 60 and over.
heb aangegeven heeft het kabinet na advies van de Gezondheidsraad besloten het AstraZeneca-vaccin enkel te gebruiken bij mensen van 60 jaar en ouder.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuiken over de werking van vaccinatie tegen COVID-19 bij patiënten die worden behandeld vanwege een auto-immuunziekte

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether vaccine effectiveness against COVID-19 in immunocompromised patients is adequately studied, whether drug package inserts and vaccination guidance are sufficient, and what protection will be given to these patients and unvaccinated people. The minister answered that studies via ZonMw are ongoing, that existing guidelines already address reduced vaccine response, that a booster question is under advice, and that he will keep monitoring and inform clinicians and patients, without committing to new binding measures like mask mandates or entry tests.
There are patient groups where there is a suspicion that the COVID-19 vaccination will have insufficient effect.
Er zijn patiëntgroepen waarbij het vermoeden bestaat dat de vaccinatie tegen COVID-19 onvoldoende effect zal hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over ernstig dementerenden die gedwongen moeten vertrekken uit een kleinschalige woonvorm

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked the Minister of Health why residents with severe dementia must leave a small-scale care home (Het Kristal, Apeldoorn) because the operator says it is loss-making, and whether the ministry will intervene. The minister replied that closure is primarily the responsibility of the care provider and the care office, that the Inspectorate has no concerns about quality, that the ministry has contacted both parties and asked to be kept informed, and that group sizes of 8 are better suited to small-scale dementia care.
At this moment it is up to the care provider and the care office to reach acceptable solutions for the clients.
Het is op dit moment aan de zorgaanbieder en het zorgkantoor om tot acceptabele oplossingen voor de cliënten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen door de coronapandemie

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the government how socioeconomic health inequalities have grown due to the coronavirus pandemic, and how communication about vaccination and measures reaches people who are digitally or functionally illiterate, and how many communication staff the government employs. The minister answered that research on the widening gap is ongoing with results expected by year-end, cited existing data and studies, listed communication staff numbers (811.5 fte at department communication directorates, 15 fte on the vaccination communication team), and described outreach tools for low-literacy and digitally less skilled groups.
It is expected that in the coming months it will become clearer what the consequences of the pandemic are for socioeconomic health inequalities in the Netherlands.
Naar verwachting zal de komende maanden meer duidelijk worden wat de gevolgen zijn van de pandemie voor de sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Paternotte en Van der Werf over het incident bij de corona-vaccinatielocatie Amsterdam

Four MPs asked the health and justice ministers about reported harassment of people queuing for COVID vaccination at a vaccination site in Amsterdam during a demonstration march, asking about police response, arrests, GGD instructions, reporting, and safety guarantees. The minister answered that police found no confirmed intimidation, no complaints or reports were registered, police urged victims to file complaints, and vaccination site safety is a decentralised responsibility under existing protocols and support networks.
The police are aware of a social media report that people were harassed. The police were visibly present but could not confirm this.
De politie is op de hoogte van een bericht op social media dat mensen zijn lastiggevallen. De politie was zichtbaar aanwezig, maar heeft dit niet kunnen constateren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Hijink en Leijten over het afschuiven van uitbetalingen bij letselschade door verzekeraars aan gemeenten

MPs Van Nispen, Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked about insurers redirecting injury-claim victims to municipalities for costs insurers should bear, and about slow payouts and municipal recovery of costs. The minister answered that insurers may not require victims to first go to the municipality, that victims may choose, that no fixed settlement term exists, and that municipalities are responsible for recovering costs, with no direct national role beyond pointing to a convenant option.
An insurer of the liable party may not require a victim to first approach the municipality to claim support under the Social Support Act 2015.

Een verzekeraar van de aansprakelijke partij mag niet van een slachtoffer verlangen dat hij zich eerst tot de gemeente wendt voor een beroep op ondersteuning via de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de CoronaCheck-app en ‘testen voor toegang’

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about the CoronaCheck app, whether paper certificates would remain available, DigiD requirements, the cost of 'testing for access', and whether the RIVM should advise on it. The Minister said paper proofs remain available, DigiD is needed only for GGD and vaccination data, costs are justified by faster reopening, and the OMT has already advised repeatedly on the policy.
The cabinet has not calculated what the costs per life-year gained would be.
Het kabinet heeft hierbij niet berekend wat de kosten per gewonnen levensjaar zouden zijn.
