Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het feit dat de Stichting Open Nederland geen testlocaties heeft in de provincies Flevoland, Groningen en Zeeland

MP Kwint asked why there are no access-testing sites for Stichting Open Nederland in Flevoland, Groningen and Zeeland, and why existing sites were not taken over, and whether the GGD should have run testing instead. The minister says sites exist in those provinces, that national coverage under 20 minutes' drive is being pursued as capacity scales up, and that the GGD should not be burdened with access testing.
That is why we are working towards national coverage with a car travel time of under 20 minutes one way.
Daarom werken we toe naar een landelijke dekking van een reistijd met de auto onder de 20 minuten enkele reis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de rechtvaardiging van de vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen ter bestrijding van het coronavirus

An MP asks the Health Minister for the criteria used to classify infectious diseases under the Public Health Act, why COVID-19 was placed in category A, whether the OMT advice will be published, and under what conditions it would leave category A. The minister explains the classification criteria, points to the public OMT advice and Kamerstukken, and says downgrading is not yet possible given uncertain developments and new variants.
This OMT advice was sent to the House of Representatives and is therefore publicly available.
Dit OMT-advies is gestuurd aan de Tweede Kamer en daarmee openbaar te raadplegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat inwoners rond Tata Steel IJmuiden vaker ziek zijn

An MP asked the government about reports that residents near Tata Steel IJmuiden are sicker, covering medical support, a possible compensation fund, short-term protection, RIVM follow-up research, emission monitoring, cumulative exposure and the province's enforcement. The state secretary answered that the province of North Holland is the competent authority for permits and enforcement, that the Rijk advises but cannot order a production stop, and that the ILT is monitoring the province's follow-up on the Randstedelijke Rekenkamer recommendations.
The provincial executive of North Holland is the competent authority here. The national government does not have the power to impose a production stop on Tata Steel.
Gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Noord-Holland zijn hier bevoegd gezag. Het Rijk heeft niet de bevoegdheid om een productiestop aan Tata Steel op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ziek worden door luchtvervuiling

An MP asked the ministers whether the government will act on children's health harm from air pollution, including around Tata Steel in IJmuiden, and on oversight and enforcement of industrial emissions. The state secretary answered that the Clean Air Accord targets 50% health gain by 2030, that monitoring and enforcement lie largely with the province and environmental services, and that a plan on the VTH enforcement advisory report will follow from the next cabinet.
It is up to the competent authorities and environmental services to ensure, in their permitting, that emissions remain within the norms
Het is aan de bevoegde gezagen en omgevingsdiensten om in hun vergunningverlening er op toe te zien dat uitstoot binnen de normen blijft
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over de oproep uit Suriname om hulp te bieden met vaccineren

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about Suriname's request for vaccination help amid a COVID-19 surge and the Indian export ban. The minister answered that Nederland has responded with oxygen containers, medical supplies, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses and a planned 500,000 to 750,000 doses, sent a special envoy, and donated EUR 70 million to COVAX.
The Netherlands has also committed that from week 25, provided supplies allow, vaccines will be delivered to Suriname.
Nederland heeft tevens toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over het aanbod van het Diaspora Medisch Team Nederland om steun aan het vaccinatieprogramma in Suriname te faciliteren

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about the Diaspora Medical Team's offer to support Suriname's vaccination programme, whether the minister had contacted Suriname's health minister, and whether vaccines would be supplied. The minister replied that talks with Suriname's health minister had taken place, that 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were sent with further deliveries promised from week 25, and that a coordinator was deployed to match Surinamese needs with Dutch medical staff offers.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has committed that from week 25, provided deliveries allow it, vaccines will be supplied to Suriname.
Verder heeft Nederland toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bikker en Pouw-Verweij over sterke toename van het aantal gevallen van euthanasie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bikker and Pouw-Verweij asked whether the sharp rise in euthanasia notifications in 2020 is worrying, whether the RTE commissions' ethical review is weak, whether video consultations and the RTE's narrowed 'questions-raising' selection undermine safeguards, and whether isolation in care homes is driving requests. The minister answered that the rise tracks the overall increase in deaths, that COVID-19 played only a minor direct role, that deviation from in-person consultations is allowed under the KNMG/ministry COVID arrangements, that no signals of rising euthanasia wishes in Dutch care homes were found, and that an evaluation will examine physician attitudes.
I see no reason for further investigation into the increase in the absolute number of euthanasia notifications to the RTE in 2020.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar de stijging van het absolute aantal euthanasiemeldingen bij de RTE in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het vaccinatieregister en (indirecte) vaccinatiedrang in de zorg

An MP from FvD asked the health minister whether the RIVM vaccination register holds data only with explicit consent, whether employers may require or pressure staff to be vaccinated, and whether care institutions may force unvaccinated staff to wear masks. The minister answered that data is registered only with consent, that vaccination is voluntary and employers may not require or pressure it, and that unvaccinated staff must wear masks like vaccinated staff in high-risk settings.
Yes, the RIVM only registers personal data if the person concerned has given consent for this.
Ja, het RIVM registreert alleen persoonsgegevens als daar toestemming voor is gegeven door de betrokken persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland en China twijfel zaaien over Europese vaccins

MPs Paternotte and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia and China are spreading doubt about European vaccines, whether the government will push back against such disinformation in the EU and bilaterally, and about the quality and regulatory status of Sinopharm, Sinovac and Sputnik V vaccines. The minister acknowledges the disinformation is condemnable but judges its impact small, describes EU and Dutch counter-disinformation efforts and the Chinese and Russian contacts, and says Sputnik V's EMA review is still ongoing with no date for a formal application.

At the same time, the cabinet has confidence in the pluriform Dutch and European media landscape, in which the free press assesses this kind of reporting on its merits and the impact of this kind of disinformation is so far small.

Tegelijkertijd heeft het kabinet vertrouwen in het pluriforme Nederlandse en Europese medialandschap, waarin de vrije pers dit soort berichtgeving op z’n merites beoordeelt en de impact van dit soort desinformatie vooralsnog klein is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over misstanden bij een evangelische leef- en woongemeenschap in Overijssel

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked the minister to respond to alleged abuses at an evangelical living community in Balkbrug, including poor care, misuse of care funds and inadequate housing, and why authorities acted late and what investigations found. The minister reports that the Wmo supervisor found mostly non-compliance with quality rules, with a deadline of 1 July 2021, that building inspection found the building met code, and that a preliminary administrative inquiry found no urgent facts; the IGJ is not currently investigating, and the community is not obliged to publish annual figures because it is funded by personal budgets.
Given a few findings where possible unlawfulness must be examined further, the supervisor advises commissioning a (more in-depth) Wmo lawfulness investigation.

Gelet op een paar bevindingen waarbij eventuele onrechtmatigheid nader onderzocht moet worden, adviseert de toezichthouder om een opdracht te verstrekken voor een (meer verdiepend) rechtmatigheidsonderzoek Wmo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het gebruik van Ivermectine bij de behandeling van COVID-19

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health whether ivermectin should be used off-label for COVID-19 patients, citing studies and foreign protocols, and whether doctors could be allowed to prescribe it despite a fine. The Minister replied that evaluating the studies is for medical specialists, that off-label use outside research is currently not permitted given the lack of evidence and the NHG, SWAB and EMA advice against it, and that the decision lies with the treating doctor within legal limits.
No, this is not permitted unless there is a clinical study.
Nee, dit is niet toegestaan tenzij er sprake is van een klinische studie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over een coronatoegangsbewijs voor Nederlanders die in het buitenland gevaccineerd worden

An MP asked the health minister about COVID vaccination certificates for Dutch nationals vaccinated abroad, including registration in the CIMS system and eligibility for the EU digital certificate. The minister gave partial answers, saying registration is still being explored and that EU-approved foreign vaccinations will be facilitated once residents can request a Dutch certificate, with more information to follow later.
I will inform your House when more is clear.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier over wanneer meer duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Houwelingen over het 'Jaarverslag VWS'

An FvD MP asked the health minister, medical care minister and state secretary about the 2020 VWS annual report: requests for Auditdienst Rijk audits, vaccine pricing under the Emergency Support Initiative, escalation procedures, a pending external accountant review of stocks, WNT pay-norm exceedances, correspondence with a public health foundation, and irregularities records. The answer is a cover letter referring the questions to a separate letter and attached report, without answering the questions in the text provided.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over signalen dat er nog steeds geen zelftesten beschikbaar zijn op scholen

An SP MP asked the health and education ministers whether schools still lacked COVID self-test kits for teachers and pupils, how distribution was progressing, and where schools could report shortages. The minister replied that rollout to secondary and primary schools was largely complete, with about 300 primary schools receiving top-up deliveries, a helpdesk and online ordering module in place, and secondary schools supplied ahead of reopening.
However, about 300 primary schools reported that they had received too few tests to test all their staff preventively twice a week until the summer holiday.
Wel hebben ongeveer 300 scholen in het primair onderwijs aangegeven te weinig testen te hebben ontvangen om al hun personeel tot aan de zomervakantie twee keer per week preventief te laten testen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Farmaceut Roche vult zijn zakken met zelftesten, met hulp van minister De Jonge'

An MP asked why the ministry ordered 46.5 million self-tests from Roche without a tender, why Roche received an exemption faster than other manufacturers, and why Roche was prioritised. The minister acknowledged the non-tendered procurement was unlawful (onrechtmatig), explained the urgency and the split across five suppliers, and said the exemption process favours firms already far along with notified bodies, without fully explaining the speed of Roche's approval.
I previously informed your House about this unlawful procurement.
Ik heb uw Kamer eerder over deze onrechtmatige inkoop geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het artikel 'Afgewezen zorgaanbieders glippen weer binnen via de achterdeur'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a news report that care providers rejected by municipalities and prosecution services return via the Wlz or PGB route, and about fraud-related data-sharing limits. The Minister answered that existing tools suffice in principle, that a bill on data-sharing against care fraud is pending and controversial, that Wlz indications are set independently by the CIZ, and that data-sharing grounds in the Wlz may need amendment.
There is no registration system for care providers that no longer receive a contract from a municipality and subsequently seek to place clients under the Wlz.
Er is geen registratiesysteem voor zorgaanbieders die geen contract (meer) krijgen bij een gemeente en vervolgens cliënten onder willen brengen bij de Wlz.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders over het bericht dat een farmaceut zijn zakken vult met de hulp van minister De Jonge

MPs Agema and Wilders asked the Health Minister about a report that pharmaceutical firm Roche profited from ministry help with COVID self-test procurement, including the lack of tendering for a 46.5 million euro order and the choice of tests. The minister denied Roche gained an unfair head start, explained the exemption procedure and the urgent direct orders, and acknowledged two procurement irregularities that were reported to parliament.
I have informed you of the irregularities in the procurement.
Van onrechtmatigheden bij de inkoop heb ik u op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hagen over het bericht dat Duitsland reisbeperkingen instelt voor het Verenigd Koninkrijk vanwege de opmars van de Indiase virusvariant B.1617

MPs Paternotte and Hagen asked about Germany's travel restrictions on the UK over the Indian B.1617 variant, the adequacy of contact tracing and genomic surveillance, and whether further measures are needed. Minister De Jonge replied that the RIVM advises no additional measures now, that surveillance meets ECDC norms with about 1500 sequences weekly, and that the RIVM will keep monitoring.

At my request, the RIVM will continue to closely monitor the situation and will advise me, both on request and unsolicited, if additional measures for travellers from the UK turn out to be needed at a later time.

Op mijn verzoek blijft het RIVM de situatie nauwgezet monitoren, waarbij zij mij gevraagd en ongevraagd zal adviseren indien aanvullende maatregelen voor reizigers uit het VK op een later moment alsnog nodig blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Geen Q-koortsvergoeding voor een op de vijf slachtoffers'

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked about roughly 600 rejected Q-fever compensation applications (about 20%) and whether applicants were wrongly excluded. The minister replied that rejected applicants did not meet the eligibility criteria, that the scheme was broadened after consultation with parliament, and that appeal procedures and an independent medical commission already reviewed the refusals.
For the rejected applications, objection and appeal procedures were available.
Voor de afgewezen aanvragen heeft er bezwaar en beroep opengestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de onzekere toekomst van het ziekenhuis in Zutphen

An MP asks the Minister about the uncertain future of the Gelre hospital in Zutphen, including whether emergency care, acute obstetrics and other basic services will be lost and how the proposed scaling-down is justified given the hospital's financial health. The Minister answers that Gelre is still examining its future configuration with stakeholders, that no closure decision has been taken, that the RIVM accessibility analysis would be required before any closure of acute services, and that the broader care landscape is a matter for a future cabinet.
Moreover, if there is a concrete intention to close the Zutphen location, an accessibility analysis must be requested from the RIVM by the hospital.
Overigens geldt als er een concreet voornemen is om de locatie Zutphen te sluiten er een bereikbaarheidsanalyse moeten worden opgevraagd bij het RIVM door het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het aanbieden van een alternatief vaccin voor 60-plussers

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister whether he would offer a non-AstraZeneca vaccine to over-60s who wanted one, after he had promised an answer within two weeks. The minister acknowledged the delay and said the 60-64 group who had not yet been vaccinated could book a mRNA vaccine at a GGD from 5 June, while those already given AstraZeneca would get their second dose from the GP.
Unfortunately I did not manage this within those two weeks, but today I have informed you about an alternative vaccine for over-60s
Helaas is het mij niet binnen die twee weken gelukt, maar heb ik u vandaag geïnformeerd over een alternatief vaccin voor 60-plussers

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Paternotte over de brandbrief van de Ondernemingsraad KDS en het FNV over het stijgend aantal besmettingen in slachthuizen en het niet naleven van de coronamaatregelen

MPs De Groot and Paternotte asked ministers about a works council letter reporting rising COVID-19 infections in slaughterhouses, non-compliance with measures, and weak NVWA oversight. The minister answered that the NVWA and inspectorates use an escalation ladder, including halting inspections, and that the Apeldoorn slaughterhouse was closed temporarily and restarted under conditions, while stating she finds the reported conduct undesirable and commits to continued close monitoring.
I do not recognise that these concerns are widely shared among employees in the food industry.
Ik herken niet dat die zorgen breed gedeeld worden bij medewerkers in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht ‘De geheime coronadeals van Sywert van Lienden’

An MP from JA21 asks the Minister of Health why the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen awarded large face-mask orders to Sywert van Lienden's commercial company Relief Goods Alliance, despite conflict-of-interest concerns, and whether the masks were rejected or unpaid. The Minister denies undue preference, says all leads were assessed on price, quality and delivery, rejects conflict of interest, and states the masks were CE-certified and that an accountant's report will follow.
As soon as the accountant's report is available, I will send it to you.
Zodra het accountantsrapport er is, zal ik u dit doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat criminele zorgaanbieders kwetsbare cliënten inzetten voor drugshandel of gedwongen prostitutie

MP Hijink asked the minister how criminal care providers exploit vulnerable clients for drug work or forced prostitution, how long this has gone on, and what measures will prevent and prosecute it. The minister acknowledges the problem as unacceptable, says representative data are lacking so no new national study is planned, and points to existing and forthcoming instruments (Wtza, Wibz, Wet Bibob, Wbsrz) and enforcement by the Openbaar Ministerie without naming specific providers.
Representative data on this are not available.
Hierover zijn geen representatieve data beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Paternotte over de berichtgeving dat arbeidsmigranten niet allemaal een vaccin krijgen en de maatschappelijke opvang voor ongedocumenteerden wordt afgebouwd

Opposition MPs Paulusma and Paternotte asked why migrant workers and undocumented people not registered in the BRP may not receive vaccination invitations and why emergency shelter is being wound down. Minister De Jonge answered that unregistered groups are being reached via GGD regional plans and outreach, and that the shelter wind-down timing remains appropriate.

The Ministry of VWS asked the GGD regions, together with regional partners such as municipalities, shelter organisations and street doctors, to draw up a regional implementation plan for vaccinating homeless people, people in women's shelters and undocumented people.

Het Ministerie van VWS heeft GGD-en verzocht – in samenwerking met regionale partners zoals gemeenten, opvanginstellingen en straatdokters – een regionaal uitvoeringsplan te maken voor de vaccinatie van dakloze mensen, mensen die verblijven in de vrouwenopvang en ongedocumenteerde mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht dat Duitsland Nederlandstalige vaccinatiebewijzen niet accepteert

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the health minister whether Germany's refusal to accept Dutch-language vaccination certificates is undesirable and whether the government will seek a temporary recognition of Dutch certificates. The minister confirmed the facts, said the choice of languages is for Germany, reported bilateral talks showing the Dutch registration card does not meet German requirements, and said the government will keep pressing Germany and push the EU Digital COVID Certificate forward.
Yes, we will continue to press for this in our contacts with Germany.
Ja, we blijven ons hier in de contacten met Duitsland voor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Paternotte over het bericht 'Europees vaccinatie-certificaat ook goed nieuws voor de eilanden'

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the progress, timing and invention issues for introducing the EU digital green (vaccination) certificate in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, and whether travel between overseas territories and countries would be possible. The state secretary answered that working groups are preparing, the target date of 21 June also applies, residents without a BSN/DigiD face a special route that is being discussed, and travel between territories will be possible.

Currently it is being examined what the technical and legal requirements of the certificate are and whether introducing the digital green certificate is deemed opportune by the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.

Momenteel wordt bekeken wat de technische en juridische vereisten zijn van het certificaat en of het in gebruik nemen van het digitale groen certificaat opportuun wordt geacht door de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Farmaceuten keken niet naar de bij effecten van coronavaccins op vrouwen’

MPs Ellemeet and Westerveld asked whether regulators EMA and CBG examine sex-specific side effects of COVID-19 vaccines, whether halved doses for young women are being studied, and whether interaction effects and raw trial data should be required. The minister answered that sex was recorded and subgroup analyses were done, that a sex-specific safety analysis for AstraZeneca was still awaited, that research on the rare side effect is ongoing, and that full clinical reports are already published so no extra requirement is needed.
An additional requirement is not necessary.
Een extra eis is niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat Denemarken stopt met het Janssen-vaccin in hun vaccinatieprogramma

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister how he views Denmark dropping the Janssen vaccine from its programme, what Denmark plans for surplus Janssen and AstraZeneca doses, and what EU rules govern redistributing or exporting surplus vaccines. The minister said the Netherlands will await the new data and EMA advice, that Denmark is still deciding, that EU rules on surplus are still under discussion, and that he would buy surplus doses if offered.
I think it is important to first carefully find out on the basis of what new data Denmark reached this decision.
Ik vind het belangrijk om eerst goed uit te zoeken op basis van welke nieuwe gegevens Denemarken tot dit besluit komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het gebrek aan maatregelen tegen de gezondheidsrisico’s van de geitenhouderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Health Minister why no measures have been taken against the health risks of goat farming near residents, given research since 2011 showing higher pneumonia risk, and questions the delayed follow-up research and the lack of a national production cap on goats. The minister answers that the research is ongoing with completion delayed to 2024 by COVID-19, that provinces (not the national government) control goat-farm moratoria which the cabinet supports, and that national risk-reducing measures await the cause being identified.
The cabinet is having these follow-up studies carried out in order to ultimately be able to take risk-reducing measures.
Het kabinet laat deze vervolgonderzoeken uitvoeren om uiteindelijk risicoreducerende maatregelen te kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen ver vaccinatiedwang en vaccinatiedrang, met name in relatie tot de invoering van de ‘Digital Green Pass’

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked the health minister to define vaccination coercion and pressure, and how a proposed EU Digital Green Pass could create pressure on unvaccinated people through travel restrictions. The minister answered that vaccination must remain a free choice, that the government steers against both coercion and pressure, and that the EU certificate's use is left to member states, with no concrete definition or note promised.
I think it is important that it is and remains a free choice for people to be vaccinated.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat het een vrije keuze is en blijft voor mensen om zich te laten vaccineren.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Vaccinatiebeleid

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister about vaccine transmission, variant effectiveness, long-term side effects and whether vaccinating the whole population is wise, citing a newspaper interview with two doctors. The minister answered that transmission is reduced but not eliminated, vaccines appear effective against current variants, and the Health Council advice on transmission is pending.
I expect the GR to advise me on this in the second half of May.
Ik verwacht dat de GR mij hier in de tweede helft van mei over adviseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Vaccineer zo snel mogelijk ook in armere landen om mutaties te voorkomen'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health and trade ministers about COVAX vaccine targets, a TRIPS waiver, C-TAP technology sharing and EU contract negotiations, and whether the government would act on these. The minister answered that Nigeria-style supply shortfalls are understandable, that the government supports COVAX financially and in kind, is cautious about a TRIPS waiver and C-TAP, and is consulting Belgium and the EU, without firm commitments.
The cabinet will argue within the EU that Europe contributes constructively to this discussion.
Het kabinet zal binnen de EU bepleiten dat Europa constructief aan deze discussie bijdraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Diertens over het delen van genetisch testmateriaal van Nederlanders met de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten

Two MPs from D66 asked the health minister whether negotiations to send Dutch COVID test genetic material to laboratories in the United Arab Emirates complied with GDPR, whether it was anonymised, and whether misuse was a risk. The minister replied that the negotiations had been stopped, that all privacy risks were examined and a limited residual risk remained, and that other, more durable solutions for test capacity had been found.
There was a limited residual risk, and since other, more durable solutions had by then been found to increase test capacity, it was decided to stop the negotiations.

Er was sprake van een beperkt restrisico, en aangezien op dat moment ook al andere, meer duurzame oplossingen waren gevonden om de testcapaciteit te vergroten, is besloten de onderhandelingen stop te zetten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven ver de onderzoeksresultaten van de Stichting Onderzoek Multinationale Ondernemingen (SOMO): “Hoe maken we publiek gefinancierde coronavaccins toegankelijk voor iedereen?”

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether conditions on affordability, access, transparency and licensing should attach to publicly funded COVID-19 research and vaccine purchase deals, referring to a SOMO report. The minister answered that most of the 917 million euro was not research spending, that the joint EU negotiations were purchase contracts rather than R&D funding, that the NFU licensing toolkit offers optional building blocks and no change is planned yet, and that the confidentiality of advance purchase agreements is not shown to undermine public trust.
The cabinet therefore encourages the use of the principles for socially responsible licensing developed by the Dutch Federation of University Medical Centres (NFU) and the toolkit based on them.

Het kabinet moedigt daarom het gebruik aan van de door de Nederlands Federatie van Universitair Medische Centra (NFU) ontwikkelde principes voor maatschappelijk verantwoord licentiëren en de daarop gebaseerde toolkit.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Paternotte, Snels en Westerveld ver de financiële middelen voor toegangstesten

MPs Sneller, Paternotte, Snels and Westerveld asked the Health Minister about the roughly 925 million euro for access testing, its legal basis, the outsourcing to a private foundation, board pay, and whether funds were committed before parliamentary authorisation. The minister answered that spending is phased with go/no-go decisions, that funds were committed before formal authorisation under Comptabiliteitswet article 2.27, and that contract texts were shared with parliament, while offering to seek Auditdienst Rijk advice.
Your House was informed of the funds for phase 0 through the fourth supplementary budget of VWS on 12 March.
Uw Kamer is door middel de vierde incidentele begroting van VWS op 12 maart geïnformeerd over de middelen voor fase 0.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken, Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Bikker en Westerveld over AstraZeneca en een nieuw advies van de Gezondheidsraad

Five MPs asked the Health Minister about EMA and other countries' age-limit decisions for AstraZeneca, vaccination gaps among vulnerable groups, and a RIVM official's remarks about surplus doses. The minister answered that the Health Council was asked urgently to reconsider, that outreach to vulnerable groups is ongoing, and that the remarks were unfortunately worded, but did not answer the final question on submitting answers by 29 April.
I asked the Health Council on 26 April to urgently advise whether the new EMA information leads to a reconsideration of the use of the AstraZeneca vaccine.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 26 april jl., gevraagd met spoed te adviseren of de nieuwe informatie van het EMA tot een heroverweging van de inzet van het AstraZeneca-vaccin leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het artikel 'Afgewezen zorgaanbieders glippen weer binnen via de achterdeur'

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers why DJI contracted and extended Stichting OnderDak after an inspectorate found insufficient oversight, and how information-sharing between care purchasers is restricted. The minister answered that DJI knew of the inspection findings, intensified contract management, and pointed to a pending bill and the inspectorate's oversight limits.
The Public Prosecution Service, in the interest of a possible criminal investigation, does not comment on whether a criminal investigation is being conducted in a specific case.

Het Openbaar Ministerie doet in het belang van een eventueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek geen uitspraak over de vraag of in een specifiek geval al dan niet een strafrechtelijk onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hammelburg over Europese hulp aan het zwaar door het coronavirus getroffen India

MPs Paternotte and Hammelburg asked whether the government would help India during its severe COVID-19 wave with medical supplies, vaccine production support, genome sequencing and lifting US export restrictions. The minister answered that Nederland is sending oxygen concentrators, ventilators and antivirals, funding Red Cross and Global Fund support, and that US export restrictions were lifted on 25 April.
In response, the Netherlands is sending oxygen concentrators, ventilation equipment and antiviral medicines.
In reactie daarop stuurt Nederland zuurstof-concentratoren, beademingsapparatuur en anti-virale middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over een toename van coronabesmettingen in slachthuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about rising COVID-19 infections at slaughterhouses (Vion Tilburg and Boxtel), cluster definitions, reporting obligations to the GGD, inspection of Vion Boxtel, and rotation of inspection staff. The minister answered in detail, confirming clusters and outbreak numbers, describing GGD and Inspectie SZW follow-up, and stating that inspection staff are not moved between slaughterhouses when symptomatic, while noting that a RIVM study on cold rooms was commissioned.
I commissioned the RIVM in January 2021 to conduct further research into the role of cold rooms in the food industry as a possible aggravating risk factor for the spread of COVID-19.
Het RIVM opdracht gegeven heb nader onderzoek te doen naar de rol van koude ruimtes in de voedselindustrie als mogelijke verhogende risicofactor voor verspreiding van COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over sneltesten middels de QuBA

Rep. Van Haga asked the Health Minister about the validation status and timeline of the Quick Breath Analyzer (QuBA) rapid COVID test, and who may validate it. The minister said the ministry is not involved in validation, that validation is time-consuming and the manufacturer is responsible, that IGJ supervises but does not validate, and that WHO antigen criteria are used in NL but do not apply to QuBA.
The Ministry of VWS is not involved in the validation of the Quick Breath Analyzer.
Het Ministerie van VWS is niet betrokken bij de validatie van de Quick Breath Analyzer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Nederland liep kans op miljoenen Oxford-vaccins mis'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about a news report that the Netherlands risked missing millions of Oxford COVID-19 vaccines, and why a 2020 financial support request to Halix and the Oxford consortium was not pursued. The minister rejected the framing, explained the EU joint procurement strategy and the TIVA alliance that secured over 80 million doses, and said no concrete Oxford request was made and no investment was needed.
I do not recognise myself in the title of the report you refer to. The Netherlands did not miss out on Oxford vaccines.
Ik herken mij niet in de titel van het bericht waaraan u refereert. Nederland is geen «Oxford» vaccins misgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de bereikbaarheid van GGD-GHOR voor afspraken van vaccinaties

MP Aukje de Vries asks the minister why the GGD-GHOR appointment phone line and website were hard to reach on 15 April 2021, how this squares with the GGD's own social media posts, and for call-centre performance figures for March and April. Minister De Jonge attributes the 15 April problems to overload of the 088 line used for obesity and Down syndrome groups, says the line will become a 0800 number, and reports call-abandonment, waiting time and answer-speed figures showing improvement.
It has now been decided that the 088 number will be converted to a 0800 number, so that problems can be absorbed in such exceptional circumstances as well.
Inmiddels is besloten dat het 088-nummer zal worden omgezet naar een 0800-nummer, zodat ook bij dit soort bijzondere omstandigheden problemen opgevangen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over het bericht dat tientallen miljoenen sneltests stof verzamelen in de opslag en het onderwijs aan een lijntje wordt gehouden

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked why tens of millions of rapid COVID tests sit in storage while schools are kept waiting for them. The minister answered that professional-supervision requirements blocked school testing, that self-tests were approved and are being rolled out to schools gradually, and that he will continue working on broader availability.
I have adopted the advice of the expert panel.
Ik heb het advies van het deskundigenpanel overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het testprotocol COVID-19 bij kinderen onder de 13 jaar

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether his earlier answers on COVID-19 testing for children under 13 wrongly implied a testing obligation, since no such obligation exists. The minister confirmed there is no testing obligation, said 'must' was used as a very urgent recommendation, and declined to publicise a correction beyond assuming the public understands it.
There is indeed no testing obligation in force.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Laan-Geselschap over 'Nog steeds geen onderzoek Sarah'

MPs Regterschot and Laan-Geselschap asked whether national inspectorates should have investigated the fatal 2018 stabbing of Sarah Papenheim and whether such incidents can be independently investigated at case level. The minister replied that no Wmo calamity investigation was legally possible because the victim was not a client, that inspectorates cooperate in specific cases, and that municipalities can commission independent case investigations.

In this event the victim was not a client. Therefore the Wmo Supervision Rotterdam-Rijnmond and TSD concluded that in this case there is no legal basis for Wmo supervision to start a calamity investigation.

In deze gebeurtenis was het slachtoffer geen cliënt. Daarom hebben het Toezicht Wmo Rotterdam-Rijnmond en TSD geconcludeerd dat in deze casus voor het Wmo-toezicht geen wettelijke basis is een calamiteitenonderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Romke de Jong over de Duitse testplicht bij grenswerkers

Two D66 MPs asked why German COVID test requirements apply to cross-border workers living in the Netherlands, whether they were informed, who pays for tests, and whether the GGD can provide certificates. The State Secretary confirmed the test obligation applies to them, pointed to official information channels, declined to make GGD tests available for certificates, and said a free testing facility in the border region was being set up.
No. The GGDs test with the aim of combating infectious diseases; preventive testing and issuing test certificates are indeed not part of that.
Nee. De GGD'en testen met als doel om de infectieziektebestrijding tegen te gaan; het preventief testen en verstrekken van testbewijzen maken daar inderdaad geen onderdeel van uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Aukje de Vries over het verplicht moeten tonen van een negatief testbewijs bij de grens tussen Nederland en Duitsland

Two VVD MPs asked the Dutch government about the German requirement to show a negative test when crossing the border, including for cross-border workers and pupils, and whether the government would raise the problem with Germany. The State Secretary answered that a Dutch test facility is being set up, that Germany has relaxed some rules for cross-border commuters, and that the government has been in ongoing contact with German authorities.
The cabinet shares this view and therefore wants to create a testing facility for these specific groups.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening, en wil voor deze specifieke groepen daarom een testvoorziening creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht ‘De anti-abortusbeweging haalt vrouwen over tot het nemen van gevaarlijke ‘spijtpil’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister about reports that anti-abortion groups pressure women into taking a dangerous 'regret pill' (progesterone) and whether such groups should be restricted, including by buffer zones around clinics. The minister stated that dispensing these drugs is restricted to pharmacists and licensed doctors, that the inspectorate enforces this, that buffer zones are for mayors to decide under the Public Manifestations Act, and that the inspectorate is investigating a Urk practice without a criminal probe yet.
As is customary, the Inspectorate makes no statements while the investigation is ongoing.
Zoals gebruikelijk doet de Inspectie hangende het onderzoek geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de pilots met testbewijzen

An SP MP asked the health minister about COVID-19 access-test pilots run by commercial providers via Stichting Open Nederland, including costs, procurement, profit margins and why GGDs were not used. The minister answered that participation is voluntary but a negative test is required for certain activities, that the state pays costs until 1 July, and that profit margins are monitored, while several cost and procurement details were deferred pending the open-house tender and a separate letter.
I have sent you the most important documents relating to the agreements between the Ministry of VWS and Stichting Open Nederland.
Ik heb u daarbij de belangrijkste documenten doen toekomen die betrekking hebben op de afspraken tussen het Ministerie van VWS en Stichting Open Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat het ministerie in strijd met de wet, en zonder toezicht 925 miljoen euro stort voor entreetesten

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that the ministry channelled 925 million euros to Stichting Open Nederland for entry tests without open tender and without oversight, questioning cost control, governance, salaries, contracts, and possible liability. The minister defended the direct award as necessary for speed, described phased go/no-go funding with accountability and external audit, and declined to answer the questions on the parliamentary debate timing.
The cabinet decides for each phase whether to further scale up the testing capacity.
Het kabinet besluit immers steeds per fase om de testcapaciteit verder op te schalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over de ontwikkelingen van de gezondheidssituatie op Bonaire en Curaçao

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about COVID-19 hospitalisations, the call centre, vaccination capacity, reduced regular care and overload risk on Bonaire and Curaçao, and whether a negative PCR test should be required for travellers to the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered with figures, reports of resolved call-centre problems, cross-island patient transfers, and the designation of the islands as high-risk areas with testing obligations.
Talks are also being held about transferring patients to other countries in the region when local capacity proves insufficient despite joint efforts.
Ook worden gesprekken gevoerd over de overplaatsing van patiënten naar andere landen in de regio, wanneer de lokale capaciteit ondanks gezamenlijke inspanningen onvoldoende blijken te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Curaçao kan geen coronapatiënten meer opnemen, IC ligt helemaal vol'

MP Kuiken asked the health and kingdom relations ministers how the government will support Curaçao after reports that its ICU was full and it could no longer take COVID patients, and whether the navy ship Karel Doorman could be deployed. The Staatssecretaris answered by pointing to a letter on three support lines, to cross-island hospital cooperation, extra staff and equipment, and patient transfers, while stating that VWS has no authority over the Karel Doorman and that no assistance request has been made to Defence.
The Ministry of VWS has no authority over the deployment of the ZMS Karel Doorman.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen zeggenschap over de inzet van de ZMS Karel Doorman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de aanpak van financiële ouderenmishandeling

An MP asked the minister how the government will strengthen protection of elderly people against financial abuse, including the functioning of local alliances, cooperation with municipalities and banks, and the lack of concrete enforcement. The state secretary answered that municipalities have a legal duty under the Wmo 2015 but no detailed requirements, that about 65 local alliances exist, and that the government will engage the VNG, NVB and ouderenbonden and organise a congress without committing to specific enforcement measures.
I therefore do not intend to take specific actions, but I do want to encourage municipalities to strengthen local alliances.
Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens om specifieke acties in te zetten, maar ik wil gemeenten wel aanmoedigen om lokale allianties te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de uitzending van Zembla inzake financiële ouderenmishandeling

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about a Zembla broadcast on financial elder abuse, including its prevalence, whether it rises with Covid, prosecution rates, and why not every municipality has an active local alliance. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the legal responsibility, that no national steering is planned, that local alliances are valued and will be encouraged, and that a consultation with municipalities and elderly organisations is planned.
I am therefore not intending to take specific actions aimed at realising alliances in all municipalities, or to set up actions as part of national steering of the approach.

Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens om specifieke acties in te zetten gericht op het realiseren van allianties in alle gemeenten, of om acties op te zetten als onderdeel van landelijke aansturing van de aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over artiesten voor de 'field labs' die niet betaald krijgen

An MP asked whether artists at the government-linked 'field labs' pilot events are unpaid and whether this is acceptable given the sector's hardship. The minister confirmed the events were initiated by the sector, performers participate pro bono, ticket proceeds go to the event, and listed general COVID support measures for culture.
The sector itself took the initiative to organise these events and approached the artists and suppliers to participate pro bono in the field labs.
De sector zelf heeft het initiatief genomen om deze events te organiseren en de artiesten en toeleveranciers benaderd om pro bono deel te nemen aan de fieldlabs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over vliegverboden en de coronasituatie in India en Zuid-Amerika

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about travel bans and the COVID situation in India and South America, including whether the B.1.617 variant justified a flight ban on India. The minister answered that the RIVM advised no ban on India for now, that the list of banned countries is reviewed regularly, and that the government is preparing mandatory quarantine for travellers from very high-risk areas.
The RIVM has also recently indicated that it currently sees no reason to advise imposing a flight ban.
Het RIVM heeft ook recent aangegeven op dit moment geen aanleiding te zien om te adviseren een vliegverbod in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorgmedewerkers ervaren vaccinatiedruk'

MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked whether healthcare workers experience pressure to be vaccinated against COVID-19 from employers or colleagues, and what the government is doing about it. The ministers answered that vaccination must remain voluntary, that about 20 reports of perceived pressure reached unions while the inspectorates received almost none, and that the government relies on persuasion and advice rather than coercion.
Due to the confidentiality of the reports, they cannot provide further information about these reports.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de meldingen kunnen zij geen nadere info verschaffen over deze meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de maatschappelijke waarde van mantelzorg

An MP asked the health minister about the societal value of informal care (estimated at 22 billion euros), caregiver overburdening, work-combination problems, and administrative burden. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to the joint programme 'Samen sterk voor mantelzorg', ongoing work with municipalities and employers, and a study on a caregiver declaration, while largely deferring further steps to a future cabinet.
It is up to a next cabinet to consider what additional measures may be needed.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te bezien wat eventueel aanvullend hierop nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Vader van honderden’ en massadoneren van sperma

An MP asks the health minister about a serial sperm donor who fathered hundreds of children, the loophole allowing donors to exceed the Dutch limit via foreign banks and private arrangements, and the delayed amendment of the Wdkb donor-data law. The minister acknowledges the problems, says the amendment to the Wdkb will be sent to parliament soon, but states he cannot control private donations or foreign banks and declines new investigations.
With the amendment of the Wdkb, it will be legally ensured that a donor's sperma may be used by Dutch clinics for a maximum of 12 women and this will be centrally monitored by the Sdkb.

Met de wijziging van de Wdkb wordt wettelijk geborgd dat het sperma van een donor maar bij maximaal 12 vrouwen door Nederlandse klinieken mag worden gebruikt en wordt dit centraal door de Sdkb gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mondkapjesverplichting voor kinderen

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health about the scientific basis, proportionality and harms of the mask requirement for children, citing a court ruling and studies on infections and child wellbeing. The Minister answers that the measures follow WHO, ECDC and OMT advice, that the requirement applies only in secondary schools and only briefly, and that exemptions exist for those who cannot wear masks.
I therefore see no reason to lift the mask requirement immediately.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om de mondkapjesverplichting onmiddellijk op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuis hoeft identiteit zaaddonor niet prijs te geven’

MP Tellegen asks the minister how a Gelderland court ruling that a hospital cannot be forced to disclose a sperm donor's identity fits the donor law's balancing test, and whether the law should be changed to protect donor children's right to know their biological father. The minister says a court ruling is awaited in a second case, that a legal amendment for formerly known donors who later chose anonymity may follow, and reports on the status of the register of donor confidentiality declarations.
Depending on the ruling, I am willing to initiate a legislative amendment.
Afhankelijk van de uitspraak ben ik bereid een wetswijziging te initiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘GGD en RIVM wijzen naar elkaar voor niet halen vaccinatiedoel’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why GGD and RIVM blame each other for missing the vaccination target, why vaccine stocks remain high while booths stand empty, and about call-centre problems, the July target, post-summer vaccination and contracts. The Minister explained the late-March surge in call-ins and the stock-buffer policy, announced call-centre expansion and online booking, and said he will ask the Health Council for long-term advice and that contracts for 2022 are being negotiated.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de voorraad van vaccins in Nederland

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about vaccine stocks, the coronavirus dashboard change, the safety stock policy for the Pfizer vaccine and why first-dose appointments may not be cancelled. The minister answered in detail, explaining stock categories, the reduction of the safety buffer from five to three days, and the logistics of delivery, but gave limited justification for some earlier statements and only partly answered the questions on comparative rankings.
From 13 April, the Coronavirus dashboard will therefore assume 1% spillage.
Vanaf 13 april wordt in daarom op het Coronadashboard met 1% spillage gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over alternatieve zorg tijdens de lockdown

MP Dik-Faber asked the health minister about the closure of alternative care (complementary therapies and lactation care) during the lockdown, citing a petition, CBS usage figures and health harms. The minister answered that the ban on contact professions, which covered alternative care, was a necessary emergency measure, has since been lifted, and that lactation care is again available, while declining to seek new OMT advice.
The temporary ban on contact professions also included a ban on providing alternative care.
Het tijdelijke verbod op het uitoefenen van contactberoepen hield ook een verbod op het verlenen van alternatieve zorg in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Houwelingen en Van Haga over het vrijwillig laten vaccineren van mantelzorgers en de (geestelijk) gehandicapte personen die zij verzorgen

MPs Van Houwelingen and Van Haga asked why family caregivers are not given priority COVID-19 vaccination like care workers, and whether caregivers authorised to act for mentally disabled persons should decide on their charges' vaccination. Minister De Jonge answered that vaccination follows age and medical risk on Gezondheidsraad advice, and that a legal representative, never the caregiver, decides for incapable clients.
No, when a client is incapable of making such decisions, there is a legal representative who makes these decisions for the client.
Nee, op het moment dat een cliënt wilsonbekwaam ter zake is voor dergelijke beslissingen, is er een wettelijk vertegenwoordiger die deze beslissingen voor de cliënt neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken en Van den Hul over de vaccinatiestrategie voor kwetsbaren

MPs Westerveld, Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the health minister about the vaccination strategy for vulnerable people, including people in voluntary quarantine, children who cannot attend school, the risk groups, and the timing of vaccinations for those with medical indications. The minister answered that the government does not track the number of people in voluntary quarantine, that schools are expected to keep in contact with vulnerable pupils and find alternative education, and that vaccination for the highest-risk groups has started with the Gezondheidsraad's advice still pending for children.
The behavioural unit does not record who is in voluntary quarantine.
Door de gedragsunit wordt niet geregistreerd wie er in vrijwillige quarantaine is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de vaccinproductie bij Halix en de relatie met de Nederlandse regering

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health and the Prime Minister about the Halix vaccine plant in Leiden, whether the government failed to invest there, and why Halix supplied the UK but not the EU. The minister answered at length: Halix only makes the active ingredient for AstraZeneca, the government did not invest because Halix did not request it, EU supply was handled through AstraZeneca and advance purchase agreements, and documents were provided.
The content of these kinds of conversations cannot be stated because of their confidential nature.
Over de inhoud van dit soort gesprekken kunnen i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter geen uitspraken gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Geen huisartsenpost in Woensdrecht: ‘De reistijd is amper vier minuten langer’'

An MP asked the health minister about plans to move the Bergen op Zoom out-of-hours GP post to Roosendaal, citing a report that the extra travel time is only four minutes. The minister gave estimated travel times (5 to 8 minutes longer by car, 5 to 7 minutes longer by ambulance), said consultations with residents were postponed due to Covid-19, and declined to provide many visit statistics, saying the provider holds them.
Care providers themselves hold this data and can use it in decision-making.
Zorgaanbieders beschikken zelf over deze gegevens en kunnen deze gebruiken bij besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de misstanden rondom de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe RIVM gebouw

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about vibration-sensitivity problems, cost overruns, delays and contractor withdrawals in the construction of the new RIVM/CBG headquarters in Utrecht. The government answered each question, acknowledging the vibration-requirement problems, roughly 36.5 million euro in extra costs shared with the contractor, and a delayed handover, while stating it complied with procurement rules and that the building will meet the requirements.
The House will be informed separately by letter about the new handover date.
De Kamer wordt middels een brief separaat geïnformeerd over de nieuwe opleverdatum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de Corona Opt-In, de wijze waarop mensen hun medische gegevens kunnen beschermen en mogelijk verkeerde antwoorden van de minister

An MP asks whether the Corona Opt-In, which opens medical records of about 8 million people who never consented to access by emergency services, remains in force, why it cannot be ended, who can view the data, and whether oversight of access is adequate. The minister replies that the measure remains necessary, that access is limited to authorised professionals with consent and logging, that pharmacies have no access, and that hospital audits are being arranged.
I believe that sufficient safeguards have been built into the Corona Opt-In to let the measure continue for as long as necessary within the Covid-19 context.
Ik vind dat er in het kader van de Corona Opt-in voldoende waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om de maatregel zolang noodzakelijk in het kader van Covid-19 te laten voortduren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over leerlingen in het voortgezet onderwijs die op 1,5 meter moeten sporten in de buitenlucht

An MP asked whether secondary school pupils must keep 1.5 metres apart during outdoor PE lessons, and why this differs from adult sports clubs, and asked for the 1.5-metre rule to be dropped for outdoor PE. The minister replied that pupils are legally exempt from the distance rule during PE for enforceability reasons, that RIVM still advises keeping distance, and declined to drop the rule.
Secondary school pupils are not legally required to keep 1.5 metres apart during physical education lessons, but the RIVM strongly advises it.

Leerlingen in het voortgezet onderwijs zijn wettelijk niet verplicht om tijdens de lessen lichamelijke opvoeding 1,5 meter afstand van elkaar te houden, maar dit wordt wel dringend geadviseerd door het RIVM.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de ontdekking dat het vogelgriepvirus H5N8 op mensen is overgesprongen en de rol van Nederland bij het vergroten van de wereldwijde risico’s op zoönose-uitbraken

An MP asks the Health Minister about H5N8 bird flu jumping to humans in Russia, Dutch broiler-breeder exports to Russia, culling and restocking of infected farms, NVWA capacity, and the zoonosis risk. The minister answers that the Dutch H5N8 strain is genetically different and not assessed as more transmissible to humans, that exports are governed by OIE standards, that an expert group will examine zoonosis causes, and that a full response within one week is not feasible.
I cannot answer this question. I cannot assess whether and to what extent the loss of Dutch hatching-egg exports would affect poultry sectors in other countries.
Deze vraag kan ik niet beantwoorden. Ik kan niet beoordelen of en in hoeverre het wegvallen van de export van broedeieren uit Nederland van invloed zou zijn op pluimveesectoren in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over vrijheidsbeperkingen in zorginstellingen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health about disproportionately long restrictions on residents' freedom in long-term care institutions during COVID-19, including quarantine, visits and whether the Wzd applies. The minister answered that institutions must weigh proportionality, that the IGJ supervises, that the Tijdelijke wet maatregelen COVID-19 does not restrict leaving the grounds, and that he will raise the issues with sector bodies and clarify the website, though he could not answer by the requested deadline.
I will ask these umbrella organisations to discuss this topic with their members and inform me of the outcomes.
Ik zal deze koepelorganisaties verzoeken dit onderwerp met hun leden te bespreken en mij over de uitkomsten daarvan te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de coronabesmetting van minister Ollongren

An SP MP asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Health about Minister Ollongren entering her official car with driver shortly after learning she had COVID-19, and about whether driver and workplace protections were followed. The government answers that the protocol for official transport was followed, the minister tested as a contact and did not need quarantine, and the driver's employer met its duty of care, while withholding further driver details on privacy grounds.
For reasons of privacy, no further information is provided about the driver.
Vanwege privacy wordt geen verdere informatie verstrekt over de chauffeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over onnodige lesuitval door de onvoorspelbaarheid van de tijd die coronatests kosten

MPs asked whether school closures caused by unpredictable COVID test waiting times for teachers are acceptable, how schools cope given teacher shortages, and why teachers do not get priority testing. The minister apologised for the late reply, said priority testing for education staff has existed since September 2020 and capacity has been expanded, and said schools must offer alternatives such as remote teaching.
Since September 2020, education staff, like care staff, can be tested with priority.
Sinds september 2020 kan onderwijspersoneel, net als zorgpersoneel, met voorrang getest worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over het testprotocol COVID-19 bij kinderen onder de 13 jaar

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked why children under 13 could only be tested for COVID-19 when symptomatic, whether schools' case increases were reported, and why GGD school case figures were not public. The minister answered that testing policy for under-13s was tightened in February 2021, testing capacity is sufficient, GGD school-level data stay regional or aggregated, and the RIVM has central registration by region and age.
I do not have information on the precise figures of the School Reporting Point, however.
De precieze cijfers van het Scholenmeldpunt heb ik echter geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Van den Hul over de inzet van sneltests op scholen

MPs Asscher and Van den Hul asked whether rapid tests could be used in schools as a preventive measure, as some European countries do, and about their capacity, priority for vital professions, and turnaround times. Minister De Jonge answered that school testing can add value, that pilots face scalability and legal problems being addressed by an expert panel, that rapid tests are being prepared for self-testing, and that teachers can book priority testing with reported turnaround times of 20 to 25 hours.
In the COVID-19 status letter of 23 March I informed your House about this and explained how I am working towards further rollout of testing in education based on the experts' recommendations.

In de stand van zaken brief COVID-19 van 23 maart heb ik uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd en toegelicht hoe ik met de aanbevelingen van de deskundigen toewerk naar een verdere uitrol van testen in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Verhoeven over de stand van zakenbrief digitale ondersteuning pandemiebestrijding

MPs Agema and Verhoeven asked the health minister about security vulnerabilities in GGD COVID testing and tracing IT systems, whether risk analyses will be published, and data deletion and vaccination communication. The minister answered that mitigating measures reduced vulnerabilities, that risk analyses will not be published now on security advice but will be reconsidered when the audit is delivered, and that monitoring and continuous security actions are in place.
As previously promised, when the audit is delivered I will reconsider whether it is possible to make this analysis or parts of it public.
Zoals eerder toegezegd zal ik bij het opleveren van de audit heroverwegen of het mogelijk is deze analyse of delen van deze analyse openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Thuis testen of je besmet bent met corona, nu nog als experiment’

An MP asked the health minister about a report on home COVID-19 antigen self-tests, including when results would be known, whether supervision and a legal basis are needed, and how this fits with voluntariness and on-site testing rules. The minister answered that a temporary exemption route for manufacturers is open, that the IGJ will supervise sellers, that self-tests are unsuitable for high-risk groups and access testing, and that a legal basis for a test certificate is being prepared.
From 5 March, manufacturers can submit an application.
Vanaf 5 maart jl. kunnen fabrikanten een aanvraag indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Smeulders over de onderbetaling van medewerkers bij de Coronacallcenters

MPs Smeulders and Kröger asked why the government again contracted Teleperformance for the corona callcenters, whether working conditions and pension accrual were tender criteria, and whether the government would intervene on underpayment and pensions. The minister replied that GGD GHOR chose Teleperformance because no other party could deliver in time, that the contract required compliance with labour law and any applicable CAO, and that the government is not the formal employer so it will not intervene or meet Teleperformance.
As far as I am aware, there are no signals that Teleperformance does not comply with the applicable laws and regulations or fails to apply any applicable CAO.
Voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen signalen dat Teleperformance niet voldoet aan de geldende wet-en regelgeving en een eventueel geldende cao niet toepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Afhandeling aanvragen farmaceutische vergunningen ernstig vertraagd'

An MP asked the health minister about serious delays in IGJ and CIBG/Farmatec handling pharmaceutical licence applications, the impact on GMP facility investment, and remedies. The minister acknowledges a backlog of about 25 overdue applications, attributes it to COVID-related inspection priorities, and outlines measures such as recruitment and a streamlined inspection programme, without a firm completion date.
At the end of 2020 the backlog in answering advice requests rose to about 25 pending applications whose 90-day deadline had been exceeded.
Eind 2020 liep de achterstand in beantwoording van adviesaanvragen op tot ongeveer 25 lopende aanvragen waarvan de termijn van 90 dagen was overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de vraag of de vaccinatiestrategie in Nederland voldoende kan worden versneld

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health whether the Dutch COVID-19 vaccination strategy could be accelerated, comparing it with other EU countries and asking about preparations, private partners and vaccine stockpiles. The minister answered that Dutch preparations target up to 2.5 million vaccinations per week from May, that private and armed-forces support is being used, and that stock levels per vaccine were reported, with AstraZeneca stock expected to be worked down within two weeks.
I expect that this high AstraZeneca stock level will be worked down within two weeks.
Ik verwacht dat deze hoge voorraadstand AstraZeneca binnen twee weken is ingelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Pas vanaf 18 jaar een coronavaccin: chronisch zieke Milan (16) zit al sinds maart thuis, maar wordt niet ingeënt’

An MP asked the health minister why chronically ill 16-year-olds cannot yet receive a COVID-19 vaccine and what research and advice is underway for under-18s. The minister replied that trials in children are ongoing, that the Health Council was asked for advice on vaccinating medically at-risk minors, and that a decision will follow that advice.
On 2 March I asked the Health Council to advise on the possibility of also vaccinating persons under 18.
Op 2 maart jl. heb ik de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om advies uit te brengen over de mogelijkheid ook personen jonger dan 18 jaar te vaccineren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over de vaccinatiestrategie

The MP asks why care homes still struggle to order vaccines for all residents at once, whether the second-dose interval rules and GGD couple-vaccination instructions are flexible enough, and how GGD staff are instructed. The minister explains the rollout was adjusted to allow simultaneous vaccination, acknowledges communication confusion, states longer dose intervals are acceptable, and promises clarified instructions and a catch-up round, without addressing the call for stricter oversight.
It must be clear to care institutions where they stand.
Het moet duidelijk zijn voor zorginstellingen waar ze aan toe zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kuiken over het dubbele testbeleid voor vliegreizen

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked the ministers about the double testing regime for flights into the Netherlands, including data on positive tests, crew testing, quarantine compliance, airport test availability and EU coordination. The government answered that it holds no data on positive tests before departure, said compliance and crew results are not registered or are low, and maintained that pre-departure testing is more effective, while committing to extend the rapid test validity to 24 hours.
The cabinet has no data on the number of travellers who tested positive with a PCR test before they wanted to travel to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft geen data over aantallen reizigers die positief zijn getest met een PCR-test voordat zij naar Nederland wilden afreizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Diertens over aanwijzing ex artikel 34, eerste lid, Wet publieke gezondheid

MPs Groothuizen, Bergkamp and Diertens asked the health minister about designating the UMCG as a site for forced Covid-19 isolation, how often the emergency powers under the Public Health Act have been used, and how quarantine and legal protection would be handled. The minister answered that the designation was overdue, that only six isolation orders were issued by two regions with one court extension request refused, and that quarantine powers were not used, with further legislation on quarantine announced.
With this decision, the formal situation is finally arranged so that a hospital is designated at the moment a safety region chair imposes a mandatory isolation order.
Met dit besluit wordt alsnog de formele situatie geregeld dat er een ziekenhuis is aangewezen op het moment dat een voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio een verplichte isolatie beschikking oplegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de publicatie van de scorekaart van Farma ter Verantwoording

The MP asks the health minister about a Farma ter Verantwoording scorecard rating pharmaceutical firms on COVID-19 drugs, including licence transparency, production costs, technology sharing and fair global access. The minister replies that licence agreements are confidential, that the scorecard categories are one-sided, and that policy relies on transparency pressure, access benchmarks and EU joint procurement, while committing to no specific new action.
A licence agreement is generally a confidential agreement between two parties.
Een licentieovereenkomst is in de regel een vertrouwelijke overeenkomst tussen twee partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Kerstens en Kuiken over zorgcowboys die gemeenten op kosten jagen

MPs Nijboer, Kerstens and Kuiken asked about 'zorgcowboys' moving clients across the country to the detriment of municipalities, municipal financial strain in youth care, benefits and shelter, and whether this causes social rental housing construction problems and gatekeeping of care. Minister De Jonge answered that no signals of such practices were received, pointed to COVID compensation, extra youth-care funds and the planned residence-principle reforms, and largely deferred the structural funding question to a future cabinet.
Decision-making on a structural solution in terms of adjusting the system from 2022 and the required budget will be left to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming over een structurele oplossing in termen van aanpassing in het stelsel vanaf 2022 en benodigd budget, zal aan een volgend kabinet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Pas de vaccinatiestrategie aan, zeggen deskundigen: niet 2 prikken, maar 1’

An MP asked the health minister about expert calls to give one COVID-19 vaccine dose instead of two, plus related questions on research and a risk algorithm. The minister answered that the Health Council advised against a single-dose schedule, so the two-dose strategy stays, and that further advice and research are being sought.
Based on this advice, I have decided not to change the vaccination strategy on this point.
Op basis van dit advies heb ik besloten de vaccinatiestrategie op dit punt niet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over 'Lid vaccinatiecommissie: ‘Haal vaccins uit China en India’'

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about a vaccination committee member's call to source COVID-19 vaccines from China and India, and whether the government would invest in or contract them. The minister defended the EU procurement strategy, said the Chinese and Indian vaccines are not yet of added value given uncertain EMA approval timing and supply volumes, and noted that the companies must decide themselves whether to seek approval.
For the time being, I do not believe these vaccines currently add value to the European portfolio.
Vooralsnog ben ik niet van mening dat deze vaccins op dit moment van toegevoegde waarde zijn voor de Europese portfolio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'EU erkent: wel degelijk Nederlandse productie AstraZeneca-vaccin'

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about reports that Dutch company Halix produces AstraZeneca vaccine, its production capacity, any Dutch negotiations or investment, and why the UK contract was prioritised. The minister replied that the Netherlands acted through EU and Inclusive Vaccine Alliance contracts, that AstraZeneca selects its own contract manufacturers, that no specific Dutch production arrangements were made, and declined to share export and Halix output details citing confidentiality.
The specific data on export licences are commercially confidential and for that reason cannot be shared.
De specifieke gegevens met betrekking tot de exportvergunningen zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kunnen om die reden niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over het bericht 'vertraging ggz-indicaties in de Wlz door hoge aantal aanvragen'

MPs Slootweg and Peters asked why GGZ Wlz indication requests far exceeded the expected 9,500, how long applicants will wait, what the dedicated CIZ team and transitional arrangements involve, and what the shift means for Wmo funding and care hours. The state secretary answered that the initial estimate was too low because ambulant clients and providers were initially hesitant, that over 16,000 clients are expected to receive Wlz GGZ indications, that a noodplan with extra staff is in place, that Wmo decisions were extended to 1 July 2021, and that the Wmo-to-Wlz transfer will be recalculated budget-neutrally for municipalities.
At the end of 2020 I made agreements with the CIZ on an emergency plan containing various measures to clear the backlog of applications as quickly and carefully as possible.
Eind 2020 heb ik met het CIZ afspraken gemaakt over een noodplan, waarin verschillende maatregelen zijn opgenomen om het stuwmeer aan aanvragen zo snel en zorgvuldig mogelijk weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Hijink over het bericht ‘KLM to resume SA flights to Amsterdam’

Two MPs asked whether KLM was resuming flights from South Africa to Amsterdam despite the travel ban and whether the government would act against it. The minister said airlines decide commercially, KLM screens passengers for exemptions, six passenger flights ran in late February, and airlines must check travellers' test results, with regional safety authorities checking on arrival.
It is up to the airlines themselves to assess whether flights to destinations under a flight ban are commercially attractive based on the estimated number of exempt cases.

Het is aan de luchtvaartmaatschappijen zelf om te beoordelen of vluchten naar bestemmingen waarvoor een vliegverbod geldt, commercieel interessant zijn op basis van het geschatte aantal uitzonderingsgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Aukje de Vries en Veldman over de problematiek rondom bemanningswisselingen en vaccinatie van zeevarenden

MPs from the VVD asked about crew changes and vaccination of seafarers, including test requirements at foreign airports, the feasibility of arrival testing, vaccine rollout delays such as in the Philippines, and private vaccination options. The minister acknowledged the difficulties, extended the antigen test validity to 24 hours, and said the RIVM is examining how seafarers can access existing vaccination routes, without committing to new parliamentary reporting.
I will inform your House when there are new developments regarding the points above.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren op het moment dat er met betrekking tot bovenstaande punten nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Commissie neemt belangrijke maatregelen voor een verenigd front tegen COVID-19'
