An MP asked the Minister of Health about the EU call for at least 5-10% genome sequencing of positive COVID-19 tests, why the Netherlands does not reach that share, and how RIVM plans to scale up national variant surveillance. The minister answered that RIVM follows the ECDC norm of roughly 500 random samples per week, currently performs 600-900 sequences weekly plus 300-400 at Erasmus MC, is scaling up to 1,200-1,500 samples per week with a target of end April 2021, and is coordinating a wider laboratory network.
Achieving the European Commission's target of sequencing capacity of at least 5% of positive test results is not a goal in itself within Dutch policy.

Het behalen van de door de Europese Commissie gestelde doelstelling van een sequentie-analysecapaciteit van ten minste 5% van de positieve testresultaten is geen doel op zich binnen het Nederlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Austria sounds alarm over South Africa Coronavirus Variant in Tyrol region'

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the spread of the South African coronavirus variant in Austria's Tyrol region and whether Dutch sequencing capacity is sufficient to detect new variants early. The minister described Austria's measures, the current variant prevalence in the Netherlands, and said sequencing is being scaled up in line with ECDC advice, without committing to a specific percentage of positive tests.
The RIVM is therefore scaling up to a higher and sustainable capacity.
Het RIVM schaalt dan ook op naar een hogere en duurzame capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de gang van zaken rond het naar buiten brengen van het besluit over de opening van kinderopvang en basisscholen

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked why the government publicly signalled reopening of primary schools and childcare before the OMT advice existed, how the OMT reasoned, and how safe reopening and testing capacity could be ensured. Minister De Jonge answered that hope for reopening preceded the advice, that the OMT weighed social interests alongside epidemiological risk, and that extra measures and testing were planned, while declining to disclose the OMT's internal vote and not answering the question on the exact timing of measures in full detail.
To enable an open exchange of views within the OMT, no statements are made about this exchange and the discussion remains confidential.
Om een open gedachtewisseling in het OMT mogelijk te maken, worden geen uitspraken gedaan over deze gedachtewisseling en blijft de bespreking vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Kooten-Arissen over het beleid rondom maskergebruik ter preventie van SARS-CoV-2 infecties in de ziekenhuiszorg

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the RIVM guidance on masks for healthcare staff treating COVID-19 patients is adequate, given aerosol transmission concerns and calls for FFP2 masks. The minister replied that the expert advice (OMT and RIVM) still considers type IIR surgical masks sufficient outside aerosol-generating procedures, while employers may deviate on risk assessment and must support staff requests, and that the guidance is for professional bodies rather than politicians to set.
It is not for me to determine when which type of PPE/face mask must be prescribed for use by healthcare workers.
Het is niet aan mij om te bepalen wanneer welke type PBM/mondneusmasker voorgeschreven dient te worden voor gebruik door zorgmedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'EU still firmly opposed to lifting intellectual property rights on vaccines'

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Trade whether the EU's opposition to suspending intellectual property rights on COVID-19 vaccines is justified, and why the government backs the C-TAP initiative and opposes the India/South Africa waiver. Minister De Jonge answers that IP suspension would not expand production, that voluntary cooperation and licensing are preferred, that a vaccine envoy has been asked to inventory domestic capacity, and that the government will not support the TRIPS waiver.
The Cabinet has received no information that would prompt it to revise its position that the existence of patents is not the reason for the current shortage of Covid-19 vaccines.
Het Kabinet heeft geen informatie ontvangen om het standpunt te herzien dat het bestaan van octrooien niet de reden is voor de huidige schaarste aan Covid-19 vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over pgb-houders en hun zorgverleners en de vaccinatiestrategie

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked the health minister why paid-care (pgb) caregivers in small-scale living initiatives were deprioritised in the COVID vaccination strategy, asked for clarity on target groups and timing, and asked for consistent information across government, RIVM and GP websites. The minister explained vaccine supply constraints, gave timelines for each group, and committed to aligning communication with RIVM and to answering at the next debate.
I understand the importance of a consistent message about COVID vaccination and therefore align communication, and thus also the content of the respective websites, with the RIVM.
Ik begrijp het belang van eenduidige boodschap over coronavaccinatie en stem daarom de communicatie, en dus ook de inhoud van de respectievelijke websites, af met het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de vaccinatie van bewoners en personeel in de langdurige zorg

An MP asked the health minister why residents of nursing homes without a care indication or with an indication but no treatment are not vaccinated in their own home, and for a full overview of vulnerable groups and priority rules. The minister explained the phased vaccination strategy by age, medical indication and logistics, and said he is willing to meet the LVOI on the strategy for small-scale residential initiatives.
Yes, I am willing to enter into discussion with LVOI.
Ja, ik ben bereid om met LVOI in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de uitspraken van Eurocommissaris Johansson dat Europa meer migranten nodig heeft

An SGP MP asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Health about EU Commissioner Johansson's remarks that Europe needs more migrants, and about the implications for Dutch migration debate and policy. The government answers that the remarks have no consequences for the Dutch situation, that member states decide on labour migration numbers, that a general migration ceiling is not current policy, and that the relevant demographic and sectoral analyses (Verkenning 2050, WRR report) are still awaited.
The final report of the Verkenning 2050, which will contain a calculation of the societal implications, is expected in spring 2021.
Het eindrapport van de Verkenning 2050, dat een doorrekening van de maatschappelijke implicaties zal bevatten, is in het voorjaar van 2021 voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over signalen over problematiek samenhangend met de overgang van statushouders van een AZC naar de gemeente

VVD MPs asked how status holders are transferred from asylum reception centres to municipalities, what factors guide placement, what funding and information municipalities receive, and whether their care needs and municipal difficulties are being addressed. The State Secretary explained the COA-to-municipality matching and information-sharing process, noted some information gaps and a review underway, and stated that funding and care needs are handled under the same criteria as other residents, with an Ombudsman investigation into unaccompanied minors pending.
Your House will be informed about this shortly.
Uw Kamer wordt hierover op korte termijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Nederlandse spermadonor verwekt 200 kinderen en adverteert ermee op social media’

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about a Dutch sperm donor reportedly fathering around 200 children and advertising on social media, and about regulating multi-donor practices domestically and abroad. The Minister of Health answered that private donation falls outside government control, pointed to clinic rules and the planned Wdkb amendment capping donations at 12 families, and said no registration or international agreement is feasible for private arrangements.
Outside the clinics and the Sdkb, there is no visibility into the number of so-called multi-sperm donors active in the Netherlands or abroad.
Buiten de klinieken en de Sdkb om is er geen zicht op het aantal zogenaamde multi-spermadonoren dat actief is in Nederland of in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'ISKO Vital B.V. ontvangt als eerste het NEN-keurmerk voor mondkapjes voor publiek gebruik'

MP Veldman asked the health minister about a NEN quality mark for public face masks, including how many suppliers are being tested, whether testing covers virus mutations, whether the OMT will be asked for new advice, the production capacity, and the minister's view of such a mark. The minister answered substantively on all six questions, noting two certificates issued and three applications pending, that no new OMT advice is needed, and that the mark is a useful tool supported by the ministry.
There are currently two certificates issued and there are currently three applications being processed.
Er zijn momenteel twee certificaten uitgegeven en er zijn momenteel drie aanvragen in behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Klaver, Ploumen en Van der Staaij over de snelheid van het vaccineren en de uitvoering van de vaccinatiestrategie

Four MPs (Jetten, Klaver, Ploumen, Van der Staaij) asked the health minister why the Netherlands lags the EU average in COVID-19 vaccination, about planning, stock management, the role of Defence and business, and vaccinating nursing-home residents. The minister answered that the first shot was given later than in other member states, that a large safety stock was held, that stock management and planning are being adjusted, and that vaccination groups are being prioritised by risk, while the answers on Defence/business offers and prognoses were largely restated policy or deferred.
It is not easy to estimate when the Netherlands will be at the same vaccination rate as the other EU countries or even above it.
Het is niet goed in te schatten wanneer Nederland op dezelfde vaccinatiegraad zit als de andere EU-landen of zelfs daar boven.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over keuzevrijheid in het vaccin voor een specifieke groep gewetensbezwaarden

Two MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked the health minister whether people with conscientious objections to vaccines developed or tested using fetal-derived cell lines (HEK293, PER.C6) should be given freedom of choice among COVID-19 vaccines. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the vaccines are lawful under current rules, but refused individual choice of vaccine type because of limited supply and a need for rapid mass vaccination, while pointing to information and dialogue efforts.
It is not possible for an individual to choose a specific type of vaccine.
Het is niet mogelijk om als individu de keuze te maken voor een specifiek type vaccin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Ruim twintig mensen besmet in Fries woonzorgcentrum, deels met Britse variant'

An SP MP asked the health minister about a COVID-19 outbreak at a Frisian care home, including why FFP2 masks were not used, whether preventive testing should expand, and whether care workers will have enough FFP2 masks. The minister expressed regret, explained that surgical masks suffice in most cases under RIVM guidance, said preventive testing is not yet justified, and stated supply is adequate while agreeing with social partners to clarify practical guidance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de vaccinatie van dove of slechthorende zorgmedewerkers in De Gelderhorst en in het algemeen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 outbreak control at the deaf care home De Gelderhorst, whether deafness contributed to spread, and whether deaf or hard-of-hearing care staff can book vaccinations given the phone-only booking. The minister says the crisis is under control, deafness did not contribute, information is provided bilingually, and GGD is exploring accessibility solutions for all groups, including interpreters for phone booking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Paternotte en Veldman over de handhaving van de negatieve PCR-testuitslag en verklaring voor inreizen of transit in Nederland

MPs Schonis, Paternotte and Veldman asked how compliance with the mandatory negative PCR test requirement for travellers entering the Netherlands is enforced, including spot checks, bus and train stations, testing on arrival, and exemptions for vaccinated travellers. The minister answered that carriers must check 100% of passengers with sanctions available, veiligheidsregio's perform spot checks, arrival testing and vaccination exemptions were not adopted, and enforcement is via fines and orders under administrative coercion.
The safety regions carry out spot checks among arriving passengers to see whether the airline and ferry companies comply sufficiently.
De veiligheidsregio's doen steekproeven onder aankomende passagiers om te zien of de naleving door de luchtvaart- en ferrymaatschappijen voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over uitgiftepunten voor gecertificeerde mondneusmaskers

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen could supply FFP2 masks to food banks and other groups, whether FFP2 mask requirements should be introduced, and why some care workers still lack FFP2 masks. The minister answered that the supplied masks are CE-certified Type II R surgical masks, that the OMT advises against stricter public mask rules, that care workers may deviate from the norm with employer consultation and can report to the Inspectie SZW, and that supplies are sufficient.
I would like to hear where this happens, so that we can enter into discussion with these care institutions.
Ik verneem graag waar dit gebeurt, zodat we met deze zorginstellingen in gesprek kunnen treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over incorrecte cijfers van ziekenhuisopnames en de besluitvorming hieromtrent

An MP from D66 asked the health minister why COVID-19 hospital admission figures differed between data sources (OSIRIS, Stichting NICE, LCPS) and how this affected decisions on extra measures in September and October 2020. The minister answered in detail that the sources count admissions differently, that the dashboard was updated, that signal values and OMT advice guided decisions, and that the government would not commit to new action.
However, I have not managed to answer this before a next debate on the developments surrounding the coronavirus.
Het is mij echter niet gelukt om dit vóór een volgend debat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van den Berge over de vaccinatiestrategie

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Health how homeless people, undocumented residents, unmanaged-budget recipients, informal carers and children of undocumented parents will be reached, informed, registered and vaccinated under the COVID-19 vaccination strategy. The Minister answered all 13 questions one by one, giving timing based on expected supply and Health Council risk groups, outlining outreach through organisations like the Leger des Heils, and stating that children under 18 are not yet being vaccinated.
We will soon discuss with the organisations where these groups are known (including the Salvation Army) how this harder-to-reach target group can best be informed.
We gaan binnenkort met de organisaties waar deze groepen bekend zijn (o.a. het Leger des Heils) in gesprek over de vraag hoe deze moeilijker bereikbare doelgroep het beste geïnformeerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de dreigende slacht van honderdduizenden haaien voor coronavaccins

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether squalene from shark livers used in some COVID-19 vaccines should be replaced by plant-based sources and whether the government would choose vaccines without protected animals. The minister confirmed shark-derived squalene is in the Sanofi/GSK vaccine, said plant-based alternatives are preferable where equivalent, and promised to ask contract partners in future agreements about protected animals in production.
I am, however, willing to ask the contracting party in the case of new agreements whether they use protected animals in the production process.
Ik ben wel bereid om in geval van nieuwe overeenkomsten aan de contractpartij te vragen of ze gebruik maken van beschermde dieren bij het productieproces
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'De strijd om het coronavaccin barst nu pas echt los'

An SP MP asks the Health Minister about the dispute between the EU and AstraZeneca over delayed COVID-19 vaccine deliveries, export licensing, patents, WHO C-TAP and production capacity in the Netherlands. The minister says the EU is seeking explanations from AstraZeneca, supports an export licensing register, sees no case for releasing patents, and promises to follow up on several points.
At this moment I am not aware of the legal steps the Italian government is taking against Pfizer. I will look into this and inform you later.
Op dit moment ben ik niet op de hoogte van de juridische stappen die de Italiaanse overheid neemt richting Pfizer. Ik zal dit nagaan en u hier later over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het gebruik van het middel ivermectine tegen COVID-19

An MP from the FvD asked the Minister of Health about recent studies suggesting ivermectin reduces COVID-19 hospitalisation, infection and mortality, and what the government has done to investigate it. The Minister said the SWAB currently advises against ivermectin on the basis of available evidence, that ZonMw has not funded ivermectin studies, and that vaccination remains preferable because the measures and treatments serve different purposes.
However, it is not for me to interpret these studies, but for medical scientific specialists.
Het is evenwel niet aan mij om deze studies te duiden, maar aan medisch wetenschappelijke specialisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over de beschikbaarheid van hulpmiddelen en basismateriaal bij de levering ten behoeve van, en uitvoering van de vaccinatiestrategie

An MP asked the health minister whether Pfizer's vaccine output per vial and the supply of basic materials such as vials, stoppers and caps could constrain the vaccination strategy, and what the government would do about shortages and export restrictions. The minister answered that Pfizer's product information now specifies six doses per vial, that supply is contracted per dose, that shortages of basic materials are not currently the limiting factor, and that the government would examine support for producers if needed.
I have no insight into lead times for basic materials in the filling process.
Ik heb geen inzicht in levertijden van basismaterialen bij het afvulproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het programma ‘Zaak van je Leven’ van WNL en de rol van het Waarschuwingsregister Zorg en Welzijn

A VVD MP asked whether the minister still supports making the Waarschuwingsregister Zorg en Welzijn mandatory and how misconduct by care staff moving between providers will be prevented. The minister answered that he has dropped plans for a legal obligation to join the register due to practical and legal objections, and that alternatives will be discussed with stakeholders in early 2021.
As indicated in my letter to your House, I have decided to refrain from a statutory obligation to join the Warning Register.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief aan uw Kamer, heb ik besloten af te zien van een wettelijke verplichting tot aansluiting bij het Waarschuwingsregister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de voorbereidingen voor vaccinatie tegen het coronavirus

An MP asked the Health Minister why the Netherlands would vaccinate more slowly than Germany and Spain, why it relies on existing structures, and how infrastructure, personnel, materials and public information for COVID-19 vaccination are being arranged. The minister answered that rollout began in early January, that the strategy builds on existing routes and central sites, and that materials, cold storage and communication are in place or being secured, though one question was not answered in time.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht 'Ontwikkelaar corona-sneltest ontwijkt op grote schaal belastingen'

SP MPs asked the health minister and finance state secretary about reports that Qiagen, a supplier of COVID-19 test kits, avoided Dutch taxes while receiving public subsidies, and about public investment via the Dutch Venture Initiative. The minister answered that the government cannot comment on individual taxpayers under article 67 AWR, that no test orders were placed with Qiagen, and that the government will pursue anti-avoidance measures and study public country-by-country reporting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asked the health minister about remarks that COVID measures might last longer for unvaccinated people, the legality of sharing vaccination status, enforcement of the 1.5-metre rule, air ionisation, mass testing and hospital capacity. The minister denied a two-tier regime, said no vaccination obligation is planned, referred the ethics question to the Health Council, and gave detailed answers on enforcement, testing strategy and care capacity.
That is why, as I explained in my letters of 20 November and 21 December, I asked the Health Council's Ethics and Law Committee to draw up an ethical framework.
Daarom heb ik, zoals ik in mijn Kamerbrief van 20 november en 21 december heb toegelicht, de Commissie Ethiek en recht van de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd een ethisch afwegingskader op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de campagne van Second Love waarin wordt opgeroepen tot vreemdgaan

An SGP MP asked the Health Minister whether the government would condemn a Second Love advertising campaign urging infidelity, and whether it would press the advertiser or municipalities to stop it, and how municipalities support relationships and prevent divorce harms. The government answered that advertising content is for the Reclame Code Commissie to judge, that relationships are a private matter, and that municipalities provide relationship and divorce support under the Jeugdwet, with the SzS programme supporting them.
It is not for the government to become substantively involved in advertising campaigns or to pass judgment on them.
Het is niet aan de overheid om inhoudelijke bemoeienis te hebben met reclamecampagnes of hier over een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over regionale verschillen in de euthanasiepraktijk

An ChristenUnie MP asked the health minister to explain unexplained regional differences in euthanasia rates across municipalities, which the research attributes partly to supply-side factors such as physicians initiating end-of-life talks, and to propose further study, a regional evaluation and expanded registration. The minister acknowledged the research, stated that the practice is highly careful everywhere and that regional differences in care quality do not exist, saw no need for further research now, and promised to examine patient characteristics and provincial differences in the fourth law evaluation expected around 2022.
As long as care diligence is high, I am therefore neutral about regional differences.
Zolang de zorgvuldigheid hoog is, sta ik dan ook neutraal tegenover regionale verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen het bezoek van predikanten beperken

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether hospitals restricting visits by chaplains conflicts with agreements and legal rights, and whether patients may receive pastoral visits outside visiting hours. The minister replied that hospitals may limit visits for infection control, that no distinction is made between visitor types, that he disagrees with the claim of non-compliance, and that he will only alert hospital associations to a guidance document; he declined to answer question 8 and could not answer in time.
It is up to the care institution to weigh this, in which the safety of all patients and staff counts alongside the interest of the individual patient.
Het is aan de zorginstelling om een afweging te maken, waarbij naast het belang van de individuele patiënt de veiligheid van alle patiënten en personeel meetelt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kuiken over crisismeldingen in de jeugd-ggz

MP Kuiken (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about the reported rise in crisis referrals in youth mental health care, difficulty finding beds for acutely ill young people, long waiting times, and calls for structural funding. The State Secretary confirmed the rise, pointed to an ongoing survey of regions, a crisis bed app, and existing extra funds, and said a study on structural funding would be submitted to the incoming cabinet, without committing to new money now.
To get a sharper picture of the capacity and bottlenecks in specialist youth mental health care, I have agreed with the VNG to map this as quickly as possible.
Om scherper zicht op te krijgen op de capaciteit en knelpunten rondom specialistische j-ggz zorg heb ik met de VNG afgesproken om dit zo snel mogelijk in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over besmetting aan boord van vliegtuigen

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about in-flight COVID-19 transmission on a Dubai to Auckland flight, the role of APUs and masks, and the status of the NLR/RIVM study. The minister acknowledged that some measures were not fully applied on the flight, explained APU use and mask exceptions, pointed to layered measures and new flight bans, and said the study report is expected around March.
The aviation committee debate of 4 February has been postponed.
Het AO Luchtvaart van 4 februari jl. is uitgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van donderdagavond 10 december 2020 'Sterke stijging anorexiapatiënten tijdens coronacrisis'

CDA MPs asked the government about a Nieuwsuur report on a sharp rise in anorexia patients during the coronavirus crisis, rising waiting lists for complex psychiatric care, bed shortages for anorexia treatment, interim care, regional high-complexity care tables, and the Court of Audit's view that long waits worsen conditions. The State Secretary acknowledged the mental health impact, described measures such as a consultation line, transparency rules and an evaluation of high-complexity care, but gave averages rather than specific anorexia waiting-list figures and did not provide case counts.
I will send you this evaluation.
Ik zal u deze evaluatie doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het aantal ziekenhuisopnames op het corona dashboard

An MP asked the Minister of Health about discrepancies between hospital admission figures on the corona dashboard and figures from hospitals, and whether thresholds were crossed late as a result. The minister explained that the dashboard uses Stichting NICE and LCPS data with different purposes, acknowledged a possible time lag and under-reporting from one hospital, and committed to changing the headline indicator to show new admissions reported that day.
That is why we have now also adjusted the core indicator of hospital admissions.
Daarom hebben we inmiddels ook de kernindicator van ziekenhuisopnames aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het voorkomen en bestrijden van genitale verminking

MPs Becker and Veldman (VVD) asked the ministers about preventing and combating female genital mutilation (FGM), including prevalence data, the role of GPs and the care chain, Veilig Thuis reporting, reconstructive surgery coverage, integration course content, Schiphol controls and a reporting obligation. The state secretary answered that preventive and chain policy exists and is being evaluated, that data are limited or not monitored, that some measures (Schiphol controls) have no fixed timeline, and that a mandatory reporting duty is under study with Raad van State reservations.
The number of women who report to their GP because they are victims of FGM is not monitored.
Het aantal vrouwen dat zich meldt bij de huisarts omdat zij slachtoffer zijn van VGV wordt niet gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het bericht dat het reisadvies van Curaçao naar oranje is bijgesteld

Two D66 MPs asked why the travel advice for Curaçao was changed to orange only on 8 December 2020 despite a record number of infections, how many Dutch travellers had booked trips, and why returning travellers from Curaçao were not tested while Atlanta flights were. Minister De Jonge answered that the advice followed rising infections and that Curaçao is no longer a high-risk area since 8 January, so no PCR or antigen test is required, while giving partial figures on travel volumes and declining to address booking numbers directly.
Can you answer these questions within a week, given the start of the Christmas holiday next week?
Vraag 12 Kunt u, vanwege de start van de kerstvakantie volgende week, deze vragen binnen een week beantwoorden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over ‘Niet bewoners maar personeel van verpleeghuizen als eerste gevaccineerd’

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports that nursing home staff rather than residents would be vaccinated first, and about the effect on the vaccination strategy, the vaccine rollout, communication, and the registration system. The minister said the centralized BioNTech/Pfizer rollout and the Health Council advice shaped the priorities, answered most questions on substance, and declined to confirm a RIVM-led meeting, reporting only a ministerial stakeholder meeting instead.
Inquiries with the RIVM show that such a meeting did not take place.
Navraag bij het RIVM leert dat een dergelijk overleg niet heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Voor deze ouderen geen plek meer’

An SP MP asks the health and medical care ministers about older patients who cannot be placed in nursing homes or receive home care after hospital treatment, and whether this has worsened during the coronavirus crisis. The minister reports current care-capacity figures, notes staffing shortages as the main cause, describes the regional and national procedures for staff support, and points to funding for small-scale housing for older people.
For privacy reasons, figures broken down by age are not available.
Vanwege privacyoverwegingen zijn cijfers op basis van leeftijd niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over reizen tijdens de coronacrisis

Two D66 MPs asked ministers why travel advice for Curaçao and other Caribbean and Canary Island destinations seemed inconsistent with the Prime Minister's call not to travel abroad, and why airlines were promoting trips. The ministers answered that a worldwide orange travel advice now applies, that airlines and tour operators agreed to limit package holidays and add PCR and rapid testing requirements, and that testing of arriving travellers is being assessed for capacity.
On 15 December 2020 the travel advice was adjusted worldwide to orange.
Op 15 december 2020 is het reisadvies wereldwijd aangepast naar oranje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asks the government about Maastricht Aachen Airport growth, noise in Limburg quiet areas, and conflicting studies on tourism impacts, and asks whether the growth doctrine influenced commissioned research. The minister answers that the province of Limburg is responsible for quiet areas and for MAA's future, that the independent advice is pending, and that he does not take positions on the Breda and Ecorys studies, while also replying on the air-freight levy report and rejecting a growth doctrine.

Since I am not the commissioning party for either study and there is no formal application for an airport decision yet that I must consider, I do not think it is appropriate to make statements about either study.

Aangezien ik geen opdrachtgever ben van beide onderzoeken en er nog geen formele aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit ligt waarover ik mij moet buigen acht ik het niet opportuun om uitspraken te doen over beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het kerkbezoek van de minister van Defensie

An MP asked whether the Minister of Defence's attendance at an in-person church service, and the Justice Minister's earlier call to stay home over Christmas, were consistent with government policy and the example expected of cabinet members. The government answered that the church visit was a personal choice, that Covid rules cannot ban collective worship under the constitutional freedom of religion, and that a minister's individual faith is a personal matter.
Visiting a physical church service by the Minister of Defence was a personal choice.
Het bezoeken van een fysieke kerkdienst door de Minister van Defensie was een persoonlijke keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de tekorten aan budgetten in de Wmo en de jeugdzorg

An SP MP asks the minister whether the VNG call on municipalities to take cost-control measures (income-based limits, budget ceilings, waiting lists) under the Wmo subscription tariff is acceptable, and how support and budgets for Wmo and youth care will be secured. The minister replies that such measures outside the legal framework are not allowed, that municipalities are sufficiently compensated, and that a stuurgroep and bestuurlijke weging on youth care will inform the next cabinet, with no additional budget now.
However, proposals under which municipalities create waiting lists and introduce budget ceilings so that people can no longer use the Wmo 2015 are not permitted.
Echter, voorstellen waarbij gemeenten wachtlijsten laten ontstaan en budgetplafonds instellen waardoor mensen geen gebruik meer kunnen maken van de Wmo 2015 zijn niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'De indicatiepraktijk: Wijkverpleging onder druk en in de kou'

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Health about the division of responsibilities between health insurers and nurses who assess care needs, after reports that insurers revise nursing care plans without first consulting the assessing nurse. The minister answers that the nurse is responsible for the assessment, insurers check lawfulness and efficiency and should first seek clarification, disputes go to the SKGZ, and he will examine unclarities but mainly points to ongoing agreements and a planned insurer document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de voorbereiding op een mogelijke toename van besmettingen met de Engelse coronavariant

An MP asked the health minister fourteen questions on preparedness for a possible surge of infections with the English coronavirus variant, covering case numbers, testing and quarantine capacity, hospital supplies, and school reopening. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation, so the questions themselves are not answered in this document.
Can you answer these questions in your letter ahead of the next plenary debate on developments surrounding the coronavirus?
Kunt u deze vragen beantwoorden in uw brief voorafgaand aan het eerstvolgende plenaire debat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Vrijgevestigde artsen boren goudader aan met coronatesten'

SP MP Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports that self-employed doctors profited heavily from COVID-19 testing fees, whether this influenced testing policy, and whether lab revenues, test prices and doctors' income could be disclosed or reclaimed. The minister said excessive earnings are undesirable but no rules were broken, found no sign that OMT members' finances influenced advice, refused to publish per-lab figures and income data as commercially confidential, saw no short-term way to make specialist income transparent, and ruled out reclaiming the money while backing the NVMM call for voluntary restraint.
The number of tests performed and revenue per laboratory is commercially sensitive information and I therefore cannot make it public.
De hoeveelheid verrichtte testen en omzet per laboratorium is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en kan ik derhalve niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over de mededeling dat er 4 januari 2021 gestart kan worden met vaccineren

An MP from the VVD asked the Health Minister on what basis he announced vaccinations could start on 4 January 2021, and raised concerns from LHV, Actiz and CNV about readiness, protocols, staffing, materials and ICT. The minister answered that the timing rested on EMA expectations and intensive consultation with implementing parties, that guidance and implementation agreements are being issued, and that staffing and materials are being arranged, while declining to answer the questions separately before the next debate.
On that basis, and on the basis of intensive consultation with implementing parties, I expressed the expectation that, if all goes well, we could start the first vaccination in the week of 4 January.
Op basis daarvan en op basis van intensief overleg met uitvoerende partijen heb ik de verwachting uitgesproken om -als alles meezit- in de week van 4 januari te kunnen starten met de eerste prik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ''Registreer wie welk vaccin krijgt’, zeggen de apothekers''

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how the central vaccination registry works, when it would be operational, whether vaccine batches would be traceable, and what legal issues apply. The minister answered that the registry went live in early January 2021, uses registration at source with patient consent under GDPR and WGBO, and that vaccines will not carry scannable codes but recipients receive a certificate with vaccine type and batch number.
The central registration system was put into use in the first week of January.
Het centrale registratiesysteem is in de eerste week van januari in gebruik genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de vaccinatiestrategie

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Health Minister why the COVID-19 vaccination rollout in the Netherlands is slower than abroad, why GGDs started site planning late, and about the invitation system, staffing, testing capacity and vaccine wastage. The minister answers that the first vaccinations were given on 6 January, that central sites were chosen on RIVM advice because of cold-storage and wastage concerns, and that most questions are answered by reference to earlier letters.

Because of the deep-frozen storage conditions combined with the limited shelf life after thawing, the specific delivery method, and to prevent as much wastage as possible, the cabinet opted in early December, on RIVM advice, to administer the BioNTech/Pfizer vaccine at central locations.

Vanwege de diepgevroren bewaarcondities in combinatie met de beperkte houdbaarheid na ontdooien, de specifieke wijze van levering, én om zo veel mogelijk spillage te voorkomen, heeft het kabinet begin december op advies van het RIVM gekozen voor toediening van het BioNTech/Pfizer vaccin via centrale locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over de vaccinatiestrategie in Nederland

MPs Jetten and Diertens (D66) asked the health minister about the Dutch COVID-19 vaccination strategy, including why logistics for the BioNTech/Pfizer vaccine (ultra-cold storage, 975-dose packs) were not anticipated earlier, why care workers were prioritised over frail elderly, and why the start was late. The minister answered that preparations began before summer 2020, RIVM discussed packaging with Pfizer from October and repacking proved unfeasible, and the strategy was adjusted after Gezondheidsraad advice.
The RIVM was not surprised that the vaccine was packaged differently from vaccines normally used, for example against flu.
Het RIVM was niet verrast dat het vaccin anders verpakt was dan vaccins die regulier worden ingezet, bijvoorbeeld tegen de griep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over sneltesten

An MP asked the health minister how many rapid COVID-19 tests are in stock broken down by manufacturer and type, the forecast for rapid test procurement, the estimated number of private rapid tests, and for answers before 19 November. The minister listed five validated antigen test manufacturers, reported about 6.8 million tests in stock at end November, said procurement would be increased toward 10 million tests per month, said private test numbers are unknown, and said answers before 19 November were not possible.
The numbers of antigen (rapid) tests administered there are not known to me.
De aantallen antigeen(snel)testen die daar worden afgenomen zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mogelijke terugtrekking van de Corman-Drosten paper inzake de PCR-test

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister whether the Corman-Drosten PCR paper, used as basis for SARS-CoV-2 test kits, should be retracted following a peer-review challenge, and whether RIVM should respond and testing policy should change. The minister acknowledged the critique, said the journal is conducting its own independent review and that he awaits its outcome, and rejected the calls to change testing policy.
Via RIVM I understand that the journal is currently conducting its own independent research to see whether the criticism is justified.
Via het RIVM heb ik begrepen dat het tijdschrift momenteel haar eigen onafhankelijk onderzoek verricht om te bezien of de kritiek terecht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de effecten van een slechte luchtkwaliteit voor herstellende COVID-19 patiënten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government whether people recovering from COVID-19 are harmed by wood-burning smoke, whether ventilation advice conflicts with it, and why the Clean Air Agreement lacks binding measures such as a ban during smoke alerts and enforcement of complaints. The State Secretary answers that the health risks are plausible but not scientifically proven, points to voluntary measures (stookwijzer, pilot projects, complaint routing to municipalities) and declines a stoking ban for now.
As I explained in response to the Van Esch motion, I will ask municipalities to seriously follow up on reports received via the stookwijzer.
Zoals ik in reactie op de motie van Van Esch 4 , heb toegelicht, zal ik gemeenten vragen om serieus opvolging te geven aan meldingen die binnenkomen via de stookwijzer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over de berichtgeving ‘Gommers en Kuipers: 'Begin maandag met vaccineren ziekenhuispersoneel'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister whether he would heed calls by intensivist Gommers and hospital director Kuipers to start vaccinating essential hospital staff immediately, given rising sick leave and postponed treatments, and when staff such as ICU, emergency and ambulance workers would be eligible. The minister replied only by referring to a broader letter on the COVID-19 vaccination strategy update.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 vaccination strategy update status'
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 vaccinatiestrategie update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over de uitzending het interview met burgemeester Aboutaleb van Rotterdam

Two CDA MPs asked whether people awaiting or with a positive COVID-19 test should be obliged to stay home, and whether mayors can enforce this under the Public Health Act. The minister agreed that such people should stay home, confirmed that stay-at-home is currently voluntary, and explained that mandatory quarantine lies with the safety region chair under the Wpg, not the mayor, so mayors cannot enforce it without amending the law.
Without amending the Wpg, mayors therefore have no powers to make staying at home mandatory after a positive test result and to enforce that obligation.
Zonder aanpassing van de Wpg zijn er dus geen mogelijkheden voor burgemeesters om thuisblijven verplicht te stellen bij een positieve testuitslag en om deze verplichting te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van den Berg over koude werkplekken in het onderwijs

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education and of Health about cold classrooms, school ventilation norms, the SUDS/SUViS funding, UV-C and ionisation research, and air purifiers. The minister answered that school boards must ensure a safe workplace and that funding for ventilation (SUViS, opening 1 January 2021) does not cover specific air purifiers, while stating no research commission on UV-C or ionisation is planned for now.
Yes, but I do not expect the impossible of schools.
Ja, maar ik verwacht niet het onmogelijke van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over vervoer na overlijden bij overplaatsing naar een ander ziekenhuis

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether relatives of COVID-19 patients who died after transfer to another hospital face high costs for transporting the body home, and how that is communicated. The Minister said about 30 such deaths are estimated, 34 relatives applied to the Ombudsman for Funeral Services for a contribution, and insurers have shown goodwill, with the Ombudsman acting as contact point for those affected.
That is why I am willing to bear these extra costs and have got the Ombudsman for Funeral Services to act as a contact point for anyone affected.
Daarom ben ik bereid deze extra kosten te dragen en heb ik de Ombudsman voor het Uitvaartwezen bereid gevonden om als aanspreekpunt voor eventuele gedupeerden te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de mogelijke sluiting van de Spoedeisende Hulp in Gorinchem

An MP asked the minister about the possible closure of the emergency department in Gorinchem, which would force patients to travel further, and what guarantees exist for timely access to emergency care. The minister answered that closure is not at issue, outlined the conditions and the RIVM accessibility analysis required before any closure, and invited the petitioners to the consultation on the acute care sketch.
There is no question of (the need for) closing the emergency department at the Beatrixziekenhuis.
Er is geen sprake van (de noodzaak tot) een sluiting van de SEH in het Beatrixziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Klaver over het COVID-19 virus

MPs Kröger and Klaver asked the Health Minister about the RIVM guidance distinguishing 'vluchtig' from 'niet-vluchtig' contact for protective equipment in care, the delay in revising it, mask stocks and prices, regional versus national COVID measures, and whether the OMT should be reconvened. The minister answered that the guidance was a risk-based set of principles that could be departed from professionally, that the revision in August reflected practical problems rather than new science, that masks stocks were sufficient, and that regional measures were preferred with national action when needed.
The Ministry of VWS has no substantive role in determining the guidelines.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen inhoudelijke rol bij het vaststellen van de uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het artikel “Hoe 'testen, testen, testen' stukliep op een muur van eigenbelang”

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a Follow the Money article on conflicts of interest hampering the scale-up of COVID-19 testing, including dual roles of OMT member Vossen and fees of specialists. The minister largely disputed that testing was deliberately blocked, said a 70,000-per-day shortfall was never the case, and pointed to new steps to strengthen testing governance, while giving only generic answers on fees and conflicts.
Ms Vossen, as chair of the NVMM, together with several experts took the initiative in March to establish the diagnostics taskforce with the aim of increasing testing capacity.
Mevrouw Vossen heeft als voorzitter van de NVMM samen met enkele deskundigen in maart het initiatief genomen tot oprichting van de taskforce diagnostiek met als doel de testcapaciteit te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het plots sluiten van de teststraat op Schiphol

MPs Paternotte and Diertens (D66) asked the Health Minister why the Schiphol testing facility for travellers from high-risk areas was suddenly closed, whether it was a trial, and related questions on testing policy. The minister answered that the facility was a voluntary sample-based trial, closed because of pressure on lab capacity, and provided some figures but gave only partial answers on the trial design and did not commit to reopening.
The intention to close the test facility once the trial results came in is indeed something I did not mention.
Het voornemen om de teststraat weer te sluiten nadat de resultaten van de proef binnen zouden komen, heb ik inderdaad niet genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over dreigende tekorten aan testmaterialen

MP Asscher asked the health minister whether shortages of plastic testing materials for COVID-19 tests were looming, which suppliers were used, how stocks are monitored, and why the Chamber was not kept informed despite a motion. The minister replied that critical items such as filter tips are being addressed through procurement and alternative suppliers, that in-house cartridge production is being set up, and that he trusts testing targets can be met.
With the progress report that I send to the House every two weeks, I give your House an update on the state of affairs regarding testing.
Met de voortgangsrapportage die ik tweewekelijks naar de Kamer stuur geef ik uw Kamer een update over de stand van zaken rondom testen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht van Bits of Freedom over de Coronatester

MP Hijink (SP) asked the health minister about a planned CoronaTester app and whether it would become a corona health passport, and about voluntariness and societal risks. The minister said the app is being explored to support testing, that privacy, fundamental rights and voluntariness will be weighed, and that the Health Council will advise, but gave no firm details and promised to inform parliament later.
As I informed you by letter of 18 November, the OMT advises in its 85th advice to explore the possibility of requiring a negative test result on entry to the Netherlands for all travellers.

Zoals ik u bij brief van 18 november heb gemeld adviseert het OMT in haar 85e advies om de mogelijkheid te verkennen van het eisen van een negatieve testuitslag bij binnenkomst in Nederland voor alle reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Kröger over het mogelijk instellen van een (regionale) avondklok-maatregel

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would use the Coordination Act on states of emergency or the Act on extraordinary powers of civil authority to impose a (regional) evening curfew during the COVID-19 pandemic, and why it now considered this after earlier saying a state of emergency was not necessary. Minister Grapperhaus answered that a curfew is not currently on the table, that it would be based on article 8 of the Wbbbg without declaring a state of emergency, that parliament would be informed in advance by royal decree, and that no substantive weighing of curfew measures has yet been made.
Of an intention to do so, notice will be given to the States General, so that views can be exchanged between government and States General if desired, unless urgency prevents it.

Van een voornemen daartoe zal mededeling worden gedaan aan de Staten-Generaal, zodat daarover desgewenst tussen regering en Staten-Generaal van gedachten kan worden gewisseld, tenzij de vereiste spoed zich daartegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zingen in groepsverband

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health why group singing was banned for people over thirteen, on what evidence the exceptions rest, and how choirs and conductors were informed and compensated. The Minister cites OMT advice that singing cannot be ruled out as a transmission risk, notes the ban has since become a strong recommendation, and offers talks with choir representatives and the financial support available to conductors.

I am willing to enter into discussion with representatives of choirs and conductors and would also gladly involve my colleagues from Justice and Security and Education, Culture and Science, with whom the measures are coordinated.
Ik ben bereid om het gesprek aan te gaan met vertegenwoordigers van koren en dirigenten en betrek ook graag mijn collega's van JenV en OCW, met wie de maatregelen worden afgestemd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Paternotte en Pia Dijkstra over de kabinetsreactie op het 73e OMT COVID-19 advies en de berichten over het testbeleid van Duitsland en Frankrijk, respectievelijk het bericht over

MPs from D66 asked the health and infrastructure ministers about testing of travellers from high-risk countries, airport contact tracing, air cargo capacity and pricing for vaccine distribution, and EU vaccine negotiations. The ministers answered that testing and quarantine measures are being developed, that contact tracing follows RIVM guidance, and that logistics preparations and EU negotiations are ongoing, but declined to answer each question separately.
Unfortunately, this has not proven possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over incorrecte cijfers van ziekenhuisopnames

MPs Diertens and Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the Minister of Health why hospital admission figures on the coronavirus dashboard were wrong, when the ministry knew, whether Parliament was informed, and whether meeting records and advice of the BAO and OMT could be shared. The minister explained that the discrepancy came mainly from broader testing rather than delayed reporting, that the dashboard switched to NICE data on 13 October, and refused to release OMT and BAO minutes citing confidentiality and Article 68 of the Constitution while sharing some advice.
I do not have OMT minutes available and they are not public.
OMT-verslagen heb ik niet beschikbaar en zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het COVID-19 reproductiegetal (R)

An MP asked the health minister whether incomplete reporting of positive results from commercial test sites undermines the reliability of the COVID-19 reproduction number R, and how it is calculated. The minister answered that under-reporting is limited, that inspection and reporting duties are enforced, and that R is checked against hospital-admission-based estimates.
My efforts are therefore aimed at receiving all positive results from commercial test sites.
Mijn inspanningen zijn er dus op gericht om alle positieve uitslagen van commerciële teststraten te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Aartsen over 'Spanje wil tweede instorting toerisme voorkomen'

MPs Dijkstra, Koopmans and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether safe travel corridors and rapid testing could revive tourism, following reports on Spain's Semana Santa operation, and how the EU and other parties could set criteria. The minister said the current COVID situation rules out reopening tourism now, promised to make necessary travel safer via negative test certificates and a possible shorter quarantine, and said a possible Schiphol–Atlanta corridor is being explored.
Therefore, at this moment there is no question of restarting tourism.
Daarom is op dit moment geen sprake van het weer op gang helpen van toerisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ontwikkeling en distributie van coronavaccins

An SP MP asks the health and economic affairs ministers about COVID-19 vaccine patents, C-TAP participation, global distribution, public funding, pricing transparency, mRNA safety and vaccination registration. The minister defends the intellectual property system, says compulsory licences are not currently warranted, cites confidentiality for withholding price details, and promises further information to parliament.
The information is preferably public, but may remain confidential because of commercially sensitive information or the negotiating position.
De informatie is bij voorkeur openbaar, maar kan omwille van bedrijfsgevoelige informatie, of de onderhandelingspositie, vertrouwelijk blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het Dik-Faber over de toegang tot mondzorg voor mensen in de schuldsanering

An MP asked the minister whether people entering debt rescheduling are forced to cancel supplementary health insurance, including dental cover, and what this means for access to care and recovery. The minister said he knows of no signals of forced cancellation, that insurers suspend supplementary cover for premium arrears, and pointed to municipal tools and a planned conference, without committing to new rules.
I am not aware of signals that people in a debt assistance process are forced to cancel their supplementary health insurance.
Ik ben niet bekend met signalen dat mensen in een schuldhulpverleningstraject zitten gedwongen worden om hun aanvullende zorgverzekering op te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Ellemeet over de laatste ontwikkelingen betreffende COVID-19

MPs Klaver and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 test capacity, lab shortages, PPE shortage claims in elderly care, and the shifting testing targets. The minister answered that testing capacity now exceeds demand, that shortages were due to multiple causes, and that the PPE guidelines were not driven by scarcity, while acknowledging the testing targets were revised upward after demand surged and admitting the answers were late.
I do not have figures on what share of the critical/other COVID-19 category is carried out for healthcare personnel.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over welk deel van de kritieke/overige Covid-19 categorie uitgevoerd wordt voor personeel in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de gewijzigde criteria bij het beoordelen van een PCR-test

Van Haga asked the health minister whether changed PCR test assessment criteria (fragment targets and cycle threshold raised from 30 to 35) explain the rise in positive tests, why changes were not communicated, and whether this distorts the data. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter ('Gewijzigde criteria PCR-test', Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 765) and provides a footnote link to the RIVM guideline, without answering the questions on substance.

Further answer: the written questions from MP Van Haga (FvD) to the Minister of Health on the changed criteria for assessing a PCR test (submitted 13 October 2020) have been answered by letter 'Changed PCR test criteria' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 765).

Nader antwoord De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Van Haga (FvD) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gewijzigde criteria bij het beoordelen van een PCR-test (ingezonden 13 oktober 2020) ( 2020Z18662 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Gewijzigde criteria PCR-test» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 765 ) X
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over het bericht ‘Schaarste testmaterialen dreigt, Nederlandse producten verdwijnen naar buitenland’

GreenLeft MPs Klaver and Kröger asked the Health Minister whether shortages of PCR test materials are looming, why Dutch-based producer Bioplastics supplies only two percent of its output to the Netherlands, and whether shortages can be ruled out. The minister answered that stocks of tubes, swabs and cartridges are adequate, that filter tips are a critical item being actively sourced, and that a Dutch cartridge production line and alternative tests are being pursued, though individual laboratories may still face shortages.
I note that there is currently no need for the centrally purchased cartridges.
Ik constateer dat aan de centraal ingekochte cartridges momenteel geen behoefte is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het bericht 'Twee asielzoekers in azc Ter Apel besmet met Corona'

MPs Becker and Veldman asked about reports of COVID-19 infections at the Ter Apel reception centre, including the applicable protocol, quarantine of contacts and arrivals from high-risk areas, and protection of staff and vulnerable asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that no Ter Apel-specific protocol exists, describes the general COA/GGD/GZA protocol, and sets out quarantine, testing and staff protection measures, while several answers note capacity constraints.
There is no protocol specifically for the Ter Apel reception centre. Therefore I cannot provide it to you.
Er is geen protocol voor specifiek het aanmeldcentrum ter Apel. Derhalve kan ik u dat niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Peters over het rapport van de ombudsman 'Blijvende zorg'

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister how the Ombudsman's report 'Blijvende zorg' on people with complex, long-term care needs should be addressed, including the size of the affected group, the role of the Juiste Loket, client support and who is accountable when care is organised across domains. The minister acknowledged the problems, listed ongoing access-improvement projects and client-support pilots, gave figures on Wlz and Wmo recipients, and committed to further monitoring and a forthcoming bill on Wlz client support.
There is no national registration of the number of people who actually use these provisions.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van het aantal mensen dat daadwerkelijk een beroep doet op deze voorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het voorstel in de gemeente Oldenzaal om de huishoudelijke verzorging uit de Wmo te halen

MP Hijink (SP) asked the minister whether the Oldenzaal motion to move household care out of the Wmo into special assistance is lawful, and about its wider effects and the deficits in the social domain. The minister answered that the plan conflicts with the Wmo 2015 and is not permitted, that he has contacted Oldenzaal and may use interbestuurlijk toezicht, and that a monitor of the subscription tariff is being followed.
The intention to remove domestic help from the Wmo 2015 and make it part of special assistance runs counter to the law's principles and is not permitted.
Het voornemen om huishoudelijke hulp uit de Wmo 2015 te halen en onderdeel te maken van de bijzondere bijstand staat haaks op de uitgangspunten van de wet en is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over een verkeerde inschatting in de vraag naar griepvaccinaties

An MP from D66 asked the health minister why the flu vaccine supply was insufficient and whether the government misjudged demand, plus related questions on procurement timing, correspondence and the priority group. The state secretary answered that vaccine ordering followed standard forecasting, that extra doses were bought when possible, that the minister acknowledged she would have wanted more, and that a priority rule was set for healthy 60-69 year olds, while refusing to send correspondence within the deadline.
I can share the correspondence with your House, but this cannot be done within the deadline you set for answering these questions.
Ik kan de correspondentie met uw Kamer delen, maar dit lukt niet binnen de door u gestelde termijn voor beantwoording van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht dat zorgmedewerkers met corona toch moeten komen werken

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the health minister whether zorgmedewerkers with COVID-19 may still be made to work, whether they accept exceptions to isolation rules when rosters cannot be filled, and how care continuity is ensured without endangering patients. The minister answered that positive staff must not work and cannot be forced to, that narrow exceptions in FMS and RIVM guidance require documented, safe risk assessments, and that regional steering groups and staffing measures will be used; the answer to the eighth question was not given in time for the committee debate.
Staff who have tested positive may not work and may also not be forced to work.
Medewerkers die positief getest zijn, mogen niet werken en mogen ook niet worden gedwongen om te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het artikel ‘Top verdienen aan jeugdzorg in Tilburg’

The MP Hijink (SP) asked the state secretary about reports that youth care providers in Tilburg and elsewhere earn high profits while municipalities face deficits, and about tariffs, procurement models, staff costs and supervision. The state secretary answered that municipalities set their own tariffs and procurement, that the Wibz bill will allow conditions on profit distribution, that financial supervision lies with municipalities and quality supervision with the Inspectie, and that a study on extra structural funding for youth care is underway.
Financial supervision lies with the municipality, which must check whether providers meet the conditions of contracting and tendering.
Het financieel toezicht ligt bij de gemeente die moet controleren of aanbieders voldoen aan de voorwaarden van de contractering en aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Tekorten in zorg, forse winst bedrijven: vijftig tinten grijs op een lucratieve markt’

An MP asked the health minister about reports of high profit margins (up to 42.4%) at care providers, weak municipal control over contracted providers, and delays in integrity legislation. The minister said profits are acceptable for continuity but that high margins warrant checks by municipalities and the ministry, pointed to existing municipal oversight tools, and said the Wibz bill will be consulted in spring 2021 while a study on municipal funding is due end 2020.
I believe that high profit margins give cause to examine why they are possible and whether the quality of care delivered is adequate.
Ik vind dat bij hoge winstpercentages er aanleiding is om na te gaan waarom het mogelijk is dat deze behaald worden en of de kwaliteit van de geleverde zorg wel afdoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het artikel op Zembla van 11 augustus 2020 over de toegang voor hulphonden in openbare ruimtes

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about a Zembla report that the law guaranteeing access for assistance dogs in public places is not working in practice, and about enforcement, reporting to the complaints body and courts, and awareness measures. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and courts handle complaints and criminal enforcement is possible, and said a European standardisation process is the main focus rather than an evaluation.
The College has set up the procedure to be as low-threshold as possible.
Het College heeft de procedure zodanig ingericht dat deze zo laagdrempelig mogelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de heer Bouali geld kreeg van het ministerie van VWS voor een coronacampagne en ook een promo maakte voor de minister voor zijn CDA-lijsttrekkersverkiezing

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked Minister De Jonge whether Ali B received Health Ministry money for a coronavirus influencer campaign and whether he was paid for a promo video backing De Jonge's CDA leadership bid. The minister answered that the campaign was run via agency Roorda with artists Boef and Famke Louise and that the agency paid SPEC EUR 42,350 plus EUR 24,224 for concept work, and that Ali B was not paid for the video.
Ali B. expressed his support in a short video message for my leadership election for the CDA.
Ali B. heeft in een korte videoboodschap zijn steun betuigd voor mijn lijst0trekkersverkiezing voor het CDA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de betalingen voor de Jongeren Corona campagne van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport aan diverse artiesten

An MP asked the Health Minister about a EUR 66,574 invoice paid to an advertising agency for a youth COVID campaign using rapper Boef and Famke Louise, whether the fees were excessive, and whether there was a conflict of interest linked to Ali B's later video. The minister defended the use of artists for reaching youth, said the fees were lower than typical for their reach, and denied any conflict of interest because he was not involved in contracting.
Neither in the request to Roorda by the NKC, nor in Roorda's proposal to deploy these artists, nor in the contract negotiations was I involved.
Noch bij de uitvraag aan Roorda door het NKC, noch bij het voorstel om deze artiesten in te zetten door Roorda, noch bij de contractonderhandelingen ben ik betrokken geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bieden van perspectief aan ondernemers na de gedeeltelijke lockdown en het onderzoek naar aanleiding van het OMT-advies over restaurants

An MP from the VVD asked the government how it would respond to the OMT advice on restaurants and the promised talks with hospitality and events sectors about prospects after the partial lockdown, including progress on FieldLab initiatives. The government answered that talks with sector representatives are ongoing, that segmented measures are being discussed, that FieldLab programmes for events are being developed with a possible start in January, and that the RIVM advice on the events FieldLab is pending.
The cabinet would like sectors to come forward with new initiatives if these can offer new prospects.
Het kabinet ziet graag dat sectoren zich melden met nieuwe initiatieven als die nieuwe perspectieven kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Krol over schrijnende quarantaine in verzorgingshuis

Krol asked the minister about an elderly woman quarantined for two weeks in a Nunspeet care home with only a commode and no shower, questioning why testing was not used instead and whether the facility should be inspected. The minister said the woman has since moved to a new location, that testing cannot replace quarantine, and that the facility considers the situation undesirable, without committing to a quality inspection.
Are you willing to subject the location to a quality inspection?
Bent u bereid de locatie aan een kwaliteitsonderzoek te onderwerpen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over ventilatiesystemen in schoolgebouwen

Two SP MPs asked whether school ventilation systems meet standards, how quickly they could be improved, which countries the RIVM cited for keeping schools open, and what it would cost to fix ventilation in all Dutch schools. The minister said the OMT and RIVM saw no reason to change ventilation policy, pointed schools to existing Bouwbesluit requirements and guidance, noted that 11 percent of school buildings in an incomplete survey fell short, and referred to a 360 million euro fund that municipalities can draw on with schools.
The advice to schools is, insofar as they have not yet done so, to check their ventilation against the applicable requirements.
Het advies aan scholen is – voor zover dat nog niet gedaan is – hun ventilatie te controleren op de daarvoor geldende eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de classificatie van COVID-19 en aanverwante vragen

An MP asked the health minister about the case fatality and infection fatality rates of COVID-19 versus influenza, its A-class classification, the 1.5-metre distancing rule and the PCR test validity. The minister answered with figures, explained that the CFR difference reflects changed testing policy, kept the A-classification and gave the rationale for 1.5 metres, while withholding some model data by referring to the RIVM website.
I see no reason to change the classification of COVID-19 at this time.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de classificatie van COVID-19 op dit moment aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Testlijnmedewerkers kunnen bij persoonsgegevens, ook als dat niet mag'

Written questions from MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a report that COVID test-line call-centre staff could access personal data even where not permitted, and whether this violates the GDPR. The minister replied that staff need access to records to schedule appointments and check results, that logging and confidentiality agreements provide safeguards, that the GGD addresses misuse with consequences, and that the AVG applies to the call centre.
Let me first state that I consider care in handling personal data to be of great importance.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat ik zorgvuldigheid bij het omgaan met persoonsgegevens van groot belang vind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Smeulders en Buitenweg over Coronatestlijn

MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reports that staff of the coronavirus testing helpline could access personal data beyond what their tasks required, about WhatsApp data sharing, training, outsourcing to Teleperformance, unpaid hours and working conditions. The government answered that access is necessary for the job, that logging and confidentiality agreements safeguard privacy, that GGD-GHOR is responsible, and that labour conditions are for employers and social partners, with the Inspectie SZW available for complaints.
Care in handling personal data is of course of great importance.
Zorgvuldigheid is bij het omgaan met persoonsgegevens uiteraard van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de nog altijd voortdurende dreiging van het coronavirus in de vleesindustrie

MP Ouwehand asked the ministers whether they would prevent meat processor Vion from raising slaughter rates and why no intervention followed at Vion and Van Rooi Meat, and asked about coronavirus transmission via meat and the scope of slaughterhouse testing. The minister replied that slaughter hours were only temporarily reduced and are returning to normal, that the safety region judged the situations safe enough and acted case by case, and that testing is risk-based and scientific evidence shows food transmission is very unlikely.
It is up to the chair of the safety region, within infectious disease control, to take the most suitable control measures case by case.
Het is aan de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio in het kader van infectieziektenbestrijding om per geval de meest geëigende (beheers)maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over het voldoen aan artikel 68 van de Grondwet

Two MPs from D66 asked the health minister whether the government complies with article 68 of the Constitution, which requires ministers to give parliament requested information unless state interests oppose it, concerning withheld OMT and BAO meeting records and the early handling of personal protective equipment in January and February 2020. The minister refused to release OMT minutes and BAO records, citing the confidentiality needed for expert advice and the constitutional limits of article 68, while giving a detailed chronology of PPE procurement and inventory steps.
The relevant OMT minutes are not provided for the reasons stated in the answer to question 4.
De desbetreffende OMT-notulen worden niet verstrekt om redenen vermeld in het antwoord op vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de onderzoeken naar de werking van mondmaskers

Two SP MPs asked the minister to explain the basis of RIVM's claims that medical face masks could create false security, given that the RIVM said no scientific study showed this and later cited preprints. The minister answered that the remarks concerned FFP2 masks used in care, were based on expert opinion and WHO/ECDC consensus, and that the earlier reference to studies was an error, but did not provide the studies requested.
Unfortunately, confusion has arisen about Mr Van Dissel's statements on the use of face masks during the technical briefing of 22 April 2020 and the possible occurrence of false security.

Er is helaas onduidelijkheid ontstaan over de uitspraken van de heer Van Dissel over het gebruik van mondneusmaskers tijdens de technische briefing op 22 april 2020 en het mogelijk optreden van schijnveiligheid daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Jetten over 'Wouter wilde bloedplasma doneren voor middel tegen corona, maar werd geweigerd'

MPs Bergkamp and Jetten asked the Minister of Health why gay and bisexual men are excluded from donating blood plasma against COVID-19 and what the criteria are. The minister explained that Sanquin's MSM-based selection rules rest on higher infection risks and announced that a 4-month deferral criterion will extend to plasma donations, while a RIVM study on sexual risk behaviour as an alternative criterion has been delayed.
Sanquin has informed me that the current selection criterion for whole blood donation by men who have sex with men (MSM) will soon also apply to plasma donations.

Sanquin heeft mij laten weten dat het huidige selectiecriterium voor het doneren van volbloed door mannen die seks hebben gehad met andere mannen (MSM) binnenkort ook van toepassing zal zijn voor plasmadonaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de waarschuwing dat de gemuteerde varianten van het coronavirus die rondgaan in de nertsenfokkerij, ongevoelig zijn voor de ontwikkelde vaccins

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether mink-derived SARS-CoV-2 variants found in Denmark could make COVID-19 vaccines ineffective and whether the Netherlands was aware of the risk. The minister answered that the risk was theoretical and unconfirmed, that Dutch mink farms are being culled as a precaution, and that the Netherlands has raised the issue at EU level.
The legislative process for the cessation scheme is proceeding as planned.
Het wetgevingstraject voor de stoppersregeling loopt als gepland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het artikel 'Helft minder slachtoffers moord en doodslag in 20 jaar'

Three MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about a CBS report showing that over half of women killed in 2015-2019 were killed by a partner or ex-partner, and whether prior police contact existed and how police respond. The government confirmed the figures, said police and prosecution systems cannot provide case-level data on prior contact, and described existing protective measures and COVID-related steps without committing to new concrete action.
