No, unfortunately I cannot. The police and the Public Prosecution Service cannot, based on the records in their systems, provide insight into the cases involving (ex-)partner violence with fatal outcomes in the period 2015 through 2019.

Nee, dat kan ik helaas niet. De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kunnen op basis van de registraties in hun systemen geen inzicht geven in de gevallen waarbij sprake was van (ex-)partnergeweld met dodelijke afloop in de periode 2015 tot en met 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Dierenbeschermers willen verbod op reptielenbeurs in Houten: ‘Kan in coronatijd niet door de beugel’’

An MP asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Health about a reptile fair in Houten held during the coronavirus crisis, including exotic species, possible zoonotic risks, legality of origin and enforcement by the NVWA. The minister replied that neither the Besluit houders van dieren nor the Wet publieke gezondheid allows preventive bans on animal fairs, that inspections and enforcement are carried out, and declined to answer the questions again in the committee debate.
Neither the Besluit houders van dieren under the Wet Dieren nor the Wet publieke gezondheid grants powers to preventively prohibit animal fairs.
Noch het Besluit houders van dieren onder de Wet Dieren, noch de Wet publieke gezondheid geeft bevoegdheden om beurzen met dieren preventief te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over de monitor Langer Thuis 2020 van het RIVM

The VVD MP Laan-Geselschap asked the minister whether the RIVM Langer Thuis 2020 monitor is adequate for parliamentary oversight, given that many indicators show outdated or unchanged figures and no interim results before summer 2021, and asked for an interim report in 2020. Minister De Jonge explained the unchanged indicators by program timelines or data not yet available, and pointed to the second progress report sent the same day as providing the most recent results, without committing to a separate interim report.
I share your interest in having a good picture of the progress of the Langer Thuis programme.
Ik deel uw belang om een goed beeld te hebben van de voortgang van het programma Langer Thuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Van den Bosch en Veldman over het toestaan en mogelijk maken van winterterrassen als reddingsboei voor horecaondernemers

VVD MPs asked whether winter terraces with covers and heaters could serve as a lifeline for hospitality businesses, whether municipalities should be encouraged to allow them, and what rules apply to tents and canopies under Covid measures. The government agreed terraces help and that municipalities should weigh allowing them, said it is a local decision, and explained that open-sided terraces count as outdoor locations, though it keeps no overview of municipal decisions.
Such an overview is not kept.
Een dergelijk overzicht wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Sazias over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus in verpleeghuizen

MPs Van Brenk and Sazias asked about ventilation checks in nursing homes, compliance with standards, repairs, and wastewater surveillance for coronavirus. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for their own ventilation, that no national figures on checked or repaired systems exist, and that wastewater sampling was increased to twice weekly with pilots underway.
I cannot give an estimate of how many ventilation systems have or have not been adapted and what period is still needed for this.
Ik kan geen inschatting geven van hoeveel ventilatiesystemen wel of niet zijn aangepast en welke periode hiervoor nog nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Duizenden kinderen worden uit huis geplaatst en dat kan zeer traumatisch zijn'

A VVD MP asked the ministers about reports that thousands of children are placed out of home in high-conflict (complex) divorces, covering terminology, triage, costs, registration, court procedures, and reporting quality. The state secretary answered largely by describing existing procedures, stating that cost and registration data on divorce-related cases are not available due to privacy rules, and committing to a policy response on equal parental care rights later in the year.
Due to privacy legislation, such data may not be used for another purpose, such as policy information.
Vanwege privacywetgeving mogen dergelijke gegevens niet worden gebruikt voor een ander doel, zoals beleidsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Testlabs kunnen wél meer aan, maar deze concurrentiestrijd zit in de weg'

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why COVID-19 testing was allocated to existing hospital and medical microbiology labs rather than large labs, and about pricing and central coordination. The Minister defended the phased allocation, said central coordination through the LCDK will be strengthened, and gave test prices for the Netherlands, France, Germany and Belgium.
I want to position the LCT more firmly and have appointed a new chair. The LCDK will become a service of the Ministry of VWS.
Ik wil de LCT steviger positioneren en heb een nieuwe voorzitter benoemd. Het LCDK wordt een dienst van het Ministerie van VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bonussen die uitgekeerd worden aan personeel op het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

An SP MP asked the health ministry how many staff received corona-related one-off bonuses, their highest and average amounts, the criteria used, and whether they had been paid. The minister reported 373 of about 1,500 staff received bonuses of 100 to 3,500 euro net (average 1,092 euro), based on overtime and duration, consistent with union agreements, and that all have been paid.
The employees who were granted a one-off reward have now received it.
De medewerkers die een incidentele beloning toegekend hebben gekregen, hebben deze inmiddels ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht meer dan een applaus voor de kraamzorg

An MP asked the ministers about a report on care workers in maternity care during COVID-19, including social distancing, protective equipment, the role of maternity carers, pay, and eligibility for the 2020 bonus. The minister answered that protective equipment follows RIVM guidance with employers responsible for supplying it, pay is for social partners to negotiate, and bonus eligibility is for care providers to assess, with no commitment to new action.
The Ministry of VWS does not consider it plausible that maternity care professionals fall one-to-one under the delineation criteria set out in the guidance.
Het Ministerie van VWS acht het niet aannemelijk dat de zorgprofessionals in de kraamzorg een op een vallen onder de afbakeningscriteria zoals gesteld in de handreiking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Ouders klem door onterechte meldingen kindermishandeling’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that parents were pressured after unfounded child abuse reports, including whether a 2016 promise of trauma aid for 600 families was carried out and where support is available. The State Secretary says aftercare was studied, shared with stakeholders and is being worked on, offers case-specific support and complaint routes, and notes that drang is being reconsidered following advisory bodies' report.
The research shows that not all those involved need aftercare.
Uit het onderzoek blijkt dat niet alle betrokkenen behoefte hebben aan nazorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gezondheidsschade van windturbines

Mr Baudet (FvD) asked whether wind turbine noise, especially low-frequency noise, causes serious health problems for residents, citing a Danish 20 dB indoor limit, a German 1,000 m distance rule, and the precautionary principle, and asked for a halt to nearby turbine projects. The State Secretary answered that no conclusive evidence exists yet, that Dutch noise norms cover the full spectrum and are about as strict as the Danish norm, that the RIVM will review the unpublished LUMC study, that a low-frequency research programme will be reported by summer 2021, and that existing projects will not be halted.
I will ask the RIVM to look at the research results when they are published.
Ik zal het RIVM vragen naar de onderzoeksresultaten te kijken wanneer deze gepubliceerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over de toegankelijkheid van gemeentelijke websites voor slechtzienden en slechthorenden

MPs Kerstens and Kuiken asked why many Dutch municipal websites still fail accessibility rules for visually and hearing-impaired users, despite earlier promises, and what enforcement the government will use. State Secretary Knops answered that the legal duty took effect on 23 September 2020, that obstacles such as lack of knowledge and resources explain non-compliance, that dedicated accessibility teams will be deployed, and that formal supervision will follow the Wet digitale overheid, which is still before the Senate.

To have all government organisations publish an accessibility statement as quickly as possible, all municipalities, water boards, provinces and national government organisations without a valid statement will be approached in the coming months by government accessibility teams and the Digitoegankelijk expertise centre.

Om zo snel mogelijk alsnog alle overheidsorganisaties een toegankelijkheids-verklaring te laten publiceren, worden in elk geval de komende maanden alle gemeenten, waterschappen, provincies en rijksoverheidsorganisaties zonder een (geldige) verklaring benaderd door toegankelijkheidsteams van de overheid en het expertisecentrum Digitoegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Mondkapjes blijven ‘made in China’, Arnhemse fabriek mag nog steeds geen medische mondkapjes maken'

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that an Arnhem mask factory was still not allowed to make medical masks, and why certification of the three government-selected domestic mask producers was taking so long. The minister explained the factory had self-certification problems with microbiological findings and that the three producers were in advanced certification stages with deliveries expected within weeks.
Mondmaskerfabriek BV is now having an independent test laboratory examine whether the microbiological deviation can be resolved through sterilisation with gamma radiation.
Mondmaskerfabriek BV laat nu in een onafhankelijk testlaboratorium onderzoeken of de microbiologische afwijking door middel van sterilisatie met gammastraling opgelost kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Vaccindeals staatsgeheim: experts roepen op tot transparantie’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about press reports that the EU vaccine purchase deals are state secrets and experts call for transparency, including comparisons with the H1N1 pandemic, the legal basis of confidentiality, and liability for vaccine damage. The Minister says the contracts are confidential under a Commission clause and binding on member states, that transparency is provided where possible, and that Nederland cannot commit to bear no liability costs, pointing to product liability law and limited indemnification.
I can say little about the precise text of the contracts.
Over de precieze tekst van de contracten kan ik weinig kwijt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de huidige visie van het kabinet op het gebruik van hydroxychloroquine in de strijd tegen COVID-19

Two MPs asked the minister about a Dutch study reporting reduced ICU admission with early hydroxychloroquine and whether the government will keep hydroxychloroquine available and follow up on the findings. The minister answered that the government will leave the judgement on hydroxychloroquine to experts, monitor developments and keep supply under review, and that an advisory panel will assess further research.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Uitgaan is nu een avondje zitten’

An MP asked several ministers about illegal parties during COVID restrictions, enforcement numbers, the option of controlled reopening of venues, and support for the sector. The government answered that enforcement data cannot be split by party type, that nightclubs stay closed due to infection risk, that a ventilation pilot is being prepared, and that financial support schemes continue.
Unfortunately, a breakdown by illegal parties and festivals cannot be made.
Een uitsplitsing naar illegale feesten en festivals is helaas niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Is de voorraad aan mondkapjes voldoende om een volgende besmettingspiek door te komen?’

An SP MP asked the minister whether the stock of face masks suffices for a next infection peak, including whether a ten-week buffer is needed and what happens if shortages arise. The minister answered that the national stockpile (LCH) can cover a second and for most products a third wave, longer than ten weeks, and pointed to a letter on preventive mask use and to ongoing monitoring of supply.
The results of the stress test showed that the LCH has sufficient stocks, in various scenarios, to meet a second wave and for most products even a third wave.
De uitkomsten van de stress test hebben laten zien dat het LCH voldoende voorraden heeft, in verschillende scenario's, om een tweede en voor de meeste producten zelfs een derde golf aan te kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de Ierse kleurcodes voor gedragsmaatregelen om de verspreiding van het coronavirus tegen te gaan

An MP asks the Health Minister about Ireland's colour-coded alert system for scaling up behavioural COVID-19 measures, whether it is too simple, and whether clear communication and a similar scheme can be introduced urgently. The minister confirms awareness, says a public version of a route map inspired by the Irish model has been published, and refers back to earlier answers without committing to a new scheme.
This public version contains different colours for different levels and is inspired by the Irish model.
Deze publieksversie bevat verschillende kleuren voor verschillende niveaus en is geïnspireerd op het Ierse model.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Culturele instellingen in chaos na coronamaatregelen

MPs asked the ministers why COVID-19 exemptions for cultural institutions differ between regions, why safety regions were unprepared, and whether a uniform rule set and RIVM-tested pilots are possible. The government answered that exemptions lapsed after the tougher measures of 13 October, that a uniform 30-visitor cap now applies and a routekaart improves predictability, and that a Fieldlab programme and RIVM advice will inform test events.
With these tougher measures, the possibility for the Safety Regions to grant exemptions has lapsed.
Met deze stevigere maatregelen is de mogelijkheid tot het verlenen van vrijstellingen door de Veiligheidsregio’s komen te vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bonussen aan personeel op het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

MPs Hijink asked whether ministry staff at VWS are dissatisfied with a 500 euro bonus, whether some received up to 5,000 euro, and how many received bonuses and how much. The minister answered that dissatisfaction is not known, that incidental rewards are standard practice across ministries under Rijk-wide frameworks, and that corona-related one-off rewards were agreed with unions, without giving the individual figures requested.
Incidentally, there is no question of a generic reward here.
Van een generieke beloning is hierbij overigens geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgsectoren bakkeleien over opleidingsplaatsen gz-psychologen

The MP asked why the government will not provide more structural training places for gz-psychologists despite rising demand, and why the allocation system favours larger training institutions. The state secretary replied that places follow the Capacity Organ's advice and budget room, that the 787 places for 2021 match the maximum advice, that the allocation system is the responsibility of the TOP foundation, and that the government will not change the system but will inform parliament after a November interim forecast.
I am awaiting the interim forecast of mid-November and do not want to anticipate it.
Ik wacht de tussentijdse raming van medio november af en wil daar niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over een demonstratieverbod bij abortusklinieken

An MP asked the health minister whether a Arnhem ban on demonstrations within 500 metres of an abortion clinic is welcome, whether other municipalities take similar measures, and whether a nationwide ban is needed after clinics asked for one. The minister answered that local mayors under the Public Manifestations Act must judge measures case by case, that other municipalities use varied arrangements, and that a national ban is not considered, while promoting knowledge exchange among municipalities.
Under the Wom, local authorities must assess per demonstration whether measures are necessary, which is also why a national ban is not under consideration.
Op grond van de Wom dient het lokale gezag per demonstratie te beoordelen of maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn, een landelijk verbod is ook daarom niet in beeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Beukering-Huijbrechts over de berichten ‘Slachthuis mocht openblijven ondanks vele coronabesmettingen’ en ‘Dit is waarom slachthuis Vion open mocht blijven ondanks de vele

Two D66 MPs asked why slaughterhouses Vion and Rooi Meat were allowed to stay open despite many COVID-19 infections, including why the safety region did not intervene at Rooi Meat when staffing exceeded the agreed level and why the NVWA did not stop slaughter. The minister answered that the safety region weighed the case, issued a warning rather than a sanction, deemed the situation safe, and that NVWA had no reason to halt operations, while promising to inform parliament on sector talks and noting a new national coordination platform.
The chair of the safety region weighed the situation and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction.
De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de besluitvorming in de coronapandemie

MP Asscher asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Health about the decision-making in the COVID-19 pandemic, including the clarity of the approach, the division of responsibilities and crisis structure, the informal Catshuis meetings, the criteria for the latest measures, and the role of behavioural scientists. Minister De Jonge answered that the strategy aims for targeted regional and national measures, described the layered advisory and ministerial decision-making structures, and declined to share the content of informal Catshuis discussions, citing the need for candid exchange.
It concerns informal and exploratory consultation at the initiative of the Prime Minister without a formal agenda.
Het betreft informeel en beschouwend overleg op initiatief van de Minister-President zonder formele agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over de uitwerking van de digitale ondersteuning van bron- en contactonderzoek

MPs Buitenweg and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about the government's digital support for contact tracing, including the GGD programme of requirements, reliance on Bluetooth technology, and the composition of the expert group and advisory committee. The minister answered that the programme of requirements was published on 19 May 2020, that Bluetooth was chosen after research on the Apple and Google framework, and described how expertise and the advisory committee were assembled.
No, that is not correct. The programme was presented to me on 19 May 2020 and I published it that same day.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Het programma is op 19 mei 2020 aan mij aangeboden en op die dag door mij gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van den Berg over de uitzending van Max meldpunt 'Driekwart mantelzorgers overbelast na coronaperiode'

CDA MPs asked the health minister about a survey finding that many informal carers are overburdened after the first COVID period and that day-care had not fully resumed. The minister says day-care can resume within RIVM guidelines, that municipalities received compensation and agreements were made with VNG and providers, and points to a carer support ladder and local examples.
Where clients indicate they cannot resolve matters with their provider, the Juiste Loket has been asked to help provider and client reach an appropriate solution through consultation.
Daar waar cliënten aangeven er met hun aanbieder niet uit te komen, is het Juiste Loket gevraagd eraan bij te dragen dat aanbieder en cliënt in overleg tot een passende oplossing komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) over de polymerase chain reaction-test (PCR-test)

The MP asks the Minister of Health to provide substantive answers to 14 questions on the PCR test, after a brief earlier reply was judged insufficient. The Minister refers the MP to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation, which has answered the questions, and points to the earlier related questions.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Status update letter COVID-19'
zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken brief COVID-19»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) over fout-positieve uitslagen van de PCR-testen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about news reports of possibly hundreds of false-positive PCR test results per week, and whether this affects case statistics and the corona measures. The answer, given by referring to a separate letter on the state of COVID-19, does not address the questions on substance and provides no new information in this document.
The written questions from MP Van Haga to the Minister of Health on false-positive PCR test results have been answered by means of the letter 'State of affairs letter COVID-19'.

De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over fout-positieve uitslagen van de PCR-testen ( 2020Z16256 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken brief COVID-19»
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) over testmethodes voor COVID-19

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the status, accuracy (false positives and negatives), costs and use of antigen, serological and PCR COVID-19 tests. The Minister's answer refers the questions to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 656) rather than answering them directly.
The written questions from MP Van Haga to the Minister of Health on COVID-19 test methods (2020Z16247) have been answered by means of the letter 'Status update letter COVID-19'.

De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over testmethodes voor COVID-19 ( 2020Z16247 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken brief COVID-19»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) over PCR-testuitslagen betreffende COVID-19 besmettingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about PCR test interpretation for COVID-19, including whether high Ct values mean non-infectiousness, the Dutch positivity cut-off, German versus Dutch laboratory practice, false-positive rates, whether Ct values are reported, and accreditation of foreign laboratories. The answers were deferred to a separate letter on the state of COVID-19 affairs, so no substantive answers are given here.

The written questions from MP Van Gerven (SP) to the Minister of Health on PCR test results for COVID-19 infections (2020Z17703) have been answered by means of the letter 'State of affairs letter COVID-19'.

De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over PCR-testuitslagen betreffende COVID-19 besmettingen ( 2020Z17703 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken brief COVID-19»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Zorg moet fundamenteel anders volgens 'coronaminister' Hugo de Jonge: 'Regie terug bij overheid’'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the COVID-19 crisis shows that healthcare can work without markets, and about his remarks on greater state steering, cooperation, and limits on insurer competition. The minister answered that cooperation should be strengthened within the existing framework, that patients' free choice of provider and insurer should not be absolutised, and that the policy direction would be set out in a later discussion note, without committing to structural change now.

We will consider these experiences, together with administrative and practical experiences such as the movement toward the right care in the right place, in the discussion note 'Care for the Future' which we will send to the House before the budget debate.
Deze ervaringen zullen we samen met de bestuurlijke en praktische ervaringen, zoals in de beweging naar de juiste zorg op de juiste plek, betrekken bij de discussienota «Zorg voor de toekomst».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Ploumen over onafhankelijk advies over welke lessen geleerd kunnen worden van de coronamaatregelen

MPs Hijink and Ploumen asked how the government is implementing the motion on independent lessons-learned advice on the corona measures, whether a kwartiermaker for evaluation was appointed with party ties to the minister, and whether the evaluation will be truly independent. The minister replied that over 90 external experts contributed through the Lessons Learned trajectory, that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid is conducting an independent evaluation, and that the government is accountable to parliament on the evaluation's design and results.
On how the evaluation is shaped and its results, the cabinet will account to your House.
Over de wijze waarop evaluatie wordt vormgegeven en de resultaten ervan legt het kabinet verantwoording af aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Coronarichtlijnen RIVM leidden tot onveiligheid in ouderenzorg’

Parliamentary member Kerstens asked whether RIVM guidelines on personal protective equipment left healthcare workers in unsafe situations in elderly care, and why the guidelines were not revised despite pressure from the field. The Minister replied that inspectorates received no reports that following RIVM guidelines caused unsafe situations, that the guidelines allow professional deviation, and that causes of infections in nursing homes will be part of the evaluation.
When asked further, it turned out that no risky situations arose because protective equipment was truly no longer available and/or RIVM guidelines could not be followed.
Bij doorvragen bleek dat er geen risicovolle situaties zijn ontstaan doordat er écht geen beschermingsmiddelen meer beschikbaar waren en/of RIVM-richtlijnen niet gevolgd konden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het anticiperen op de testcapaciteit in Nederland en het plotseling stoppen met testen van reizigers uit oranje gebieden op Schiphol

MPs Diertens and Paternotte (D66) asked the Health Minister about anticipating testing capacity and the sudden halt of testing travellers from orange-zone countries at Schiphol. The minister's answers describe RIVM capacity estimates, expansion steps, the Schiphol test-street pilot, and its temporary suspension due to lab capacity pressure.
The research on asymptomatic testing in the context of the Schiphol test street will soon be shared with the House.
Het onderzoek naar asymptomatisch testen in het kader van de teststraat op Schiphol wordt binnenkort gedeeld met Uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Kerstens over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over hoe de coronarichtlijnen van het RIVM tot onveiligheid leidden in de ouderenzorg

An MP asks the health minister about a Nieuwsuur report that RIVM corona guidelines led to unsafe conditions in elderly care, including shortages of protective equipment, the role of the labour inspectorate and IGJ, and whether the guidelines conflicted with the Arbo law. The minister replies that shortages were not a factor in drafting the guidelines, that employers bear responsibility for worker safety, that inspectorates reported no calamities from shortages, and that RIVM is responsible for the guidance content.
RIVM is substantively responsible for the guidelines and incorporated comments where necessary into the final version published on 20 March on RIVM's website.
Het RIVM is inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor de uitgangspunten en heeft opmerkingen waar nodig verwerkt in de definitieve versie die op 20 maart is gepubliceerd op de website van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de richtlijnen van het RIVM die tot onveiligheid in de ouderenzorg leidden

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health whether RIVM guidelines and the shortage of protective equipment contributed to infections and deaths in elderly care, and whether employers and inspectorates were adequately responsible. The minister answered that responsibility lies with employers and that inspectorates applied RIVM norms as a temporary starting point, while denying a conclusive link between the guidelines and harm.
Employers are responsible for a safe working environment and for good and continuous care to patients and clients.
Werkgevers zijn verantwoordelijk voor een veilige werkomgeving en voor goede en continue zorg aan patiënten en cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over de uitzending van Zembla over Apotex

Two CDA MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the sale of Apotex Leiden to Indian firm Aurobindo, the risks of dependence on foreign medicine production, and related investment screening. The minister answered that the state is willing to provide a loan to help a Dutch takeover by Innogenerics, that no talks with the top of Apotex took place, and that the government is working on EU-level mapping of medicine supply chains and a broader investment screening mechanism.
I am in consultation with sectors and experts to discuss what a good approach is to move further on this.
Ik ben in overleg met sectoren en deskundigen om te bespreken wat een goede aanpak is om hierin verder te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat loslopende nertsen zijn gesignaleerd

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports of escaped mink in Oldebroek and Best, their origin, NVWA enforcement, infection risk, causes of escapes and a study linking mink farms to human infections, and whether ending the mink sector only by March 2021 is responsible. The minister answered that the risk to residents is negligible, that escapes are handled by euthanasia and testing under a protocol without active searching, and that legislation to end the sector is being prepared urgently.
Further inventory of the locations where loose mink have been spotted is therefore not necessary and I will not do it.
Verdere inventarisatie van de locaties waar loslopende nertsen zijn gesignaleerd is daarmee niet nodig en zal ik dus niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de toegang tot zorg nog steeds niet op orde is

An MP asks the health minister about an ombudsman report showing that access to care for citizens with complex, cross-domain care needs is still not in order, and asks why improvements have not materialised and why clients are still bounced between agencies. The minister acknowledges the problem, lists ongoing improvement projects, client-support and 'no wrong door' efforts, and promises a discussion note on care policy options to the Tweede Kamer.
The National Ombudsman rightly observes, however, that it is still often very difficult for citizens with complex, cross-domain care needs to receive appropriate support and care.
De Nationale ombudsman constateert echter terecht dat het voor burgers met complexe, domeinoverstijgende zorgvragen nog vaak erg lastig is om passende ondersteuning en zorg te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over compensatie van mutatiedagen

An SP MP asked whether care providers funded by personal budget (pgb) with 24-hour residence cannot claim vacancy ('mutatiedagen') compensation that in-kind care providers can, and asked who qualifies and why not pgb providers. The Minister confirmed that only in-kind residential providers can claim these days under NZa rules, explained the exceptions, and argued that pgb funding cannot buy residence and that the NZa rules fit institutional funding; corona-related budget measures for pgb were noted.
It is correct that in the Nursing and Care sector, the compensation for vacancy days can only be claimed by care providers that deliver residential care in kind.
Het klopt dat in de sector Verpleging en Verzorging (VV) de compensatie van mutatiedagen alleen kan worden aangevraagd door zorgaanbieders die verblijfszorg leveren via zorg in natura.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het ontlopen van strafvervolging na genitale verminking

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether parents can evade prosecution for female genital mutilation by moving to the United Kingdom, and what measures and EU action are possible. The minister answered that no loophole exists in UK law, that the government sees no need for further UK contact or EU action, and that the police and prosecutors can act, including prosecution of mutilation abroad.
I am not aware that Somali status holders move with the aim of avoiding prosecution for cutting their daughters.
Het is mij niet bekend dat Somalische statushouders verhuizen met als doel om strafvervolging voor het besnijden van hun dochters te ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Onrust over geheime vaccinonderhandelingen'

The MP asks about secret EU negotiations for COVID-19 vaccine contracts, including liability waivers for manufacturers such as AstraZeneca, the identity of negotiators, and profit margins. The minister replies that EU product liability law is fully respected, negotiators are bound by confidentiality, pricing is withheld, and the government will keep the Chamber informed in general terms.
Information relating to financial aspects of each contract, such as price agreements, falls under the confidentiality obligation.
De informatie die betrekking heeft op financiële aspecten van elk contract zoals prijsafspraken, valt onder de geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de mogelijkheid van één cao voor verplegend en verzorgend personeel

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the salary and career consequences of separate collective labour agreements for nursing and care staff, and whether a single CAO for them would be feasible. The Minister answered that CAO negotiations are a matter for employers and employees, that the government will ask the SER for an inventory of issues, and provided salary tables, scale classifications and background data.
In healthcare it is up to employers and employees to make agreements together on terms of employment and record them in a collective labour agreement (CAO).
In de zorg is het aan werkgevers en werknemers om samen afspraken te maken over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en deze vast te leggen in een collectieve arbeidsovereenkomst (cao).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Veldman over het bericht 'Grote ov-campagne moet reiziger weer in de trein en bus krijgen'

MPs Ziengs and Veldman asked whether the government supports a public transport campaign aiming to restore 80% of pre-corona ridership, given rising infection numbers and advice to work from home. The state secretary answered that the campaign was run by transport operators, was halted on 25 September, and that the government now asks people to limit travel as far as possible.
As indicated, the campaign has been halted and, with the 28 September call to limit travel movements, the 80% target is no longer realistic or desirable.
Zoals aangegeven is de campagne stilgelegd en met de oproep van 28 september om de reisbewegingen te beperken is de 80% niet meer reëel en wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Autistische Gijs (11) kan nergens terecht voor zorg: 'Hij zegt zelfs dat hij niet langer wil leven, hartverscheurend''

An MP asked the minister how a parent can find appropriate care for an 11-year-old autistic child who has no suitable placement, and who is responsible when a provider is unable to continue treatment. The government answers that municipalities and providers are responsible, points to regional expertise teams and new expertise centres for complex youth care, and gives no measures specifically for this family.
Municipalities are responsible for organising support and care for children and young people.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van de ondersteuning en zorg aan kinderen en jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Sterke daling nieuwe werknemers in de jeugdzorg: 'Zo gaat het kapot’

An MP asked the minister about a sharp drop in new staff entering youth care, the risk to waiting lists and the working conditions of youth care workers. The state secretary disputed the 30% figure, cited a 13% drop after correcting for administrative mobility, and outlined sector action on recruitment, pay, workload and administrative burden.
It is important that people choose to work in youth care and that this still happens in considerable numbers.
Het is belangrijk dat mensen kiezen om in de jeugdzorg te werken en dat dat nog steeds met flinke aantallen gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Tekort aan jeugdzorgers steeds nijpender'

Mr. Wörsdörfer (VVD) asked the minister about a report on a worsening shortage of youth care workers, including a reported 30% drop in inflow in Q1 2020, and about steps to reduce administrative burdens. The state secretary answered that the 30% figure covers only inflow from outside the sector without correcting for administrative mobility, that the true decline is about 13%, and outlined a covenant to stop time-recording and planned simplification of product codes by 2022.
I intend to lay down the simplification of product codes in a ministerial regulation, with a target date of 1 January 2022.
Ik ben voornemens om de vereenvoudiging van de productcodes vast te leggen in een ministeriele regeling, streefdatum is 1 januari 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ''We verzieken ons leefmilieu en daarmee onszelf', artsen starten landelijke campagne'

An MP asked the health and infrastructure ministers whether they accept that air pollution from intensive livestock farming worsens COVID-19 outcomes and whether they will act on the link. The government answered that the link is plausible but not established, that more research is being explored with RIVM, and that existing air-quality policy (Schone Lucht Akkoord, nitrogen and livestock measures) is the response.
As indicated in the answer to question 4, RIVM has been asked to explore the research possibilities regarding the relationship between air quality, livestock farming and COVID-19.
Zoals aangegeven in antwoord op vraag 4 is het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de onderzoeksmogelijkheden aangaande de relatie luchtkwaliteit, veehouderij en COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de dreigende uitval van zorgpersoneel door stress

An MP asked the ministers about warnings that healthcare staff face burnout and stress-related absenteeism before a second COVID-19 wave, and whether the government will compensate staff for the deductible when they contract COVID-19 at work. The minister answered that psychosocial support initiatives, a second bonus and a workload programme exist, but rejected waiving the deductible for staff and said employers, not government, hold the duty of care for work-related illness.
However, it is not known or traceable whether healthcare workers contracted the virus at work or outside of it.
Het is echter niet bekend of te achterhalen of zorgmedewerkers het virus tijdens hun werk hebben opgelopen of daarbuiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Tv-spotje voor anti-abortusweek; critici noemen wervingsactie ‘misleidend'

MP Ellemeet asked whether a TV spot for an anti-abortion week, criticised as misleading, should be banned or acted against, and whether French-style rules on abortion information are an option. Minister De Jonge declined to judge the spot's content, pointed to the advertising code and its Commission as the existing remedy, and rejected French-style criminal rules as unnecessary and undesirable.
It is not for me to judge the content of the TV spots concerned.
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van de betreffende tv-spotjes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over het bericht ‘VWS hielp met taaleis Duits lab van de testmarkt te weren’

Two SP MPs asked the health minister why extra conditions, including a Dutch-language requirement for an arts-microbioloog, were imposed on a German lab seeking to test for COVID-19, despite RIVM approval, and whether this breached EU law and why the lab's capacity was not used sooner. The minister replied that the conditions derive from quality-of-care law, that two German labs now offer testing with Dutch partners, that the conditions were not meant to exclude providers, and that the government will consult on reorganising the test landscape.
I want to emphasise that these requirements were not intended to keep parties out of the market, and it did not turn out that way.
Ik wil benadrukken dat deze eisen niet bedoeld was om partijen te weren van de markt, en het heeft zo ook niet uitgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'VWS hielp met taaleis Duits lab van de testmarkt te weren'

An MP asked the health minister why the ministry imposed a Dutch-language requirement (a Dutch-speaking arts-microbioloog attached to the lab) that reportedly kept a German lab out of the COVID-19 test market, and whether this was justified and in line with EU law. The minister answered that the requirement derived from professional care standards under the wkkgz, was not meant to exclude parties, that no labs were excluded on that basis, and that German labs were contracted once test demand rose in August.
I want to emphasise that these requirements were not intended to keep parties out of the market, and that is not how it turned out.
Ik wil benadrukken dat deze eisen niet bedoeld waren om partijen te weren van de markt, en het heeft zo ook niet uitgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het bericht 'Kopzorgen KNVB om duel Jong Oranje in Belarus: Veiligheid boven alles'

Two MPs asked whether the Netherlands should intervene over Jong Oranje playing in Belarus amid health and political risks, and whether UEFA should cancel the match. The government said the football decisions and quarantine exemption are for the KNVB and UEFA, that it advised on local health and safety but did not contact UEFA, and that it actively raises human rights concerns through multilateral bodies.
The cabinet is of the view that it is not for the government but for UEFA and affiliated federations themselves to decide whether it is desirable to play football in a country like Belarus.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het niet aan de overheid, maar aan de UEFA en aangesloten bonden zelf is om te bepalen of het wenselijk is in een land als Wit-Rusland te voetballen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Toezichthouder NZa: de zorg is te veel een verdienmodel geworden’

The MP asked how financial incentives in healthcare, such as pay-per-service production incentives, can be reduced, and what share of cancelled care was unnecessary. The minister replied that advice from the NZa and Zorginstituut on digital care, appropriate use, and bundling/outcome-based contracting is awaited, with a RIVM study on indirect COVID effects, and gave no firm estimate of unnecessary care.
It is difficult to determine what percentage of the care that was cancelled is not sensible.
Het is moeilijk vast te stellen welk percentage van de zorg die is uitgevallen niet zinnig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Eerste coronabesmetting vastgesteld in Grieks vluchtelingenkamp Moria’

The MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Health about the first COVID-19 infection found in the Moria refugee camp on Lesbos, including contact with Greek counterparts, medical needs, testing, evacuations and EU funding. The government answered that it has regular contact with Greece, that camp residents are now tested, that Netherlands contributed a hospitainer and EUR 1 million to UNICEF, and that the number of migrants on the Greek islands fell from about 42,000 to 26,000.
The cabinet has informed the House on several occasions about the circumstances and the measures taken by the Greek government to prevent an outbreak of COVID-19 among migrants on the islands.

Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer op verschillende momenten geïnformeerd over de omstandigheden en de maatregelen die door de Griekse overheid zijn getroffen om de uitbraak van COVID-19 onder de migranten op de eilanden te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Belangenconflict dreigt bij MCL en Tjongerschans, waar de toezichthouders hun beloning hebben verdubbeld'

An MP asked the health minister about news that supervisory board members at three Friesland hospital groups doubled their pay, the possible conflict of interest of shared boards, and whether the chair held too many positions. The minister answered that the pay increases were reversed, that shared boards are permitted under current rules, that the chair's positions were not clearly unlawful, and that the IGJ would not investigate, while pointing to the forthcoming Wibz bill.
The IGJ has informed me that it is in discussion with the board of directors and the supervisory board about developments in good governance within the organisation.
Wel heeft de IGJ mij laten weten in gesprek te zijn met de raad van bestuur en de raad van commissarissen over ontwikkelingen op het gebied van goed bestuur binnen de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het pr-beleid van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

MP Hijink asks the health minister why a corona evaluation letter was sent to the media under embargo before Parliament, whether this reflects a PR strategy outranking parliamentary information, and for an overview of letters sent to media first, and a pledge that Parliament will be informed first. The minister answers that the embargo respected Parliament's information position, that no overview exists because the ministry does not seek media coverage before informing Parliament, and does not commit to changing the practice.
By applying an embargo until after the Parliamentary letter was sent, the information position of the House was respected.
Door het hanteren van een embargo tot na het versturen van de Kamerbrief werd de informatiepositie van de Kamer gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Dreigend tekort voor laboratoria die coronatests moeten onderzoeken’

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about a reported shortage facing labs that process COVID tests, including accreditation requirements, contracting timelines, and the end of coronavirus envoy Feike Sijbesma's role. The minister answered that the labs meet RIVM quality requirements, contracts take a few weeks, Sijbesma's work was largely complete with no successor named, and no lab failed the quality check.
The RIVM has drawn up a list of laboratories eligible to carry out COVID-19 diagnostics.
Het RIVM heeft een lijst opgemaakt van laboratoria die in aanmerking komen voor het uitvoeren van COVID-19 diagnostiek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de oproep om al het zorgpersoneel een bonus te geven

Labour MP Kerstens asks why medical technicians, ICT staff, office workers and roster planners in healthcare are excluded from the COVID-19 bonus, and whether the bonus will be paid this calendar year. The minister defends the targeted design of the bonus, declines to change it, and says the government cannot guarantee payment by year-end because employers control the final payout.
An amendment of the bonus scheme is therefore not necessary in my view.
Een aanpassing van de bonusregeling acht ik dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de opschaling van ic’s bij een nieuwe coronagolf in gevaar is

An MP asked the ministers about reports of staffing shortages threatening ICU expansion in a second COVID wave, including nurses' limited involvement in planning and reluctance to work extra hours. The minister answered that the CNO advice on nurse involvement is being followed up after the autumn recess, that regional plans are reportedly progressing, and that an extra bonus and staff-involvement measures are planned.
On how we will follow up the CNO's advice, your House will be informed after the autumn recess, as stated.
Over hoe we vervolg gaan geven aan het advies van de CNO wordt uw Kamer zoals gezegd geïnformeerd na het herfstreces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Rog over het al dan niet verplicht dragen van mondkapjes in het leerlingenvervoer

MPs Van den Berg and Rog (CDA) asked why the emergency regulation requires masks for travellers aged 13 and over while official guidance exempts pupils in special secondary education, and asked for clarity before schools reopened. The minister confirmed the regulation prevails over sector protocols, said pupils need not wear masks in school transport, and announced a formal instruction to safety regions ending enforcement of the mask requirement for that transport.
This clarity is provided through an additional instruction to the chairs of the safety regions under the Public Health Act
Deze duidelijkheid wordt geboden door een aanvullende aanwijzing aan de voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio’s op grond van de Wet publieke gezondheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het afschalen van het bron- en contactonderzoek voor covid-19 door de GGD’en in opdracht van het ministerie van VWS

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked whether the health ministry cut the basic capacity for COVID-19 contact tracing from 850 to 550 FTE in a June 2020 service agreement with the GGD's, and whether financial considerations drove this. Minister De Jonge denied any scaling-down plan or cost motive, stated the state bears all scaling costs, and attached the service agreement.
No, this is incorrect. Between VWS and GGD GHOR, financial agreements were made on scaling up the national capacity in line with the scaling plan from late May.
Nee, dit is onjuist. Tussen VWS en GGD GHOR zijn financiële afspraken gemaakt over de opschaling van de landelijke capaciteit conform het opschalingsplan van eind mei.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de coronatestlocatie op Schiphol alweer gesloten wordt wegens gebrek aan testcapaciteit

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked why the Schiphol COVID test site was closing for lack of capacity, how many risk-area travellers were tested and how many were positive, what happened to the promise to test travellers before boarding, and why there was insufficient test capacity. Minister De Jonge answered that the site was a pilot to test asymptomatic people, that about 1.6% of 19,012 tested were positive, that pre-departure testing is legally hard to mandate and is being explored at EU level, and that test capacity shortages stem from material constraints and higher demand, with sufficiency expected by early October.
I have previously indicated that this is being further explored, including at European level.
Ik heb eerder aangegeven dat dit verder verkend wordt, ook in Europees verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er vreselijke dingen zijn gebeurd met het testen van vaccins in Afrika

MP Kuzu asked the ministers whether clinical vaccine trials in developing countries, including Africa, are supervised to protect participants' rights, whether abuses are known, and whether pharmaceutical firms exploit weaker rules there. Minister De Jonge answered that all trials supporting EU registration must meet EU Good Clinical Practice standards wherever they are conducted, that EMA verifies compliance through inspections, that no current abuses are known, and that compensation rules and capacity-building efforts exist.
Clinical studies supporting EU drug registration, wherever in the world they are conducted, must comply with all Good Clinical Practice (GCP) regulations.
Klinische onderzoeken ten behoeve van de registratie van geneesmiddelen in de EU, waar ook ter wereld uitgevoerd, moeten voldoen aan alle regelgeving op het gebied van Good Clinical Practice (GCP)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het bericht 'Duitsland spoort veel besmettingen op', 'Van nieuwe Duitse virusdragers werd 40% besmet in het buitenland'

MPs Kröger and Renkema asked the health minister about the share of new Dutch infections acquired abroad, why Schiphol testing is limited to daytime hours and a daily cap, and whether overland travellers and other airports are tested. The minister answered that about 5 to 12 percent of recent cases had a travel history, that the Schiphol testing trial was running at a limited scale and is being evaluated by RIVM, and that future testing decisions will follow those results.
Based on the results from RIVM, we will consider how to proceed with testing incoming travellers at airports.
Aan de hand van de uitkomsten van het RIVM zullen we bezien hoe we verder gaan met het testen van inkomende reizigers op luchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de corona-teststraat op Schiphol ’s avonds dicht is, ook al landen er duizenden reizigers uit risicogebieden

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked why the Schiphol COVID test site closes in the evening while thousands of travellers from risk areas arrive, and about a 2003 SARS study showing aircraft transmission. Minister De Jonge answered that the site was a research setting, lab capacity is strained, it has been temporarily closed, EU coordination on pre-departure testing is ongoing with no mandatory testing in the Netherlands, and aircraft transmission risks appear limited.
The test site at Schiphol was a research setting examining the effect of testing people without symptoms, in this case travellers.
De teststraat op Schiphol was een onderzoeksetting waarin werd gekeken naar het effect van het testen van mensen zonder klachten, in dit geval reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'VWS en GGD’en roepen op: 'Testen: graag! Maar alleen bij klachten'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the government's call to test only people with symptoms, testing without symptoms, testing capacity and stock levels. The minister said mandatory testing is not possible under the Public Health Act, outlined ongoing studies of asymptomatic testing, and described capacity expansion and reserves, promising 50,000 tests a day by late September and 70,000 by late October.
Testing cannot be made mandatory under the Public Health Act.
Testen kan via de Wet publieke gezondheid niet verplicht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de stand van zaken rond het testbeleid, laboratoriumcapaciteit en ventilatie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 testing capacity, laboratory bottlenecks, the reagent supply, testing policy, and whether filters or UV/ionisation systems could improve ventilation. The Minister attributed delays to laboratory setbacks and international reagent shortages, stated that testing is limited to symptomatic people as current policy, and said RIVM does not currently study UV-C or ionisation systems while filters are only partly useful.
I will keep your House informed of the progress of the elaboration.
Ik houd uw Kamer op de hoogte van de voortgang van de uitwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat het aantal besmettingen met corona de afgelopen twee weken is gedaald.

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Health Minister why the reproduction number stayed above 1 even though weekly infections fell by 2.5 and 3.5 percent. Minister De Jonge explained how R is calculated over the preceding two weeks by RIVM, confirmed infections fell in weeks 33 and 34 but rose again from September, and noted that recent R estimates are not shown on the dashboard due to insufficient reliability.
The reliability of R estimates less than two weeks ago is insufficient and they are not shown on the dashboard.
De betrouwbaarheid voor R schattingen minder dan twee weken geleden is onvoldoende en wordt niet op het dashboard weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het bericht 'Lucratief beleggen in ouderen met dementie'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how to respond to a report on investors profiting from dementia care, including promised 7% returns on care property, private nursing home growth, sale-and-lease-back structures, foreign takeovers, inspection report publication and concentration oversight. The minister answered each question, saying he cannot judge the returns, that care leaders must buy property at market rates, that he is preparing the Wibz bill allowing profit-distribution conditions, that the IGJ oversees quality, and that he sees no need for nationality-based rules.

However, I am working on the bill on integrity of care provider business operations (Wibz), in which I want to introduce the possibility of attaching additional conditions to profit distribution in sectors where there is currently no ban on profit distribution.

Ik werk echter aan het wetsvoorstel integere bedrijfsvoering zorgaanbieders (Wibz) waarin ik de mogelijkheid wil introduceren aanvullende voorwaarden te stellen aan winstuitkering voor sectoren waar nu geen verbod op winstuitkering geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een drietal artikelen van Follow the Money over 'particuliere zorg voor ouderen met dementie'

The MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about Follow the Money reporting on private, investor-backed care for people with dementia, including foreign and private equity involvement, weak oversight, and unclear service charges. The Minister acknowledged the trend, said the IGJ and NZa have adequate instruments, announced a bill (Wibz) to allow conditions on profit distribution, but declined new regulation of service costs and a separate regulator.

With the already announced bill on integrity of business operations of care providers (Wibz), I want to introduce the possibility of imposing additional conditions on profit distribution in sectors where there is currently no ban on profit distribution.

Met het al aangekondigde wetsvoorstel integere bedrijfsvoering zorgaanbieders (Wibz) wil ik de mogelijkheid introduceren aanvullende voorwaarden te stellen aan winstuitkering voor sectoren waar nu geen verbod op winstuitkering geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over gebrekkige transparantie bij particuliere woonzorgbedrijven

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about weak transparency at private care-home operators, including the reported 7% return on dementia housing, foreign ownership, staffing norms, and split of rent and service costs. The minister said the Wlz profit ban does not cover this housing, promised a bill allowing conditions on profit distribution, and said staffing norms and oversight by the IGJ and care offices apply, while many details were left to providers and care offices.

However, I am working on the bill on integrity of care provider operations, in which I want to introduce the option of attaching additional conditions to profit distribution for sectors where there is currently no ban on profit distribution.

Ik werk echter aan het wetsvoorstel integere bedrijfsvoering zorgaanbieders waarin ik de mogelijkheid wil introduceren aanvullende voorwaarden te stellen aan winstuitkering voor sectoren waar nu geen verbod op winstuitkering geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat het RIVM het protocol voor bron- en contactonderzoek aanpaste na een telefoontje van VWS

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked whether RIVM changed its contact-tracing protocol after a call from the Ministry of VWS, why, and for a full list of protocol changes prompted by the ministry. The minister confirms the mid-quarantine call was dropped after RIVM and GGD GHOR consulted, citing the shortened quarantine and burdensome calls, and says protocol changes are made regularly with expert input and listed publicly.
Following this report, the Ministry of VWS inquired with RIVM whether sufficient account had been taken, in this consideration, of the upcoming adjustment to the GGD GHOR Nederland scaling-up plan.

Naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving is er vanuit het Ministerie van VWS navraag gedaan bij het RIVM of in deze afweging voldoende rekening gehouden werd met de aanpassing van het opschalingsplan van GGD GHOR Nederland dat aanstaande was.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over de uitspraak van de directeur van het RIVM gedaan tijdens de technische briefing van 11 augustus 2020 dat de besmettingen met corona in Dokkum “evident“ buiten gebeur

Opposition MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether the RIVM director's claim that Dokkum COVID infections were evidently transmitted outdoors was based only on media reports, and whether he should have investigated first. The minister confirmed awareness of the remarks, denied that the claim rested only on media reports, and said the GGD considered outdoor transmission very plausible but not certain, the director using the case as an illustration.
Mr Van Dissel used this case as an illustration that transmission outdoors is indeed possible.
De heer van Dissel heeft deze casus als illustratie gebruikt dat overdracht ook buiten wel degelijk mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat van 70 procent van de coronabesmettingen onbekend is waar men het heeft opgelopen.

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health about reports that for 70 percent of COVID-19 infections the source is unknown, and whether this means contact tracing is failing and whether the home-visitor limit of six persons is proportionate. The minister replied that the 70 percent figure does not mean the source is unknown, that the home is the most common setting, and that the measure is proportionate.
However, this does not mean that in all other cases we have no idea what the setting of the infection was.
Dit wil echter niet zeggen dat we in alle andere gevallen geen idee hebben wat de setting van de besmetting is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Baudet over hydroxychloroquine

Two MPs (Van Haga and Baudet) asked the health minister about the status of national hydroxychloroquine trials for COVID-19 after the Lancet paper was retracted, and why no extra efforts were made to keep the drug available for early use. The minister said inclusion in the trials was stopped, that there is still no objective reason for extra efforts, and that interpreting clinical research is for experts.
It is for experts to interpret clinical research.
Het is aan de deskundigen om klinisch onderzoek te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Ergernis en chaos bij werving GGD'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how a blank cheque for the GGD fits with years of budget cuts, whether recruitment criteria for contact tracers and outsourcing to commercial agencies are acceptable, and whether central coordination is planned. The minister said GGDs are adequately funded with federal covering of extra COVID costs, that regional criteria follow a national job profile, that outsourcing is understandable given the crisis, and that central coordination via GGD GHOR Nederland is already in place without guaranteeing capacity at all times.
I am therefore committed to resolving all emerging bottlenecks as quickly as possible together with the GGDs.
Ik zet mij er dan ook voor in om alle knelpunten die opspelen zo snel mogelijk samen met de GGD’en op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over ergernis en chaos bij werving van mensen voor bron- en contactonderzoek

An MP from the PvdA asks the health minister about frustration and chaos in recruiting contact tracers for COVID-19, the shortage of staff, the lack of uniform requirements and pay across GGDs, and who is responsible for public health. The minister answers that recruitment is ongoing, the shortage mainly concerns infectious disease doctors, a capacity plan has been sent to parliament, and that responsibilities are set out in the Public Health Act, without committing to new uniform standards.
I unfortunately can never guarantee that there is always sufficient capacity available to carry out contact tracing in line with the protocol in all regions.
Ik kan helaas nooit garanderen dat er altijd voldoende capaciteit beschikbaar is voor het uitvoeren van het BCO conform het protocol in alle regio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de onderzoeker stelt dat bij de uitbraak van corona in een zorginstelling de ventilatie vrijwel zeker een rol heeft gespeeld.

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health how he responds to a researcher's claim, broadcast on Op1, that ventilation very likely contributed to a corona outbreak at a Maassluis care home, and why GGD conclusions were published before the underlying studies. The minister disputes the claim, says viral traces on ventilation equipment were very low, and attaches the public version of the study.
I have attached the public version of the study, which was published on the website of the GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond.
Ik heb de publieksversie van het onderzoek, die op de website van de GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond is gepubliceerd, bijgevoegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘VWS zet maaltijdbezorgers onder druk om corona-app’

An MP asked whether the health ministry pressed meal-delivery workers' association to urge workers to install the CoronaMelder app without stating that use is voluntary, and how the 'partnerships manager' role squares with voluntariness. The minister admits the suggestion should not have been made, that two other organisations (PostNL, ANWB) were approached with insufficient emphasis on voluntariness, and that the mail should have been different.
This should not have been suggested because of the authority relationship between employers and employees.
Dit had niet mogen worden gesuggereerd vanwege de gezagsrelatie tussen werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat VWS maaltijdbezorgers onder druk zet om de corona-app te gebruiken

An MP asked whether the Health Ministry pressuring meal delivery workers to use the CoronaMelder app violates the Tijdelijke wet notificatieapplicatie's ban on indirect obligation via employers. The minister admits the ministry's email should not have suggested asking couriers to download the app, stresses that use must remain voluntary, and says such conduct could be a criminal offence for which the courts would decide.
Although this email was written with the best intentions, the suggestion to 'ask couriers to download the app' should not have been made.
Hoewel deze mail met de beste bedoelingen is geschreven, had de suggestie om «bezorgers te vragen de app te downloaden» niet gedaan mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Peters, Bergkamp en Diertens over het belang van ventilatie tegen de verspreiding van het coronavirus

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the health minister how seriously the government takes airborne transmission of COVID-19 and ventilation, and whether guidance and enforcement of building ventilation rules are adequate. The minister said the RIVM sees insufficient evidence for additional ventilation measures, pointed to existing guidance and to municipalities and building owners for enforcement, and noted that information has been published.
It is uncertain whether a specific ventilation (threshold) as an additional measure actually contributes to preventing or reducing SARS-CoV-2 transmission.
Het is onzeker of een bepaalde ventilatie(drempel) als aanvullende maatregel een daadwerkelijk bijdrage levert aan het voorkomen of verminderen van SARS-CoV-2-transmissie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het twitterbericht van de minister van VWS waarin hij schrijft dat we pas veilig zijn voor het coronavirus wanneer er een vaccin is

MPs Wilders and Agema asked Minister De Jonge to justify his tweet that we are only safe from the coronavirus once a vaccine exists, and questioned why medicines, ventilation, or preparedness would not suffice, plus the Mexican flu vaccine compensation. The minister argued vaccines are the most effective preventive tool, that medicines and preparedness play supporting roles, and that the narcolepsy compensation process is still ongoing.
The process aims to reach an amicable settlement. This process is still ongoing.
Het proces is erop gericht om te komen tot een minnelijke regeling. Dit proces is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Van den Berg over de webinar ‘Schouwen door PA en VS: Welbeschouwd een goed idee?!’

MPs Regterschot and Van den Berg asked whether physician assistants and verpleegkundig specialisten could be authorised to perform natural-death inspections (lijkschouw) to relieve doctors, and whether the Wlb should be amended. The minister answered that taakherschikking is not opposed if quality can be shown, that research via ZonMw and a further exploration this autumn will be undertaken, and that the need for a Wlb amendment will be considered.
Before taking the step to prepare the necessary amendment of article 3 of the Wlb, thorough research must first be done into the possibilities for task redistribution.

Alvorens de stap te zetten tot voorbereiding van de benodigde wetswijziging van artikel 3 van de Wlb, zal daarom eerst gedegen onderzoek moeten worden gedaan naar de mogelijkheden tot taakherschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Veldman over de registratieplicht in de horeca en de mogelijkheid om mensen te weigeren die niet mee werken aan de registratieplicht

MPs Aartsen and Veldman asked whether hospitality operators may refuse guests who do not cooperate with the COVID-19 contact-registration obligation, and about how details of that obligation were communicated and whether operators were involved. The state secretary answered that guests cannot be refused for withholding contact data because consent must be voluntary under the GDPR, while refusal is allowed for breaches of safety rules such as the 1.5-metre distance, and that operators were not involved in drafting the obligation but were informed in advance.
It is very important that hospitality operators can ensure the measures to combat infections are properly implemented.
Het is heel belangrijk dat horecaondernemers ervoor kunnen zorgen dat de maatregelen om besmettingen tegen te gaan, goed uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over met corona besmette nertsen

An MP asked the ministers whether new Covid-19 infections at mink farms show that earlier measures failed, whether workers are tested, and whether all mink farms should be preventively culled before the autumn harvest. The minister answered that the risk is not minimised, announced intensified screening and enforcement, and argued preventive culling is not the most effective measure, instead planning an accelerated end to fur farming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over met corona besmette nertsen

An MP asked whether recent COVID-19 infections on mink farms show that measures have had little effect, why a new OMT-Z advice was needed before culling, whether economic interests are overriding public health as in the Q fever case, and why mink are not culled preventively. The minister answered that the measures were insufficient and were tightened, that the OMT-Z advised against preventive culling as the most effective route, and that the fur farming sector will be phased out faster.
For that reason, in my letter of 28 August 2020 I announced a tightening of the current measures and several additional measures.
Om die reden heb ik in mijn brief van 28 augustus 2020 een aanscherping van de huidige maatregelen en enkele aanvullende maatregelen afgekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Tielen over het artikel ‘Zzp’er in de zorg niet duurder dan medewerker in loondienst

MPs Regterschot and Tielen asked whether they agree that self-employed (zzp) care workers cost institutions no more than employees, and why the government is negative about zzp'ers, along with questions on care labour shortages, a motion on worker involvement, and a bonus for self-employed workers during COVID-19. The minister answers that cost comparisons rest on unsubstantiated assumptions and that balance between flexible and permanent staff matters, promising further study, a progress report in September, and a bonus application window opening 1 October 2020.
In my view, this balance is currently insufficient.
Naar mijn mening is deze balans er momenteel onvoldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het verbieden van intimidatie van vrouwen buiten abortusklinieken

An MP asked the health minister whether a court ruling on a municipal buffer zone around an abortion clinic obliges all municipalities to create such zones, and whether the minister will act nationally against intimidation of women outside clinics. The minister replied that municipal mayors are primarily responsible under the Public Manifestations Act, that local circumstances differ, that the ruling is provisional, and that he will not impose buffer zones nationally, though he will keep discussing the situation with municipalities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Diertens over het bericht ‘RIVM-site Infectieradar pas na zomer weer operationeel’

MPs Veldman and Diertens asked the Minister of Health about reports that the RIVM Infectieradar website would not be operational until after summer, including which software partner replaces Formdesk, contact with the Grote Griepmeting developers, funding, and when it will be reliable. The minister answered that development runs via the EU-funded EpiPose project with ISI-Foundation and Coneno, that talks with the Grote Griepmeting stalled over financial expectations, and that operation is targeted for September 2020 with security and privacy approvals.

The RIVM states its aim is to have the planned Infectieradar operational in September 2020, with all aspects (technical, information security, privacy) guaranteed and approved within the RIVM and VWS.

Het RIVM geeft aan als doel te hebben om in september 2020 de voorgenomen Infectieradar operationeel te hebben, waarbij alle aspecten (technisch, informatiebeveiliging, privacy) gewaarborgd en goedgekeurd zijn binnen het RIVM en VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het actief ontmoedigen van onnodige reizen naar risicogebieden

Green MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the government how it will discourage unnecessary travel to COVID-19 risk areas, including ticket advertising and the Schiphol test lane's capacity. The ministers answered that travellers bear responsibility for their choices, orange advice is in place, a Schiphol testing study is under way with results expected mid-September, and airlines were urged to stop promoting travel to orange areas.
It is the responsibility of the traveller themselves to weigh whether a trip is necessary or not.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de reiziger zelf om de afweging te maken of een reis noodzakelijk is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Rog en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Haast geboden met ventilatie op scholen’

Three CDA MPs asked ministers whether ventilation rules for schools were known before the school year, how many schools meet current Bouwbesluit ventilation standards, and what measures RIVM, the Belastingdienst and ministries took. The government answered that existing building code rules apply, that school boards are responsible and no data on school ventilation is collected, and that the answers to the questions were delayed.
No data are collected or kept on the ventilation of school buildings.
Er worden geen gegevens verzameld of bijgehouden over de ventilatie van schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat er nog steeds een tekort is aan handschoenen in de verpleeghuizen.

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the minister about reports that nursing homes still lack gloves, and why the government cannot secure protective equipment while imposing corona measures. The minister acknowledged a temporary shortage, said it has now eased, and described the ordering channels available to care providers.
There was temporarily a tight supply, but meanwhile so many gloves have arrived and are available that the situation has eased.
Er was tijdelijk een krappe voorraad maar inmiddels zijn er dusdanig veel handschoenen binnengekomen en leverbaar dat die situatie is ingelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de actuele voorraden persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen

An SP MP asked the health minister about current stocks of personal protective equipment, the LCH procurement criteria, RIVM guidelines and domestic production. The minister answered that the LCH covers an emergency supply sufficient for a second wave based on March/April peak use, and listed Dutch producers, while deferring stock-analysis details to late September.
