I expect to inform you further about this at the end of September.
Ik verwacht u daar eind september verder over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over test- en ventilatiebeleid bij corona

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the accessibility of COVID-19 test sites, the closure of the Breda test site, and ventilation checks in nursing homes. The minister referred to a letter on testing for most questions, explained that the Breda site closes for locational and football reasons while a new one opens, and said a central ventilation team check would add no value while Actiz surveys members.
Actiz is currently conducting a survey among its members and will inform me about it.
Actiz voert op dit moment een inventarisatie onder de leden uit en zal mij daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bron- en contactonderzoek, de opschaling van de GGD en de rol van de minister van VWS

An MP from D66 asked the health minister why the revised GGD contact-tracing scale-up plan was not published, why the assumed positive test rate was lowered from 8% to 5%, and why a warning memo from GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond did not reach the ministry through formal channels, with questions on communication lessons. The minister answered that the revised plan is a working document superseded by a later plan sent to parliament, that the 5% assumption was realistic given low positivity, and that the memo was shared informally and that signals should ideally travel through formal channels.
Will you send parliament a copy of this revised scale-up plan? If not, why not?
Kopie van dit aangepaste opschalingsplan de Kamer te doen toekomen? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de nieuwe vertragingen van de versterking

An SP MP asked the Interior and Health ministers about new delays in the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation, payment and negotiation problems with contractors, and health and trust impacts on residents. The Interior Minister acknowledges delays partly caused by COVID-19 measures, says the policy itself is unchanged, and gives partial answers, withholding commercial details and deferring some matters to the NCG and municipalities.
NCG makes no statement on the content of these negotiations because of commercially sensitive information and because a statement could affect the negotiations.
Over de inhoud van deze onderhandelingen doet NCG geen uitspraak in verband met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en het feit dat een uitspraak hierover de onderhandelingen kan beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat de NVWA nalatig is bij corona in slachthuizen

MP Moorlag asked the ministers about a report that the NVWA was negligent in responding to internal warnings about COVID-19 risks in slaughterhouses, including whether 1.5m distancing was enforceable, whether an external reporting point is needed for NVWA staff, and how health would be prioritised over economic interests. The minister responded that the NVWA took protective measures such as masks for vets from 11 May, that working conditions in slaughterhouses fall under the Inspectie SZW and the companies themselves, that an external reporting route via Inspectie SZW exists, and that public health was always leading in local decisions.
I do not recognise the picture that the NVWA acted indifferently or negligently.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de NVWA onverschillig of nalatig heeft geopereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over nalatigheid bij de NVWA bij het ingrijpen in slachthuizen waar onvoldoende maatregelen werden genomen tegen de verspreiding van het coronavirus

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the ministers why the NVWA failed to act against inadequate COVID-19 measures in slaughterhouses, despite staff warnings, and whether the government misinformed parliament. The minister rejects charges of NVWA or ministerial failure, says the NVWA did act (including suspending work at four slaughterhouses), and promises ongoing coordination and a September letter on the line-speed motion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de adviezen van de Europese Commissie over de aanstaande griepgolf ten tijde van COVID-19

MP Diertens (D66) asked the health minister how the government will respond to European Commission advice on preparing for a flu season alongside a possible second COVID-19 wave, including widening vaccine eligibility, earlier vaccination, testing and protective equipment shortages, and lessons from the 2017/2018 flu epidemic. The state secretary answered that extra flu vaccines were purchased, earlier vaccination is not considered useful, the eligible group will be reviewed by the Health Council in 2021, testing and equipment supplies are being expanded, and vaccination-rate efforts continue.
For that reason I have purchased more than half a million additional flu vaccinations for the National Flu Prevention Programme.
Ik heb om die reden dan ook ruim een half miljoen extra griepvaccinaties ingekocht voor het Nationaal Programma Grieppreventie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Weyenberg over het bericht 'Angstcultuur in vleessector: slachterijwerkers zwijgen opgelegd'

D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports of a fear culture in the meat sector, where migrant slaughterhouse workers feel threatened with dismissal if they report sick, and about hygiene, COVID-19 testing, and abusive temp agencies. The government acknowledges the dependency problem, points to existing inspection and reporting channels, and commits to advisory follow-up and a national cooperation platform, but gives mostly general answers and declines to reconsider the sampling-based testing approach.
The cooperation platform will be fully operational from 1 September.
Het samenwerkingsplatform is vanaf 1 september volledig operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Bromet en Ellemeet over G4 EA H1N1-virus en het bericht ‘RIVM houdt ontwikkeling van Chinees varkensvirus goed in de gaten’

MPs Klaver, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the ministers why RIVM is not preparing for the G4 EA H1N1 swine flu virus despite its pandemic potential, how vaccines could be produced, and what sources RIVM monitors. The ministers answered that human-to-human transmission has not been observed, vaccine production takes 4-6 months via WHO-coordinated surveillance, and that no link exists with African swine fever.
It is currently not known how Chinese employees and pig farmers were infected. That is a Chinese matter and we have no information about it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend op welke manier Chinese medewerkers en varkensboeren zijn besmet. Dat is een Chinese aangelegenheid en we hebben daarover geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Paternotte over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het bericht dat een Amerikaanse farmaceut een Nederlands coronamedicijn in productie neemt

MPs Paternotte and Pia Dijkstra asked why the government was not involved in negotiations between an American pharmaceutical firm and Dutch research institutions over a Dutch COVID-19 drug licence, despite public funding, and whether the MVL licensing principles guarantee affordability and availability, including under possible US export restrictions. Minister De Jonge answered that IP ownership lies with the universities, that the government has expectations but no direct role, that the MVL principles will be applied but are not legally binding, and that a licensing toolbox will be delivered by late August.
As long as we do not know what the actual provisions are on which the described collaboration is based, any statement from me on this would be speculative.
Zolang we niet weten wat de daadwerkelijke bepalingen zijn waarop de beschreven samenwerking is gebaseerd zou elke uitspraak mijnerzijds hierover speculatief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asks the government to justify continued COVID-19 restrictions, their proportionality, effects on mental health, economy and poverty, and the scientific basis for distancing and ventilation advice. The ministers respond that restrictions remain necessary to control the virus, describe the OMT and BAO advisory process and support measures, and state that herd immunity was never a goal.
The decision whether the measures proposed by the OMT are implemented is then up to the cabinet.
De afweging of de maatregelen die het OMT voorstelt worden uitgevoerd, is vervolgens aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over psychische mishandeling

Three MPs (Bergkamp, Van den Hul, Özütok) asked the ministers about how the government addresses psychological abuse, its criminal-law treatment, registration, and compliance with the Istanbul Convention and children's rights treaty. Minister De Jonge replied that existing law and the GHNT programme already allow action, that police and courts do not register psychological abuse separately, and that no specific problems are reported in prosecution.
It therefore cannot be determined from police registration how often a report of psychological abuse has been filed, whether or not combined with other forms of abuse.
Het is daarom niet uit de politieregistratie te halen hoe vaak aangifte is gedaan van psychische mishandeling, al dan niet in combinatie met andere vormen van mishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP from FvD asked the ministers of health, interior and justice about second-wave preparedness, IC capacity, AstraZeneca conflict-of-interest concerns, hydroxychloroquine research, social media censorship, face-mask experiments and a minister's holiday in Sweden. The government answered that capacity expansion and PPE stockpiles are underway, denied any conflict of interest, and defended the local face-mask experiments as proportionate.
I see no risks in the fact that we have entered into a deal with AstraZeneca.
Ik zie geen risico's in het feit dat we met AstraZeneca in zee zijn gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de tijdens de persconferentie de dato 6 augustus 2020 aangekondigde aanvullende maatregelen voor studenten en studieverenigingen

Van Haga asks why introduction activities of general student associations are restricted differently from those of study and sports associations, and why the risk differs. The Minister explains the measures were set to limit infection among young people, and after consultation with the safety regions general student associations were later allowed small-scale activities under strict conditions.
After consultation with the Security Council on 17 August, it was decided to also give student associations the opportunity to organise small-scale physical introduction gatherings.
Na overleg met het Veiligheidsberaad op 17 augustus jl. is besloten om ook studentenverenigingen de gelegenheid te geven om kleinschalige fysieke introductiebijeenkomsten te organiseren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Van Gerven over de financiële belangen van testlabs van medisch-microbiologen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether testing capacity in the large labs was underused in early 2020, whether financial interests of medical-microbiology labs drove testing choices, and whether the OMT was steered toward them. The Minister denied that financial interests shaped advice, attributed the early restrictive testing policy to material shortages and validation constraints, and declined to comment on OMT steering because he has no seat on it.
I do not sit on the OMT and can therefore make no statements about steering within the OMT.
Ik heb geen zitting in het OMT en ik kan dan ook geen uitspraken over sturing binnen het OMT doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de brandweer een woonzorgcentrum moest koelen vanwege de hitte

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether it is unacceptable that frail elderly residents of a care home had to stay in overheated rooms, requiring fire service cooling, and whether the Inspectorate (IGJ) would intervene and whether the Heat Plan is binding. The minister answered that the rules already guarantee a comfortable living climate, that providers are responsible, that the IGJ received no complaints and sees no reason to investigate, and that the Heat Plan is only a communication plan, with the topic to be raised in regular consultations.
The inspectorate has received no reports about the heat in the care home. There is no reason for the inspectorate to conduct further investigation.
Over de warmte in het woonzorgcentrum heeft de inspectie geen meldingen gehad. Er is voor de inspectie geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek te doen.

Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over “het bericht dat vier van de vijf gemeenten niet weten of ‘tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog Joods vastgoed is onteigend en doorverkocht terwijl dat

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked ministers whether the government will map all looted Jewish property during WWII, return unlawfully collected taxes and fees, and open the Nederlands Beheersinstituut archives. The government replied that the Kordes commission and the 2000 settlement already addressed postwar restitution, that no new investigation or restitution is planned, and that most Verkaufsbücher archive material is already digitised and open.
In view of the outcomes of this research and the government's response, there is no reason to conduct new research into looted real estate.
Gezien de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en de reactie van het kabinet is er geen aanleiding om opnieuw onderzoek te doen naar geroofd onroerend goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Geluk-Poortvliet en Peters over het bericht ‘Zorgondernemer betaalde zichzelf tonnen uit terwijl zijn bedrijven in zwaar weer verkeerden’

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health why the inspectorate tolerated Olcea's poor care for years, whether municipalities and insurers were informed, and how a founder could restart a business after bankruptcy. The minister answered in detail on inspection history, the curator's handling of the sale, contract termination, and planned tightening of entry rules, while stating that some questions fall under other responsibilities or cannot be answered for individual cases.
The Tax Authority itself cannot address individual cases because of its fiscal confidentiality obligation.
De Belastingdienst kan zelf vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Zorgmedewerkers willen voorrang bij coronatests nu wachttijden oplopen'

An MP from the PvdA asked the health ministers whether they would grant priority coronavirus testing to healthcare workers after unions and care employers called for it amid growing test waiting times, and why shortages persisted despite claims of sufficient capacity. The answer refers the MP to a letter on test-and-trace strategy and does not address the questions directly.

The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to the Ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Medical Care (submitted 17 August 2020) have been answered by letter 'Testing and tracing: strategically combating the Corona pandemic together'.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Medische Zorg (ingezonden 17 augustus 2020). zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga inzake de polymerase chain reaction-test (PCR-test)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the reliability of PCR tests for COVID-19, including false positives, detection of old viral fragments, and whether positive results should be treated as infection, across 14 questions. The minister answered by letter, referring to the government's broader testing and tracing strategy rather than answering each question individually.

The written questions from MP Van Haga to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (submitted 18 August 2020) have been answered by letter 'Testing and tracing: jointly tackling the Corona pandemic strategically' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 510).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Haga (Van Haga) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (ingezonden 18 augustus 2020) zijn beantwoord middels brief » Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 510 ).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over de berichten 'Coronateststraat Schiphol voorlopig maar beperkt open voor hoog risicopassagiers' en 'Mandatory coronavirus testing at airports in Germany off to

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that the Schiphol testing facility was only partly open to high-risk arrivals and why not all travellers from risk areas are tested, unlike in Germany, asking about capacity, prioritisation, and missing entry controls. The minister's reply, sent by letter on testing and tracing, is referenced but the substantive answers are not reproduced in the text provided.
Questions from MPs Paternotte and Diertens (both D66) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the reports
Vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens (beiden D66) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berichten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte werkte vlak voor arrestatie met kwetsbare jongeren’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked how a terror suspect convicted of a terrorism offence could work in three youth care institutions under a false identity, and about screening, information sharing and oversight of care staff. The minister answered that the screening failure cannot be fully reconstructed, that VOG responsibility lies with employers and staffing agencies, that the IGJ found no irregularities in recent visits, and that a criminal investigation and the WODC study will inform future screening policy.
Unfortunately, it can no longer be established why this went wrong at the staffing agency or at the three institutions in 2018.
Het is helaas niet meer na te gaan waarom dat bij het uitzendbureau of bij de drie instellingen in 2018 verkeerd is gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over schadelijke behandelingen tegen autisme

An MP asked the Health Minister about harmful alternative treatments for autism such as CEASE therapy, HDT and homeopathic prophylaxis, including their effectiveness, prevalence and whether the Wet BIG should be changed. The state secretary said the claims are unacceptable, that no scientific evidence supports them, that enforcement options exist, and committed to examining legal avenues with IGJ and CBG after the summer.
I intend, together with the IGJ and CBG, to look into possible (legal) avenues through which the approach to possibly harmful homeopathic treatments or prophylaxis could be improved.
Ik ben van plan om, samen met IGJ en CBG, te kijken naar mogelijke (wettelijke) ingangen, waardoor de aanpak van mogelijk schadelijke homeopathische behandelingen of profylaxe kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over werknemers die buiten het vangnet voor flexwerkers vallen

An MP asked whether UWV reconsiders TOFA applications only for workers whose holiday pay was paid out or included in an all-in wage, not for those excluded despite too-low income, and whether UWV would act more leniently for them. The minister confirmed that objections lead to reassessment, that only one known case exists, and that the coarse TOFA selection cannot be made more flexible without losing workability.
I indicated then that the selection based on data in the payroll records of those eligible can produce rather arbitrary outcomes.
Ik heb toen aangegeven dat de selectie op basis van gegevens in de polisadministratie van de mensen die in aanmerking komen tamelijk willekeurige uitkomsten kan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over beïnvloeding van Europees onderzoek door de farmaceutische industrie

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that the pharmaceutical industry influenced European research funding (IMI) on epidemic vaccines, and whether mandatory transparency rules for industry payments are needed. The minister acknowledged the importance of public interest safeguards, said IMI decision-making is shared between public and private partners, referred to the IMI open letter for details, saw no need for further steps now, and stated the existing voluntary Transparantieregister Zorg works broadly well with an evaluation planned.
It is important that public interests are properly safeguarded in European research and innovation programmes.
Het is van belang dat publieke belangen goed worden geborgd in Europese onderzoeks- en innovatieprogramma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitzending van het televisieprogramma Op1 over ouders die hun meervoudig gehandicapte kind verzorgen en verplegen en worden gekort op hun pgb-budget

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister to respond to an Op1 broadcast about parents caring for severely disabled children who see their PGB budgets cut, including which care tasks count as usual parental care and how many families are affected. The minister said he cannot judge individual cases or specific nursing tasks, pointed to nurses, the SKGZ dispute body and insurers for case-level decisions, and committed to ongoing talks with insurers and to informing parliament further.
Moreover, it does not fit the division of roles and powers for the Ministry of VWS to take a position on individual casuistry.
Bovendien past het niet in de rol- en bevoegdheidsverdeling om als Ministerie van VWS een standpunt in te nemen in individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over ontvangen signalen over oneigenlijk gebruik van GIRFEC en de zogenoemde Kansencirkel

An MP asked the minister about parental fears that the Kansencirkel, derived from Scotland's GIRFEC, could be misused as a risk-assessment tool and lead to case files, and about oversight of this. The minister answered that central government will not spread GIRFEC, municipalities may experiment, the Kansencirkel is not meant as a risk tool, and the IGJ has received no reports of misuse, with complaints routed to the IGJ and AKJ.
I am not aware of any signals of improper use of the Kansencirkel or other elements of GIRFEC.
Er zijn mij geen signalen bekend van oneigenlijk gebruik van de Kansencirkel of andere elementen van GIRFEC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht dat Polen zich wil terugtrekken uit het verdrag dat geweld tegen vrouwen bestrijdt

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they share concern over Poland's reported plan to withdraw from the Istanbul Convention on violence against women, whether they will contact Polish counterparts, and whether they will support Polish civil society groups. The government answered that it shares the concern, that no withdrawal decision yet exists in Poland, that a joint démarche was made on 7 August, that the Netherlands will not withdraw, and that support for Polish organisations will be considered if warranted.

The cabinet will continue to follow the matter and, after the ruling of the Polish Constitutional Court and a possible decision by the Polish government, will assess whether and what further action is appropriate and most effective.

Het kabinet blijft de zaak volgen en zal na de uitspraak van het Pools Constitutioneel Hof en een mogelijk besluit van de Poolse regering bezien of en welke verdere actie opportuun is en het meest effectief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het voortdurende mishandeling van jonge turnsters

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the ministers about reported abuse of young gymnasts in Dutch gymnastics and what the government would do, including on the independence of the reporting point, the top-sport culture, statute of limitations, and criminal reporting. The minister answered that an independent study on the scope of boundary-crossing behaviour in gym sport is funded and due around end 2020, that the CVSN and ISR provide independence and disciplinary oversight, that the limitation period was already extended, and that the outcomes will be followed up.
For that reason, the Ministry of VWS is funding an independent study into the nature, scope and approach of boundary-crossing behaviour in gymnastics and gym sport.
Om die reden financiert het Ministerie van VWS een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de aard, omvang en aanpak van grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de turn- en gymsport
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het stijgend aantal besmettingen met COVID-19 i.r.t. terugkerende vluchten

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Infrastructure about rising COVID-19 infections linked to returning flights, including how many infected travellers came from which regions, whether there is insight into flights' contribution, whether arriving travellers with symptoms are tested, whether fellow passengers are tested, and what measures would follow if infections keep rising. The government answered that flight-linked cases appear to be a limited share of total new infections, that testing and symptom checks at airports exist, that close contacts are traced, and that a quarantine obligation for travellers from high-risk areas is being prepared through a change to the Public Health Act.
The reason for the trip is not passed on to the GGD.
De reden van de reis wordt niet doorgegeven aan de GGD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over terugkerende vluchten met besmette reizigers

An MP asked ministers whether returning flights carrying travellers infected with COVID-19 from outbreak areas were adequately monitored, including quarantine and testing, and whether the policy on flying would be reconsidered. The ministers answered that no fellow passengers were infected, that quarantine for travellers from high-risk areas is being legally arranged, and that the general aviation policy would not change beyond offering airport testing.
Therefore, it is also desirable for travellers coming from a high-risk area to have the possibility of imposing a quarantine obligation merely because the traveller comes from such an unsafe area.

Derhalve is het ook voor reizigers die uit een hoog risicogebied komen, wenselijk om de mogelijkheid te hebben om een quarantaineplicht op te leggen vanwege het enkele feit dat de reiziger uit een dergelijk onveilig gebied komt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Regterschot over intensivecare-verpleegkundigen (ic) naar aanleiding van het artikel in de Gelderlander van 18 juli 2020: ‘Ruim 10 procent ic-verpleegkundigen Radboudumc Nijmegen

MPs Tielen and Regterschot (VVD) asked ministers about the high departure rate of intensive care nurses at Radboudumc, whether it is an outlier, and about projected nurse outflow, training places, returning former staff and anaesthesia workers. Minister De Jonge replied that a 10% employer outflow is normal and national, that the figures are not comparable to the reported ones, and pointed to the Capaciteitsplan, retention measures, returning-staff schemes and a pending study and advice.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over de recente Zuid-Koreaanse studie naar de overdraagbaarheid van COVID-19 door kinderen

Two SP MPs asked the Health and Education Ministers about a South Korean study on children's transmission of COVID-19 and its implications for school reopening. The government answered that the study rests on few children, offers no new insight into transmission and did not study school openings, and committed to monitoring the literature and reporting school-linked clusters to OCW.
RIVM informs the Ministry of Health about the latest developments so they can be taken into account in policy-making.
Het RIVM informeert VWS over de meest recente ontwikkelingen, zodat deze meegenomen kunnen worden in de beleidsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Oud-topman RIVM: 'We moeten meer testen, anders blijft het een smeulende veenbrand''

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the health minister how he views a former RIVM chief's call for more COVID-19 testing, including testing of asymptomatic people, and why the OMT downplays asymptomatic spread. The answer was given by reference to a separate letter on OMT advice and COVID-19 measures, without substantive answers in this document.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z13783) have been answered by letter 'Adviezen OMT en maatregelen COVID-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 504).

De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z13783 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Adviezen OMT en maatregelen COVID-19» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 504 ).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over de berichten: ‘Flu virus with 'pandemic potential' found in China’ en ‘Zorgen in China over nieuwe griep, die mogelijk kan uitgroeien tot pandemie’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports of a swine-origin H1N1 influenza virus with pandemic potential found in China and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister answered that existing zoonosis structures and hygiene protocols are adequate, the virus shows no sustained human-to-human transmission so far, and current vaccines do not work well against it, while WHO will assess whether a new vaccine is needed.
I informed your House about the COVID-19 lessons learned process in my letter of 15 June 2020.
Ik heb uw Kamer over het proces t.a.v. COVID-19: «lessons learned» geïnformeerd in mijn brief van 15 juni 2020
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de werking van de Overheidsbijdrage in de Arbeidskostenontwikkeling (OVA)

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how the Overheidsbijdrage in de Arbeidskostenontwikkeling (OVA) was set up, how it is determined and reported, and what a lower OVA in 2021 due to the COVID-19 recession would mean for care wages. The minister answered that the OVA is governed by the 1999 OVA-convenant and set from CPB forecasts, that deviating requires representative employer agreement, and that the Chamber is not routinely informed to avoid a floor in collective bargaining.
That is why the OVA-convenant agrees to avoid publicity about the OVA.
Daarom is in het OVA-convenant afgesproken om publiciteit over de OVA te mijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de werkgelegenheid in het zorgvervoer

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the health minister about threatened jobs in patient transport, the 80% fixed-cost compensation demanded by the sector, and whether municipalities and others must keep paying and be compensated. The minister said the state arranged continuity payments that were largely ended by 1 July with case-by-case exceptions, that municipalities should use their general funds and negotiate locally, and declined to commit to further compensation or mandatory payment.
Additional compensation from central government for municipalities paying 80% of the costs of cancelled rides is therefore not an issue.
Aanvullende compensatie vanuit het Rijk voor gemeenten bij doorbetaling van 80% van de kosten van uitgevallen ritten is daarom niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat een slachthuis medewerkers heeft aangezet tot het afleggen van valse gezondheidsverklaringen

An MP asked ministers about reports that a slaughterhouse pressured workers to fill in false health declarations, and whether the company withheld declarations from the GGD and why oversight was not tighter. The government said it had no signals of withholding, that the Inspectie SZW found no irregularities in one site, that additional oversight measures were taken, and that the NVWA could halt slaughter work if worker safety is not assured; criminal investigation is for the Openbaar Ministerie.
If the safety of NVWA and KDS staff is not assured, the NVWA will halt its work in slaughterhouses.
Als de veiligheid van NVWA en KDS medewerkers niet geborgd is, staakt de NVWA de werkzaamheden in slachterijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de oproep tot een mondkapjesplicht

MP Asscher asked the Health Minister whether the government would reconsider mask-wearing requirements in light of mayors' calls, foreign tightening, and a Utrecht study, and whether the OMT would factor in mask distribution in nursing homes. The minister answered that he asked the OMT for advice on the added value of a non-medical mask requirement in specific situations and places, referred to his letter of 30 July, and said scarcity is not relevant to that question.
Following recent developments on wider use of face masks abroad, and to be able to take a well-considered decision, on 24 July I asked the Outbreak Management Team (OMT) for advice

Naar aanleiding van de recente ontwikkelingen over het breder gebruik van mondkapjes in het buitenland en om een weloverwogen besluit hierover te kunnen nemen heb ik op 24 juli jl. het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) gevraagd om advies te geven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over onderzoek naar nut van mondkapjes

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the evidence for face masks, the Norwegian study and RIVM behavioural research, and the constitutional basis for local mask obligations. The minister replied that there is no conclusive evidence of a health benefit, that distance remains the core measure, and that local experiments in Amsterdam and Rotterdam run under emergency ordinances pending the proposed Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act.
With a view to the future, the cabinet has submitted the bill Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act.
Het kabinet heeft met het oog op de toekomst het wetsvoorstel Tijdelijke wet maatregelen covid-19 ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de aanvullende maatregelen om het coronavirus te bestrijden

MP Asscher (PvdA) asked Minister De Jonge about local COVID-19 measures, the face-mask obligation, the risk of a patchwork of local rules, wastewater monitoring thresholds, and testing and contact-tracing capacity. The minister answered that regional safety chairs can take proportionate local measures, that the mask decision depends on OMT advice and experiments, and that test and tracing targets are being scaled up, but gave no fixed thresholds or contingency plans.
The cabinet has no plans beyond those shared with the House in various letters to parliament and on rijksoverheid.nl.
Het kabinet heeft geen andere plannen dan in de diverse Kamerbrieven en op rijksoverheid.nl met de Kamer gedeeld zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Mondkapjesplicht in grote steden

Three D66 MPs asked whether local mask-wearing requirements in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, imposed via emergency ordinances, are compatible with Article 10 of the Constitution, their enforceability and sanctions, and why voluntary wearing was not chosen. The ministers answered that the experiments are a temporary, proportionate, locally motivated response to non-compliance with the 1.5-metre rule, that violations are punishable with a 95-euro fine, and that courts remain available for objections, while acknowledging the legal uncertainty and offering a temporary bill to shorten the emergency situation.
It is not for the government to intervene in any assessment of the sanction by the court.
Het is niet aan de regering om te treden in de eventuele beoordeling van de sanctie door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Testen, testen, testen, maar hoe?

An SP MP asked the health minister whether COVID-19 testing policy, which mainly tests symptomatic people, should change to catch asymptomatic and presymptomatic infections, and about related measures. The minister answered that asymptomatic testing can help in specific cases, announced testing of returning travellers and a trial of the contact-tracing app, and said the government will respond to local outbreaks with various measures.
I have asked the OMT to advise me from what point asymptomatic testing of close contacts in contact tracing has sufficient added value.
Ik heb aan het OMT gevraagd mij te adviseren vanaf welk moment het asymptomatisch testen bij nauwe contacten uit het bron- en contact onderzoek voldoende toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Hijink over het bericht dat bij een slachthuis in Helmond werknemers, al dan niet in opdracht van de werkgever, ziekteklachten verzwegen

MPs Futselaar and Hijink asked the government about reports that workers at a Helmond slaughterhouse concealed COVID-19 symptoms and falsified forms, and about enforcement, GGD inspections, NVWA oversight and sector culture. The ministers said such conduct is unacceptable, pointed to Inspectie SZW powers and planned extra enforcement powers, and described NVWA and GGD actions and a sector review.
I intend to give the Inspectorate SZW more legal powers to enforce effectively
Ik heb het voornemen om de Inspectie SZW meer wettelijke mogelijkheden te geven om effectief te kunnen handhaven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat een ventilatiesysteem het coronavirus verspreidde in een verpleeghuis.

MP Asscher asked the Health Minister why a confidential RIVM report, which reportedly found a ventilation system spread the virus in a nursing home, was not published, and whether ventilation advice and an aerosol expert should be reconsidered. The minister said the document is a confidential surveillance-meeting report that may be traceable to individuals, an investigation by the GGD is ongoing, no new research justifies changes yet, and the ventilation advice was updated on 28 July and published on the government website.
There is no question of a confidential or secret report; it concerns a confidential record of the Signaling Consultation.
Er is geen sprake van een vertrouwelijk of geheim rapport, het gaat om een vertrouwelijk verslag van het Signaleringsoverleg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het bericht 'Gommers ziet geen verschil tussen Efteling en kermis: 'Virus niet verspreiden''

CDA MPs asked the health minister whether the NVIC chair's view that fairground visits should be possible under good plans is considered, whether fairground operators' continuity and field labs were addressed, and when clarity would be given. The minister replied that the relaxations announced on 24 June give perspective, that 1.5 metre distancing applies with no maximum headcount including fairs, that the sector will run a field lab and results will be reported to parliament, and that the June relaxations give clarity.
I will inform the House about this.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van beleidskeuzes bij de bestrijding van de coronapandemie in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about expected infection and death levels under the Dutch mitigation policy, the basis for policy choices, and whether a hard lockdown would be better. The minister answered that infection levels are being monitored through serological studies, that policy aims at controlling the virus rather than herd immunity, and that the measures prevented about 90% of expected ICU admissions, but he did not give mortality projections for the policy options.
Calculations made concern the number of ICU and hospital admissions. Mortality is a derivative of these calculations.
Berekeningen die worden gemaakt betreffen het aantal IC- en ziekenhuisopnames. Sterfte is een afgeleide van deze berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Renkema over de snelle toename van het aantal nieuwe COVID-19 besmettingen

MPs Ellemeet and Renkema asked the health minister about the rapid rise in COVID-19 infections, the reproduction number, enforcement, communication, quarantine for travellers and hospital capacity. The minister answered that the rise reflects loosened measures and regional outbreaks, promised intensified communication and continued monitoring, but declined a NL-Alert and a legal travel quarantine.
It is being examined how a message on the basic rules can be added to radio and television in the short term.
Er wordt gekeken hoe er op korte termijn een uiting over de basisregels aan kan worden toegevoegd op radio en televisie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de reactie van het kabinet op het 'Draaiboek triage op basis van niet medische overwegingen voor IC-opname ten tijde van fase 3 in de COVID-19 pandemie'

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the cabinet why the Minister for Medical Care signed the June 2020 letter on the triage draft for ICU admission in COVID-19 phase 3, whether it is an ethical matter, how the draft was prepared, and what the cabinet's role and alternatives are. The government answered that medical care falls under the Medical Care minister, that the cabinet rejects age-only selection as discriminatory and favours first come, first served, and that it will await a broad societal dialogue before deciding whether to confirm the draft or use regulation.
I am awaiting the broad societal discussion now, but if necessary the general prohibition of discrimination will be clarified in legislation or regulations.
Ik wacht de brede maatschappelijke discussie nu af, maar zo nodig zal in wet- of regelgeving het algemene discriminatieverbod worden verduidelijkt.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de 100 miljoen euro extra aan de WHO

An MP asked about cliniclown salaries versus nurses, the 100 million euro extra to the WHO, Dutch IC capacity and which WHO advice the Netherlands followed. The minister said the salary comparison is misleading due to different funding and CAO systems, that the cost of testing and ICU expansion is not yet known or still being calculated, and that the Netherlands applies WHO guidance within its national context.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over de continuïteit van jeugdhulp en geestelijke gezondheidszorg

GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about continuity of youth care and mental health care during the coronavirus crisis, including treatment and visiting rules, liquidity risks, shortages of protective equipment, the size of postponed care demand, and whether insurers should proactively inventory support. The minister answered that visiting rules are being balanced against RIVM guidance, that continuity payments and compensation schemes are in place, and that the NZa monitors postponed care while insurers retain their duty of care.
A general visitor stop is therefore not desirable.
Een algehele bezoekersstop is daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de financiering voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek voor vaccinontwikkeling

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked why COVID-19 vaccine research funding through ZonMw starts late, whether the budget is too small, who assesses proposals, and whether private vaccine development could inflate prices or deny supply to the Netherlands. Minister De Jonge answered that funding was raised to 40 million euro for the ZonMw programme and 67.5 million euro overall, that assessment follows published procedures, and that he does not share concerns about price inflation or supply refusal.
The RIVM delivered this scan in the first week of May.
Het RIVM heeft deze scan de eerste week van mei opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Zorgen om luchtvervuiling in Brabant en Limburg: 'Wat als er een tweede golf komt en het aantal doden hier weer hoger ligt?''

MPs Futselaar and Van Gerven asked the ministers whether residents of Brabant and Limburg have grounds for concern about COVID-19 resurgence linked to air pollution from livestock farming, and what steps will be taken on research and reducing pollution. The minister answered that RIVM is still scoping research on the air quality and COVID-19 link, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord and other measures address air pollution, and that mink farms with infections will be culled while a voluntary exit scheme is being considered.
Once these have been mapped out, my colleagues at I&W and VWS and I will decide whether and, if so, which studies we want to commission from RIVM.
Nadat deze in kaart zijn gebracht zullen mijn collega’s van I&W en VWS en ikzelf besluiten of en zo ja, welke onderzoeken we willen uitzetten bij het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'PGB 2.0 loopt half jaar vertraging op'

An SP MP asked the Minister of VWS about a six-month delay and EUR 12.5 million in extra costs for the PGB2.0 payment system, including how costs were underestimated, timelines, and cost-benefit. The minister attributed the extra costs to technical adjustments, said VWS bears them, and committed to sending a revised budget once the rollout schedule is financially calculated.
This rollout planning is being costed financially; once its budget is established I will provide you with a revised budget.
Deze invoeringsplanning wordt financieel doorgerekend, zodra de begroting hiervan is vastgesteld zal ik u een aangepaste begroting verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over de gevolgen van het coronavirus op bewoners en medewerkers van verpleeghuizen

SP MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 in nursing homes, covering testing, death counts, visitor bans, protective equipment and staff pressure. The minister acknowledged the heavy impact of visitor restrictions, said testing policy was broadened from 6 April, and promised pilots with relaxed visiting rules, though he gave no firm timeline beyond 19 May and deferred some questions.
I will start pilots as soon as possible to gain experience with a relaxed visitor arrangement in preparation for broader relaxation.
Ik start op zo kort mogelijke termijn pilots die ervaring gaan opdoen met een versoepelde bezoekregeling ter voorbereiding op een bredere versoepeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de verspreiding van het coronavirus in verpleeghuizen

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about COVID-19 spread in nursing homes, including full ward isolation, staff protective equipment, return of residents from hospital, testing capacity and the delayed answers. The minister answered all questions, describing cohort isolation, PPE supply via the LCH, revised testing policy and procedures for returning residents, while stating that he would respond separately after a late answer.
I now answer the questions posed on 30 March 2020 after all.
Ik geef alsnog antwoord op de op 30 maart 2020 gestelde vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het faillissement van hulpmiddelenleverancier HMC

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether clients dependent on aids from the bankrupt supplier HMC could be protected, whether equipment already paid for by municipalities stays available, and whether municipalities can contract alternative suppliers quickly. The Minister agreed clients must not be harmed, described a bridging credit and municipal contracts with other suppliers, and reported that a takeover firm now serves about 85% of former municipal clients.
I agree that clients must not be the victims of the bankruptcy of this supplier of aids.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat cliënten niet de dupe mogen worden van het faillissement van deze leverancier van hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Zorgpersoneel op de Veluwe neemt ontslag uit angst voor corona: ‘Enorm gebrek aan beschermingsmiddelen’

An MP asks the health minister how he reconciles his statements on protective equipment with reports of shortages leading care staff to quit, and about slow staff testing and a motion on central coordination. The minister acknowledges his earlier answer caused a misunderstanding, says there is currently no shortage and that the new allocation framework and central consortium address the problem, and states that no cases of inability to follow RIVM guidelines were reported.
I addressed this during the parliamentary debate of 8 April.
Ik ben hier tijdens het Kamerdebat van 8 april op ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de situatie in de verpleeghuizen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the COVID-19 situation in nursing homes, including infection and death figures, scenarios, protective equipment, testing, inspection reports and a weekly update. The Minister gave detailed figures (about 8,400 confirmed infections and 2,800 deaths by 6 July), described visitor rules, a knowledge coalition and research efforts, said the LCH can meet demand for protective equipment, reported about 90 inspectorate reports, and agreed to answer in future weekly updates.
Will you answer these written questions instead of including the answers generally in your weekly update on developments of the coronavirus?
Vraag 9 Wilt u deze schriftelijke vragen beantwoorden in plaats van de antwoorden algemeen mee te nemen in uw wekelijkse update over de ontwikkelingen van het coronavirus?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘150 doden door corona in gehandicaptenzorg: ‘Deze groep wordt vergeten’'

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports of 150 COVID-19 deaths in disability care and whether people with disabilities were being forgotten, including visiting rules, testing, inclusion under the UN Disability Convention and accessible apps. The minister answered that sector-agreed visiting arrangements and a routekaart were in place, committed to testing for symptomatic people and to including the UN Convention in the strategy, and said accessibility standards were being applied to contact-tracing apps.
From 1 June, everyone with complaints can get tested.
Vanaf 1 juni kan iedereen met klachten zich laten testen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een mogelijke aanbesteding van het Centraal Administratie Kantoor

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the CAK's collection tenders overlap with the CJIB, why small bailiff offices are excluded by the lot structure, and whether price is effectively the selection criterion. The minister explains the CAK is transferring most enforcement to the CJIB, the remaining tender is a separate gradual transition, and lots are limited for efficiency and single-contact reasons, with 70% weight on quality.
Within the tender the CAK applies the following price and quality ratio: price 30% and quality 70%.
Het CAK hanteert binnen de aanbesteding de volgende verhouding voor prijs en kwaliteit: prijs = 30% en kwaliteit = 70%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘UMC’s willen loonsverhoging voor verpleegkundigen’

An MP asked the Health Minister whether he agrees that university medical centres, as employers, now want wage increases for nurses ahead of collective bargaining, and whether extra funds should be set aside to reward care workers. The minister answered that a fair wage is due, pointed to the annual government contribution of about 1.1 billion euros for 2020 and recent collective agreements with raises, without committing to additional funding.
To enable competitive salary development, I make the government contribution to labour cost development available each year.
Om een concurrerende salarisontwikkeling mogelijk te maken, stel ik jaarlijks de overheidsbijdrage in de arbeidskostenontwikkeling beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het advies van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie om de abortuspil na 24 weken te gebruiken

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the minister about WHO guidance permitting medical abortion pills after 12 and even 24 weeks, questioning its compatibility with Dutch practice and whether development aid funds such procedures. The minister replied that Dutch clinics limit the pill to 9 weeks while hospitals follow NVOG guidance up to 24 weeks, saw no reason to contact the WHO, and said aid supports safe abortion care within recipient countries' legal frameworks.
I see no reason to contact the WHO about the 2014 Clinical practice handbook for safe abortion.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om in contact te treden met de WHO over het in 2014 uitgebrachte «Clinical practice handbook for safe abortion».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over het datalek bij de infectieradar website

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the health minister how he reacted to Formdesk's claim that it received no warning about the Infectieradar data leak, and why the ministry's account of the security checks differed from its earlier statements. The minister answered that RIVM implemented the fix Formdesk advised, that a second flaw was only found on 6 June, and that RIVM now concedes an extra test could have caught it, while stating there is no remaining disagreement with Formdesk.

In hindsight, RIVM concludes that this problem could have been noticed on 25 March if an extra test of this risk had been carried out after implementing the measure advised by Formdesk's supplier and before the Infectieradar was placed online.

Achteraf gezien concludeert het RIVM dat dit probleem op 25 maart opgemerkt had kunnen worden indien ná implementatie van de door de leverancier van Formdesk geadviseerde maatregel en vóór het online plaatsen van Infectieradar een extra test op dit risico was uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over het bericht dat regels voor bezoek verpleeghuis verwarrend en frustrerend zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that visiting rules in nursing homes are confusing and frustrating, and whether homes hide behind the Public Health Act. The minister answered that restrictions were unavoidable in March, that COVID-free locations no longer face visiting limits, and that homes should implement visits through consultation.
At all locations that are COVID-free, visits are possible without restrictions.
Op alle locaties die COVID-vrij zijn, geldt dat bezoek zonder beperkingen mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘De jaknikkers van Hugo’

An MP asked the minister why GGD public health services were delayed in scaling up contact tracing for COVID-19, including funding, timing of instructions, and the app. The minister rejected the criticism, said GGDs were involved in decisions and funded by municipalities, and noted the Inspectorate has started an inquiry.
On 24 June the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate started an inquiry into the quality of the test sites and contact tracing carried out by the GGDs.
Op 24 juni is de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) gestart met een onderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de teststraten en het bron- en contactonderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Minister legt lek infectieradar bij ontwikkelaar, bedrijf reageert verbaasd’

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about the Infectieradar data leak, including other security risks, the vendor's knowledge of the flaw, notification of affected participants, and effects on trust and organ donor registration. The minister answered that RIVM identified several security risks, that the flaw was missed in the initial analysis, that 49 forms were viewed by a journalist and a security expert, and that RIVM now requires an external pentest before releasing such environments.
To prevent such a situation in the future, the RIVM Formdesk environments will only be released once an additional pentest has been carried out by an external party.
Om een dergelijke situatie in de toekomst te voorkomen worden de RIVM Formdesk omgevingen pas vrijgegeven als er een extra pentest is uitgevoerd door een externe partij.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Experts: coronabeleid snel evalueren van levensbelang'

MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health why the government chose to draw lessons learned rather than an interim evaluation of the COVID-19 policy, and disputed the claim that a group-immunity strategy is still pursued. The minister answered that the government is focusing on lessons learned to prepare for a second wave, that the strategy is to control the virus, that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid will conduct a full evaluation later, and that most recommendations of the report are already in line with existing policy, though some are not adopted.
A comprehensive policy evaluation will nevertheless be carried out by the Dutch Safety Board (Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid) at the request of the cabinet.
Een uitgebreide beleids evaluatie wordt evengoed wel uitgevoerd door de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid, op verzoek van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen lid Van Haga over de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie Van Haga / Hiddema inzake duidelijkheid voor de dansscholen

An MP asked the Minister of Health how the adopted motion on clarity for dance schools would be implemented, why sports gyms could reopen while dance schools could not, and whether dance schools could restart on 1 July 2020. The minister answered that the motion was already settled through the 1 July loosening decision, that dance schools fall under indoor sport which was permitted again from 1 July, and that earlier outdoor lessons had been possible.
Indoor sports were not permitted until 1 July, so this also applied to gyms.
Binnensporten was tot 1 juli niet toegestaan, dus ook niet voor sportscholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Kerstens over het document ‘Ouderlijke verantwoordelijkheid voor zorg in de zorgverzekeringswet’

MPs Kerstens and Hijink asked whether the minister knew of a document on parental responsibility for care under the Zorgverzekeringswet and why parents caring for seriously ill children were being assessed lower on indications based on it. The minister said the document has no official status, that the professional body V&VN has put its new care norm on hold, and that he will talk with stakeholders and parents, while declining to dictate the professional group's timetable.
I am going to discuss this with the involved child-care parties.
Ik ga hierover met de betrokken kindzorg-partijen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Raemakers over de consultatie van de Wet houdende wijziging van de Jeugdwet en enige andere wetten

MPs Wörsdörfer and Raemakers asked why the consultation on the Youth Act amendment bill started on 10 July 2020 when the minister had said he hoped to start it after the summer, and whether the consultation period of about eight weeks, overlapping holidays, gave municipalities enough time to respond. The minister answered that the aim had long been summer consultation, that the eight-week period accommodates all parties, and that he will not extend the period but will discuss the outcome with parliament this autumn.
I would like to discuss with your House this autumn how I intend to deal with the outcome of the consultation, and I therefore do not intend to extend the consultation period in general.
Ik wil graag dit najaar nog met uw Kamer bespreken hoe ik met de opbrengst uit de consultatie wil omgaan en ben daarom niet van plan om de consultatieperiode in zijn algemeenheid te verlengen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht van de Vereniging van Ouderengeneeskundigen (Verenso) dat stelt dat het voorkomen van een nieuwe lockdown in verpleeghuizen bij een tweede coronagolf vraagt om een an

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health about a Verenso statement that preventing a renewed nursing-home lockdown requires a different organisation of care, and about protective equipment, testing, deaths and the use of sedating medication in nursing homes during the lockdown. The minister answered that lessons are being drawn from the bezoekregeling, that protective equipment and testing are secured, and that IGJ is verifying signals on sedative medication use.
There are currently no hard figures available on the use of sedating medication in nursing homes.
Er zijn op dit moment geen harde cijfers beschikbaar over de toepassing van rustgevende medicatie in verpleeghuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de impact van racisme op de gezondheid

An MP asked the health minister about the effects of racism and discrimination on health, including mental health and ethnic health gaps, and whether research and care should address this. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to campaigns, diversity in medical research and inclusive research groups, and referred to other ministries' work, without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet is committed to countering this as much as possible.
Het kabinet maakt zich er sterk voor om dit zoveel mogelijk tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht 'Met een scootmobiel ben je niet meer welkom in de regiotaxi'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that scooter users were temporarily refused in regional taxis under a sector protocol, and whether scooters should be treated like wheelchairs. The minister explained the protocol treated scooters as luggage for safety reasons, that the rule was lifted from 1 July 2020, and that scooters serve independence but other aids can be used at destinations.

This protocol was drawn up by Koninklijk Nederlands Vervoer (KNV), the national trade association for entrepreneurs in care and taxi transport, and the trade unions FNV and CNV, in consultation with client organisations and other relevant parties.

Dit protocol is opgesteld door Koninklijk Nederlands Vervoer (KNV), de landelijke branchevereniging voor ondernemers in het zorg- en taxivervoer, en vakbonden FNV en CNV, in overleg met cliëntorganisaties en andere relevante partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het protocol Veilig Zorgvervoer

Two 50PLUS MPs asked why scootmobiles were excluded from care transport under the sector protocol 'Veilig Zorgvervoer', citing extra contact moments and reduced mobility. The Minister explained the exclusion was a temporary safety measure to limit contact, noted that scootmobiles were allowed again from 1 July 2020, and said the protocol is a living document.
Owing to the easing of corona measures from 1 July 2020, the sector protocol for care transport now allows scootmobiles to be taken again in care transport, including the regiotaxi.

Mede door de versoepeling van coronamaatregelen per 1 juli 2020 is in het sectorprotocol voor zorgvervoer opgenomen dat scootmobielen weer in het zorgvervoer, waaronder de regiotaxi, meegenomen kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over blijvende signalen van tekorten aan persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen voor zorgverleners

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about persistent shortages of personal protective equipment for care workers, including outside hospitals, and why PPE is not provided preventively. The minister reported 71 million items distributed, said PPE use is risk-based with professional discretion added from 1 May, and that preventive provision is not desirable because it could create scarcity.
Generally deploying personal protective equipment preventively is not desirable because it could in turn create scarcity.
Algemeen preventief inzetten van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen is niet wenselijk omdat daardoor juist weer schaarste kan ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor kinderen en jongeren in jeugdzorg

An MP asked the Health Minister about the effects of the COVID-19 crisis on youth care, including reduced care delivery, the risk of children falling out of view, monitoring, and youth participation in treatment. The minister answered that effects on long-term demand are not yet clear, that care is partly recovering since mid-May, and that impact is monitored with commitments to keep working with providers and youth councils.
This means it is not yet possible to make statements about the long-term effects of the coronavirus crisis on the number of young people needing youth care.
Dit maakt dat het op dit moment nog niet mogelijk is om uitspraken te doen wat de effecten van de Coronacrisis zijn op het aantal jongeren die jeugdhulp nodig hebben voor de lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het eerder openen van coffeeshops

An MP asked why coffeeshops were not allowed to reopen with full hospitality like other catering businesses on 1 June 2020, and whether this caused nuisance or illegal trade. The minister explained that gradual reopening was needed to control the virus, that coffeeshops were allowed to reopen from 1 July under the same conditions as regular hospitality, and that no signals of nuisance or illegal trade had been received.
This means coffeeshops may also open from 1 July, including for the hospitality function, under the same conditions as regular hospitality.
Dit betekent dat de coffeeshops ook per 1 juli open mogen, ook voor de horecafunctie, onder dezelfde voorwaarden als de reguliere horeca.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet en Renkema over de berichten ‘Verpleeghuizen wilden al vroeg testen maar werden geweigerd’, 'Protocol voor contactonderzoek kent twee grote zwakke plekken' en ’Inval-minis

Greens MPs asked the health minister about nursing homes being denied COVID-19 testing, the contact-tracing protocol, staffing needs, and the procurement of protective equipment through the national LCH consortium. The minister answered most questions with figures and explanations, while declining to give some data (such as the Germany, Belgium and France mask purchase figures) and deferring on the one-by-one timing request.
No, I do not have this overview at the moment.
Nee, dit overzicht heb ik op dit moment niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het beperkt aantal wettelijke verlofdagen in een verpleeghuis

An MP asked the health minister about the limit on leave days for residents of long-term care facilities, after a broadcast reported a 42-day cap. The minister answered that the total declarable absence is 146 days per year, that the NZa is willing to discuss and adjust the rules with care providers, and that the answer was delayed by the corona crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Acute geldproblemen bij kleine zorginstellingen door corona’

Deputy Kerstens (PvdA) asked the health minister about reports that small residential care initiatives face acute financial problems due to COVID-19 and whether the government will prevent their collapse and compensate extra costs and lost income. The minister acknowledged the problem and said continuity of care is paramount, pointing to expanded personal budget (pgb) spending options and opening the extra corona costs scheme to affected initiatives, while the detailed solution was still being worked out with stakeholders.
For me, continuity of care comes first.
Voor mij staat de continuïteit van zorg voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hijink over acute geldproblemen bij kleine woonzorginstellingen door corona

MP Hijink asked the minister whether small PGB-funded dementia care homes facing vacancies and lost income due to COVID-19 would receive compensation like in-kind care providers, and whether they would be allowed to convert to in-kind contracting. The minister answered that PGB-related measures were taken (declaring undelivered care, raising budgets, opening the EKC scheme), explained structural differences with in-kind care, and pointed to the zorgkantoor for conversion, while the detailed compensation design was still being worked out.
Together with the relevant field parties, I am currently further developing this solution direction.
Samen met betrokken veldpartijen werk ik deze oplossingsrichting momenteel verder uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Van Weyenberg over het heropenen van de sekswerksector

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the Dutch sex work sector could reopen under a hygiene protocol like Belgium's, and why not if not. The minister answered that the sector may reopen from 1 July under sector-drafted protocols that follow RIVM guidance, with EZK giving further advice on the protocols.
The sex work sector may reopen from 1 July.
De sekswerksector mag per 1 juli weer open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het Hoenderloo College

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked the ministers about an open letter from Hoenderloo College staff alleging misconduct by Pluryn toward the works council, parents and youth, the inspectorate's role, and the closure and social plan. The minister answers that responsibility lies primarily with Pluryn, that the inspectorate monitors closely and rejects the staff's description of its role, that placements are being arranged with ongoing monitoring, and that a social plan was agreed on 26 June 2020.
The education inspectorate supervises the quality and continuity of education.
De onderwijsinspectie ziet toe op de kwaliteit en continuïteit van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bergkamp over het maximaal aantal afwezigheidsdagen in verpleeghuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the rules limiting nursing home residents to 42 leave days a year (maximum two weeks at a time) unduly restrict family care, and whether the rules could be made more flexible. The minister acknowledged the limits, said exceptions can be arranged case by case and that the NZa is willing to discuss adjusting the rules, but kept the basic principles of part-time stay unchanged.
The NZa has informed me that it is willing to discuss bottlenecks in the rules and conditions on funding of absence days with care offices and care providers and, where necessary, adjust them.

De NZa heeft mij laten weten bereid te zijn om met zorgkantoren en zorgaanbieders/ brancheverenigingen knelpunten in de regels en nadere voorwaarden rondom de bekostiging van de afwezigheidsdagen te bespreken en zo nodig aan te passen
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bromet over het rapport ‘Uitgesproken’

MP Bromet asked the ministers about the 'Uitgesproken' report on pesticide use near residents in Westerveld, including the lack of citizen participation in the local convenant, the planned LNV pilot and the timing of the Health Council advice. Minister Schouten answered that local parties should find their own balance, that the pilot is being prepared under provincial leadership, and that the Health Council advice was published on 29 June 2020 with a reply sent separately.
My preference is that residents and growers enter into dialogue with each other to reach satisfactory agreements at the local level.
Het heeft mijn voorkeur dat omwonenden en telers met elkaar in gesprek komen om op lokaal niveau bevredigende afspraken te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een Amerikaanse farmaceut een Nederlands coronamedicijn in productie neemt

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that an American pharmaceutical firm would mass-produce a Dutch COVID-19 antibody drug, including the government's role, licensing terms, export risks and European production. The minister answered that he was not involved in licensing talks, that UMC licensing principles would apply, and that export-restriction questions were premature.
Conversations of this kind are usually confidential, and I have no further information about them.
Dit type gesprekken verloopt in de regel vertrouwelijk, ik heb hier verder geen informatie over.
Antwoord op vragen van van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het Hoenderloo College

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked why the Hoenderloo College is closing by 1 August 2020, whether Pluryn is meeting its duty of care, and whether the ministers can intervene or place the foundation under curatorship. The ministers replied that the closure date is only a target, the institution closes only once every young person has a suitable follow-up placement, the inspectorate is monitoring this and has tightened supervision, and curatorship of a private foundation is not possible outside bankruptcy.
It has been agreed, however, that the Hoenderloo Group will only close once a suitable and sustainable follow-up place has been found for every young person.
Afgesproken is, echter, dat de Hoenderloo Groep pas sluit als er voor iedere jongere een passende en duurzame vervolgplek is.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het nijpende huisartsentekort

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the ministers about the worsening general practitioner shortage, including whether the duty of care can still be met, the impact on quality of care, administrative burdens, training capacity and additional funding. The minister answered that insurers have a leading role under the duty of care, that the ministry and the LHV will support regions, and that additional funds and measures such as task-shifting and digital care are being pursued, without committing to new legislation.

The Ministry of VWS and the Dutch GP association LHV will, with the help of a bureau, go into the regions to provide support and help regions increase access to GP care in both the short and long term.

Het Ministerie van VWS en de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging (LHV) gaan met medewerking van een bureau regio's in om ondersteuning te bieden en regio's te helpen met de toegankelijkheid van huisartsenzorg te verhogen voor zowel de korte als lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over ontwikkelingen op het gebied van seksuele gezondheid

An SGP MP asked the minister about sexual health education: the review of lesson methods, the budget and its distribution for schools, the level playing field for providers, state-aid consequences for Rutgers, continuity of counselling contracts, and abortion counselling and aftercare. The minister answered that the Kwink study and a letter would follow, detailed a 7.1 million euro annual budget, said no further measures were needed on abortion clinic cooperation, and gave a substantive but partly general account.
This study will be submitted by Kwink Groep in June, and the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport will then inform you about it.
Dit onderzoek wordt in juni aangeboden door Kwink Groep en de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal u vervolgens daarover informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de berichten 'Vleessector vindt kritiek op hygiëne in coronatijden niet terecht' en 'Schouder aan schouder aan de lopende band: slachterijen willen coronatests'

An MP from D66 asked ministers how food safety in meat processing is guaranteed during the coronavirus crisis, how infections among slaughterhouse workers are being prevented, and whether testing of workers should be done. The government answered that the NVWA keeps official meat inspection running as usual, that Inspectie SZW has issued guidance and accepts complaints, and that testing will be risk-based and phased in outbreak locations.
If the NVWA finds that slaughterhouses do not comply with all RIVM guidelines, no inspections take place.
Indien de NVWA constateert dat slachthuizen zich niet houden aan alle RIVM-richtlijnen vinden er geen keuringen plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over veiligheidsmaatregelen voor vliegtuigpassagiers en -personeel

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Bruins asked about aircraft transmission risks of COVID-19 (drawing on SARS-1 evidence), EASA/ECDC guidance, and whether the OMT should advise on flying. Minister De Jonge answered that protocols were drafted by the sector based on RIVM advice, measures are indefinite, evidence on in-flight transmission is limited, and the OMT has not been asked but RIVM has advised twice.
On the basis of existing literature, no sound comparison can be made between transmission of SARS-CoV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 on aircraft.
Er kan op basis van bestaande literatuur geen goed vergelijk worden gemaakt tussen overdracht van SARS-CoV-1 en SARS-CoV-2 in vliegtuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de oprichting van de Inclusieve Vaccin Alliantie

An MP asked the health minister how the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance with Germany, France and Italy relates to a joint EU vaccine purchase, whether more countries will join, how it balances EU supply against vaccines for vulnerable countries, how it fits with other global initiatives, and how EU production will be stimulated. The minister answered that the Alliance is a step toward the EU Vaccine Strategy, that talks with some member states are ongoing, that non-EU interest is being considered, and that commitments to production in Europe and to CEPI were made.
It was taken as a starting point that every agreement should be accessible to all EU member states under the same conditions as for the initiators.
Daarbij is het uitgangspunt vooropgezet dat elke afspraak voor alle EU-lidstaten onder dezelfde condities als voor de initiatiefnemers toegankelijk zou moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over het bericht dat het meer testen in de zorg doden had kunnen schelen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister whether it was true that more testing in care could have saved lives, and why he opposed a motion to optimise testing capacity. The minister answered that testing was expanded step by step in line with laboratory capacity, the OMT advice and the easing of measures, and rejected that he made an error.
No, certainly not. Based on the increased testing capacity, the OMT advised on 30 March to expand the testing policy from 6 April.
Nee, geenszins. Het OMT adviseerde op basis van de toegenomen testcapaciteit op 30 maart om het testbeleid uit te breiden per 6 april.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de bestelling van 300 miljoen vaccins bij AstraZeneca

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the 300 million AstraZeneca vaccine deal amounts to vaccine nationalism, how the doses and prices are set, who advised on it, and asked about AstraZeneca's past legal cases. The minister rejected vaccine nationalism, said the deal is open to all EU states, withheld price and R&D cost details to protect negotiations, and declined to comment on the past cases.
The negotiation result was not made public because this could harm the alliance's negotiating position and that of the European Joint Negotiation Team in talks with other pharmaceutical companies.

Het onderhandelingsresultaat is niet openbaar gemaakt omdat dit de onderhandelingspositie van de alliantie en in het vervolg van het Europese Joint Negotiation Team in gesprekken met andere farmaceutische bedrijven kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het artikel ‘Helpt ventileren tegen corona? Nederland negeert Duits advies frisse lucht’

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Health Minister about a newspaper article on ventilation against COVID-19, requesting OMT advice, Dutch research on aerogenic transmission, current infection and hospital figures, IFR, the PIENTER study and an evaluation of PCR tests.
