The minister mostly provided requested figures and referred to RIVM publications and a technical briefing, while declining to answer the question on the unidentified evaluation report as unclear.
For the answers to these questions, I refer you to the letter to the House of 24 June 2020 and its annex: the OMT advice.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen, verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief van 24 juni 2020 en de bijlage van de Kamerbrief: het OMT-advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Van der Staaij over de financiering van ziekenhuizen en over het bericht ‘NVZ: ‘VWS laat ziekenhuizen en verzekeraars vrij worstelen over geld’

MPs Ellemeet and Van der Staaij asked about a 47% fall in hospital care revenue during COVID-19, whether hospitals should be fully compensated, whether all hospitals are protected from bankruptcy, and whether the financing system should change. Minister Van Rijn answered that insurers' continuity payments and cost reimbursement are in place, the NZa supervises insurers, a Contourennota on the system is postponed to autumn, and the regime for larger providers is still being worked out.
With the continuity contribution and extra-cost scheme there is compensation, so hospitals need not get into financial difficulties because of the coronavirus crisis.
Met de continuïteitsbijdrage en meerkostenregeling is er sprake van compensatie, waardoor ziekenhuizen niet vanwege de coronacrisis in financiële problemen hoeven te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat bij een slachthuis 1 op de 5 medewerkers besmet is met corona

An MP asked the health minister about reports that one in five staff at a Groenlo slaughterhouse had tested positive for coronavirus, questioning contact tracing speed, quarantine, income protection, data completeness and housing of migrant workers. The government answered that contact tracing largely took place within 48 hours, all staff were tested and quarantined, LCI guidelines were followed, and a risk-based plan for sector outbreaks and a migrant worker protection team were being developed.
It requires a lot of investigative work to establish how many of the 'close contacts' have been tested.
Het vraagt veel uitzoekwerk om na te gaan hoeveel van de «nauwe contacten» getest zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat het RIVM geen richtlijnen wil opleggen voor vliegverkeer

MP Asscher (PvdA) asked the health minister why the RIVM would not impose binding COVID-19 rules on air travel, questioning the evidence base, the absence of rules compared with other sectors, and whether economic motives play a role. The minister answered that the RIVM is not guided by economic motives, that aircraft ventilation and sector protocols mitigate risk, that travellers must stay home if symptomatic, and that monitoring and contact tracing will be stepped up.
The RIVM does not allow itself to be guided by economic motives when drawing up guidelines and advice.
Het RIVM laat zich bij het opstellen van richtlijnen en adviezen niet leiden door economische motieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ellemeet over de berichten dat KLM weer wil gaan vliegen op diverse Europese steden

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers whether KLM's plan to resume flights to European cities, including COVID-19 hotspots, was sensible given travel restrictions, and about cabin safety, masks and staff protection. The minister answered that entry rules, RIVM-based airline protocols, travel advice and mask guidance address the risks, and that KLM had not consulted RIVM or the OMT.
As far as I am aware, KLM has not held consultations with the RIVM and OMT about expanding flights to European cities.
Voor zover mij bekend heeft KLM geen overleg gevoerd met het RIVM en OMT over uitbreiding van vluchten naar Europese steden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid voor mensen met een handicap in het openbaar vervoer in het licht van de coronacrisis

MPs Schonis and Bergkamp asked how people with disabilities can keep access to public transport during the COVID-19 measures, including wheelchair space loss and assistance. The State Secretary answered that the OV protocol applies to all travellers, NS assistance is fully restored from 1 June, and the working group will report later, committing to a letter and involving disability organisations.
How this will be elaborated, I will let your House know in the letter I promised at the committee debate.
Hoe dit uitgewerkt wordt, zal ik aan uw Kamer laten weten in de brief die ik heb toegezegd bij het notaoverleg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Westerveld en Renkema over het openbaar vervoer

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about public transport access during COVID-19, including the OV protocol, student timing, support for people with disabilities, and bicycle policy. The state secretary answered that the protocol protects all users, that Reisassistentie is fully available again from 1 June, and that a further letter on accessibility for people with disabilities will follow.
How accessibility will be further guaranteed for this group is a topic of discussion in the OV protocol working group.
Hoe toegankelijkheid verder wordt gewaarborgd voor deze groep is onderwerp van gesprek in de werkgroep OV-protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de richtlijnen voor reizen per vliegtuig in coronatijd

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the ministers why aviation COVID-19 rules differ from those for public transport, hospitality and culture, and how the rules are enforced, along with related questions on refunds, EASA guidance and whether the sector is left to self-regulate. The minister answered that sector-specific risk assessments, RIVM advice, airline protocols, and enforcement by airports, safety regions and the Marechaussee justify the approach, while largely deferring details to earlier letters.

If in the view of the chair of the Safety Region insufficient measures are taken or irresponsible health situations arise, additional restrictive measures can be imposed, such as closing parts of certain locations.

Als naar het oordeel van de voorzitter van de Veiligheidsregio onvoldoende maatregelen worden getroffen of er vanuit oogpunt van gezondheidszorg onverantwoorde situaties ontstaan, kunnen aanvullende beperkende maatregelen getroffen worden, zoals het sluiten van delen van bepaalde locaties.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peters, Van der Molen en Slootweg over de uitgestelde invoering van het nieuwe woonplaatsbeginsel

Three CDA MPs asked why the new woonplaatsbeginsel (residence principle for youth care funding) was postponed and whether municipalities such as Goirle are financially harmed. The minister answered that the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ care is extended by a year and raised to 30 million euros, and that postponement to 2022 was chosen to ensure careful implementation given the COVID-19 workload on municipalities.
Now that the introduction of the youth residence principle has been postponed by one year, the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ is extended by one year.
Nu de invoering van het woonplaatsbeginsel jeugd met een jaar is uitgesteld, wordt de compensatieregeling voogdij en 18+ met een jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Renkema en Kuiken over jeugdzorg en de (jeugd-)GGZ

MPs Westerveld, Renkema and Kuiken asked the health minister about youth care and mental health services disrupted by COVID-19, including remote care, crisis beds, support for children in unsafe homes, financial stability of providers and shortages of protective equipment. The minister answered that the ministry monitors signals via crisis-structure consultations, supports digital care, reports crisis-bed capacity as sufficient, lists measures for children at risk, and describes agreements with VNG and the Jeugdautoriteit on continued funding.
When signals arrive repeatedly, we place them on the agenda of one of the consultations we set up within the corona crisis structure for mental health care and youth care.
Als signalen herhaaldelijk binnenkomen, agenderen we deze in één van de overleggen die we hebben opgezet in het kader van de corona-crisisstructuur voor de GGZ en voor de jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de voorgenomen stelselwijziging in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the VNG's proposed voluntary Norm for Client-Side Commissioning (NvO) on youth care regional cooperation is sufficient, whether municipal self-regulation can provide clarity and steering, and whether structural extra funding and an arbitration committee are adequate. The Minister answers that the NvO aligns with government plans, that a bill strengthening regional cooperation is being prepared for internet consultation in summer, that a study on structural funding results at end 2020, and that the VNG's expert team rejected legal limits on the youth care entitlement.
The cabinet has a bill in preparation. It aims, among other things, to strengthen regional cooperation.
Het kabinet heeft een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding. Deze ziet onder meer op het versterken van regionale samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about the financial distress of the Hoenderloo Groep (Pluryn), the sale of its property, the number of youths without a suitable placement, and whether ministry oversight is adequate. The minister answered that Pluryn is responsible for its own finances and that the Youth Authority monitors them, that about 18 youths still lack a lasting placement with closure targeted for 1 August 2020, and that the state cannot place a youth care provider under curatorship.
Youth care providers are themselves responsible for their business operations.
Jeugdhulpaanbieders zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een bonus voor zorgverleners

An MP asked the ministers whether they will provide clarity and quick payment of a promised bonus for healthcare workers, and whether structural pay increases are planned. The minister replied that an independent explorer is working with unions and employers on the form of the bonus, expected within weeks, and pointed to recent collective agreements and the annual government contribution to labour cost growth.
I hope to be able to tell the House, and especially the people in healthcare, within a few weeks what the reward will look like.
Ik hoop de Kamer en vooral de mensen in de zorg over enkele weken te kunnen melden hoe de beloning er uit gaat zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kerstens over de aanhoudende problemen die gezinnen met ernstig zieke kinderen ervaren

MPs Hijink and Kerstens asked the Health Minister how government will resolve persistent problems families of seriously ill children face with insurers and care indications, why the minister will not respond to case files submitted by the BVIKZ, and about the upcoming indication guidelines. The minister refers to earlier letters, says he cannot judge individual cases, points to the SKGZ complaints body, and says a professional-standards handbook is being drafted with consultation of parent organisations.
I cannot judge the content of the cases, as I do not have the (nursing) knowledge and expertise for that.
Ik kan niet oordelen over de inhoud van de casussen, daar heb ik de (verpleegkundige) kennis en expertise niet voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over bezoekverboden aan niet-coronapatienten in Limburgse ziekenhuizen

An MP asked whether hospitals in Limburg still maintain visitor bans for non-COVID patients and what the guidelines are. The minister replied that since 2 June no Limburg hospital has a full ban, that hospitals set their own visiting arrangements (one visitor per day at the named hospitals), and that there are no specific national guidelines on visits.
There are no specific guidelines regarding hospital visits for (non-)COVID patients.
Er zijn geen specifieke richtlijnen met betrekking tot ziekenhuisbezoek aan (niet-)coronapatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de productie van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen in Nederland

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister about domestic production of personal protective equipment, including which producers exist, certification capacity for masks in the Netherlands, and whether small firms are treated equally to large ones in procurement via the LCH. The Minister answered that no full registry exists, listed selected contracts and certifying bodies, said the government will not set up its own notified body, and that firms bear the risk of failed certification.
A general overview of all manufacturers of protective equipment in the Netherlands cannot be given, because this is not registered.
Een algemeen overzicht van alle fabrikanten van beschermingsmiddelen in Nederland is niet te geven, omdat dit niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aankoop van vijf miljoen afgekeurde mondkapjes

Two SP MPs asked the Minister why around five million government-purchased face masks were rejected as unfit for care, what their type, financial impact and recovery prospects are, and what happens to them. The Minister said the LCH procurement consortium checks quality at three stages, withholds payment on rejected goods and has no recall insurance, and that the risk to the ministry cannot yet be quantified and rejected masks are being checked for other uses.
The LCH generally pays part of the purchase price in advance, but for part of the purchases no financial obligation was entered into in advance.
Het LCH betaalt, in de regel, vooraf een gedeelte van de koopsom aan, maar voor een deel van de aankopen is vooraf geen financiële verplichting aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het invoeren van een draagplicht voor niet-functionele mondmaskers in het openbaar vervoer

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked how a mandatory face-covering rule in public transport would be enforced, and questioned why non-medical masks need no CE marking or minimum quality standards and why masks are not provided free of charge. Minister Bruins answered that enforcement runs through existing transport supervisors without checking mask type, that NEN is drafting recommendations for non-medical masks, and that people are responsible for buying their own masks, with VAT lowered to 0%.
People themselves are responsible for purchasing a face mask.
Mensen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het aanschaffen van een mondkapje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over de zwendel met mondmaskers

An MP asked the health minister about reports of chaos and fraud in face-mask purchasing, the quality of masks supplied via the national consortium (LCH), and what happens to rejected masks. The minister answered that quality checks and inspectorate oversight are in place, stock levels are sufficient, and rejected masks are being returned or reassessed, though details are limited.

Oversight by the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority, the Labour Inspectorate, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate and the Fiscal Intelligence and Investigation Service is therefore very important.

Toezicht door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA), Inspectie SZW (iSZW), Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) en het Fiscale inlichtingen- en opsporingsdienst (FIOD) is daarom erg belangrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel 'Zorgverzekeraars frustreren specialistische ouderenzorg in de wijk'

An MP asks whether insurers frustrate specialist elderly care (SO) in the community and why earlier motions on structural funding and inclusion of MESO were not implemented. The minister says SO care is now in the basic package, acknowledges insurers' contracting conditions requiring 'verblijf', promises talks with insurers, NZa and Zorginstituut, and a subsidy study for MESO, reporting back in autumn.
I have had contact with health insurers about this.
Ik heb hierover contact gehad met zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars specialisten ouderenzorg in de wijk frustreren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why insurers' contracting conditions make it hard for geriatric specialists to work in the community, and about tariff cuts for elderly care. The Minister replied that insurers have a duty of care overseen by the NZa, that the conditions are being discussed with insurers and Verenso, and that tariff cuts reflect cost research and the lack of a quality framework.
That is why I have invited both Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) and Verenso to discuss the contracting conditions.
Daarom heb ik zowel Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) als Verenso uitgenodigd om over de inkoopvoorwaarden in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het verdiepend onderzoek naar ‘inzicht in besteding jeugdhulpmiddelen’

MP Peters (CDA) asked the Minister of Health about industry objections to the representativeness and depth of the study on spending of youth care funds, the follow-up research, data limits and cost drivers. The Minister answered that the study was never meant to be representative, that the follow-up will be representative and involve the sector, and that cost growth and data issues are being addressed, but largely deferred methodological choices to research bureaus.
It was left to the research bureaus that submitted a tender to decide which data they wish to use.
Het is aan de onderzoeksbureaus die een offerte hebben ingediend overgelaten van welke data zij gebruik willen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat Leeuwarden stopt met inkoop van specialistische hulp voor vrouwen in opvang voor 43 gemeenten

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the minister about Leeuwarden ending its role as national purchaser of specialist women's shelter care for 43 municipalities, and whether this threatens care continuity and signals an unsustainable system. The minister answered that responsibility lies with municipalities under the Wmo2015, the Leeuwarden contract runs to 31 December 2020, the VNG and centre municipalities are arranging an orderly handover, and he sees no reason for national action at this point.
It is up to municipalities to set quality requirements for this provision and, based on those requirements, to decide which organisation to contract the care to.
Het is daarmee aan gemeenten om eisen te stellen aan de kwaliteit van deze voorziening en – op basis van deze eisen – te beslissen bij welke organisatie zij deze zorg beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat Ritalin zonder goede diagnostiek worden voorgeschreven

An MP asked the Minister of Health about research showing Ritalin is prescribed to children without proper diagnosis, and whether guidelines are followed and why prescriptions have fallen since 2015. The minister acknowledged that diagnostics must be careful, noted the increase was fourfold rather than tenfold, and said the 2019 ADHD care standard aims to prevent over- and under-diagnosis.
Careful diagnosis is the basis of adequate medical practice when prescribing medicines.
Zorgvuldige diagnostiek is bij het voorschrijven van medicijnen de grondslag van adequaat medisch handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen en Kuiken over de omvang en aanpak van seksuele intimidatie en geweld jegens meisjes en vrouwen in Amsterdam

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers about the scale of sexual harassment and violence against girls and women in Amsterdam, the city's measures, and whether a national gender-sensitive approach and VNG coordination are needed. The government welcomed Amsterdam's measures, pointed to national research, a pending review of the Istanbul Convention recommendations, VNG coordination work and planned extensions of the Veilige Steden programme, and noted new sex offence legislation and extra funding for vice teams.
Together with the other relevant departments, NGOs and experts, I will in the coming period discuss the recommendations in the evaluation report, including this one.
Samen met de andere betrokken departementen, NGO's en experts ga ik de komende tijd in gesprek over aanbevelingen in het evaluatierapport, waaronder deze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Westerveld over het artikel ‘Jeugdzorgbedden weg in Oss en Boxtel, kan dat wel?’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Westerveld asked the minister about youth care beds closing in Oss and Boxtel, how waiting lists for specialist youth care are monitored regionally and nationally, and whether the inspectorate and providers can make waiting lists transparent. The minister answered that municipalities hold the youth care duty and that waiting-list problems must be addressed regionally, announcing binding inter-municipal cooperation and a regional approach, while declining a national overview and not committing to new agreements beyond existing regional commitments.
They hold the youth care duty and are responsible for sufficient suitable care provision.
Zij hebben de jeugdhulpplicht en zijn verantwoordelijk voor voldoende passend hulpaanbod.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over gedupeerde studenten van niet-erkende beroepsopleidingen in de zorg

MPs asked why UWV referred students to non-accredited care training run by Quadrant, whether UWV and the government will prevent this and whether they will help affected students. The minister answered that UWV only checked accreditation and that the contract was ended, promised tighter voucher rules and periodic talks with trainers, but said no diploma can be issued outside accredited schools and offered only a conversation with affected students.
UWV is working on an adjustment of the procurement framework that sets out the contractual obligations of a trainer.
UWV werkt aan een aanpassing van het inkoopkader waarin de contractuele verplichtingen van een opleider zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht dat veel private equity en buitenlandse partijen betrokken zijn bij fusies in de zorg

An MP asked the health minister about private equity and foreign takeovers of care providers, including the Stepping Stones/Korian case, covering client and works council involvement, NZa powers to assess quality and affordability, board composition, and funding and staffing. The minister answered that councils have advisory rights, that the NZa currently cannot refuse a merger on quality or affordability grounds though tightening is being considered, and gave factual answers on the Stepping Stones board, funding and staffing.
However, the NZa currently does not have the power to reject a merger request on the basis of possible consequences for the quality and affordability of care.
De NZa heeft echter momenteel niet de bevoegdheid een fusieverzoek af te wijzen op basis van mogelijke gevolgen voor de kwaliteit en betaalbaarheid van de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het effect van het verbod op plastic rietjes op mensen met een beperking

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked the health minister about the effect of the EU-based ban on plastic straws on people with disabilities who depend on them. The minister acknowledges that no adequate alternatives exist yet, points to the medical-device exemption, says a consultation with stakeholders and the ministry of Infrastructure is underway, and offers to organise a meeting with the target group and manufacturers.
I am willing (together with the Ministry of IenW) to organise such a consultation to examine which alternative options exist.
Ik ben bereid (samen met het Ministerie van IenW) om zo’n overleg te organiseren om te onderzoeken welke alternatieve mogelijkheden er zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over stopzetten van de huishoudelijke verzorging in de gemeente Montferland

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health whether the municipality of Montferland may withdraw home-care indications when clients pause care out of fear of COVID-19, and how the minister judges this. The minister answers that unilateral withdrawal without careful individual assessment conflicts with the Wmo 2015, that the municipality has said it will not withdraw such decisions, and that the minister will consider interbestuurlijk toezicht if the council's intervention fails.
Unilaterally withdrawing a decision whose term has not expired, without prior and careful investigation of the individual client's circumstances, is not in line with the provisions of the Wmo 2015.

Het eenzijdig intrekken van een beschikking waarvan de looptijd niet verstreken is, zonder voorafgaand en zorgvuldig onderzoek naar de individuele omstandigheden van de betreffende cliënt, is niet in overstemming met het ter zake bepaalde in de Wmo 2015.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de brief van een wetenschapper uit Milaan dat meer concrete kennis door meer systematisch onderzoek nodig is om ons door de CoV crisis te loodsen'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how the government responds to a Milan scientist's letter calling for more systematic research on COVID-19, including transmission, immunity and severity. The minister agreed research is needed, cited ongoing Dutch and EU studies and provided preliminary figures, but did not answer question 6 on timing.
I have therefore forwarded this letter to the RIVM with the request to look at his proposal.
Ik heb deze brief dan ook aan het RIVM doorgestuurd met het verzoek om te kijken naar zijn voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de reportage 'Stille ramp in verpleeghuis: 'de ouderen gaan hier één-voor-één dood''

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about a Nieuwsuur report on COVID-19 deaths in nursing homes, covering infections, IGJ signals, protective equipment, testing, isolation, and care for vulnerable groups. The minister answered at length, citing case figures, outlining guidelines and testing policy, and pointing to earlier letters for many details.
No registration is available of the number of infected employees in nursing homes.
Van het aantal besmette medewerkers in verpleeghuizen is geen registratie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Een op de vier medewerkers in verpleeghuizen Nijmegen besmet met corona'

MPs Kerstens asked the minister about a report that about a quarter of tested nursing home staff in the Nijmegen region had COVID-19, and about causes, protective equipment, sick-leave rules and staffing. The minister confirmed the report, said national data on staff infections by sector are not available, attributed the spread in nursing homes to several factors, and pointed to measures on testing, protective equipment and staffing.
No, I do not have national information on infections among staff in the nursing home sector.
Nee, ik beschik niet over landelijke informatie omtrent besmettingen van medewerkers in de verpleeghuissector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht 'Onbegrijpelijke concurrentie rond abortus'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health about abortion clinics remaining open to foreign women during the COVID-19 crisis, the clinics' infection-control measures and consultation practices, and whether the abortion pill would be made freely available. The Minister answered that clinics remain open and accessible, that the reflection period and in-person safeguards continue under a temporary telephone-consult arrangement, and that the sexual education and counselling programme has been delayed by the pandemic.
Also during the coronavirus crisis, Dutch statutory and regulatory framework applies.
Ook tijdens de coronacrisis geldt de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de handelwijze van Facilicom/Axxicom in de thuiszorg

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why Facilicom/Axxicom urged thuiszorg staff to take holiday days, whether staff can be forced to take leave, and why home-care workers lack protective equipment and testing. The minister replied that employers may request but not force leave, that protective equipment and testing are available in specified cases, and that the employer bears the risk of reduced work.
However, an employee is not obliged to do so.
Een werknemer is hiertoe echter niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de toegang tot abortushulpverlening ten tijde van de coronacrisis

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister of Health whether women unable to reach abortion clinics during the COVID-19 measures, and whether telemedicine abortion and pharmacy dispensing should be allowed. The minister replied that abortion care remains available, that case-by-case solutions are offered, and that telemedicine abortion is not considered medically responsible care, so no system change is planned.
Also during this corona crisis, Dutch abortion care is available and accessible.
Ook tijdens deze coronacrisis is de Nederlandse abortushulpverlening namelijk beschikbaar en toegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht Expertisecentrum Euthanasie stopt met hulp wegens corona

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the Expertise Centre for Euthanasia suspending its assistance due to COVID-19, including shortages of protective equipment and whether SCEN doctors and GPs continue their work. The Minister responded that the Centre resumed care in phases since week 18, that it meets RIVM guidelines and is eligible for PPE, and that GPs and palliative care continue, with monitoring of medicine supplies.
The situation has since changed: the Expertise Centre for Euthanasia has gradually resumed its assistance since week 18.
Inmiddels is de situatie veranderd: het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie heeft sinds week 18 de hulpverlening gefaseerd hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Ophef over stopzetten hulp van gemeente Montferland in coronatijd'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a municipality (Montferland) that reportedly withdrew care assessments from clients who refused help during the COVID-19 crisis, pressuring them and saving costs. The minister said the municipality's approach was inappropriate and contrary to the Wmo 2015, that it has since committed not to apply it, and that he will monitor this closely and may use interbestuurlijk toezicht if needed.
Unilaterally withdrawing that decision without prior careful investigation of the individual circumstances of the client is not in line with the Wmo 2015.
Het eenzijdig intrekken van die beschikking zonder voorafgaand zorgvuldig onderzoek naar de individuele omstandigheden van de betreffende cliënt, is niet in overeenstemming met de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over coronabesmettingen bij medewerkers van slachthuizen en vleesverwerkingsbedrijven

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about COVID-19 infections among slaughterhouse workers, whether the RIVM guidelines could be followed, enforcement by the NVWA and KDS, and the risk to food safety and animal welfare. Minister Schouten answered that slaughterhouses bear primary responsibility, that the NVWA can suspend work where guidelines cannot be followed and did so at four plants, and that some questions (sick-leave data, number of stoppages, stocks of meat) were not available or answered only partially.
Where the NVWA finds that the RIVM guidelines cannot adequately be followed, the NVWA employee can immediately suspend the service.
Daar waar de NVWA constateert dat de richtlijnen van het RIVM niet adequaat kunnen worden opgevolgd, kan de NVWA-medewerker de dienstverlening per direct opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over de berichten dat verpleeghuizen al vroeg wilden testen maar werden geweigerd en dat ouderen het aflegden in de strijd om aandacht

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister whether nursing homes were refused staff testing in March 2020 and why ouderen were disadvantaged, and asked about RIVM guidance, testing capacity and protective equipment. The minister answered in detail on the timeline of testing policy, said he lacked data on infections caused by staff, acknowledged an error in the 31 March letter, and stated that testing access had since largely been resolved.
No, percentages of infections in nursing homes unintentionally caused by staff are not known to me.
Nee, percentages besmettingen in verpleeghuizen die ongewild veroorzaakt zijn door personeel zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen al vroeg wilden testen maar werden geweigerd

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Diertens asked the health minister whether nursing homes were refused permission to test staff early in the COVID-19 crisis, and how testing and protective equipment guidelines evolved. The minister answered that nursing staff became eligible for testing from 6 April 2020, that testing was rationed due to scarcity, and that no data exists on refusals or on links between early testing and infection spread.
I have no information on this and cannot make an estimate.
Hier heb ik geen informatie over en ik kan ook geen inschatting maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Haga over hydroxychloroquine

MPs Baudet and Van Haga asked the health minister about Dutch research on hydroxychloroquine for COVID-19, stockpiling, international cooperation, the minister's 'quackery motion' remark, and reports of prescribing abroad. The minister replied that Dutch trials were paused after a Lancet study, that SWAB and CBG advise against first-line use since efficacy is unproven and risks exist, that about 17,000 packs were secured for hospitals, and that the motion was rightly characterised.
I will closely monitor developments in order to, in consultation with parties across the whole medicines chain, take additional efforts where necessary.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen om in overleg met de partijen in de gehele geneesmiddelenketen 5 waar nodig over te gaan tot extra inspanningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Özütok en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Van 2 uitvaarten per week naar 2 per dag: uitvaartondernemer Marjan Damen draait overuren’

MPs asked the ministers about reports that funeral directors were overstretched by rising COVID-19 deaths, including capacity in mortuaries, the role of Defence and coordination, protective equipment, coffin supply and Islamic and Jewish burial rights. The minister answered that the sector is coping, that a coordination point and Defence support can be arranged if needed, that mortuary and coffin capacity is sufficient with contingency plans, and that burial options exist.
I indeed receive questions from the funeral sector about the Corona crisis, including about the cabinet's measures and RIVM guidelines.
Ik ontvang inderdaad vragen uit de uitvaartsector over de Corona-crisis, waaronder ook over de maatregelen van het kabinet en de richtlijnen van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over de wanhopige oproep van de docenten van de Hoenderloo Groep en de huidige stand van zaken

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked about teachers' distress over the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep, including the lack of a social plan, placement of pupils, and whether the school should stay open. The minister answers that a social plan is under negotiation, pupils are being transferred to suitable youth-care places, and he sees no reason to keep the school open, while promising to keep the Chamber informed.
The Minister of VWS is willing to keep the Chamber informed of the progress of the closure, as he has done in the recent period from his system responsibility.
De Minister van VWS is bereid de Kamer, zoals hij ook de afgelopen periode heeft gedaan vanuit zijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid, op de hoogte te houden van de voortgang van de sluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de briefing inzake het testbeleid en de persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the health and medical care ministers about the procurement of personal protective equipment, the shortage claims, and the reasons no additional suppliers were added during COVID-19. Minister Van Rijn answered that the LCH buys from over fifty suppliers, that RIVM guidelines are risk-based rather than shortage-based, and that the LCH is working to expand procurement and transport, but gave no precise delivery dates.
I have instructed the LCH to procure as much protective equipment for healthcare as possible.
Ik heb het LCH opdracht gegeven om maximaal beschermingsmiddelen voor de zorg in te kopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over richtlijnen voor begrafenissen en kerkdiensten

MP Van der Staaij asks why large department stores may admit hundreds of visitors while religious services and funerals are capped at 30 people, and on what basis the restrictions are justified. The minister answers that stores are not closed by government and may operate under 1.5-metre rules, that the 30-person cap for services and funerals will be reviewed for 100 persons from 1 July on OMT advice, and that the measures will be placed on temporary legislation rather than emergency ordinances.
In a state governed by the rule of law, emergency ordinances cannot last too long, partly in view of the ongoing consequences for everyone's freedoms and fundamental rights.
In een rechtstaat kunnen noodverordeningen niet te lang duren, mede met het oog op de voortdurende gevolgen voor de vrijheden en grondrechten van eenieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de definitieve sluiting van Het Poortje

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the government about the definitive closure of Het Poortje youth institution in Groningen, including a claimed EUR 3.5 million deficit, dismissals, and whether youth care in Groningen and Drenthe remains adequate. Minister De Jonge answered that Elker will close its Groningen Jeugdzorg Plus location but continue closed youth care in smaller settings without forced dismissals, that regions are satisfied with places, and that no emergency plan is needed.
Elker Jeugdhulp & onderwijs has informed me that it will organise closed youth care differently.
Elker Jeugdhulp & onderwijs heeft mij gemeld dat zij de gesloten jeugdhulp anders gaan organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel ‘De nood is groot: 22 procent stijging in aantal verzoeken om euthanasie’

An MP asked the Health Minister about a reported 22% rise in euthanasia requests, the withdrawal of 5% of requests by treating physicians, doubts among doctors about complex cases such as dementia and psychiatric conditions, and growing waiting lists at the Expertisecentrum Euthanasie. The minister answered that the rise follows a long-term trend linked to ageing and other factors, that physicians are free to accept or refer requests, and that training modules will be made broadly available with a progress letter promised before summer.
I am currently investigating, together with the professional groups and the Expertise Centre, how the Expertise Centre's training offer can be made available to all general practitioners.
Ik onderzoek momenteel samen met de beroepsgroepen en het Expertisecentrum hoe het scholingsaanbod van het Expertisecentrum beschikbaar kan komen voor alle huisartsen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Ellemeet en Renkema over de berichten ‘Expertisecentrum kreeg vorig jaar recordaantal euthanasieverzoeken’ en ‘Jongeren die in 2017 zelfmoord pleegden vaak verstrikt in web van

MPs Westerveld, Ellemeet and Renkema asked the Health Minister about reports on record euthanasia requests at the Expertise Centre and on young people who died by suicide after being caught in the care system, asking about youth euthanasia rules, unrecorded self-harm and suicide prevention policy. The minister answered that most youth requests reflect a need for help rather than a death wish, provided statistics on youth requests and rejections, and said the government will present a new national suicide prevention agenda this year.
The Expertise Centre does not keep data on this.
Hier houdt het Expertisecentrum geen gegevens over bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over gemeenten die zich zorgen maken over de sluiting van de Hoenderloo Groep

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about municipalities' concerns over Pluryn's plan to close the Hoenderloo Groep, including a two-day response deadline, the limited influence of municipalities, the Inspectorate's concerns, and timing of clarity for youth and staff. The minister said the two-day deadline did not fit a careful process, a revised plan was circulated, the Inspectorate supports the closure as traceable while monitoring intensively, and clarity for youth and staff will come case by case.
Setting a two-day deadline for a response that must also be coordinated among many municipalities does not fit such a careful process.
Het stellen van een deadline van 2 dagen voor een reactie die ook nog tussen vele gemeenten moet worden afgestemd past niet in een dergelijk zorgvuldig proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de sluiting van locaties Hoenderloo en Deelen van jeugdzorgaanbieder Pluryn

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the closure of Pluryn's Hoenderloo and Deelen youth care locations, including whether the 'Klein Hoenderloo' rescue plan was seriously considered, the inspectorate's findings on quality and management, and placement of affected youths. The Minister answers that the rescue plan was assessed by all stakeholders as insufficiently certain, alternatives were explored, the IGJ supports the closure decision, and it will monitor placements of affected youths with monthly visits.
I proceed on the basis that a suitable follow-up will be found for every child.
Ik ga er hiermee vanuit dat voor ieder kind een passend vervolg komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de Hoenderloo-groep

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep, the sale of its site, whether Pluryn properly assessed a takeover plan, the role of the municipal council, and uncertainty for parents and youths about alternative placements. The Minister answered that Pluryn must sell property to restore finances, that the municipality will discuss the spatial framework with the council, that Pluryn and the IGJ will oversee transfers before August 2020, and that parents' intention statements are a careful procedure.
I supervise that Pluryn sets up a tight (decision-making) process with municipalities and care offices to achieve (financial) recovery and become a future-proof organisation.
Ik zie erop toe dat Pluryn een strak (besluitvormings)proces inricht met gemeenten en zorgkantoren om tot (financieel) herstel te komen en een toekomstbestendige organisatie te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Bergkamp en Van Nispen over duivelsuitdrijving bij kinderen en andere misstanden binnen religieuze gemeenschappen

MPs asked whether exorcism practices against children in religious communities, including alleged sexual abuse and threats, are harmful and criminal, and how oversight, reporting and independent research could be strengthened. The minister agreed such practices can harm children and may be criminal, pointed to Veilig Thuis and the police for oversight, declined a separate national study, and said he would consider a constitutional-law angle on restricting religious freedom by statute.

Given the extensive research agenda of the WODC and the number of studies still in the queue, I do not consider it desirable to start a separate study into the nature and extent of exorcisms in the Netherlands.

Antwoord 7 Ik acht het – mede gezien de omvangrijke onderzoeksagenda van het WODC en de hoeveelheid onderzoeken die nog in de wachtrij staan – niet wenselijk om een separaat onderzoek naar de aard en omvang van duivelsuitdrijvingen in Nederland op te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Nispen over het bericht dat verenigingen voor jeugd- en jongerenwerk in de problemen komen door de coronacrisis

MPs Von Martels, Peters and Van Nispen asked the health minister about youth and scouting associations and playground foundations facing financial trouble due to the COVID-19 crisis, and whether they are excluded from support. The minister replied that some such organisations may qualify for national support schemes, that municipalities are primarily responsible, and that the full effects are not yet known.

The municipality is the first responsible government for these associations, and if the situation for scouting or youth work lasts long, these associations will have to look with the municipality at what options exist to keep these facilities from being endangered.

De gemeente is de eerstverantwoordelijke overheid voor deze verenigingen en mocht de situatie voor de scouting of jeugdwerk langdurig voortduren dan zullen deze verenigingen dan ook met de gemeente moeten kijken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de gevolgen van de coronamaatregelen voor relatie- en opvoedingsondersteuning

An MP asked the Health Minister whether COVID-19 measures have increased demand for relationship and parenting support, whether providers such as the Eigen Kracht Centrale face financial trouble, and whether intake barriers should be lowered. The minister answered that he lacks data on the scale of demand, pointed to existing helplines, municipal support and the escalation route to the Jeugdautoriteit, and said relationship therapy is not covered by the Zvw so no deductible or GP referral applies.
I have no insight into the precise extent of the problem or whether there has been an increase in requests for such help and support.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de precieze omvang van de problematiek en of er sprake is van een stijging in het aantal aanvragen voor dergelijke hulp en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over onzekerheid bij fysiotherapeuten als gevolg van uitblijven van informatie over de  continuiteitsbijdrage van  Zorgverzekeraars Nederland

An MP asked the health minister about uncertainty among physiotherapists over the continuity contribution promised by health insurers, including the amount, conditions and timing, and whether the government would intervene. The minister replied that insurers had set out the scheme in letters of 5 April and 1 May, that advance payments were available from mid-April for listed branches, and that the contribution can be applied for from 15 May based on normal insured revenue.
Care providers can apply for the continuity contribution from 15 May.
Zorgaanbieders kunnen de continuïteitsbijdrage vanaf 15 mei as. aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Verhoeven over mondkapjes en het Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH)

MPs Diertens and Verhoeven asked why the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH) scaled up existing suppliers rather than adding new ones, whether this disadvantages other suppliers, how rejected masks are handled, and how contact professionals and citizens are informed about face masks. The minister answered that the LCH uses both existing and new suppliers, applies quality criteria, provides test results on rejection, and that information on masks is available on rijksoverheid.nl, with the LCH having no logistics role for non-medical masks.
In the case of forged certificates, no details are released, so as not to facilitate future fraud.
In het geval dat sprake is van vervalsing van certificaten, worden geen details vrijgegeven, om toekomstige fraude niet in de hand te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Wie vormen het Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH)?'

An SP MP asked the Health Minister which parties and individuals sit in the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH), who holds what responsibility, whether there is conflict of interest or profit, and how it was set up. The minister answered at length: the LCH is a temporary, non-profit public-private cooperation of individual experts (not organisations), VWS commissions and guarantees it, distributors work at cost, and the LCH was set up at the sector's request.
The LCH consists of individuals and not of organisations and institutions.
Het LCH bestaat uit personen en niet uit organisaties en instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Van Gerven over het rapport over de financialisering van big pharma (nieuwe versie)

Two SP MPs asked the minister for Medical Care about an SOMO report on the financialisation of big pharma, including shareholder payouts, debt-financed buybacks, the role of public money in COVID-19 vaccine development, and access conditions. The minister answered that transparency on R&D costs and pricing is important, that the government negotiates hard on prices and will remain transparent on public vaccine investments, and that it will insist on broad access, but did not accept the characterisation of the business model as unacceptable or unsustainable.
I will remain transparent about the Dutch government's investment strategy and within European cooperation.
Ik zal transparant blijven over de investeringsstrategie van de Nederlandse overheid en in Europees samenwerkingsverband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de Nederlandse strategie in de bestrijding van COVID-19

MP Asscher asked the government about its COVID-19 strategy, including whether it aims for containment or mitigation, the basis for contact tracing and quarantine choices, and advice on masks. Minister De Jonge answered that the strategy aims at maximal control of the virus with two central goals, and that the government will scale up testing, tracing and monitoring, while many questions were answered by reference to earlier letters or dealt with protocols and staffing.
From the start of the outbreak, the cabinet's strategy has been aimed at maximally controlling the virus.
Vanaf het begin van de uitbraak is de strategie van het kabinet gericht op het maximaal controleren van het virus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over Europese aanbesteding van medische apparatuur en hulpmiddelen

Ploumen asked the health minister about Dutch participation in EU joint procurement of protective equipment, delivery timelines, the rescEU stockpile and EU civil protection contributions. The minister answered that Nederland joined all four joint procurements, but none of the products can be delivered in the short term, with lead times up to 52 weeks, and that Nederland is still considering participation in rescEU.
Member states' bids in the various procurement procedures are confidential.
De inzet van de lidstaten op de verschillende aanbestedingsprocedures is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bijgesteld advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan ‘Capaciteitsplan 2011-2024’ en de opleidingscapaciteit van tandartsen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a revised Capacity Body advice on medical and dental training places, prompted by new CBS population projections, should be adopted, including keeping medical intake at 2900 and raising dental training capacity from 240 to 359. The minister answered that the revised advice will be taken into account in the government's response to the Capacity Plan, to be sent to parliament before summer, and did not commit to specific numbers now.
We will take the revised advice of the Capacity Body into account in our response to the Capacity Plan.
Wij zullen het bijgestelde advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan bij onze reactie op het Capaciteitsplan betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de aanhoudende intimidatie van vrouwen buiten abortusklinieken

MP Ploumen asked ministers why intimidation of women outside abortion clinics continues despite earlier debates and motions, and what measures are being taken, including whether municipalities have sufficient powers, buffer zones, group bans, and criminal law changes. The government answers that it finds such intimidation undesirable but that demonstration rights are constitutionally protected, that municipalities report sufficient powers under the Wom, that criminal law can address misconduct, and that it will keep consulting municipalities and clinics and inform parliament annually without proposing legislative change.
Municipalities have indicated that they have sufficient powers to steer the demonstrations in the right direction.
Gemeenten hebben aangeven dat zij over genoeg bevoegdheden beschikken om de demonstraties in goede banen te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het gevolgde en te volgen protocol bij coronarepatriëringsvluchten uit niet-brandhaarden

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether a COVID-19 repatriation flight from Kuala Lumpur was overcrowded and whether quarantine or protocol changes were planned for such flights. The minister could not independently confirm the footage, said the flight carried 285 passengers and 13 crew under EASA and RIVM guidance, and stated no new measures were being considered for now.
At this moment the cabinet is not considering new measures, but we are monitoring the situation closely.
Op dit moment overweegt het kabinet geen nieuwe maatregelen, maar we monitoren de situatie nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het openhouden van vliegroutes van en naar Spanje ondanks snelle toename aantal besmettingen

D66 MPs asked why flight routes from Spain stayed open while infection numbers rose quickly, comparing this with the ban on flights from Italy and asking for a stricter flight ban and monitoring. The minister answered that multiple factors inform flight restrictions, pointed to EASA high-risk country measures and RIVM advice, and said monitoring continues without committing to a ban on Spain.
We are continuously monitoring and advising on whether additional measures for air traffic are needed.
Wij zijn continu bezig met het monitoren en advies of er aanvullende maatregelen voor het luchtverkeer nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het controleren van de Nederlandse grenzen inzake de coronacrisis

Two MPs from FvD asked the Health and Justice ministers how Dutch border controls operate during the COVID-19 crisis, including checks on arrivals, flight bans, and border checks with Germany and Belgium. The government answered that policy aims to control COVID-19 maximally, that travellers from high-risk countries must quarantine for 14 days, that border checks are sample-based and arrival numbers are not tracked, and that no land-border controls or travel bans are currently needed.
Insight into the number of persons travelling from abroad to the Netherlands cannot be provided.
Inzicht in het aantal personen dat vanuit het buitenland naar Nederland reist, is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over zelftesten voor corona

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about unreliable and unlawfully marketed COVID-19 self-test kits, including imports from China, and asked what the government will do about enforcement, monitoring by the IGJ, sanctions and customs checks. The Minister's reply is a referral to a letter on the COVID-19 situation, meaning the questions were answered by reference to another document rather than on substance.
The written questions from MPs Marijnissen and Hijink (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07032) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07032 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over een alternatief voor een corona-app

MP Asscher asked the Minister of Health about alternatives to a corona tracing app, including whether manual contact tracing like in Massachusetts is a good approach, how many trained tracers would be needed, and how they could be recruited, and asked for answers before the 22 April debate. The answer is a referral to a separate letter (COVID-19 update) and does not address the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Asscher (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07145) have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Asscher (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07145 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het beleid voor testen en beschermingsmiddelen bij mensen die werken in de huishoudelijke verzorging

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health whether RIVM guidelines provide testing for home care workers, whether they should be tested and protected with personal protective equipment, and why the guidance on contact with coughing patients was loosened. The Minister referred the answers to the COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 315) rather than answering each question in this document.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07555) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07555 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Specialisten: nog te vroeg voor bezoek aan verpleeghuizen'

An MP asked the Minister of Health why he did not consult the specialists' association Verenso before announcing a trial reopening of nursing home visits from 11 May, and asked about timing, conditions, national frameworks and a joint plan. The answer refers the MP to the government's COVID-19 status letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 315) as the response to these questions.

The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07651) have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 315).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07651 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 315 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg, Özütok en Snels over de opschorting van het Wob-verzoek van Pieter Klein

MPs from D66, GroenLinks asked the Health Minister why he suspended a Wob freedom-of-information request from journalist Pieter Klein on coronavirus matters and whether this undermines oversight and press freedom. The minister answered that the request was suspended for force majeure due to crisis work, that only coronavirus-related Wob requests are paused with a plan to resume by 1 June, and that alternative channels and appeal routes remain open.
Only in a very exceptional situation can an administrative body invoke force majeure to suspend the decision period for Wob requests.
Uitsluitend in geval van een zeer uitzonderlijke situatie kan een bestuursorgaan met een beroep op overmacht de beslistermijn voor Wob-verzoeken opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het testen van politieagenten op corona

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether police officers, boa's and enforcement staff know they can be tested for COVID-19 after work incidents, whether testing is available without a spitting or coughing incident, and whether GGD capacity suffices. The minister answered that information is provided through internal channels, that testing is possible after a work incident or with symptoms on advice of the occupational doctor, that testing is being broadened from 18 May and 1 June, and that GGD capacity is sufficient.

That is why it has been agreed that professionals in enforcement and supervision (including police officers, boa's and other enforcers) can also be tested if a work incident (spitting, coughing, resuscitation, fight or forcible arrest) has possibly exposed them to infection.

Daarom is afgesproken dat professionals in handhaving en toezicht (waaronder o.a. agenten, boa’s en andere handhavers) ook getest kunnen worden als zij door een incident tijdens het werk (spugen, hoesten, reanimatie, vechtpartij of aanhouding met geweld) een mogelijke besmetting hebben opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over nog steeds bestaande onduidelijkheid over het testbeleid

Labour MP Asscher asks Health Minister De Jonge why testing guidance for healthcare workers remains unclear despite earlier statements that all symptomatic staff could be tested from 6 April 2020, and why hospital and nursing-home guidance differs on symptoms. The minister acknowledges unclear guidance, promises clarifications and to ask RIVM to revise hospital guidance, and sets out testing and contact-tracing capacity measures, though he declines to give a full account on several points.
I will ask the RIVM whether the hospital guideline dated 1 April should be adjusted by analogy with the guideline for healthcare workers outside hospitals.
Ik zal het RIVM vragen of de richtlijn voor ziekenhuizen die van 1 april jl. is in analogie met de richtlijn voor zorgmedewerkers buiten de zorg aangepast zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over een convenant voor gemeenten en (jeugd)zorgaanbieders om de continuïteit van (jeugd)zorg aan te bieden in tijden van de coronacrisis

CDA MPs asked the health minister about a model agreement between municipalities and youth and care providers to keep care going during the coronavirus crisis, and whether municipalities should guarantee advance payments. The minister confirmed the model was read, said the Rijk and VNG urged municipalities to give financial security until at least 1 June 2020, and said a later April agreement on continued funding superseded the model.
The model agreement dates from March and in its current form is therefore no longer suitable to submit to municipalities.
Het modelconvenant dateert uit maart en is in haar huidige vorm zodoende niet meer geschikt om voor te leggen aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Test op antistoffen, dat is nu essentieel’ en ‘onderzoek relatie corona en vuile lucht’.

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper op-ed on antibody testing and the mechanics of immunity after a mild COVID-19 infection, a proposal to test a representative sample, and a possible link between air pollution and COVID-19 severity. The minister answered that research on antibodies and immunity is still ongoing, that an expert task force will advise on testing strategy, that the Pienter-Covid study already tests a broader population sample, and referred the air pollution question to earlier answers.
The task force will among other things assess whether and for which persons it is desirable for an antibody test to be deployed on a large scale.
De taskforce zal onder andere beoordelen of en voor welke personen het wenselijk is dat een test op antistoffen op grote schaal ingezet gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over een noodfonds voor mensen werkzaam in de zorg

Labour MPs Asscher and Kerstens asked the Health Minister whether the ministry had contact with the initiators of a relief fund for healthcare workers infected with COVID-19, and whether the government would support a fund quickly and how much it would contribute. The minister confirmed contact occurred but, on the fund questions, only referred to a commitment in an earlier letter to parliament.
For the answer to the questions posed, I refer to the commitment I made in the letter of 15 April.
Voor het antwoord op de gestelde vragen verwijs ik naar de toezegging die ik heb gedaan in de brief van 15 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het voortdurende tekort aan mondkapjes

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister about shortages of face masks, the role of the national procurement consortium (LCH), certification, quality control, and logistics, in 18 numbered questions. The minister answered that the LCH centrally procures scarce protective equipment on the ministry's mandate, with RIVM quality checks, and that shortages will remain fragile for now.
The LCH acts on the assignment of the Ministry of VWS. This means the LCH's working method is determined by VWS.
Het LCH handelt in opdracht van het Ministerie van VWS. Dat betekent dat de werkwijze van het LCH door VWS wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het rapport ‘Constant nieuwe gezichten, ik crash daarvan’ van Stichting Het Vergeten Kind

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report showing children in youth care face frequent placement moves and high staff turnover, and asked what will be done to reduce both. The Minister acknowledges the problem, says municipalities and providers are primarily responsible, and points to existing programmes, a handbook in preparation, a WODC study and workforce initiatives, while committing to help build better data but without a concrete binding measure.
Primarily, municipalities and providers are the ones to be held accountable for this.
Primair zijn gemeenten en aanbieders hierop aanspreekbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over dwangbehandelingen in de jeugdzorg

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about the reduction of coercive and restrictive measures in youth care, including inspection visits, planned legislation on youth legal position, registration of forced seclusion and force-feeding, and inspection oversight. The minister answered that inspections covered closed youth institutions and related facilities, that institutions are not legally obliged to report seclusion data to the inspectorate, and that a bill on the legal position of youths in closed institutions is planned for consultation by July 2020.
Closed youth care institutions have no legal obligation to send this registration to the inspectorate.
Gesloten jeugdhulpinstellingen hebben geen wettelijke plicht om deze registratie aan de inspectie te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het datalek van het Donorregister

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Health Minister 19 questions about the missing external hard drives holding Donorregister data, covering timing, security, notification and remedies. The minister answered that the CIBG discovered the loss in February-March 2020, notified the Data Protection Authority, is informing affected citizens, and that the Audit Dienst Rijk and the Data Protection Authority are investigating, with the findings to be shared with parliament.
I will therefore inform the House of the outcomes of the investigations by the ADR and the AP, and ask the CIBG to report any follow-up steps to me and make them public.
Ik zal de Kamer daarom informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken door de ADR en AP en het CIBG vragen om eventueel te nemen vervolgstappen aan mij te rapporteren en deze openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over uithuisgeplaatste kinderen die niet meer terug kunnen naar de eigen ouders

MP Peters (CDA) asked the ministers whether children placed out of home after parents were evicted for debt or lack of housing could be returned, and what the government does to prevent evictions and support housing. The government answered that no general six-month housing requirement exists, that it is working on early warning and debt-support measures, and that it does not accept a housing guarantee for parents whose children are placed under court order.
There are no figures available on how often this occurs.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over COVID-19 en de bestrijding ervan

An MP asked the health minister about COVID-19 testing capacity, the government's testing policy, the role of asymptomatic carriers, nursing-home safety, OMT advice documents and when a recovered person stops being infectious. The minister answered that capacity is sufficient under current policy, pointed to letters to parliament for the strategy, and said the questions could not be answered earlier.

Do you recall sending the 60th and 61st OMT reports to the House on Thursday? Can you send all reports/advice from the 45th to the 57th OMT to the House, along with other unnumbered reports on this subject?

Vraag 15 Herinnert u zich dat u op donderdag het 60e en 61e verslag van het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) aan de Kamer stuurde? Kunt u alle verslagen/adviezen van het 45e OMT tot en met het 57e OMT aan de Kamer doen toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de RIVM-presentatie over de verschillende corona-scenario’s

An MP asked the health minister when the government knew that pre-23 March measures would overshoot IC capacity, why stricter measures and household isolation came late, and why the emergency ordinances took 23 days. The minister said he was kept informed through weekly briefings, referred to a letter of 7 April for the model questions, explained household isolation was added as IC admissions rose, and attributed the delay to the need for ordinances drafted with the safety regions.
For the answers to these questions I refer you to my letter to the House of 7 April.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik u naar mijn Kamerbrief van 7 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de toegang tot abortushulpverlening ten tijden van de coronacrisis

MP Ploumen asks the Health Minister whether abortion care remains accessible during the coronavirus crisis, whether clinics should stay open, whether costs should be covered for undocumented migrants and foreign students, and whether medical abortion pills could be prescribed for home use as in the UK. The minister answers that abortion care remains available, that clinics are open with adapted consultation and visitor rules, that the existing maximum tariff allows lower fees, and that home use of pills is rejected because it does not fit careful, medically verified care.
In addition, I want to emphasise again that at present I have received no signals from the Dutch abortion sector or the Dutch Society of Abortion Doctors that call for a change in current policy.

Daarnaast wil ik nogmaals benadrukken dat ik op dit moment vanuit de Nederlandse abortussector dan wel het Nederlands Genootschap van Abortusartsen geen signalen heb ontvangen die nopen tot een aanpassing van het huidige beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de 100 miljoen euro extra aan de WHO

An MP asked whether the Netherlands was giving an extra 100 million euro to the WHO, where the money goes, why it is spent abroad rather than at home, and whether the government will criticise the WHO over China and Taiwan. The minister replies that the 100 million is a multi-purpose budget for the poorest countries, of which only 7.5 million goes to the WHO, that the Netherlands always serves its own interest, and that a broad evaluation of the response will follow, while several questions on domestic spending are answered only by reference to an accompanying letter.
The cabinet of course supports a broad evaluation of the international corona response, as the standard procedure prescribes.
Het kabinet steunt vanzelfsprekend een brede evaluatie van de internationale coronabestrijding, zoals de standaardprocedure voorschrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Gemeentelijke websites vaak beperkt toegankelijk’

Two MPs asked the ministers about the accessibility of municipal websites for visually and hearing-impaired people, after a report that about two-thirds remain inaccessible. State Secretary Knops answered that a new legal duty to publish accessibility statements applies from 23 September 2020, that municipal councils and provinces handle supervision with existing legal tools, and that he will urge municipalities to improve, referring to the helpdesk and existing communication.
I will hold municipalities and other authorities to their responsibility.
Ik zal gemeenten en andere overheden aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht ‘Wereldwijde toename huiselijk geweld door coronavirus’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports of rising domestic violence during the coronavirus crisis, including an Italian police app, the Fier chat function, a national 24/7 chat, BES islands provision, and safe shelter availability. The minister answered by reference to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277) rather than answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MPs Bergkamp and Diertens (both D66) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) and State Secretary Blokhuis (Health, Welfare and Sport) (2020Z06384) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 277).

De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens (beiden D66) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) en Staatssecretaris Blokhuis (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) ( 2020Z06384 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘De zorgverleners worden niet voldoende beschermd’

An MP asks the health minister about reports that care workers are insufficiently protected, questioning the RIVM guideline relaxations on protective equipment, the inspectorate's role, and supply infrastructure. The answer states that all written questions were answered in the minister's COVID-19 status letter to the House, with a footnote to the press report.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) (2020Z06769) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) ( 2020Z06769 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het testbeleid in zorginstellingen

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister of Health about healthcare workers with mild symptoms who cannot get tested, the division of testing responsibilities between employers, GP and GGD, and what workers should do when referred back and forth. The minister's answer refers to a separate letter on the state of affairs (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277) rather than answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MP Hijink (SP) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) and Minister van Rijn (Medical Care) have been answered by letter <COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs>.

De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Hijink (SP) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) en Minister van Rijn (Medische Zorg) ( 2020Z07031 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Onrust bij thuiszorg en wijkverpleging om gebrek aan bescherming’.

An MP asks the Minister of Health about reports of unrest among home-care and nursing staff over inadequate protective equipment during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether the situation is unsafe for patients and workers. The answer is a cross-reference to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation, with no substantive response to the questions in this document.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) (2020Z06302) have been answered by means of the letter <COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs>.
De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) ( 2020Z06302 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Een schriftelijke wilsverklaring is nog geen euthanasieverzoek’

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij asked the health and justice ministers about an article arguing that a written advance euthanasia declaration is not a concrete request, and about verification, the role of the Regional Review Committees, and transparency of closed case files. Minister De Jonge answered that a written request can replace an oral one only if it is explicit and concrete, that other due-diligence rules still apply, that the Supreme Court case on dementia verification precludes substantive comment for now, and that the fourth evaluation will examine transparency.
I therefore consider it appropriate to exercise restraint in responding substantively until the Supreme Court's judgment is known.
Mij past daarom terughoudendheid om hier inhoudelijk op te reageren tot het oordeel van de Hoge Raad bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de dringende oproep van Per Saldo over de onzekerheden bij pgb-houders aangaande het coronavirus
