An MP asked the minister how the government responds to Per Saldo's urgent call on uncertainties for personal budget (pgb) holders during the coronavirus crisis, covering protective equipment, continued payment of pgb care, the 40-hour norm, lost collective day care, natura care alternatives, and reassessment procedures for families. The minister answers that temporary measures were published, that pgb care providers will be paid until 1 June, that the 40-hour norm is being explored for temporary relaxation, and that agreed indication extensions and guidance apply, but gives no new legislative or structural change.
These agreements apply to care and support purchased with a pgb under the Youth Act, Wmo 2015, Zvw or Wlz.
Deze afspraken zijn van toepassing op zorg en ondersteuning die met een pgb uit de Jeugdwet, Wmo 2015, Zvw of Wlz wordt ingekocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de effecten van de coronamaatregelen op geweld achter de voordeur

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health about rising domestic violence during COVID-19 lockdowns, including French-style emergency measures, a safe code word, SMS reporting, outreach to victims and reopening schools for children in unsafe homes. The Minister replied only by referring to a general COVID-19 update letter to parliament, without answering the individual questions.
The written questions from MP Van den Hul (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van den Hul (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over doorbetaling van het zorgvervoer

Member Kerstens (PvdA) asked the Minister of Health about financial distress in the patient transport sector during the COVID-19 crisis, including reports of double-loading patients, whether transporters should be kept solvent, and whether clients should pay for cancelled trips and extra protocol costs. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation, without answering the questions directly.
The written questions from member Kerstens (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het interview met speciaal gezant Sijbesma bij Buitenhof

An MP asks the Health Minister about a speaker's statements on Dutch COVID-19 testing policy, including whether restrictive testing was a policy choice, how much test material was not delivered, and which suppliers reduced deliveries. The answer states the questions were answered in the weekly COVID-19 update letter, without the substantive detail here.
The written questions from MP Asscher to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered in the letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Asscher (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'Corona-app dreigt te mislukken door enorme haast van kabinet'

An MP from D66 asked the health and justice ministers about the rushed timeline and tender for the Corona contact-tracing app, including deadlines, cybersecurity, open source, and expert concerns. The government answered by referring to its COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Verhoeven (D66) to the ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Legal Protection have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update status'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Rechtsbescherming zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de tekorten aan beschermende middelen bij zorginstellingen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister twelve questions about shortages of protective equipment at care institutions, including bureaucracy and delays at the national procurement consortium LCH, untested supplies, and rejected offers. The minister's reply is a cross-reference: the questions were answered in a broader COVID-19 status letter rather than individually.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Zorgverlening zonder afdoende persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether he had noted a KNMG report that care workers were providing care without adequate protective equipment, and whether he agreed that such work could not be expected and that risks were too high. The answer refers the reader to a separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) where the questions were answered.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de berichtgeving dat het sterftecijfer door het coronavirus hoger is dan eerder gemeld

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked why Dutch COVID-19 death figures may be about twice the officially reported number, whether CBS and RIVM should combine data, whether suspected cases are recorded, and whether testing of elderly care residents will be expanded. Minister De Jonge acknowledged the deaths are higher than RIVM figures, which only count confirmed cases, referred to earlier answers for the data questions, and said the government will strengthen protection of the vulnerable and point to its testing policy letter.
The total number is larger than the RIVM figures that RIVM publishes; we also explain this when publishing those figures.
Het totaal aantal is groter dan de RIVM cijfers die het RIVM publiceert, dat leggen we ook uit bij de publicatie van die cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Krol, Sazias, Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over alle berichtgeving omtrent het coronavirus

Four 50PLUS MPs asked a range of questions about COVID-19 coverage, care for the elderly and family carers, unemployment benefits, the economy and EU financing, and emergency powers and enforcement. The government answered most questions substantively, commits to several concrete steps, and declines to say whether a state of emergency will be declared, pointing instead to ordinary crisis structures.
The cabinet took a decision on this on Tuesday 31 March.
Het kabinet heeft hier op dinsdag 31 maart jl. een besluit over genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de aardbevingen van 22 en 23 maart ten tijde van corona

An MP asked ministers about earthquakes in Groningen on 22-23 March 2020 during the coronavirus lockdown, including whether residents can safely stay home, whether monitoring thresholds were exceeded, the TCMG's reduced evening availability, relocation to temporary housing, speeding up reinforcement, and asking Shell/NAM for extra money. The ministers answered that no monitoring thresholds were exceeded, that TCMG adjusted opening hours and piloted remote damage inspections while keeping acute-unsafe-situation handling, that reinforcement is being accelerated as gas extraction falls, and that all reinforcement costs are borne by NAM and its shareholders.
I have the authority to intervene in extraction at any time if the safety situation gives cause for it.
Ik heb de bevoegdheid om te allen tijde in de winning in te grijpen als de veiligheidssituatie daar aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over regels voor campings en recreatieparken ten aanzien van de coronamaatregelen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Health how the 1.5-metre rule at campsites is enforced, how shared facilities should be handled, and whether people are moving to northern campsites and holiday homes during the COVID-19 crisis. The government answered that enforcement rests mainly on people themselves and operator communication, with municipal enforcement under regional emergency ordinances, that shared sanitary facilities were closed from 31 March, and that the sector has been informed of the rules.
If people do not comply with the rules, municipal enforcement officers can enforce them on the basis of the emergency ordinance each safety region has adopted.
Als mensen zich niet aan de voorschriften houden, kunnen gemeentelijke handhavers handhaven op basis van de noodverordening die elke veiligheidsregio heeft vastgesteld.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Krol over het melden van mogelijke coronadoden door huisartsen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether GPs must report suspected COVID-19 deaths to the GGD and to be included in RIVM figures, since only test-confirmed cases are reported. The minister answered that suspected cases no longer need reporting under the current policy, that the Wpg is effectively set aside pending formal change, and that RIVM will only publish confirmed COVID-19 deaths, with excess mortality used as a proxy.
Pending a formal amendment of the reporting obligation, only confirmed cases therefore need to be reported to the GGD.
Vooruitlopend op een formele wijziging van de meldplicht geldt daarom dat alleen bevestigde gevallen gemeld hoeven te worden aan de GGD.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten 'De corona-angst achter de dichte deuren van het verpleeghuis» en «Frankrijk moet dodenlijst bijstellen: honderden ouderen overleden in verpleeghuizen'

The MP Kerstens asks the Minister of Health about reports on COVID-19 deaths in nursing homes, including whether the true number of infected residents and deaths is known, whether all residents and staff with symptoms are tested, how many locations have reported cases, whether protective equipment is sufficient, and whether maatwerk on visits is possible. The minister's reply refers to a broader COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z06121) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z06121 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over de discrepantie tussen de berichtgeving over bestellingen en leveringen van beschermingsmiddelen en de tekorten die nog steeds worden ervaren door zorgmedewerkers

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health ministers about the gap between reports of protective equipment orders and deliveries and continuing shortages for care workers, referencing an adopted motion and the state of affairs letter, and asked whether supplies are adequate across hospitals, nursing homes, GP practices, home care, and disability/youth/mental health settings. The government answered by referring to its COVID-19 state of affairs letter of the same date rather than answering the questions separately.

The written questions from MPs Wilders and Agema (both PVV) to the Ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Medical Care (2020Z06296) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema (beiden PVV) aan de Ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06296 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het bericht 'Onrust bij thuiszorg, wijkverpleging, gehandicaptenzorg en ouderen zorg bij gebrek aan bescherming en beperkt testen personeel'

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the ministers, following press reports, about shortages of protective equipment and limited testing for staff in home care, district nursing, disability care and elderly care, including how the ministry's purchasing collective, alternative supplies, industry contributions, domestic production, expanded testing and a passed motion would be handled. The answer is a referral: the questions were answered in the broader COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than individually.

The written questions from members Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the Ministers for Medical Care and of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z06304) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de Ministers voor Medische Zorg en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z06304 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Wilders, Krol, Van der Staaij en Baudet over COVID-19 patiënten aan boord van vluchten uit coronabrandhaard New York

Five MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about the lack of temperature checks and symptom screening for passengers on flights from COVID-19-affected New York, and whether the government should ban such flights. The answer is a referral: the questions are answered in a separate letter on tourism during Easter and the May holiday and measures for New York flights, with the answers to questions 15-19 due on 8 April 2020.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Countering tourism during Easter and the May holiday; measures for flights from New York'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Tegengaan toerisme tijdens Pasen en de meivakantie; maatregelen voor vluchten uit New York»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het door gemeenten en zorgverzekeraars (niet) doorbetalen van zorgaanbieders die als gevolg van de coronacrisis bijvoorbeeld geconfronteerd worden met ‘afbestelde’ zorg en ond

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether care providers facing cancelled care during the corona crisis will be paid by municipalities and health insurers, and whether the minister will hold them to account and compensate municipalities. The minister says the VNG and insurers have committed to continued payment through 1 June, will monitor implementation, use interbestuurlijk toezicht if municipalities neglect their duties, and will compensate municipalities for direct extra costs, while details for non-contracted providers are still under discussion.
Should it turn out that municipalities do not do this, or not sufficiently, and there is neglect of duty in this respect, the instruments of interadministrative supervision will be deployed.
Mocht blijken dat gemeenten dit niet of in onvoldoende mate doen en er in dit opzicht sprake is van taakverwaarlozing, dan zal het instrumentarium van interbestuurlijk toezicht worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de effecten van de coronamaatregelen op geweld achter de voordeur

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the effects of COVID-19 measures, such as school closures and stay-at-home advice, on domestic violence and child abuse, and how institutions like Veilig Thuis and women's shelters are prepared. The minister answered by referring to the general COVID-19 update letter to the House rather than addressing the questions individually.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken'
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over de gevolgen van het coronavirus op bewoners en medewerkers van verpleeghuizen

SP MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 infections among nursing home residents and staff, testing and mortality counting, visitor restrictions and their effects on residents, protective equipment, and related staffing and visiting policy. The answer refers the MPs to the government's COVID-19 status update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) instead of answering each question directly.
The written questions from MPs Marijnissen and Hijink (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z05791) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Status update'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z05791 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht dat het RIVM het sombere scenario uit ziet komen

Labour MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that RIVM now expects the gloomier COVID-19 scenario, and why its ICU length-of-stay and capacity assumptions differ from the 25 March briefing. The minister's reply refers to a separate written answer on the current state of affairs (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) rather than answering the questions directly.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 200)
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200 )
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht «De eerste 100 extra beademingsapparaten van Philips zijn binnen: «mooi nieuws»

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the use of Defence, veterinarians, private clinics and other parties for ventilator supply during COVID-19, including counts of available and deployed ventilators, and whether answers could be given before the plenary debate. The answers were not given in this document; the minister referred to a letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) instead.
have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 200)
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200 )
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

PvdA MPs asked the health ministers how far the Netherlands follows WHO advice on testing for COVID-19, whether test kits, staff, laboratory capacity and protective equipment are sufficient, and how ICU capacity, public information and distancing rules are handled. The minister answered that testing is targeted due to global shortages under a national guideline with a taskforce, that protective equipment is distributed under a central procurement and regional distribution structure, and that information is clear and updated, while largely restating existing policy and referring to a separate Kamerbrief for ICU capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de capaciteit van IC-units en beademingsapparaten in Nederland i.v.m. de Corona-pandemie

An MP from the PVV asked the Prime Minister and the Health Minister how many COVID-19 patients were in Dutch intensive care, the projected growth, current IC and ventilator capacity, and what would be done to keep care available. The minister referred to the NVIC website for patient numbers and to earlier letters for capacity measures, gave no concrete figures or projections, and did not answer on the Friday deadline.
To keep everyone well informed about the number of COVID-19 patients in intensive care, the Dutch Association of Intensive Care (NVIC) updates the number daily on its website.

Antwoord 1, 2 Om iedereen blijvend goed te informeren over het aantal COVID-19-patiënten dat op de IC ligt, houdt de Nederlandse Vereniging van Intensive Care (NVIC) dagelijks op haar website ( www.nvic.nl ) bij om hoeveel patiënten dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Gezelschap over het bericht ‘Elise moet door haar spierziekte extra oppassen voor Corona’

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Gezelschap asked the Health Minister about a news report on a child with muscular disease at extra risk from coronavirus, and whether care-indication renewals by insurers should be paused for families under strain. The minister answered that the parties agreed a protocol under which current indications can be extended by three months, while renewals remain possible where care needs change.
On re-indication when the care input has not changed, the advice summarised briefly states that the current indication can be extended by three months or as much shorter as applicable.
Over herindicatie wanneer de zorginzet niet gewijzigd is, stelt het advies kort samengevat dat de huidige indicatie met drie maanden verlengd kan worden of zoveel korter als van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over gedragsregels en communicatie bij het coronavirus, in het bijzonder in de grensregio’s

An MP from D66 asked the health minister how the government assesses reports that German politicians want the border closed unless Dutch and German corona rules are aligned, and whether differences in compliance and rules in the border region require coordination. The minister answered that the gap between Dutch and German measures has narrowed, that consultation with German states and Belgium is ongoing, that Dutch shops remain open unlike in Germany, and that the government will intensify public information on compliance.
Yes. Thus today the public campaign starts.
Ja. Zo start vandaag de publiekscampagne
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het gehanteerde beleid met betrekking tot het testen op COVID-19 (corona) besmettingen

Two FvD MPs asked the health minister about COVID-19 testing policy, including who is tested, testing capacity, lysis buffer supply, and imports. The minister answered that testing is restricted due to global shortages, that about 2000 tests run daily across 35 labs, and that a special COVID-19 envoy and taskforce will coordinate production and distribution.
At present, approximately 2000 COVID-19 tests are carried out daily in the Netherlands.
Op dit moment worden dagelijks ongeveer 2000 COVID-2019 tests uitgevoerd in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Beckerman en Van Nispen over huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis

SP MPs asked why eviction summary proceedings are treated as urgent or postponed during the coronavirus crisis, whether evictions should be halted, and whether a law banning evictions is needed. The minister answers that eviction cases are postponed except in exceptional superspoed cases, that landlord associations agreed to avoid evictions during the crisis, and that the government will use emergency legislation to extend temporary leases.
Eviction cases have not been classified as urgent by the judiciary, so for now no oral hearings take place unless the judge in summary proceedings decides a hearing must go ahead.

Huisuitzettingen zijn door de rechtspraak niet aangemerkt als urgente zaken en voorlopig vinden er daarom geen mondelinge behandelingen plaats, tenzij de rechter in kort geding oordeelt dat een zitting moet doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over de sluiting van de onderwijstak van De Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked the ministers whether Pluryn's separation of the Hoenderloo College education branch into a separate foundation was used to strip teachers of their rights and funds, and what action the government would take. Minister Slob answered that the closure of the Hoenderloo College followed inevitably from closing the care locations, that the Inspectorate monitors Pluryn's finances and compliance, and that Pluryn has promised a social plan and new posts for teachers.
The Inspectorate of Education supervises compliance with laws and regulations, and if irregularities are found it will take appropriate measures.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs ziet toe op naleving van wet- en regelgeving en als blijkt dat er onrechtmatigheden zijn begaan dan zal de inspectie passende maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen van uw Kamer over medische zorg in penitentiaire inrichtingen, detentiecentra en forensisch psychiatrische centra

An SP MP asked about medical care in prisons, detention centres and forensic psychiatric centres, including staffing shortages, waiting times for psychiatric prison places, use of isolation cells and medication safety. The Minister acknowledges recruitment difficulties and waiting lists of a few days, describes recruitment and capacity measures, and promises to review capacity in 2021 without committing to specific deadlines for resolving the problems.
The number of prisoners waiting for a place in a PPC fluctuates.
Het aantal gedetineerden dat op een plaatsing in een PPC wacht fluctueert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat daklozen van de gemeente Den Haag geld krijgen om de stad te verlaten

An SP MP asked the minister about a Den Haag pilot paying homeless people to move to other cities, and whether this is a sustainable response to the shortage of beds and housing. The state secretary defended the pilot as voluntary, support-oriented casework, said he would present an overarching plan before summer, and welcomed the pilot's results while not withdrawing it.
The pilot is therefore explicitly meant for people who themselves indicate they want to live somewhere other than The Hague.
De pilot is dus nadrukkelijk bedoeld voor mensen die zélf aangeven ergens anders te willen wonen dan in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht dat ‘Jeugdzorginstelling eist dat ouders video van uit huis halen dochtertje van internet verwijderen’

An MP asked about a youth care institution demanding that parents remove a video of their daughter from the internet, and about complaint routes, data on complaints, grounds for ending parental authority, mediation, and parents' right to criticise providers. The minister answered that complaints can go to the institution, its complaints committee, the National Ombudsman and professional tribunals, that the courts decide on ending parental authority and the privacy conflict, and that talks with certified institutions on a framework will be considered.
Such an overview is not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Westerveld over het manifest van Lijm de zorg

MPs Wörsdörfer (VVD) and Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Health about the Lijm de zorg manifesto on young people and parents who get stuck in the youth care system, including numbers, the number of contact points, and promised follow-up. The Minister acknowledged that some young people do not get timely help, reported about 100 complex youth cases in 2019, outlined new regional expert teams and specialist centres, and said a single clear overview and a referral route to VWS are being set up, while confirming the follow-up letter was already sent.
It is not known how many signals were received in 2017 and 2018.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel signalen er in 2017 en 2018 zijn binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de wijziging woonplaatsbeginsel

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Health about the amended residence principle in youth care, including whether youth care providers should get an automated residence check via the BRP and what happens if municipalities miss the two-week deadline to name the responsible municipality. The Minister rejects a BRP access tool on principled, privacy and management grounds, promises a feasibility study, and proposes municipalities pay providers and settle costs among themselves if the deadline is missed.

Following this implementation assessment, further research was conducted into whether it would be possible and necessary for youth care providers to check in the BRP which municipality is responsible.
Naar aanleiding van deze Uitvoeringstoets is er nader onderzocht of het mogelijk en nodig zou zijn dat jeugdzorgaanbieders in de BRP kunnen checken welke gemeente verantwoordelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de problemen bij de regionale zorgcentrale Centrale24 in Eindhoven

An MP asked the minister about serious problems at the regional care call centre Centrale24 in Eindhoven, including night-time client safety, IT outages, use of unqualified students, and a culture discouraging reporting of misconduct. The minister answered that care providers are responsible for night-time safety and staffing, pointed to a knowledge-sharing platform, said providers must have internal incident reporting and serious incidents must be reported to the IGJ, and left open the question of a further inspection investigation.
It is the responsibility of every care provider to ensure this, whether it concerns deploying staff or using technology as an aid.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van iedere zorgaanbieder om daarin te voorzien, of het nu gaat om de inzet van personeel of het gebruik van technologie als hulpmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ’Zorginstelling Woerden dreigt gehandicapt stel uit elkaar te halen: ‘Het is mensonterend’’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that a care institution in Woerden would separate a disabled couple, questioning the nursing qualifications required for assisted ventilation and whether residents could stay. The minister said the provider must offer alternative housing, arranged temporary care, and that the required staffing and decisions are the provider's responsibility, with wage and recruitment questions answered by pointing to sector agreements.
I cannot go into the specific medical and nursing care and procedures that the seven clients need at the individual level.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke medische en verpleegkundige zorg en handelingen die de zeven cliënten op individueel niveau nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink en Van der Staaij over de mogelijke doorstart van de Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Health about the Hoenderloo Groep closure, his contacts with parents, steps toward a possible restart and its consistency with the Chamber's motion. The Minister replied that he visited the site, held talks with Pluryn, gemeenten and the IGJ, asked KPMG to test restart plans, and that Pluryn has offered placements for all youths while the IGJ oversees the transfer process.
I informed your House on 20 February 2020 about this, in line with my commitment in the committee debate on financial problems at youth care institutions and the Hijink et al. motion.
Ik heb uw Kamer, conform mijn toezegging in het AO «financiële problemen bij diverse jeugdzorginstellingen» en motie Hijink cs, hierover op 20 februari 2020 geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat hoogbejaarden in woonzorgcentrum Mariaoord te Rosmalen dekens moeten omdoen omdat de verwarming in de gangen uitgezet is wegens CO2-gekte

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the minister whether he shares the view that frail elderly residents of nursing home Mariaoord should not be left cold because heating in corridors was switched off for CO2 reasons, and what he will do about it. The minister answered that a comfortable indoor climate matters, that the Kwaliteitskader Verpleeghuiszorg applies, that the home's measures are evaluated with residents and the client council, and that the IGJ supervises quality and safety and can intervene.
That is why the measures taken are evaluated with residents and the client council so that residents' comfort is not compromised.
Daarom worden ingezette maatregelen geëvalueerd met bewoners en de cliëntenraad opdat het comfort van de bewoners niet in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Hijink over het rapport van de Inspectie Gezondheid en Jeugd inzake DeSeizoenen

MPs Slootweg (CDA) and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the IGJ report on DeSeizoenen, including the governance structure, service arrangements with Care Shared Services, transparency of costs and dividends, legal costs of the dispute with the Central Client Council, and alleged pressure on vulnerable clients. The Minister answered that the personal union is expected to end by 1 July 2020, that the IGJ found no basis to pursue dividend or Belastingdienst information, and that no continuity or bankruptcy signals were received, while describing pressure on vulnerable clients as unacceptable.
Het onder druk zetten van kwetsbare mensen is onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Regterschot over het bericht ‘Vrouwen willen wél meer werken in de zorg: oplossing voor personeelstekort?’

MPs Tielen and Regterschot asked the ministers about a report showing many part-time care workers want more hours, and whether employers and government are doing enough to act on this instead of only recruiting. Minister De Jonge answered that increasing part-time hours is one solution direction, that the government supports the Het Potentieel Pakken foundation, and that a response to the motion on temporary contract-hour expansion will follow in the IBO Deeltijdwerk reaction due this winter.
A response to the motion of MPs Tielen and Van Weyenberg will follow in the cabinet response to the IBO Deeltijdwerk.
Een reactie op de motie van de leden Tielen en Van Weyenberg zal volgen in de kabinetsreactie op het IBO Deeltijdwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht ‘Vindicat met 900 leden op wintersport naar Italië, ondanks coronavirus’

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports that student association Vindicat sent 900 members on a ski trip to northern Italy despite coronavirus, and asked whether this reflected incoherent policy and what measures would be taken on return. The minister answered that travel advice for the region changed only after the group left, that the advisories of RIVM and foreign affairs serve as the clear rules, and that GGD Groningen will coordinate the group's return with screening on arrival.
At the moment the Vindicat members departed, non-essential travel to this area was not yet being advised against.
Op het moment dat de leden van Vindicat vertrokken werden niet essentiële reizen naar dit gebied nog niet ontraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over ontvangen signalen van het afsluiten van een zwijgcontract

An MP asked whether the government still supports banning gag contracts in healthcare and youth care, how many reports the inspectorate received, what action was taken, and when the bill goes to consultation. The minister confirmed the ban policy, reported few reports (8 confirmed of 55 in 2016-2017, 11 since, none confirmed), described a warning-based response, and said the bill will go to consultation shortly and to parliament after summer 2020.
The draft bill is nearly finished. The bill will very soon be put out for consultation.
Het ontwerp van het wetsvoorstel is bijna afgerond. Het wetsvoorstel wordt zeer binnenkort in consultatie gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht dat 23 ouderen hun huis kwijtraken door een commerciële overname

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked about 23 elderly residents losing their homes after a commercial takeover of their care-housing provider, including the inspectorate's assessment of the building and the legality of the tenant stopping rent payments. The minister said the inspectorate found the building unfit for 24-hour care, that the courts found stopping rent unjustified, and that residents were relocated, compensated for moving, and given tenancy protections, while declining to judge the complex dispute in detail.
I am therefore reticent in my judgement because I do not wish to intervene in the court's assessment and do not know all the details.
Dit maakt dat ik terughoudend ben in mijn oordeel omdat ik niet wil treden in de beoordeling van de rechter en niet alle details ken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over normenkaders voor de intensieve kindzorg

MP Hijink asks the Minister of Health about two competing assessment frameworks (normenkaders) for indication in intensive child care, one accredited by the Zorginstituut and one used by some home-care organisations and insurers, and whether the government should act. The Minister states that the V&VN professional norm is the common standard, that insurers rely on it, that the NZa does not govern care content, and that V&VN will clarify the norm for child home care by 1 May.
Such an assignment does not fall within the powers of the NZa.
Een dergelijke opdracht past niet binnen de bevoegdheden van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars, Per Saldo, V&VN en VWS maken afspraken over indicatieproces kindzorg thuis’

Two MPs asked the minister why the parent organisation BVIKZ was not included in agreements on the indication process for child home care, and whether parents' maatwerk and the indication norms were changed. The minister answered that the agreements rest with the Zvw-pgb parties, that BVIKZ is involved in the wider process, that the policy is unchanged, and that no extra meetings are currently planned.
I was, am and remain willing to involve BVIKZ in the solutions on this file; the parliamentary questions asked are, in my view, separate from that.
Ik was, ben en blijf bereid om BVIKZ te betrekken bij de oplossingen op dit dossier, de gestelde Kamervragen staan hier wat mij betreft los van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Inspectie: Veilig Thuis sloot zwijgcontract met ouders’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Veilig Thuis Utrecht imposed a confidentiality contract on a family and kept an unfounded Pediatric Condition Falsification suspicion on file, and about monitoring the family. Minister De Jonge answered that the IGJ found the amended settlement no longer contained confidentiality-contract features, that the disputed clause was dropped, that correction and deletion procedures exist, and that no further steps against Veilig Thuis Utrecht are needed.
It is not for me to judge the conduct of professionals in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over het handelen van professionals in individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en lid Hijink over het bericht dat een man in hongerstaking gaat

MPs Beckerman and Hijink asked the government how it will help Dhani Hoekstra, who announced a hunger strike over Groningen earthquake damage, and what it will do for people suffering psychological distress from gas extraction. The minister said the case is handled by responsible bodies, declined to comment on the individual case, and outlined gas-extraction phase-out, extra funding for social-emotional support and mental health care, without giving a count of users.
Beyond that, I will not comment on this individual case.
Voor het overige doe ik geen uitlatingen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Snel oplossing voor intensieve kindzorg’

An MP asks the health minister about reports that parents of children needing intensive care are losing or facing reduced personal budgets (PGB) under the Zvw, and whether this reflects a rule change or a shift to youth care. The minister answers that no regulation changed, insurers only clarified wording on network care, and agreed with stakeholders on short-term and structural steps including a clarified professional norm by 1 May.
There have been no changes in regulations.
Er zijn geen aanpassingen in regelgeving geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de falende controle op zorgfraude

MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about rising healthcare fraud, the risk-free fraud reported by DSW, insufficient enforcement capacity, family-based care fraud, the Wtza bill, and municipal oversight after the 2015 decentralisations. Minister De Jonge answered that fraud cannot be precisely quantified, outlined a chain-wide enforcement approach with new measures and extra Inspectie SZW capacity, and said municipal oversight should remain locally organised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over pleegouders die voortijdig stoppen

An MP asked the health minister about foster parents who stop prematurely, the report 'Waarom stoppen pleegouders', financial barriers, cooperation between child protection and foster care, and unaccompanied asylum-seeking children placed in foster families. The minister answered that better aftercare and support will be addressed within the foster care action plan, with an action-research outcome expected in autumn 2020.

I will therefore engage with all parties involved in implementing the foster care action plan to see where within the plan there are opportunities to further strengthen support, recognition and appreciation of foster parents.

Ik ga dan ook in gesprek met alle partijen die betrokken zijn bij de uitvoering van het actieplan pleegzorg om te kijken waar binnen het actieplan mogelijkheden zijn om de ondersteuning, erkenning en waardering van pleegouders verder te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over mensen met een stoornis in het autistische spectrum die hun plaats in een woonvorm dreigen te verliezen door korte indicaties

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether short Wmo assessments for people with autism spectrum disorder, a lifelong condition, threaten their place in a supported housing arrangement, and what is being done with VNG and client organisations. The minister says short indications are not appropriate for permanent limitations, that municipalities are encouraged to issue longer decisions, and that Leeuwarden's policy grants 2-3 year indications and no contact is needed for now.

It is the responsibility of the municipality of Leeuwarden, in consultation with these people and individually, taking into account the characteristics of the person and their situation, to determine what support is appropriate for them.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Leeuwarden om in samenspraak met deze mensen, individueel, rekening houdend met de kenmerken van de persoon en diens situatie, te bezien wat voor hen passende ondersteuning is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over gedwongen verhuizingen

An SP MP asks whether forced relocations of residents of care institution Reinaerde, from Woerden to locations hundreds of kilometres away and separated from family, are acceptable and reflect a careful process, and whether residents can stay near home. The Minister answers that the closure of verpleegkundige staffing made intensive care unavailable locally, that a careful search was conducted with the zorgkantoor and IGJ, and that alternatives in Ermelo, Zeist and Katwijk were offered, with no one moved to Friesland.
I am of the view that Reinaerde is carrying out a careful search process.
Ik ben van mening dat Reinaerde een zorgvuldig zoekproces doorloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Zorginstelling Woerden dreigt gehandicapt stel uit elkaar te halen: Het is mensonterend’

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health why seven disabled residents of a Woerden care facility must move by 1 February 2020 to distant locations, and whether the process fits the target group. The Minister acknowledged the disruption, said the facility could not keep providing the needed nursing care nearby, and stated that no residents must move to Friesland, Drenthe or Overijssel, while noting some residents still lacked a final choice and that the Inspectorate has followed the developments closely.
Together with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate I have closely followed developments and consulted with various parties involved.
Samen met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd heb ik de ontwikkelingen intensief gevolgd en ben ik met verschillende betrokken partijen in overleg gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de gedwongen verhuizing van mensen met een handicap uit Woerden

An MP asked the health minister about the forced relocation of seven disabled residents from a Woerden care facility, many over 150 km away, due to staff shortages, and about pressure on residents and whether the minister would monitor the transfers. The minister acknowledged the hardship, said the care provider could no longer deliver adequate nursing care in Woerden, reported that residents were offered alternatives elsewhere, and said the ministry is monitoring developments with the Inspectorate.
I have closely followed developments together with the Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth and have consulted with various involved parties.
Ik heb de ontwikkelingen samen met de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg en Jeugd intensief gevolgd en ben met verschillende betrokken partijen in overleg gegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het feit dat belangenbehartigers niet worden betrokken bij de kwestie van lagere pgb’s voor ouders die hun zieke kind thuis zelf verzorgen

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Geselschap asked why patient representatives were not involved in talks on lower personal budgets (pgb) for parents caring for their seriously ill child at home. The minister replied that representative organisations are consulted, that different meetings with different goals took place from 4 to 7 February, and that he will answer the written questions as soon as possible.

Consultation with interest representatives such as Per Saldo, Stichting Kind en Ziekenhuis, Spierziekten Nederland, Kenniscentrum Kinderpalliatieve Zorg and the Belangenvereniging Intensieve Kindzorg does indeed take place.

Er vindt wel degelijk overleg plaats met belangenbehartigers zoals Per Saldo, Stichting Kind en Ziekenhuis, Spierziekten Nederland, Kenniscentrum Kinderpalliatieve Zorg en de Belangenvereniging Intensieve Kindzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ouders die thuis voor ernstig ziek kind zorgen, krijgen minder geld’

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Geselschap asked the Minister of Health about reports that parents caring for a seriously ill child at home receive less personal budget (pgb) funding, and about the conduct of KinderThuisZorg, the handling of such care as 'usual care', and related questions. The minister answered that the rules have not changed, that the cited passage is meant to clarify practice, that above-usual care remains reimbursable to parents at the informal tariff, and that VWS is monitoring insurers and practice variation.
VWS is in consultation with the professional group V&VN to look into unexplained practice variation in needs assessments.
VWS is met de beroepsgroep V&VN in overleg om te kijken naar onverklaarbare praktijkvariatie bij indicatiestellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Regterschot over het artikel ‘Opvang nieuwe slachtoffers huiselijk geweld niet geregeld’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a news report that women's shelter care in Noord- and Midden-Limburg was not arranged from 1 January 2020 due to a procurement dispute, and about information to municipal councils and the handling of Wmo procurement. The minister replied that interim agreements ensure continuity of shelter, that no other municipalities are known to lack shelter care, that municipal councils' information is a college responsibility, and that shelter triage is not part of mental health care.
Informing municipal councils about local Wmo care is a responsibility of the mayor and aldermen of the municipality concerned.
Het informeren van de gemeenteraden over de lokale Wmo-zorg is een verantwoordelijkheid van het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de betreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over tijdelijke uithuisplaatsingen vanuit gezinshuizen

An SP MP asked the minister whether foster parents employed by gezinshuizen lose income when a child is temporarily placed elsewhere for treatment, and whether such losses are monitored. The minister answered that employment terms follow the CAO Jeugdzorg, that bridging arrangements are for employer and employee to agree, and that no register exists to quantify affected foster parents.
No, that is not known to me. It is not possible to find that out, because there is no register with the names and addresses of foster parents.
Nee, dat is mij niet bekend. Het is niet mogelijk om dat uit te zoeken, omdat er geen register is met de namen en adressen van gezinshuisouders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over het bericht dat zorginstellingen misbruik lijken te maken van de regeling waarmee zij aanstelling of ontslag van een bewindvoerder, mentor of curator mogen vragen

Two MPs (Van Nispen and Hijink, SP) asked about reports that care institutions are misusing their power to request appointment or dismissal of guardians and administrators, and whether judges adequately check such requests and whether guardians are dependent on care institutions. Minister Dekker answered that the figures were misread (about 20 institutional requests per year since 2017), that safeguards against conflicts of interest exist, and that the evaluation did not show clear misuse, while promising to ask care umbrella organisations to raise the issue with members.
When a care institution files a dismissal or appointment request, the judge assesses the merits of the request and weighs all interests involved.
Als een zorginstelling een ontslag- en benoemingsverzoek indient, beoordeelt de rechter de gegrondheid van het verzoek en weegt hij alle betrokken belangen af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht “Die man kent onze zoon helemaal niet”

An MP asked whether care institutions use court proceedings to remove family members as guardians or administrators, whether guardians are financially dependent on institutions, and whether mediation should be mandatory before removal. The minister says such petitions are about 20 per year, sees no reason to restrict access to court, notes conflict-of-interest safeguards exist, and declines to mandate mediation.
I agree that conflicts between care institutions and administrators/mentors should preferably be resolved outside the court.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat conflicten tussen zorginstellingen en bewindvoerders/mentoren bij voorkeur buiten de rechter om worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de tien tips voor de toekomst van de wijkverpleging

An MP asked the minister how to respond to claims by the director of Buurtzorg that fewer care hours could be needed through better interventions, and whether a standard, integrated approach and a single tariff should be pursued. The minister largely defers to care providers and professionals, points to existing quality frameworks and ZonMw funding, and says he will reduce non-contracted care and wait for NZa advice on tariffs.
I agree that the current system contains incentives to provide unnecessarily more and longer care.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat er in het huidige stelsel prikkels zijn om onnodig meer en lang zorg te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over gemeenten die nauwelijks zicht hebben op de besteding van zorggeld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether municipalities' lack of oversight over care spending, and the excessive profits of care providers, is acceptable and what municipalities can do. The Minister calls excessive profits unacceptable, points to planned measures on entry and profit conditions, and says municipalities already have instruments to act on unjustified profits.
I have previously stated that I consider excessive profits socially unacceptable.
Ik heb eerder aangegeven excessieve winsten maatschappelijk onacceptabel te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de hogere instroom van cliënten in de Wmo als gevolg van de invoering van het abonnementstarief

An SP MP asked the minister about rising Wmo home-care demand after the subscription tariff was introduced, the shifting of budgets by municipalities, how income groups are monitored, and how the Hijink motion will be implemented. The minister says the increase was anticipated, commits to an ongoing monitor with VNG and to annual discussion, but draws no conclusions yet and sees no current need for additional compensation.
I consider it important that the effects of the subscription tariff are closely monitored.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de effecten van het abonnementstarief goed worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Amsterdam moet belofte inlossen: hoeveel uur is ‘een schoon huis’?’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether Amsterdam's continued use of result-based rather than hours-based home help decisions, after a court ruling, is acceptable and whether he will consult the municipality. The minister answered that he had urged municipalities to comply with the ruling, that Amsterdam created a temporary option for hours-based decisions, and that he sees no reason to consult Amsterdam.
In view of the foregoing, I currently see no reason to enter into consultation with the municipality of Amsterdam.
Gelet op het voorgaande zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om met de gemeente Amsterdam in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vrouwenbesnijdenis

An SP MP asked the health minister about female genital mutilation (FGM) in the Netherlands, including the effectiveness of measures, reporting duties, prevalence data, airport and border measures, international cooperation and curriculum changes. The minister answered that FGM is criminal and harmful, announced an action agenda on harmful practices, described existing prevention and reporting measures, and committed to further steps such as the action agenda and an FGM campaign element.
That is why I am, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, drawing up an action agenda on harmful practices.
Daarom stel ik, in samenwerking met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming, een actieagenda Schadelijke Praktijken op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het sluiten van de afdelingen van het Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix

MPs Ellemeet asked whether the government accepts that the Winterswijk hospital (Santiz, formerly Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix) plans to close departments despite merger promises, and how paediatrics, acute obstetrics, eating-disorder care and inter-tier cooperation will be protected. The minister answered that the merger was approved in 2016 and that the hospital board must give clarity on its implementation; acute obstetrics cannot close as the hospital is classed as sensitive, a regional working group has been set up, and the board has paused its decision on concentrating paediatrics and obstetrics.
I consider it important that the parties involved in the Achterhoek jointly go through a careful process and take the time for it.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de betrokken partijen in de Achterhoek gezamenlijk een zorgvuldig proces doorlopen en hier de tijd voor nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen bij de verstrekking van hulpmiddelen

An SP MP asked the health minister how to view a Emmeloord woman who was housebound for four months because her adapted wheelchair was not delivered, and about financial problems at the Hulpmiddelencentrum causing supplier refusals. The minister said municipalities remain ultimately responsible for timely aid provision, outlined a capital injection and an action plan, and gave partial answers on how many municipalities and suppliers are affected.
However, the municipality always remains ultimately responsible for the timely provision of an adequate aid.
De gemeente blijft echter altijd eindverantwoordelijk voor de tijdige verstrekking van een adequaat hulpmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘VGZ zet succesproject huisartsen op pauze’

An SP MP asks the health minister whether he accepts insurer VGZ pausing a successful GP pilot ('Positieve Gezondheid') because it reduces hospital referrals and revenue, and how this fits national care policy. The minister says the pilot continues for 2020, further expansion will be discussed regionally, and the decision is for regional parties to agree, without the government directly overriding the insurer.
Agreements on continuing and expanding the project must be made between the care providers and health insurers involved and must fit the broader regional picture.
Afspraken over de voortzetting en uitbreiding van het project moeten tussen de betrokken zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars worden gemaakt en moet passen in het bredere plaatje in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over achterstandsscholen die zich bevinden in fijnstofgebieden

An MP asks whether schools in air-pollution zones, many of them disadvantaged schools in Amsterdam, were left unprotected and whether parents and school boards are informed, and asks for national funding of filters and green playgrounds. The minister replies that air quality is a shared responsibility of municipalities and schools, that the GGD advises on health effects, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord sets targets, and that national funding for filters and playgrounds does not fit the current system.
It is up to municipalities to inform school boards about air quality and health effects, and to take measures to reduce exposure to local sources.
Het is aan gemeenten om schoolbesturen te informeren over de luchtkwaliteit en gezondheidseffecten, en maatregelen te treffen om blootstelling aan lokale bronnen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de reorganisatie en het verandertraject van de Gezondheidsraad

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the reorganisation and change process at the secretariat of the Health Council, including how its director is appointed, the publication record and turnover of staff, and the works council's role. The minister answered that the director was appointed through the regular procedure after the preferred candidate withdrew, that the reorganisation emerged from a change process, and that the works council gave a negative opinion on the reorganisation decision.
The secretariat of the Health Council supports the Health Council in carrying out its advisory task.
Het secretariaat van de Gezondheidsraad ondersteunt de Gezondheidsraad in de uitvoering van de adviestaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen in Kamer over interne onrust Gezondheidsraad’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of intimidation, a poor work culture and internal unrest at the secretariat of the Health Council, including a staff survey and a reorganisation that many staff reject. The minister answered that the reorganisation is needed to speed up advice, that the works council's challenge was dismissed by the Enterprise Chamber, and that he will closely monitor implementation while stating the advice remains of high quality.
I will actively monitor, follow progress and steer implementation where necessary.
Ik zal actief meekijken, de voortgang volgen en waar nodig meesturen op implementatie van de verandering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over "Het bericht dat zorginstelling Pluryn kinderen weigert die specialistische hulp nodig hebben"

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health about reports that Pluryn, a care institution, is refusing children needing specialist help and is in financial trouble, including rising personnel costs, acquisitions, staffing, property costs and regulator involvement. The minister gave figures on costs, revenue, depreciation, clients and FTEs, declined to discuss governance, acquisitions and property costs as internal matters, and said the NZa had no supervisory role in youth care.
From my position, I do not consider it desirable to intervene in the conduct, relationships and dynamics between the management, supervision and works councils within a specific organisation.
Vanuit mijn positie acht ik het niet wenselijk te treden in het optreden, de relaties en verhoudingen tussen het bestuur, toezicht en medezeggenschap in een specifieke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de sluiting van residentiële bedden bij Oosterpoort

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why residential youth-care beds at Oosterpoort are being closed amid municipal budget cuts, and how youths are protected from falling through the cracks. The minister replied that the closure was a joint regional decision, that municipalities have arranged alternative family-based care, and that municipalities are responsible for youth care provision.
Municipalities are responsible for youth care and have a statutory youth-care obligation.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp en hebben een wettelijke jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de overname van jeugdzorginstelling Juzt is afgeketst

An SP MP asked why the takeover of the near-bankrupt youth care provider Juzt failed, who guarantees the funding, and how clients and staff are affected. The minister explains that bankruptcy was averted through municipal loans and a €3 million liquidity loan from VWS, that care is being transferred in phases to other providers, and that regional and national cooperation on youth care will be strengthened.
Before 1 March 2020 we will inform the House further about our policy intentions in this regard.
Voor 1 maart 2020 zullen wij uw Kamer nader informeren over onze beleidsvoornemens daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over kinderen die seksueel zijn misbruikt en onvoldoende hulp krijgen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health and justice ministers about child sexual abuse victims who receive insufficient care, including misdiagnosis, referrals between services, use of isolation, and funding problems at Centres for Sexual Violence. The minister acknowledged difficulties in recognising trauma and referral delays, outlined programmes and pilots, and said the exact numbers are not known while committing to further research and a study with the Dutch Rapporteur.
The requested figures are not known.
De gevraagde cijfers zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling Hoenderloo Groep

CDA MPs asked why youth care provider Pluryn is closing De Hoenderloo Groep, how the roughly 200 youths and 500 staff will be placed elsewhere, and what the financing of special education for the Gelderse Vallei consortium implies. The minister answers that Pluryn has announced the closure citing quality, finances and regional care, that a one-year phase-out plan with individual placements is in preparation under IGJ and education inspectorate supervision, and that funding changes and a planned AMvB on realistic youth care prices are being pursued, while the education funding issue has been corrected by a recovery action.
The IGJ is already involved and will assess this plan and actively supervise the care transfer of the youths currently staying at De Hoenderloo Groep.
De IGJ is reeds betrokken en zal dit plan beoordelen en actief toezien op de zorgvuldigheid van de zorgoverdracht van de jeugdigen die nu bij De Hoenderloo Groep verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over de sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling Hoenderloo Groep

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep youth care institution, including inspection signals, staff complaints, Pluryn's finances and governance, and tariffs. The minister answered that the inspectorate had found shortcomings and reviewed an improvement plan, declined to comment on the relationship between the board and supervisory bodies in a specific organisation, and gave financial figures from Pluryn's accountability document.
From my position, I consider it not desirable to intervene in the relationships between the board, supervision and employee participation within a specific organisation.
Vanuit mijn positie acht ik het niet wenselijk te treden in de relaties en verhoudingen tussen het bestuur, toezicht en medezeggenschap in een specifieke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de kosten van het organiseren van de ouderenzorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about municipal warnings that home care for older people will cost about 7% more over five years, and about related funding strains, workforce and care gaps. The Minister said the trend cannot be concluded from a small sample, will monitor the Wmo abonnementstarief impact with a national study and discuss measures with the VNG in 2020, and pointed to the funding framework and the 2015 care reform.
Based on the outcomes of the monitoring study, I will discuss this annually with the VNG.
Op basis van de uitkomsten uit het monitoronderzoek zal ik jaarlijks met de VNG het gesprek hierover voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de sluiting van de Hoenderloo Groep

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health about the causes, staffing, funding and continuity of care after the closure of De Hoenderloo Group, which houses about 200 children. The minister answered that Pluryn is responsible for orderly transfer of care, municipalities for adequate youth care, and the IGJ will supervise the closure plan, while describing a liquidity support scheme and a staff-retention intention agreement.
I am closely monitoring the situation to ensure that Pluryn and the municipalities take their responsibility.
Ik volg de situatie nauwgezet om te zorgen dat Pluryn en gemeenten hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling De Hoenderloo Groep

MP Voordewind asks the Minister of Health about the planned closure of youth care institution De Hoenderloo Groep, including the risk that children return home without adequate care, whether a coordinated regional approach and Jeugdautoriteit advice are needed, and whether the ministry will guarantee continuity of care. The Minister answers that Pluryn is responsible for a careful transition plan supervised by the IGJ, that municipalities hold statutory responsibility for youth care and must coordinate across regions under Utrecht's lead, and that the Jeugdautoriteit is involved without need for extra advice now.
Pluryn is responsible for setting up a careful approach with suitable tailored solutions for each child.
Pluryn is verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige aanpak met passende maatwerkoplossingen voor elk kind in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over het bericht ‘Elke dag dertien doden door ongelukkige val’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that thirteen people die daily from falls, including whether rising fall deaths after age correction, the abolition of care homes, screening for fall risk, medication review and structural fall prevention can reduce harm. The minister attributes the rise mainly to longer lives with chronic illness and medication use, says fall prevention needs better implementation, and promises to inform parliament in spring about bottlenecks and possible solutions.

This spring the State Secretary will inform the House of Representatives about bottlenecks and possible solutions for these and several other interventions at the intersection of care and the social domain.
Dit voorjaar zal de Staatssecretaris uw Kamer informeren over knelpunten en mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen van deze en enkele andere interventies op het snijvlak van zorg en het sociaal domein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Turkse appartementen gebouwd met Nederlandse zorgmiljoenen: gemeente onderzoekt rol 47 Utrechters'

An MP asked the health minister about a case in which Utrecht residents defrauded care funds to build apartments in Turkey, including whether the fraudsters would be registered in a warning register and how the 6.5 million euros would be recovered. The minister answered that a bill to allow registration of fraudsters in the Warning Register Care Fraud is being prepared for end of Q2 2020, that recovery is being pursued by the municipality and insurer, and that he will inform the House of further findings.
While the investigation is ongoing, the Public Prosecution Service cannot make statements about the means it deploys against suspects.
Lopende het onderzoek kan het OM geen mededelingen doen over de middelen die het inzet jegens verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Harbers over het OPS-model

MPs Lodders and Harbers asked the ministers whether the full source code, calculation rules and data of the OPS dispersion model had been made public, and why emission data requested after a September 2019 commitment had not been shared. The minister replied that the source code was published in early November 2019 with the model data in the OPS download, that emission data were partly withheld for business confidentiality and privacy reasons, and that the RIVM released aggregated data to the plaintiffs in a court case on 7 January 2020, with further publication of changes promised.
Not all emission data are publicly available on Emissieregistratie because they contain business-confidential and/or privacy-sensitive (GDPR) information.
Niet alle emissiedata zijn openbaar op Emissieregistratie te vinden aangezien deze bedrijfsvertrouwelijke en/of privacygevoelige (AVG) informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de concurrentie tussen zorgorganisaties

An SP MP asked the health minister whether competition law prevents care organisations from cooperating to find places for elderly patients, and what role the ACM plays. The minister answered that such cooperation is permitted, explained the Competition Act and ACM guidance, and said competition is a means rather than an end and that he will support cooperation.
Of course care organisations may consult to see where a place is available for a patient.
Natuurlijk mogen zorgorganisaties overleggen om te kijken waar plek is voor een patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geweld tegen vrouwen vergt een Nationaal Coördinator’

An MP asked ministers about a report calling for a National Coordinator on violence against women, including prevalence figures, budgets, police stalking detection and coordination between ministries. The minister answered that the figures are known, that responsibility is shared across departments and municipalities with existing programmes and budgets, and that coordination is sufficient, promising a GREVIO-related review and a stalking-training trajectory.
I am of the view that coordination between the ministries is given sufficient shape with this.
Ik ben van mening dat de coördinatie tussen de ministeries hiermee voldoende vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat 23 ouderen hun huis kwijtraken vanwege een commerciële overname

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked the ministers of Health and Interior about reports that 23 elderly residents of De Keizershof must leave after a commercial takeover, and whether this is acceptable, legally sound, and comparable to the Careyn case. The minister answered that the building was never a care location, the care provider and property owner disputed who pays for adaptations, the rent stopped and the lease was dissolved by court, and that the ministers have contacted the parties to help residents find new housing, committing to no formal structural change.
I find it very unfortunate that these elderly residents have ended up in this situation.
Ik vind het heel vervelend dat deze ouderen in deze situatie terecht zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat de IRMA-app wordt gebruikt in een huisartsenpost

An MP asked about a GP-practice portal in Uden that lets patients log in with the IRMA app, raising privacy, legal basis and BSN concerns. The Minister says the legal position is still open: the Dutch Data Protection Authority has not excluded IRMA, national rules on private login means await the Digital Government Act, and the government is cautiously positive about attribute-based authentication while keeping DigiD as the current standard.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority has not yet ruled out IRMA.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens heeft IRMA nog niet uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over gebrek aan coördinatie bij de bestrijding van geweld tegen vrouwen

An MP asks whether the government considers coordination of efforts against violence against women adequate, given the number of femicide victims, and whether it will appoint a national coordinator as proposed by UN Women Netherlands. The minister answers that municipalities are primarily responsible, that the national programme Geweld hoort nergens thuis is centrally coordinated, and that existing inter-ministerial coordination is sufficient, so no national coordinator is planned.
I am of the view that coordination between the ministries is sufficiently organised with this.
Ik ben van mening dat de coördinatie tussen de ministeries hiermee voldoende vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over de financiële toestand van GGZ-instelling Dokter Bosman

MPs Peters and Van den Berg (CDA) asked Minister De Jonge about the financial troubles of GGZ provider Dokter Bosman, including an investor demanding municipal debt write-offs, alleged over-declaration, unfiled accounts, Tax Office claims, and continuity of youth care. The minister answered that profit-taking has no place in care and rules on dividends are being examined, but he lacked insight into the firm's finances, municipalities decide for themselves, the accounts were later filed, and supervisors and the Youth Authority are involved, with the matter now resolved by a takeover.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht, ingevolge artikel 67 Algemene wet rijksbelastingen, kan niet worden ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kuiken over de structurele problemen in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether youth care problems amount to a structurally failing system, why parents are turned away by municipalities, and why providers face non-cost-covering tariffs, and whether plans have been properly coordinated with VNG and parliament. The Minister replies that more money has been allocated, a non-binding regional cooperation model and a future AMvB on realistic tariffs are planned, with a concrete plan promised for March 2020.
As promised during the committee meeting of 18 November, I will come up with a plan in early March 2020 on how we want to improve the organisation of youth care in the short and longer term.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het WGO van 18 november jl., kom ik begin maart 2020 met een plan hoe we de organisatie van de jeugdhulp willen verbeteren op korte en langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over tekortschietende hulp in woonzorgcentrum Het Schild

An MP asked the minister why care quality at nursing home Het Schild remains deficient more than a year after the first inspection, and whether residents should be protected by intervention or extra funding. The minister confirmed the inspectorate has imposed heightened supervision, will reassess the situation and take further measures if needed, and that the health insurer's care office is discussing measures and possible extra funding with the home.
The inspectorate has imposed heightened supervision to closely monitor the situation within Het Schild.
De inspectie heeft verscherpt toezicht ingesteld om de situatie binnen Het Schild nauwlettend te kunnen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘‘Nu Niet Zwanger’-programma moet wel vrijwillig zijn’

An MP from D66 asked the health minister whether the Nu Niet Zwanger programme, which discusses pregnancy wishes and contraception with vulnerable women and men, guarantees voluntariness and avoids coercion or stigma, and asked about protocols, target group, training and the monitor.
