The minister answered that the programme is voluntary, that safeguards are built in through subsidy conditions, access criteria, a regional implementation process and training, and that a separate independent monitor is being set up, but did not commit to sharing protocols because the methodology is not written as one.
The methodology itself has not been translated into a protocol, precisely to encourage and safeguard tailored work.
Deze methodiek zelf is niet door vertaald in een protocol, juist ook om maatwerk te stimuleren en te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over een voormalige vruchtbaarheidskliniek in Oosterbeek

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked about a former fertility clinic in Oosterbeek where a doctor may have fathered around 150 children, asking about the legal framework of the 1970s-80s, whether affected children can find their donor, and what the ministers will do to help. The Minister replied that no specific donor-registration law existed before 2004 and no evidence shows the clinic was illegal then, and that missing clinic records mean donors cannot be traced, so the only option left is free registration in the Fiom KID-DNA databank.
The administration of this fertility clinic is missing, so it is not possible to determine from it which donors donated at this clinic.
De administratie van deze vruchtbaarheidskliniek ontbreekt, zodat het niet mogelijk is op basis daarvan te achterhalen welke donoren in deze kliniek hebben gedoneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat mensen niet meer naar buiten durven vanwege een gebrek aan openbare toiletten

MPs Hijink and Van Raak asked why many municipalities do not provide public toilets and whether a national minimum norm should be imposed. Minister De Jonge answered that municipalities are responsible for deciding how many public toilets are needed, pointed to voluntary programmes and alternatives, and said a national norm is not appropriate.
Municipalities themselves have the freedom and responsibility, together with residents with and without disabilities, to determine how many (semi-)public toilets are needed.
Gemeenten hebben zelf de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid samen met inwoners, met en zonder beperking, te bepalen hoeveel (semi)openbare toiletten nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de sluiting van de Vlinderhof en Bloesemhof in Montfoort

An MP asked the health minister whether closing the Vlinderhof day-care and the small Bloesemhof nursing home in Montfoort is acceptable given the shortage of care places, and what the government will do. The minister says closure is justified on quality grounds, that residents are being relocated in consultation, that alternative capacity exists nearby, and that the decision is final while he will monitor the relocations.
The decision to close De Vlinderhof and De Bloesemhof is final and no further steps in the decision-making on this are expected.
De beslissing om De Vlinderhof en De Bloesemhof te sluiten is definitief en er zijn geen verdere stappen in de besluitvorming daarover te verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsinformatie voor mensen met een auditieve beperking ook in crisissituaties

An MP asked the government how public information, including crisis communications and televised statements, can be made accessible to people with hearing impairments. The ministers pointed to existing accessibility rules, transcripts of press conferences, live sign-language interpretation of the PM's weekly talk, and a joint approach with stakeholders for crisis situations, promising to inform parliament shortly.
Your House will be informed of the progress in the short term.
Uw Kamer wordt op korte termijn over de voortgang geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten ‘Puinhoop bij Arnhems verpleeghuis; inspectie grijpt in’ en ‘All Day moet cliënten van Dunya Zorggroep na twee maanden alweer overdragen aan goede zorgpartij’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the inspectorate intervened at an Arnhem nursing home run by Dunya Zorggroep and that clients were transferred twice in two months, asking how the quality and continuity of care were checked, what the standard transfer procedure is, and whether the operator's history warrants new rules. The minister answered that the inspectorate ordered the transfers, found the handover to All Day unacceptable and unplanned, announced a new licensing law (Wtza) and a separate bill on integrity of operations, and noted that Dunya Woonzorg was declared bankrupt by the court.
The bill on the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders (Wtza), submitted to your House for plenary debate, introduces a notification duty and a licensing requirement.
Het wetsvoorstel Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders (Wtza), dat door uw Kamer is aangemeld voor plenaire behandeling, introduceert een meldplicht en een vergunningplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het faillissementen in de verpleeghuiszorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why care homes such as Het Grotenhuis (Trimenzo) went bankrupt after the competition authority ACM blocked or conditioned mergers, and how this squares with the national shortage of nursing home places. The Minister rejects the claim that ACM caused the bankruptcies, explains the merger control rules and defenses available, and says the care was continued by Sensire after a takeover, which ACM has now approved.
The conclusion that the nursing home went bankrupt because a merger was rejected by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is one I do not share.
De gevolgtrekking dat het verpleeghuis failliet is gegaan door het afkeuren van een fusie door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de dreigende sluiting van Reinaerde

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the threatened closure of care home Reinaerde, which serves 26 residents with physical disabilities, and what options exist to keep it open. The Minister answered that the provider decides how care is organised, that the building is too small and staff recruitment is insufficient, that the IGJ monitors developments, and that the Chamber will be informed early next year.
The decision to organise care differently is a decision of the care provider.
De keuze om de zorg op een andere manier te organiseren is een besluit van de zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over berichten dat ziekenhuizen en verpleeghuizen zo vol zijn dat ouderen verzorgd worden in een hospice

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reports that hospices in Twente are full and that elderly people on waiting lists for nursing homes end up in hospices. The Minister answered that no recent figures exist for Twente, that such placements are not intended, that regional agreements are being made, and that extra budget is available to tackle nursing home waiting lists.
No recent figures are available on the number of people who could not be admitted to a hospice in Twente.
Er zijn geen recente cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat niet kon worden opgenomen in een hospice in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat veel gemeenten laks omgaan met VN-verdrag

An MP asked the health minister whether it is troubling that most municipalities pay insufficient attention to people with disabilities in their policy plans and whether gemeenten should be monitored and given inspraak mechanisms such as Danish disability councils. The minister acknowledges gaps, points to monitoring by Movisie and VNG projects and plans, and says gemeenten are already legally required to involve clients, leaving the form of inspraak to each municipality.
I consider it important that municipalities pay attention to people with a disability when developing policy.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat gemeenten bij de totstandkoming van beleid aandacht besteden aan mensen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Renkema over het rapport ‘Beleidsscan VN-Verdrag handicap’ van de NVRR?

MPs Özütok and Renkema asked ministers about the NVRR report on municipal implementation of the UN Disability Convention, including why most municipalities lag, the lack of attention to women with disabilities, national implementation steps, and the convention's status in the Caribbean and Kingdom countries. The minister answered that municipalities face challenges, that the VNG project 'Iedereen doet mee' and the 'Onbeperkt Meedoen!' programme are underway, that the NVRR did not investigate the cause regarding women, and that the convention awaits implementing legislation in Caribbean Netherlands and has not been ratified by the other Kingdom countries.
The NVRR did not investigate the cause of why municipalities pay no particular attention to the position of women with disabilities.
De NVRR heeft niet onderzocht wat de oorzaak is waarom gemeenten geen bijzondere aandacht besteden aan de positie van vrouwen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatie-armoede in Nederland

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about period poverty in the Netherlands, citing research by De Bovengrondse and Plan International and asking whether women should have access to good menstrual products and whether free products for pupils and students, as in Scotland, will be introduced. The minister agrees women should have access, points to school sexual education and a planned handreiking on poverty for schools, and concludes existing policy is sufficient without new measures specific to menstrual poverty.
The research gives no reason to take policy measures specifically aimed at this sub-aspect of poverty beyond the cabinet's current efforts.
Het onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding om bovenop de huidige inzet van het kabinet beleidsmaatregelen te nemen specifiek gericht op dit deelaspect van armoede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de beschikbaarheid van respijtzorg in gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of Health about respite care for overburdened carers in municipalities such as Zaanstad, and whether contracting problems mean carers must wait years for support. The minister answered that municipalities are legally obliged to support carers under the Wmo 2015, disputed the newspaper's picture of Zaanstad, and described recent contracts and a national approach to improve visibility of respite care.

Municipalities have the statutory duty to provide social support to residents where needed, promote informal care, and make provisions to prevent carer overburden, including through support and respite care options.

Gemeenten hebben de wettelijke opdracht om, waar aangewezen, maatschappelijke ondersteuning te verlenen aan ingezetenen, mantelzorg te bevorderen en voorzieningen te treffen om overbelasting van mantelzorgers, onder meer door ondersteuning en mogelijkheden van respijtzorg, te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jeugdzorgaanbieders naar de rechter stappen vanwege tariefverlagingen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about youth care providers suing municipalities in The Hague region over steep tariff cuts, questioning whether cuts of around 40% were real and whether quality care and provider continuity could survive. The Minister answered that most tariffs actually rose, that a court ruled partly for the providers and found the region had not shown its tariffs reflected costs, and that a reasonable-price AMvB and a liquidity subsidy scheme are being prepared while municipalities remain responsible for their own obligations.
That is why the Minister for Legal Protection and I announced in our letter to the House of 7 November 2019 an AMvB on reasonable prices for the Youth Act.

Dit is de reden dat de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en ik in de Tweede Kamerbrief «over het bericht dat jeugdzorgaanbieders naar de rechter stappen vanwege tariefverlagingen» van 7 november 2019 een AMvB reële prijs voor de Jeugdwet hebben aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat een 13-jarig meisje 4 uur lang met handboeien om is vastgehouden

MP Westerveld asked the health minister how a 13-year-old girl could be held for four hours in handcuffs without an available crisis place, and whether this shows too little care is available. The minister answered that a suitable place existed in the girl's own region, that the press report was corrected, that she was placed in her existing institution, and that no national figures are kept on out-of-region crisis placements.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over zorgorganisatie DeSeizoenen die de gedragscode voor de zorg schendt

MPs Hijink and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health about conflicts of interest and governance failures at care provider DeSeizoenen, including shared directors with Care Shared Services and weak administration. The Minister said conflicts of interest are unacceptable, that the provider has committed to restructuring its governance by next year, and that further measures will be set out in a letter to parliament.
I find it undesirable when care providers violate the governance code for care.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als zorgaanbieders de governancecode zorg schenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de gevolgen van het cao-akkoord VVT voor de continuïteit van zorg

An MP asked the health minister whether the new VVT collective agreement could cause financial trouble or bankruptcies among home-care organisations and how continuity of care would be guaranteed. The minister answered that there is no reason to assume care continuity is at risk, that municipalities are primarily responsible under the Wmo 2015, and described the conditions for ministry intervention and the ongoing evaluation of the reasonable-price rule.
If continuity of support under the Wmo 2015 is ever at stake, it is primarily up to municipalities to intervene.
Indien continuïteit van ondersteuning op grond van de Wmo 2015 op enig moment in het geding komt, is het primair aan gemeenten om in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de wachtkamer van de zorg: overvolle Twentse hospices

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the health minister about hospices in Twente functioning as waiting rooms for nursing homes, terminally ill people dying at home for lack of hospice beds, hospital transfers to hospices, the decline of care homes, and the financing of bed capacity. Minister De Jonge said hospices should not serve as a general care function for older people, that dying people should be able to reach hospices where preferred, and that he is consulting the hospice sector and palliative networks and will send a letter on nursing home building needs in December.

I am in discussion with the hospice industry association, VPTZ Nederland, and the palliative care networks to see how better regional coordination can ensure people do not go to a hospice too late or too early.

Ik ben in gesprek met de brancheorganisatie van hospices, VPTZ Nederland, en de netwerken palliatieve zorg om te bezien hoe betere afstemming in de regio ervoor kan zorgen dat mensen niet te laat of te vroeg naar een hospice gaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld en Wörstendörfer over ‘jeugdzorg wil actie tegen agressie’: ‘je bent gewaarschuwd ik maak je kapot’

MPs Wörstendörfer and Westerveld asked the government about rising aggression against youth care workers, sentencing, complaints handling, and privacy of professionals' data in the registry. The minister answered that aggression is widespread and measures are underway, that the OM applies a 200% aggravation for such offences, that complaints procedures are being evaluated, and that the registry data leak has been corrected.
I will talk with the sector, the police and the Public Prosecution Service to find out whether additional steps are needed.
Ik ga in gesprek met de branche, de politie en het OM te achterhalen of extra stappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de indexatie van Jeugdzorgtarieven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether agreed national indexation of youth care tariffs exists, given the VNG's statement that no national agreements can be made, and what the government will do if municipalities do not index. The minister answered that bilateral agreements with the VNG exist, that a general administrative order (AMvB) with a binding indexation obligation is being prepared, and that the VNG will publish indexation percentages annually.
The AMvB will in any case contain an obligation to index.
De AMvB zal in ieder geval een verplichting tot indexatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Stichting tegen kindermishandeling gebruikte subsidie voor spirituele workshops'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether ZonMw's EUR 16,000 advance to No Kidding for peer-expert workshops on child abuse was used appropriately, and whether subsidies should require scientific grounding and be clawed back. The minister said the advance fits the programme's goals, that subsidies are not automatically conditioned on scientific evidence, and that no clawback is planned.
It is not realistic to expect that relevant scientific evidence is available for all interventions from the pilots of such an action programme.
Het is niet realistisch om te verwachten dat relevante wetenschappelijke onderbouwing voorhanden is voor alle interventies uit de pilots van een dergelijk actieprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over levensbedreigend ziek zijn en lang op de wachtlijst staan

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the health minister about a 13-year-old with a life-threatening eating disorder who waited nine months for treatment, whether the minister knew of similar cases, how many young people are on waiting lists, and what will shorten them. The minister apologised for the late reply, said a treatment place was found after intervention, but has no overview of waiting lists and points to regional arrangements and planned expertise centres.
There is no national overview of waiting lists and waiting times.
Er bestaat geen landelijk overzicht van wachtlijsten en wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het bericht dat zorginstelling Pluryn kinderen die specialistische hulp nodig hebben weigert

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about reports that youth care provider Pluryn is refusing children needing specialist help, its financial difficulties, a recovery plan shifting to residential care, and staff workload. The Minister answered that Pluryn says no acute cases are refused, that funding is a municipal matter, that no subsidy clawback is currently planned, and that the Minister monitors the situation as system steward while pointing to broader reform and labour-market measures.
Municipalities have a duty to provide youth care and are responsible for the availability of appropriate youth care.
Gemeenten hebben een jeugdhulpplicht en zijn verantwoordelijk voor de beschikbaarheid van passende jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat tientallen jeugdzorgorganisaties failliet dreigen te gaan

An MP asks the health minister whether dozens of youth care providers face bankruptcy, whether this threatens children's care, and whether the government will act, including on a motion for research into 'too big to fail' youth care organisations. The minister says providers and municipalities are primarily responsible, that the Youth Authority can mediate and escalate to the ministry if continuity of crucial care is at risk, and that an investigation found 40% of providers have a high financial risk, with further research planned.
Involvement from VWS is normally not necessary and not at issue in that case.
Bemoeienis vanuit VWS is daarbij normaal gesproken niet nodig en niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat tientallen jeugdzorgorganisaties failliet dreigen te gaan

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the conditions for emergency liquidity support to youth care providers at risk of bankruptcy, the budget source of the EUR 3 million support given to Juzt, and why support is given case by case rather than structurally. The minister answered that providers are primarily responsible, that VWS will intervene only in exceptional cases under strict conditions, that a EUR 20 million subsidy scheme is forthcoming, and that structural reform of youth care is being pursued separately.
Ahead of this subsidy scheme, in the specific case of youth care provider Juzt, EUR 3 million in liquidity support has been granted.
Vooruitlopend op deze subsidieregeling is in het specifieke geval van jeugdhulpaanbieder Juzt € 3 miljoen liquiditeitssteun toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over de administratieve lasten in de zorg die blijven stijgen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister why administrative burdens in care keep rising, how the (Ont)Regel de Zorg programme will deliver relief, and whether overhead in youth and social care is avoidable. The minister acknowledged the rise, said the programme must become more effective, committed to intensified local and national action and an in-depth KPMG study, but declined to commission a data-based mapping of coordination processes.
That is why we are currently carrying out an in-depth study on insight into the spending of youth care funds.
Daarom voeren we op dit moment een diepteonderzoek «inzicht in besteding jeugdzorgmiddelen» uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het percentage coördinatiekosten van het totale jeugdzorgbudget

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reported claims that around 30% of the youth care budget goes to coordination costs, and about the realism of such percentages, gemeente contract harmonisation, regional cooperation, procurement guidance and removal of avoidable rules. The Minister said the figures are not comparable due to differing definitions, cited a 5% municipal implementation cost benchmark, and described ongoing harmonisation, a deep-dive study, and rule-scrapping sessions.
It is not known which municipal cooperation arrangements have broken up in the last two years.
Het is niet bekend welke samenwerkingsverbanden de laatste twee jaar uit elkaar zijn gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de toename van het aantal kinderen dat in een crisisopvang woont

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked the government about the rising number of children living in crisis shelters, including whether gezinnen should get priority for housing and whether the issue will be addressed in an upcoming homelessness action plan. The minister answered that children should not grow up in shelters, that no recent data exists so a study will be commissioned, that housing allocation is a municipal responsibility, and that a homelessness action plan is being prepared.
There are no recent substantiated figures on the number of children currently living in women's or social shelters.
Er zijn geen recente onderbouwde cijfers bekend over het aantal kinderen dat momenteel in de vrouwen- of maatschappelijke opvang woont.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het stoppen met het herindicatie circus voor mensen met een chronische aandoening of een beperking

MPs Bergkamp, Raemakers and Slootweg asked whether the one-time diagnosis rule for chronically ill people (no repeated reassessments) would apply equally to Wmo and Jeugdwet support, and what would be done about repeated re-indication for blind people and people with disabilities. The minister answered that the Zvw change covers only health insurance, that Wmo and youth support require individual assessment, and that the VNG will survey municipal practice without a uniform legal change.
For young people with a disability, the need for help will change over time, and it is desirable to reassess the required help to best match their needs.
Voor jongeren met een beperking zal met het verstrijken van de tijd de hulpvraag veranderen en is het wenselijk de benodigde hulp opnieuw te inventariseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de problematiek rondom hulpmiddelen en verhuizingen

An SP MP asked the health minister about persistent problems with keeping assistive devices after moving to another municipality, the findings of Ieder(in), whether investigations should give way to firm agreements, whether lifelong devices could move to the Zorgverzekeringswet, and the status of agreements with the VNG. The minister answered that an action team and a board table were set up, 434 signals were received with 144 requiring action, that a broader review of device reimbursement schemes will be explored, and that an action plan will follow in January 2020.

I intend to send Parliament the action plan on improving the provision of assistive devices after the board table in January next year, and to inform Parliament of progress on all actions before summer 2020.

Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer na de bestuurlijke tafel in januari volgend jaar het actieplan verbetering verstrekking hulpmiddelen te doen toekomen en voor de zomer van 2020 uw Kamer te informeren over de voortgang van alle acties uit het actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Laan-Geselschap inzake “het krijgen van een assistentiehond”

MPs Van den Bosch and Laan-Geselschap asked why the PTSD assistance-dog study for veterans has not yet concluded and why waiting lists and limited choice of trainers persist. The minister replies that the first study was finished and presented in June 2018, that a follow-up longitudinal study with Utrecht University is expected to report in September 2021, and that the results will guide future policy on dog deployment, training and funding.
The research result is expected to be ready in September 2021. Defence is of course following this closely.
Het onderzoeksresultaat zal naar verwachting in september 2021 gereed zijn. Defensie volgt dit uiteraard aandachtig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het percentage coördinatiekosten van totaal jeugdzorgbudget

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Health about reports that about 30% of the youth care budget goes to coordination costs, and whether the government has insight into this. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, said the coordination-cost figures are a Berenschot benchmark with varying definitions, committed to a KPMG deep-dive study due end of the year, and described the deregulation ('ontregel de zorg') and schrapdagen efforts to cut avoidable overhead.
To this end, the in-depth study 'insight into the spending of youth care funds' is currently being carried out.
Hiertoe wordt momenteel het diepteonderzoek «inzicht in besteding jeugdzorgmiddelen» uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over gezinsvoogden

An MP asked the Minister about a shortage of child-protection guardians (gezinsvoogden), their caseloads, links to out-of-home placements, and unresolved responsibility for pocket and clothing money for children under protective orders. The Minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to an ongoing inspection and to labour-market programmes, and said he would raise the issue of pocket money with municipalities.
The inspection report, including my response, I will send to you before the WGO Youth meeting of 18 November 2019.
Het inspectierapport, inclusief mijn reactie, zal ik u voor het WGO Jeugd van 18 november 2019 toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het stoppen van Stichting De Opbouw met het aanbieden van jeugdzorg door Lijn5

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the decision by Stichting De Opbouw to stop offering youth care through Lijn5, its impact on about 2,000 young people and families, late notification, and whether the funding and organisation of youth care is to blame. The minister answered that Lijn5 remains fully operational, families were informed, care continuity is being arranged with other providers, municipalities bear the youth care duty, and the situation of several youth care providers is being monitored with the Jeugdautoriteit involved.
Lijn5 is fully operational and all treatment appointments are being honoured.
Lijn5 is volledig in bedrijf en alle behandelafspraken worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de berichtgeving dat de werkdruk zo hoog is in de zorg dat zorgpersoneel steeds vaker psychische hulp nodig heeft

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that the share of healthcare workers receiving psychological care rose about 40 percent over four years, whether work causes these complaints, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged the rising trend as worrying, noted work contributes to complaints for part of the workforce, and listed retention measures and a TNO study on burnout.
A rising trend in the share of healthcare workers receiving psychological care I find worrying and all the more reason to invest further in improving the working climate for healthcare workers.

Een stijgende trend in het aandeel zorgmedewerkers dat psychische zorg ontvangt vind ik zorgelijk en eens te meer reden om extra in te zetten op het verbeteren van het werkklimaat van zorgmedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de (on)toegankelijkheid van speeltuinen voor kinderen met een beperking

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Health about the inaccessibility of playgrounds for children with disabilities, citing a commitment to make half of municipalities have an accessible playground, and asked for data and further steps. The minister answered that no national figures exist, pointed to VNG-led learning networks and a Handreiking Samen Spelen, and promised to report on it in the next progress report due before summer 2020.
Figures on this are not available (nationally).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Toetsingscommissies euthanasie gaan meer naar de context kijken’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Tellegen asked about reports that euthanasia review committees will look more at context, and about a proposal to let the Supreme Court rule on euthanasia law questions directly. The government said it is examining allowing cassation in the interest of the law against RTE rulings, is studying ways to protect doctors from lengthy criminal proceedings, and that talks with stakeholders have already taken place, with a substantive letter promised this autumn.
Your House has been promised that this proposal will be examined.
Aan uw Kamer is toegezegd dat dit voorstel wordt onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het manifest van Ieder(in) en de Vereniging Gehandicaptenzorg Nederland (VGN) over de toegang tot huisartsenzorg voor mensen met een beperking

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a manifesto by Ieder(in) and VGN reporting that growing numbers of people with intellectual disabilities receiving Wlz care are being refused or dropped by GPs and GP posts, and about the LHV guideline excluding Wlz clients in institutions from basic GP care. The Minister acknowledged the signals, said he finds problems with access to medical-generalist care undesirable, commissioned an NZa study due early 2020, and reported a 15 October 2019 meeting with stakeholders agreeing short- and long-term actions, with a fuller approach promised by year-end.
I commissioned the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) at the end of August to research the signals about declining accessibility of medical-generalist care for this patient group.
Ik heb de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) eind augustus een opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de signalen over afnemende toegankelijkheid van de medisch-generalistische zorg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Ellemeet over de ingezonden brandbrief in het NRC van 67 zorgprofessionals ‘Laten we de duurste ziekte aanpakken – dementie’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about a open letter from 67 care professionals urging greater focus on preventing dementia, including claims about lifestyle-related risk and possible savings. The minister acknowledged the letter, said prevention is part of existing programmes and the Nationaal Preventieakkoord, and declined to make a sugar tax a priority while offering to talk with the initiators.
We are, however, willing to enter into discussion with the initiators.
Wel zijn wij bereid met de initiatiefnemers het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Bergkamp over de onbereikbaarheid van aangepaste rolstoelwoningen

Two D66 MPs asked why a patient was refused an accessible wheelchair home due to age, and about accessibility policy under the UN disability convention and related housing rules. The minister said the patient has since been offered a suitable home, that corporations may label dwellings for specific groups on objective grounds, and that no further signals of wrongful refusals were received, while promising to discuss any such cases with Aedes and stating that no national definition of a wheelchair home exists.
I have not received any further signals.
Er hebben mij niet meer signalen bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat wederom een jeugdzorginstelling sluit vanwege financiële problemen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government's May 2019 measures on financial problems at youth care providers are sufficient, after another youth care institution closed. The minister says gemeenten and the Jeugdautoriteit are responsible, describes an early warning instrument and a EUR 20 million liquidity facility, and declines to adopt the MP's motion on an investigation, though it promises an analysis by the Jeugdautoriteit.
I closely follow developments from my role as system steward.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend vanuit mijn rol als stelselverantwoordelijke.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de rol die transferverpleegkundigen en transferbureaus spelen in persoonsgerichte zorg

Two D66 MPs asked about the role of transfer nurses and transfer agencies in person-centred care, including staff numbers, opening hours, and coordination with municipalities under the Wmo. The minister said there is no good overview of transfer nurse numbers, that the sector is mainly hospital-based, and that he will ask V&VN and VNG about local agreements with municipalities.
There is no good overview of the number of transfer nurses and the number of full-time equivalents.
Er is geen goed overzicht van het aantal transferverpleegkundigen en het aantal fte's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kwantificering van zorgkosten

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify health and care costs attributable to (non-Western) immigrants, premium arrears, and targeted programmes. The minister answered that no breakdown by migration background is available for most items, gave an estimate of about 2.2 million euros for medically necessary care to uninsured non-Western-background residents, and pointed to other sources for cost differences.
We have no insight into what share of care costs is spent on Dutch residents with a migration background.
We hebben geen inzicht in welk deel van de kosten van zorg wordt aangewend voor Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “de alternatieve luchtvaartnota van Natuur & Milieu, Greenpeace en Natuur en Milieufederatie Noord-Holland, waaruit blijkt dat krimp van de luchtvaart onvermijdelijk is.”

MP Van Raan asks the government whether it endorses the claims in an alternative aviation policy paper by environmental NGOs, including that aviation must shrink, that technical measures are insufficient, and that health and noise harms and nitrogen deposition require action. The minister answers that the government pursues a broad mix of climate instruments, will assess volumes via the PlanMER, does not endorse all claims (e.g., on economic importance), and will consider the paper's ideas in the forthcoming Luchtvaartnota without committing to a shrinkage scenario.
The government's approach is primarily aimed at achieving the necessary emission reductions through this route.
De inzet van het kabinet is er primair op gericht om via deze weg de benodigde emissiereducties te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de artikelen over PrivaZorg van Follow the Money en Trouw

A Labour MP asked the health minister about investigative reports on PrivaZorg, including tax information not shared with care supervisors, a whistleblower's treatment, governance and accountant roles, and whether criminal complaints were filed. The minister answered that the IGJ has tightened oversight, the IKZ information-sharing will be improved by a forthcoming bill, governance measures are being prepared, and no criminal complaint was deemed likely to succeed.
During an ongoing investigation, the IGJ does not provide informants with information about the content of the investigation.
Gedurende een lopend onderzoek verschaft de IGJ geen informatie over de inhoud van het onderzoek aan melders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de oud-bestuurders van PrivaZorg ruim 14 miljoen zorggeld uit de zorginstelling hebben gesluisd

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Health Minister and the State Secretary of Finance about reports that former PrivaZorg directors siphoned over 14 million euro of care funds through a complex corporate structure, and whether the IGJ, NZa, Tax Service and prosecutors should have acted earlier. The minister answered that the IGJ found no proven unlawful conduct within current legal frameworks, that the agencies lack sufficient powers over governance and integrity, and that new legislation on integrity, supervision and dividend conditions is being prepared.

The IGJ and NZa have previously indicated that they still have insufficient powers to investigate integrity and professional business operations, conflicts of interest, siphoning off care funds and setting up complex inefficient corporate structures.

De IGJ en de NZa hebben eerder aangegeven dat ze nog onvoldoende bevoegdheden hebben om onderzoek te doen naar integere en professionele bedrijfsvoering, belangenverstrengeling, wegsluizen van zorggelden en het optuigen van complexe ondoelmatige bedrijfsstructuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het  bericht dat  de overheid wist van financiële misstanden bij Privazorg, maar niets deed

MP Slootweg asked whether the tax authority knew of Privazorg executives paying themselves from care funds since 2007 and not sharing this with the inspectorate, and about the role of accountancy firm Grant Thornton and multi-entity structures in care organisations. The minister declined individual cases citing tax secrecy, said the inspectorate and NZa lack direct powers over Grant Thornton, and announced legislation on conflicts of interest, internal supervision and transparency.
Due to the tax secrecy obligation under article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht ingevolge artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen va het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat INEOS via kindermarketing het draagvlak voor schaliegas probeert te vergroten

An MP asked whether INEOS's sponsorship of The Daily Mile, used to build support for shale gas, should be countered, and whether schools should be warned and the programme publicly funded. The minister replied that INEOS is not a sponsor in the Netherlands, that JOGG runs the programme independently, that schools can use the sponsorship convenant, and that the government sees no reason for further action.
INEOS is not a sponsor of The Daily Mile in the Netherlands.
INEOS is in Nederland geen sponsor van The Daily Mile.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het (aankomende) tekort aan verpleeghuisplekken

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Health about the expected shortage of nursing home places, waiting lists (including for zzp 4), partner admission rules, supervision, and the 2020 tariff revision. The Minister answered most questions with figures and explanations, referred some data to earlier letters, said there is no national registration of partner-admission waits, and committed to a further letter ahead of the budget debate.
I do not have the requested information, because there is no national registration of the preferences and possible waiting times of partners wishing to be admitted.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie, omdat er geen landelijke registratie plaatsvindt van de voorkeuren en eventuele wachttijden van partners met opnamewens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verstopte route naar het verpleeghuis waardoor duizenden minder weerbare ouderen wachten op een plek

An MP asked the health minister about long waiting times for nursing-home places, the treeknorm, NZa warnings about Wlz budget shortfalls and a hospital's struggle to place elderly patients. The minister acknowledged the figures, said most actively mediated clients are placed within the norm, and promised a further letter on measures and the Wlz budget.
During the Langer Thuis debate of 25 September I committed to inform you by letter, before the budget debate, about additional measures.
Ik heb tijdens het debat Langer Thuis van 25 september toegezegd nog vóór de begrotingsbehandeling u per brief te informeren over aanvullende maatregelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over diverse berichten inzake de berichten 'Duizenden ouderen wachten op verpleeghuisplek of thuiszorg', 'Route naar verpleeghuis zit verstopt' en '36 huizen afbellen voor één pati

An MP from the Labour party asks the Minister of Health about press reports on elderly people waiting for nursing home places or home care, and whether the government takes responsibility and will act with extra measures and money. The Minister acknowledges the scale of the challenge, gives no waiting-list numbers for home care, points to public waiting-list overviews for nursing homes, and defers the substantive answers on responsibility, measures and funding to a letter before the budget debate.
For the further answers to these questions I refer to my letter that I will send before the budget debate.
Voor de verdere beantwoording op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief die ik zal sturen vóór de begrotingsbehandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat medische hulp voor - en onderzoek naar mensen met niet-westerse achtergrond achterblijft

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Medical Care whether symptoms of conditions more common in non-Western populations are missed by doctors, whether funding and attention for non-white diseases is insufficient, and what the ministry is doing about it. The minister replied that the ministry does not distinguish between white and non-white conditions, points to existing rare-disease policy, European reference networks, research programmes and patient-organisation subsidies, and does not commit to new targeted measures.
The ministry has no insight into the time and attention devoted to non-white conditions, because policy does not distinguish between these conditions.
Het ministerie heeft geen zicht op de tijd en aandacht die naar niet-witte aandoeningen gaat, omdat er in het beleid geen onderscheid gemaakt wordt tussen deze aandoeningen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag inzake de specialist ouderengeneeskunde die verdacht werd van onzorgvuldige euthanasie op een demente patiënte

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the ministers about a district court ruling acquitting a geriatric specialist accused of careless euthanasia on a dementia patient, and its effects on review bodies and the Euthanasia Act. The government answered that the Public Prosecution Service will not appeal but the Procurator-General will seek a cassation ruling in the interest of the law, that review practice should follow the Supreme Court decision once issued, and that current law already covers taking the current situation into account, while declining to comment further on a possible amendment.
However, the Public Prosecution Service has asked the Procurator-General at the Supreme Court to file a cassation appeal in the interest of the law in the above case.
Wel heeft het OM de Procureur-Generaal bij de Hoge Raad verzocht om cassatie in het belang der wet in te stellen in bovengenoemde zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de Coöperatie Laatste Wil een handleiding online heeft gezet waarmee het mogelijk is om een leven te beëindigen

MPs Van der Molen and Van Toorenburg asked whether the government would act against the Coöperatie Laatste Wil after it posted online a manual naming chemicals usable for ending life, and whether a criminal investigation should be reopened. The government called the manual undesirable and said it was in talks with the CLW, but stated that the Public Prosecution Service independently decides whether to investigate and will inform parliament only once it has decided.
The OM makes an independent, autonomous assessment of whether or not to start a criminal investigation.
Het OM maakt een eigenstandige, onafhankelijke afweging over het al dan niet starten van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Tielen over het bericht 'Salafistische jongerenwerkers actief in Den Haag'

MPs Peters and Tielen asked the ministers about reports that Salafist youth workers operate in The Hague, including one worker who stopped after police warnings, and whether radical influence on youth is widespread. The government confirmed the case was handled locally with the employer ending the worker's contract, said no grounds exist for a wider inventory or new measures on leaked information, and pointed to existing prevention and partnership efforts.
We are not aware of any signals that would require such an inventory.
Er zijn ons geen signalen bekend die een dergelijke inventarisatie nodig zouden maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat gemeenten massaal korten op het sociaal domein

MP Kerstens asked whether it is not troubling that municipal budget shortfalls lead to cuts in the social domain that hit the most vulnerable, and when the limit of responsible execution of the decentralisations would be reached. Minister De Jonge answered that the survey of municipalities is not evidence of actual shortfalls, that the government and municipalities keep talking, that extra youth-care funds were provided, and that municipal execution is not irresponsible.
There can be no question of irresponsible execution by municipalities.
Er kan geen sprake zijn van een onverantwoorde uitvoering door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Kinderen in de gesloten jeugdzorg te vaak opgesloten’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister whether he accepts the inspectorate's warning that agreed targets for reducing forced isolation of youths in closed youth care will not be met, and asked what he will do about staff shortages and funding. The minister denies the inspectorate said the targets will not be met, points to a baseline measurement of 860 isolations and a project with providers, and promises further measurement and an labour-market agenda, while not committing to a firm 2022 zero target.
The factsheet does not state that the agreements with the field will not be met.
In het factsheet staat niet dat de afspraken met het werkveld niet gehaald gaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over Zuid- en Oost-Europeanen die omgeschoold worden voor de Nederlandse zorg

An SP MP asked the health minister about recruiting Southern and Eastern European nurses for Dutch care, including the role of agencies such as EMTG and language risks. The minister answered that hiring foreign staff is left to care institutions within EU free movement and BIG registration rules, that language proficiency is required, that foreign nurses are a small share, and that the focus should be on retaining and recruiting Dutch staff.
There is no complete picture of the extent to which care institutions want to bring foreign care workers to the Netherlands.
Er is geen compleet beeld van de mate waarin zorginstellingen buitenlandse zorgverleners naar Nederland willen halen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Hermans en Laan-Geselschap over het af en toe in een instelling kunnen verblijven van ouderen en gehandicapten

Three MPs asked the minister about respite and part-time residential care (logeerzorg and deeltijdverblijf) for elderly and disabled people, including pilot results, administrative burden, and the fixed co-payment from 1 January 2020. The minister answered in detail on pilots, bureaucracy reduction for carers, and the Wlz co-payment change, while deferring the final pilot results to November and not addressing the Wmo case fully.
For that reason, research is currently being conducted via the national panel of MantelzorgNL and ANBO into the need for structural respite care.
Om die reden wordt momenteel onderzocht via het landelijke panel van MantelzorgNL en ANBO wat de behoefte is aan structurele logeerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het aanpakken van pro-anorexia websites en ‘anorexiacoaches’

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers about pro-anorexia websites, the scale of such online communities, and the 'anorexia coaches' who solicit sexual images from vulnerable girls. The government said a research study by CKM and GGZ Rivierduinen is ongoing with results due in autumn, that a ban on pro-ana sites would be ineffective and could reinforce stigma, and pointed to existing criminal law, grooming provisions and the K-EET care chain initiative as its response.
It has not been mapped how extensive the pro-anorexia websites are in the Netherlands, and there is no overall picture of the websites, forums and social media channels.
Er is niet in kaart gebracht hoe omvangrijk de pro-anorexia websites zijn in Nederland en er is geen totaalbeeld van de websites, fora en sociale mediakanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het schrappen van zware jeugdzorg voordat alternatieve, dan wel ambulante jeugdzorg beschikbaar is

An MP asks the minister whether plans by sixteen municipalities to cut specialist youth care beds in 2020, before alternative ambulant care is in place, threaten continuity of care and how the minister will guarantee it. The minister says municipalities bear a statutory duty to ensure continuity, that the Ondersteuningsteam Zorg voor de Jeugd is looking at reaching agreement, that he sees no reason yet for action, and that he has no signals of similar cuts elsewhere.
Municipalities have a statutory duty to provide youth care.
Gemeenten zijn hebben een wettelijk vastgelegde jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat gemeenten bedden in de specialistische jeugdzorg gaan schrappen zonder alternatieve opvang

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about municipalities in Noord-Brabant planning to cut EUR 10 million from specialised youth care in 2020 without alternative provision, and about guaranteeing capacity rather than provider revenue. The minister answers that municipalities hold the statutory duty to provide youth care and ensure continuity, that he endorses home-first care while accepting that institutional placement is sometimes the best option, and that the national support team is examining how to reach agreement between providers and municipalities.
Municipalities are responsible for youth care and have a statutory duty to provide youth care.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp en hebben een wettelijke jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de aanbeveling van het VN-Mensenrechtencomité 2019 om de waarborgen voor de euthanasiepraktijk te versterken door toetsing vooraf

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked whether the government will respond to the 2019 UN Human Rights Committee recommendation to strengthen ex ante review of euthanasia, including an independent ethics commission. Minister De Jonge replied that he sees no reason to change the Wtl, citing broad public support, six careful-practice criteria and post-hoc review by regional committees, and that this answer serves as an early response.
I see no reason to amend the current euthanasia legislation, for the following reasons.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de huidige euthanasiewetgeving aan te passen, om de volgende redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat hulpverleners afhaken door te lage zorgtarieven

An MP asked the health minister whether low personal-budget care tariffs and slow renewal procedures in Eindhoven are driving care providers out and leaving clients without support. The minister said municipalities must justify their tariffs and follow legal deadlines, that Eindhoven has taken effective measures, and that he will talk with the VNG about tariff justification.
I will therefore enter into discussion with the VNG to examine whether municipalities sufficiently justify their tariffs, as the legal frameworks imply.
Met de VNG zal ik daarom in gesprek treden om te bezien of gemeenten hun tarieven voldoende onderbouwen, zoals de wettelijke kaders impliceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat ouderen nauwelijks geld overhouden

An MP asked the health and social affairs ministers about reports that older people have little money left after paying care costs, including Regioplan findings, example budgets, the earlier start of the high own contribution, and whether financial reasons push people away from thuis care into nursing homes. The minister disputes the Regioplan scope, gives partial calculations as percentages of disposable income, says the situation is hard to quantify, and promises an advisory report from a committee at end 2019.
It is impossible to determine exactly how much money older people have left, because this amount depends heavily on the personal preferences and choices of the individual client.
Het is hierbij onmogelijk te bepalen welk bedrag ouderen precies overhouden, omdat dit bedrag sterk afhankelijk is van de persoonlijke voorkeuren en keuzes van de individuele cliënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over onderzoek naar mogelijk misbruik bij zwaar gehandicapten kinderen en jongvolwassenen

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about a police investigation into suspected abuse of severely disabled children and young adults at care provider Dichterbij, the closure of the location, the status of agency staff suspected of involvement, and whether the Chamber would be informed of the investigation's outcome. The minister said the provider rightly reported the abuse, described the relocation of residents and the dismissal of three agency workers, declined to comment on individual criminal cases, and confirmed that the same VOG (certificate of conduct) requirements apply to temporary staff as to permanent staff, which the inspectorate checks.
We do not go into individual (criminal) cases.
Wij gaan niet in op individuele (straf)zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de problematiek rondom rolstoelen en scootmobielen

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about long repair waits and insufficient tailoring for wheelchair and scooter users, and whether the government would act on a Patiëntenfederatie/Ieder(in) recommendation. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to a follow-up study and VNG agreements, and said he would commission a bureau to help implement the recommendations, reporting back next year.
I intend to give a bureau the assignment to help implement the recommendations.
Ik ben voornemens een bureau de opdracht te geven om te helpen de aanbevelingen te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden en Kuiken over het bericht 'Relatie zorgfraude en terrorisme onderzocht'

Two MPs asked whether suspicious financial transactions linked to care fraud, and a possible link with terrorism financing, were detected and acted upon by the FIU-Nederland, including how many transactions there were and whether earlier years were investigated. The minister replied that over 1,300 unusual transactions related to care fraud were reported in 2018, that many remain under investigation so no concrete figures are yet available, and that no further retrospective investigation is planned.
As a result, no concrete statements can yet be made about the number of transactions declared suspicious by the FIU-Nederland that may be related to care fraud, or the amount involved.

Hierdoor kunnen er nog geen concrete uitspraken worden gedaan over het aantal door de FIU-Nederland verdacht verklaarde transacties dat mogelijk te relateren is aan zorgfraude alsmede het bedrag dat daarmee gemoeid is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over fraude in de zorg

An MP asks the Health Minister about a Twente care bureau lending care funds, whether such loans can be made unlawful, and how fraud in municipal care will be tracked. The minister says the Bevorderen samenwerking en rechtmatige zorg bill will improve signal-sharing and a warning register, that loans are undesirable and stricter internal and external oversight is being prepared, and that municipalities are responsible for registering their own non-compliance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de financiële ondersteuning van Europese anti-abortus clubs door Amerikaanse miljardairs

An MP asked the health minister whether he is concerned that US billionaires fund European anti-abortion groups seeking to influence policy, whether Dutch organisations receive similar funding, and whether women's right to choose should be defended. The minister said donor acceptance is up to the organisations, he is unaware of funding of Dutch groups beyond their public reports showing reliance on donations, and he firmly supports women's free access to abortion care within the existing Dutch law.
I consider it important that every woman considering a termination can make a well-considered choice freely.
Ik acht het van belang dat iedere vrouw die een zwangerschapsafbreking overweegt, in vrijheid een weloverwogen keuze kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur 'Zorg voor complexe gehandicapten nog steeds niet op orde'

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Health about a Nieuwsuur broadcast showing that care for people with complex disabilities is still not adequate, including how many extra places have been created and how the 100 planned places are distributed. The Minister acknowledges the problem, describes the joint inventory of regional shortages due by March 2020 and the programme Volwaardig Leven, but gives no figures on places added or on the regional allocation, and says the extramuralisation effect is not measurable.
For that reason I cannot make a concrete statement on whether the reduction of intramural beds in mental health care has led to more pressure on the disability sector.
Ik kan mede daarom geen concrete uitspraak doen of de afbouw van intramurale bedden in de GGZ geleid heeft tot meer druk op de gehandicaptensector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over het bericht dat zorgcowboys binnen twee jaar miljonair worden in de thuiszorg

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about reports that home-care providers are making very high profits, including the Karmel/De Kroon and Faveo/Emmen cases, and about supervision of such profits. The minister said very high margins are unacceptable, pointed to municipal contract oversight and new measures, and acknowledged past unlawful dividend payments while withholding a full overview of sector profits.
I do not have a complete picture of this, but I want to emphasise that achieving very high profit margins is socially unacceptable.
Ik heb hier geen integraal beeld van, maar wil benadrukken dat ik het behalen van zeer hoge winstmarges maatschappelijk onacceptabel vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de dyslexieindustrie

MP Peters (CDA) asked the Health Minister whether dyslexia care providers have become commercial and taken over by investment funds, whether the gatekeeper for dyslexia referrals is independent of commercial providers, and whether quality control and scientific advice are in the hands of commercial actors. The minister answered that data on providers and acquisitions is lacking, announced a study into EED spending and municipal steering, and said a gatekeeper should be independent and an independence guarantee will be examined, but declined for now to make an independent gatekeeper mandatory.
No figures are available on the total number of dyslexia providers or on takeovers of dyslexia providers by (foreign) investment funds.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het totaal aantal dyslexieaanbieders of over overnames van dyslexieaanbieders door (buitenlandse) investeringsfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de afbouw en overdracht van de zorg bij jeugdzorginstelling Juzt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about financial and organisational problems at youth care provider Juzt and other providers, how gemeenten and the state proactively respond, and asked for an investigation into Juzt's causes. The minister said continuity of care is leading, the Jeugdautoriteit and early warning instruments are being developed, and he sees no added value in a cause investigation beyond what is already known.
At present I see no added value in an investigation into the causes compared with what is already known.
Momenteel zie ik geen meerwaarde in een onderzoek naar de oorzaken ten opzichte van hetgeen nu al bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de ontmanteling van jeugdzorgaanbieder Juzt

The SP MP Hijink asks the Minister of Health why the government did not intervene earlier in the financial problems of youth care provider Juzt, whether it has an inventory of other providers in financial trouble, and how it views the consequences of the 2015 decentralisation of youth care. The minister answers that the ministry was informed in 2016, gave transitional subsidies, and that the Youth Authority and municipalities now manage a controlled wind-down, while pointing to an early warning instrument, a Youth Authority analysis of provider finances, and extra municipal funding.
To detect in time the financial and organisational problems that could lead to discontinuity of care, the Youth Care Action Programme agreed that an early warning instrument will be introduced.

Om financiële en organisatorische problemen die kunnen leiden tot discontinuïteit van zorg tijdig te kunnen signaleren, is binnen het Actieprogramma Zorg voor de Jeugd afgesproken dat er een early warning instrument komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Westerveld over geweld in de jeugdzorg

MPs Buitenweg and Westerveld asked whether psychological child abuse is punishable under Dutch criminal law and how prosecutors handle it, and what measures the government will take. The minister answered that Article 300 Sr can cover psychological abuse, that the Public Prosecution Service examines such cases case by case, that no Criminal Code revision is currently considered opportune, and listed ongoing programmes and a pending bill strengthening child abuse liability.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het voorkomen van vrouwelijke genitale verminking in Nederland

An MP asked the health and justice ministers why no convictions have followed the 1993 ban on female genital mutilation, how many girls are at risk, what protections exist for girls travelling abroad, and how many reports professionals make. The government explains VGV is prosecuted as (aggravated) assault since no specific offence exists, outlines prevention, child protection and travel-permission measures, and says it will report further measures by end 2019.
The Public Prosecution Service does not record for violent offences whether FGM is involved, because there is no specific criminal offence in the Criminal Code.
Het Openbaar Ministerie registreert bij geweldsdelicten niet of sprake is van VGV, omdat er geen specifieke strafbaarstelling bestaat in het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Cordaan die verstandelijk beperkte cliënten een zwijgcontract liet tekenen

An MP asked the ministers why care organisation Cordaan had intellectually disabled clients sign silence contracts about abuse, when the abuse was reported late to the Inspectorate and perpetrators left with payments. The minister called silence clauses unacceptable, said the Inspectorate was not aware of the contracts until recently, and announced a law banning such clauses to go to consultation by end of year.
I find concluding such a contract between victims and a care organisation completely unacceptable.
Ik vind het afsluiten van een dergelijk contract tussen slachtoffers en een zorgorganisatie volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het gebrekkige toezicht op de data van patiënten

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked how patient data is protected, whether a US company had access to anonymised data, whether patients are informed about research use, and about monopoly risks in digital care. The minister answered that responsibility lies mainly with care providers, that the software in question is not used in the Netherlands, that anonymised or consented research is the rule, and promised further letters and debate.
Hospitals themselves bear responsibility for their patient management software and what they agree with suppliers in their contracts.
Ziekenhuizen dragen zelf de verantwoordelijkheid voor hun software voor patiëntenbeheer en hetgeen ze afspreken met de leveranciers in hun contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg en Geurts over de Nederlandse voorbereiding op een harde Brexit

CDA MPs asked the government about the Dutch preparations for a hard Brexit on 31 October 2019, covering customs staffing and enforcement choices, medicine and medical device shortages, live animal inspection posts and NVWA capacity. The government answered that staffing targets were met, customs and NVWA preparations continue, and that shortages and disruptions cannot be fully ruled out.
The Tweede Kamer was informed about these choices in the cabinet letter dated 18 January 2019.
Over deze keuzes is de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd in de brief van het kabinet d.d. 18 januari 2019
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de faciliteiten van jongerenorganisaties

An MP asked the education, health and interior ministers about whether youth organisations deserve facilities, how youth are consulted on policy, which subsidies exist and how board grants (bestuursbeurzen) are allocated. The government answered that youth participation matters, outlined existing consultation channels and subsidies, and defended the current allocation criteria limited to higher-education-relevant organisations.
No, there is no separate overview of youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Nee, er is geen afzonderlijk overzicht van jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over brandveiligheid in seniorenwoningen

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about fire safety in senior housing complexes after a news report on evacuation risks, asking about past signals, measures on smoke spread and escape route length, and whether existing rules fall short. The minister answered that stricter fire safety requirements for residential buildings are planned, with TNO research and a draft amendment to the Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving to follow, and that municipalities can already impose new-build standards on existing complexes but the minister is still considering how to encourage this.
In this letter I report that I intend to tighten the fire safety requirements for residential buildings.
Ik meld in deze brief dat ik voornemens ben om de brandveiligheidseisen voor woongebouwen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over de grote klappen voor de werkgelegenheid in Groningen

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the ministers about reported job losses in Groningen (about 180 jobs at the RUG) and healthcare access caused by the revised higher-education funding model. The minister answered that there is no forced internal reallocation, that RUG funding changes are small (0.0% in 2020-2021, -1.1% in 2022, -0.9% in 2023), that healthcare access is unaffected, and that the government is committed to Groningen's employment and liveability.
It is the responsibility of the institution's board to allocate the government contribution internally.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de instelling om de rijksbijdrage intern te verdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het huisartsentekort in Zeeland

An MP asked the health minister about the shortage of GPs in Zeeland, the insurer's duty of care, whether the NZa will act against the insurer, the GP action plan with the LHV, and the surplus of basic doctors. The minister answered that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care and found no reason to act, that a GP action plan is being implemented with long-term timelines, and that the numerus fixus and training places will be reviewed at the end of the year.
It is not for me, but for the NZa, to assess whether the duty of care is being fulfilled.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de NZa om te beoordelen of aan de zorgplicht wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Ploumen over het faillissement van Huize de Berg

MPs Hijink and Ploumen asked the minister about the bankruptcy of Huize de Berg, a convent whose facilities staff were sold to a commercial group, including whether staff are owed wages and whether a sister company restart is planned. The minister answered that the bankruptcy concerns the hospitality subsidiary, not care provision, that the causes are for the curator to investigate, that workers may claim wage guarantees via UWV, and that Blueprint Group denies planning a restart, and provided an overview of group entities.
From my position I cannot pass judgment on this specific case.
Ik kan vanuit mijn positie geen oordeel vellen over dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Bonden: CAO-actievoerders ziekenhuizen last van intimidatie’

An MP asked the health minister whether hospital employers intimidating staff taking part in CAO strike actions breaches the right to collective action, and what the government would say to such employers. The minister answered that the right to collective action is protected by the European Social Charter, that courts must judge whether it was violated, and that the parties should resume CAO talks.
To what extent there is a violation of this right in this case is for the court to assess.
In hoeverre er in dit geval sprake is van schending van dit recht, is aan de rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over recente berichtgeving rondom SAVE Midden-Nederland en Veilig Thuis

MP Tielen asked about reports that parents involved with SAVE Midden-Nederland and Veilig Thuis feel opposed rather than supported, whether combining the referring body and a certifying institution creates conflicts of interest, and how inspectorates supervise these bodies. The minister acknowledged complaints, said the organisational structure is legally permitted, pointed to shared supervision by the IGJ and Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid, and noted that much of the relevant information is not available centrally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over Wmo indicaties die voor bepaalde tijd gelden

An MP asked the minister about Rucphen municipality issuing time-limited Wmo indications without actively contacting clients for reassessment, risking abrupt end of care. The minister said the law does not prescribe indication duration, that long-term indications should generally be issued for lasting disabilities, that the municipality should proactively inform clients, and that the municipality has been asked to notify clients with pre-2019 indications.
I consider the failure to inform citizens with a chronic condition vulnerable and unacceptable.
Ik vind het niet informeren van burgers met een chronische aandoening kwetsbaar en niet aanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de inspectie van de IGJ bij Stichting OnderDak

MP Kerstens asked the health minister why the inspectorate visited Stichting OnderDak with notice, how representative five client interviews are, why repeated investigations led to no binding consequences, and what lessons are drawn. The minister answered that the visit was pre-announced for practical reasons, the five interviews were an impression rather than a representative sample, the inspectorate ordered improvements with a deadline of 16 September 2019, and it will consider further steps if needed.
The inspectorate has instructed the organisation to draw up an action plan based on the identified shortcomings and to implement improvement measures.
De inspectie heeft opdracht gegeven een plan van aanpak op te stellen op basis van de geconstateerde tekortkomingen en verbetermaatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over Limburgse zorgaanbieders die onterecht miljoenenwinsten opstreken

An MP asked the Minister of Health about Limburg care providers who allegedly earned excessive profits, the delayed financial settlement for 2015-2016, follow-up on about 50 providers, the lawsuits, and transparency towards the Maastricht council. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for oversight and contracting, the council has been informed and is handling it, and that fraud is hard to quantify while the government will report on its anti-fraud programme in September.
Municipalities are responsible for the lawful implementation of the Wmo 2015 and the Youth Act.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de rechtmatige uitvoering van de Wmo 2015 en de Jeugdwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het artikel ‘Zorgfraudeurs hebben vaak al een strafblad’

MPs Rutte and Hermans (VVD) asked the Health Minister about a report linking healthcare fraud to prior criminal records, including how criminal records of care managers are handled in licensing, PGB fraud enforcement, Bibob checks and vetting of managers. The minister says the IKZ findings are valuable, that licensing under the Wtza already allows refusal or revocation based on VOG and Bibob, that the Wtza need not be tightened now, and that the licensing requirement will be extended in a separate future bill.
As indicated in the letter of 9 July 2019, we will in the future further extend the licensing requirement in the Wtza.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 9 juli 2019 2 zullen we de vergunningplicht in de Wtza in de toekomst wel verder uitbreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat Careyn de inspectie op het verkeerde been heeft gezet

An SP MP asks the minister about reports that care provider Careyn misled the health inspectorate (IGJ) during an announced visit to a care home, including whether the inspection's findings on a resident relocation were correctly represented. The minister defends the IGJ's choices on visit setup and scope, states the inspectorate does not verify relocation procedures, and points residents to the provider's complaints procedure.
The IGJ has not checked whether the relocation was carried out correctly. This is not a task of the IGJ.
De IGJ heeft niet getoetst of de verhuizing correct is uitgevoerd. Dit is geen taak van de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Zembla doet onderzoek naar Tuindorp-Oost: Careyn zette inspectie op het verkeerde been’

An MP asked the health minister whether the Inspectorate's announced visit to Careyn's Tuindorp-Oost complex, its limited interviewees and its failure to consult residents and the client council were consistent with its policy on unannounced inspections. The minister defended the visit as a scoped quality-and-safety check, said the Inspectorate chooses its own methods, denied that the Inspectorate endorsed Careyn's decision, and declined to characterise Careyn's conduct.
Supervision is tailor-made. The IGJ weighs in each situation what the right setting is to receive relevant information.
Toezicht is maatwerk. De IGJ maakt in elke situatie de afweging wat de juiste setting is om relevante informatie te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jeugdzorg niet langer verantwoord is

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health about reports that youth care in Twente is no longer responsible, and whether the government will act on regional deficits and the risk that money concerns overshadow care quality. The Minister acknowledges shortages, points to €1.02 billion extra for municipalities, bilateral agreements with the VNG, further research, and procurement support, while stating extra money alone will not solve the problems.
For this reason, the cabinet and the VNG have simultaneously made administrative agreements to make the youth care system function better, more effectively and more efficiently.
Daarom hebben het kabinet en de VNG gelijktijdig bestuurlijke afspraken gemaakt om het jeugdhulpstelsel beter, effectiever en efficiënter te laten functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Drost over de registratie van een levenloos geboren kind na een abortus

MPs Dik-Faber and Drost asked why a stillborn child after abortion could be registered in the Basisregistratie Personen, whether this was foreseen, and how it fits with the law on abortion and the legal status of unborn life. The State Secretary answered that registration follows parents' wishes without conditions, that no legal consequences attach, that the Waz framework is unchanged, and declined to launch a broader societal debate.
I have received similar questions from municipalities and will shortly look into what can be done about this.
Ik heb overigens vergelijkbare vragen ontvangen vanuit gemeenten en zal op korte termijn bekijken wat hieraan gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Hermans over de monitoring van de afschaffing BPM-teruggaaf voor taxi’s en openbaar vervoer

MPs Lodders and Hermans asked the State Secretary of Finance how the monitoring of the abolition of the BPM refund for taxis and public transport (including accessible transport) is being carried out, and about zero-emission vehicle availability, range, weight-related licence issues, and the absence of greening in the 'Iedereen Onderweg' agenda.
