The government answered that monitoring of supply is underway, that zero-emission options exist but are more limited for wheelchair taxis, that the rolstoelbusje refund for care institutions remains, and that greening is already covered by a separate convenant.
For the debate on the Tax Plan 2020, the cabinet will return in more detail to the supply of very low-emission and zero-emission vehicles for targeted transport.
Voor de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2020 komt het kabinet uitgebreider terug op het aanbod van zeer zuinige en emissievrije voertuigen voor doelgroepenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de dyslexieindustrie

Peters (CDA) asks the health and education ministers about the dyslexia diagnosis industry, rising dyslexia certificate numbers, and alleged conflicts of interest at the Nederlands Kwaliteitsinstituut Dyslexie (NKD) and in gatekeeper advice to municipalities. The ministers say diagnosis is guided by a multi-step protocol, that exam-accommodation notifications have fallen since 2016, that the NKD is a private sector body rather than an independent institute, and that further research on dyslexia numbers and municipal spending will be commissioned.
The NKD was established by the sector itself with the aim of safeguarding and promoting the quality of diagnosis and treatment of EED.
Het NKD is door de sector zelf opgericht met als doel het bewaken en bevorderen van de kwaliteit van diagnostiek en behandeling van EED
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over de uitzending Meldpunt van 7 juni 2019 inzake wachtlijsten

Opposition MP Geleijnse asked the Minister of Health about waiting lists for nursing home places raised by a Meldpunt broadcast, including causes, forecasts, real estate, and short-term measures. The minister acknowledged rising waiting lists driven by demographics, listed funding and workforce measures, and largely deferred capacity and real estate questions to a forthcoming letter.
I will ask the Zorginstituut to make these publicly available via their website.
Ik zal het Zorginstituut vragen deze via hun site openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Miljoenen weggesluisd uit thuiszorgorganisatie Privazorg’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that millions were siphoned from home-care provider Privazorg, including the conduct and pay of its former director, and whether the Governance Code and oversight tools are adequate. The minister called the situation unacceptable, said the Governance Code is voluntary and that he is examining stronger internal and external oversight, possibly including legal anchoring of parts of the code, and said there is no current reason to fear for continuity of care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de aanhoudende problemen bij jeugdzorginstelling Juzt

An MP asks the health minister about persistent problems at youth care institution Juzt, including a threatened penalty and whether the relocated youth group is housed in a suitable, safe location. The minister explains the inspectorate imposed a last under penalty, that the group moved to a new house on 27 June, and that the inspectorate found it compliant on 4 July, with the order to be lifted soon.
The IGJ has closely monitored the situation and had various options to force the care provider to deliver good care.
De IGJ heeft de situatie nauwgezet in de gaten gehouden en had verschillende mogelijkheden om de zorgaanbieder te dwingen goede zorg te verlenen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Van Aalst over het mensonterende voorval in Zeist

PVV MPs asked ministers about a degrading incident involving a regional taxi driver filmed on Facebook, and whether low tariffs in insurer tenders cause work pressure. The minister denied a link to tariffs, said the contract with the province of Utrecht sets realistic rates and quality requirements, and will ask the NZa to explore the issue with stakeholders.
For that reason he will ask the NZa to carry out an exploration by talking with all parties (insurers, taxi unions and patient associations) about the possible problems.
Om die reden zal hij aan de NZa vragen om een verkenning uit te voeren door met alle partijen (verzekeraars, taxibonden en patiëntenverenigingen) in gesprek te gaan over de mogelijke problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het aanbieden van scholing over euthanasie bij psychiatrie door het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie van de Levenseindekliniek

An MP asked the Minister of Health about euthanasia training for psychiatrists offered by the Levenseindekliniek, the NVvP guideline on euthanasia in psychiatry, and whether psychiatrists should engage more with such requests. The Minister answered that the profession is responsible for training and guidelines, pointed to existing NVvP training and dissemination, said it is too early to measure referral effects, and promised a study of psychiatric euthanasia requests reported in early 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over de voorgenomen uitbreiding van een geitenhouderij in Hurwenen

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the expansion of a goat farm in Hurwenen from 7,000 to over 13,000 goats was acceptable, given a RIVM link to pneumonia risk, and whether the minister would impose a national expansion ban or intervene in this case. The minister replied that land-use and environmental decisions rest with municipalities and provinces, that a flawed permit application led to the permit being granted by operation of law, that follow-up health research is expected in 2021, and that no national ban is being considered.
The municipality concerned acknowledged, according to the Zembla broadcast, that the permit application was not handled properly and that errors were made.
De betreffende gemeente heeft, blijkens de uitzending van het programma Zembla, erkend dat op de vergunningaanvraag niet goed is gereageerd en dat er fouten zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht 'Menzis eist 6 ton van zorgbureau Care Free Twente'

MPs Van den Berg and Geluk-Poortvliet asked the health minister about Menzis's fraud investigation into care agency Care Free Twente, including whether insurers and municipalities check that staff are qualified. The minister confirmed the investigation, described the findings (90 percent unqualified staff and incorrect declarations), explained the insurer's statutory controls, and noted that municipalities set their own contract conditions.
Supervision under the Wkkgz is assigned to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate.
Het toezicht op de Wkkgz is belegd bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over gemeenten die zich niet aan de AMvB reële prijs houden

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the health minister why many municipalities do not apply the AMvB reële prijs, so care providers cannot pay staff under the VVT collective agreement, and about the state of tariff adjustments. The minister disputes the claim that half of municipalities fail, cites a limited number of investigated complaints, acknowledges indexation difficulties, and points to sector agreements on national indexation guidelines and a forthcoming evaluation.
I do note that indexation is a frequently occurring point of discussion between providers and municipalities.
Ik constateer wel dat indexatie een veel voorkomend punt van discussie is tussen aanbieders en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over bureaucratie in de jeugdzorg

MP Westerveld asks the Minister of Health about reports that youth-care negotiations with municipalities focus on money, procurement burdens absorbing budget in municipal bureaucracy, and staffing and administrative costs. The minister denies that discussions only concern money, acknowledges procurement burdens, points to extra funding and planned VNG agreements, but declines to provide municipal staffing figures and defers that responsibility to municipalities.
No. This is a responsibility of individual municipalities.
Neen. Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van individuele gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over de VPRO-serie ‘Uitgewoond’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Health about a VPRO documentary on forced relocations of nursing home residents, including the Inspectorate's involvement, whether it should be notified early of relocations, and how residents and client councils should be involved. The minister agreed to commission research on the effects of relocations via SANO, stated the Inspectorate had reviewed the case and found sufficient care by the provider, and declined to involve the Inspectorate in every relocation.
No. It is the responsibility of a care provider to provide good, person-centred and safe care, including during a relocation.
Nee. Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van een zorgaanbieder om goede, persoonsgerichte en veilige zorg te geven, ook bij een verhuizing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over te dure huurwoningen voor zorgcliënten in Zwolle

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked whether the government knows of care clients forced to move because their rent is too high for their income in Zwolle, and whether rent for care housing is monitored. The minister replied that she had no such signals, explained the tenancy protection rules for care housing, said rent is not monitored against client income, and will await the municipality's study before considering further steps.
No, rent is not supervised in relation to the income of tenants (who may also be care clients).
Nee, op huurprijzen wordt geen toezicht gehouden in relatie tot het inkomen van huurders
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Snels over het bericht dat het kabinet €2 miljard per jaar kan besparen op diabeteszorg (voor type 2) door betere, meer duurzame en goedkopere diabeteszorg

Greens MPs Ellemeet and Snels asked whether the government would pursue lifestyle medicine and demedicalisation to cut type 2 diabetes costs, and how this fits budget rules and prevention commitments. The minister responded that lifestyle interventions can help but their savings are not yet proven, pointed to a ZonMw research programme of 1 million euro, said GLI is in the basic package and expects further steps via the Preventieakkoord, and promised an inventory with stakeholders by year end.
I want to work with relevant field parties to inventory why certain lifestyle interventions (e.g. interventions for diabetes) are not getting off the ground or are not being scaled up.
Ik wil samen met betrokken veldpartijen inventariseren waarom bepaalde leefstijlinterventies (bijv. interventies bij diabetes) niet van de grond komen of niet worden opgeschaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over bodyguards die nodig zijn om vrouwen te begeleiden naar een abortuskliniek

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the health minister about volunteer bodyguards escorting women to abortion clinics and whether the government will act against increasingly militant anti-abortion demonstrators. The minister said the initiative is lawful, that protecting women is a matter for mayors, and that measures depend on local circumstances; he pointed to a recent letter and a debate instead of new measures.
Whether measures are necessary and justified depends on all relevant facts and (local) circumstances, and is therefore an assessment that can only be made locally by the mayor.

Of maatregelen noodzakelijk en gerechtvaardigd zijn, is afhankelijk van alle relevante feiten en (plaatselijke) omstandigheden, en daarmee een beoordeling die alleen lokaal door de burgemeester kan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met de toekenning van de kwaliteitsgelden verpleeghuiszorg

An SP MP asked the health minister about nursing-home quality funds: whether an organisation that hired staff in 2018 in anticipation was wrongly denied 2019 quality money, and whether the rules force cutbacks. The minister answered that the funds were properly allocated, the 2019 budget was granted, and that 2020 rules allow case-by-case deviation, with the health insurer's office to discuss a solution.
See answer 3. The administrative agreements on the 2020 quality budget give the health insurance office more room for tailored solutions.
Zie antwoord 3. De bestuurlijke afspraken over het kwaliteitsbudget 2020 bieden het zorgkantoor meer ruimte voor maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over het bericht dat de doorstroming vanuit de vrouwenopvang naar huurwoningen problematisch verloopt

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked about reports that women leaving shelters struggle to move into rental housing, and about the Ombudsman's findings on shelter bottlenecks and clawed-back rent allowance. The Minister acknowledges local housing shortages, points to existing priority rules for shelter residents and to ongoing working groups and a commitment to inform parliament, while stating there is no national picture of shelter place shortages and that municipalities are responsible.
There is no national picture of the (possible) shortages of shelter places in women's shelters.
Er is geen landelijk beeld van de (eventuele) tekorten aan opvangplekken in de vrouwenopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ondervoeding bij thuiswonende ouderen

An MP asked the health and education ministers about malnutrition among community-dwelling elderly and whether screening, training and GP guidance should be strengthened. The minister said prevention is shared with carers and professionals, pointed to existing tools and education modules, and declined to mandate structural screening or GP checks.
However, I will raise attention to these education modules in consultations with representatives of relevant training programmes.
Wel zal ik in overleggen met de vertegenwoordigers van relevante opleidingen aandacht vragen voor deze onderwijsmodules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het recht tot zelfbeschikking van intersekse baby’s en kinderen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about UN Committee against Torture recommendations on intersex children's bodily autonomy, prevalence, unnecessary surgery, and parental consent. Minister Bruins answered that medical decisions rest with professionals, that no IGJ reports of non-consensual procedures are known, that research is insufficient, and that a quality standard for intersex/DSD care is being developed.
I therefore cannot confirm that there are intersex babies and children in the Netherlands who have undergone a non-medically necessary procedure without informed consent.
Ik kan dan ook niet bevestigen dat er intersekse baby's en kinderen zijn in Nederland die zonder dat er sprake is van informed consent een niet-medisch noodzakelijke ingreep hebben ondergaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatie-armoede in Nederland

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked whether period poverty, the inability to afford menstrual products, occurs in the Netherlands and whether the government would investigate it. The state secretary replied that there is no evidence yet, that the feminist platform De Bovengrondse is researching it with results due in August, and that the government will decide on further steps after those results.
On the basis of the outcomes we will determine whether and which further steps are necessary or desirable.
Op basis van de uitkomsten zullen wij bepalen of en welke verdere stappen nodig dan wel wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de bekostiging van Plusopvang vanuit de Jeugdwet

MP Peters asks whether municipalities may use Youth Act funds for free Plusopvang (special after-school care with extra support) and whether this may increase demand, while parents in regular BSO pay themselves. Minister De Jonge answers that municipalities have discretion under the Youth Act, that such use is not contrary to the law, that free provision likely raises demand, and that no figures on the number of municipalities or children are kept.
It is not contrary to the Youth Act for a municipality to use funds for such Plusopvang.
Het is niet strijdig met de Jeugdwet dat een gemeente middelen inzet voor een dergelijke plusopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten ‘Enschedese zorgbureau Samen Sterk speelde bank voor familie en bekenden’ en ‘Zorggeld lenen aan familie: het mag van de Twentse gemeenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that care providers in Enschede lent care funds to relatives and acquaintances, and whether municipalities can exclude such providers. The Minister called this undesirable, said he had no oversight data but saw no reason to investigate, and said municipalities have existing powers under the Wmo 2015 and the contract was terminated, so no further action is planned.
I have no insight into this, but I have no reason to assume this is a common practice.
Ik heb hier geen zicht op, maar ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat dit een gangbare praktijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over een zorgorganisatie die leningen verstrekt

An MP asked the health minister whether care organisations may lend money or invest their revenue, whether youth-care funds reach care, and why problems at a Twente care provider surfaced only at the annual accounts stage. The minister confirmed no legal bar exists on such activities for Wmo providers, pointed to municipalities for contract and quality criteria, and said the regional partnership terminated the contract on advice, so no further action is planned.
I therefore see no reason to take further action.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om verdere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de extra inzet van Twentse gemeenten om foute zorgbureaus op te sporen

An MP asked the minister about Twente municipalities' traffic-light model flagging 64 of over 300 contracted care providers as red, the low share fully in order, and whether pre-contract controls should be strengthened, including under open-house contracting. The minister says the red providers will be investigated before conclusions are drawn, supports pre-contract control in principle, and agrees to talks with the VNG and municipal partnerships.
Yes, I am willing to do that.
Ja, daar ben ik toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over aanbestedingen in het sociaal domein

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the high share of social-domain care contracts awarded outside EU procurement rules, whether the Aanbestedingswet should change, why the Netherlands has no simplified national procedure, and what uniform tariffs or procedures the state could impose. The minister answered that municipalities choose their own instruments, that the light regime for social services is hard to apply, that the state is pursuing an EU-level evaluation of the directive, and that it is supporting municipalities through guidance, training and dialogue rather than a single national procedure.
That is why I am pursuing an evaluation of the procurement directive in Brussels.
Daarom zet ik in Brussel in op een evaluatie van de aanbestedingsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over berichten dat foute zorgondernemers makkelijk door aanbestedingsprocedures komen

An MP asked the health minister whether fraudulent care providers can easily win new contracts after aanbesteding, given differing municipal rules in the Twente region. The minister acknowledged the fraud problem, pointed to a planned bill creating a warning register and information-sharing hub for care fraud, and said municipalities are responsible for contracting, with a VNG support programme and Twente toolbox as tools.
Therefore I am preparing legislation to improve cooperation between different bodies in tackling care fraud.
Daarom bereid ik wetgeving voor om de samenwerking tussen verschillende instanties bij het aanpakken van zorgfraude te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsinformatie voor mensen met een auditieve beperking ook in crisissituaties

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about whether government information during crises is accessible to people with hearing impairments, citing an EU resolution, the UN disability convention and a WODC study. The ministers listed steps taken on NL-Alert channels and promised a plan of action on crisis communication for deaf and hard-of-hearing people to be sent to parliament after the summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van der Molen en Van Dam over de inzet van een gebarentolk bij crisiscommunicatie door de overheid en bij persconferenties van de overheid

CDA MPs asked whether sign-language interpreters should be used in government crisis communication and press conferences, after the Utrecht attack gave deaf people no interpretation. The ministers answered that a plan of action will be sent to parliament after the summer, that transcripts of post-cabinet press conferences are published, and that the government does not consider the UN disability convention breached.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jongeren die grensoverschrijdend gedrag vertonen niet worden behandeld

MP Kuiken asked whether a national overview exists of young people with risky behaviour who go untreated, despite court orders, and whether the government will act on municipalities' funding requests. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that waiting lists are being tackled regionally, and that extra funds for youth care were allocated, with a progress report promised.
To ensure that rulings on this component are actually carried out, the Youth Act obliges municipalities to deploy the youth assistance that a judge deems necessary.
Om te verzekeren dat vonnissen op dit onderdeel daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd, verplicht de Jeugdwet gemeenten de jeugdhulp die een rechter nodig acht, in te zetten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van Wijngaarden en Laan-Geselschap over de berichten ‘Tientallen jongeren met grensoverschrijdend gedrag worden niet behandeld’ en ‘Aanhoudingen in Rotterdam voor groepsverkrachtin

Three VVD MPs asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and Health about press reports on untreated youths with sexual boundary-crossing behaviour and group rape by minors in Rotterdam. The government answered that trends in juvenile sex offending are falling, that municipalities are responsible for youth care ordered by courts, and that financial shortfall does not exempt municipalities from their duty.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for the provision of youth care. Financial shortage does not release municipalities from their youth care obligation.
Op grond van de Jeugdwet zijn gemeenten verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de jeugdhulp. Financiële krapte ontslaat gemeenten niet van hun jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht ‘Opnieuw datalek in Utrechtse Jeugdzorg’

An MP asked the health minister about a data leak at the Utrecht youth care sector: a test website of the professional register SKJ wrongly published 34 non-anonymised disciplinary decisions, and whether the government will strengthen cybersecurity across healthcare. The minister acknowledges the leak as undesirable, reports steps including pen-tests, an IGJ inspection and a Jeugdzorg Nederland review, and promises a separate letter on information security in September.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een ALS-patiënt een rekening van € 20.000 heeft moeten betalen door een fout van het zorgkantoor

MP Hijink asked the minister to respond to a case where an ALS patient received a EUR 20,000 bill from the CAK because a care office reported her care late, and asked about the scale of such stacked bills and remedies. The minister acknowledged the delayed data and said he shortened the period for initial levies, ordered data-matching checks, and plans further measures, though he did not provide a breakdown by responsible party.
I have shortened the period within which the CAK may impose an initial levy of the personal contribution from 36 to 12 months.
Ik heb de termijn waarover het CAK een initiële oplegging van de eigen bijdrage mag opleggen verkort van 36 naar 12 maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over de VPROserie ‘Uitgewoond’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about a VPRO series on elderly residents of De Drie Hoven forced to relocate, covering transfer rules, care standards, oversight, and planning of nursing capacity. The minister answered that the inspectorate found the move handled correctly, that existing quality standards suffice, and promised further research and a report by year end on building condition and capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Dunya Zorggroep weigert dossiers te verstrekken na beslag: ‘Ik ben bang dat er mensen gaan sterven’

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Health whether it is unacceptable that Dunya Zorggroep refused to transfer patient files after seizure, what powers the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) has to enforce transfer, whether it has been enforced, whether sanctions were imposed, and how often such situations occur. The minister answered that the IGJ issued an order and instruction, then a penalty payment order with a two-day compliance period, is monitoring closely, and that the situation is exceptional.
The IGJ first issued an order and then gave an instruction to the care provider to enforce a careful transfer of the client files.
De IGJ heeft eerst een bevel opgelegd en daarna een aanwijzing gegeven aan de zorgaanbieder om een zorgvuldige overdracht van de cliëntdossiers af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'De jacht op het 'zelfdodingspoeder' gaat door, maar nu ondergronds'

MP Tellegen asks the health minister about reports that people seek a suicide agent illegally and about a survey by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil. The minister calls the cooperative's earlier plans undesirable, says suicide should be prevented, points to the Wtl as the legal framework, and announces a study into people wishing to end life outside that framework.
That is why I have started a study into the size and circumstances of this group.
Daarom heb ik een onderzoek naar de omvang en omstandigheden van deze groep gestart
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de te lange wachtlijsten in de transgenderzorg

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about long waiting lists in gender-affirming care, including Amsterdam UMC's waiting times, staffing shortages, a planned Radboud UMC youth service, and a priority scheme for trans youth. The minister acknowledged the waits are undesirable, pointed to a navigator (kwartiermaker) advisory process and capacity expansions, and left prioritisation largely to insurers and providers.
I too find the long waiting lists for gender-affirming care undesirable.
Ook ik vind de lange wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de jeugdzorginstelling Elker – het Poortje

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister about budget cuts and job losses at youth care provider Elker – het Poortje in Groningen and Drenthe, and the risks for suicidal and vulnerable youths. The minister answered that a mediation process is ongoing under the support team OZJ, that municipalities hold the youth care duty, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and a dispute committee exist, with a 20 million euro liquidity facility, but gave no concrete rescue plan or contingency document.
Municipalities are responsible for youth care and have a youth care duty.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp en hebben een jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over woonvormen voor dementerenden

An MP asked the ministers about shortages of suitable housing for seniors and people with dementia, whether government will stimulate initiatives like those in the Aedes agenda, and whether lessons from Germany will be applied. The minister answered that existing programmes (Woonagenda, Langer thuis) support housing and care for older people, that support is available, and that the government does not itself initiate such housing forms, without committing to new binding agreements.
Municipalities are encouraged to map the challenge of housing and care for older people and to make a plan to ensure people do not end up living unsuitably.
Gemeenten worden gestimuleerd om de opgave met betrekking tot wonen en zorg voor ouderen in beeld te brengen en een plan te maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de brandbrief van de Raad van Toezicht van jeugdzorginstelling Elker – het Poortje

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister about the board of Elker – het Poortje's warning that youth care institutions can no longer provide good care, and about financial shortfalls and lack of coordination in the youth care transition. The minister acknowledged the signals, pointed to a mediation track with regional bodies, extra municipal funding and the Jeugdautoriteit, but did not commit to a new concrete intervention beyond monitoring.
It is a worrying signal and it has my explicit attention.
Het is een zorgelijk signaal en het heeft nadrukkelijk mijn aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Idealistische' zorgbaas De Blok sluist miljoenen naar eigen bv’s van RTL-Z

An MP asks the health minister whether Buurtzorg's CEO routing public care funds to his own companies is consistent with earlier inspection findings and the governance code, and whether laws should change. The minister says the inspectorate found no grounds for enforcement, the situation is not comparable to Alliade, and he will examine possible new statutory powers for external supervision and inform parliament around summer.
In consultation with the NZa and IGJ, I am examining how this can be given further substance and whether, and if so which, additional statutory provisions are desirable.
In overleg met de NZa en IGJ bekijk ik hoe daar nadere invulling aan kan worden gegeven en onderzoek ik of, en zo ja, welke aanvullende wettelijke bepalingen wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met de indicatie voor ernstig zieke kinderen

MP Hijink asked the ministers whether health insurers frustrate indication and re-indication for seriously ill children, shorten indication periods, push children toward Wlz or municipalities, pressure nurses to reduce hours, and why the denktank on children with intensive care needs was dissolved. Minister De Jonge stated that the child nurse decides indication, insurers have a legal role to check lawfulness, individual cases are not commented on, and he will discuss indication issues with care parties under the 2019-2022 agreement.
In answering parliamentary questions I do not go into individual case details.
In beantwoording van Kamervragen ga ik niet in op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Bruins Slot over de algemene ledenvergadering van de Koninklijke Bond van Oranjeverenigingen en het manifest ‘Versterk vrijwilligerswerk’

MPs Bruins Slot and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about the Koninklijke Bond van Oranjeverenigingen's manifesto on volunteering, including regulatory burden, asylum-seeker volunteering, training, municipal subsidy rules and event bureaucracy. The government supports the goals and the activities of Oranjeverenigingen, declines to abolish the volunteer declaration or change several rules, promises to examine further reductions in event regulation, and answered the final question (on Koningsdag 2019) as not answered in time.
The cabinet is also exploring other options to further reduce the regulatory burden of organising events.
Het kabinet onderzoekt daarnaast andere mogelijkheden om de regeldruk bij het organiseren van evenementen verder te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het feit dat het aantal jeugdzorg klachten in Den Haag is verdubbeld

An MP asks the minister about the doubling of youth care complaints handled by the Hague youth ombudsman, under-reporting by vulnerable youth, waiting lists, administrative burden and whether the Hague municipality will be engaged. The minister says the rise may reflect growing awareness of the ombudsman, plans to lower barriers and tackle waiting times regionally, and that the issues are not specific to The Hague.
I believe the threshold for approaching the Youth Ombudsman should be as low as possible.
Ik vind dat de drempel richting de Jeugdombudsman zo laag mogelijk moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat een niet-bewezen effectieve therapie bij ADHD wel door zorgverzekeraars vergoed wordt

MPs Raemakers and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers whether insurers, municipalities and UWV fund horse therapy for ADHD and other treatments not proven effective. The minister replied that such therapy is outside the basic package, that insurers set their own supplementary coverage, that UWV buys horse-coaching as Werk-Fit activation with success monitoring, and that the Jeugdwet and PGB rules apply to municipalities without a full list of funded treatments.
We therefore do not have a (complete) overview of which treatments or therapies are reimbursed from the supplementary package.
Wij beschikken dan ook niet over een (totaal)overzicht van welke behandelingen of therapieën uit het aanvullende pakket vergoed worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over zorginstellingen die ten onterechte kosten in rekening brengen voor het opbaren van overledenen

An SP MP asks whether care homes may charge relatives for laying out deceased residents in their rooms, whether this should be banned or regulated by the NZa, and whether the 13-day vacancy allowance should be extended. The minister says laying-out costs fall outside the Wmg and NZa regulation, that no ban or new rules are planned, and that ActiZ will be asked to improve communication with relatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over berichten dat een directeur ruim €1,5 miljoen aan zorggeld heeft vergokt

Opposition MP Hijink asked the minister to respond to reports that a care-agency director in Almelo gambled over EUR 1.5 million of care funds, and asked about inspection, municipal oversight and the handling of the case. The minister said the matter is under criminal investigation and that recovery lies with the municipality, defended the municipalities' tendering and oversight, and promised to keep the Chamber informed.
Given the confidentiality of the investigation, I cannot comment on its content or progress.
Gezien de vertrouwelijkheid van het onderzoek, kan ik over de inhoud en het verloop ervan geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Kops over het bericht dat een bejaard Nieuwegeins stel dat al vanwege huisuitzetting uit het leven wilde stappen vrijdag opnieuw op straat staat

MPs Agema and Kops asked about an elderly Nieuwegein couple facing eviction and homelessness, questioning priority for status holders in social housing and the closure of care home places. The minister rejected the link to status holders, stated that no one should have to live on the street, and said the couple had found temporary housing.
The couple has thus not ended up on the street.
Het echtpaar is daarmee niet op straat komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Avirazorg mag van inspectie geen cliënten meer aannemen, maar gaat door onder andere naam’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that home-care provider Avirazorg, barred by the inspectorate from taking new clients, continued under another name, and about overlapping board members across regional care providers. The minister called the situation undesirable, said the provider has now ceased and the inspectorate is considering further steps, and described the inspectorate's supervision approach for home care.
If care is in fact organised in the same way, I consider that undesirable.
Als de zorg feitelijk op dezelfde manier is georganiseerd, dan vind ik dat onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat private equity goed is voor recordaantal overnames in Nederlandse zorg

An MP asked the health minister about private equity-backed takeovers in Dutch elder care, including Korian's planned acquisition of Stepping Stones, rental and service fees, the role of the NZa and IGJ, and whether the NZa should be able to review such takeovers. The minister said the government is studying how to tighten merger oversight for care and will inform parliament before summer, while stating the inspectorate's role is to check care quality against legal standards.
I aim to inform the House about this before the summer.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hier voor de zomer over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Directeur Victorie vergokte ruim 1,5 miljoen euro zorggeld in Enschedees casino'

The PVV MP Agema asked the Minister of Health about reports that the director of a care provider in Almelo gambled over 1.5 million euros of care funds in a casino over five years, asking how this could happen and how the money would be recovered. The minister called it shocking, explained that the municipality and the Social Investigation Service Twente investigated, that the provider lost its contract, that the municipality filed a fraud report, and that recovery of the money is the municipality's responsibility and still being pursued.
The responsibility for recovering the 1.5 million euros of care funds lies with the municipality of Almelo.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het terughalen van de 1,5 miljoen euro aan zorggeld ligt bij de gemeente Almelo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over een Frans beursfonds dat toetreedt in de Nederlandse zorg

MP Hijink asks the health minister about French listed funds investing in Dutch commercial elderly care, whether charging residents high rent and service costs while care is reimbursed is desirable, and whether profit distribution via separate property and care companies amounts to disguised profit-making nursing homes, and asks for investigation and a ban. The minister says care access and quality come first, that separating housing and care costs is possible, and that studies on profit distribution will be shared before summer.
We aim to inform your House before the summer about the outcomes of these studies and the conclusions we draw from them.
Wij streven ernaar uw Kamer voor de zomer over te informeren over de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken en de conclusies die we daaraan verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de zaak Tuitjenhorn

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about the Tuitjenhorn case, including the Inspectorate's court challenge over a documentary, the naming of inspectors, its handling of the Council of State ruling, and whether GPs can practise without fear of orders. The Minister defended the Inspectorate, noting it accepted the ruling, apologised, and that an independent commission found its conduct largely sound.
The inspectorate accepted the Council of State's ruling of 1 June 2016 and has drawn lessons from it.
De inspectie heeft de uitspraak van de Raad van State van 1 juni 2016 aanvaard en heeft hier lering uit getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Wetenschappelijke studie laat zien: hoe sterker de wiet, des te groter de kans op psychose'

An MP asked the ministers how a study linking cannabis potency to psychosis risk affects care, prevention policy, THC limits for the cannabis experiment and the definition of softdrugs. The minister answered that the causal link is contested, that care aims to stop cannabis use, that labelling and information requirements are being set for coffeeshops, and that no upper THC limit is set for now pending more research.
Partly on the basis of the Knottnerus committee's advice, we for now set no upper limit on the THC content of Dutch cannabis and hashish to be produced within the closed coffeeshop experiment.

Mede op basis van het advies van de commissie Knottnerus in deze, stellen wij vooralsnog geen bovengrens aan het THC-gehalte van Nederwiet en Nederhasj die in het kader van het experiment gesloten coffeeshopketen zal worden geproduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het faillissement van zorginstelling Siza Nova Me

An MP asked the health minister about the bankruptcy of care provider Siza Nova Me, the managing director's 'brilliant failure' remark, whether the ministry would investigate, and whether the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders would prevent similar cases. The minister said the curator is responsible for investigating the causes, that the ministry sees no reason for its own investigation, and that the bill does not assess business cases.
I see no reason to conduct independent investigation of this bankruptcy in addition to the curator's investigation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om in aanvulling op het onderzoek door de curator eigenstandig onderzoek te doen naar dit faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Bergkamp en Raemakers over het niet van de grond komen van projecten die over schotten heen werken

MPs Diertens, Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about the Nova Me care initiative that collapsed over funding divides between care domains, and about budgets and the Wlz experiment article. The minister answered that no funding is earmarked for the experiment article, that VGZ found the care not suitable, and declined to convene a dedicated meeting on lessons learned.
I have no insight into the amount of money that parties in daily practice invest in realising appropriate cross-domain care for clients.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid geld die er in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt geïnvesteerd door partijen om passend aanbod over domeinen heen voor cliënten te realiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Middendorp over de artikelen ‘Molly Russell’s father: cutting, biting, burning — my daughter was shown it all on social media’ en ‘You have amazing ability, Damian Hinds tells te

Two MPs asked the government about UK press reports on the death of a teenager linked to social media content, whether similar Dutch cases are known, whether Dutch research on social media and suicide will be undertaken, and what action will be taken. The minister said no Dutch data on causes of suicide are kept, a 113 Suicide Prevention study on 2017 youth suicides is underway with results expected at year end, and pointed to EU audiovisual rules, media literacy in the curriculum and existing support networks.
In the Netherlands no data are kept on the causes of suicide.
In Nederland worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over de oorzaken van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het monddood maken van de sociaal domein cliëntenraad in Eindhoven

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether dismissals of five critical members of the Eindhoven social domain client council amounted to silencing the council and whether monitoring of municipal client councils was planned. The minister said the dismissals were reviewed by an independent objections committee which found them justified, described the municipality's clearer mandate for the council, and saw no reason for action.
I contacted the municipality of Eindhoven to inform myself about the situation.
Ik heb contact opgenomen met de gemeente Eindhoven om mij te informeren over de situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het lastig vallen van vrouwen bij abortusklinieken door anti-abortusdemonstranten

An MP asked the health minister about anti-abortion demonstrators harassing women at abortion clinics, including Rotterdam and Utrecht, and whether the government would protect access via buffer zones. The minister said demonstrations are primarily a municipal responsibility, that buffer zones may be a legitimate option decided locally by mayors, and that he will convene municipalities and clinics before the summer recess.
It is primarily up to municipalities to steer demonstrations in the right direction, as I also indicated in my earlier committee letter and answers to parliamentary questions on this matter.
Het is primair aan gemeenten om demonstraties in goede banen te leiden, zoals ik ook aangaf in mijn eerdere commissiebrief en beantwoording van de Kamervragen hierover
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht  dat dagbesteding voor gehandicapten onder druk staat (ingezonden 4 april 2019)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that day-care services for disabled people are under pressure, with shrinking choice, closures and cuts, and whether client input and choice are being respected. The Minister acknowledged the findings, said the statutory guarantees remain, outlined a transport budget increase and NZa rule adjustment, and listed programmes to strengthen client control and independent client support.
The renewal of long-term care has not detracted from the principle that people who depend on care must receive it.
Met de vernieuwing van de langdurige zorg is geen afbreuk gedaan aan het uitgangspunt dat mensen die zijn aangewezen op zorg, deze ook moeten krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat het ministerie van VWS de grootste stijging aan communicatiemedewerkers van alle ministeries heeft

An MP asked the Minister of VWS about the growth in communications staff at the ministry, its costs, campaigns on healthcare, and whether staff are used for party-political election activities. The government answered that staff work on policy communication, the growth was driven by public engagement needs, and election-campaign use is ruled out, while providing figures and campaign overviews.
No. The communications staff of VWS work on communication about policy, not on election activities.
Antwoord 18 De communicatiemedewerkers van VWS werken aan communicatie over beleid, niet aan verkiezingsactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Klachten over Tuindorp-Oost gegrond: onzorgvuldig, onfatsoenlijk, geen compassie’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the Careyn complaints committee's harsh finding on the relocation of Tuindorp-Oost residents, and related Zembla reporting, indicate a pattern and what the minister thinks of it. The minister said care providers must show compassion and careful relocation support, that he has no role in individual complaints, and that IGJ inspections found no broader pattern, with the enforcement order already lifted.
I have no indications that the actions of Careyn about which the complaint was filed are part of a broader pattern.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de handelingen van Careyn waarover de klacht is ingediend, onderdeel zijn van een breder patroon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat toezichthouders een rem willen op BV-constructies

PvdA MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Health whether opaque financial BV structures in healthcare, which the NVTZ and others say hamper supervision, should be curbed and what tools IGJ and NZa have. The minister acknowledges the problem, promises to strengthen external oversight of business operations and inform parliament around summer, notes existing WTZi rules and the TIB programme, but defends such structures as sometimes legitimate.
As indicated, I am therefore working together with the IGJ and NZa on further strengthening the supervision of the business operations of healthcare providers.
Zoals aangegeven werk ik daarom samen met de IGJ en NZa aan het verder versterken van het toezicht op de bedrijfsvoering van zorgaanbieders.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het gevaar dat het goede werk dat Nierteam aan Huis voor nierpatiënten verricht, mogelijk moet worden stopgezet vanwege lange beoordelingstermijnen bij de Nederlandse Zorg

An MP asked the minister whether the Nierteam aan Huis project, now funded by insurers and the Kidney Foundation, can be added to regular care reimbursement despite long assessment times at the NZa, and whether bridge funding will be provided. The minister answered that the NZa's timelines are being discussed, that the NZa will look at speeding up its process, and that bridge funding will be explored with insurers in 2020.
I will discuss with ZN the possibilities for bridge funding in 2020.
Ik zal met ZN in gesprek gaan over mogelijkheden voor overbruggingsfinanciering in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over hoe de vergoeding en het leveren van palliatieve (terminale) zorg nog altijd niet goed loopt

MP Bergkamp (D66) asks why palliative terminal care delivered on a nurse's indication is still not fully reimbursed, why uncontracted care faces lower reimbursement and authorisation requirements, and what is being done about the 24-hour care issue. Minister De Jonge answers that contracted care is fully reimbursed, that wait times for contracted palliative care are short, that the authorisation procedure should be fast, and that ministry talks with VVN and ZN on indication ambiguities are ongoing.
I regret it if the farewell of a dying person is burdened by financial or administrative hassles.
Ik betreur het als het afscheid van een stervende wordt verzwaard door financiële of administratieve beslommeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over noodzakelijke terminale zorg die niet altijd vergoed wordt door zorgverzekeraars

An SP MP asks the health minister why insurers reimburse only part of the palliative care nurses deem necessary, why home-care organisations cannot always deliver it, and whether insurers are overriding professional indications. The minister responds that contracted care is fully reimbursed, that insurers use authorisation (machtiging) requirements only for non-contracted care under statutory review duties, and that insurers deny allegations of indication-cutting targets and of capping hours.
Health insurers have the statutory task under the Health Insurance Act to check the lawfulness and efficiency of care.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben in de Zorgverzekeringswet de wettelijke taak om de rechtmatigheid en doelmatigheid van de zorg te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat private equity goed is voor recordaantal overnames in Nederlandse zorg

Member Slootweg (CDA) asked the health minister about reports that private equity overseas acquisitions in Dutch healthcare hit a record, including transaction volumes, foreign buyer shares, quality, staffing, real estate and patient selection. The minister answered that the NZa reviewed 167 concentrations in 2018 (four with foreign parties), that quality rules and IGJ supervision apply regardless of ownership, and that he has no concrete signals of risk selection or market power abuse, while stating he lacks data on several points.
When asked, the NZa does not have exact information on the transaction sums or on the involvement of private equity parties, which can be both Dutch and foreign.
Desgevraagd heeft de NZa geen exacte informatie over de transactiesommen en over de betrokkenheid van private equity partijen, die zowel Nederlands als buitenlands kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat tarieven in de jeugd-ggz niet kostendekkend zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether youth mental health care tariffs fail to cover costs, with a majority of providers reporting losses averaging 3%, and what steps will address it. The minister replied that tariffs are a matter for municipalities and providers in a decentralised system, pointed to existing support bodies, a dispute committee and a Youth Authority, and said he takes the issue seriously without committing to new measures.
Providers' executives are primarily responsible for the management of their organisations.
Bestuurders van aanbieders zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsvoering van hun organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over facturen van het CAK

An SP MP asked the health minister why CAK invoices showed very high total care costs, such as nearly €97,000 for household help and €34,800 for a handbike, and whether these should be removed. The minister explained that these are theoretical total costs shown only on request in itemised invoices, not the actual co-payments, apologised, and agreed to stop showing full care costs on invoices.
I have decided, in consultation with CAK and ZN, to no longer show the full amounts of care costs on the invoice.
Ik heb in overleg met CAK en ZN besloten om de volledige bedragen van de kosten van zorg niet meer op de factuur te vermelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over toegang tot zorg voor dementerende ouderen met een migratieachtergrond

An MP from the PvdA asked the health minister about access to care for elderly migrant dementia patients, including whether they stay at home too long and whether culture-specific nursing home care is adequate. The minister answered that no broad campaign is planned, that a Noom guideline for culture-specific nursing care will be added to the 'Thuis in het verpleeghuis' programme per an adopted motion, and that a SCP study will report in 2021.
The motion's intent is that the guideline be added to the 'Thuis in het verpleeghuis' programme.
De motie heeft als strekking dat de leidraad aan het programma «Thuis in het verpleeghuis» wordt toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht dat maagdenvlieshersteloperaties in Nederlandse klinieken worden uitgevoerd

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health whether he was aware of reports that hymen-restoration operations are performed in Dutch clinics, what he thought of it, and what steps he would take against clinics, better inform young women, and protect them. The minister called such operations unacceptable, said he is talking with doctors and the inspectorate and will study the possibility of a ban, reporting results before year end.

I am in talks with doctors, among other things about using the domestic violence and child abuse reporting code, and I will talk with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate about how they can tighten supervision if needed

Ik ben in gesprek met artsen onder andere over het gebruik van de meldcode huiselijke geweld en kindermishandeling, ga ik in gesprek met de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd hoe zij het toezicht aan kunnen scherpen als dit nodig is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht ‘Ook asielzoeker krijgt hulp bij eerwraak’

MPs Becker and Tielen asked the government about reports of honour-based violence and threats against asylum seekers in reception centres, including how many cases were recorded, whether perpetrators were removed, and whether residence permits were revoked. The State Secretary answered that COA-registration is limited for safety reasons, that perpetrators can be moved to an EBTL and victims to women's shelters, and that the government will audit social safety in late 2019 and agree with municipalities to fund shelter access for victims awaiting residence decisions.
Quantitative information on the number of reports made to Veilig Thuis is currently not available.
Kwantitatieve informatie omtrent het aantal meldingen gedaan bij Veilig Thuis is op dit moment echter niet voor handen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het vergeten van onderwijs bij de aanbesteding van jeugdzorg in Noord-Holland Noord

MP Westerveld asks how education was left out of the procurement of closed youth care in Noord-Holland Noord, whether education is legally required, and how a fix will be guaranteed. The minister answers that the youth care provider must arrange schooling under the Jeugdwet and Leerplichtwet, that an education branch will open on 1 August 2019 with interim toleration, and that the situation will be reviewed with municipalities and education partners.

In my response to the action plan 'The best suited care for vulnerable young people' of 25 March 2019, I indicated that my colleague for BVOM and I will explore with municipalities, institutions and education partners how the transformation in youth care relates to an appropriate education offer.

In mijn reactie op het actieplan «De best passende zorg voor kwetsbare jongeren» van 25 maart 2019 heb ik aangegeven dat mijn collega voor BVOM en ik met gemeenten, instellingen en onderwijspartners gaan verkennen hoe de transformatie in de jeugdhulp zich verhoudt tot een passend onderwijsaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over onveiligheid in woonzorginstellingen

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about safety problems and weak oversight in supported-housing institutions housing ex-offenders and former TBS patients, following local media reports. The minister answered that municipalities supervise Wmo-funded supported housing, the IGJ and Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid have limited roles, no national picture is planned, and the government will send a forensic-expertise study and publish municipal oversight reports.
I do not have a national registration of the actual use by municipalities of the enforcement instruments available to them.
Ik beschik niet over een landelijke registratie van het feitelijke gebruik door gemeenten van het hun ter beschikking staande handhavingsinstrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Buitenweg en Van der Staaij over de gesloten jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld, Buitenweg and Van der Staaij asked the ministers about youths being placed in closed youth care because no alternatives exist, the acceptability of deprivation of liberty, waiting lists, and compliance with children's rights. Minister De Jonge answered that closed care should be minimised, pointed to a best-fit care plan and expert teams, acknowledged the lack of alternatives and the need for a new legal framework, and said several points are under study.
That young people have experienced stays in a closed institution as a prison, I consider an important signal.
Dat jongeren het verblijf in een gesloten instelling als een gevangenis hebben ervaren, vind ik een belangrijk signaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Rijk verdeelt wmo-gelden anders: Gelderse gemeenten krijgen miljoenen minder’

MP Kerstens asked the ministers whether the proposed new allocation model for protected housing (beschermd wonen) funds under the Wmo, which reportedly cuts funds for Gelderland municipalities, is unjust, could discourage municipalities from hosting providers, threatens access to care, and whether the government will talk with municipalities, revise the model, add money, or assign a role to provinces. The minister replied that the model follows the Toekomst Beschermd Wonen commission advice, that regional implementation agreements and consultations with the VNG are underway, that the model will be reviewed in 2019 with a final decision in spring 2020 and introduction planned for 2021 via a phased transition, and that municipalities are responsible so no provincial role is foreseen.
In spring 2020 the definitive decision on the allocation model and the timing of its introduction will be taken.
In het voorjaar van 2020 vindt definitieve besluitvorming plaats over het verdeelmodel en het moment van invoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Die gevaarlijke pijnstiller uitbannen lukt maar niet’

MPs De Groot and Dik-Faber asked about a study and news report on pharmaceutical residues (diclofenac) in water, including EU priority substance listing, waterboard monitoring, province and Rijkswaterstaat action, hospital wastewater treatment and the Green Deal Duurzame Zorg. The minister agrees on the urgency, notes the EU has postponed revising the priority list, points to the chain approach and biomonitoring experiments, says hospital treatment depends on local circumstances, and promises to keep the Chamber informed on the Green Deal follow-up.
I will gladly keep you informed of the progress on both topics.
Ik zal u graag op de hoogte houden van de stand van zaken op beide onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het datalek bij Jeugdzorg waardoor dossiers van duizenden kwetsbare kinderen zijn gelekt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a data leak at Jeugdzorg Utrecht exposing thousands of children's files, including whether security norms were met and whether Z-CERT participation should be mandatory. The Minister says the leak came from an expired domain name now recovered, that Z-CERT will be asked to register lapsed domains, and that making Z-CERT membership compulsory will be examined in 2019.
As promised in response to the Ellemeet motion, VWS will examine in 2019 making participation of care and youth aid institutions in Z-CERT mandatory.
Zoals toegezegd in reactie op de motie Ellemeet (TK 270529, nr 179) zal VWS in 2019 het verplichtstellen van de deelname van zorg- en jeugdhulpinstellingen aan Z-CERT onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over misstanden in woonzorginstellingen en gebrek aan toezicht hierop

MPs Hijink and Van Nispen asked about drug use, weapons incidents and unreported problems at residential care facilities for forensic clients, and about inspection gaps and the award of contracts to small providers. The State Secretary largely rejected a systemic problem, said inspections and municipalities had acted adequately, and promised a letter on the forensic residential care supply and supervision structure.
The picture painted in the Omroep Gelderland articles is not a pretty one.
Het beeld dat geschetst wordt in de artikelen van Omroep Gelderland is geen fraai beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het bericht dat 28 Gelderse gemeenten kampen met grote tekorten op de jeugdzorg

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked whether the minister shares concern that 28 Gelderland municipalities face large youth care deficits, whether children's care is at risk, and whether municipalities are adequately compensated. The minister acknowledges the signals, points to municipalities' statutory youth care duty and the council's oversight role, and refers to the ongoing 'Onderzoek Jeugd' that will turn signals into facts before deciding on measures.
Municipalities have the youth care obligation. This means they must offer timely and appropriate help to children who need it.
Gemeenten hebben de jeugdhulpplicht. Dit houdt in dat zij kinderen die dit nodig hebben tijdig passende hulp moeten bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de situatie van donorkinderen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health about the implementation of the 2017 action plan for donor-conceived children, the evaluation of the Donor Data Act, consanguinity limits on donors, and access to donor information. The Minister reported on the status of the seven action points, said the evaluation is nearly complete, defended the 25-children limit as revised, and said the age-16 disclosure threshold follows other legislation.
As usual, the Minister of VWS accounts to the House of Representatives for the policy pursued and thus also for the status of the action plan supporting donor children.

Zoals gebruikelijk legt de Minister van VWS verantwoording af over het gevoerde beleid aan de Tweede Kamer en daarmee ook over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot het Actieplan ondersteuning donorkinderen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over een inkomenstoets bij jeugdhulp

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a means-test (inkomenstoets) for youth care, used in Dordrecht, is desirable, lawful and compatible with the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether other municipalities use similar barriers. The Minister said municipalities face dilemmas, promised a study into funding of informal care, and declined to judge legality because the matter is pending before the court.
The working method of Zuid Holland Zuid is currently also before the court. I am therefore awaiting the court's judgment.
De werkwijze van Zuid Holland Zuid ligt momenteel ook bij de rechter. Ik wacht daarom het oordeel van de rechter af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het bericht ‘Private equity mengt zich steeds meer in de zorg’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about reports that private equity is increasingly investing in Dutch healthcare, including risks to quality of care and to sensitive medical data held by foreign investors, and whether the NZa should get a care-content review power over mergers. The minister answered that existing quality and privacy rules apply equally to investors, that the government is studying sharpened merger oversight with ACM, NZa and IGJ and will inform parliament before summer, and that marketisation will be addressed in a forthcoming letter.

As I informed your House in my letter of 22 October 2018, the Minister for Medical Care and Sport, the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport and I are currently examining concrete suggestions from the ACM, NZa and IGJ to sharpen care-specific merger oversight.

Zoals ik uw Kamer heb geïnformeerd in mijn brief van 22 oktober 2018, onderzoeken de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport, de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en ik momenteel concrete suggesties van de ACM, de NZa en de IGJ om het zorgspecifieke fusietoezicht aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Rudmer Heerema en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘ADO supporters bekladden Amsterdam’

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that ADO Den Haag supporters defaced Amsterdam monuments, including the Dokwerker, with anti-Jewish slogans, asking about arrests, club responsibility, and nationwide stadium bans. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that a complaint is under review by the Public Prosecution Service, that the KNVB and clubs can impose stadium bans as a private-law measure, and that he will discuss antisemitism in football with the KNVB.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het bericht dat lipfillers worden verstrekt aan minderjarigen door zowel artsen als onbevoegden

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about reports that lip fillers are administered to minors by doctors and unqualified providers, and about the IGJ's supervision. The Minister acknowledged concern, reported several signals and two notifications received by the IGJ, explained the risk-based and complaint-based supervision approach, and said the IGJ has sufficient enforcement powers and that the BIG law now explicitly covers cosmetic treatments from 1 April 2019.
In addition, the IGJ takes into account in its risk-based supervision whether fillers are placed in patients under 18 without medical necessity.
Daarnaast neemt de IGJ in haar risicotoezicht mee of fillers worden geplaatst bij patiënten onder de 18 jaar zonder medische noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over ‘Reclame’ op school die tot dure jeugdhulp leidt

A CDA MP asked the health minister about youth care providers holding consultation hours in schools and giving parents pre-printed referral letters, and about rising youth mental-health care use. The minister condemned the practice of providers referring to themselves, said the in-depth youth care study will be sent to parliament around end of April, and described existing municipal-GP cooperation.
Ik keur deze praktijk ten zeerste af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over kindermishandeling

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about the finding that nearly half of schools lack clear procedures for suspected child abuse, teacher training on recognising abuse, and how the verbeterde meldcode will be implemented in schools. The minister answered that school boards are legally responsible for the meldcode, the Inspectorate will pay extra attention, and the government is running implementation support, teacher-training reviews and pilots.
Given the implementation of the improved meldcode, I am asking the Inspectorate of Education to pay extra attention to this in the coming years.
Ik vraag de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gezien de implementatie van de verbeterde meldcode de komende jaren hiervoor extra aandacht te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en De Lange over zorgfraude als verdienmodel voor criminelen

MPs Hermans and De Lange asked the Minister of Health about reports of care fraud as a criminal earning model, including recruitment of vulnerable people and misuse of personal budgets (PGB). The minister acknowledged the problem and outlined measures: more inspection capacity, automated checks in PGB 2.0, PGB-competence frameworks, a planned information-sharing bill delayed to early 2020, and municipal support programmes.
To tackle fraudsters as quickly and as firmly as possible, forces must be pooled even better.
Om fraudeurs zo snel en zo stevig mogelijk aan te pakken moeten de krachten nog beter gebundeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de ontoegankelijkheid van de zorg

An MP asks the health minister how vulnerable people can find the right care and support, whether people lacking funds to advance equipment costs are left stranded, and what action has been taken on Ombudsman signals. The minister acknowledges the problems, commits to pushing a 'no wrong door' principle and ongoing programmes, while pointing to municipalities and insurers for equipment provision and promising to inform the House on pending evaluations.
I will work in the coming period to ensure that the 'no wrong door' principle becomes the standard in daily implementation practice.
Ik zal mij er de komende periode voor inzetten dat het principe van «no wrong door» ook in de praktijk van de dagelijkse uitvoering de standaard wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het vastlopen van de onderhandelingen over de cao Jeugdzorg

Westerveld (GreenLeft) asked the Health Minister about the stalled collective labour agreement talks in youth care, asking how to make the sector attractive given high workload, low investment in training, staff turnover and sick leave. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to a labour market study and ongoing talks with sector partners, cited sick-leave and workload figures, and said that wage increases reach youth care through municipal budgets, without committing to new binding measures.
VWS is in talks with JenV and relevant sector parties about measures to be taken to tackle the labour market bottlenecks for youth professionals.
VWS is samen met JenV en met betrokken sectorpartijen in gesprek over te nemen maatregelen om de knelpunten op de arbeidsmarkt voor jeugdprofessionals aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het steeds ouder worden van mensen met een drugsverslaving en het toerusten van zorginstellingen hierop

Two D66 MPs asked the Health Minister about rising drug addiction among older people and whether municipalities, Wlz care institutions and prevention are adequately equipped. The minister gave prevalence figures showing rises among older users, said municipalities are responsible for quality, found no signals of insufficient expertise in elderly care, argued late-life prevention is largely ineffective, and offered to send an overview of research but saw no reason for special action.
We are willing to do so. At present, however, we see no reason to take special action on this.
Daartoe zijn wij bereid. Op dit moment zien wij echter geen aanleiding hierop bijzondere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over te lage tarieven voor pleegzorg, jeugdbescherming en jeugdhulp

An MP asked ministers about allegedly too-low tariffs for foster care, child protection and youth care, and about related cost and funding issues. The minister answered that no broad cost study is planned, that tariffs are a matter for municipalities and providers with escalation routes available, and that a progress report on the youth care action programme will follow in May 2019.
It is primarily up to municipalities and providers to reach agreement on the realistic tariff given the specific circumstances and wishes.
Het is primair aan gemeenten en aanbieders om tot overeenstemming te komen over het reële tarief gegeven de specifieke omstandigheden en wensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gedeeltelijk onder curatele plaatsen van Zeeuwse jeugdzorginstelling

An MP asks the minister how the Zeeland youth care provider Intervence came into serious financial trouble, how it affects clients, and what is being done to protect children. The minister answers that municipalities and Intervence reached agreements in February 2019, that no youths are reported to be in danger, and that an early-warning method and a dispute committee are being set up.
The municipalities have the legal duty to ensure that sufficient youth protection and youth probation is always available.
De gemeenten hebben de wettelijke plicht ervoor te zorgen dat er altijd voldoende jeugdbescherming en jeugdreclassering beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vrouwenbesnijdenis

Rep. Van Dijk asked the government about a request to the Hague mayor to act against the As-Soennah mosque over alleged endorsement of female genital mutilation, whether reconstructive surgery after FGM should be covered by basic insurance, and the practice of hymen checks and hymen restoration. The minister replied that the enforcement decision lies with the mayor, that FGM is illegal and the government pursues an integrated chain approach, that reconstructive surgery cannot yet be added to basic insurance pending a Zorginstituut opinion, and that the government opposes hymen restoration done out of fear and will consult doctors and the NVOG.
The request to enforce is addressed to the mayor of The Hague.
Het verzoek tot handhaven is gericht aan de burgemeester van Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over foutieve inning eigen bijdrage door het CAK

An MP asked the Health Minister about incorrect collection of patient co-payments by the CAK and whether it has been put right; the minister answered that internal processes are being improved, that he will shorten retroactive correction periods to twelve months for serious CAK or chain-partner failures, and that the CAK will draft a plan with external advice under ministerial monitoring. The answers are substantive but give no detailed timeline and partly reframe the CAK problems as a structural challenge rather than a deterioration.
The Ministry of VWS will make agreements with the CAK to keep progress on track.
Het Ministerie van VWS zal daarbij met het CAK afspraken maken om de voortgang op koers te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Hijink over de zorg in het aardbevingsgebied

SP MPs asked about strain on healthcare in the Groningen earthquake area, including uncertainty over reinforcement of care buildings, staff stress, sick-leave data and the status of the care plan. The minister replied that the Groninger Zorgakkoord was signed, that support coaches are provided for care staff, that no sick-leave figures exist specifically for the area, and that reinforcement costs are borne by NAM.
There are no known figures on sick leave in care and welfare specifically in the earthquake area.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het ziekteverzuim in zorg en welzijn specifiek in het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over zwijgcontract in de jeugdbescherming

An MP asked whether a gag contract in youth protection prevented a victim from reporting abuse, whether pleegzorg screening and gag-contract bans would be pursued, and whether investigations into a silence culture were planned. The minister answered that the contract did not prevent reporting, that such contracts are undesirable and a legal change is being considered, that screening improvements are underway, and that no further investigation into a silence culture is currently warranted.
Concluding such a contract between a victim and a youth institution is something I consider very undesirable.
Het afsluiten van een dergelijk contract tussen een slachtoffer en een jeugdinstelling vind ik zeer ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over ontbrekende zorg

An SP MP asks the health minister about the long wait for a wheelchair-accessible home adaptation for a family with a severely disabled child, and whether the fragmented care system leaves families passed between bodies. The minister says the municipality is handling the request, that delays reflect complex assessment, that he has no power to intervene in individual Wmo cases, and points to ongoing cooperation programmes.
As Minister, I cannot intervene in the handling of individual cases under the Wmo 2015.
Als Minister kan ik op grond van de Wmo 2015 niet ingrijpen in de behandeling van individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen bij de invoering van het abonnementstarief

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about municipalities classifying home care as general provisions, leading to higher co-payments and double bills under the subscription tariff. The minister defended the phased introduction of the subscription tariff, denied any misapplication of the AMvB, and promised to have municipalities and the CAK clarify information for citizens.
I have since had the general information on the CAK and government websites further clarified regarding the difference in contribution for general provisions and tailored provisions.

Ik heb inmiddels de algemene informatie op de websites van het CAK en rijksoverheid verder laten verduidelijken met betrekking tot het verschil in bijdrage voor algemene voorzieningen en maatwerkvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de minister gerommel met zorggeld in de doofpot stopt

An SP MP asks the health minister whether he will publicly condemn the spending of health funds on a costly report and the use of foundations to evade the WNT pay cap, and questions the ministry's handling of Espria's account. The minister answers that spending must be careful but that judging the report's value is for the supervisory board, notes that CIBG found no WNT violation, and promises to strengthen external oversight with proposals around summer and a bill to bring subcontractors under the WNT.
I find it undesirable that structures are set up that are solely intended to circumvent laws and regulations.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat er constructies worden opgetuigd die enkel zijn bedoeld om wet- en regelgeving te omzeilen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het adverteren voor en meewerken aan maagdenvliesherstel in Nederland

The MPs Becker and Arno Rutte (VVD) asked whether the government would raise with Dutch gynaecologists the option of no longer issuing certificates of virginity, following a Belgian medical council ruling.
