Minister De Jonge answered that he is willing to raise it in his meeting with gynaecologists and will report on it in the next progress letter on the Geweld hoort nergens thuis programme.
Yes, I am willing to raise this during my conversation with gynaecologists in the Netherlands.
Ja, ik ben bereid om tijdens mijn gesprek met de gynaecologen in Nederland dit aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van der Molen over het bestaan van zogenaamde “spookburgers.”

MPs Peters and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about homeless people being refused registration and mail addresses by municipalities despite a 2016 agreement, and whether the government would compel municipalities to register them. The government acknowledged the problem and the duty to register, said it is pursuing guidance, workshops and a legislative clarification making registration on a mail address mandatory, but declined to name the refusing municipalities or to use direct enforcement powers for now.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Geen kinderen meer in de isoleercel? Niet haalbaar, zeggen instellingen’

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked about reports that youth care institutions say the goal of ending solitary confinement of children by 2021 is unrealistic, and about the current frequency of isolation, enforcement, and staffing. The minister says no such letter has been received, a uniform definition and registration of forced isolation is being developed with results due May 2019, the Inspectorate will supervise the rules, and staffing shortages are being addressed through a recruitment campaign.
It is not clear whether young people in Jeugdzorgplus are now forcibly isolated more or less often than in previous years.
Het is niet duidelijk of jongeren in de Jeugdzorgplus nu vaker of minder vaak dan in voorgaande jaren gedwongen worden afgezonderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jongeren vaak ten onrechte worden opgesloten in isoleercellen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that young people are often wrongly isolated in seclusion cells and whether staff shortages and the isolation practice harm them. The Minister says the ambition to stop coerced seclusion is in place, that an IGJ inspection project and a nulmeting are underway, and that isolation may be used only as a last resort and never to punish, committing to further monitoring and funding for alternative models.

To prevent harmful and traumatising effects of coerced seclusion, last April I set the ambition, together with municipalities and youth care providers in the Zorg voor de Jeugd programme, to stop coerced seclusion.

Om schadelijke en traumatiserende effecten van gedwongen afzonderen te voorkomen, heb ik april vorig jaar – samen met gemeenten en jeugdhulpinstellingen, in het programma Zorg voor de Jeugd – de ambitie neergelegd om te stoppen met gedwongen afzonderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de paarse krokodil Apeldoornse coöperatie bij hulp in laatste levensfase belemmert

An MP asked the minister about reports that the Paarse Krokodil care cooperative in Apeldoorn is hampered in providing home palliative end-of-life care by insurers' prior-authorisation requirements, and whether such barriers are being imposed deliberately. The minister finds this distressing, defends prior authorisation as a tool against unjustified care use, and points to contracting efforts and bureaucracy reduction, promising no new national inventory of barriers.
Health insurers must have purchased sufficient care to meet their duty of care.
Zorgverzekeraar moeten voldoende zorg ingekocht hebben om aan hun zorgplicht te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over nieuwe voorbeelden van naheffingen bij het CAK

An SP MP asked the health minister to respond to a case where a CAK error led to a retroactive bill over 6,000 euros, and whether the minister would request forgiveness or limit repayment to 12 months. The minister admitted errors and communication failures, said the CAK cannot generally waive contributions except in specific cases, and announced an AMvB shortening retroactive revisions to 12 months, to be in force 1 January 2020.
Because this individual case is still before the court, I will not go into the substance of the case further.
Omdat deze individuele zaak nog onder de rechter ligt ga ik verder niet inhoudelijk in op de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de mantelzorgmakelaar in relatie tot de onafhankelijke cliëntondersteuner

An MP asked the minister whether paid mantelzorgmakelaars (caregiver brokers) conflict with the free, independent client support guaranteed by law, and how they relate to independent cliëntondersteuning. The minister answered that caregiver brokers are a specialised form of client support, that local municipalities have policy room and clients must decide whether a paid broker adds value, and that such brokers can be useful, while noting that the right to free independent support must not be undermined.
However, the emergence of the market for client support may not detract from the right to free client support.
Het ontstaan van de markt voor cliëntondersteuning mag echter geen afbreuk doen aan het recht op gratis cliëntondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

An MP asked the government about the Dutch Week without Meat campaign, including whether ministries should promote it, whether canteen meals should be made meat-free by default, and whether external costs of meat should be priced in. The government answered by referring to earlier answers (Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896), giving no substantive response to the questions.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03361, on a week without meat, have been answered by way of Appendix Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03361 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1896 .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Westerveld over het opstappen van jeugdzorginstelling topman vanwege financiële problemen

MPs Kuiken and Westerveld asked the Minister of Health about the departure of the top manager of youth care provider Juzt over financial problems, including when the ministry learned of the problems, the planned relocation of youths from Lievenshove, staff reductions, and measures against sector-wide financial distress. The minister answered that the ministry was informed in 2016, that the region and Juzt are negotiating, that relocation is delayed by costs and closure is set for mid-April, and that new oversight and mediation bodies have been set up in response to the sector's financial strain.
I am closely following developments and, as the system's responsible minister, I am keeping a very close eye on the situation.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend en houd als stelselverantwoordelijke nadrukkelijk een vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de geringe aandacht voor levenseindezorg in medische opleidingen

An MP asked the health minister why end-of-life care receives little attention in Dutch medical curricula and whether mandatory teaching should be added. The minister said curricula are the responsibility of the profession and training institutions, noted ZonMw projects supporting palliative care education, and committed only to bringing the Leyden study to the attention of the committee revising the training framework.
It is not for me to adopt this advice. It is for the profession and the training institutions, which are responsible for the content of the training programmes.
Het is niet aan mij om dit advies over te nemen. Het is aan de beroepsgroep en de opleiders, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de inhoud van de opleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de brand in de serviceflat Oranjeparkflat

An MP asked the health minister about a fatal fire in a service flat for elderly residents, the results of the investigation, how fire safety supervision of such housing is organised, and whether earlier incidents led to changes. The minister answered that the cause was an accident and fire safety was in order, outlined the division of responsibilities among owners, operators, residents and municipalities, and pointed to a risk-based fire safety model and extra attention to fire safety in the health inspectorate's supervision.
The IGJ will ask care providers offering residential care, in its supervision, to explicitly pay attention to building fire safety in their risk inventory and evaluation.

De IGJ zal de zorgaanbieders die intramurale zorg aanbieden in haar toezicht vragen om in hun risico-inventarisatie en evaluatie ook nadrukkelijk aandacht te besteden aan de brandveiligheid van het gebouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Deze gastarbeiders zijn oud in een land dat een tussenstop had moeten zijn’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about reports that older guest workers face poorer health, reduced AOW pensions, and low remigration uptake, and what support or follow-up is planned. The government answered that it cannot precisely estimate pension counts, that AOW reductions average about 32.5% falling to 27.8%, that care is meant to be person-centred with programmes like Langer Thuis and Een tegen Eenzaamheid, and that remigration uptake may be affected by pension levels, family ties and health care in the origin country.
I have instructed that the knowledge gained about what works and what does not be bundled.
Ik heb opdracht gegeven om de geleerde kennis over wat werkt en wat niet te bundelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Pieter Heerma en Van den Berg over de last onder dwangsom werkgeversportaal UWV

MPs Van der Molen, Heerma and Van den Berg (CDA) asked about the Dutch Data Protection Authority's penalty order against the UWV employer portal, the choice of eID assurance level (eHerkenning substantial versus eIDAS high), the role of UZI cards, and cost estimates for employers. The minister answered that UWV's 2018 risk analysis found the substantial level appropriate, that the cost estimates were not too low, and that the UZI card is only for patient identification.
I do not share the view that eHerkenning means were prescribed at the wrong level.
Ik deel niet de mening dat sprake is van het voorschrijven van eHerkenningsmiddelen op een verkeerd niveau.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Raemakers over “vaak geen passende jeugdzorg”

An MP asked the minister about the Inspectorate's finding that young people in youth care often do not receive appropriate help, including suicides, and about related questions on integrated care, suicide research, professional standards, youth participation and regional expert teams. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to existing programmes, research and guidelines, and committed to including the findings in an action plan for closed youth care to be sent to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat overeenkomsten worden afgekeurd door het zorgkantoor omdat de zorgverlener nog een andere baan heeft

An MP asked the minister whether it is acceptable that care-office approval of personal-budget care contracts is refused when a carer has another job, and whether low tariffs are hindering recruitment. The minister says the care office checks the 40-hour cap and may consider side jobs, but a side job alone is not grounds for rejection, and he will consult on how this is applied; he sees no structural signals that the tariff caps are too low.
However, the existence of side activities in itself cannot by definition be a reason to reject a care agreement.
Het bestaan van nevenwerkzaamheden op zich kan echter niet per definitie een reden zijn om een zorgovereenkomst af te keuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de monitoring eigen bijdrage Wmo tekort schiet

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the monitor of the Wmo co-payment shortfall and municipal compensation for the subscription tariff was adequate. The minister said the CPB estimates are based on CAK data, municipalities are fully compensated for estimated costs, and an independent monitor will track effects.
However, I consider it important to closely follow the more precise effects of introducing the subscription tariff in practice through a monitor.
Wel vind ik het van belang om de meer precieze effecten van de introductie van het abonnementstarief in de praktijk nauwlettend te volgen via een monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Ellemeet over demonstranten die vrouwen intimideren voor abortusklinieken

Three MPs asked whether anti-abortion demonstrators intimidating women outside clinics is acceptable, how far demonstration rights extend, whether such conduct is criminal, and whether the government will meet clinics and municipalities. The minister said such intimidation is undesirable, that demonstrations are widespread but usually not intimidating, that municipalities can impose conditions and APV rules may cover the conduct, and that a joint meeting with clinics and municipalities will be held before the summer recess.
With due regard to the substantive responsibilities of local government, I will invite the municipalities concerned and the abortion clinics to a joint consultation before the summer recess.
Met inachtneming van de inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheden van het lokale gezag, zal ik voor het zomerreces de betrokken gemeenten en de abortusklinieken uitnodigen voor een gezamenlijk overleg

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat wanneer een terminale cliënt slaapt of gesedeerd is, de uren niet worden vergoed door Zilveren Kruis, waardoor waken bij iemand die dood gaat niet kan

An MP asked whether a tweet claiming Zilveren Kruis does not reimburse night-time waking for dying patients who are asleep or sedated is correct and how the minister will stop it. The minister answered that the tweet is incorrect: waking is reimbursable under the Zorgverzekeringswet when the district nurse indicates it on nursing grounds and documents it in the care plan, and volunteers can support relatives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het adverteren voor en het meewerken aan maagdenvliesherstel in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about hymen reconstruction clinics, medical practice and whether doctors should still cooperate, given WHO opposition and risks of coercion linked to honour-related pressure. The minister condemns the practice when driven by fear, says the NVOG 2004 guidance still advises against the operation unless counselling leaves no alternative, and commits to talks with doctors and the NVOG, reporting back later.
I will therefore enter into discussion with the doctors concerned and the Dutch Society for Obstetrics & Gynaecology (NVOG) about preventing hymen reconstruction in women.
Ik ga daarom met de betreffende artsen en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Obstetrie & Gynaecologie (NVOG) in gesprek over het voorkomen van maagdenvliesherstel bij vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het feit dat slachtoffers van seksueel geweld die een beroep doen op het Centrum Seksueel Geweld daarvoor hun eigen risico moeten aanspreken

Two PvdA MPs asked why sexual violence victims using Centrum Seksueel Geweld must pay their Zvw deductible and whether this deters reporting. The government confirms the deductible applies to medical care, points to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven compensation and a planned one-year temporary arrangement to reimburse the deductible in the acute phase, but does not abolish the deductible.
The deductible does not relate to the criminal law aspect of sexual violence, but to the provision of care.
Het eigen risico heeft geen betrekking op het strafrechtelijk aspect van seksueel geweld, maar op de zorgverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat verzekeraars 170 miljoen onbenut laten voor wijkverpleging

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether insurers leaving 170 million euro of wijkverpleging funds unspent threatens their duty of care, and whether insurers should be pressed or obliged to use the money for staff and better wages. The minister answered that contract terms are a local matter, encouraged quality and multi-year contracts, and pointed to 1.7 billion euro extra for wages in 2019 while leaving collective agreements to social partners.
The contract between health insurers and care providers is the place to make agreements about what is needed to continue delivering the right care.
Het contract tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders is de plek om afspraken te maken over wat er nodig is om de juiste zorg te kunnen blijven leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis Bronovo dicht door tekort aan personeel'

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked about the closure of Bronovo hospital due to staff shortages, requesting an overview of hospitals with staff-related service cuts, vacancy and self-employed figures, and measures to address shortages. The minister said staffing is one cause among several in HMC's consolidation to two sites, cited national capacity data without a list of affected hospitals, and pointed to funding and the Werken in de Zorg programme as measures.
There is no overview of hospitals that must postpone or relocate care due to a staff shortage.
Er is geen overzicht van ziekenhuizen die zorg moeten uitstellen of verplaatsen vanwege een tekort aan personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de toename van psychiatrische problematiek in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the Minister of Health about rising psychiatric problems in youth care, including suicides, transfers of young people to closed youth care, constant re-placement, specialist versus generalist care under tendering, and staff overload. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to ongoing research, IGJ supervision, regional expert teams, efforts to recruit foster families and a procurement approach, and promised further steps on placements and workload.
I will continue to put this on the agenda and push all involved parties to stop, or reduce, the re-placement of children placed out of home.
Ik zal dit blijven agenderen en aanjagen richting alle betrokken partijen om het doorverhuizen van uit huisgeplaatste kinderen te stoppen/terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Slootweg over het artikel op Zorgvisie ‘30 procent van de cliëntenondersteuners kan niet onafhankelijk werken’

CDA MPs asked the health minister about a survey showing that about a third of client support workers feel their independence is under pressure from care offices and municipalities, and that some issue decisions for clients they also support. The minister called this undesirable, committed to separating the support and decision-making functions via the VNG, and said the findings will be shared with care offices and municipalities.
I therefore consider it undesirable that a client support worker issues decisions for clients to whom they also provide client support.
Ik vind het dus ongewenst dat een cliëntondersteuner beschikkingen afgeeft voor cliënten aan wie ze tevens clientondersteuning bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘1,7 Miljard euro aan pgb’s onzeker of foutief’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that EUR 1.7 billion in personal budgets (pgb) may be unlawful or uncertain, and about signals on the SVB. The minister acknowledged the problems, attributed them mainly to monthly fixed payments lacking a legal basis (now fixed retroactively) and difficulty verifying delivered care, denied that fraud is the main issue, and promised further talks and a later update.
To resolve this I amended the Regulation on Long-term Care, Wmo 2015 and the Youth Act with retroactive effect from 1 January 2018, creating a legal basis for monthly payments.

Om dat op te lossen heb ik de Regeling Langdurige Zorg, Wmo 2015 en Jeugdwet met terugwerkende kracht vanaf 1 januari 2018 aangepast waarmee een wettelijke grondslag voor maandbetalingen is gecreëerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Vast Wmo-tarief mag niet leiden tot verschraling zorg’

MP Kerstens asked whether the fixed Wmo subscription tariff could harm vulnerable, low-income people and whether the government would guarantee no harm and compensate those affected before monitoring results appear. Minister De Jonge answered that the Wmo 2015 provides legal safeguards, municipalities are compensated for the estimated costs, and an effects monitor will follow the measure, without committing to advance guarantees or compensation.
The introduction of the subscription tariff for the Wmo co-payment may not lead to people who are dependent on it not receiving or insufficiently receiving the support they need.
De invoering van het abonnementstarief voor de eigen bijdrage Wmo kan en mag er niet toe leiden dat mensen die daarop zijn aangewezen niet of onvoldoende de ondersteuning krijgen die ze nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Landelijke tarieven moeten Wmo betaalbaar houden’

Kerstens (PvdA) asks the minister whether home-care wage increases under the VVT collective agreement are paid on time, whether the state compensates municipalities enough, and whether a higher national minimum Wmo tariff should be introduced. De Jonge answers that employers and municipalities bear primary responsibility, that municipalities are compensated, that the abonnementstarief effects will be monitored, and that a national minimum tariff is undesirable because it would limit local tailoring and innovation.
I consider the introduction of a national minimum tariff, as described in the article, undesirable.
Ik acht een invoering van een landelijk minimumtarief, zoals beschreven in het artikel, niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht '369.334 euro voor een rapport van honderd pagina's dat in een la ligt'

An MP asked ministers about a press report that a health-sector foundation paid about 369,000 euro for a 100-page report, allegedly as a disguised golden handshake for a former executive via a WNT-evading construction. The minister disputes the press framing, says the WNT does not apply to this private foundation, and states the cabinet sees no reason to add an anti-abuse clause to the WNT.
It is up to the commissioning party of the research, in this case Espria, to judge that.
Het is aan de opdrachtgever van het onderzoek, in dit geval Espria, om daarover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het artikel ‘ €369.344 euro voor een rapport van honderd pagina’s dat in een la ligt’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister about a Follow the Money report on a one-year contract for former Espria executive Meerdink via a foundation set up by Espria's supervisory board, questioning the payment from collective funds, the report's quality and the sessions held. The minister answers that the matter is for Espria's board and internal supervisor, that he has not seen the report or the seven-page note, and that no government officials attended the sessions.
However, it is not for me to judge in individual cases the amount an institution has spent on a study.
Het is echter niet aan mij om in individuele gevallen te oordelen over het bedrag dat een instelling heeft uitgegeven aan een onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat huisartsen zorg weigeren aan woonzorghuizen voor mensen met dementie

An MP asked the minister whether it is concerning that GPs refuse care to residents of small-scale dementia care homes, and how access to 24-hour specialist care is guaranteed. The minister acknowledged GP pressure and the need for cooperation, promised a separate letter on options and financing, but did not commit to new rules or direct oversight changes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Toeloop verwacht voor zorg van de gemeente door nieuwe regeling’

An MP asked the health minister whether the new Wmo income-based subscription tariff will harm low-income people and whether gemeenten are sufficiently compensated, with extra demand expected. The minister says gemeenten are compensated, the Wmo 2015 gives adequate safeguards, and an agreed monitor will track effects with a power to adjust rules by AMvB if needed.
With the VNG I have therefore agreed to closely monitor the effects in practice using a monitor, and to act on it if the monitor's results give cause to do so.
Met de VNG heb ik dan ook afgesproken om de effecten in de praktijk met behulp van een monitor nauwlettend te volgen én als de resultaten van de monitor hiertoe aanleiding geven, hierop te acteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het bericht dat zorg in kleine woonvormen voor ouderen niet altijd goed geregeld is

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Health about reports that care in small-scale housing for the elderly is not always well organised, including insufficient staff knowledge, late specialist involvement, and new providers not registering with CIBG. The Minister acknowledged the problem and pointed to the Wtza bill, which introduces a mandatory registration duty and licensing for providers, and to the quality framework requiring 24/7 doctor and specialist availability.

With the bill on the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders (Wtza), there will be a registration duty for all new care providers falling under the scope of the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg (Wkkgz).
Met het wetsvoorstel Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders (Wtza) komt er een meldplicht voor alle nieuwe zorgaanbieders onder de reikwijdte van de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg (Wkkgz).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het bericht ‘Witte hesjes, zorg dat de gezondheidszorg weer zorg wordt’

MP Geleijnse asked the Minister of Health whether VWS should develop and enforce cost standards for hospitals, require doctors and NZa/IGJ representatives on hospital boards, and whether insurers should lack decisive influence over hospital treatment through price agreements. The minister rejected all three ideas, saying hospitals are responsible for their own financial management, that NZa/IGJ members on boards would undermine their independence, and that insurers negotiate prices on behalf of insured people.
Based on that premise, I do not agree with this statement.
Vanuit dat gegeven ga ik niet mee met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat het AMC honderden hoofden van omstreden Amerikaans bedrijf kocht

The MP Bruins Slot asked the Minister of Health about reports that the AMC bought hundreds of heads from a controversial US body-brokering company, including whether financial incentives for body donation and imports of body parts are acceptable under Dutch law. The Minister answered that paying donors beyond their costs is prohibited or will be, that commercial use of body material is acceptable if donors are properly informed, and that the forthcoming Wzl bill will regulate imported material, while not committing to a new import rule for body parts.
I intend to set rules on this in the Wzl.
Ik ben voornemens hierover regels te stellen in de Wzl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over assistentiehonden

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurer CZ requiring assistance dogs to be owned by the training school, dog breed rules, and problems when insured people switch insurers. The minister replied that insurers decide how to contract care, that school ownership aids quality and complaints, that CZ dropped the breed requirement, and that insurers cooperate to ensure continuity of care.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Rog over uitbreiding regeling Gratis VOG

Two CDA MPs asked why compulsory-VOG volunteers in schools, childcare and out-of-school care cannot use the free VOG scheme, and whether it could be extended to them. The minister answered that the scheme is only for organisations not already legally required to obtain a VOG, to stimulate voluntary integrity policy, and that no extension is planned, though communication will be intensified.
This is roughly in line with expectations.
Dit is bij benadering conform de verwachtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over wachtlijsten bij de jeugdbescherming

An MP asked the minister about long waiting lists at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming (child protection board), with about 3,000 children waiting, and about the causes and remedies. The minister acknowledged the concern, cited causes such as staff shortages and overstretched research capacity, and pointed to an action plan with targets and monitoring by the inspectorates.
Both the Inspectorates and I are closely monitoring the progress of this plan.
Zowel de Inspecties als ik houden de voortgang van dit plan nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over een misbruikdrama in de atletiekwereld

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked why a 2009 report of boundary-crossing conduct by an athletics coach led to no investigation, whether the athletics federation should have reported to police, whether criminal complaints were filed, and whether tuchtrecht rulings should feed into criminal prosecution and VOG screening. The minister said the police-led investigation covers the earlier report and cannot be discussed, that criminal law takes precedence over disciplinary law, that the Centrum Seksueel Geweld and Slachtofferhulp can help victims, and that linking sports disciplinary lists to the VOG is not desirable.
To get a good picture of the matters at issue, the police investigation team led by the Public Prosecution Service gathers as much relevant information as possible.
Om een goed beeld te krijgen van de zaken die spelen en gespeeld hebben, vergaart het onderzoeksteam van politie onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) zoveel mogelijk relevante informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de houding van dit kabinet ten aanzien van medische ethische onderwerpen

Labour MP Ploumen asks the health minister why the cabinet gives little attention to medical ethics and voluntary end of life, and about the status of promised research and discussions. The minister rejects the claim of avoiding the topic, points to the medical ethics memo, research on people with a persistent wish to die (results due end 2019), and planned information and discussion activities.
I agree with you that the topic of voluntary end of life is an important social issue.
Ik ben het met u eens dat het onderwerp voltooid leven een maatschappelijk belangrijk thema is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de professionele autonomie van de onafhankelijke cliëntondersteuner die onder druk staat

An MP asks the health minister about pressure on the independence of client support workers under the Wmo 2015 and Wlz, including whether they may draft care allocation decisions and whether they can work across life domains. The minister acknowledges the pressure is undesirable, points to subsidies, the koploper municipal trajectory and planned talks with care offices, but largely refers back to existing rules and ongoing initiatives without new binding commitments.

I will present the outcomes of the Christelijke Hogeschool Ede research and the BCMB vision to the care offices and ask them whether, and if so how, they can incorporate this into their development agenda.

Ik zal de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de Christelijke Hogeschool Ede en de visie van de BCMB aan de zorgkantoren voorleggen en hen vragen of, en zo ja op welke wijze, zij dat kunnen meenemen in hun ontwikkelagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

MP Akerboom (PvdD) asked 21 questions about Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, challenging the government's climate policy, economic growth assumptions, and responsibility toward young people, and proposing measures such as a 0% VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and plant-based catering. The answer was a brief referral stating that the questions were answered in a separate Aanhangsel document, without giving substantive responses in this document.
The written questions from MP Akerboom (PvdD), question number 2018Z24296, have been answered by means of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Akerboom (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24296 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Von Martels over zorgvervoer en privacyregels

MPs Slootweg and Von Martels asked whether online booking of patient transport is becoming more common, whether strict GDPR privacy rules force two-factor login that burdens users, and whether booking confirmations can show reserved wheelchair space. The minister answered that internet communication is increasing, that GDPR and existing national rules apply, that two-factor login is separate from the booking confirmation which is the transporter's responsibility, and that no concrete change or action was promised.
Without further information about the reason for your question, or without further explanation, it is not possible for me to answer this question precisely.
Zonder nadere informatie over de aanleiding van uw vraag cq. zonder nadere duiding, is het voor mij niet mogelijk deze vraag precies te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het bericht dat 20 procent van de kinderen van gescheiden ouders hun vader niet meer ziet

GroenLinks MPs asked about reports that 20 percent of children of divorced parents no longer see their father, requesting research, figures, international data and policy measures. The minister pointed to ongoing UvA/CBS and WODC research, cited a 2017 WODC figure of about 12 percent no contact with fathers, and described existing action plans on shared parenting and a planned review of child benefit rules.
In addition, the WODC is currently conducting research into the non-compliance with contact arrangements.
Daarnaast doet het WODC thans onderzoek naar het niet-nakomen van omgangsregelingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat wanneer een terminale cliënt slaapt of gesedeerd is, de uren niet worden vergoed door Zilveren Kruis, waardoor waken bij iemand die dood gaat niet kan

An MP asked whether health insurer Zilveren Kruis refuses to reimburse nursing hours when a terminal patient is asleep or sedated, making deathbed watching impossible. The minister answers that care indicated by the district nurse, including watching, is reimbursable when justified in the care plan, that VWS will clarify the rules via a Zorginstituut factsheet in Q1 2019, and that a palliative care campaign will follow.
If there are questions in a specific situation about the indicated hours and/or the nature of the care, it is important and advisable that a care provider contacts the health insurer to discuss this.

Mochten er in een specifieke situatie vragen zijn over de geïndiceerde uren en/of de aard van de zorg, dan is het belangrijk en raadzaam dat een zorgaanbieder contact opneemt met de zorgverzekeraar om dit door te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de ‘Rapportage aan het Comité voor de rechten van personen met een handicap, inzake de eerste rapportage van Nederland’

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report on implementing the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, covering accessibility, local inclusion plans, guardianship, education, transport and development aid. The Minister answered that the Onbeperkt Meedoen! programme and existing measures address these concerns, while acknowledging that implementation takes time and promising follow-up letters and an evaluation meeting.
I share the College's call to make the necessary adjustments as quickly as possible so that persons with disabilities can participate as fully as possible in society.

Ik deel de oproep van het College om zo snel als mogelijk noodzakelijke aanpassingen te treffen om te zorgen dat personen met een beperking zo volwaardig mogelijk kunnen deelnemen aan de maatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Verbetering gebruik meldcode huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling bij ggz’

Tielen (VVD) asked the health minister about an Inspectorate finding that some youth mental health institutions believed the child-abuse reporting code did not apply to them. The minister answered that most GGZ institutions are well advanced, that the misunderstanding is wrong since the code covers all clients' risks, and committed to extra inspectorate attention, regional support and an evaluation of the law.
I have asked the Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth to pay extra attention this year to supervision of the reporting code for domestic violence and child abuse.
Ik heb de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd gevraagd om dit jaar extra aandacht te besteden aan het toezicht van de meldcode huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht 'Zorginstelling omzeilt winstverbod'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether the affiliated property, service and management structures of DeSeizoenen BV circumvent the profit ban in care and whether the WNT pay rules were respected. The minister answered that the IGJ and NZa are investigating and that they will share no further information for now, so he awaits the outcome.
The inspectorate and the NZa have indicated that, in the interest of their investigation, they are not providing further information at this time.
De inspectie en de NZa hebben aangegeven om in het belang van hun onderzoek op dit moment geen nadere informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Waarschuwing voor flinke tegenvaller gemeenten'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that municipalities may receive at least 100 million euro less from the municipal fund than assumed, and whether this would worsen their finances in social domain services and shift burdens onto vulnerable residents. The Minister denied that the figure was correct, said the definitive figure will come with the May 2019 circular, rejected the claim of a budget-driven shift onto vulnerable citizens, and promised a joint analysis of youth care with the VNG reported in spring 2019 plus monitoring of the Wmo co-payment change.
The cabinet is currently jointly conducting an in-depth study of youth care with the VNG.
Het kabinet voert momenteel gezamenlijk met de VNG een verdiepend onderzoek naar jeugdhulp uit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Zorg-zzp’er verdringt verpleging in vaste dienst’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that self-employed care workers (zzp'ers) are displacing permanent nursing staff, including trends, reasons for self-employment, rates and pension coverage. The minister acknowledged the signals as worrying, announced an action-oriented study by VWS and referred to the Actieprogramma Werken in de Zorg, while providing available figures and noting that some data could not be verified.
Given my wish to quickly have insight into a realistic course of action, VWS will shortly commission an (action-oriented) study in which all relevant aspects are mapped out.

Gegeven mijn wens om snel zicht te hebben op een reëel handelingsperspectief zal VWS op korte termijn een (actiegericht) onderzoek laten uitzetten, waarbij alle relevante aspecten in kaart worden gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over straffen en belonen in de jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers whether a silent-sitting punishment and the withdrawal of earned privileges in youth care institutions are still used, whether extra oversight took place after a 2010 ruling, and what is done to protect youths and promote evidence-based methods. The minister answered that Pluryn reports the measure is no longer used, that the IGJ will make unannounced visits and will inspect all closed youth care institutions in early 2019, that advocates reported only minor concerns, and that a knowledge programme on effective methods starts in January 2019.
The IGJ will visit DHG unannounced to verify this as well.
De IGJ zal DHG onaangekondigd bezoeken om dit ook te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Grote onrust: ouderen in deze aanleunwoningen betalen bijna de helft meer voor hun maaltijd'

An MP asked the minister whether ending municipal subsidies for communal meals harms the fight against loneliness, why meal prices rose sharply in a care facility's sheltered housing, and what the extra costs of losing the social activity would be. The minister answered that responsibility lies with municipalities under the Wmo 2015, that the provider raised the price to cover costs after consultations, and that talks between the alderman, residents and provider are ongoing.
Under the Wmo 2015, municipalities are legally responsible for ensuring a suitable range of support based on the personal situation of residents.
Het is op basis van de Wmo 2015 de wettelijke verantwoordelijk van gemeenten om te zorgen voor een passend aanbod van de ondersteuning gebaseerd op de persoonlijke situatie van inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de grote kloof tussen gelukkige en kwetsbare kinderen

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked about the large gap in wellbeing between happy and vulnerable children found by the Children's Ombudsman, including safety at home, stress, youth care, and participation. The minister acknowledged the findings, said the Ombudsman's follow-up research will be awaited, and pointed to existing programmes on domestic violence, child poverty, education equality and sport, without committing to new measures.
We will await the outcomes of the follow-up research and then weigh whether further research is needed.
We zullen de uitkomsten van het vervolgonderzoek afwachten en vervolgens de afweging maken of er nader onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over jarenlange misstanden bij Herstelcentrum C&S

MP Hijink (SP) asked the health minister how she judged years of abuse, neglect, coercion and poor care at Herstelcentrum C&S, why the inspectorates and municipal supervisors missed it until 2016, why clients were housed in old caravans and forced to sign pgb declarations, and what lessons and legislation (Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders) would prevent recurrence. Minister De Jonge condemned the abuses, said the inspectorates received no signals before 2016, announced a municipal evaluation due early 2019 and an agreed framework for pgb-proficiency and entry controls under Wmo 2015.

I will closely follow this evaluation, planned for early 2019, and in consultation with GGD Gelderland Zuid, VNG and IGJ examine which lessons from this case can be translated into the national framework of agreements

Ik zal deze evaluatie, die voor het begin van 2019 staat gepland, intensief volgen en in overleg met de GGD Gelderland Zuid, VNG en IGJ bekijken welke lessen uit deze casus kunnen worden door vertaald naar het landelijke afsprakenkader
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over stilzitstraffen bij de Hoenderloo Groep

Peters (CDA) asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about 'stilzitstraffen' (sitting-still punishments) at youth care institution De Hoenderloo Groep, whether they are unlawful, why they were not abolished sooner, and why the IGJ missed them. Minister De Jonge replied that the measure is not unlawful if applied very sparingly, that the institution says it has stopped using it, that the IGJ will make an unannounced visit to verify this, and that the IGJ had not received signals about it and is reviewing a remediation plan.
The IGJ will visit DHG unannounced to verify this.
De IGJ zal DHG onaangekondigd bezoeken om dit ook te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat de experimentele klas voor hoogbegaafde leerlingen in Leiden (LIVE) in haar voortbestaan wordt bedreigd

An MP asked the ministers about the threatened Leiden experimental class for gifted pupils (LIVE), which lost its education funding because it is not a formal school, and whether the 15 million euro coalition funding and the Thuiszitterspact apply. The minister answered that LIVE is not a recognised school, so education funding and inspectorate oversight do not apply, that municipality and regional partners are responsible, and that they are working with the region and Gedragswerk to find a suitable arrangement.
The initiative has not been designated as a school within the meaning of the Compulsory Education Act 1969. Therefore, funding from education is not permitted.
Het initiatief is niet aangemerkt als school in de zin van de Leerplichtwet 1969. Daarom is financiering vanuit onderwijs niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg inzake het gevonden leeuwenwelpje in Tienhoven

An MP asked the ministers about a lion cub found in Tienhoven, the origin of the animal, the CITES protection of lions, the positive list for mammals kept as pets, and the WHO's inclusion of traditional Chinese medicine in the ICD. The minister declined to disclose origin details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, and otherwise gave largely policy-level answers, committing to consult on the positive list in 2019 and to support CITES disposal work.
This information is part of a criminal investigation.
Deze informatie is onderdeel van strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de uitzending van Radar inzake een 93-jarige dame die in de schulden is gekomen door een fout van het CAK

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a Radar broadcast in which a 93-year-old woman fell into debt after a CAK administrative error on her care contribution. The minister admitted errors, offered a settlement, shortened retroactive recovery to twelve months, and promised a general administrative order and a letter to the CAK.
In response to this undesirable situation, I have decided to shorten the retroactive effect of revisions arising from a serious shortcoming or serious delay on the part of the CAK to twelve months.

Naar aanleiding van deze onwenselijke situatie heb ik besloten de terugwerkende kracht van herzieningen, die ontstaan naar aanleiding van een ernstige tekortkoming of ernstige vertraging aan de kant van het CAK, te verkorten naar twaalf maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het artikel 'Of mevrouw Bastiaansen (93) uit Breda maar even 20 mille wil terugbetalen'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a case where a 93-year-old was asked to repay about 20,000 euros in under-paid care contributions after CAK data errors, and about how often CAK recovers or refunds such amounts. The minister reported five comparable cases, no reporting on causes or totals, and decided to shorten the retroactive recovery period to twelve months for CAK-caused errors and to give CAK more discretion for tailored solutions.
Therefore I have decided to shorten the retroactive effect of revisions arising from a serious shortcoming or serious delay on the part of the CAK to twelve months.

Daarom heb ik besloten de terugwerkende kracht van herzieningen, welke ontstaan naar aanleiding van een ernstige tekortkoming of ernstige vertraging aan de kant van het CAK zijnde, te verkorten naar twaalf maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over structurele problemen bij het CAK

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a 93-year-old woman who received a 27,000 euro bill from CAK due to an administrative error, whether the minister would plead for debt forgiveness, and about CAK's practices, website information and communication. The minister answered that CAK will contact the woman to find a solution, that naheffing periods will be shortened to twelve months and CAK given more room for tailored solutions, that CAK must set contributions immediately after receiving data, that website improvements are ongoing, and that CAK will be asked to communicate personally with clients.

In addition, I want to examine together with CAK how, in cases like this where a client suffers such serious harm due to an error on CAK's side, the period for the back-charge can be considerably shortened.

Daarnaast wil ik samen met het CAK bekijken hoe in dit soort gevallen, waarbij een cliënt zo erg nadeel ondervindt door een fout aan de kant van het CAK, de termijn voor de naheffing aanzienlijk verkort kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over de behandeling van assistentiehonden door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs Bergkamp and Paternotte asked the ministers how airlines such as KLM may verify and treat assistance dogs, including the lack of an official accreditation system and differences between hulphonden and emotional assistance dogs. The minister replied that Dutch law allows refusal only for disproportionate burden or safety reasons, that no accreditation system exists yet pending a European standardisation process, and that the government will remain involved in that process.
It is therefore not an absolute right.
Het is daarmee geen absoluut recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Veel inzet onbevoegd personeel in zorg’

An MP asks the Minister of Health about a survey by V&VN showing staff shortages, unqualified staff being deployed, and patient safety concerns in care. The minister responds that unqualified staff may perform non-care tasks under conditions, that patient-stop measures signal shortages, that the Action Programme Working in Care and regional plans address the problem, and that safety concerns can be reported to the inspectorate.
It is not known what the precise deployment of unqualified or incompetent staff involved in the situations the respondents referred to, nor what exactly is experienced as a risk to patient safety.

Het is niet bekend wat de precieze inzet van onbevoegd of onbekwaam personeel inhield in de situaties waar de respondenten naar verwezen en wat precies als risico voor de patiëntveiligheid wordt ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over de werkdruk in de thuiszorg

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Health about reports of heavy workload in home care, including missed mandatory breaks, unpaid travel time and accrued minus-hours, and asked about Actiz talks and the sector's tariff structure. The minister said the signals concern employers not honouring CAO agreements, that workers should first raise it with their employer and can seek help from unions or legal aid, and that the Actiz contact will be followed up with members.
If an employer does not honour the CAO agreements, the first step is for the employee concerned to raise it with the employer.
Als een werkgever de cao-afspraken niet nakomt, is het in eerste instantie zaak dat hij daarop wordt aangesproken door de betreffende medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel 'Beroepsgroep gynaecologen: IVF-draagmoederschap ook mogelijk voor homostellen'

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked nine questions about the NVOG's 2016 position allowing IVF surrogacy with donor gametes, including its medical, legal and privacy implications and costs. The Minister answered that the position was grounded in a careful assessment, that surrogacy is already possible, that costs for non-medical cases are not covered by basic insurance, and that the government is not responsible for clinic decisions, offering limited commitments.
Offering IVF surrogacy is separate from a decision on a legal framework and from the research on this in the context of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap advice.
Het aanbieden van ivf-draagmoederschap staat los van een besluit tot een juridische regeling en de onderzoeken daarnaar in het kader van het advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Nederlandse vrouw moet langer wachten op anticonceptiepil’

MPs Ellemeet and Ploumen asked about a shortage of contraceptive pills and whether the preferential reimbursement policy of insurers contributes to it. The minister said supply should recover in December 2018 or January 2019, that the shortage stems from production problems rather than preference policy, and that the measures taken will be evaluated.
In the working group on medicine shortages I will evaluate the measures taken to prevent medicine shortages based on the cases from 2017 and 2018.
In de werkgroep geneesmiddeltekorten zal ik de genomen maatregelen om geneesmiddelentekorten te voorkómen evalueren op basis van de casuïstiek uit 2017 en 2018.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema, De Graaf en Markuszower over de door een prediker gedane uitspraak in een online cursus van de As Soenah moskee te Den Haag, te weten: ‘Vrouwenbesnijdenis is niet verplicht

MPs Wilders, Agema, De Graaf and Markuszower asked about a preacher's statement that female genital cutting is recommended though not mandatory, and how many girls were cut, how many cases were prosecuted, and what subsidised organisations do. The minister answered that prevalence research is under way with results expected mid-2019, that cutting is prosecuted as assault, that cases are not registered separately, and that the government funds an integrated chain approach and will report on it in a progress letter.
It therefore cannot be retrieved from the registers how many court cases of genital mutilation there are.
Het is daarom niet uit de registers te halen om hoeveel rechtszaken van genitale verminking het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de aanbesteding jeugdzorg in Noord Holland Noord

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Health about a tender for closed youth care in Noord-Holland Noord that led to a court case by provider Transferium, and about the risk to continuity of care and visitation for vulnerable youths. The Minister said he is monitoring the situation, that gemeenten must ensure continuity and closed youth care availability in the region, and that he will intervene if the parties cannot agree.

If the municipalities and the institutions still fail to reach agreement together, so that the availability of closed youth care is jeopardised, I will take the steps necessary to secure availability nonetheless.

In het geval dat de gemeenten en de instellingen er toch gezamenlijk niet uitkomen, waardoor de beschikbaarheid van gesloten jeugdhulp in het gedrang komt, zal ik die stappen zetten die nodig zijn om alsnog de beschikbaarheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de toename van het aantal daklozen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a wheelchair-using homeless woman refused at a Haarlem night shelter, the rising number of homeless people, waiting lists, and municipalities refusing postal addresses to homeless people. The State Secretary answers that the woman now has shelter, that CBS figures show homelessness rising to 2015 with a dip in 2016, that no national waiting-list data exist, and that the Ministry of BZK has pursued municipalities on postal-address refusals and will raise the issue with them.
Municipalities are legally responsible for providing good help and support.
Gemeenten zijn wettelijk verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van goede hulp en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over pleegzorg door grootouders

An MP asked the health minister whether he agrees that more grandparents could take in children in foster care, whether a codicil should be introduced, and whether legal barriers exist. The minister said the network is already considered first, that he will work with Jeugdzorg Nederland on recruitment and review fiscal and legal obstacles, but does not see a role in introducing a codicil nationally.
In light of this, I currently see no role for myself in introducing such a codicil nationally.
Mede tegen deze achtergrond zie ik vooralsnog geen rol voor mij om een dergelijk codicil landelijk in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Schrik bij hoogbejaarde: Leiden halveert huishoudelijke hulp’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that Leiden reduced a 90-year-old's personal budget for domestic help by half without consultation, and whether this would be reversed. The minister replied that Leiden introduced a new, needs-based regime after case law, the budget was lowered after a call and a decision letter, and after new information the municipality raised the budget.
In this contact it did not appear that circumstances had since changed.
In dit contact is niet gebleken dat er inmiddels sprake was van gewijzigde omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Veldhovense wethouder: Budgetplafonds Eindhoven gaan in tegen de wet'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether municipal budget caps on youth care and social support providers conflict with the municipal duty of care under the Jeugdwet and Wmo 2015, and whether the Minister would intervene in Eindhoven. The Minister replied that budget caps are not per se incompatible with the law, that municipal councils are first responsible for controlling the executive, and that he sees no reason to intervene in Eindhoven at present.

If the executive fails to meet its legal responsibilities, in this case contracting sufficient providers to meet demand for support, the municipal council is first in line to scrutinise and correct the executive.

Mocht het college nalaten om aan de wettelijke verantwoordelijkheden, in dit geval het voldoende gecontracteerd hebben van aanbieders om aan de vraag om ondersteuning te kunnen voldoen, dan is in eerste instantie de gemeenteraad aan zet om het college hierop te controleren en bij te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de crisis bij Careyn

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a crisis at care provider Careyn, including the forced relocation of 22 elderly residents, client council advice, ministerial questions on appeal rights, staff sick leave and the IGJ supervisory order. The Minister answered most questions, saying the IGJ will publish its findings on the supervisory order around early 2019 and that the relocation is Careyn's responsibility, while declining to name the auditor or explain the council chair's resignation.
When the IGJ sees reason to do so, it examines whether care is safe and of sufficient quality.
Wanneer IGJ daar aanleiding toe ziet, onderzoekt ze of zorg veilig en van voldoende kwaliteit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Managers Careyn oorzaak diepe crisis Tuindorp-Oost’

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Health whether mismanaging managers caused the crisis at care provider Careyn in Tuindorp-Oost, how relocation of elderly residents, high sick leave and Careyn's finances are being addressed. The Minister answers that care providers are primarily responsible themselves, that IGJ supervision of Careyn is ongoing, that 22 residents must move for safety reasons, and refers to the annual report for finances.
Care organisations are primarily responsible themselves for the quality of care and business operations as well as for continuity of governance.
Zorgorganisaties zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de zorg en de bedrijfsvoering alsmede voor de continuïteit in het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat vrijwilligers in de zorg vaak taken uitvoeren waarvoor een opleiding is vereist

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how he responds to a report that a fifth of volunteers in care perform medical tasks requiring training, and whether it is unacceptable that municipalities expect such tasks from volunteers. The minister says such situations are incidental, reaffirms the Wet BIG rules on reserved acts and supervision, and promises a further letter on volunteer-professional cooperation by year end.
I am not aware of situations in which volunteers structurally perform medical acts for which they have not been trained.
Ik ben niet bekend met situaties waarin vrijwilligers structureel medische handelingen uitvoeren waarvoor zij niet zijn opgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over zorgondernemer, de heer Winter

SP MPs asked the health minister about the bankruptcies of hospitals run by entrepreneur Loek Winter, including calls for NZa investigation of financial constructions, conflicts of interest, WNT compliance and property profits. The minister answered that curators will investigate, that the IGJ and NZa will be asked to examine financial constructions with a letter promised by end of November, and that other questions await separate studies or are left to the curator.
Yes, as promised I will ask the IGJ and the NZa to investigate the financial constructions at the hospitals.
Ja, zoals toegezegd zal ik de IGJ en de NZa vragen om onderzoek te doen naar de financiële constructies bij de ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Geweerde zorgbureaus slepen in andere Twentse gemeenten nieuw contract in de wacht’

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health about reports that excluded home-care agencies were winning new contracts in other Twente municipalities, asking whether the IGJ would investigate and whether municipalities are taking unacceptable risks with care funds. The minister replied that the IGJ has no ongoing investigation into these agencies, that municipalities bear primary responsibility for contracting and quality checks, and that he sees no reason to act against the municipalities concerned.
Currently, an investigation by the social investigation service is still ongoing.
Op dit moment loopt nog onderzoek van de sociale recherche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Agnes Mulder over het instellen van wachttijden door de gemeente Assen om tekorten in het sociaal domein tegen te gaan

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about Assen's plans to introduce waiting times and budget caps in youth care and Wmo to curb deficits in the social domain. The minister confirmed awareness, noted the council removed the waiting-time proposal before adopting the measures, and stressed that municipalities retain a statutory duty to provide youth care regardless of budget overruns.
The mere fact that the municipal youth care budget is (threatening to be) exceeded does not detract from the youth care obligation.
Het enkele feit dat het gemeentelijk budget voor jeugdhulp overschreden (dreigt) te worden doet niet af aan de jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Gemeenten verschillen te veel bij toewijzing langdurige zorg?'

An MP from the CDA asked the Health Minister about large differences between municipalities in rejecting long-term care (Wlz) applications for children, and whether affected families receive the care municipalities are responsible for. The minister confirmed the figures are correct but said the causes are unclear, pointed to knowledge gaps among municipalities, providers and families, noted the CIZ assesses applications objectively, and pledged outreach and better client support.
I have no reason to assume that municipalities that quickly request a Wlz assessment provide less good care.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat gemeenten die snel een Wlz-indicatie aanvragen misschien minder goede zorg bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over begeleiding van pleegouders

An MP asked the Minister of Health about criticism by inspectorates of the supervision of foster parents in the Hannah case, about a critical 'zwartboek' on Jeugdbescherming Brabant, and about complaint routes and further investigation into foster-care support. The minister acknowledged errors in the case, pointed to an internal investigation, inspectorate oversight and a planned joint audit, and described existing complaint procedures and an ongoing evaluation of the foster-parent position law.
Jeugdbescherming Brabant (JBB) and Combinatie Jeugdzorg (CJZ) reported the calamity to the inspectorates and, also at the inspectorates' request, carried out an internal investigation into the case.

Jeugdbescherming Brabant (JBB) en Combinatie Jeugdzorg (CJZ) hebben de calamiteit bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd en de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (hierna inspecties) gemeld en hebben, ook op verzoek van de inspecties, een intern onderzoek naar de zaak uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Ellemeet over de ondertekening van CIZ-aanvragen van wilsonbekwame cliënten

MPs Bergkamp and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about the signing of CIZ care applications by incapacitated clients, given delays and the lack of a clear rule on who may sign. The Minister defends the current Wlz signing rules, describes an interim CIZ practice accepting proof that guardianship is being arranged, and promises talks with ActiZ, VGN and CIZ and a clear arrangement, while rejecting any change to the Wlz itself.
I am in consultation with ActiZ, VGN and the CIZ to examine how the CIZ can process applications quickly without harming clients' interests.
Ik ben met ActiZ, VGN en het CIZ in overleg om te bezien op welke manier het CIZ snel aanvragen in behandeling kan nemen, zonder afbreuk te doen aan de belangen van cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de rapportage ‘Eindrapportage verdeling fonds tekortgemeenten’

MP Tielen (VVD) asks the Health Minister about the VNG final report on distributing the 200 million euro Fonds Tekortgemeenten, questioning the use of accountant statements and budgets, the absence of a substantive policy check, the 50%/100% compensation tiers, the large differences between comparable municipalities, and whether the scheme rewards passive policy. The minister replies that the criteria were approved by the VNG general meeting, that accountant statements concern lawfulness rather than policy, that municipalities chose not to test policy for practical reasons, and that a youth benchmark study is underway with results expected in spring 2019, without committing to a successor fund.
That is why other sources of information were also used.
Daarom is ook gebruik gemaakt van andere informatiebronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over loverboypraktijken in jeugdinstellingen

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers about alleged loverboy practices in youth institutions, including a suspect formerly employed by Hoenderloo Groep and unsafe situations at several facilities. The government answered that the criminal case is pending, that the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care is investigating the signals and monitoring Juzt, and that it has no other current signals beyond these institutions, while the national rapporteur reports on trafficking and a programme against trafficking is forthcoming.
Because the case is still before the court, I cannot make further statements about this case.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is, kan ik over deze zaak geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat farmaceutisch bedrijven voor miljarden aan belasting ontwijken

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked whether the government would tie pharmaceutical companies' tax conduct to drug price negotiations, and about tax competition, the innovation box and a sector code on pricing. The State Secretary replied that the corporate tax cut is largely financed by base broadening, defended the innovation box as meeting OECD standards, and said tax morality plays no role in price negotiations while welcoming the voluntary pharma code.
Under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act I cannot discuss the way individual companies fulfil their tax obligations.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de manier waarop individuele bedrijven hun belastingplicht voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het beëindigen van regionale inkoop jeugdzorg in Brabant

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether he is aware that 21 municipalities in Brabant are ending joint regional purchasing of ambulatory youth care, whether this is driven by rising deficits and Eindhoven's budget caps, and whether he will act and use the pending amendment to force regional purchasing. The minister confirms awareness, explains the region is splitting non-statutory purchasing into two regions while keeping core services joint, says he monitors developments and will intervene if care availability is at risk, and sees no reason yet to engage the municipalities.

As system responsible I am following these developments and keeping a finger on the pulse. Should the availability of youth care come under pressure, I will take the steps necessary to nonetheless secure availability.

Ik volg als stelselverantwoordelijke deze ontwikkelingen en houd een «vinger aan de pols». In het geval de beschikbaarheid van jeugdhulp in het gedrang komt, zal ik die stappen zetten die nodig zijn om alsnog de beschikbaarheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Wijkzorg sjoemelt tegen ondervoeding'

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about reports that district nurses misreport hours to get meal assistance approved for elderly people at risk of malnutrition, and who is responsible when both insurer and municipality refuse. The minister acknowledged the problem, said responsibility is clear within each system but unclear at the Wmo/Zvw boundary, and promised a joint factsheet with VNG, ZN, V&VN and ZIN before Christmas.

Furthermore, I believe it is up to care professionals, health insurers and municipalities to arrange behind the scenes that help is provided as smartly and timely as possible and is financed in the right way.

Daarnaast vind ik het aan zorgprofessionals, zorgverzekeraars en gemeenten om achter de schermen te regelen dat de hulp zo slim en tijdig mogelijk wordt geleverd en op de juiste manier wordt bekostigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Aantal euthanasiegevallen daalt voor het eerst in jaren’

An MP asks the health minister whether doctors are becoming more reluctant to perform euthanasia out of fear of prosecution, and about waiting lists at the Levenseindekliniek and the study into rising euthanasia numbers. The minister answers that the reluctance is known but not investigated, that the Public Prosecution Service's independent role is defended, that capacity is largely adequate, and that a study will report in spring 2020.
Whether this is actually the case has not been investigated.
Of dit feitelijk ook zo is, is niet onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het fors toenemend aantal ZZP’ers in de zorg

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about the rapid rise of self-employed (ZZP) workers in care and its effects on quality, continuity and staff workload. The minister answered that quality obligations and inspection apply equally to self-employed workers, and pointed to the workforce action programme and the regulatory-burden programme as responses.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) supervises the quality, safety and accessibility of care and does not distinguish by the type of employment relationship.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) houdt toezicht op de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toegankelijkheid van de zorg en maakt daarbij geen onderscheid naar de aard van het dienstverband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over signalen dat het registratieproces van gediplomeerde jeugdhulpwerkers bij SKJ te traag is

An MP asked the Minister whether the Kwaliteitsregister Jeugd (SKJ) registration of youth care workers is too slow, and whether this leaves professionals working unregistered and risks quality. The Minister answered that most applications are processed within the six-week term, average processing is five weeks, and that the ministry sees no evidence registration delays prevent meeting the 1 January 2019 deadline, while offering to discuss with SKJ if needed.
At present there are no indications that the processing time from registration to youth and family professional is a bottleneck
Op dit moment zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de doorlooptijd van registratie tot jeugd- en gezinsprofessional een knelpunt is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over gezinshuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about children placed in family-style group homes, frequent relocation of children in care, the tax treatment of foster-home carers, and reducing closed placements. The Minister agreed relocations should be minimised, promised talks on family-style care and a quality framework, and a stepwise approach to fewer closed placements, without giving figures.
Figures on this are unfortunately not available.
Cijfers hierover zijn helaas niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het gestegen aantal zelfmoorden van jongeren die Jeugdhulp krijgen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about rising youth suicides among young people receiving youth care, whether children get timely help, the causes, and whether suicide attempts should be better recorded. The minister answered that a deeper investigation of the 81 cases is pending, that the inspectorate handles calamities, and that a programme to reduce closed placements and improve timely care is underway.
I cannot give an answer to this question at this time.
Op deze vraag kan ik nu geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten ‘Oproep aan ouders en personeel Arduin: spreek je samen uit’ en ‘Arduin is in nood, maar raad van toezicht verhoogt eigen beloning flink’

An MP asked the health minister about reports of a fear culture at care provider Arduin, dismissals of staff who spoke out, and a large pay rise for its supervisory board. The minister said the IGJ monitors Arduin closely, that the board's raise was unwise, and asked CIBG to check compliance with the top-income standards.
I have asked the agency CIBG to investigate whether there is a violation of the Top Income Standards Act in this case.
Ik heb het agentschap CIBG gevraagd te onderzoeken of in dit geval sprake is van een overtreding van de Wet Normering Topinkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Slootweg over het bericht 'Hulpbehoevenden aansporen om hun omgeving in te zetten werkt niet'

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Health about a study finding that encouraging frail elderly and chronically ill people to draw on their own networks often fails, with help obtained in only 3 of 64 keukentafelgesprekken. The minister acknowledged the findings, said the policy is not being revised, pointed to Langer Thuis and a respite-care coordinator, and gave partial answers on respite care, mantelzorg numbers and sollicitatieplicht exemptions, withholding the counts of exemptions.
I have no insight into the number of exemptions from the job-application obligation due to informal care.
Ik heb geen inzicht in aantallen vrijstellingen van de sollicitatieplicht vanwege mantelzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de grote vertraging bij de herbeoordeling van bestrijdingsmiddelen

An MP asked the ministers why pesticide active substances with possible harmful properties have had their EU approvals extended without full reassessment, and why Dutch authorisations remain in place. The minister replied that delays are due to procedural and capacity reasons, that extensions are temporary pending full review, that the Ctgb is the competent authority and acts when new scientific information warrants it, and that it is not for the minister to instruct the Ctgb.
The Ctgb is the competent authority in the Netherlands for decisions on whether to authorise plant protection products.
Het Ctgb is in Nederland de bevoegde autoriteit voor besluiten over het al dan niet toelaten van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Zeeuwse zorginstelling is in nood maar toezichthouders verhogen eigen beloning’

MP Agema asks why supervisory board members of Arduin, a Zeeland care institution in distress and closed by the Inspectorate, raised their own pay by 66%, and whether sanctions will be taken against its board. The minister answers that pay of supervisory boards is set under the WNT, that he asked CIBG to check for a violation and enforce if found, and that the decision was unwise given Arduin's situation.
I have asked CIBG to investigate whether there is a violation of the WNT.
Ik heb het CIBG gevraagd te onderzoeken of hier sprake is van overtreding van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘8% van de Nederlandse vrouwen koopt geen anticonceptie uit geldgebrek’

An MP asked the health minister about a report that 8% of Dutch women skipped buying contraception for financial reasons, and whether abortion is financially accessible for undocumented women. The minister acknowledged vulnerable women sometimes forgo contraception, pointed to the nationwide Nu Niet Zwanger programme funded via municipalities, said contraception is not basic insurance care, and explained that uninsured women pay abortion clinics directly under a maximum tariff set by the NZa.
I am of the view that the nationwide Nu Niet Zwanger programme reaches a large group of vulnerable women.
Ik ben van mening dat met het landsdekkende programma Nu Niet Zwanger een grote groep kwetsbare vrouwen wordt bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Slootweg over de wenselijkheid van initiatieven als het ‘Kindergasthuis de Boeg’

Two MPs asked the government whether initiatives like Kindergasthuis De Boeg, a family guest house near hospitals, are desirable, how many exist, their costs compared with hospital stays, and how they could be supported. The minister answered that the houses are valuable for families but not a government responsibility, offered no overview or budget, and said hospitals remain primarily responsible for medical aspects.
I have no overview of the number of initiatives.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de aantallen initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht dat de pro-life beweging Siriz geen objectieve informatie geeft aan zwangere vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked whether the government shares concerns that counselling organisation Siriz, funded for unwanted-pregnancy support, steered women with leading chat questions and whether subsidies should change.
