The State Secretary answered that new quality criteria and an open-house funding model will apply from 2019, that organisations may hold their values but must not steer the woman's choice, and that the matter will be discussed with the parties.
For me it is important that all choice-support conversations must meet the same quality standards.
Voor mij is het daarbij belangrijk dat alle keuzehulpgesprekken moeten voldoen aan dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het bericht 'Haperende ICT in de Zorg: verkeerde medicatie, foute beslissingen'

MPs Rutte and Hermans asked the health minister about NOS reports of faulty ICT in healthcare causing dangerous medication errors, asking who is responsible and whether the Inspectorate can oversee it. The minister said information exchange agreements are a shared responsibility of care providers coordinated through the Informatieberaad, that the Inspectorate has carried out exploratory inspections and publishes findings, and that the VIPP programme deadlines are being pursued with a possible deadline extension for some clinics.
On the question of whether government should take more control on this point, I will return to it in the letter you receive at the end of this year on electronic data exchange.
Over de vraag of de overheid op dit punt meer regie zou moeten voeren kom ik terug in de brief die u aan het eind van dit jaar ontvangt over elektronische gegevensuitwisseling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht  'Inspectie: Arduin moet direct stoppen met behandelen van cliënten in Aagtekerke'

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked about the Inspectorate's order that Arduin stop treating clients at Aagtekerke, including whether only seven clients were affected, how care is guaranteed, the board's responsibilities, and board and supervisory pay and profit since 2014. Minister De Jonge answered that the Inspectorate found acute danger in coercion-related care, four of six involuntarily admitted clients were transferred and the order has ended, responsibility lies with the board and supervisory board under the Wkkgz, and provided pay and profit tables.

The Inspectorate considers that, although the conditions for good coercion-related care are currently insufficiently secured, the shortcomings no longer pose an acute danger to the safety or health of the clients.

De inspectie is van oordeel dat, hoewel op dit moment de voorwaarden voor goede bopz-gerelateerde zorg onvoldoende zijn geborgd, de tekortkomingen geen acuut gevaar meer vormen voor de veiligheid of gezondheid van de cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over informatiereizen in de zorg

An SP MP asked why the ministry commissioned a handbook on 'information journeys' in healthcare using personas, questioning whether it insults care workers and why it uses jargon like 'klant'. The minister answered that it aims to keep information provision patient-centred, that the wording is not objectionable, and that the handbook cost EUR 7,529.
Het realiseren van de handreiking heeft € 7.529 euro gekost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht Drugshandel en pooiers jongere niet veilig in jeugdzorg-instelling Heldring

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that youths in the Heldring youth care institution were unsafe due to drug dealing and pimps, and whether the Inspectorate (IGJ) would investigate, along with staffing, loverboy risks and the inspectorate's earlier role. The minister said the signals are taken seriously, that the institution is commissioning an independent safety analysis under IGJ supervision, and that the IGJ will decide on further steps afterward.
The inspectorate and the Heldring foundation jointly agreed that the Heldring foundation will have an in-depth analysis of the safety situation carried out.
De inspectie en de Heldringstichting hebben gezamenlijk afgesproken dat de Heldringstichting een diepgravende analyse van de veiligheidssituatie laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Hermans over het bericht dat ouderen zich niet bewust zijn van toeslagen

VVD MPs Lodders and Hermans asked the government about reports that many elderly people do not claim the healthcare and rent allowances they are entitled to, and what steps will be taken. The government acknowledges non-take-up, says it cannot confirm the healthcare-allowance figures, and defers concrete measures to an IBO review of the allowance system due in spring and autumn 2019.
The cabinet will, as mentioned above, start an IBO study into the allowance system.
Het kabinet zal, zoals hierboven reeds vermeld, een IBO onderzoek starten naar het toeslagenstelsel.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de gemeente Eindhoven huishoudelijke hulp niet levert (wat al erg is) maar dat er daarenboven notabene een verplichte eigen bijdrage moet worden betaald

An MP asks the health minister whether it is acceptable that Eindhoven suspends home-help (Wmo) care for three weeks in summer and makes clients pay a fixed contribution anyway, and whether the law should change. The minister answers that reducing care unilaterally is not allowed, that the matter is a local responsibility handled by the municipal council, that a subscription-rate contribution is planned from 2019, and that no legal amendment is needed.
A unilateral (temporary) reduction in the scope of support, such that it can no longer be regarded as appropriate, must not occur.
Van het eenzijdig (tijdelijk) terugbrengen van de omvang van de ondersteuning, met als gevolg dat deze niet langer als passend kan worden aangemerkt, mag geen sprake zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Kuiken over de uitzending van Brandpunt+ over eenzame jongeren

MPs Raemakers and Kuiken asked the health minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on loneliness among young people, including whether the action programme 'Eén tegen eenzaamheid' neglects young people, the causes and risks, municipal and youth-care responses, suicide trends and an LHBTI project. The minister answered that the programme focuses on older people for substantive reasons, acknowledged that loneliness among young people is a taboo and a social problem, outlined preventive and youth-care measures, and declined to set up a separate action programme for young people.
I am not planning to draw up an action programme for loneliness among young people as well.
Ik ben niet voornemens om ook voor eenzaamheid onder jongeren een actieprogramma op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'VVD onder vuur om Wmo-advies'

An MP asked whether VVD senator Anne-Wil Duthler voted on a bill containing advice from her own firm, how much work the firm received, and whether the tender would be disclosed. The minister answered that the firm was hired in 2013 for a privacy impact assessment at a total cost of EUR 78,400 via a single-tender procurement, and that part of its advice was adopted.
Bureau Duthler was asked to carry out this privacy impact assessment.
Bureau Duthler is aangezocht om deze pia te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de schijn van belangenverstrengeling met de totstandkoming van de Wmo 2015

An SP MP asked the health minister about the appearance of conflict of interest after a VVD senator's firm, Bureau Duthler Associates, advised the ministry on a privacy impact assessment for the Wmo 2015 bill, and asked for the advice and its effect on the bill. The minister answered that the firm was hired for specialist privacy input in 2013, that the advice was published with the bill in January 2014 and partly adopted, and that assessing conflict of interest is primarily the senators' own responsibility.
I consider it primarily a matter for the senators themselves to weigh whether involvement in an assignment can lead to a conflict of interest.
Ik vind het primair een zaak van senatoren zelf om een afweging te maken of betrokkenheid bij een opdracht kan leiden tot belangenverstrengeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Peters over een aanbesteding jeugdbescherming en de jeugdreclassering in Noord-Holland

MPs Kuiken and Peters asked the minister about a failed open-house tender for youth protection and youth probation in 25 Noord-Holland municipalities, the risk to continuity of care, and time-recording demands. The minister answered that the open-house procedure is ongoing so no conclusions can yet be drawn, that municipalities are responsible for securing provision while the ministry monitors the situation and will intervene if needed, and that the ministry will raise time-recording requirements with municipalities.

If municipalities and institutions still fail to reach agreement together, so that the availability of youth protection and youth probation is jeopardised, we will take the steps necessary to secure availability.

In het geval dat de gemeenten en de instellingen er toch gezamenlijk niet uitkomen, waardoor de beschikbaarheid van jeugdbescherming en jeugdreclassering in het gedrang komt, zullen we die stappen zetten die nodig zijn om alsnog de beschikbaarheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over seksuele uitbuiting in een jeugdzorginstelling

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked about sexual exploitation of girls in a closed youth care institution in Zetten and whether the inspectorate's assessment framework is adequate. The minister said the case is before court, that the inspectorates have requested an in-depth independent investigation by the foundation, and that the framework will be reflected on after that investigation.
The inspectorates want to be informed about the facts and any shortcomings in the care provided to the young people concerned.
De inspecties willen geïnformeerd worden over de feiten en eventuele tekortkomingen in de hulp aan zowel de betreffende jeugdigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat een verdienmodel voor thuiszorgtechnologie ontbreekt

MP Ellemeet asked the health minister whether the lack of a business model for home-care technology, which leaves producers with an uncertain market, is a concern and whether VWS should steer financing of specific applications. Minister De Jonge answered that reimbursement is possible within existing rules through indirect funding, negotiated tariffs and experiments, and that VWS is stimulating uptake through a planned E-health Thuis scheme, though he gave no commitment to direct central steering.
I expect to be able to inform the House about the stimulation scheme in early 2019.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in het vroege begin 2019 over de stimuleringsregeling te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de positie van medewerkers in de jeugdhulp

An MP asked the Minister of Health why employment in youth care lags behind other sectors, what causes high turnover and sick leave, and whether administrative burden and tendering add to workload. The minister answered that an labour market study of the wider youth domain is underway with results expected in autumn 2018, that the causes lie largely with employers and sector parties, and that administrative burden reduction and a recruitment campaign are being pursued.
I will inform your House about this, as already committed to in the Action Programme Youth Care of the Minister for Legal Protection and me of 16 April 2018.

Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren, zoals ook reeds in het kader van het Actieprogramma Zorg voor de jeugd van de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en mij van 16 april 2018 (Kamerstuk 34 880, nr.3 ) is toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Meer mantelzorg verwachten is politiek wensdenken’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a report questioning whether policy promoting self-reliance and more informal care (mantelzorg) is working, and about loneliness among Wmo users and dementia caregivers. The minister rejected the claim that policy expects far more caregiving, said regional ageing requires more support, and listed programmes such as Langer Thuis and Eén tegen eenzaamheid, without changing policy.
Data on the percentage of informal carers who feel lonely, however, are not available.
Gegevens over het percentage mantelzorgers met gevoelens van eenzaamheid zijn echter niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het achterhouden van informatie voor de Kamer

An MP asked the Health Minister whether the Chamber was fully informed about a dossier after a newspaper report that a Landsadvocaat memo had not been shared with parliament. The minister replied that advice from the Landsadvocaat is confidential by policy, that the minister makes an independent assessment, and that the Chamber is always informed as fully and timely as possible.
It is established policy not to share advice from the Landsadvocaat with the Chamber, as such advice, like lawyers' advice in general, is confidential.
Het is staand beleid om adviezen van de Landsadvocaat, die net als adviezen van advocaten in het algemeen vertrouwelijk zijn, niet met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de berichtgeving dat uit onderzoek blijkt dat het aansporen van hulpbehoevenden om hun omgeving in te zetten niet werkt

An MP asked whether the government will change its policy of urging vulnerable people to mobilise their own networks, given research finding this rarely yields help and may increase inequality and pressure. The minister replied that the approach is still developing, that some households need support from professionals, and that programmes such as Langer Thuis and Eén tegen eenzaamheid will be continued, without committing to a substantive policy change.
Of course attention must be paid to households that prove themselves insufficiently able to articulate their support need and/or to oversee how it is organised.
Er moet uiteraard wel aandacht zijn voor huishoudens die zelf onvoldoende in staat blijken te zijn hun ondersteuningsvraag te articuleren en/of de wijze van organiseren te kunnen overzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Personeel Arduin slaat alarm'

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked the health minister about staff shortages at Arduin, a disability care provider, after staff raised alarm, and how the Inspectorate (IGJ) monitors it. The minister says the Inspectorate follows Arduin intensively, including unannounced visits and an order at one location, and points to the national 'Werken in de zorg' programme and Arduin's participation in the regional plan.
The inspectorate follows Arduin intensively, as also appears from my answer to earlier parliamentary questions.
De inspectie volgt Arduin intensief, zo blijkt ook uit mijn beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat zorgaanbieders mogelijk niet de wachttijden van casemanagement dementie willen registreren

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that care providers may not want to register waiting times for dementia case management, and about the transparency rules the NZa will introduce on 1 December 2018. The Minister confirmed the 62,000 users and 2,359 professionals, said waiting times must be visible at regional level, and stated the regulation will take effect as planned despite objections from ActiZ and BTN.
To fully curb waiting times nationwide, it is important that there is structural insight into the state of waiting lists and waiting times at regional level.
Om de wachttijden in het hele land volledig terug te dringen, is het van belang dat er structureel zicht is op de stand van de wachtlijsten en -tijden op regioniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over een fout in de herberekening van de eigen bijdrage

An SP MP asked the health minister about a 27-year-old care resident whose income was miscalculated by UWV, leaving him with less pocket money than the minimum, and asked how common such cases are and whether the 2,500 euro threshold for requesting a recalculation should change. The minister explained the two-year income basis, reported 5,576 approved reference-year changes in 2016, and refused to change the threshold, citing administrative burden.
The administrative burden of a reference-year change must be weighed against its effect on the current personal contribution.
De administratieve lasten van een peiljaarverlegging dienen op te wegen tegen het effect op de lopende eigen bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de belofte dat mensen uit batch 1588 voor 19 juli duidelijkheid zouden hebben en de gevolgen voor de stressbeleving van mensen wanneer dit niet gebeurt

An SP MP asked whether residents of batch 1.588 received the promised letter giving clarity before 19 July, and about stress and distrust when clarity is delayed. The minister confirmed the letter was sent, said the group's composition is unchanged and the reinforcement approach can proceed, and reported on the health action plan and related programmes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het beleid van pappen en nathouden van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd bij inspecties in thuiszorginstellingen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Hijink asked the Health Minister whether the Inspectorate's practice of 'papping en nathouden' (giving new home-care providers repeated chances to correct failings) is acceptable after a Consumentenbond study, and whether structural causes such as staff shortages lie behind the failings. The minister replied that the Inspectorate works with providers' capacity to improve, follows up with re-inspections, escalates when needed, that staff shortages are a sector-wide issue addressed by an action programme, and that the Inspectorate will increase oversight of home care and a notification duty for new providers is being legislated.
Therefore the IGJ will, this year and in the coming years too, exercise more supervision over home care.
Daarom gaat de IGJ nog dit jaar – en ook komende jaren – meer toezicht houden op de thuiszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over falend toezicht en ongeschoold personeel in de thuiszorg

MP Kerstens asked the health minister why the inspectorate does not intervene against thuiszorg providers failing basic requirements and employing unqualified staff, and what will be done about it. The minister acknowledges the findings, says the IGJ demands improvement with follow-up visits and escalates enforcement where needed, and points to the Wtza bill and the Werken in de Zorg programme.
The IGJ therefore demands further improvement from those care providers.
De IGJ eist daarom verdere verbetering bij die zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het beleid van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd bij inspecties bij thuiszorginstellingen

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Health about the Inspectorate's (IGJ) approach to inspecting home-care providers, including its intervention powers, the handover of providers to another department, the 15 quality conditions, and follow-up on improvements. The Minister answered that the IGJ has sufficient powers, applies a risk-based approach with a dedicated team for new providers, and will intensify home-care supervision this year, while stating that signals should be reported to the national complaints point.
The IGJ has sufficient options to intervene when it finds shortcomings.
De IGJ heeft voldoende mogelijkheden om in te grijpen wanneer zij tekortkomingen constateert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Rechtbank geeft Nijmegen tik op vingers; zorgfraude niet aangetoond'

An MP asked the health minister about a court ruling that the municipality of Nijmegen had not proven care fraud at a care provider, and about municipal control over personal budgets (pgb). The minister left the court case to the judge, said municipalities can check budget holders and that a policy review of the pgb is underway, and gave figures on pgb fraude.
I leave the assessment of the case to the judge.
Ik laat het beoordelen van de zaak aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over Rotterdamse wijkteams die verdrinken in regels en controles, waardoor mensen lang moeten wachten op zorg en ondersteuning

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that Rotterdam neighbourhood teams are overwhelmed by municipal rules and controls, causing long waits for care, and whether a 30-page intake form is acceptable. The Minister declined to judge the Rotterdam Court of Audit findings, leaving the assessment to the Rotterdam council and executive, and pointed to national programmes on reducing administrative burden and a planned consultation with field parties in 2018-2019.
The vast majority of municipalities choose to use neighbourhood teams in implementing the Youth Act and the Wmo 2015.
Het overgrote deel van de gemeenten kiest ervoor bij de uitvoering van de Jeugdwet en de Wmo 2015 gebruik te maken van wijkteams.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de tekorten aan wijkverpleegkundigen in de zomer

An MP asked the Minister of Health about shortages of district nurses in summer 2018, including reports that office staff were deployed to cover gaps and whether the shortfall was underestimated. The minister said the shortage is structural across care and welfare, pointed to the Actieprogramma Werken in de Zorg, the 2018-2021 Hoofdlijnenakkoord Wijkverpleging, and the Inspectie's monitoring of non-care staff use, while declining to confirm the one-in-three figure or the vacancy count.
I cannot confirm the number of open care vacancies mentioned in the article.
Het in het artikel genoemde aantal openstaande zorgvacatures kan ik niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Toorenburg over onnodig confronterende vragen op evaluatieformulieren voor ouders van kinderen met zeer ernstige verstandelijke en meervoudige beperkingen (ZEVMB)

Two MPs asked whether evaluation forms that ask parents who are curators of children with severe multiple disabilities (ZEVMB) about their children's self-reliance are unnecessarily confronting, and whether the forms can be changed. The minister acknowledges the questions can be painful, reports that the form has been revised so parents can skip questions with a medical statement, and says the issue will be discussed with stakeholders and the Werkgroep Wij zien je Wel.
At the second periodic evaluation, answering the questions can be much shorter via a specific ZEVMB-targeted route.
Bij de tweede periodieke evaluatie kan de beantwoording van de vragen veel korter zijn via een «afslag», die specifiek is gericht op ZEVMB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over Tzorg dat gedurende de zomerperiode het aantal uren huishoudelijke verzorging halveert

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that Tzorg halved home-help hours in the summer period in Breda, whether other providers did the same, and whether municipalities should reclaim unpaid funds. The minister answered that reducing support unilaterally is not allowed, that municipalities bear responsibility under the Wmo 2015, that he sees no reason for national investigation, and that the matter is for municipalities and the municipal council to oversee.
It is primarily for the municipal council to supervise the municipal executive on the adequate implementation of the law and municipal policy.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om het college van burgemeester en wethouders te controleren op de adequate uitvoering van de wet en het gemeentelijk beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het achterblijven van verhoogde thuiszorgtarieven

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether most municipalities are lagging in raising home-care tariffs to match the new VVT collective agreement and whether this threatens providers and care access. The minister answered that it is too early to judge, that municipalities have until 1 January 2019 to agree new tariffs, that the monitoring group and an evaluation study are ongoing, and that the tariff map's picture of widespread lagging is not supported.
It is still too early to establish nationally how municipalities have translated this year's collective agreements for nursing, care and home care into municipal care tariffs.

Het is nog te vroeg om landelijk vast te stellen op welke wijze gemeenten de cao-afspraken, die dit jaar voor de verpleging, verzorging en thuiszorg zijn gemaakt, hebben vertaald naar de gemeentelijke zorgtarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de doorstart van thuiszorgorganisatie Vérian

An SP MP asks the health minister how to judge the Vérian home-care bankruptcy and restart via a BV, the staff terms, gemeente responsibilities, union tactics and bankruptcy law. The minister answers that the curator will report, that municipalities bear continuity duties under the Wmo 2015, that a law-review track on transfers in bankruptcy is underway, and declines to judge individual conduct.
It is among the statutory tasks of the trustee to investigate the course of events surrounding a bankruptcy and to report on it.
Het behoort tot de wettelijke taken van de curator om de gang van zaken rond een faillissement te onderzoeken en hierover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de toename van suïcide onder kinderen

An MP asked the government about a sharp rise in youth suicides, whether it is structural, how to detect depressive symptoms early, whether the Transformatiefonds should fund such projects, whether the STORM pilot should be scaled up, and what action is taken against Instagram accounts glorifying suicide. The state secretary answered that a CBS microdata analysis and expert meeting are planned for September, pointed to the Meerjarenprogramma Depressiepreventie, said it is not known whether Transformatiefonds applications address depression, supported STORM-type initiatives as a matter for schools, and agreed to discuss monitoring tools with Facebook.
I share the view that further research is needed to map out the possible causes and explanations.
Ik deel de opvatting dat nader onderzoek aangewezen is om de mogelijke oorzaken en verklaringen hiervan in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht 'Te weinig personeel bij zorgcentra van Liante'

SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether Zorggroep Liante asking relatives of nursing home residents to fill staffing gaps is acceptable, who is liable if something goes wrong, and how to prevent such shortages in future summers. The Minister replied that relatives would only do non-care support tasks during temporary overload, that the care organisation remains fully responsible under the Wkkgz, and listed sector programmes to address the labour shortage, though he did not confirm the shortage was larger than before.
The care institution is always ultimately responsible for the stay of and care for the residents living in the care institution.
De zorginstelling is altijd eindverantwoordelijk voor het verblijf van en de zorg voor de bewoners die in de zorginstelling verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Jeugdzorg Zuid-Holland Zuid komt opnieuw miljoenen tekort’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether Zuid-Holland Zuid municipalities, which face renewed youth care deficits, qualify for the extra fund for deficit municipalities, and why, and how the criteria were set. The minister answered that the criteria were drawn up by the VNG and approved by municipalities, that applications run until 15 September 2018 with decisions expected in November, and that no municipality has yet received compensation.
The criteria for distributing the provision for deficit municipalities (renamed by the VNG as the Fund for Deficit Municipalities) were drawn up by the VNG in consultation with municipalities.
De criteria voor de verdeling van de voorziening voor tekortgemeenten (door de VNG omgedoopt tot Fonds Tekortgemeenten) zijn door de VNG, in samenspraak met gemeenten, opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de juiste behandeling bij niet aangeboren hersenletsel

Two D66 MPs asked about the correct diagnosis and treatment of acquired brain injury, including waiting times for rehabilitation and support from municipalities. The minister answered that diagnosis is difficult, that a care standard for traumatic brain injury exists and is being implemented, that waiting times for outpatient consultations average about five weeks, and that existing initiatives to improve chain cooperation are underway.
No figures are known on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Ellemeet en Dik-Faber over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs from SGP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why the disability equality law and public transport rules exclude small buurtbussen from wheelchair accessibility requirements, and whether the government would act. The State Secretary answered that accessibility rules were written for larger scheduled buses, that provinces and municipalities are responsible for buurtbus requirements, and that accessibility of buurtbussen is an item on an action programme with stakeholders, without committing to a legal change.
The responsibility for this lies with the provinces and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt bij provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Roon en Agema over het beleid van Jeugdbescherming Rijnmond inzake reisadviezen naar Israël

PVV MPs asked whether the Rotterdam youth protection agency JRR gives children under supervision a negative travel advice for Israel, why it differs from Turkey or Morocco, and whether it should allow travel to such areas when accompanied by an adult. The minister answered that the certified institution assesses each trip case by case for every destination, that the ministry's advice is only one factor, and that it will not restrict the institution's power to refuse travel when child development is at risk.
There is no general negative travel advice for any country.
Er is daarbij geen sprake van een algemeen negatief reisadvies voor welk land dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Trillende handen aan het bed’ (uitbuiting in de thuiszorg)

MPs Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about exploitation of Bulgarian live-in home-care workers by Care4You and related firms, and about municipal underpayment for home care. The ministers said inspections are ongoing, enforcement rests with labour and care inspectorates, and reviews of the reasonable-price decree are underway with results due in 2019.
I have asked the care offices to further investigate the roughly ten cases in this case in which PGB care is purchased.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren gevraagd om het tiental zaken waarin in deze casus pgb-zorg wordt ingekocht nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat kwetsbare ouderen die hulp nodig hebben met eten deze pas krijgen als het te laat is

MP Bergkamp asked the minister whether meal assistance for frail elderly people is being denied or delayed, and which body is responsible under which law, and urged clear agreements. The minister acknowledged the importance of nutrition, explained that responsibility depends on the Wmo, Zvw or Wlz, and committed to continued consultation with VNG and Zorgverzekeraars Nederland on clearer division of responsibilities.
Clients must not be left falling between two stools as a result.
Het mag niet zo zijn dat cliënten hierdoor tussen wal en schip terecht komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Wordt abortus opnieuw een taboe'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about a poll showing less youth support for abortion, whether abortion taboos harm women's free choice, and whether advertising with the word abortion is restricted on YouTube and Google. The minister replied that a taboo exists among young girls, pointed to the FIOM campaign and ongoing work on counselling, and explained that abortion ads are allowed on Google Ads search but not on the Display Network.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Arduin in Zeeland

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of high workload and staff shortages at Arduin, a disability care provider in Zeeland, including whether the inspectorate knew, whether the change process caused the complaints, and high sick leave. The minister said the inspectorate found shortcomings, held a meeting with the board in January 2018, chose not to impose enforcement measures, and is monitoring the change process through quarterly reports and unannounced visits.
The inspectorate therefore decided not to take enforcement measures and to closely monitor the change process.
De inspectie heeft daarom besloten niet over te gaan tot handhavingsmaatregelen en het verandertraject nauwlettend te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens en Van den Hul over de studentenstop bij zorgopleidingen terwijl er een personeelstekort is in de zorg

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked why nursing schools impose an intake cap (studentenstop) while the care sector faces staff shortages, whether the vicious circle of shortages and too few placements is recognised, whether stipends for placement supervision are being negotiated, and whether trainees are used as full-time staff. The minister replied that hogescholen are dropping the numerus fixus for nursing from 2019/2020, that regional action plans, the SectorplanPlus and the Stagefonds are the instruments used, that no negotiation on supervision fees is taking place, and that using trainees as full staff is undesirable and left to schools and care institutions to resolve.
I financially support this programme with the SectorplanPlus.
Dit programma ondersteun ik financieel met het SectorplanPlus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özdil over het bericht ‘Vicieuze cirkel: groot tekort aan verpleegkundigen, maar de opleidingen hanteren studentenstops omdat er geen stageplaatsen zijn’

GroenLinks MPs asked the health and education ministers why the nursing shortage persists despite student admission stops caused by insufficient internship places, and about internship funding, student deployment as staff, and the numerus fixus. The minister answered that regional action plans, the SectorplanPlus and the Stagefonds address the shortage, that most universities of applied sciences are dropping the numerus fixus from 2019/2020, and that the admission budget for the current year cannot be increased.
Compensating staff shortages with the full deployment of interns is not desirable.
Het compenseren van personeelstekorten met de volwaardige inzet van stagiairs is niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Vaak uitzondering gevraagd op maximering salaris’

MP Hijink asks the health minister about reports that care executives often seek exceptions to the WNT pay cap, whether the ministry will share the refusal data and the criteria used, and whether this is morally acceptable. The minister confirms most requests come from the care sector, notes that a request may only seek a different pay class, says the 2018 requests were all rejected, but declines to release a list of refused organisations on privacy grounds and refers to the existing Staatscourant publication of granted exceptions.
Given the above considerations, I will not provide this overview to your House.
Gegeven de bovenstaande overwegingen zal ik dit overzicht niet aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het toepassen van palliatieve sedatie bij mensen met dementie buiten de palliatieve fase

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health and justice ministers about deep palliative sedation of people with dementia outside the terminal phase, including whether it is used as a means to control severe behavioural problems, its relation to euthanasia oversight and the Wet zorg en dwang, and whether guidelines are being revised. Minister De Jonge answered that the core condition of a life expectancy under two weeks still applies in principle, that professional bodies are revising guidelines and a ZonMw study on the rise in sedation is under way, and that the Wzd framework permits such care only after a strict necessity and subsidiarity assessment.
No figures are known on the number of continuous deep palliative sedations in patients with dementia or non-psychogeriatric conditions with a life expectancy longer than two weeks.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal continue en diepe palliatieve sedaties bij patiënten met dementie of niet-psychogeriatrische aandoeningen en een langere levensverwachting dan twee weken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het testen van erfelijke ziekten via de huisarts

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the health minister about GP-offered carrier screening for hereditary diseases for couples planning a child, including licensing, ethical counselling, coverage and transparency of the UMCG study. The minister answered that GP offers operate under university genetic centre licences, that counselling is adequate, that the test is not reimbursed without medical indication, and that quality guidelines are being drafted.
I will consult with the relevant professional associations so that these guidelines come as quickly as possible.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de betreffende beroepsverenigingen opdat deze richtlijnen er zo snel mogelijk komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over genetische testen voor zwangere vrouwen die door huisartsen aangeboden worden

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether GP-offered prenatal carrier tests fall under the Wbmv and WBO licensing regimes, and about the status of a UMCG study on psychological impact. The Minister said the GP practices work under UMCG responsibility within Wbmv rules, that the WBO need not apply, and that the study has been completed with results being prepared for publication, with no commitment to new policy yet.
If the research results give cause to revise current policy on offering prenatal carrier tests, I will inform your House of this.
In geval de onderzoeksuitkomsten aanleiding geven om het huidige beleid rondom het aanbieden van prenatale dragerschapstests te herzien zal ik uw Kamer hiervan op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over parkeerregels- en kosten voor mensen met een beperking

An SP MP asked the minister whether national rules or guidelines should harmonise differing municipal parking rules and fees for people with disabilities, whether public transport access justifies lower costs, and about the disability parking card (GPK) conditions, renewal fees and medical assessment costs. The minister replied that parking policy is decentralised to municipalities, that the VNG and GNMI will discuss the issues, that the UN disability convention does not require uniform rules, and that renewal fees are justified as a government service.
The UN convention does not require that parking tariffs, parking rules and the use of a GPK be regulated uniformly within a State.
Het VN-verdrag eist niet dat parkeertarieven, parkeerregels en het gebruik van een GPK in een Staat uniform geregeld is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Bergkamp en Ellemeet over de stageomstandigheden van studenten verpleegkundige en verzorging

MPs Hijink, Bergkamp and Ellemeet asked the minister about NU'91 survey findings on care students' internships: underpaid allowances, high workload, weak supervision, risky tasks beyond their competence, and interns filling staff shortages. The minister answered that CAO agreements should be respected but allowances need not meet minimum wage, that schools and care providers share responsibility for supervision, that interns should not fill staff shortages, and that he will bring the report to the attention of stakeholders.
I will bring it to attention.
Ik zal het onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over werknemers van umc’s die gaan actievoeren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether he supports umc staff taking action over stalled collective bargaining, whether he finds the NFU's offers acceptable, and whether he will press employers to avoid eroding collective agreements. The minister answered that collective agreement negotiations are a matter between private parties, that he has no involvement beyond the state's labour cost contribution, and that he will not intervene.
Collective agreement negotiations are a matter between the private parties in healthcare.
Cao-onderhandelingen zijn een zaak tussen de private partijen in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de St. Maartenschool te Nijmegen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about the financial and care arrangements of the St. Maartenschool in Nijmegen, including a loan with municipal guarantees, responsibility between the ministries, and whether parents must arrange care funding themselves. The ministers answered that a process to organise care during school hours is underway with a process facilitator, that municipalities provided a bridging subsidy, and that the government is exploring direct funding for complex cases but this will take time.
In the letter we will send to the House of Representatives on this issue, we will also set out how we can support schools and parents in the meantime.
In de brief die wij over deze problematiek aan de Tweede Kamer zullen sturen, zullen we ook opnemen op welke wijze wij scholen en ouders in de tussentijd kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over fors duurder wordend zorgvervoer

An MP asked whether the abolition of the BPM refund scheme for taxis would make patient transport (wheelchair users, dialysis patients) substantially more expensive and reduce available transport. The minister denied a large cost increase, pointing to greening incentives, indexation of contracts, municipal duty of care and health insurance reimbursement, without committing to a new measure.
With the abolition of the BPM refund scheme for taxis, the cabinet aims to further green taxi transport.
Met de afschaffing van de BPM-teruggaveregeling voor taxi's beoogt het kabinet het taxivervoer verder te vergroenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Veiligheidsregio verzweeg fout jodiumpillen in Limburg’

Two D66 MPs asked the government whether errors in distributing potassium iodide tablets left some families without them, why the error was not communicated, and whether distribution and registration methods should change. The minister acknowledged distribution problems could not be fully traced, described a remedial scheme for affected Limburg households, and promised an evaluation by RIVM due in 2019 while rejecting a registration system.
Unfortunately I cannot determine where errors may have been made or how many families did not receive the tablets.
Ik kan helaas niet achterhalen waar mogelijk fouten zijn gemaakt en hoeveel gezinnen de tabletten niet hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het radioprogramma Reporter 'Misstanden in de maatschappelijke ondersteuning'

An MP asked the minister about a Reporter radio broadcast on problems in municipal social support (home help, independent client support, medical assessment) and about related court case numbers. The minister said home help can be offered as a general or individual provision, that client supporters must be functionally separated from decision-making, that medical assessments must be independent, and that Wmo lawsuits fell to 1,200 in 2017 with the Wmo evaluation covering these themes.
I do not have a national overview of the municipalities that offer home help in the form of a general provision.
Ik heb geen landelijk overzicht van de gemeenten die huishoudelijke hulp in de vorm van een algemene voorziening aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zelfs het wijkteam dat mensen moet helpen verdwaalt tussen zorgloketten

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that municipal care-access teams get lost among too many counters, rules and funding streams, and whether this reflects the decentralisations, waiting lists and the Ombudsman's findings. The minister acknowledged the problems for complex cases, denied structural waiting lists citing lack of national data, and promised to inform parliament soon on strengthening independent client support.
I will shortly inform the House of Representatives how I intend to strengthen this function.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer binnenkort informeren hoe ik deze functie wil versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de Franse investeerder Orpea een Nederlands zorgbedrijf met omstreden managementteam koopt

An MP asks the Health Minister about the acquisition of Dagelijks Leven, a Dutch elderly care provider, by French investor Orpea, including the role of its management, government funding, and whether foreign ownership should be curbed. The minister answers that the takeover was cleared by the NZa under competition rules, that no financial problems or Waardigheid en Trots funds were involved, that foreign and domestic owners are treated alike under existing regulation, and that the IGJ monitors governance.
Care institutions are private institutions and are responsible for decisions on the organisation of care provision, governance and ownership relations.
Zorginstellingen zijn private instellingen en zijn verantwoordelijk voor beslissingen omtrent de organisatie van de zorgverlening, het bestuur en de eigendomsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de strijd tegen onderbetalende gemeenten in de thuiszorg

An SP MP asks the health minister whether he accepts a NRC report that many municipalities pay below-cost home-care rates, whether this undermines care workers' wages, and whether the monitoring group should contact unions and care providers. The minister disputes the report's 25-euro threshold, says 13 signals covering 27 municipalities were investigated with a nuanced outcome, and commits to continuing the monitoring group and an evaluation due early 2019.
On the basis of my current understanding, I cannot endorse the conclusion in the NRC article.
Op basis van mijn huidige inzicht kan ik de conclusie in het NRC-artikel niet onderschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Strijd tegen onderbetalende gemeenten in de thuiszorg’

MPs Ellemeet asked the Minister of VWS whether municipalities pay fair home-care rates and whether the Besluit reële prijs is adequate, after a newspaper claimed most municipalities pay too little. The minister disputes the newspaper's conclusion, reports that 13 signals covering 27 municipalities have been investigated by a monitoring group with no confirmed inadequate tariffs, and notes the new wage scale and cao timing.
I have asked the municipalities and providers concerned, following these research findings, to determine in further consultation how they can still properly give effect to the Besluit reële prijs.

Ik heb de betreffende gemeenten en aanbieders naar aanleiding van deze onderzoeksbevindingen verzocht in nader overleg te bepalen hoe alsnog goed invulling kan worden gegeven aan het Besluit reële prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat 1100 thuiszorgmedewerkers vrezen voor hun baan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health how long he knew of Vérian Care & Clean's financial trouble, whether he would investigate, guarantee workers' wages and client care, and keep Parliament informed. The Minister said the curator is responsible for investigating the bankruptcy, that municipalities bear responsibility for continuity of care under the Wmo, and that workers can claim WW benefits, but he gave no commitment to an own investigation.
It is among the legal tasks of the curator to investigate the course of events surrounding a bankruptcy and to report on it.
Het behoort tot de wettelijke taken van de curator om de gang van zaken rond een faillissement te onderzoeken en hierover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Arts te lang in onzekerheid na euthanasie’

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister how the statutory six-week deadline for euthanasia review committees will be enforced, given delays, and what can be done to reduce doctors' uncertainty, including a proposal for a second psychiatric opinion. The minister acknowledged rising review times, described efficiency measures and a shorter opinion letter, and said the second-opinion proposal fits Supreme Court case law.
In 2017 the average processing time rose from 37 days to 52 days.
In 2017 is de afdoeningtermijn gestegen van gemiddeld 37 dagen naar 52 dagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Miljoenentekort voor Midden-Groningen: Erg zorgwekkende situatie’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of municipal youth care budget shortfalls (Midden-Groningen, Noordoost-Brabant) and whether children would be harmed, and what the Rijk would do. The minister said youth care duties remain in force despite shortfalls, that the Rijk and VNG agreed a 200 million euro temporary facility for municipalities facing stacked social-domain deficits, and that talks with affected regions are ongoing.
It is not precisely known how many municipalities experience a shortfall or surplus on their youth care budget.
Er is niet precies bekend hoeveel gemeenten een tekort of een overschot ervaren op hun jeugdhulpbudget.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over wooninitiatieven voor kinderen met een beperking

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked the health minister about the SCP finding that parent-initiated small-scale housing for children with disabilities is under pressure, covering funding, regulation, support, short indication periods, the housing allowance and PGB rules. The minister answered that he will consult VNG, ZN and Per Saldo on bottlenecks and clearer information, and promised further steps on client support and the housing allowance, without committing to a formal change.
I am going to consult with VNG, ZN and Per Saldo about these bottlenecks, including governance and financing, to discuss which improvements are possible in practice.
Ik ga met VNG, ZN en Per Saldo in overleg over deze knelpunten, waaronder regie en financiering, om te bespreken welke verbeteringen in de praktijk mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over misstanden in de Wmo

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health whether municipalities influence Wmo assessment doctors, whether citizens should have to litigate against municipalities, and whether the minister will investigate further and let care providers make eligibility decisions. The minister replies that the legal position of clients under the Wmo 2015 is adequately regulated, that no further investigation is planned, and that bezwaar and beroep remain available.
Based on the information currently available to me, I still have no reason to assume that municipalities are guilty of influencing assessment doctors more than occasionally.

Ik heb op basis van de mij thans ter beschikking staande informatie nog steeds geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat gemeenten zich meer dan mogelijk op incidentele basis schuldig maken aan de beïnvloeding van keuringsartsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Fabrikant van Nederlandse medicijnen buit werknemers uit en vervuilt milieu’

Two MPs asked ministers whether Aurobindo Pharma violates OECD guidelines by underpaying workers and polluting, and what they will do about it. The ministers said they expect compliance with OECD guidelines, will raise antibiotic-residue wastewater discharge through EU and GMP channels, and plan an official-level meeting with the Dutch office and talks with procurers and insurers, without confirming any violation.
A meeting at official level with the Dutch office of Aurobindo Pharma is already planned.
Een gesprek op ambtelijk niveau met het Nederlandse kantoor van Aurobindo Pharma is reeds gepland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de onvindbaarheid van donorvaders

An MP asked the health minister why sperm donors from before 2004 are hard to find for donor-conceived children, and whether clinics and donors should be obliged or encouraged to make themselves traceable. The minister acknowledged the difficulty, pointed to new agreements between the foundation Sdkb, clinics and the profession to approach anonymous donors, and declined to fund registration for donor children in the KID-DNA databank.
I have decided not to reimburse registration in the FIOM KID-DNA databank for donor children conceived before 2004.
Ik heb besloten de inschrijving in de FIOM KID-DNA databank voor donorkinderen, verwekt voor 2004, niet te vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Dijksma over het tekort aan opvanglocaties voor slachtoffers van geweld achter de voordeur

MPs Van den Hul and Dijksma asked whether extra funds for domestic violence and women's shelters were real or simply reallocated from the municipal fund, and how the funds would be monitored. The minister said the money is additional, added through the general municipal fund to the decentralisation grant, with the spending left to municipalities and monitoring to be requested from the VNG.
These are additional funds which were first added without earmarking to the general fund, and part of which was then specifically spent on Veilig Thuis.
Het gaat hier dus om extra middelen die zonder oormerk allereerst aan de algemene uitkering zijn toegevoegd en waarvan vervolgens een deel specifiek voor Veilig Thuis is ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Voortman over het bericht 'Vluchtroutes voor mindervaliden op festivals te smal: ‘ik lig zo omver’'

MPs Ellemeet and Voortman asked whether the fire-safety rules for event venues (Bbgbop) adequately protect people with disabilities at festivals, and what the government will do about narrow escape routes. The minister replied that the national decree only sets minimum widths, that accessibility is the responsibility of organisers and municipalities, and that he will consult disability organisations on possible rule changes.
I will shortly contact the disability interest organisations to explain how the Bbgbop works and to explore together where improvements to the regulations are possible.

Ik zal op korte termijn met de belangenorganisaties voor personen met een beperking in contact treden om enerzijds de werking van het Bbgbop toe te lichten en anderzijds om samen met hen te bezien waar verbeteringen in regelgeving mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Mbo'ers lossen tekorten arbeidsmarkt niet op’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about shortages of skilled workers in care and welfare, including the share of career changers and returners, the availability and cost of BIG re-registration training and exams, and whether pass rates and exam frequency could be improved. The minister answered in detail with figures, describes Zorgpact and SectorplanPlus measures, says pass rates will be published on request to the MBO Raad, and states that digitalising the exam will be decided in autumn.
I will contact the MBO Raad to that end.
Ik zal daartoe contact opnemen met de MBO Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Langer in kliniek door tekort aan thuiszorg’

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about reports of patients staying longer in clinics due to a shortage of district nurses, including how many could not die at home and when the shortage would be resolved. The minister gave rough shortage estimates, said no figures on deaths at home were known, pointed patients to their insurer and the Nza for care gaps, and referred to a workforce action programme with a target of near-zero shortages by 2022.
Regarding this requested data, I am not aware of any figures.
Ten aanzien van deze gevraagde gegevens zijn mij geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sazias over het bericht ‘Sterke daling van potentiële mantelzorgers in de toekomst’

MPs Bergkamp and Sazias asked the minister of Health about a report projecting a sharp decline in potential informal carers and about the availability of respite care for carers. The minister acknowledges the projected need for greater support, promises concrete proposals in the Langer Thuis programme and research on respite care in cooperation with municipalities and Mezzo.
In the Langer Thuis programme I will come with concrete proposals for better support for informal carers.
In het programma Langer Thuis kom ik met concrete voorstellen voor een betere ondersteuning van mantelzorgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de komst van een zelfmoordmachine naar de uitvaartbeurs in Amsterdam

Three MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a suicide machine (euthanasia demonstration) was shown at an open funeral fair in Amsterdam, and what the government would do about it and about suicide prevention investment. The Staatssecretaris called such a demonstration highly undesirable, said the government has no legal power to ban it, and promised to inform the House this spring on suicide prevention funding.
I have no legal powers to prohibit such demonstrations, the aim of which is to stimulate discussion.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om te verbieden dat dergelijke demonstraties plaatsvinden, waarvan het doel is de discussie aan te jagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht van Omroep Brabant dat omstreden zelfmoordpoeder wekenlang te koop was op Marktplaats

An MP asked the health minister about reports that controversial suicide powder was sold on Marktplaats for weeks, and about platform responsibility and inspection oversight. The minister acknowledged the undesirability, said Marktplaats removed ads after reports and contacted the NVWA, described existing inspection tools, and promised to report on an ongoing exploration of regulating such substances in spring.
I will inform you of the outcomes of the exploration still this spring.
Ik zal u nog dit voorjaar informeren over de uitkomsten van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verkoop van euthanasieproducten via een website

MP Van der Staaij asked whether a website selling euthanasia products amounts to criminal assistance in suicide, whether the public prosecution service will investigate, who runs the site, and what powers exist to shut it down. The Minister of Justice replied that the public prosecution service decides independently on investigation and prosecution, declined to comment on this individual case, said the identity of the operators is unknown to him, and described the notice-and-take-down procedure and the prosecutor's power under article 54a Sr. to order internet providers to block access.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide independently, on the basis of the facts and circumstances, whether to open an investigation and possibly take a prosecution decision.
Het is aan het OM om op basis van de feiten en omstandigheden eigenstandig te beslissen of een opsporingsonderzoek wordt ingesteld en eventueel een vervolgingsbeslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Zorgondernemers kunnen keer op keer failliet gaan: geen haan die er naar kraait’

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether a care entrepreneur who repeatedly went bankrupt could simply found a new care company, and whether the Wtza and inspectorate powers are adequate to address this. The minister said the bankruptcy-related case is under investigation so he will not comment on it, that curators can pursue personal liability and director bans, and that the new notification obligation under the Wtza plus existing inspection and fraud-coordination tools provide sufficient instruments, while noting some enforcement gaps.
I therefore do not consider it appropriate at this stage to pass judgment on this individual case.
Ik vind het daarom niet gepast om in dit stadium uitspraak te doen over deze individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Hijink over belangenverstrengeling in de zorg

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether the ANBO director serving as president-commissaris of commercial care organisation Fundis creates conflicts of interest, and whether the minister supervises such side functions. The minister answered that boards and members of ANBO and Fundis must judge these roles, and that he does not supervise the side functions of interest-group leaders.
I do not supervise the executives of interest organisations and their side functions.
Ik houd geen toezicht op de bestuurders van belangenorganisaties en hun nevenfuncties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Peters over het artikel 'Hulp nieuwe stijl: sámen tegen muren oplopen'

CDA MPs Geluk and Peters asked the health minister about a press report that neighbourhood teams in municipalities, though closer to citizens, hit the same bureaucratic walls as citizens, including tensions with municipal departments and limited mandates to work across rules. The minister answered that municipalities have freedom in organising access to care, that the teams' diversity and expertise gaps need attention, and that he will talk with municipalities about clarity on what local teams can deliver.
I will talk with municipalities and other relevant parties about how access to youth care for children and families can be improved.
Ik ga met de gemeenten en andere relevante partijen in gesprek over de wijze waarop de toegang tot de jeugdhulp voor kinderen en gezinnen beter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht 'De Zorgconsulent failliet: slechte zorg en geen salaris voor personeel'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government knew about reports that care provider De Zorgconsulent was near bankruptcy with poor care and unpaid staff, and what measures had been taken on care quality. The minister replied that the inspectorate had tracked the provider since 2016, found care quality and staffing inadequate, issued a directive, and that care for clients is now being transferred to other providers under inspectorate monitoring.
The inspectorate will continue to monitor the situation until clients have been properly transferred.
De inspectie blijft de situatie volgen tot het moment dat de cliënten goed zijn overgedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zieke werknemers zorgaanbieder Carinova moeten werk inhalen’

Two MPs asked the minister whether employees at care provider Carinova being required to make up work missed due to sickness is acceptable, whether this amounts to sickness-absence manipulation contrary to law, and whether the minister will contact Carinova. The minister answered that sick workers must not be pressured, that employers must pay wages during illness, and that the matter is for the parties to resolve; the employer has since withdrawn the disputed protocol, and individual cases are for the courts.
It is up to the parties to engage in dialogue about the situation described in the news report.
Het ligt op de weg van partijen om over de in het nieuwsbericht geschetste situatie het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘Jeugdpsychiaters slaan alarm over het isoleren van kinderen in de Jeugdzorg’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that youth psychiatrists warn of isolation of children in youth care, including how often and how long it happens, a national registration system, the 24-hour notification term, legal safeguards, staff shortages and a staffing norm. The minister acknowledged the issue, backed a sector plan to cut temporary isolation with a baseline measurement, promised to agree a national registration system and a timeline on legal position rules, and declined to set a staffing norm, pointing to the existing quality framework.
I will make agreements about this with the institutions and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate.
Ik ga daar met de instellingen en de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd i.o. afspraken over maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de emotionele oproep van ouders na de dood van hun dochter om het zelfmoordpoeder te verbieden en het strafrechtelijk vervolgen, dan wel verbieden van de Coöperatie Laat

An SGP MP asked the Health and Justice ministers, after parents' emotional appeal following their daughter's suicide, whether they would ban the self-death powder sold by the CLW, pursue prosecution, and dissolve the cooperative under civil law, and whether a meeting with the CLW had taken place. The ministers answered that they will explore regulation options, that the Public Prosecution Service has started a criminal investigation and asked the CLW to cease its activities, that civil dissolution is being considered by the OM, and that a meeting with the CLW is not appropriate during the investigation.
Since the Cooperative Last Will is the subject of a criminal investigation, a conversation by me with this cooperative is not opportune and the commitment cannot be fulfilled.
Aangezien de Coöperatie Laatste Wil onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, is een gesprek van mij met deze coöperatie niet opportuun en kan de toezegging niet gestand worden gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over seksueel misbruik tijdens de tantramassage

An MP asked whether the Inspectorate for Healthcare had received reports of sexual abuse by tantra masseurs, what rules apply to the profession, whether police refused around thirty complaints, and whether the government would engage with the Tantra Misbruik reporting point. The ministers answered that the Inspectorate concluded these activities fall outside the Wkkgz and thus outside its supervision, that victims were advised to file police reports, and that they do not comment on individual cases, describing the police reporting process instead.
As I have previously informed the House, I do not go into individual cases and complaints.
Antwoord 4, 5 Zoals ik uw kamer eerder heb geïnformeerd 2 ga ik niet in op individuele casus en aangiften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Hermans over het bericht dat publiek zorggeld van Stichting Buurtzorg naar privébedrijfjes zou zijn gesluisd

MPs Slootweg and Hermans asked whether Stichting Buurtzorg funnelled over a million euros of public care money to private companies linked to its founder, and about oversight, a tax repayment arrangement and foreign activities. The minister answered that providers are responsible for their own governance, that the inspectorate sees no quality problems and is gathering information, that the NZa does not oversee such flows, and that tax confidentiality prevents disclosure of the arrangement.
The NZa does not supervise money flows between care providers and affiliated legal entities.
De NZa houdt geen toezicht op geldstromen tussen zorgaanbieders en gelieerde rechtspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Departementen blokkeren fusie van ZonMW en NWO’

MP Bruins asks why the planned merger of ZonMW into NWO was reportedly blocked by the ministries, and whether cultural differences justify stopping it. The ministers answer that the statutory integration was dropped as the wrong instrument, that the aims remain via an updated cooperation agreement from 2019, and that the transition has cost about EUR 6 million to 2017.
During the transition process we concluded that a change of law is not the right instrument to achieve this objective.
Gedurende het transitieproces zijn wij tot de conclusie gekomen dat een wetswijziging niet het juiste instrument is om deze doelstelling te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over het objectieve verdeelmodel Wmo en Jeugd in relatie tot doelmatig medicijngebruik

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked whether the medicine-use distribution criterion in the Wmo and Youth social domain fund penalises municipalities like Asten that prescribe medicines efficiently, and what will be done about it, including timing of the evaluation and compensation. The minister answered that the criterion fits average municipal costs, that individual compensation does not fit the integrated approach, that a qualitative evaluation is complete with a quantitative follow-up to be decided, and that best-practice sharing is encouraged.
Once this research is completed, I will present the research report to your House.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond, zal ik het onderzoeksrapport aan uw Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Dijksma over het tekort aan opvanglocaties voor slachtoffers van geweld achter de voordeur

MPs Van den Hul and Dijksma asked the minister about a shortage of shelter places for victims of domestic violence and whether funding is distributed fairly across the country. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for shelter, that funds were reallocated by objective criteria, that €11.9 million extra is added for Veilig Thuis, and that he will report on progress in autumn 2018.
It is the responsibility of the centre municipalities for women's shelter to adequately support victims of domestic violence with shelter and guidance.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de centrumgemeenten vrouwenopvang om slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld voldoende te ondersteunen met opvang en begeleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Doorstroming van oudere in ziekenhuis ligt plat door griep’

MP Agema asks whether the minister knows of a report that elderly patient flow from hospitals is blocked by flu, and how large the shortage of nursing-home places is. The minister acknowledges the report, corrects the terminology, says he has no figures on needed extra capacity per region, and describes agreements with providers and insurers, including a promised letter on coordination points.
I have no overview of whether, and if so how much, extra capacity was needed per region
Ik heb geen overzicht over of en zo ja, hoeveel extra capaciteit er per regio nodig was
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht 'GGD onderzoekt verdacht letsel bij kwetsbaren'

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about GGD Amsterdam's forensic medical examinations of injuries in vulnerable groups (intellectually disabled people, elderly, children) and whether this expertise should be safeguarded nationally. The minister agreed such expertise matters, said on-site injury examination has value, and committed to asking GGD GHOR Nederland for advice and informing the Chamber about a proposal.
I am happy to adopt your suggestion to ask GGD GHOR Nederland for advice to come with GGD Amsterdam to a proposal on how forensic medical expertise can be safeguarded regionally.
Ik neem graag uw suggestie over om aan GGD GHOR Nederland advies te vragen om met GGD Amsterdam te komen tot een voorstel over hoe forensisch medische expertise regionaal kan worden geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kooiman over het bericht 'Gemeente harkt te veel persoonsgegevens binnen' (Herdruk)

MPs Hijink and Kooiman asked the health minister about reports that municipalities collect too much personal data via self-reliance matrices, and whether privacy oversight and municipal guidance are adequate. The minister acknowledged limited violations in Nijmegen and Zaanstad, said the Dutch data protection authority is responsible for enforcement, and listed support measures for municipalities while declining to undertake new specific activities.
I do not intend to undertake specific activities aimed at ensuring that municipalities using self-reliance matrices handle them properly from a privacy law perspective.
Ik ben niet van plan om specifieke activiteiten te ondernemen die erop zijn gericht dat gemeenten die met zelfredzaamheidmatrices werken, daar vanuit het privacyrecht bezien goed mee omgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Tielen over de Nieuwsuurreportage 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Health, Welfare and Sport about a Nieuwsuur report on Roma children exploited in criminal activity, including what is being done about multi-problem families, information sharing between municipalities and abroad, and why some municipalities dropped recommended approaches. The state secretary answered that knowledge has been gathered, that a national adviser has been appointed, and that inter-ministerial and cross-border cooperation exists, but declined to give figures on exploited children and said RvdK does not register ethnicity.
Because children are not registered by ethnicity at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, I cannot say whether or how often Roma children have been placed out of home.
Omdat kinderen bij de RvdK niet worden geregistreerd op etniciteit, kan ik niet aangeven of en hoe vaak Roma kinderen uit huis zijn geplaatst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over de uitvoering van de WMO in Groningen

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of Health about the Wmo implementation in Groningen after a broadcast reported a resident being refused help despite being unable to travel alone, and whether municipal discretion makes support depend on place of residence. The Minister says the Wmo leaves individual assessment and objections to municipalities and councils, that he cannot judge individual decisions, will contact Groningen to discuss it, and sees no current reason to intervene as supervisor.
I cannot intervene in the assessment the municipality made in individual situations.
Ik kan niet treden in de afweging die de gemeente in individuele situaties heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het artikel 'Jeugdpsychiatrie bij gemeente is fout'

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about an article claiming that youth psychiatric care organised by municipalities is failing, and asked whether referrals to specialist youth mental health care are being handled well. The minister agreed that care should be organised close to the child's social environment, said referral data is available through the VNG app rather than broken down by referrer, and promised to talk with municipalities about uniform standards for neighbourhood teams.
Information is however available on youth care use per municipality and per region, including on referrals.
Wel is er informatie beschikbaar over het jeugdhulpgebruik per gemeente en per regio, inclusief over de verwijzing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over het bericht 'Loek Winter omzeilt winstverbod zorg'

CDA MPs Ronnes and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health whether profit restrictions in care can be circumvented via subcontractors, BV structures, property arrangements and tenant-council rights, and whether the IGJ and WNT cover these. The Minister acknowledged the risks, promised a position letter on profit distribution by spring and a bill to bring subcontractors under the WNT by year-end, but deferred or deflected several questions to other bodies.
Therefore, together with the Minister of the Interior, work is underway on a legislative process to bring subcontractors under the WNT and thereby tackle avoidance constructions.
Daarom wordt, samen met de Minister van BZK, gewerkt aan een wetstraject om onderaannemers onder de WNT te brengen en zodoende ontwijkconstructies aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de wijkverpleegkundigen van Plicare verdwijnen

An SP MP asks the health minister about the closure of Plicare's neighbourhood nursing services in The Hague, including loss of care for vulnerable clients, the reasons for stopping, contacts with Plicare, prevention, and funding. The minister answers that clients will be transferred to other providers, that insurers no longer purchase neighbourhood care separately, that the government will not interfere in care procurement negotiations, and that data on insurer contracting is not available.
I do not have such data at my disposal.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke data.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over een brede open studie naar het zorgstelsel en de zorgkosten

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government and the WRR would carry out a broad open study of the healthcare system and rising healthcare costs, as promised in the budget debate. The minister replied that the government supports the request, is consulting the WRR, and that the WRR will decide on its work programme this spring.
Yes, we have discussed your request and wholeheartedly support it.
Ja, wij hebben uw verzoek besproken en steunen het verzoek van harte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat thuiszorgorganisaties cliënten van Zilveren Kruis weren

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether home-care providers excluding Zilveren Kruis clients reflects restrictive contracting, why a minimum turnover blocks small providers, and how patient choice is protected. The minister denied any compromise of choice, said he will report on stimulating multi-year contracting before summer 2018, and said Zilveren Kruis has a duty of care to its insured.
I have no insight into that in this specific pilot.
Daar heb ik in deze specifieke pilot geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over gezinshuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about research on family-style group homes (gezinshuizen) for children, their social return, numbers of homes and children, registration under the Youth Act, a quality framework, administrative burden and contract types. The minister answered that the research is noted and supports placement in small-scale settings, gave estimates of homes and children, said registration is under legal review, and said a quality framework will be delivered at year end.
I intend to inform the House by letter, before the bill on amending the admission of care providers (Wtza) is debated, about this matter.
aan de TK heb toegezegd, ben ik van plan uw Kamer voorafgaand aan de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel Wijziging toetreding zorgaanbieder (Wtza) bij brief te informeren hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Oosten over het artikel 'Opleggen van huisverbod moet vaker en sneller'

MPs Tielen and Van Oosten asked about a call by The Hague's mayor to impose household bans more often and faster, and about hulpverlening follow-up, extensions, and information sharing in domestic violence cases. The minister defends the household ban as an effective tool within a broader safety plan, acknowledges problems organising aid, says extensions are only legal when danger persists, and points to ongoing programmes and existing reporting code.
There are therefore no figures available on this.
Er zijn hierover daarom geen cijfers beschikbaar.
