Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het bericht dat blindend en slechtzienden in Den Haag kunnen stemmen voor de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen

Two D66 MPs asked whether blind and visually impaired voters in The Hague can vote independently in the 2018 municipal elections using a template and audio support, and whether every municipality should offer this, including talks with the VNG. The minister confirmed the template is permitted for municipalities but declined to press for national rollout before The Hague's pilot is evaluated, promising to inform parliament on accessibility measures soon.
I therefore consider it still too early to discuss with the VNG before the 21 March council elections whether this approach can also be followed in other municipalities.
Ik vind het daarom nog te vroeg om al vóór de raadsverkiezingen van 21 maart met de VNG te bespreken of deze werkwijze ook in andere gemeenten kan worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ellemeet, Dik-Faber en Von Martels over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in de dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs asked whether wheelchair users can be refused when transferring from a regular bus to a community bus, and whether the Wet personenvervoer 2000 should be amended to close a gap. The government answers there is no legal omission: the Wgbh/cz applies, community buses are deliberately outside its scope as small vehicles, the province chose not to impose further demands on volunteer-run services, and gemeenten must provide small-scale wheelchair transport instead.
There is no omission in the Wet personenvervoer 2000 that would need to be repaired.
Er is geen sprake van een omissie in de Wet personenvervoer 2000 die gerepareerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Het gewone sterven blijft onderbelicht’

An SGP MP asked the health minister whether public debate overly focuses on euthanasia at the expense of natural dying and palliative care, and how the 8 million euro per year for palliative care would be spent. The minister agreed that palliative care deserves more attention, outlined planned awareness activities from after summer 2018, and said the spending plan and timeline would follow in an April 2018 letter.
In my forthcoming letter on palliative care (April 2018) I will go into more detail on the plans and the further timeline.
In mijn komende brief over palliatieve zorg (april 2018) zal ik in meer detail ingaan op de plannen en het verdere tijdpad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Door ziekteverzuim lekt half miljard weg uit de zorg'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about a report that sick leave in healthcare is costing half a billion euros, including questions on long-term absence by subsector, function, institution and management turnover. The minister confirmed that sick leave in health and welfare care is structurally higher than average, that the half-billion figure appears plausible based on Vernet data, and that no breakdown by function or institution is available, while pointing to existing programmes and a broader labour market action plan.
The CBS statistics do not break down sick leave by individual care institution.
In de statistieken van het CBS wordt geen uitsplitsing gemaakt van het ziekteverzuim per zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de mogelijkheden van mensen met een visuele of auditieve beperking om tv-programma’s te bekijken en zorgwebsites te bezoeken

MP Westerveld asked about audio description on NPO television and accessibility of healthcare websites for blind, visually impaired and deaf users. The minister replies that audio description continues in 2018 and is being evaluated, and that digital accessibility of care websites is a responsibility of care providers, to be addressed through the VN Convention implementation programme.

The Minister of VWS has no insight into which websites are or are not sufficiently accessible and therefore cannot monitor whether patients with a disability have sufficient access to care institutions' websites.

De Minister van VWS heeft geen zicht op welke websites al dan niet voldoende toegankelijk zijn en kan dan ook niet in de gaten houden of patiënten met een beperking voldoende toegang hebben tot websites van zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen behandelen intensief door bij levenseinde’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister how the government views conflicting findings from a university consortium and the Zorginstituut on whether hospitals overtreat patients at the end of life, and why hospital-level practice variation was not studied. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut commissioned and published the studies, that its own analysis nuanced the consortium's findings, and that practice variation at hospital level was not requested because of legal limits on identifiable data, while saying further hospital-level research is possible only if institutions share data and declining to commission it now.
The Zorginstituut awarded the assignment on the basis of this offer, and informed the researchers that it has no legal possibility to publish information traceable to individual institutions.

Het Zorginstituut heeft de opdracht toegekend op basis van deze offerte, en heeft de onderzoekers laten weten dat het Zorginstituut juridisch geen mogelijkheden heeft om tot instellingen herleidbare informatie te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het bericht dat de zorg heeft te kampen met verlies

MP Hermans asked the Minister of Health about reports that care providers, especially nursing and residential homes, are running losses, including whether wage and property costs, accountant costs and reporting explain it, and how to ensure extra funds for nursing homes are not used to fill budget gaps. The minister acknowledged rising costs driven mainly by wage increases and a retroactive allowance, said the NZa is studying care tariffs and cost prices, and committed to contract provisions that allow clawback of funds not spent on the agreed quality-framework investments.
From the 2019 care purchasing round onward, the contracts must allow funds to be reclaimed if they are not used for the agreed investments in implementing the quality framework.

De contracten moeten met ingang van de zorginkoop 2019 mogelijk maken dat de middelen worden teruggevorderd, indien deze niet zijn ingezet voor de afgesproken investeringen in de implementatie van het kwaliteitskader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht ‘Crisisbedden bestaan niet meer’

MP Dijksma asked the health minister about a report that crisis beds for dementia patients are no longer available, leaving a patient without a place for three days. Minister De Jonge acknowledged the situation as distressing, said there is a continuous shortage in the region and promised to ask the care office to consult partners, review rules on emergency care, and set up regional coordination points by April.
There is no national overview of the number of Wlz crisis beds and their occupancy rate.
Er is geen landelijk overzicht van het aantal Wlz-crisisbedden en de bezettingsgraad daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over het bericht dat de aardbevingen in Groningen de gezondheid van Groningers aantasten

Two SP MPs asked whether the government accepts that earthquakes in Groningen harm residents' health, including a reported PTSD-like picture, and whether the state is responsible and will act. The minister acknowledges the health impact, says removing the causes of stress is the top priority, promises gas production reduction options and a public-law damage protocol, and commits to a health action plan from the RIVM and GGD by end of April.
Removing the causes of stress and uncertainty has the highest priority.
Het wegnemen van de oorzaken van de stress en onzekerheid heeft de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over de berichtgeving dat stress in bevingsgebied Groningen tot sterfgevallen leidt

MPs Beckerman and Kooiman (SP) asked ministers whether reports that earthquake-related stress in Groningen leads to deaths were known, and how affected people would be supported. Minister Wiebes replied that the government finds this worrying, prioritises removing the causes of stress, wants gas extraction reduced further this term, and wants damage settlement accelerated, referring to an earlier answer.
Removing the causes of the stress and uncertainty has the highest priority.
Het wegnemen van de oorzaken van de stress en onzekerheid heeft de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Hermans over de berichten 'Honderdduizenden ouderen houden dure ziekenhuisbedden bezet' en 'Veel 65-plussers liggen onnodig in ziekenhuis'

VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that hundreds of thousands of elderly patients occupy costly hospital beds without medical need and that about 1.4 billion euro is spent on unnecessary care. The ministers acknowledge the problem, describe alternative options such as short-stay facilities and regional coordination points, but say most figures from the ActiZ-commissioned study cannot be verified.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over doorstroming en drukte bij maatschappelijke opvang

MPs Beckerman and Kooiman asked about shortages and slow move-on in women's shelters and emergency homelessness shelters, including Groningen's reduced capacity and the lack of affordable housing for shelter residents. The minister responded that a working group with several ministries and municipal follow-up will address bottlenecks from the Ombudsman's report, municipalities will carry local responsibility for housing and capacity agreements, and a multi-year agenda on sheltered housing is being developed.
Currently, work is underway to set up this working group.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan het opzetten van deze werkgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht 'Verbod embryo’s kweken niet houdbaar'

Tellegen (VVD) and Dijkstra (D66) asked the Health Minister about calls by European doctors' associations to legalise creating human embryos for research and about the implications for patients if the ban remains. The minister said the coalition parties hold differing views, that a broad ethical debate must come first, and that the government will pursue alternative stem-cell research instead.
The cabinet will stimulate this discussion and at the same time focus on innovative stem cell research.
Het kabinet zal deze discussie stimuleren en tegelijkertijd inzetten op innovatief stamcelonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘E-healthweek 2018: ‘Opschaling is altijd gedoe’’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the slow scaling of e-health innovations, the potential of blockchain in healthcare, its obstacles, and the status of the Mijn Zorg Log prototype including its possible use for personal budgets. The minister answered that scaling is a challenge involving organisational change, listed existing support instruments, said blockchain is still early-stage with research ongoing by Zorginstituut Nederland, and described a small practice trial and the need for further study before wider use.
To deploy Mijn Zorg Log more broadly, including for personal budgets, further research is needed.
Om Mijn Zorg Log breder in te zetten, waaronder voor PGB, is nader onderzoek nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over de signalen het meeverhuizen naar een verpleeghuis niet altijd mogelijk is

An MP asked the minister whether care institutions must offer partner co-admission to spouses moving into nursing homes and how the surviving partner is treated after death. The minister confirmed that the Wlz allows a non-eligible partner to be admitted and retain residence after the eligible partner dies, while noting institutions may lack suitable rooms and are not obliged to help find a new home.
It is not possible to determine how often this occurs.
Het is niet mogelijk na te gaan hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Hermans en De Lange over het bericht 'Wachttijden onacceptabel'

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the causes of waiting times across healthcare sectors, whether insurers and providers have agreed to reduce them, and what the NZa can enforce. The minister answered that the NZa has an action plan, that insurers can be sanctioned under their duty of care, and that concrete follow-up such as reports to the House is planned.
Health insurers must make efforts to ensure that their insured persons receive good quality, accessible and timely care.
Zorgverzekeraars moeten zich inspannen om ervoor te zorgen dat hun verzekerden kwalitatief goede, bereikbare en tijdige zorg ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de vergunningsaanvraag voor het openen van een nieuwe abortuskliniek in ‘s Hertogenbosch

An MP asked whether a new abortion clinic in 's-Hertogenbosch was being licensed, whether capacity or spread can be considered, and whether investor returns create incentives. The minister replied that no application has been received yet, that licensing law contains no capacity or spread conditions, that he is reviewing whether regulation needs changing, and that the clinic may not pursue profit.
As reported to the House of Representatives on 27 September 2017, I am looking at the current regulations in this area to see whether adjustment is needed.
Zoals aan de Tweede Kamer gemeld op 27 september 2017 4 kijk ik naar de huidige regelgeving op dit gebied om te bezien of aanpassing nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht 'Rolstoelgebruikers hekelen gebrekkige assistentie op vliegvelden'

MPs Bergkamp and Paternotte asked about reports that wheelchair users criticise poor assistance at airports, the rising demand for assistance, liability for compensation, rules on carrying mobility aids, and the funding of assistance. The minister acknowledges problems at Schiphol, states that airports bear primary responsibility under EU Regulation 1107/2006, notes the ILT supervises through inspections and complaints, and explains that the per-passenger PRM charge applies to departing passengers only.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Peters over het bericht ‘Jeugdhulp is online bedreiging beu’

MPs Raemakers and Peters asked the Minister of Health about online threats and false accusations against youth care workers and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the problem is worrying, pointed to existing campaigns and guidance, and said talks with employers, police, prosecutors and internet companies would report back before summer 2018.
Before summer 2018 we will inform you of the results of this consultation.
Vóór de zomer van 2018 zullen wij u informeren over de resultaten van dit overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het delen van persoonsgegevens van gebruikers van Valys

An MP asks the minister whether Valys transport operator Transvision shares passenger personal data with Belgian firm Cubigo, and whether this is permissible under its concession contract. The minister answers that data is not shared with Cubigo, that VITA use is voluntary, that privacy is not at issue, and that information to users has been improved and a meeting with user organisations is planned.
I have raised this with Transvision and the information on the website has since been adjusted.
Ik heb Transvision hierop aangesproken en de informatie op de website is inmiddels aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de uitzending van Zembla ‘Verdachte ouders’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about a Zembla broadcast on suspected Munchausen by proxy/PCF cases, including rising Veilig Thuis reports, support for doctors, the role of the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and the need for fact-finding. The ministers answered that professionals are supported through protocols, expert centres and joint guidance, that no Dutch research exists on prevalence, and that a fact-finding action plan will be sent to parliament in spring 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Registratie kindermishandeling bij veel organisaties niet op orde'

MP Tielen asked the Health Minister whether child abuse registration in youth health care is inadequate and how it will be improved, and about coordination with Veilig Thuis and the role of youth health care. The minister acknowledged the inspectorate's findings, pointed to a sector-led action plan and a planned national programme, and gave mostly general commitments without new binding measures.
I consider complete, correct and better registration of child abuse important so that timely action can be taken on suspicions of and monitoring of child abuse.
Ik vind een volledige, juiste en betere registratie van kindermishandeling belangrijk om tijdig te kunnen acteren bij vermoedens van en het monitoren van kindermishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een keuringarts is gezwicht onder gemeentelijke druk

An SP MP asked the health minister whether a municipality (Lingewaard) pressured a medical assessor to alter a report to cut care costs, and whether this is common and should change. The minister said the matter is before the administrative and disciplinary courts, that pressure on assessors is not acceptable and cost should not drive decisions, but that no evidence suggests it is more than incidental, so no further investigation is needed.

It is for the administrative judge to assess whether the municipality's decision to refuse the requested tailored care was lawful, and for the disciplinary judge to determine whether the assessing doctor acted correctly.

Het is aan de bestuursrechter om te beoordelen of het door de gemeente genomen besluit tot afwijzing van de aangevraagde maatwerkvoorzieningen rechtmatig is en het is aan de tuchtrechter om vast te stellen of de keuringsarts juist heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Steeds meer mensen willen euthanasie, kliniek kan de vraag niet aan’

An MP asked the health minister about reports of growing demand for euthanasia that the Levenseindekliniek cannot meet, including waiting lists, declining physician objections, and rising complex requests. The minister confirmed the rising request figures, said the causes of waiting lists are unclear, and stressed that physicians keep their own choice and pressure on them is not allowed, promising to discuss knowledge of the euthanasia law with parties.
There are no national figures on complex euthanasia requests that physicians could or would not take on.
Er zijn geen landelijke cijfers over complexe euthanasieverzoeken die artsen niet in behandeling konden of wilden nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Enorm tekort aan wijkverpleegkundigen: “Mijn zoon slaapt op de bank”’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a shortage of district nurses leaves terminally ill patients waiting for care, how large the shortage is, and what will be done before year end. The Minister answered that insurers have a duty of care, the NZa has received no signals of non-compliance, workforce figures will follow in spring, and regional action plans and extra funding are being pursued.
People who experience problems accessing district nursing care can contact their insurer.
Mensen die problemen ondervinden met de toegang tot wijkverpleegkundige zorg kunnen contact opnemen met hun verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat psychische hulp aan kwetsbare jongeren ernstig in gevaar is

An MP asks the minister how to respond to reports that youth mental health care is delayed or unavailable because municipal budgets are exhausted, and about waiting lists, bureaucracy, staffing and trust. The minister acknowledges the concern, says children must never be denied timely care, points to regional agreements, expert teams, an admin-burden bill and a labour market study, though much responsibility is placed on municipalities and providers.
I have agreed with municipalities and youth care providers to make waiting times transparent at regional level and to incorporate agreements on this into the 2018 purchasing contracts.
Ik heb met gemeenten en jeugdhulpaanbieders de afspraak gemaakt wachttijden op regionaal niveau inzichtelijk te maken en afspraken hierover in de inkoopcontracten van 2018 te verwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Slootweg over het bericht 'Draagvlak mantelzorg is tanende'

CDA MPs asked the minister about a report showing declining public support for informal care and whether municipalities and insurers consider caregivers' capacity, awareness of support options, and shared decision-making. The minister acknowledged the strain on caregivers and promised talks with municipalities, Mezzo and insurers, plus a later SCP publication and a Langer Thuis programme with concrete agreements.

I will therefore enter into discussion with municipalities, Mezzo and caregivers themselves to see how we can jointly ensure that informal care remains bearable and that care remains adequate for the care recipient.

Ik zal daarom met gemeenten, Mezzo en mantelzorgers zelf in gesprek gaan om te kijken hoe we gezamenlijk ervoor kunnen zorgen dat mantelzorg dragelijk blijft en dat de zorg toereikend blijft voor de zorgvrager.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het onderzoek “Economische’ daklozen vallen tussen wal en schip; Zelfredzaam zonder dak’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about a report on 'self-reliant' homeless people who fall between care systems, including how many exist and how the coalition agreement's call for better-aligned care applies. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said such people are not counted, attributed implementation problems to professionals' limited discretion, and promised a multi-year agenda and an update before summer 2018.
It is up to municipalities to provide shelter to all residents of the Netherlands who need it, regardless of the specific problems involved.
Het is aan gemeenten om aan alle ingezetenen van Nederland opvang te verlenen indien zij dat nodig hebben, ongeacht de specifieke problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'De overheid is de regie kwijt in het bestrijden van overlast van ratten'

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about reports that government has lost control of rat control, including the health risks, the RIVM rat monitoring, WHO advice, the status of an initiative group, the effectiveness of integrated pest management and public information for households. The ministers answered that three ministries share responsibility, that no national plague or clear rise in rat-related disease is visible, that existing legal frameworks cover prevention, and that monitoring, a planned effectiveness study and consumer information are under way.
Three ministries jointly lead the control of rat nuisance.
Er zijn drie ministeries die gezamenlijk regie voeren op het bestrijden van overlast van ratten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het instellen van een draagmoederbank

An MP asks the health minister whether a Dutch surrogacy bank should be established, following calls from specialists and FIOM, and asks about legal changes, risks of exploitation and transparency for children. The minister says the question depends on the Staatscommissie's recommendations and announces studies to be reported to parliament in January 2018, without committing to amending the law.
The Minister for Legal Protection will inform the House in January 2018 about the studies announced in the coalition agreement following the Staatscommissie's advice.
De Minister voor Rechtsbescherming zal uw Kamer in januari 2018 informeren over de in het regeerakkoord aangekondigde onderzoeken naar aanleiding van het advies van de Staatscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma over het pleidooi van gemeenten om meer soorten van de wietproef toe te staan

The MPs asked whether the government would allow several kinds of cannabis cultivation experiments as municipalities requested, rather than only one centrally supplied model, and whether they would consult the VNG. The minister said the experiments are still being designed in consultation with partners including municipalities and an independent evaluation committee, and aimed to submit the legislation in the second quarter of 2018.
We aim to submit the necessary legislation and regulations to your House in the second quarter of 2018.
Wij streven ernaar om de benodigde wet- en regelgeving in het tweede kwartaal van 2018 bij uw Kamer in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht van het CBS “Kinderen eten te weinig fruit, groente en vis”

An MP asked the ministers whether the CBS finding that most children eat too little fruit, vegetables and fish is worrying, why lower-educated parents' children eat less healthily, what role government plays in healthy eating, and whether VAT on fruit and vegetables should be reduced. The state secretary acknowledged the concern and the socioeconomic gradient, pointed to Voedingscentrum information, school and childcare programmes and a forthcoming Nationaal Preventieakkoord, defended the National School Breakfast and sponsorship rules, and said the IBO found weaker evidence for price measures on food than on tobacco and alcohol.
I will inform your House about this in more detail.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gevolgen van schade door aardbevingen op de gezondheid

An SP MP asks the ministers about the health effects of earthquake damage in Groningen, citing a rise in health complaints, the under-counting of damage in the NAM register, the closed damage protocol, and the NAM's close operational and financial ties to the Centrum Veilig Wonen. The minister answers that the damage process is stalled pending a new protocol, that NAM will step back from damage decisions, and that a regional fund and a public-controlled damage fund are being explored, while declining to publish the NAM-CVW contract and stating that the KPMG report was already sent to parliament.
However, the old damage-handling protocol set by NAM has been closed and damage handling has been at a standstill for some time pending a new damage protocol.
Het oude, door NAM vastgestelde protocol voor behandeling van schademeldingen is echter gesloten en de schadeafhandeling ligt al geruime tijd stil in afwachting van een nieuw schadeprotocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over mogelijk nog grotere fraude bij CASA klinieken

An MP asked the minister whether CASA clinics might have billed abortions that never took place, given the gap with other clinics' expected September 2017 volumes, and asked for inspection checks and no permit before answers were given. The minister said clinics report quarterly by law, the inspectorate will compare figures, and a permit for a successor will not be decided before the answers are received.
I will ask the IGJ i.o. to compare the data for this period with the same period in 2016.
Ik zal de IGJ i.o. vragen de gegevens over deze periode te vergelijken met dezelfde periode in 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over euthanasie in de Levenseindekliniek bij psychiatrisch patiënten

Two MPs asked the Health Minister whether euthanasia by the Levenseindekliniek for psychiatric patients who were not fully treated, or not in unbearable hopeless suffering, was in line with the Chabot ruling and why the RTE judged such cases careful. The Minister declined to judge individual cases, explained the distinction between hopeless suffering and absence of a reasonable alternative, said he would discuss concerns with the profession in the evaluation of the euthanasia law, but saw no reason to doubt current practice.
It is not for me as Minister to judge individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om te oordelen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Groot over het bericht 'Volkerak weer deels opengesteld'

A D66 MP asked the ministers whether opening part of the Volkerak to eel and mitten crab fishing is justified given dioxin and PCB contamination, ICES advice against eel fishing, and proposed EU zero catch limits. The minister answered that the opening followed the policy rule applied to measured eel contamination, that two extra areas were closed, that a national autumn fishing ban exists, and that the EU measures and 2018 reporting will be monitored.
I consider this decision to be correct, because the policy rule has been applied.
Ik beoordeel dit besluit als juist, omdat de beleidsregel is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Personeelstekort in de zorg is in een jaar tijd bijna verdubbeld’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about reports that staff shortages in care nearly doubled in a year, with high workload driving staff out, and what role the minister would play. The minister agreed that satisfied, healthy staff are essential, pointed to an action plan on three tracks (attracting, deploying and retaining staff) and regional action plans, but gave no concrete new measures.
I share your view that satisfied and healthy employees are indispensable for solving the staff shortage.
Ik deel uw mening dat tevreden en gezonde werknemers onmisbaar zijn voor het oplossen van het personeelstekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het Rapport ‘Naleving aanwijzing dd. 7 november 2016 Stichting Careyn’

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Health about the Inspectorate's report on Stichting Careyn's compliance with a formal directive, including whether confidence in care quality and safety is sufficient and what the findings mean for residents. The minister answered that the Inspectorate sees Careyn on the right track, that no acute risks were found, that organisation-wide improvements are still needed, and that the Inspectorate will intervene if risks change.
Careyn has indicated that it will do everything in its power and continue unabated with implementing the action plan for improving the quality of care.
Careyn heeft aangegeven hier alles aan te doen en onverminderd door te gaan met de uitvoering van het plan van aanpak voor de verbetering van de kwaliteit van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Futselaar over het bericht dat er een studentenstop is aan de verpleegkunde opleidingen

MPs Marijnissen and Futselaar asked about a reported student admission stop for nursing programmes amid a severe nurse shortage, the adequacy of internship places, use of trainees to fill staff gaps, and demands from nurses' organisations. Minister De Jonge answered that growth in places is managed regionally, that no hard data exist on students stopping for lack of internships, that the Stagefonds and regional action plans are being used, and that a planned action day was supported.
According to the Landelijk Overleg Opleiding Verpleegkunde, there is no hard data on students who had to stop their studies due to a shortage of internship places.
Volgens het Landelijk Overleg Opleiding Verpleegkunde zijn er geen harde gegevens over studenten die hun studie hebben moeten stoppen vanwege een tekort aan stageplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en Van der Linde over het bericht dat er een studentenstop is aan de verpleegkunde opleidingen

MPs Hermans and Van der Linde asked the ministers of Health and Education about reports of a student intake cap (numerus fixus) for nursing programmes despite a nursing shortage, including its causes, internship availability and the Utrecht case. The minister answered that fixus programmes fell from 56 to 33, that caps protect quality and internship places, that internship capacity has grown, and that the Utrecht university of applied sciences is moving to a cap of 400 full-time students.
The main reason for a programme to introduce a numerus fixus is to maintain the quality of the programme and to offer students sufficient and good-quality internship places.

De voornaamste reden voor een opleiding om een numerus fixus in te stellen is om de kwaliteit van de opleiding te behouden en om voor de studenten voldoende en kwalitatief goede stageplekken te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Q-koorts is geconstateerd in de gemeente Bodegraven-Reeuwijk

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Q-fever infection cluster of three people in Bodegraven-Reeuwijk, including the source investigation, nearby livestock vaccination, public information and the advice to residents. The minister answered that GGD and NVWA are jointly investigating the source, that a nearby farm lacking vaccination was ordered to vaccinate, and that the GGD informed GPs and the municipality, while the source remains unknown.
The GGD and the NVWA are jointly conducting research to find the source of this infection.
De GGD en de NVWA voeren gezamenlijk onderzoek uit om de bron van deze besmetting te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat meer kinderen in een gesloten jeugdinstelling belanden

An MP asked the health minister why closed youth institution placements rose, about budget cuts and staffing, and whether research and extra funding would follow. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, promised an effect monitor study of placements and an evaluation of the Youth Act in spring 2018, but did not accept that the cuts harmed care quality.
I will ask them to investigate this topic within the framework of this effect monitor youth care plus.
Ik zal hen vragen dit onderwerp in het kader van deze effectmonitor jeugdhulp plus te gaan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de lange wachtlijsten en de tekorten in de jeugdzorg

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister about long waiting lists and shortages in youth care, rising bureaucracy since the 2015 Youth Act, a petition on local quality differences, and municipal deficits of about 300 million euro. The minister acknowledged concerns, pointed to regional expert teams, standardisation of information systems, a pending bill to reduce administrative burdens, and said the deficit question requires clarifying the causes before any solution, and that answers for the GGZ debate could not be provided in time.
Due to the necessary coordination with third parties, it unfortunately did not prove possible to answer these questions before the GGZ committee meeting of 29 November.
Het is – vanwege de noodzakelijke afstemming met derden – helaas niet gelukt om deze vragen te beantwoorden voor het AO GGZ van 29 november.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het niet herkennen van signalen van mensenhandel door artsen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretaries whether doctors fail to recognise human trafficking signals, whether trafficking should be added to the meldcode for domestic violence and child abuse, how doctors can be trained, and what role municipalities should play. The minister answered that the existing meldcode can support professionals on trafficking, medical bodies can extend it, and the Lenferink recommendations are being pushed at municipalities, with an integrated action plan promised.

In the talks I am having on the meldcode for domestic violence and child abuse, I will emphasise with the KNMG doctors' federation this possibility and the important role of medical professional groups in it.

In de gesprekken die ik voer over de meldcode huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling zal ik met de artsenfederatie KNMG deze mogelijkheid en de belangrijke rol hierin van de medische beroepsgroepen benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Gemeenten weigeren massaal onderzoek jeugd’

MPs El Yassini and Raemakers asked the health minister about reports that municipalities refuse the mandatory client-experience survey for youth care, including low response rates and privacy risks when youths are written to. The minister answered that privacy is a municipal responsibility supported by VNG, that a pilot questionnaire is being evaluated, and that he will discuss improving the survey with municipalities, while no sanction on non-compliant municipalities is announced.
It is not known how many municipalities additionally carried out the youth client-experience survey but did not send the results to the ministry.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten daarnaast het cliëntervaringsonderzoek Jeugd wèl hebben uitgevoerd, maar de uitkomsten ervan niet aan VWS hebben verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, De Graaf en Agema over het bericht dat senioren in Apeldoorn overdonderd zijn door de komst van Turkse leeftijdsgenoten

MPs from the PVV asked ministers whether it is acceptable that a housing corporation in Apeldoorn plans to let vacated flats in a senior complex to Turkish elderly receiving home care, without consulting current residents, and asked for the plans to be stopped. The minister replied that corporations are free to set allocation policy within the Housing and Tenancy Acts, that the corporation appears to have followed the legal consultation procedure, and that residents can complain to the independent complaints committee or the courts, but that the minister has no role in individual allocation policy.
As far as I can tell, the housing corporation has acted within the framework of the law.
Voor zover ik kan nagaan heeft de woningcorporatie binnen de kaders van de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over het bericht 'Zo belanden honderden kinderen per jaar in de isoleercel'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that hundreds of children yearly end up in isolation cells in closed youth care and about the criteria, frequency and oversight of freedom-restricting measures. The Minister answered that no national registration exists, that the inspectorate has planned multi-year research on reducing repressive approaches, and that reporting to the inspectorate after such measures will be considered.
How often a freedom-restricting measure is used is not known to me because there is no national registration of it.
Hoe vaak een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel gebruikt wordt is mij niet bekend omdat hiervan geen landelijke registratie bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de misstanden bij Thebe

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about serious misconduct and understaffing at care organisation Thebe, raised via a staff 'Zwartboek', and asked whether the inspectorate and board should act. The minister answered that the board is responsible for safe care, that Thebe is discussing staffing with unions, that the inspectorate found generally positive care quality and sees no reason to intervene, and that he sees no grounds for further action.
I see no reason in the inspectorate's conduct to make statements about the inspectorate's competence.
Ik zie in het handelen van de inspectie geen aanleiding om uitspraken te doen over de bekwaamheid van de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Westerveld over het massaal delen van verhalen over grensoverschrijdend seksueel gedrag

MPs Voortman and Westerveld asked the ministers of Education and of Health about the mass sharing of #MeToo stories on sexual boundary violations, whether the percentage affected is unacceptable, and how schools, coaches, employers and teacher training will address boundaries, consent and harassment. The minister answered that such conduct is unacceptable, that schools already cover sexual boundaries under the existing core objectives, that teacher training and sport programmes address these topics, and that a sport-sector study is expected in December 2017.
Yes, this is already a task of education.
Ja, dit is al een taak van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het vervolgonderzoek naar Alliade

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the status and delay of the supplementary inspection into Alliade's misuse of care funds, and about the Leijten motion on care institutions placing property in separate subsidiaries. The minister replies that the report is delayed to around the turn of the year due to new information being verified, that Alliade is not obstructing the inquiry, and that the subsidiary study has been conducted with findings feeding into the policy response.
Because the investigation is still ongoing, I can only inform you that the supplementary investigation is taking longer than expected
Omdat het onderzoek nog loopt kan ik u daarover alleen laten weten dat het aanvullende onderzoek langer duurt dan verwacht

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Geen zorgtoeslag door mogelijke fraude met de Basisregistratie Personen’

An SP MP asked the government about a tenant denied childcare allowance because the landlord and her child remained registered at the address in the Personal Records Database, despite a rental contract showing they did not live there. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, citing confidentiality, explained that the tax authority may depart from the registry only when there is reasonable doubt and that a registry check is the municipality's responsibility, and promised a discussion with the policy ministries.

However, if the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances has reasonable doubt about the accuracy of the registration (for example following an objection), it must notify the municipality so that the municipality investigates the accuracy of the registration.

Indien de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen echter gerede twijfel heeft over de juistheid van de inschrijving (bijvoorbeeld naar aanleiding van een bezwaar), dient deze hiervan melding te doen aan de gemeente, zodat de gemeente onderzoek doet naar de juistheid van de inschrijving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het verminderde recht op toeslagen als effect van de afbouw van de algemene heffingskorting

SP MPs asked why the phase-out of transferability of the general tax credit to the lower-earning partner pushes single-earner households above the minimum wage, causing loss of allowances and reduced net income, and why the Nationale ombudsman's 2016 concerns have not been resolved. The minister explains the cause of the case, sets out a range of solution directions that are rejected as too costly or disproportionate, and promises to explore options and inform parliament by end 2020.
The cabinet wants to explore options that ensure households with an income at the social minimum always receive the maximum allowance amount for the relevant allowances.
Het kabinet wil de mogelijkheden verkennen die ervoor zorgen dat huishoudens met een inkomen op het sociaal minimum altijd het maximale toeslagenbedrag aan de voor hen relevante toeslagen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over scholen die in de clinch liggen met de Belastingdienst over zonnedaken

GroenLinks MPs asked why schools must charge VAT on electricity fed back to the grid and whether they could be exempted, citing a 2018 motion and the Urgenda ruling. The Secretary of State answered that the new small-business scheme from 2020 lets schools opt out of VAT on feed-in, that a blanket exemption is not possible under EU VAT rules, and that no mandatory rollout of solar panels on school roofs is planned.
An exemption for feed-in to the grid by all schools is not possible.
Een vrijstelling voor de netleveringen door alle scholen is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Lodders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de BRP.

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked the government about registration in the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), including cases where new residents are registered without the main tenant's consent and suffer consequences. Minister Knops answered that he opposes mandatory prior verification and mandatory consent from existing residents, points to municipal responsibility and ongoing work on a BRP change and complaints point, and promises a progress letter in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een belasting op luchtvervuiling in de Nederlandse industrie

An MP asked the ministers whether a tax on industrial air pollution, as proposed by the CPB, is effective and feasible, and what its production and emissions effects would be. The government agrees pricing is a useful instrument, notes modelled production declines of about 4-8% by 2030 with wide uncertainty, and says further study is needed before deciding, preferably at European level.
Should emission reductions fall short of the targets in the future, it would make sense to explore the costs and benefits of additional instruments.
Mocht in de toekomst de emissiereductie achterblijven bij de doelen, dan ligt het in de rede om de kosten en baten van aanvullende instrumenten te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Den Bosch over het bericht ‘gemeentelijke belastingen voor huiseigenaren stijgen hard in 2020’

Two VVD MPs asked whether rising local property taxes (OZB, waste and water levies) in 2020 undermine purchasing power, why the macro-norm was abolished, and what the new municipal benchmark will achieve. The minister answered that local lasten developments await the COELO atlas, that local councils decide tax increases democratically, and that benchmarking informs local debate, while rejecting new proposals for now.
It is up to the municipalities themselves to determine why the increase is necessary.
Het is aan gemeenten zelf om te bepalen waarom de stijging noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het niet meer kosteloos doen van loonaangifte voor ondernemers door de invoering van eHerkenning

Two VVD MPs asked why employers must now use eHerkenning, which costs roughly 40 to 45 euro, to file payroll returns for free-of-charge tax filing, and whether this conflicts with the goal of reducing administrative burden. The minister replied that the government chose mandatory eHerkenning for sensitive payroll data under the Wet digitale overheid, that costs are shared among users and providers, and that the scheme reduces burden with frequent use, but offered no reconsideration.

That is why, for payroll returns from 1 January 2020, the security level 'substantial' applies and a login means with a corresponding reliability level must therefore be used, in this case eHerkenning level 3.

Daarom geldt ter zake van loonaangiften per 1 januari 2020 beveiligingsniveau «substantieel» en moet dus gebruik worden gemaakt van een inlogmiddel met een overeenkomstig betrouwbaarheidsniveau, in dit geval eHerkenning niveau 3.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voortgang van de aanbestedingsprocedure van de ‘Wijziging van de Muntwet 2002 in verband met de aanbesteding van het produceren van munten en het afschaffen van beleggingsmu

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the tender procedure for coin production and the consequences of the abolition of investment coins, including DNB's role, distribution, and commemorative coins. The government answered that the tender for circulation coins was awarded to KNM, the tender for collector products was withdrawn for lack of interest, a short-term contract with KNM covers 2020, and most questions were answered on substance though tender documents were withheld as confidential.
These documents are secret and not publicly available, because strict security requirements and safeguards apply to the production and distribution of coins.
Deze documenten zijn geheim en niet openbaar opvraagbaar, omdat er bij de productie en distributie van munten strenge veiligheidseisen- en waarborgen van toepassing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over corrupte douaniers

MP Groothuizen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about corruption among customs officers in Rotterdam and why a research report on it was not published, including whether the customs service obstructed the study. The ministers answered that the research was independent, referred to a separate letter on the customs service's cooperation, and said screening of customs staff will be strengthened, with a first assessment expected in 2020.
The Police Education Council is an independent advisory body of the Ministry of Justice and Security whose position and tasks are regulated by law.
De Politieonderwijsraad is een onafhankelijk adviesorgaan van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid waarvan positie en taken bij wet zijn geregeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het feit dat de Belastingdienst het recht op huurtoeslag heeft afgewezen, terwijl een burger het wel had doordat er sprake was van verworven rechten

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked why the tax authority refused housing benefit that a citizen received under acquired rights, and how the Council of State ruling of July 2019 is being applied. The government says the authority changed its practice from 24 July 2019, lapsed acquired rights can be revived until 1 September 2020, and past final decisions will not be reopened.
Decisions that are final will not be reopened with retroactive effect.
Besluiten die wel onherroepelijk vaststaan, worden niet met terugwerkende kracht heropend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belastingen voor AOW-gerechtigden

MP Leijten asked whether the VNG's municipal tax-remission norms for AOW pensioners are adequate, given that the maximum norm can fall below the single AOW benefit, and whether the VNG and municipalities should be pressed to change them. Minister Knops answers that the norms follow national rules, municipalities have discretion and may set the maximum at 100% of AOW plus a fixed amount, and that the norms will be considered in the local tax review, with consultation if warranted.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het door laten gaan van loonbeslag bij onterecht als fraudeur aangemerkte ouders en het verstrekken van opgevraagde gegevens aan deze ouders

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether debt collection and wage garnishment against parents wrongly labelled as fraudsters has really stopped, and whether affected parents can inspect their files by phone. The State Secretary answers that a pause applies to most collection measures, that parents who have requested files will receive them, that remaining garnishments should be reported to the Belastingtelefoon, and that objections are granted case by case rather than categorically.
I also responded to the Finance Committee's request to give parents access to their files in my letter of 29 November.
Ook op het verzoek van de commissie van Financiën om ouders inzage te geven in hun dossiers ben ik in mijn brief van 29 november jl. ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Omtzigt over eHerkenning

An MP asked whether businesses must use the commercial eHerkenning login to file payroll and corporate tax returns with the Tax Authority from 1 January 2020, its legal basis, and how the transition will be managed. The minister confirmed the requirement for payroll and corporate tax returns, cited the general AWB and GDPR security duties as the basis, and promised extensions on request and a separate letter on groups without a Chamber of Commerce number by 1 March 2020.
There is a legal basis, as explained in answer to question 2.
Er is een wettelijke grondslag, zoals bij vraag 2 toegelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de mogelijkheid van pensioenoverdracht uit het buitenland

An MP asked whether people with foreign pensions can transfer them under Dutch law, and on the criteria, the obligations of Dutch pension providers, and the options when a new Dutch employer's provider refuses. The minister answered that transfers are possible under the 2015 policy decision and Article 91/92 Pensioenwet, that Dutch providers are obliged to cooperate only for transfers from EU or EEA-based insurers meeting listed conditions, and that transfers to a provider other than the new employer's are not possible.
A transfer to a pension provider other than that of the new employer is not possible.
Een waardeoverdracht naar een andere pensioenuitvoerder dan die van de nieuwe werkgever is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Aanpak belastingontwijking remt buitenlandse investeringen’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the anti-tax-avoidance push is deterring genuine foreign direct investment, and what measures would protect real investment and the investment climate. The State Secretary answered that non-bfi investment rose over ten years with no visible break, that the effect of anti-avoidance measures is hard to isolate, and listed tax-rate cuts, the principal purposes test, and an international coordinated approach as the response.
To be attractive for investment by foreign companies with real economic activity, it is important that the Netherlands has a strong investment climate across the board.
Om aantrekkelijk te zijn voor investeringen van buitenlandse bedrijven met reële economische activiteiten is het van belang dat Nederland een sterk vestigingsklimaat in de breedte heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het zonder waarschuwing incasseren van een openstaande toeslagschuld

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether it is normal that a missed payment within two weeks under a debt arrangement for a childcare-benefit debt triggers payment of the full outstanding amount, and how this fits with incasso policy. The state secretary answered that a reminder is sent first, that the procedure has applied since 2005, that about 212,000 cases were cancelled in 2018, and that personal payment arrangements remain available, while promising to reconsider policy on intent or gross negligence.
Only if that request is not met and no other response follows the payment reminder is the payment arrangement withdrawn, after which the citizen must pay the outstanding amount in one go.

Pas als niet aan dat verzoek wordt voldaan en op de betalingsherinnering evenmin een andere reactie is gevolgd, wordt de betalingsregeling ingetrokken waarna de burger gehouden is het openstaande bedrag in één keer te betalen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Een klik verwijderd van je schuldeisers’

VVD MPs asked the state secretaries about schuldenwijzer.nl, a debt-overview site that currently shows only debts enforced by bailiffs, and why tax authority, municipal and water board debts are not yet included, plus the legal obstacles around citizen service numbers. The government answered that the site helps citizens gain insight, that expansion is in progress led by bailiffs and the Belastingdienst is working on its own portal, and that no concrete legal obstacle has been identified beyond what is still to be signalled by bailiffs.
The Ministry of SZW discusses progress with SNG and KBvG and whether and how government organisations can join.
Het Ministerie van SZW bespreekt met SNG en KBvG de voortgang en ook of en zo ja, hoe overheidsorganisaties kunnen aansluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de evaluaties van 15 CAF projecten (uitgevoerd in 2015), waarom de Kamer meerdere keren gevraagd heeft

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the government had not shared evaluations of 15 CAF projects from 2015 despite repeated parliamentary questions, and when the minister and predecessor knew of them. The State Secretary answered that the evaluations were now attached, that the EDP auditors focused only on CAF 11, that the minister had only recently seen them, and that certain internal deliberation documents would not be shared with parliament.
As I indicated in my letter of 22 November, I consider it of great importance that officials must be able to exchange views freely with me and with each other.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 22 november jl. heb aangegeven acht ik het van groot belang dat ambtenaren met mij en onderling vrij van gedachten moeten kunnen wisselen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het afwijzen van kinderopvangtoeslag omdat de toeslagpartner dagbesteding heeft

An SP MP asks why childcare benefit was refused to a working mother whose partner attends daytime care, and whether this matches the law's aim of supporting work and care. The state secretary declines to comment on the individual case, says daytime care is not a statutory ground for the benefit, and points to municipal social-medical indication as the route, while planning a separate entitlement only for households where a partner has a Wlz indication.
As your House knows, for reasons of privacy I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan ik uit het oogpunt van privacy niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de houdbaarheid van box 3 en het EVRM

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2020 box 3 wealth-tax rates would breach the first protocol of the ECHR, whether legal advice was sought, and for a list of past advice and information on legal risks. The State Secretary answers that the 2017 system is unchanged, that the government takes the position it is not in breach at system level and leaves it to the courts, and that no list exists, while promising advice only on the pre-2017 system.
In these proceedings I take the position that the box 3 levy applicable from 2017 is, at system level, not in conflict with Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR.
In deze procedures neem ik het standpunt in dat de box 3-heffing die geldt vanaf 2017 op stelselniveau niet strijdig is met artikel 1 EP EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Burgemeesters op de bres voor kortebaandraverijen'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the impact of the Wet Kansspelen op afstand and the gambling tax change on short-track harness racing organisations, including possible compensation and whether the sector will survive. The government answered that the wetswijziging will likely lower payouts to the sector, that compensation talks are ongoing with implementation expected 1 January 2021, and that it could not provide a ten-year overview of race numbers.
We do not have the requested overview of developments over the past ten years.
Wij beschikken niet over het gevraagde overzicht van de ontwikkelingen in de afgelopen tien jaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het tarief in box 3 in 2020 en mogelijke schending van het eerste protocol van het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2020 box 3 wealth tax rates (0.54% and 1.27% effective) could breach Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR, referring to Supreme Court rulings and a parliamentary advocate's advice. The State Secretary answered that the rulings concerned 2013-2014, that the 2017-onward system better matches average real returns, that the government is examining the 2013-2014 issue and will seek its own advice, and that it will not give the requested definitive legal assessment before the deadline, with the letter on box 3 sent separately.
The cabinet is examining whether such a violation of Article 1 of the First Protocol by the box 3 system as it applied until 2017 occurs and will obtain its own advice on this.
Het kabinet onderzoekt of een dergelijke schending van artikel 1 EP EVRM door het box 3-stelsel zoals dat gold tot 2017 zich voordoet en zal hierover een eigen advies inwinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de effectieve belastingdruk van grote bedrijven in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the CBS finding that the effective corporate tax burden of large firms fell from 22.7% to 17.1% despite an unchanged nominal rate, and whether this is explainable to taxpayers. The State Secretary answered that loss offsetting and other differences between commercial profit and taxable amount explain the gap, and that the government awaits a further CBS publication and the advisory committee's report before drawing conclusions.
The cabinet is therefore waiting for the further CBS publication and the advice of the Advisory Committee on the taxation of multinationals.
Het kabinet wacht daarom op de nadere publicatie van het CBS en het advies van de Adviescommissie belastingheffing van multinationals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over samenwerking tussen scheepsbouwer Damen en de Nederlandse staat naar aanleiding interne memo’s op het gebied van een corruptieaffaire bij Damen

An SP MP asked the state secretaries whether Damen breached anti-corruption rules after incorrect information on agent payments in 14 cases, whether such conduct is systematic, whether Damen should be excluded from Atradius DSB guarantees, and whether corruption should weigh in the submarine tender. The government declined to judge while the criminal investigation runs, described corrective measures (reassessed cases, lifted World Bank listing, enhanced supervision), and saw no reason to exclude Damen from guarantees or the tender.
Because a criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about that.
Omdat er nog sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik daar geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten en opbrengsten in de belastingsfeer van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the tax revenue and costs attributable to (non-Western) people with a migration background, including tax, benefits and exports of pensions. The minister replied that individual tax contributions cannot be traced for indirect taxes, the Tax Administration does not record migration background, and the requested breakdowns are not available.
For no single person or household can it be determined exactly how much tax money they pay.
Van geen enkele persoon of geen enkel huishouden is exact vast te stellen hoeveel belastinggeld door hem of haar wordt betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de oud-bestuurders van PrivaZorg ruim 14 miljoen zorggeld uit de zorginstelling hebben gesluisd

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Health Minister and the State Secretary of Finance about reports that former PrivaZorg directors siphoned over 14 million euro of care funds through a complex corporate structure, and whether the IGJ, NZa, Tax Service and prosecutors should have acted earlier. The minister answered that the IGJ found no proven unlawful conduct within current legal frameworks, that the agencies lack sufficient powers over governance and integrity, and that new legislation on integrity, supervision and dividend conditions is being prepared.

The IGJ and NZa have previously indicated that they still have insufficient powers to investigate integrity and professional business operations, conflicts of interest, siphoning off care funds and setting up complex inefficient corporate structures.

De IGJ en de NZa hebben eerder aangegeven dat ze nog onvoldoende bevoegdheden hebben om onderzoek te doen naar integere en professionele bedrijfsvoering, belangenverstrengeling, wegsluizen van zorggelden en het optuigen van complexe ondoelmatige bedrijfsstructuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het  bericht dat  de overheid wist van financiële misstanden bij Privazorg, maar niets deed

MP Slootweg asked whether the tax authority knew of Privazorg executives paying themselves from care funds since 2007 and not sharing this with the inspectorate, and about the role of accountancy firm Grant Thornton and multi-entity structures in care organisations. The minister declined individual cases citing tax secrecy, said the inspectorate and NZa lack direct powers over Grant Thornton, and announced legislation on conflicts of interest, internal supervision and transparency.
Due to the tax secrecy obligation under article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht ingevolge artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over beleggers die het onmogelijk maken voor starters om een huis te kopen

MPs Asscher and Nijboer asked whether investors pushing up house prices make it impossible for first-time buyers to buy, and what the government will do about buy-to-let investors, owner-occupancy obligations and rent increases. The minister answered that a price effect is suggested but causality is not shown, that the government is exploring a differentiated transfer tax and box 3 changes, and that rent measures will be decided later in the autumn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Ldders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de Basisregistratie Persoon (BRP)

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether residents can register at any address in the BRP without the consent of existing occupants, and about the checks municipalities must perform, in cases where people are registered without the main resident knowing and suffer financial harm. The state secretary answered that registration depends on actual residence rather than consent, that municipalities control registrations under the BRP law and the adres onderzoek circular, that consent-based registration would undermine the BRP, and that the ministry is discussing solutions with municipal and implementing bodies.
Registration in the BRP at an address in the municipality is therefore not dependent on the consent of the resident already registered at that address.
Inschrijving in de BRP op een adres in de gemeente is derhalve niet afhankelijk van de instemming van de reeds op dat adres ingeschreven bewoner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten ‘Belastingproblemen Nederlandse Amerikanen nog niet de wereld uit’ en ‘Snel vraagt banken om meer coulance voor Amerikaanse Nederlanders’

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Dutch-American 'accidental Americans' face banks closing accounts without a US TIN, and about the conditions and costs of renouncing US citizenship and the IRS relief scheme. The State Secretary answered at length, saying banks are premature in closing accounts, that the situation is a US matter, and that he is pressing the US for lower fees and a joint EU approach.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het onterecht stoppen van huurtoeslag aan statushouders

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked why housing allowance is stopped and reclaimed for statushouder families when a baby is born, and asked for compensation and a fix. The government answers that the allowance is restored retroactively once the child's residence permit is granted, that the problem stems from legal eligibility requirements rather than automatic database linking, and promises to examine options with other ministers and report in spring 2020.
Even in the case of an initially late application for a residence permit, there is ultimately no loss of housing allowance.
Zelfs bij een in eerste instantie te late aanvraag van een verblijfstitel is er dus uiteindelijk geen verlies aan huurtoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de buitensporige subsidie van de luchtvaartsector

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked the government about claimed excessive subsidies to the aviation sector, including tax treatment of kerosene, Schiphol's accessibility costs, WTO rulings on Airbus and Boeing, and airport charges. The minister disputed the subsidy calculation, provided partial figures and data on Schiphol-related spending, and promised a forthcoming overview of external costs of aviation.
Question 2: Do you endorse the subsidy of 86.29 euros per person calculated in this article?
Vraag 2 Onderschrijft u de in dit artikel berekende subsidie van 86,29 euro per persoon
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de stijgende lasten voor woningcorporaties

An MP asked the Interior and Finance ministers whether the rising levy on housing associations (verhuurderheffing) and the ATAD tax rules are shrinking their investment capacity and new affordable construction, and whether the government will compensate them. The minister answered that the levy rise is mainly from WOZ-value growth and an earlier higher revenue estimate, that the 100 million euro rate cut offsets the burden, that associations' planned investments have risen, and that a 100 million euro annual reduction for building in shortage areas was announced.
There is no reason to assume that the lower new-build figures were caused by a shortage of investment capacity in the short and medium term as a result of the landlord levy.
Er is geen reden om aan te nemen dat de lagere nieuwbouwcijfers zijn ingegeven door een tekort aan investeringskracht op de korte en middellange termijn als gevolg van de verhuurderheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aangekondigde importheffing voor afval

An MP asked the government about the risk that a planned import levy on waste would push waste to landfill abroad or in the Netherlands, increasing CO2 emissions, and about its revenue, heat supply and renewable energy effects. The state secretary answered that leakage risks were limited, estimated a 4 Mton reduction package, gave a revenue forecast, and declined to reconsider the measure.
A reconsideration of this measure is, as far as the cabinet is concerned, therefore not on the table.
Een heroverweging van deze maatregel is wat het kabinet betreft dan ook niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de verwachting dat meer ouders te maken hebben gehad met onterechte stopzetting van kinderopvangtoeslag dan eerder gedacht en het onderzoek naar andere CAF-onderzoeken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Auditdienst Rijk investigation into other CAF cases took about four months to commission, whether the child care allowance stoppages were unlawful, who ordered them, and what happens to affected parents. The State Secretary answered that preparatory work and a broader ADR investigation took time, that the ADR will examine whether similar stoppages occurred in other CAF cases, and that the matter of who gave the orders and the individual cases remain under investigation or are not discussed.
I cannot rule out that this approach was also applied in other allowance-related CAF cases to a large number of persons at the same time.
Ik kan niet uitsluiten dat deze handelwijze ook in andere toeslaggerelateerde CAF-zaken bij een groot aantal personen tegelijk is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de verbijsterende CAF-affaire met de kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the CAF childcare benefit affair, including unlawful suspensions and recovery, withheld information, possible ethnic profiling, and accountability of the Tax Administration. The State Secretary answers most questions by referring to pending investigations by the Adviescommissie and Auditdienst Rijk, acknowledges some unlawful decisions, and states he will not comment on individuals.
All relevant information about the cases is currently being inventoried for the Advisory Committee and the ADR.
Alle relevante informatie over de zaken wordt op dit moment geïnventariseerd ten behoeve van de Adviescommissie en de ADR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de kinderopvangtoeslag-affaire en alle aspecten daarvan

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about the childcare benefit scandal, including the unlawful stopping of payments in the CAF-11 case, the duration of misconduct, withheld documents, accountability and possible criminal or disciplinary consequences. The State Secretary answers that the Council of State ruled the stopping unlawful, that the Adviescommissie and ADR are investigating, and that documents will be released only after those investigations and Wob procedures conclude.
I have asked the Advisory Committee and the ADR to investigate the conduct of Toeslagen.
Ik heb de Adviescommissie en de ADR gevraagd het handelen van Toeslagen te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de informatie die de regering gaf over de CAF-11 zaak aan de Nationale ombudsman

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked whether the government told the National Ombudsman that all 235 parents affected by the CAF-11 childcare benefit case were clients of the childcare agency Dadim in 2014, and whether this misled the Ombudsman into closing his inquiry. The State Secretary confirmed the 235 figure was communicated, said only about 200 were linked to Dadim, and maintained the Ombudsman said the exact number did not affect his conclusions.
Toeslagen informed me upon request that approximately 200 of these 235 parents were affiliated with the childcare agency concerned.
Toeslagen heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat circa 200 van deze 235 vraagouders waren aangesloten bij het betrokken gastouderbureau.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een ambtenaar die een stuk van het onderzoek van de EDP-auditors uit het concept-verslag van onafhankelijke onderzoekers verwijderde met het oog op het eventueel mo

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance why a civil servant removed the authorisation part of the EDP auditors' draft report on the CAF 11 childcare benefits affair, and whether this was consistent with independent investigation and prior commitments to parliament. The State Secretary answered that the authorisation investigation was dropped from the assignment in agreement with the auditors because it would add little value, that no content was removed from the draft report itself, and that the relevant Wob documents have been released.
So nothing was removed from the draft investigation.
Er is dus niets weggehaald uit het concept-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het optreden van KMar- en douanemedewerkers op Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport en Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An MP asks ministers about alleged ethnic profiling and discriminatory treatment by Customs and the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee at Schiphol and Eindhoven airports, including an Ombudsman finding on Customs cash checks. The government denies systematic profiling, acknowledges shortcomings in information provision and one inappropriate remark, cites ongoing complaint procedures, and declines a separate investigation while awaiting the Ombudsman's own inquiry.
Yes, Customs acknowledges that at the time of the complaint the provision of information at Eindhoven Airport was insufficient
Ja, de Douane erkent dat ten tijde van de klacht de informatieverstrekking op Eindhoven Airport onvoldoende was
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over de Wet modernisering kleineondernemersregeling (KOR)

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about the implementation of the modernised small business scheme (KOR), its turnover threshold of €20,000, and the consequences of a CJEU ruling on margin-scheme dealers. The State Secretary answered that the scheme takes effect on 1 January 2020, outlined the communication campaign, defended the threshold as budget-neutral and comparable within the EU, and said the scheme will be evaluated and the threshold adjusted if warranted.
However, it is necessary that the new article 24 of the Implementing Decree VAT 1968, as it would enter into force on 1 January 2020, be withdrawn.
Wel is het noodzakelijk dat het nieuwe artikel 24 Uitvoeringsbeschikking OB 1968, zoals dat in werking zou treden per 1 januari 2020, wordt ingetrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Peters over ‘meer dan 100.000 ouders die de komende maanden meer dan 1.000 euro kindgebonden budget krijgen nabetaald en mogelijk geen enkele band meer hebben met hun kind(eren)

MPs Omtzigt and Peters asked about over 100,000 parents receiving retroactive kindgebonden budget payments of over 1,000 euro, including cases where a parent has lost parental authority or been convicted of offences against a child, the position of separated parents, deceased parents, parents abroad, anti-cumulation rules, and seizure. The government answered that only the parent entitled to child benefit receives the payment, that entitled parents may still receive it after losing parental authority or being convicted, that the payment is protected from seizure, and that cross-border anti-cumulation arrangements are still being worked out.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg en Geurts over de Nederlandse voorbereiding op een harde Brexit

CDA MPs asked the government about the Dutch preparations for a hard Brexit on 31 October 2019, covering customs staffing and enforcement choices, medicine and medical device shortages, live animal inspection posts and NVWA capacity. The government answered that staffing targets were met, customs and NVWA preparations continue, and that shortages and disruptions cannot be fully ruled out.
The Tweede Kamer was informed about these choices in the cabinet letter dated 18 January 2019.
Over deze keuzes is de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd in de brief van het kabinet d.d. 18 januari 2019

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over de berichten “Criminelen wassen 1 miljard wit via export tweedehandsauto’s” en “Autobedrijven frauderen voor miljoenen bij export ex-leaseauto’s”

MPs Van der Linde and Lodders asked about press reports of money laundering through export of second-hand and ex-lease cars, asking about the scale of fraud, reporting figures, FIU access to customs data, and enforcement capacity. The Ministers answered that a criminal investigation into four dealers covers roughly 120 million euro in exports and a 21 million euro VAT loss, that no overall figures exist, and that existing cooperation and a new anti-money-laundering plan are being strengthened, while withholding further details due to the ongoing investigation.
Because this criminal investigation is still ongoing, further details cannot be disclosed.
Omdat dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt, kunnen verdere details niet worden vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over bpm-fraude bij parallelimport

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked the State Secretary of Finance about BPM fraud in imported used cars, including timing of announced measures, import and inspection figures, post-assessments, objections and no-cure-no-pay practices. The government answered that solutions are being worked out with a letter this autumn, gave import volumes, said inspections stayed flat at about 1,000 per half year, and declined to quantify penalties and some objection data for lack of registration or management information.
This autumn, your House will be further informed about this.
