Dit najaar wordt uw Kamer hierover verder geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de inspanningen van de Belastingdienst om bij te dragen aan het bestrijden van georganiseerde criminaliteit en het afpakken van misdaadgeld

SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked about the Tax Authority's contribution to fighting organised crime and seizing criminal proceeds, including why its EUR 7 million funding request from the Ondermijningsfonds was not honoured and whether regions can set their own priorities. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the request was declined due to uncertainty over a pilot, that Tax Authority priorities are set nationally within regional LIEC/RIEC structures, that extra structural funding is planned with details due on Prinsjesdag, and that asset-seizure ambitions are being pursued jointly with the Public Prosecution Service.
Given the operational nature of the spending proposals submitted by the other partners, I will not make the reinforcement plans public.
Gezien de operationele aard van de bestedingsvoorstellen die door de overige partners zijn ingediend zal ik de versterkingsplannen niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het bericht ‘Uber created $ 6.1 billion Dutch weapon to avoid paying taxes’

Green Left MP Snels asked the State Secretary for Finance about reports that Uber used Dutch structures to shelter intellectual property from tax, whether Netherlands is seen as tax-friendly, how IP valuation and amortisation work, and how the Tax Authority supervises transfer pricing. The State Secretary denied the Netherlands is a tax-friendly alternative, said quantitative data on IP transfers is unavailable, outlined the arm's-length and amortisation rules, and described tightened ruling practice and transfer-pricing audit approaches while refusing to create new amortisation limits.
Information on transfers of intellectual property to the Netherlands from countries on the Dutch list of low-tax jurisdictions is not available because it does not appear from the tax returns.

2 Informatie over verplaatsingen van intellectueel eigendom naar Nederland vanuit landen die zijn opgenomen op de Nederlandse lijst met laagbelastende jurisdicties 3 is niet voorhanden omdat dit niet uit de aangiften naar voren komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Uber verhuist van Bermuda naar Nederland om winstbelasting’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Uber is moving its intellectual property from Bermuda to the Netherlands for tax reasons, including whether a ruling guarantees annual tax deductions and how this fits the coalition agreement. The State Secretary declined to discuss Uber's individual tax position under AWR article 67, explained the general arm's-length and ruling framework, and pointed to planned anti-avoidance measures without committing to any new action on this case.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot comment on the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 AWR kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Uber een belastingvoordeel van miljarden heeft gecreëerd in Nederland

MPs Nijboer (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Uber created a multi-billion-euro tax deduction in the Netherlands by moving intellectual property from Bermuda, and whether the tax ruling and the relocation were lawful and fair. The State Secretary answered that under the general confidentiality rule of Article 67 AWR he cannot discuss the position of an individual taxpayer, explained the general rules, and listed existing anti-avoidance measures and a commission on multinational taxation.
Under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR) I cannot go into the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de ruling van Uber in Nederland

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about Uber's reported transfer of intellectual property from Bermuda to the Netherlands, the resulting tax step-up, contacts with Uber, the arm's-length research, and whether the new ruling policy allowed such a ruling. The State Secretary declined to discuss Uber's individual tax position under the confidentiality rules of the General Tax Act, described the arm's-length principle and the ongoing research due in early 2020, and explained the July 2019 ruling policy change.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 AWR kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Verkoop personenauto’s zakt flink in eerste halfjaar 2019’

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a reported 10% drop in new passenger car sales in the first half of 2019, the rise in BPM revenue despite fewer sales, and whether the BPM tables will be adjusted for the WLTP test procedure. State Secretary Snel answers that sales fluctuations are normal, that BPM revenue rose because cars became heavier and more CO2-intensive, and that the BPM will switch to WLTP-based tables from 1 July 2020 with compensating adjustments.
As described in the answer to question 3, such fluctuations in the number of new car sales are not unusual.
Zoals beschreven in het antwoord op vraag 3 zijn dergelijke fluctuaties in het aantal nieuwverkochte auto's niet ongebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de import van tweedehands elektrische auto’s voor een lagere bijtelling

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether young second-hand electric cars imported to take advantage of a lower company-car tax rate could be curbed, for example by tying the rate to first Dutch registration. The State Secretary answered that the rate depends on first-registration date wherever in the world, that such imports are expected to remain small, and that tying the rate to Dutch registration would breach EU free movement rules.
I see no possibilities to make the company-car tax rate for an imported zero-emission car depend on the moment it is registered on a Dutch license plate.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om bij import van een emissievrije auto het bijtellingspercentage afhankelijk te stellen van het moment dat ze in Nederland op kenteken worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over het artikel “Recalcitrant accountholders in de IGA”

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about a legal article on FATCA's intergovernmental agreement, including how banks must handle US persons without a TIN and whether the IRS can judge banks significantly non-compliant. The State Secretary largely rejected the article's interpretation, said the Netherlands is pressing the US for clarity and a simpler SSN procedure, but admitted US positions remain unclear and no concrete US measures have been announced.
I do not agree with this interpretation of Article 4, second paragraph, of the IGA.
Ik ben het niet eens met deze uitleg van artikel 4, tweede lid, van de IGA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Omtzigt over het bericht dat er geen deal is tussen Belastingdienst en Uber over een aftrekpost

MPs Bruins and Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority had communicated with the press about whether a ruling on a deduction exists with Uber, and asked for a reply within a week. The State Secretary declined to confirm or deny the existence of any ruling, citing the tax confidentiality duty in article 67 AWR, and said he had no reason to think that duty was breached.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, it is not permitted to disclose information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op basis van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake Rijksbelastingen is het niet toegestaan informatie over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Azarkan over  verboden staatssteun aan Nike

The MP Azarkan asks the State Secretary of Finance about reported improper tax benefits for Nike via a tax ruling that shifts profits to commanditaire vennootschappen, whether tax will be recovered, and whether rulings and substance requirements will be tightened. The State Secretary says the ruling sets an arm's-length remuneration, that it is not yet established that too little tax was paid since the European Commission is investigating state aid, offers a confidential technical briefing, and states that the new Besluit vooroverleg from 1 July 2019 bars rulings where tax saving is the sole or decisive motive and introduces an economic nexus test.
I have offered your House confidential and closed technical briefing information on the investigation procedure, the concluded rulings and the Netherlands' position.
Ik heb uw Kamer aangeboden in een vertrouwelijke en besloten technische briefing informatie te verstrekken over de onderzoeksprocedure, de afgesloten rulings en het standpunt van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Lodders over het bericht dat de Kamerbrief over letselschade foute cijfers bevat

Two MPs (Leijten, SP and Lodders, VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance why figures in a letter on personal injury compensation in the wealth tax were questioned, how injury experts were involved, whether clarity can be given quickly, and whether the debate affects the decision on counting injury compensation as own assets. The State Secretary refers to a reply letter on the motion and does not answer the questions in the text itself.

The written questions from MPs Leijten (SP) and Lodders (VVD), question number 2019Z150123, have been answered by means of the letters 'Response to the motion by MPs Leijten and Lodders on personal injury compensation'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Leijten (SP) en Lodders (VVD), vraagnummer 2019Z150123 , zijn beantwoord middels de brieven «Reactie op de motie van de leden Leijten en Lodders over letselschadevergoedingen» (Kamerstuk 35 026, nrs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Hermans over de monitoring van de afschaffing BPM-teruggaaf voor taxi’s en openbaar vervoer

MPs Lodders and Hermans asked the State Secretary of Finance how the monitoring of the abolition of the BPM refund for taxis and public transport (including accessible transport) is being carried out, and about zero-emission vehicle availability, range, weight-related licence issues, and the absence of greening in the 'Iedereen Onderweg' agenda. The government answered that monitoring of supply is underway, that zero-emission options exist but are more limited for wheelchair taxis, that the rolstoelbusje refund for care institutions remains, and that greening is already covered by a separate convenant.
For the debate on the Tax Plan 2020, the cabinet will return in more detail to the supply of very low-emission and zero-emission vehicles for targeted transport.
Voor de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2020 komt het kabinet uitgebreider terug op het aanbod van zeer zuinige en emissievrije voertuigen voor doelgroepenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over onbeantwoorde vragen over artikel 68 van de grondwet, de inlichtingenplicht van de regering

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked the government about delayed answers to parliamentary questions on the duty to provide information (article 68 of the Constitution), including state secrecy, deliberately delayed FOI requests and withheld information. The minister answered that questions were grouped for clarity, that the government does not track the requested statistics, that state-interest refusals are rare and pre-tested in cabinet, and that Parliament's information right is broader than the FOI law.
Parliament's right to information is in several respects also broader than the right to public access under the FOI law.
Het recht op inlichtingen van de Kamer is in een aantal opzichten ook breder dan het recht op openbaarheid onder de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de samenwerking tussen scheepsbouwer Damen en de Nederlandse staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries and Foreign Minister about Atradius export-credit insurance for shipbuilder Damen, alleged fraud and irregularities, and whether the submarine replacement decision should wait for clarity on Damen. The government confirmed 67 policies worth 1.89 billion euro, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and said suspicion of fraud is not grounds for exclusion from tender under the Defence procurement law.
Because this case involves an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide further statements on this.
Omdat er in deze casus sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik daar geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Lodders over de heffingskorting van Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Van Weyenberg and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the loss of tax credits (heffingskortingen) for Dutch pensioners abroad since 2019, including the number affected, budget estimates, AOW export rules, and how they were informed. The State Secretary confirmed the change follows from Belastingplan 2018 and 2019, gave estimates of about 350,000 and 130,000 affected persons and a 3 million euro revenue estimate, and described Belastingdienst and SVB communication, while not providing a precise count of AOW recipients affected.
The concrete share of these persons in the numbers is not known.
Het concrete aandeel van deze personen in de aantallen is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over de teveel betaalde belasting en ZVW-premie door oud-gevangenispersoneel dat met SBF-verlof is gegaan

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked whether former prison staff on SBF leave were wrongly charged income tax and health premiums after a 2013 law change, and why some were not compensated. The State Secretary answered that the 104-week limit runs from the start of SBF leave, that the Tax Authority and DJI reached a settlement in late 2018, and that 151 people were not refunded because no excess tax was paid for them.
This establishes that the white table applies to the remaining part of the 104-week period as of 1 January 2013.
Daarmee is vastgelegd dat op het per 1 januari 2013 resterende deel van het tijdvak van 104 weken de witte tabel wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de btw-plicht voor toezichthouders in het licht van een recente uitspraak van het Europees Hof

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT liability of supervisory board members after a 2019 CJEU ruling that such a member, paid a fixed fee and bearing no business risk, is not an independent economic operator. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, said assessment is case-by-case by the inspector, declined a general policy decree for now pending a Supreme Court case, and explained that prior VAT declarations are final and no ex officio refund follows, while also withholding the legal advice and Commission correspondence for now.

Asked for the legal advice and correspondence with the European Commission, I inform you that I am still examining the extent to which these documents may be provided, since they concern communication with or from third parties.

Gevraagd naar de juridische adviezen en correspondentie met de Europese Commissie deel ik u mee dat ik nog onderzoek in hoeverre deze stukken mogen worden verstrekt nu het communicatie van/aan derden betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het artikel ‘Energie voor elektrische auto superduur, rijden toch het goedkoopst’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked whether electric car charging, though costlier per kWh than fuel, is cheaper per kilometre than diesel, and what the government will do about fiscal incentives for business drivers and charging prices. The state secretary answered that efficiency offsets the higher per-kWh price, rejected the claim that diesel is generally cheaper, and pointed to Klimaatakkoord measures such as lowering the energy tax on electricity and raising the diesel excise.
No, I do not share that conclusion.
Nee, ik deel die conclusie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over de vermogensrendementsheffing

Two MPs (Lodders, Omtzigt) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Supreme Court ruling that the assumed 4% box 3 return was unrealistic for 2013 and 2014, and what it means for the wealth tax, future reform and pending objections. The State Secretary answered that the ruling leaves the assessments intact, that massive objections for 2013-2016 will be rejected by collective decision, that a real-return system is being studied with spaargeld results promised before Prinsjesdag, and that the questions would be answered within three weeks.
The Supreme Court attaches no consequences to a possible violation at system level in its ruling and leaves the assessments in place.
De Hoge Raad verbindt in het arrest geen gevolgen aan een mogelijke schending op stelselniveau en laat de aanslagen in stand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over de belastbaarheid van de premiebijdrage aan Gemeentepolis

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked whether the Tax Authority's plan to tax the part of the municipal Gemeentepolis premium covering the statutory deductible is legally justified and whether it is undesirable. The government replied that, after consultation between departments, taxing that part will not arise, and the social affairs ministry will inform municipalities.
After consultation between the departments concerned, it has been established that taxing the said part of the municipal contribution will not arise.
Na overleg tussen de betrokken departementen is vastgesteld dat het belasten van voornoemd deel van de gemeentelijke bijdrage niet aan de orde zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Fiscaal verdrag drijft Amerikanen in Nederland tot wanhoop’

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the US FATCA tax treaty is driving Americans living in the Netherlands to despair, including missing US TIN/SSN numbers and possible bank account closures. The State Secretary answered that he raised the issue with US authorities, that no extension of the transition period is expected, that significant non-compliance sanctions are a last resort, and that he is coordinating with France and other EU partners.
The size of this group as of 1 June 2019 is not known to me.
De omvang van deze groep op 1 juni 2019 is mij niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het uitblijven van verzoeken en vragen van Kamerleden over achtergrond en aanleiding van het onderzoek naar vermeende fraude met kinderopvangtoeslag en het onterecht stopzetten

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the government withheld documents and information about the CAF 11 childcare benefit fraud investigation and the wrongful termination of childcare benefits for hundreds of parents, including who commissioned the EDP-auditors' follow-up work, the reasons for deeper investigation, and the completeness of parents' files. The State Secretary answered that the auditors' follow-up was chosen in consultation with the ministry without restriction, that internal deliberation documents are not made public by policy, that the tax authority's CAF information management was inadequate, and that he regrets the harm to families and will work to restore trust, while declining to comment on individual officials or cases.
It is standing government policy not to make documents drawn up for internal deliberation a subject of political debate.
Het is staand beleid van het kabinet om documenten die zijn opgesteld ten behoeve van intern beraad geen onderwerp van politiek debat te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de CAF 11-zaak

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary of Finance, in around 25 questions, about the CAF 11 childcare-allowance case: the basis for suspending benefits, the 2011 and 2013 signals, the withheld internal documents and the lack of accountability within the Tax Administration. The State Secretary answers that the internal review found a tunnel focus on fraud, rigid rules and poor care, commits to an external culture study and advisory committee advice, but declines to release several internal documents and says no individual officials have been disciplined.
It is established cabinet policy not to make documents drafted for internal deliberation a subject of political debate.
Het is staand beleid van het kabinet om documenten die zijn opgesteld ten behoeve van intern beraad geen onderwerp van politiek debat te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de oproep van burgemeesters meer te investeren in de handhavingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst voor de aanpak van georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether the government would respond to mayors' calls for more Tax Authority capacity to fight organised crime, and what it would concretely do to prevent a capacity shortfall. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Tax Authority commits a substantial share of capacity to the integrated approach, that the requested extra funding for its enforcement bid was not granted, but that €1 million (2019) and €0.85 million (2020 onward) go to analysis capacity and a further increase of about €29 million structurally was decided.
The Tax Authority cannot currently always make the requested contribution.
De Belastingdienst kan op dit moment niet altijd de gevraagde bijdrage leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins en Lodders over de doorrekeningen van de subsidie op elektrische auto’s

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins and Lodders asked why PBL's expert reviewers of the Klimaatakkoord analysis could not see the mobility and electricity background documents, why the Revnext calculations were not shared sooner, and how national costs per tonne of CO2 saved differ from the government-perspective costs used by the Algemene Rekenkamer. The state secretary answered that PBL published all background documents after the reviews, that the government will send Revnext calculations and later its own positioning analyses once the Klimaatakkoord is final, and that national costs for electric driving are roughly zero by 2030 while transfers like subsidies are excluded.
It is desirable that background documents become available as soon as possible.
Het is wenselijk dat achtergronddocumenten zo snel mogelijk beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Oude vervuilende zakelijke auto veel goedkoper dan schone Tesla'

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the youngtimer scheme, which applies a lower company-car benefit to cars older than fifteen years, and whether it encourages older, more polluting cars. The State Secretary answers that the rule is a forfaitaire differentiation rather than a tax advantage, gives usage figures and emissions comparisons, and says the review of the scheme will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
I aim to send the outcomes of the study into the possibility of adjusting the youngtimer scheme to your House before the summer recess.
Ik streef er naar de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om de youngtimerregeling aan te passen voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over berichtgeving dat de Belastingtelefoon vanaf 27 mei tot sowieso 3 juni (en misschien wel langer) slecht tot niet bereikbaar was

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone was poorly or not reachable from 27 May into June 2019, including questions on waiting times, dropped calls, outage notices, complaints and a changed business portal. The State Secretary answered that the low-availability days were post-holiday peaks rather than outages, explained the closed-message and call-dropping practices, and provided monthly tables on availability, waiting times, satisfaction and complaints, while stating that outage reporting is targeted at affected users.
Friday 31 May, the day after Ascension, was not a working day for nearly the entire Tax Authority and therefore also not for the Tax Phone.
Vrijdag 31 mei, de dag na Hemelvaart, was geen werkdag voor nagenoeg de hele Belastingdienst en daarmee ook niet voor de Belastingtelefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de gevolgen van de arresten van het Europese Hof over doorstroom-bv’s van februari 2019

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of February 2019 European Court rulings on conduit companies (doorstroom-bv's), including whether the tax service will tackle abuse, re-examine rulings, and how large the affected dividend, interest and royalty flows are. The State Secretary answered that existing anti-abuse rules are largely compatible with the rulings, that a bill with a conditional withholding tax and changes to the dividend and corporate tax anti-abuse rules will follow on Budget Day, that existing rulings remain binding until the tax service notifies their lapse, and that risk-based reviews and a report on flows will follow.
I intend to inform your House further on this before the parliamentary treatment of the Tax Plan 2020.
Ik ben van plan uw Kamer hierover vóór de parlementaire behandeling van het Belastingplan 2020 nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de arresten van het Hof van Justitie

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance how the 26 February 2019 CJEU Danish judgments on abuse of EU tax directives affect Dutch conduit companies, dividend withholding exemptions, substance requirements, tax rulings and state aid. The State Secretary answers all 25 questions at length, largely affirming the CJEU's abuse criteria, accepting that substance rules may need revision, committing to review rulings and to a future withholding tax on interest and royalties, while declining to confirm several positions and deferring some matters to national courts.
The cabinet is studying these judgments thoroughly, but already establishes that the national power to combat abuse is certainly not unlimited.
Het kabinet bestudeert deze arresten grondig, maar stelt in ieder geval nu al vast dat de nationale bevoegdheid om misbruik te bestrijden zeker niet onbegrensd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ontbrekende oplossing voor belastingvrijstelling asbestdaken bij tussenopslag

MP Stoffer asked whether the Finance Ministry refuses to guarantee that a wrongly exempted asbestos-roof waste load would be back-taxed to the party issuing the false declaration rather than the landfill operator, and whether this blocks the exemption and an affordable 2025 asbestos-roof ban. Staatssecretaris Snel answered that the statutory safeguards are sufficient, that liability depends on circumstances and that he is willing to consult the sector organisations about concerns raised.
Within this framework I am of course willing to enter into consultation with the relevant trade organisations about concerns they have raised regarding the application of the exemption.
Binnen dit kader ben ik uiteraard bereid om in overleg te treden met de betrokken brancheorganisaties over zorgen die zij hebben geuit over de toepassing van de vrijstelling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Snels over ouders die met de staatssecretaris in gesprek gaan over de problemen in het kader van CAF-11 (Combiteam Aanpak Facilitators 11), waarover de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Snels asked the State Secretary of Finance, in written questions, about the childcare benefit (CAF-11) problems, the individual talks with affected parents, whether parents can bring an advisor, whether talk reports will be shared, and safeguards such as full file access, representation and time to consider offers. The State Secretary answered that parents may bring someone, that talk notes will not be shared given their personal nature but a summary will be provided, and that parents get file access and may be represented, while the advisory commission was asked to advise on time to consider offers and confidentiality clauses.
Given the personal nature of the conversations, I do not consider it appropriate to share the verbatim notes with your House.
Gezien het persoonlijke karakter van de gesprekken vind ik het niet gepast om de woordelijke notities met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een ouder die tot de Raad van State moest doorprocederen om de kinderopvangtoeslag van 2013 en 2014 te krijgen, en nog lopende zaken van ouders

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a parent who had to litigate up to the Council of State to obtain childcare allowance for 2013 and 2014 in the CAF 11 case, and about other pending parental cases, including why the tax authority did not re-check bank statements and whether the Ombudsman's recommendations were implemented. The State Secretary answered that the tax authority followed the then-current case law, detailed the Ombudsman's four recommendations and their implementation, gave litigation counts and costs, and said further action is set out in a separate letter and a meeting with parents has taken place.
I am very well aware of what the Ombudsman means in his report.
Ik ben mij heel bewust wat de Ombudsman bedoelt in zijn rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over artikel 13a in het ‘Besluit ter voorkoming van dubbele belasting’ (2001) en andere belastingverdragen

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about article 13a of the 2001 double taxation decree, whether it still fits modern international traffic, and whether international truck drivers should be covered, plus the position of Dutch workers facing double taxation. The State Secretary answered that the article follows OECD practice limited to sea and air crew, that truck drivers fall under general allocation rules, that no change is planned, but that the mandate holders will seek a prompt consultation with Norway on long-delayed cases.
I therefore undertake that the mandated handlers of these files will work to hold consultations with their Norwegian colleagues in the short term.
Ik zeg daarom toe dat de gemandateerde behandelaars van deze dossiers zich zullen inzetten om op korte termijn met hun Noorse collega’s een overleg te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Koerhuis en Lodders over het  bericht ‘Leidse  steuntrekker mag  kamer verhuren aan student om bij te verdienen’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Leiden plan to let welfare recipients sublet rooms and keep part of the income was lawful, and what the government would do. The government answered that the plan contravened the Participatiewet, that it was a serious shortcoming in lawful implementation, and that Leiden withdrew the pilot after contact with the ministry, so no formal sanction was needed.

Given its scale (both the target group and the monthly amount to be exempted) and its possible spillover effect, implementing the plan would in my view lead to a serious shortcoming in the lawful implementation of the law.

Gelet op de omvang daarvan (zowel qua doelgroep als het vrij te laten maandbedrag) en het mogelijke uitstralingseffect, zou de uitvoering van het plan naar mijn mening leiden tot een ernstige tekortkoming in de rechtmatige uitvoering van de wet

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Lodders over volkscultuur die door de Belastingdienst ongelijk wordt behandeld, als niet cultuur wordt erkend en zodoende geen gebruik kan maken van het gunstige lage btw-tarief

Two VVD MPs asked whether folk culture (parades, carnival associations, shooting guilds) is treated unequally by the Tax Authority, which allegedly does not recognise it as culture and so excludes it from the reduced 9% VAT rate. The State Secretary answers that the VAT rate depends on a closed list in Tabel I of the Wet OB, not on recognition of culture, so there is no unequal treatment and folk culture can qualify where it meets the listed activities.
As the enumeration of these items shows, there is no distinction by type of culture in applying the reduced rate.
Zoals uit de opsomming van deze posten blijkt, bestaat er bij de toepassing van het verlaagde tarief geen onderscheid in het soort cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Kwart miljoen boetes voor 1 km/u te hard: 'Dit riekt naar spekken staatskas'

VVD MPs asked the government whether fining drivers for speeding just 1 km/h over is justified, given that administration costs (9 euro) nearly equal the fine, and raised questions about the 130 km/h lower tolerance, foreign offenders and camera-based enforcement. The Justice Minister defended enforcement of small speeding offences for road safety, explained the cost breakdown and the abolition of the lower tolerance on 130 km/h roads, and reported on cross-border enforcement and the start of camera use by the tax authority.
Traffic enforcement exists to promote compliance with traffic rules and thereby safeguard road safety.
Verkeershandhaving is er om de naleving van de verkeersregels te bevorderen en daarmee de verkeersveiligheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Verplicht sparen voor onderhoud appartement’

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether VvE mandatory maintenance savings held in reserve funds should be taxed in box 3 and whether this creates unequal treatment and double taxation. The minister answered that the reserve is a taxable property right under Supreme Court case law, that there is no unequal treatment, and that no additional exemption or new measures are planned beyond reviewing the eigenwoningrente ruling.
The cabinet sees no injustice in this.
Het kabinet ziet hier geen onrechtvaardigheid in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat de bezwaarschriften box 3 inkomstenbelasting 2018 wordt aangewezen als massaal bezwaar

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the mass objection procedure for box 3 wealth tax 2018, including objection numbers since 2013, the rule requiring individual timely objections, and whether taxpayers can still raise individual circumstances after the collective legal question is decided. The State Secretary gave numbered answers: most objections were admissible, the timeliness requirement aims at equal treatment, communication efforts were made, and individual circumstances can generally not be deferred under the Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht.

Do you consider the change to the mass objection procedures, whereby taxpayers must now object individually and on time to their income tax assessment, a restriction of the rights of individual taxpayers?

Vindt u de wetswijziging in de massale bezwaarprocedures, waardoor belastingplichtigen nu wel individueel en tijdig bezwaar moeten maken tegen hun aanslag inkomstenbelasting, een inperking van de rechten van individuele belastingplichtigen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het Scandinavische duale stelsel voor het belasten van directeur-grootaandeelhouders (dga’s)

Labour MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Scandinavian dual income tax model for owner-managers (DGA), including whether a fixed return on capital would be simpler and fairer and whether the model could be studied for the Netherlands. The State Secretary explained how dual taxation works, noted that the DGA has incentives to set the salary low and to defer tax, and committed to studying the Scandinavian approach in the tax-reform building-blocks trajectory due early 2020.
The research should ultimately lead to policy options within the current system, but reforms that go beyond the current box structure will also be examined.
Het onderzoek moet uiteindelijke leiden tot beleidsopties binnen het huidige stelsel, maar er zal ook gekeken worden naar hervormingen die de huidige boxenstructuur overstijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de kosten van stimulering van fossiele brandstoffen

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the cost of fossil fuel subsidies, aviation fuel and car tax exemptions, carbon pricing and related environmental damage (34 questions). The government answered that it favours pricing polluting activities, acknowledged existing exemptions bound by international treaties, and promised a study into definitions of environmentally harmful subsidies, but did not provide several requested figures.
To nevertheless implement the motion as well as possible, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate will commission a study into the various definitions of environmentally harmful subsidies.

Om toch zo goed mogelijk uitvoering te geven aan de motie zal de Minister van Economische zaken en klimaat een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de uiteenlopende definities van milieuschadelijke subsidies
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst eist tienduizenden euro’s van matrozen’

The MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Tax Authority checks whether foreign-employer Rhine boatmen work mainly in the Netherlands, whether Dutch-resident crew were informed of the 2010 rule change, and why they must now pay social premiums twice. The government answers that Dutch social insurance applied to these boatmen since 2010, that individual letters were sent on request, that it regrets the hardship, and that it will raise the matter with Luxembourg and the SVB's regularisation procedure may offer relief in exceptional cases.
It is regrettable that the employers of Rhine boatmen nevertheless continued withholding premiums in Luxembourg.
Het is te betreuren dat de werkgevers van rijnvarenden desondanks inhouding van premies in Luxemburg hebben voortgezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over rijnvarenden, die grote persoonlijke naheffingen ontvingen van de Nederlandse belastingdienst voor sociale premies, die zij ook al in Luxemburg betaald hebben

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked why Rhine boatmen face large Dutch social premium back-assessments already paid in Luxembourg, and what steps the authorities took to recover the debt from former employers and ensure only one country collects premiums. The government answered that the tax authority cannot pursue employers for individual income-tax debts, that refund claims lie with Luxembourg authorities under its law, that it will raise the issue with Luxembourg, and that payment arrangements are available, but gave no clear timeline for resolving the double premium problem.

Although the Netherlands is not a party to these requests, I will, together with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, actively and promptly raise the signals with the Luxembourg authorities.

Hoewel Nederland geen partij is bij deze verzoeken, zal ik met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, die verantwoordelijk is voor de vaststelling van de verzekeringsplicht, de signalen hierover actief en op korte termijn bij de Luxemburgse autoriteiten onder de aandacht brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van der Linde en Koerhuis over de brief van de Ombudsman aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het opnieuw aandacht vragen voor de korte aanvraagtermi

VVD MPs asked why the Dutch Ombudsman's concerns about low awareness of the 'special situations' rent/benefit scheme and its six-week application deadline were not addressed, and what the government would change. The State Secretary answered that the Belastingdienst had expanded website information and would raise awareness via intermediaries, that the six-week term is set in regulation and sufficient in practice, and that changes await an IBO review due end 2019, while declining a coulance scheme.
From an implementation perspective, the six-week term is sufficient.
Vanuit de uitvoering gezien is de zeswekentermijn voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Omtzigt, Bisschop en Stoffer over extra belastingdruk voor scholen die het lerarentekort proberen op te vangen middels een RTC

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether Dutch VAT rules penalise school boards that match teachers through regional transfer centres (RTCs) and whether the cooperation exemption applies. The government answered that matching is a different service from supplying staff, that the Tax Authority considers RTC matching outside the cooperation exemption, and that it will consult the PO-raad and RTC network on ways to avoid additional VAT burdens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de behandeling van informeel-kapitaal-structuren in het vernieuwde rulingbeleid

An MP asks how the Tax Authority will decide whether tax avoidance is the decisive motive for a structure before issuing an advance ruling, including effects in third countries, double non-taxation, low-tax jurisdictions, and what happens if abuse emerges after a ruling. The State Secretary answers that rulings will be refused where tax saving is the sole or decisive motive, assessed case by case, with examples published in a policy decision effective 1 July 2019, and commits to publishing the policy document and a general meeting answer.
In the renewed ruling practice, no advance certainty will be given if saving Dutch or foreign tax is the sole or decisive motive for the legal act(s) or transactions.
In de vernieuwde rulingpraktijk zal geen zekerheid vooraf worden gegeven indien het besparen van Nederlandse of buitenlandse belasting de enige dan wel doorslaggevende beweegreden is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over kindgebonden budget voor co-ouders

An MP asks the government about co-parents' access to the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget), following an Ombudsman report that the scheme does not adequately reach co-parents and that payments cannot be split like child benefit. The minister acknowledges the problems, promises a broader exploration of post-divorce allocation and information improvements, but rejects splitting the benefit between co-parents.

The cabinet response indicated that this complex implementation situation requires a solution, and that I also want to look more broadly at the design to improve the allocation of the child-related budget after a divorce.

In de kabinetsreactie is aangegeven dat deze complexe uitvoeringssituatie om een oplossing vraagt, waarbij ik ook breder naar de vormgeving wil kijken om de toekenning van het kindgebonden budget na een echtscheiding te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Omtzigt over het verkopen van bespaarde CO2-rechten door autofabrikant Tesla aan Fiat-Chrysler

MPs Lodders, Ziengs and Omtzigt asked whether the EU-permitted pooling of CO2 emission credits between Tesla and Fiat-Chrysler, which may help Fiat-Chrysler avoid EU fines, is acceptable and whether it will persist under the 95 g/km rules, and how much the national EV stimulus would actually reduce EU-wide emissions given possible waterbed effects. The State Secretary answered that pooling has been allowed since 2007, that the pool average must still meet the EU norm, that the government prefers each manufacturer to meet the norm alone, and that the national EV measures yield about 2.4 Mton additional reduction, with the waterbed effect considered small given Netherlands' roughly 3% share of the EU fleet.
The cabinet is not aware of the exact amount involved between certain manufacturers in this arrangement.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van het exacte bedrag dat tussen bepaalde fabrikanten hiermee is gemoeid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het Revnext-model voor de stimulering van elektrische auto's, de merkwaardige aanbesteding, de uitkomsten van dit model en het feit dat TNO de staatssecretaris weer

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked about the Revnext CARbonTAX model used to project electric car uptake, its scientific validation, the non-competitive award of contracts, and TNO's disagreement with the government. The state secretary answered that the PBL tested the model as suitable, that Revnext holds unclear intellectual property rights, that the 2018 contract was awarded via a single-tender procedure because no other model was available, and that the government will consider options for greater transparency.
The cabinet is currently discussing all options to realise this as soon as possible.
Het kabinet bespreekt op dit moment concreet alle opties dit zo spoedig mogelijk te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Snels over de totstandkoming van de bizar lage raming van de kosten voor verlaagde bijtelling in het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord

MPs Omtzigt and Snels asked whether the Finance Ministry checked the low cost estimate for the reduced company car tax addition (bijtelling) for electric cars in the draft Climate Agreement, and how a realistic estimate could be made. The state secretary answered that the figures come from the CARbonTAX model and are plausible, that behavioural effects explain the low 2030 cost, and that annual monitoring and a 2023 evaluation of car taxation are planned.

The cabinet considers it essential to monitor annually so that timely adjustments can be made if signals of overstimulation, unbalanced distribution of burdens, or too limited room for manoeuvre for the Dutch motorist appear.

Het kabinet acht het van essentieel belang om jaarlijks te monitoren zodat tijdig kan worden bijgestuurd bij signalen van overstimulering, onevenwichtige lastenverdeling en een te beperkt handelingsperspectief voor de Nederlandse automobilist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Vaststelling WOZ door gemeenten rammelt’

MPs Lodders and Van den Bosch asked about a report that 17 municipalities scored insufficiently on WOZ property valuation, and about oversight, sanctions, and the Waarderingskamer's role. The State Secretary replied that low-scoring municipalities are placed under intensified supervision with agreed improvement deadlines, that the Waarderingskamer approved publication of WOZ values for all municipalities, and that the government sees the supervisory framework as adequate.
Municipalities that score insufficiently are placed under intensified supervision and must achieve agreed improvements within a set period.
Gemeenten die een onvoldoende scoren worden onder verscherpt toezicht geplaatst en dienen binnen een bepaalde termijn afgesproken verbeteringen te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Aruba op zwarte lijst EU belastingontwijking’

MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether Aruba was placed on the EU blacklist of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions, why it was moved from the grey list, what measures Aruba must take, and whether the Netherlands supported Aruba. The State Secretary confirmed the listing, said Aruba committed to repeal its transparency regime and is expected to be delisted at the 16 May Ecofin, and stated no figures are available on Dutch persons using Aruban tax arrangements and that Aruba bears responsibility for its own tax rules.
No figures are known about this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de zwarte en grijze lijst van belastingparadijzen

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the EU blacklist and greylist of tax havens, including the Oxfam Novib report, which countries were proposed for listing, Switzerland and EU member states' compliance, and whether the government would vote for the proposal. The State Secretary answered that the Council conclusions of 12 March 2019 contain the lists, that ten countries were added to the blacklist, that the government supports the conclusions as a significant step, and that monitoring will continue.
That is why I consider it important to find a balance between informing properly on the one hand, and doing justice to the nature and possible sensitivity of the decision-making on the other.
Daarom acht ik het van belang om een balans te vinden tussen het goed informeren enerzijds, en recht te doen aan de aard en mogelijke gevoeligheid van de besluitvorming anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Snels over het recente onderzoek ‘Taxing Aviation Fuels in the EU’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about a CE Delft study on taxing aviation fuel in the EU, including legal obstacles, revenue estimates, CO2 effects and synthetic kerosene. The State Secretary answered that Chicago Convention and EU energy tax rules constrain a kerosene tax, estimated revenue of roughly 500-750 million euro, and said effects on demand depend on many factors requiring further study.
At the international conference on CO2 pricing and flight taxes that I am organising on 20 and 21 June, a kerosene tax will also be discussed.
Tijdens de internationale conferentie over CO 2 -beprijzing en vliegbelastingen die ik organiseer op 20 en 21 juni a.s. zal ook over een kerosinebelasting worden gesproken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het CAF-11 project en andere CAF-projecten waarbij ouders jarenlang geen kinderopvangtoeslag kregen toegewezen omdat ze door de belastingdienst aan het lijntje gehouden werden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst's CAF-11 and other CAF projects, in which parents lost childcare allowance for years, and asked for an overview of cases, evaluations and legal costs. The State Secretary accepted the Ombudsman's criticism of CAF-11, announced improvement measures, but refused to disclose an overview of other CAF cases and the legal costs of ongoing proceedings, citing investigative confidentiality and procedural strategy.
I do not wish to comply with your House's request to also provide supervision-confidential information in other CAF cases.
Ik wil niet aan het verzoek van uw Kamer tegemoetkomen om ook toezichtsvertrouwelijke informatie in andere CAF-zaken te verstrekken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de belastingsubsidies op elektrische auto’s, de modellen die aangepast lijken te zijn (en geen rekening meer houden met de CO2-uitstoot die gepaard gaat met he

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked about tax subsidies for electric cars, the CARbonTAX model used for forecasts, its validation and emissions accounting, and cost-effectiveness compared with other CO2 measures and foreign countries. The State Secretary answered at length, defending the model and tank-to-wheel accounting while conceding that fiscal stimulation of electric cars is relatively costly per tonne of CO2 avoided, and offered a technical briefing on the model without providing validation evidence.
The model is the intellectual property of research bureau Revnext. The model is not 'secret' but it is not up to the central government to make this model public.
Het model is intellectueel eigendom van onderzoeksbureau Revnext. Het model is niet «geheim» maar het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om dit model openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het bericht ‘Reactie PBL op gebruik NEV-cijfers en modellen’

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether ministries and the PBL can inspect and run the private Carbontax model, whether it has been externally validated, and what the government has spent on it. The government answered that ministries and PBL have only general knowledge of the model, that it is owned by Revnext and cannot be made public, that it is the only suitable model for the analysis, and it offered a technical briefing while listing the commissioned studies and costs.
The CARbontax model is not owned by the state but is intellectual property of Revnext, therefore it is not for the state to make it public.
Het CARbontax-model is geen eigendom van het Rijk maar is intellectueel eigendom van Revnext, daarom is het niet aan het Rijk om het openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de kinderopvangtoeslag, die bij veel gezinnen is stopgezet, het CAF 11-project en de brieven van de Kinderombudsman

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about childcare benefit cutoffs, the CAF 11 project, and letters from the Children's Ombudsman, covering 14 questions on compliance, timelines, affected parents and conduct. The State Secretary answers substantively on several points, admits delays and deficient information to parents, but withholds case costs, the full number of affected parents and an overview of other CAF cases, citing confidentiality and lack of data.
It is established policy that the costs of ongoing procedures are not made public.
Het is staand beleid dat de kosten van lopende procedures niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over uitstaande belastingschuld

Two MPs (Omtzigt, Lodders) asked how much tax debt in arrears the Belastingdienst held from 2016 onward, split by collection segment, and asked for answers before a debate. The State Secretary provided the arrears figures, explained that growth partly reflects dynamic monitoring of hard-to-collect claims and a lower write-off rate, and noted that the figures differ from earlier reports due to a new information system.
I have answered these questions as far as possible in my letter of 20 February.
Ik heb deze vragen voor zover mogelijk beantwoord in mijn brief van 20 februari jongstleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Weyenberg en Slootweg over de uitwerking FATCA voor Nederlandse burgers en signalen dat bankrekeningen geblokkeerd gaan worden

MPs from VVD, D66 and CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about FATCA's effects on Dutch citizens with US ties, including banks threatening to block accounts without a US TIN/SSN. The State Secretary answered that banks may refuse or end services but must still offer basic payment accounts, that the number of affected people cannot be confirmed, and that the government is engaging US authorities on the SSN procedure and extending the transitional arrangement.
I assume the "white list" refers to banks that qualify as Participating FIs under FATCA.
Ik ga ervan uit dat met de «witte lijst» de banken worden bedoeld die kwalificeren als deelnemende bank (Participating FI) op grond van FATCA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over het bericht ‘Klokkenluiders kunnen bij misstanden aanbestedingen nergens terecht’

Two VVD MPs asked whether whistleblowers can report misconduct in public procurement, since the competition authority ACM can only act against firms under the cartel ban and not against government bodies or state companies. The state secretary answered that ACM can act against state companies acting as undertakings, that internal checks, the Huis voor Klokkenluiders and the FIOD/OM are the available routes, that no change to the rules is needed, and that research on legal protection in procurement is ongoing with results to parliament before summer.
I am of the view that it is not necessary to expand the current possibilities.
Ik ben van mening dat het niet nodig is om de huidige mogelijkheden uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het herstarten van het recht op toeslagen door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen

An SP MP asked whether the Belastingdienst's errors in restarting the kindgebonden budget also affect other allowances, how the omission of the automatic restart was discovered, and how many people lose benefits when income rises. The State Secretary answered that other allowances are not affected because they require an application, that the omission surfaced during policy and implementation analyses, and that roughly 250,000 people lose the healthcare allowance and 100,000 the rent allowance yearly due to income rises.
No, the errors made do not apply to other allowances.
Nee, de gemaakte fouten gelden niet voor andere toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale behandeling van woningen als beleggingsobject

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary of Finance how homes held as investments are taxed in box 3, box 1 and box 2, with worked examples, and whether the treatment should be made less attractive. The State Secretary answered that box 3 uses a forfaitary return on the WOZ value, that the tax cannot be attributed to a single asset, that a study on rental income taxation is underway, and that a higher transfer tax for additional homes is not an efficient option.
The aim is not to make investing in homes less attractive for tax purposes, but to map out options that can contribute to a better tax system.
Het doel daarvan is niet om het beleggen in woningen fiscaal minder aantrekkelijk te maken, maar om varianten in beeld te brengen die kunnen bijdragen aan een beter belastingstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over de advertentie in Arts en Auto: ‘Schenking eigen woning’

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper advertisement promoting 'cross gifts' that let parents give a second tax-free gift to their children via reciprocal arrangements, and whether this is legitimate and how it is enforced. The State Secretary answered that such cross gifts are unwanted and contrary to the letter and spirit of the Successiewet, that the Tax Authority will treat them as gifts from the parent and enforce against misuse, and that no amendment is planned.

I consider the use of cross gifts to obtain the increased gift tax exemption for the owner-occupied home a second time undesirable, and applying the exemption in such a case contrary to the letter and spirit of the Successiewet 1956.

Ik acht het gebruik van kruislingse schenkingen ten einde de verhoogde vrijstelling schenkbelasting voor de eigen woning voor een tweede maal te verkrijgen ongewenst en de toepassing van de vrijstelling in een dergelijk geval in strijd met de letter en geest van de Successiewet 1956.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over de teveel betaalde belasting over de SBF-verlofuitkering door oud-gevangenispersoneel

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked about excess payroll tax and health insurance premiums withheld from former prison staff receiving SBF leave benefits, and why refunds were limited to 104 weeks and to post-2013 cases. The state secretary answered that the 2013 statutory change has no retroactive effect, refunds were paid in December 2018 for the 104-week period, and the Tax Administration cannot deviate from this.
The statutory amendment has no retroactive effect for the first cohorts.
De wetswijziging kent geen terugwerkende kracht voor de eerste lichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over vorderingen van de Belastingdienst inzake schadevergoedingen gaswinningsschade

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked whether the Tax Authority taxes part of earthquake damage compensation paid to entrepreneurs and households, and whether this is fair. The minister answered that compensation for lost business income is taxed as business profit while costs of repair can be deducted, that damage compensation for private persons is generally not taxed except via box 3 wealth, and that no separate fiscal policy is planned.
I cannot respond substantively to a situation that is not described in more detail.
Ik kan niet inhoudelijk reageren op een niet nader beschreven situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de extra tonnen voor de vertrekregeling van de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance when he learned of extra costs for the Tax Authority's departure scheme, why Parliament was not informed of pending court appeals, which claims remain open, and how the costs are covered. The State Secretary answered that court rulings in late 2018 and early 2019 were known, that the financial stake is about one million euros across roughly ten ongoing cases, that Parliament was not informed given the limited stake, and that costs are absorbed within the Tax Authority's budget.
Given the relatively limited financial stake of the procedures for the employer compared with the total financial size of the departure scheme, there was no reason for me to inform your House.

Gezien het voor de werkgever relatief beperkte financiële belang van de procedures afgezet tegen de gehele financiële omvang van de vertrekregeling, was er voor mij geen aanleiding om uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over Nederland als fiscaal doorsluisland en het nieuwe rulingbeleid

MP Snels asks whether the Netherlands functions as a conduit state for profit flows to tax havens, how a conditional withholding tax and economic nexus test would work, and whether rulings should be published in full. The State Secretary answers that conditional withholding tax and nexus requirements are being introduced, that publishing summaries of rulings is preferred over full anonymised publication, and that enforcement and EU-level measures are being pursued.
I am therefore also working on many legislative amendments to tackle tax avoidance.
Ik ben daarom tevens bezig met vele wetswijzigingen om belastingontwijking aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het effectieve belastingtarief op multinationals

MP Leijten asks the State Secretary of Finance to respond to a report showing Dutch effective corporate tax rates for multinationals are among the EU's lowest, and questions the fairness, the revenue loss, the planned cut in the corporate tax rate, and whether the Netherlands is a tax haven. The State Secretary disputes the effective-rate methodology, argues the statutory rate says little about effective rates, says no study of revenue loss is warranted, rejects reconsidering the rate cut, and rejects the tax-haven label while proposing a conditional withholding tax on interest and royalties.
No, I do not acknowledge that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de overschrijdingen van begroting voor de kosten van elektrische voertuigen

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether the 141 million euro estimate for the EV bijtelling discount in Miljoenennota 2019 and the Startnota benchmark rule were breached, and what the substantial endogenous development rule implies. The Staatssecretaris acknowledges EV sales exceeded expectations, puts the 2018 cost near 200 million (about 40% above the estimate), states the 2017 benchmark is 86 million, says no specific trigger moment is fixed, and commits only to monitoring and a new estimate in Miljoenennota 2020.
For now the cabinet sees no need to adjust further in the short term, but considers it important to keep a close watch to detect signals of overstimulation in time.
Het kabinet ziet vooralsnog geen noodzaak om op korte termijn verder bij te sturen, maar acht het wel van belang om een vinger aan de pols te houden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over privacyregels die gelden voor de Belastingdienst

Nijboer (PvdA) asked how far the Belastingdienst may use third-party sources, including doctors, to verify tax deductions and whether medical confidentiality and privacy are protected. The State Secretary answered that inspectors may request information from taxpayers and administrative obligors such as doctors, that doctors may invoke their duty of confidentiality, and declined to promise that inspectors would never approach doctors independently or that doctors need never inform patients on such requests.
Nee, dit kan ik niet toezeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Douane laat controles risicovluchten schieten door hoge werkdruk'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that customs at Schiphol skip checks on risk flights due to high workload, and about staffing shortages, a union workload survey, ICT problems, sick leave and Brexit recruitment. The State Secretary largely confirmed high workload and understaffing at Schiphol, explained that risk-based choices sometimes mean planned checks are skipped, stated that the 100% control regime on flights from designated origins continues in 2019, and gave staffing, recruitment and sick-leave figures.
It has been agreed with JenV that the 100% control regime for drug enforcement on the flights designated by JenV will also be carried out in 2019.
Met JenV is afgesproken dat het 100%-controleregime in het kader van de drugsbestrijding op de door JenV aangewezen vluchten, ook in 2019 uitgevoerd zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Lodders over de stijging van de woonlasten

Two VVD MPs asked whether rising local housing costs (lokale lasten) in many municipalities, including large increases in Amsterdam, are acceptable and whether the government will act or discuss this with municipalities. The Minister answered that municipalities set local taxes democratically, that a national macronorm only limits total ozb revenues, that the Wet HOF does not restrict local tax increases, and that no further measures or talks with municipalities are planned.
For a picture of the other municipalities, one will have to wait for the 2019 edition of the COELO atlas of local taxes to appear.
Voor een beeld van de andere gemeenten zal gewacht moeten worden op het verschijnen van de 2019 editie van de COELO atlas van de lokale lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Van den Bosch en Lodders over het bericht 'Bestuurslid luidt noodklok: 'Waterschap Rivierenland heeft straks een half miljard schuld'

MPs of the VVD asked the government about a report that water board Rivierenland faces a debt of half a billion euros, asking how financial positions of water boards are monitored, whether rising dike-reinforcement costs and interest rates threaten investment plans, and whether water boards keep to their core tasks. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answered that each water board is responsible for its own finances under oversight by its general board and the provinces (including the Wet FIDO interest-risk norm), that the cost trends are not yet a established trend and are being monitored, that dike safety planning is not in jeopardy, and that water boards' core tasks are legally limited with provinces supervising them.
Each water board is itself responsible for its own financial position.
Ieder waterschap is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de eigen financiële positie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Topambtenaar kreeg ruim 40.000 euro voor achttien dagen Curaçao’

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary and Minister of Internal Affairs about a press report that a senior civil servant received over 40,000 euro in allowances for eighteen days on Curaçao, asking about the contracts, legality, tax treatment, and whether the Auditdienst Rijk should investigate. The government answered that all questions were addressed in a separate letter (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII and 35 000 IV, nr. 89), so this document itself gives no substantive answers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het rendement in box 3

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's position in Box 3 litigation that AEX main shares and real estate are stable low-risk investments, the AFM's risk classification, a return-based Box 3 system, and EU comparisons of savings taxation. The State Secretary defended the Tax Authority's argument as conditional, said no AFM fund fits the low-risk description, admitted the promised spring 2018 letter on actual-return taxation is delayed, and provided OECD-based comparative tables, answering each question separately but late.
A system of wealth return tax based on actual return has far-reaching consequences for, among other things, citizens' administrative burden, the risk of tax avoidance and feasibility.

Een stelsel van vermogensrendementsheffing op basis van werkelijk rendement heeft verregaande consequenties voor onder andere de administratieve lasten van burgers, risico's op belastingontwijking en de uitvoerbaarheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het model CARbonTAX dat gebruikt is om de verkopen van elektrische auto’s te voorspellen en welke er in 2018 meer dan 100% naast zat bij de schatting van de verkoop

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the CARbonTAX model underpredicted electric car sales in 2018 by more than 100%, and whether the model is validated and still used. The State Secretary answered that the model was built for Autobrief II, that EV sales were underestimated due to market dynamics and the early scrapping of the PHEV bijtelling discount, that the model is not public, and that its parameters were recently revalidated by PBL and TNO.
Because the Carbontax model is not public, it is not possible to send the model to your House.
Omdat het Carbontax-model niet openbaar is, is het niet mogelijk om het model aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Weyenberg over toepassing van het verlaagde btw-tarief op e-publicaties

MPs Sneller and Van Weyenberg asked whether the government will lower VAT on e-publications following the October 2018 EU political agreement, and what preparations, timeline and consultation with the sector are planned. The state secretary confirmed the agreement and earlier commitments, said preparations are underway including a draft bill for internet consultation in the first half of 2019, and targeted entry into force on 1 January 2020.
Furthermore, I intend to consult broadly on a draft bill in the first half of 2019 via an internet consultation, so that all stakeholders have the opportunity to respond.

Verder ben ik voornemens om een conceptwetsvoorstel in de eerste helft van 2019 breed te consulteren via een internetconsultatie, zodat alle belanghebbenden in de gelegenheid worden gesteld te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Gaat de Belastingdienst te ver in data-speurtocht?'

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Authority goes too far in data-gathering, including data security, privacy limits, use of Museumkaart user data, and the cost-effectiveness of the extra funding against hidden wealth. The State Secretary answers all eight questions, stating that no system can guarantee full data security, that privacy intrusions are allowed by law and assessed case by case, and that results from the hidden-wealth programme cannot be fully quantified.

When choosing to request information from new information sources, the Tax Authority weighs the interests of the Tax Authority or inspector against those of the taxpayer, applying privacy-law criteria such as purpose limitation, necessity, proportionality and subsidiarity.

De Belastingdienst hanteert bij het maken van de keuze tot het opvragen van informatie bij nieuwe informatiebronnen, een afweging tussen de belangen van de Belastingdienst c.q. de inspecteur en de belangen van de belastingplichtige, de criteria die volgen uit het privacyrecht, zoals doelbinding, noodzaak en de beginselen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Omtzigt over de vertraging van de invoering van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet

MPs Peters and Omtzigt (CDA) asked why implementation of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet was delayed by at least two years, why the Belastingdienst and UWV implementation assessments were not published earlier, and what interim measures will protect debtors. The state secretaries explain that the delay stems from ICT and process redesign, that the revised assessments will be published before the 14 February 2019 debate, and that interim measures are being sought, but give no firm dates or concrete commitments yet.
We aim to publish the Besluit beslagvrije voet before the committee debate on poverty and debt policy scheduled for 14 February 2019, so that you can review the implementation assessments.
Wij streven ernaar het Besluit beslagvrije voet vóór het voor 14 februari 2019 geplande AO Armoede- en schuldenbeleid te publiceren, zodat u van de uitvoeringstoetsen kennis kunt nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over stimuleringsmaatregelen voor zonnecel-dakpannen

MPs Moorlag and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked which subsidies, tax reductions and other incentives exist for solar-roof tiles beyond VAT recovery, and whether such incentives apply to them. The minister replied that the SDE+, net metering and innovation schemes apply, and that he knows of no obstacles to incentivising solar tiles.
As far as I am aware, there are no obstacles to incentivising solar energy from roof tiles under the various incentive measures.
Voor zover ik weet zijn er geen belemmeringen voor de stimulering van zonne-energie uit dakpannen in de verschillende stimuleringsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kosten van stimulering van elektrische auto’s en de totaal onderschatte vooruitgang in batterij technologie

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder ask whether EV tax subsidies (company car supplement, BPM, MRB, MIA) are cost-effective, how much they cost over five years, and how battery price assumptions in the CarbonTax model compare with forecasts. The government answers in detail, defending EV incentives as necessary for the transition, admitting past forecasting errors, and giving battery price figures while promising monitoring and an evaluation in 2023.
The cabinet is currently awaiting the costing of these proposals.
Het kabinet is op dit moment in afwachting van de doorrekening van deze voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de aangifte omzetbelasting (btw)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT return deadlines, payment and refund timelines, penalties for late payment by taxpayers and by the tax authority, correction returns, audit timelines, and interest on late refunds. The State Secretary answered in detail on statutory deadlines (typically eight weeks for refund decisions), penalties, and interest rules, but declined to provide statistics on late refunds or complaints and did not address the specific case substantively.
Figures on how often the Tax Authority repays late are not available.
Cijfers over hoe vaak de Belastingdienst te laat terugbetaalt zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Nederlandse lijst van laagbelastende landen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Dutch list of low-tax jurisdictions: the corporate tax rates of the 21 listed countries, the money flows to them, rulings, effective tax rates, treaties and CFC/withholding measures. The government answered in detail, largely explaining that country-level data is limited, that the list uses statutory rates, and committing to stop issuing rulings for listed-country entities from 1 July 2019 and to renegotiate treaties.
I do not have an exact breakdown of this flow across the different countries.
Ik beschik niet over een nauwkeurige verdeling van deze stroom over de verschillende landen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst gebruik gaat maken van externe inhuur voor bezwaarbehandeling bij de inkomensheffing

An MP asked whether the Tax Authority's outsourcing of objection handling for income tax to an external agency is lawful, and how independence, confidentiality and tender rules are secured. The State Secretary confirmed the temporary external hiring, said it stays under the inspector's responsibility and supervision, and listed contractual safeguards (no representation of clients against the State, confidentiality declarations, Rijks tender rules).
These staff will operate fully under the responsibility of the inspector and under the supervision of the Tax Authority.
Deze medewerkers zullen volledig onder verantwoordelijkheid van de inspecteur en onder toezicht van de Belastingdienst gaan opereren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over parkeerplaatsen bij het belastingkantoor in Maastricht

CDA MPs Ronnes and Van Helvert asked why the Tax Office in Maastricht does not open its car park to the public outside office hours and whether they would seek a solution with stakeholders. State Secretary Knops answered that security, safety and vandalism concerns, plus a higher FIOD security regime, mean the Tax Office will not admit third parties, while the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and Tax Office will study shared use of space at other sites.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the Tax Office will jointly examine the possibility of multiple use of space and map what is feasible at locations where the Tax Office is the user.

Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en de Belastingdienst zullen samen de mogelijkheid tot meervoudig ruimtegebruik onderzoeken en in beeld brengen wat er mogelijk is bij locaties waar de Belastingdienst de gebruiker is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de merkwaardige bewering van de Belastingdienst bij de Hoge Raad dat hoofdfondsen en onroerende zaken een stabiele beleggingsvorm vormen met weinig risico’s

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the tax authority told the Supreme Court that main-share funds and real estate are stable, low-risk investments, and whether that matches AFM supervision and government policy. The State Secretary answered that the remark was incidental, that the 4% return test does not depend on the risk level of assets, that the AFM does not treat such investments as risk-free, and that a real-return box 3 system is being examined alongside other tax reform work.
It is now up to the Advocate-General to give her opinion in a conclusion on the question put before the Supreme Court.
Het is nu aan de Advocaat-Generaal om in een conclusie haar mening te geven over de kwestie die aan de Hoge Raad is voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over brievenbusfirma’s van internationale wapenbedrijven in Nederland

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked whether nuclear weapons-linked arms firms should be allowed to settle in the Netherlands for tax reasons, obtain tax rulings, and face extra taxation, and whether the government would act on arms sales to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that it opposes tax-motivated settlement, rejects a special tax or exclusion for arms firms, notes no commercial firm produces nuclear weapons, and stresses its strict export controls.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual taxpayers.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Zelfstandigen bouwen wel degelijk pensioen op, maar benutten belastingvoordeel te weinig'

An MP asked whether self-employed workers build pension savings but underuse the tax advantages, and whether they know about the tax-facilitated options.
