The minister answered that self-employed people do build old-age savings but often not in a tax-favoured form, that the tax rules are explained, and that awareness-raising and reforms such as abolishing the doorsneesystematiek are being considered.
I consider it important that all workers in the Netherlands build up an adequate old-age provision.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle werkenden in Nederland een toereikende oudedagsvoorziening opbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de impact van belastingverdragen

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance about an ActionAid report claiming that Dutch tax treaties cause developing countries to lose large amounts of withholding tax on dividends and interest, and proposes fairer treaty negotiation, transparency and a UN model minimum. The government rejects the report's mechanical method and conclusions, says it will keep pushing for fair allocation of taxing rights, and promises to return on treaty assessment tools and explore data on inflows.
Just like the authors of the technical report, I do not have the micro data that would be needed to answer this question.
Net zo min als de opstellers van het technische rapport beschik ik over de micro data die nodig zouden zijn om deze vraag te beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat de belastinginspecteur besloten heeft om de RVU-boete voor de gouden handdrukken van bijna 200 miljoen aan de belastingdienst kwijt te schelden

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary about reports that the Tax Authority was waived an RVU penalty of nearly 200 million euros on golden handshakes, and about how the Supreme Court ruling of June 2018 is applied, the consequences for the state, and rights of other employers. The government answered that the inspector applied the Supreme Court criteria, that about 95 million euros is expected to be refunded in 2019, that old policy decrees will be withdrawn, and that the Ministry of Defence will object to its own RVU levy, though it answered late and did not meet the one-week deadline.
Why did you not clearly inform the House about the major consequences for the RVU scheme paid by the state?
Vraag 6 Waarom heeft u de Kamer niet duidelijk geïnformeerd over de grote gevolgen voor de door de staat betaalde RVU-regeling?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de ontslagen medewerkers van de Belastingdienst vanwege fraude

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the 15 Tax Administration employees dismissed for fraud were discovered, whether prosecution follows, how referrals to prosecutors work, and how recruitment and integrity screening are handled. The answer reports 16 dismissals for 2017-2018, explains that tax inspectors, not the employer, refer possible offences to Justice under the AAFD protocol, that the employer has no registry of such cases, and that 20 investigations were ongoing as of 1 November 2018.

For that reason, the Tax Administration as employer does not know how many cases involving non-compliance with tax obligations by its employees have been discussed with the Public Prosecution Service.

Er is om die reden bij de Belastingdienst als werkgever niet bekend hoeveel zaken met het OM besproken zijn, waarbij sprake is van het niet nakomen van fiscale verplichtingen door de belastingdienstmedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over fraude met de dividendbelasting

An MP asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about alleged large-scale dividend tax fraud (cum-ex/dividend stripping) involving Dutch banks, the Tax Authority's role, and whether banks and the Public Prosecution Service would be held to account. The government replied that it lacks sufficient information on the scale and on the involvement of specific banks, that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating potential fraud, and that the Tax Authority bears the burden of proof and could recover unlawfully refunded tax, while declining to comment on individual cases.
The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about individual investigations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen uitspraken over individuele onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Nieuwe belasting op attracties voor dagjesmensen’

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about Amsterdam's plan for a new levy on attractions aimed at day-trippers, and the limits central government sets on municipal tax autonomy. Minister Ollongren answered that municipalities can set tourist and recreation levies autonomously within legal limits, that the effects on businesses and subsidised institutions are not yet known, and that the Amsterdam alderman will first consult residents.
At this stage there is insufficient knowledge of the measure Amsterdam wishes to introduce to say anything about its potential effects on entrepreneurs or their turnover.
In dit stadium is onvoldoende bekend over de door de gemeente Amsterdam gewenste maatregel om iets te kunnen zeggen over de potentiële effecten ervan op ondernemers of hun omzet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over ING, dat de balans met 180 miljard euro bijstelde, de accountant die niet weet wat onder die post valt, de bank die zo bankenbelasting bespaarde en vervroegd staatss

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about ING's 180 billion euro balance sheet restatement, the auditor's knowledge of its components, leverage ratio compliance, early repayment of state aid and resulting bonuses. The Minister answered that netting of cash pooling is permitted under international standards, that the components are not further known to him beyond public reporting, and that the matters are for the bank, auditor, AFM and DNB rather than the ministry.
It is up to the auditor to check the annual accounts against the standards.
Het is aan de accountant om de jaarrekening te controleren op basis van de standaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Nijboer over de grootste belastingfraude in de Europese geschiedenis

MPs Snels and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about the CumEx dividend tax fraud, including prosecutions, bank involvement, the Belastingdienst's systems and whether Dutch dividend stripping continues. The government answered that it cannot judge the Dutch share or the scale abroad, referred to an ongoing OM investigation, said the Belastingdienst does not systematically track fines, and outlined limits on enforcement due to the heavy burden of proof, with a commitment to inventory dividend stripping practices.
As the cover letter shows, situations of dividend stripping also occur in the Netherlands.
Zoals blijkt uit de aanbiedingsbrief doen zich in Nederland ook situaties van dividendstripping voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Lightyear in Helmond wil lage bijtelling zonne-auto’s'

MPs Sienot and Remco Dijkstra asked whether the government supports solar-powered cars such as Lightyear's, whether a workable legal definition is possible, and whether the zero-emission company-car tax exemption for hydrogen cars could be extended to them. The state secretary answered that the government supports the innovation through several channels, that a definition is feasible but needs further study, and that the tax treatment will be reviewed and reported to parliament by mid-2019.
It is too early to attach concrete criteria to this yet.
Het is te vroeg om hier nu al concrete criteria aan te hangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Wet Bronbelasting 2020

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Dutch conditional withholding tax (Wet Bronbelasting 2020), including its threshold based on statutory rather than effective tax rates, its limitation to related parties, its interaction with EU law and tax treaties, and the substance requirements. The State Secretary defended the design as a robust anti-avoidance measure constrained by EU law and enforceability, and was reluctant to tighten substance requirements further.
I am not in principle opposed to such open norms.
Ik ben niet op voorhand een tegenstander van dergelijke open normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het artikel ‘Shell en Unilever dreigen niet met vertrek, ze waarschuwen alleen maar’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about whether Article 15d of the corporate tax act imposes a final tax settlement on multinationals moving headquarters abroad, and whether it deters such moves, plus historical counts, rulings and valuation methods. The State Secretary confirmed the final settlement applies but said its amount depends on case-specific facts, declined to accept the claim it always amounts to a large sum, and said the Tax Administration does not systematically record headquarters relocations, rulings or the amounts involved.
The Tax Administration does not systematically record headquarters relocations.
De Belastingdienst registreert verplaatsingen van hoofdkantoren niet systematisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het anonimiseren van vermogen via een commanditaire vennootschap (cv)

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority stopped giving advance agreements on commanditaire vennootschap (cv) structures used to anonymise wealth, and related questions on case law, business-activity tests, beheersverbod, stichtingen and whether such structures are still used. The State Secretary answered that the 2015 fourth anti-money-laundering directive led to ending advance certainty, that existing rulings cannot be revised, that the Tax Authority still grants mandatory share-merger rulings which may allow such structures, and that the tax treatment rules are as set out in case law.
The Tax Authority has not kept track of how often advance consultation on this subject took place in the past.
De Belastingdienst heeft niet bijgehouden hoe vaak in het verleden vooroverleg over dit onderwerp heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Beveiliging data fiscus ondermaats’

MPs Lodders and Middendorp asked about press reports that the tax authority cannot technically secure personal data, and about logging, data location, staff training and AVG compliance. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the limitation concerns only logging of data use once extracted to staff workstations in one department, that measures have been taken, and that an Analytical Data Perimeter will be introduced in 2019.
Actions with data in the central data environment of DF&A are logged and monitored.
Handelingen met gegevens in de centrale dataomgeving van DF&A worden wel gelogd en gemonitord.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Nijboer over het contact met en advies van de Europese Commissie aangaande de vraag of woningbouwcorporaties onder de werking van de antibelastingontwijkingsrichtlijn ATAD1 vall

MPs Leijten and Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance for an overview of all contacts with the European Commission on whether housing associations fall under ATAD1, how the government lobbied for an exemption and the budgetary consequences, and for the advice and the government's request to be sent to the House. The State Secretary referred to a letter of 12 November 2018 for the correspondence, stated that an exemption would carry real state-aid risks, and gave a budgetary loss table (EUR 102m in 2019 rising to 193m in 2021, structural 353m).
For answering these questions I refer to my letter of 12 November.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief van 12 november jl.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Tielen en Lodders over het bericht ‘Onterecht geld opstrijken; Ouders kunnen zich inschrijven voor studie en, zonder ooit op te dagen, kinderopvangtoeslag ontvangen. Wat

MPs from the VVD asked whether a student enrolment certificate alone is enough to receive childcare allowance, how many households receive it for study, and how enrolment is checked. The government answered that enrolment is one eligibility condition checked by the Tax Authority against Dutch education-agency data, that a certificate alone is not sufficient, and that the check is effective.
A certificate of enrolment alone is therefore not sufficient.
Een bewijs van inschrijving alleen is dus niet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Lodders over het bericht 'Tientallen gemeenten hebben geen goed beeld van WOZ-waarde huizen'

MPs Van den Bosch and Lodders (VVD) asked about news reports that dozens of municipalities have poor WOZ property valuations, including causes, overvaluation corrections, tax consequences, the meaning of Waarderingskamer star ratings, and whether sanctions will follow. Minister Ollongren answered that 95 municipalities received a negative rating at some point, mostly due to data registration and backlog problems, that the regulator decides on sanctions, and that she sees no reason for extra measures now.
The precise number of cases is not known to me or to the Waarderingskamer.
Het precieze aantal gevallen is mij of de Waarderingskamer niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat farmaceuten belasting ontwijken via Nederland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether pharmaceutical firms such as Abbott, Johnson & Johnson, Merck and Pfizer use the Netherlands to avoid tax and whether the government will investigate this. The State Secretary of Finance answered that he cannot discuss individual companies' tax affairs, pointed to the government's anti-avoidance measures (CFC rule, conditional withholding tax, EU directives) and said no separate investigation into pharmaceutical firms is planned, though the effects of the policy will be monitored.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual companies.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Ploumen over het bericht dat Nederland farmaceuten helpt om belasting te ontwijken

MPs Nijboer and Ploumen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands helps pharmaceutical companies avoid tax, including undisclosed arrangements, transparency, and effects on developing countries. The State Secretary of Finance answered that individual tax affairs cannot be discussed under article 67 AWR, and listed general anti-avoidance measures, the position on country-by-country reporting, and EU work on pharmaceutical patent protection.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual companies.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat farmaceutisch bedrijven voor miljarden aan belasting ontwijken

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked whether the government would tie pharmaceutical companies' tax conduct to drug price negotiations, and about tax competition, the innovation box and a sector code on pricing. The State Secretary replied that the corporate tax cut is largely financed by base broadening, defended the innovation box as meeting OECD standards, and said tax morality plays no role in price negotiations while welcoming the voluntary pharma code.
Under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act I cannot discuss the way individual companies fulfil their tax obligations.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de manier waarop individuele bedrijven hun belastingplicht voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over de wachttijden voor ondernemers om zich in te schrijven in het handelsregister van de Kamer van Koophandel

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretaries about waiting times of about three weeks for entrepreneurs to register at the Chamber of Commerce, including regional differences, the causes and VAT number delays. The government answered with regional waiting times of 4 to 14 days, measures taken to reduce them, and an explanation of VAT number timing, while stating it does not yet meet its 7-day target everywhere.
The KvK does not meet the target of a maximum waiting time of seven calendar days in all regions.
De KvK voldoet niet in alle regio’s aan de doelstelling van een maximale wachttijd van zeven kalenderdagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het feit dat zonnepanelen meegenomen worden in de onroerendezaakbelasting

MPs Lodders and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether solar panels, which owners could remove when moving, count toward the WOZ value and property tax, how many owners pay more, and how this fits the government's sustainability goals. The State Secretary confirmed that panels are generally included as fixed parts of the property, estimated the added tax at roughly 5 to 10 euro per year, and said the tax system will be reviewed through the Climate Agreement and the interbestuurlijk programma before a final position is taken.
There is no overview available of how municipalities handle the valuation of solar panels and whether or not they use the exception provision in the Municipalities Act.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van hoe gemeenten omgaan met de waardering van zonnepanelen en of zij al dan niet gebruik maken van de uitzonderingsbepaling in de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kosten van het rijden van een auto, lease of in eigendom, elektrisch of benzine

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder asked the State Secretary of Finance for catalogue values and net monthly lease costs for several cars under 2018 and 2019 company-car tax rules, plus the cost of running a five-year-old Tesla or Mitsubishi Outlander. The State Secretary answered with tables of catalogue prices, monthly additions to income and the tax due, using substitute models where the Tesla Model 70 was unavailable.
The table below sets out, for the requested car types for 2018, the catalogue price, the monthly addition to income and the tax due on it.
In de hierna opgenomen tabel zijn van de gevraagde (typen) auto’s voor het jaar 2018 de catalogusprijs, de bijtelling per maand en de belasting die daarover verschuldigd is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Fiscus blijft falen'

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked about Belastingtelefoon (tax helpline) call-answering failures, unit call numbers, staffing and whether a Q&A or email channel could help. The State Secretary gave detailed monthly figures showing 6-19% of callers not reached within five working days, said callers are not dropped from queues, and outlined 210 FTE extra capacity, but did not give a firm date for restored accessibility and declined email questions for security reasons.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over berichten uit het land dat belastinginspecteurs amateurmuziekverenigingen en verbonden steunverenigingen aan een belastinginspectie onderwerpen

MPs Lodders and Nijkerken-de Haan asked whether the tax authority has imposed VAT assessments, some retroactive, on supporter associations of amateur music societies, and on what legal basis. The State Secretary confirmed VAT assessments against two supporter associations and seven support foundations, explained the withdrawn VAT approvals for fundraising bodies and the general VAT exemption limits, and stated that the VAT liability follows from law and cannot be waived, though payment arrangements are possible.
The possible VAT liability, however, follows from the law. It cannot be deviated from.
De eventuele verschuldigdheid van btw vloeit echter voort uit de wet. Daar kan niet van worden afgeweken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘ministerie dendert door met vliegtaks’

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers why the ministry is pushing ahead with an aviation tax, how it fits the three-track policy, and how the EU, sector and other countries are involved. The government answers that it is pursuing all three tracks in parallel, that a national aviation tax may be introduced from 2021 if the European and emissions/noise routes yield too little, and that consultation, bilateral contacts and a Brussels coordination effort are underway.
The cabinet will make a choice this autumn on which variant can be worked out in national legislation
Het kabinet maakt dit najaar een keuze welke variant in nationale wetgeving kan worden uitgewerkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurtoeslag voor mensen die beschermd wonen of huren via een instelling

The SP's Beckerman asked why the Tax Administration's website dropped the statement that residents of temporary housing, such as shelters, receive no housing allowance, and whether this followed a 2015 Council of State ruling; he also asked about clawbacks, the number of affected tenants, and how the government will improve move-on from shelters. The minister answered that the ruling and a 2016 law on fixed-term contracts reduced such exclusions, that clawbacks continue where contracts are for short-term use, and that the government is exploring a model contract and a target-group contract with the sector, with results to Parliament by end 2018.
Precise figures on how many people currently rent a home through a social or care institution are not known, because they are not registered nationally.
Over het aantal mensen dat op dit moment een woning via een maatschappelijke of zorginstelling huurt zijn geen precieze cijfers bekend, omdat deze niet landelijk worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Fiscus blijft informatie achterhouden in rechtszaken om kinderopvangtoeslag’

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax authority withheld case-relevant notes in court cases over childcare benefit (CAF 11), and why, plus related questions on accountability, remedies and redress. The State Secretary acknowledges that some telephone notes and reports were not submitted, commits to a generous disclosure approach, has the Landsadvocaat review pending cases, and refers to the Ombudsman's findings and further steps.
I have asked the Landsadvocaat to take over the handling of the case files still before the court and to assess whether Toeslagen has submitted all documents relating to the case.

Ik heb de Landsadvocaat gevraagd om de behandeling van de dossiers, die op dit moment nog onder de rechter zijn, over te nemen en in dat kader te beoordelen of Toeslagen alle op de zaak betrekking hebbende stukken heeft overgelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet, Omtzigt en Bisschop over de uitvoering van de motie Geluk-Poortvliet en het behoud van het budget voor de instandhoudingssubsidie woonhuis-rijksmonumenten

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet, Omtzigt and Bisschop asked whether the new subsidy scheme for owner-occupied and rented listed homes, and the transfer of budget from the tax deduction, is consistent with a parliamentary motion and whether budgets will suffice. The minister replied that the scheme is open to natural persons only, the full budget remains available to owners, the budget will be evaluated in 2020, and the 100% loan cannot be combined with the subsidy.
As I indicated in my policy letter Erfgoed Telt, budgetary room arises by subsidising only those costs that contribute to maintaining the monumental parts of the monument.

Zoals ik in mijn beleidsbrief Erfgoed Telt heb aangegeven, ontstaat budgettaire ruimte door alleen de kosten te subsidiëren die bijdragen aan de instandhouding van de monumentale onderdelen van het monument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'bescherm de rechten van belastingbetalers beter'

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary of Finance about claims that high tax interest deters taxpayers from objecting, about the reciprocity and fairness of the tax interest and collection interest rules, and about a taxpayers' charter proposed by the tax advisers' association. The State Secretary answers that no such cases are known, that the rules are grounded in the principle of default and budget constraints, and that a charter adds no value beyond existing legislation, though clearer guidance may be published on the Tax Administration website.
A charter does not go through this legislative process, has an unclear status and creates expectations among taxpayers that are not necessarily justified.
Een handvest doorloopt immers niet dit wetgevingsproces, heeft een onduidelijke status en schept verwachtingen richting belastingplichtigen die niet noodzakelijkerwijs terecht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Honderdduizenden senioren lopen risico geld te laten liggen’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Raemakers asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about research showing many 55-plus households may miss out on healthcare and rent allowances, and about outreach to eligible seniors and Wajong beneficiaries. The government answered that non-take-up is known (about 17% for rent and healthcare allowance in earlier studies), that outreach exists, and that the issue will be examined in an upcoming IBO study with conclusions to inform further action.
Regarding the group of older migrants and single elderly, which you refer to in your question, no data are available in the aforementioned studies.
Over de groep oudere migranten en alleenstaande ouderen, waar u in uw vraag aan refereert, zijn in voornoemde onderzoeken geen gegevens voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over het bericht dat bijna een kwart miljoen senioren het risico lopen zorg- of huurtoeslag te missen

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked whether a Regioplan report showing that many seniors may be missing out on healthcare or rent allowances is accurate, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary says the percentages cannot be confirmed, names causes of non-take-up and promises an interdepartmental policy study of the allowance system, without committing to specific measures.
The cabinet recognises that there are citizens who do not use allowances although they may be entitled to them.
Het kabinet herkent en onderkent dat er burgers zijn die geen gebruik maken van toeslagen terwijl ze er mogelijk wel recht op hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Hermans over het bericht dat ouderen zich niet bewust zijn van toeslagen

VVD MPs Lodders and Hermans asked the government about reports that many elderly people do not claim the healthcare and rent allowances they are entitled to, and what steps will be taken. The government acknowledges non-take-up, says it cannot confirm the healthcare-allowance figures, and defers concrete measures to an IBO review of the allowance system due in spring and autumn 2019.
The cabinet will, as mentioned above, start an IBO study into the allowance system.
Het kabinet zal, zoals hierboven reeds vermeld, een IBO onderzoek starten naar het toeslagenstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Verhoog de BTW op drinkwater niet’

Two opposition MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press piece opposing a VAT increase on drinking water, asking about the price effect, the tax structure, exempting drinking water, and cutting the water levy. The State Secretary confirmed the VAT rise from 6% to 9% would raise water prices by three percentage points, rejected exempting water from the single reduced rate, and said the government will not lower or abolish the water levy.
The cabinet does not intend to lower or abolish the levy on tap water.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om de belasting op leidingwater te verlagen dan wel af te schaffen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het niet kunnen treffen van een persoonlijke betalingsregeling voor gedupeerde ouders in verband met de door de eigenaar van kinderopvang 'de Parel' gepleegde fraude met kindero

An MP asked whether parents defrauded through the childcare fraud at 'de Parel' could obtain a personal payment arrangement from the Tax Authority, after some parents were refused. The State Secretary answered that 15 of 50 requests were granted, refusals depended on individual circumstances such as intent or gross negligence, and the Tax Authority would adjust its notification letter for those refused.
Parents who do not qualify for a personal payment arrangement, for example because of intent or gross negligence, may possibly use the measure for offsetting childcare allowance.

Ouders die niet in aanmerking komen voor een persoonlijke betalingsregeling, omdat er bijvoorbeeld sprake is van opzet of grove schuld, kunnen mogelijk wel gebruik maken van «de maatregel bij verrekening van de kinderopvangtoeslag».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting nog meer gaat kosten dan eerder werd aangenomen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why abolishing the dividend tax now costs more than the 1.4 billion euro previously assumed, and urged redirecting the money to public services; the government answered that the cost is now estimated at 1.9 billion euro structurally due to higher revenue realisations and recalculation, that additional purchasing-power measures were taken for low incomes, that the advice documents were partly published, and that it will not reconsider the measure. The reply gives the cost figures and says cabinet's reasons for the policy are growth and retaining headquarters.
The cabinet, ahead of the debate with your House on 25 April 2018, disclosed in a letter of 24 April 2018 documents relating to the abolition of the dividend tax.
Het kabinet heeft – in aanloop naar het debat met uw Kamer op 25 april 2018 – bij brief van 24 april 2018 stukken geopenbaard die betrekking hebben op de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Britse beleggers zitten niet te wachten op afschaffen dividendbelasting'

MP Nijboer asked the government about a press report that British investors are not keen on abolishing the Dutch dividend tax, and about who bears the cost and revenue effects. The State Secretary answered that no foreign investors asked for abolition, that exact investor breakdowns are unavailable, and that the government will proceed with abolition to keep headquarters in the Netherlands.
Who these portfolio shareholders are is often also unknown to listed companies.
Wie deze portfolioaandeelhouders zijn is veelal ook voor beursgenoteerde bedrijven onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onvolledige antwoorden op de vragen over de erf-en schenkbelasting en de herhaalde weigering om gevraagde stukken aan de Kamer te sturen

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why answers on the inheritance and gift tax problems have been incomplete and why he keeps refusing to send internal memos and ICT analyses to parliament. The State Secretary replies that he has informed parliament sufficiently, that internal deliberation documents are kept confidential under cabinet policy, that the ICT analysis documents cannot be published for security reasons, and that management information was inadequate in April–June 2018.
I do not refuse any information.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het stopzetten van de kinderopvangtoeslag en de gevolgen daarvan en het inzagerecht van de burger in gegevens en telefoonnotities bij de BelastingTelefoon

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the termination of childcare allowance, compensation for affected families, the Belastingdienst's CAF 11 investigation documents, and citizens' right to access BelastingTelefoon call notes under the GDPR. The State Secretary answered that compensation is generally limited to statutory interest, that 109 parents received interest payments and three damage claims were rejected, that the CAF 11 report and documents will be shared confidentially, and that access rights cover only personal data, not whole documents.
So that your House can nonetheless form a good picture of the investigation and the underlying documentation, I am prepared to make the documents available for confidential inspection by your House.
Om uw Kamer toch in staat te stellen een goed beeld te krijgen van het onderzoek en de onderliggende documentatie, wil ik de stukken ter vertrouwelijke inzage aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over vaststellingsovereenkomsten tussen de belastingdienst en multinationals

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the claim that tax settlement agreements can run for 100 years squares with earlier answers saying the longest term is 10 years, and asked about the use, duration and oversight of rulings on dividend access mechanisms with multinationals. The government answers that such agreements are theoretically possible but practically limited by termination on law changes, that APA/ATR rulings run 4 to 5 years (up to 10 in exceptional cases), that many figures are not systematically kept, and that the Commission may request information but such exchanges are confidential.

For rulings with an international character, I earlier committed in answer to your questions of 15 June that I will include a limit of in principle 4 to 5 years, in line with APAs and ATRs, in the announced revision of the ruling practice.

Voor rulings met een internationaal karakter heb ik eerder in antwoord op uw Kamervragen van 15 juni jl. toegezegd dat ik een beperking van de looptijd tot in principe 4 tot 5 jaar conform APA's en ATR's zal meenemen in de door mij aangekondigde herziening van de rulingpraktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Echtpaar gooit tuinhuis op Airbnb. Hoe worden de huurinkomsten belast?’

MPs Van Eijs and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance how short-term rental income from a home (e.g. Airbnb, garden house) is taxed, and whether partial room rentals should be taxed. The State Secretary explained the existing rules under the Wet IB 2001 (article 3.113, room rental exemption, box 3 and VAT treatment), estimated about 8,000 households declared such income, and said no new measures were currently planned while a court case is on appeal.
The Tax Administration's records do not show how large the group is that should declare income from temporary rental of their own home in the income tax return.
Uit de administratie van de Belastingdienst is niet af te leiden hoe groot de groep is die inkomsten uit tijdelijke verhuur van de eigen woning moet aangeven in de aangifte inkomstenbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Belastingtelefoon slecht bereikbaar’

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone (BelastingTelefoon) was hard to reach, including ombudsman complaints, rejected calls, staffing cuts and forecasting. The State Secretary admits reachability is worse than he would like, reports 141 complaints and 1 June-31 July, cites added capacity and recruitment, and explains the call-planning model and the still-incomplete digital status portal.
Yes, reachability is worse than normal and worse than I would like.
Ja, de bereikbaarheid is slechter dan normaal en slechter dan ik zou willen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Geen reactie op uitstelverzoek door storing bij fiscus’

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked about a technical fault at the Tax Authority that left extension-request replies unsent from April to July 2018, and about redirecting callers to the BelastingTelefoon and waiting times for advisers. The Secretary of State confirmed the fault, gave the number of affected requests (29,203, of which 380 rejections), said the wait times were short and that the claim that a quarter of advisers dropped off was wrong due to incorrect open data.
A solution to this problem was implemented in the ICT environment on 20 July.
Voor dit probleem is op 20 juli een oplossing gerealiseerd in de ICT-omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de belastingtelefoon en alternatieve manieren van communiceren met de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the Tax Administration stopped publishing belastingtelefoon performance figures in its half-yearly reports, asked for call-waiting, staffing and sick-leave data, and asked about electronic communication and procedures for written questions and rulings. The State Secretary answered that the indicators were replaced by client-satisfaction and technical-accessibility measures, gave the requested data and queue-management details, said formal electronic communication is not yet open, and committed to restoring accessibility to early-2017 levels by early 2019.
The accessibility indicator, for example, only provides insight into the accessibility of telephone service, whereas the Tax Administration provides services through multiple channels.
De bereikbaarheidsindicator biedt bijvoorbeeld enkel inzicht in de bereikbaarheid van de telefonische dienstverlening, terwijl de Belastingdienst via meerdere kanalen diensten verleent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over taxichauffeurs die geen verzekering kunnen afsluiten

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about taxi drivers struggling to obtain insurance from regular insurers, rising accident claims, and whether the taxi market liberalisation and Uber drivers contributed. The minister answered that only 5-10% of taxi drivers are insured with De Vereende, that over 90% of risks are still covered by the regular market, and that no evidence links new entrants to rising claims, with the regulator ACM monitoring competition and exam requirements being reviewed.
I have taken note of this report.
Van dit bericht heb ik kennisgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Rijke huurder krijgt geld terug’

MP Nijboer asked the ministers about a report that the Tax Authority wrongly supplied tenants' income data to landlords before 2016, and whether rent increases based on that data must be reversed or compensated. The minister answered that the legal basis dates from 2013, that the Finance Minister is appealing a court ruling on the pre-2016 data, that she does not consider the Council of State ruling to invalidate those rent increases, and that individual civil cases are pending.

I am of the view that the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State does not mean that it must be concluded that the income-dependent (higher) rent increases of 2013 through 2015 were not validly agreed.

Ik ben van mening dat de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State niet tot gevolg heeft dat geconcludeerd moet worden dat de inkomensafhankelijke (hogere) huurverhogingen van de jaren 2013 tot en met 2015 niet rechtsgeldig overeengekomen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de schadevergoeding van Belastingdienst in verband met inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked about the consequences of a court ruling that the Tax Authority must pay damages to a tenant for wrongly disclosing income data to a landlord for income-dependent rent increases, and whether affected rents should be reversed. The minister answered that the government disagrees with the ruling and has appealed, does not believe rents should be reduced to 2012 levels, and sees no reason to start talks with those affected and the Woonbond.

How many households actually received a higher income-dependent rent increase is not known to me, because it is up to landlords whether or not to use the option of an income-dependent (higher) rent increase.

Voor hoeveel huishoudens daadwerkelijk een inkomensafhankelijke hogere huurverhoging is toegepast is mij niet bekend, omdat het aan verhuurders is om al dan niet gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheid tot inkomensafhankelijke (hogere) huurverhoging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raak over het bericht dat een bende cocaïnesmokkelaars is geïnfiltreerd bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Van Raak asked whether a Tax Authority employee was arrested for leaking confidential information to a drug smuggling gang, how such access is possible, how common official collusion with criminals is, and whether customs and tax officials are being bribed on a large scale. The State Secretary confirmed one Tax Authority employee is suspected, declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation, cited 2017 statistics and a WODC study, reported no known serious cases at customs in 2017-2018, saw no indication of large-scale bribery and therefore no inquiry, and said the government is strengthening its approach to undermining crime.
As far as this case is concerned, I cannot make any statements about a concrete criminal investigation.
Voor wat deze zaak betreft geldt dat ik geen mededelingen kan doen over een concreet stafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht op de website van de belastingdienst getiteld 'Wat betekent de vergoeding voor aardbevingsschade voor mijn toeslagen?'

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether compensation for Groningen earthquake damage should reduce childcare and child benefit allowances, and whether recipients face double harm and other benefit effects. The minister answered that compensation should leave people no worse off, that only a very limited group is affected through box 3 income, that such effects count as consequential damage claimable at the TCMG, and that no specific fiscal regulation is planned.
I am asking the TCMG to actively inform about this and am looking with them at how this can best be arranged in practice.
Ik vraag de TCMG hier actief over te informeren en kijk met hen hoe dit uitvoeringstechnisch het beste kan worden geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Belastingtelefoon slecht bereikbaar’

Two MPs (Lodders, Omtzigt) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Helpline was poorly reachable, whether quality indicators were valid, and what steps would fix it. The State Secretary attributed the problems to tight capacity planning, staff absence, a supplier change and a shrinking labour market, cited reachability figures, and announced extra staff and new quality controls from November 2018.
I agree with you that the reachability of the Tax Helpline must return to the level of the first half of 2017, and that the answers given must be of sufficient quality.

Ik ben met u van mening dat de bereikbaarheid van de Belastingtelefoon weer terug moet bewegen naar het niveau van de eerste helft 2017 en dat daarbij de gegeven antwoorden van een voldoende kwaliteit moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het anonimiseren van vermogen via een commanditaire vennootschap (CV)

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a Weekblad voor Fiscaalrecht article claiming limited partnerships (CVs) are used to anonymise wealth, and about tax leakage, the commercial and societas leonina requirements, and whether the Tax Authority cooperates with such structures. The State Secretary rejects the claims, says the Tax Authority no longer gives advance rulings on these structures, states no income tax is lost, and points to the forthcoming UBO register as added transparency.

I see no reason to amend the law to address the situation sketched by the article's authors, all the more so because transparency of asset components is already achieved through the introduction of the so-called UBO register.

Ik zie geen reden om de wet te wijzigen om de door de auteurs van het artikel geschetste situatie aan te pakken, temeer omdat transparantie van vermogensbestanddelen al wordt bereikt door de invoering van het zogenoemde UBO-register.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over de netto opbrengst van pachtgronden

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance how lease returns on farmland compare with the box 3 wealth tax assumed yield of 5.39%, whether the regulated rent norms can leave net lease income below the tax, and whether the government will change the box 3 system. The government answered that regulated lease prices cap only direct rental income, that box 3 is a forfaitary system averaging returns across wealth levels, that some individual landlords may face a higher tax burden than their lease income, and that a letter on actual-return box 3 is in preparation, while declining to give a regional breakdown of average net returns and of lease-type-specific yields.

Because the returns on savings and investments are adjusted annually on the basis of the most recent available data, the wealth yield tax system from 2017 onward better matches the average actual return.

Doordat de rendementen op spaargeld en beleggingen jaarlijks worden aangepast aan de hand van de meest actueel beschikbare gegevens sluit het stelsel van de vermogensrendementsheffing vanaf 2017 beter aan bij het gemiddelde werkelijke rendement.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat twee NGO’s een klachtenprocedure zijn gestart tegen het Oekraïense kippenbedrijf MHP, dat zaken doet met Nederlandse bedrijven die hiervoor exportkredietverzek

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about NGO complaints against Ukrainian poultry firm MHP, its export practices via a Dutch facility, and export credit insurance from Atradius DSB, including whether the insurer will refuse risky applications. The government confirms the complaints and the EU-Ukraine association agreement tariff issue, reports 18 insured transactions and EUR 34.1 million outstanding risk, says Atradius assessed MHP as acceptable, and commits to refusing transactions with excessive human rights or environmental risk.
Transactions where the risk of human rights violations or environmental damage is too great I reject, in line with existing policy.
Transacties waarbij het risico op schending van mensenrechten of milieuschade te groot is keur ik af, in lijn met staand beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Rechtsbescherming belastingbetalers verdient verbetering'

The MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Financieel Dagblad report claiming taxpayer rights need improvement, and whether Dutch taxpayers have a charter of rights. The State Secretary answered that Dutch taxpayer rights are well protected by national and international law and the appeal system, that the IBFD report does not cover the Netherlands, and that a charter is unnecessary given existing legal protections.
In the Netherlands considerable attention has been paid to carefully shaping the legal relationship between tax inspectors and collectors on one side and taxpayers on the other.
In Nederland is veel aandacht besteed aan een zorgvuldige vormgeving van de juridische relatie tussen belastinginspecteur en ontvanger aan de ene kant en belastingplichtigen aan de andere kant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer, Snels, Van Weyenberg, Omtzigt, Lodders en Leijten over een nieuw datalek bij Mossack Fonseca

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a new Mossack Fonseca data leak, how the Tax Authority will use the data, the yield and cost of Panama Papers work, the promised business case on strengthening its information position, and staffing outflow. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said analysis will start once the data is public, and stated that costs and yields cannot be separately tracked or directly linked, promising a broader assessment and information to parliament on Prinsjesdag 2018.

I will inform the House on Prinsjesdag 2018 to what extent additional investment in strengthening the Tax Authority's information position and enforcement capacity could benefit tax revenues and its enforcement strategy.

Ik informeer uw Kamer op Prinsjesdag 2018 in hoeverre een extra investering op het terrein van de versterking van de informatiepositie en de opsporingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst de belastingopbrengsten en ook de handhavingstrategie van de Belastingdienst ten goede kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het kennismakingsgesprek met Shell

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance why he met Shell's Dutch CEO, who initiated the meeting, who attended, and whether minutes and preparatory memos would be released. The State Secretary answered that such meetings are routine for balancing policy impact, that the meeting agenda was published, and that internal notes are not disclosed under established government policy, though relevant information will be shared in objectified form.
It is standing cabinet policy that documents prepared for internal deliberation, such as notes, memos and meeting minutes, are not made a subject of political debate.
Het is staand beleid van het kabinet om documenten die zijn opgesteld voor intern beraad, zoals notities, memo’s en gespreksverslagen geen onderwerp te maken van het politieke debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Expat Americans given one-year reprieve on US repatriation tax’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about a one-year deferral of the US 'toll tax' on repatriated foreign earnings for Accidental Americans and whether it applies to Dutch residents. The State Secretary confirmed the deferral also covers US citizens living in the Netherlands, said the Dutch embassy is lobbying Congress for full abolition, and promised to keep the House informed.
Yes, this deferral also applies to US nationals living in the Netherlands.
Ja, dit uitstel is ook van toepassing op in Nederland wonende Amerikaanse onderdanen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht Tips & tricks bij een vaststellingsovereenkomst met fiscus'

Leijten (SP) asks the State Secretary of Finance about a tax advisers' article on settlement agreements with the tax authority, including whether they can run indefinitely, whether the waiver of appeal rights is omitted, and whether non-compliant agreements are void. The State Secretary answers that agreements must state a fixed term, that a waiver of appeal is required under the Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht though compliance cannot be guaranteed in every case, that such agreements are not void under civil law, and agrees to consider capping the maximum term in the ruling practice review.
I do not approve of it, but I cannot guarantee that this provision is included in 100% of settlement agreements.
Ik keur het niet goed maar ik kan niet garanderen dat deze bepaling in 100% van de vaststellingsovereenkomsten is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over rulings over de dividendbelasting

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the full dividend-tax ruling policy of the past fifteen years, whether companies can pay dividends to zero-dividend-tax jurisdictions, how many dividend-tax rulings exist, whether they comply with law, and whether the commission examined pre-2015 rulings. The State Secretary answered that no separate ruling policy exists beyond the Verzamelbesluit, that counts of rulings were not systematically kept, that rulings are checked on procedure, and that the independent commission examined a random sample of 2017 APA/ATR rulings including some dividend-tax ones.
The number of cases in which advance certainty was given on the application of the Dividend Tax Act 1965 has not been systematically recorded over the past 15 years.
Het aantal gevallen waarin zekerheid vooraf is gegeven over de toepassing van de Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965 is niet systematisch bijgehouden in de afgelopen 15 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de problemen bij de schenk- en erfbelasting die al lang bekend waren bij de Belastingdienst, maar pas in november 2017 aan de Kamer werden meegedeeld

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why problems with the new inheritance and gift tax systems, known to the Tax Administration well before November 2017, were only reported to parliament then, and asks for the internal memos and whether withholding them is justified. The State Secretary answers that the delay only became clear in autumn 2017, that internal memos stay confidential as intern beraad, that all relevant information has been shared, and that he will not map who knew what when.
I do not provide the requested internal documents, referring briefly to the letter of 25 April 2016 from the Minister of the Interior.
De gevraagde interne documenten verstrek ik niet, waarbij ik kortheidshalve verwijs naar de Kamerbrief van 25 april 2016
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Slootweg over het lage-inkomensvoordeel

CDA MPs asked about cost increases, implementation status, employer error handling, EU worker eligibility, and the evaluation of the low-income benefit (LIV) and youth LIV. The minister answered that ICT implementation is on schedule, that targeted evaluations will follow, but that employment effects cannot yet be assessed since payments have not yet started.
The first LIV payment will be made by mid-September 2018 at the latest, and the youth LIV a year later.
De eerste betaling van het LIV zal uiterlijk medio september 2018 zijn en voor het jeugd-LIV een jaar later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale behandeling van compensatie van schade door aardbevingen

MP Nijboer asks the State Secretary of Finance whether it is fair that Groningen earthquake damage compensation, which is uncertain in existence and amount, is subject to box 3 wealth tax, and asks for a specific tax decision to relieve affected residents. The State Secretary replies that a compensation claim only enters the box 3 base once entitlement is established, that the TCMG pays within two weeks of decision so the tax-before-payment problem rarely arises, that most sums are under EUR 10,000, and that he will not adopt a specific tax decision but will explore with the Economic Affairs ministry how to remove uncertainty.
together with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate it will be explored how these uncertainties can be further removed
zal samen met het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat worden verkend hoe deze onzekerheden verder kunnen worden weggenomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de fiscale behandeling van de financiering van startups

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax treatment of startup financing, including liquidity problems, survival rates, and whether employee stock options should be taxed more favourably. The government answered that it sees no reason yet to widen the rules, pointing to ongoing evaluation of the reduced reasonable-wage rule and the stock option rule, due by the end of this cabinet period.
However, the cabinet does not want to anticipate these evaluations and currently sees no reason to widen the tax rules for startups and scale-ups.
Het kabinet wil echter niet vooruitlopen op deze evaluaties en ziet nu geen aanleiding om de fiscale regelgeving voor start-ups en scale-ups te verruimen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Omtzigt over een gezin waarvan de vrouw werkt, de man permanent in een WLZ-instelling verblijft en de kinderen dus geen recht hebben op kinderopvangtoeslag omdat de man niet werk

MPs Peters and Omtzigt asked why a family where the father is permanently in a WLZ care facility and the mother works cannot get childcare allowance, and why statutory articles on social-medical indicators have never entered into force. The Secretary of State acknowledges the rule can be harsh, says she will examine a statutory exception and report this autumn, but declines to comment on individual cases and points to municipalities for SMI.
Unfortunately I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan helaas niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over grenswerkers die klem zitten tussen de Nederlandse en Duitse Belastingdienst

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance about cross-border workers and self-employed people caught between Dutch and German tax authorities, including whether problems are increasing, how Team GWO handles questions, and how information is provided. The State Secretary answered that no data show a rise in such cases, described the existing information structure (Team GWO, border info points, outreach), and said cooperation with other tax authorities is generally good.
However, there are no figures available on all cases where problems arise from different interpretation of those tax rules in relation to Germany.
Er zijn echter geen cijfers beschikbaar van alle gevallen waar zich problemen voordoen door verschillende interpretatie van die (belasting)regels in relatie tot Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het CBS-rapport Groene Groei

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about the CBS finding that the share of environmental taxes in total tax revenue has fallen, and how this squares with the polluter-pays principle and the cabinet's 'greenest cabinet ever' ambition. The government disputes the CBS conclusion of no further greening, citing rising absolute green tax revenue, and points to planned increases in energy and waste taxes and new green levies in the coalition agreement.
The greening of the tax system will continue unabated.
De vergroening van het belastingstelsel wordt onverkort voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) en de Belastingdienst

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Administration's compliance with the GDPR, including its register of processing, impact assessments, rights handling, data breaches and Data Protection Authority investigations. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging shortcomings and promising measures and a one-year timeline for full compliance, while declining to predict AP enforcement and withholding some detail.
In the GDPR implementation process the Tax Administration has identified a number of shortcomings in compliance.
Antwoord 2 De Belastingdienst heeft in het traject voor implementatie van de AVG een aantal »tekortkomingen in de naleving geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat de BelastingTelefoon voor het zesde jaar op rij onder de maat presteert

Rep. Edgar Mulder (PVV) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Helpline was rated insufficient for the sixth year running, asking about answer accuracy, staffing, training and remedial action. State Secretary Snel answered that about 90% of calls are process and status questions meeting the 90% norm, that complex regulatory questions (about 3%) fall short, and that specialisation by theme and a stronger second line are being prepared.
Measures to improve the answering of questions on laws and regulations, such as specialisation on these questions and strengthening the second line, are being prepared.
Maatregelen om de beantwoording van vragen over wet- en regelgeving te verbeteren, zoals specialisatie op deze vragen en het versterken van de tweede lijn, worden voorbereid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Grenswerkers klem tussen Nederlandse en Duitse belastingdienst’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Interior about reports that cross-border workers are caught between Dutch and German tax authorities, including rising problem cases, information provision, DGA salary double taxation, and capacity. The government denies a clear rise in problems, says information provision is adequate and monitored, sees no need for new Germany-specific agreements or additional measures now, and commits only to continued monitoring.
However, there are no figures available on all cases where problems arise from differing interpretation of those tax rules in relation to Germany.
Er zijn echter geen cijfers beschikbaar van alle gevallen waar zich problemen voordoen door verschillende interpretatie van die (belasting)regels in relatie tot Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitgaven en de resultaten van de investeringsagenda en de gevolgen voor de plannen uit het regeerakkoord

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about spending and results of the Tax Authority's Investment Agenda, its funding after the redesign, expected extra revenue of 750 million euros per year, and whether coalition agreement measures and the fiscal policy agenda are at risk due to Tax Authority problems. The State Secretary answered with spending tables and remaining budget figures, said a direct link between investments and extra revenue cannot be established, and said implementation feasibility will be assessed through implementation tests without concrete reason to expect failures.

As my predecessor informed the House in his letter of 30 June 2016, and as I did in my letter of 23 February, it has proven impossible both ex ante and ex post to establish a direct link between specific investments and higher tax revenues.

Zoals mijn voorganger de Kamer in zijn brief van 30 juni 2016 heeft laten weten en ik in mijn brief van 23 februari jl., is gebleken dat het zowel ex ante als ex post niet mogelijk is een directe relatie te leggen tussen specifieke investeringen en meer belastingopbrengsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Van Toorenburg over de As Soennah moskee die onder de Nederlandse wet aangemerkt is als goed doel

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the As Soennah mosque holding ANBI charity status despite reportedly preaching against women's rights and advocating stoning, its missing mandatory publications, and whether foreign public bodies automatically qualify as ANBIs. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority cannot disclose individual cases, that foreign public bodies qualify automatically under current law and that the ANBI definition is under review together with other ministers, and that transparency proposals on funding from unfree countries are being explored.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and therefore does not provide information on individual cases.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) en verstrekt derhalve geen informatie over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het ETS in het kader van het rapport Groene groei van het CBS

An MP asked the ministers about the low Dutch emissions reduction under the EU ETS, whether the ETS and the MSR conflict with a national minimum CO2 price, how the surplus is determined, and whether binding reduction targets are preferable to price mechanisms. The government attributed the limited reduction to efficient, export-oriented sectors, denied any conflict, explained the surplus calculation, and rejected the preference for binding targets over pricing.
This has unfortunately not proven possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting

Green-Left MP Snels asks the State Secretary of Finance to answer earlier questions one by one about abolishing the dividend tax, its employment effects at Unilever, who benefits, and whether foreign treasuries gain most. The State Secretary largely defers to a forthcoming bill, argues the measure is part of a fiscal package for the investment climate, and says the net revenue mostly flows to foreign investors and governments, which cannot be quantified precisely.
It is therefore my preference in such situations to refer to the forthcoming bill, so as to keep the risk of incomplete and/or incorrect answers as small as possible.
Het heeft daarom mijn voorkeur om in dergelijke situaties te verwijzen naar het aankomende wetsvoorstel, om zo het risico op onvolledige en/of foutieve antwoorden zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Eindhoven wil eigen vliegtaks invoeren’

MPs of the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Eindhoven's motion to introduce a local aviation tax, including its legality, effects on competitiveness and whether other municipalities might follow. The Minister of the Interior answered that the decision rests with the municipal council, that such a tax would be tested by courts if challenged, and that the government prefers a national or European aviation levy instead.
It is up to the democratically elected representative body of the municipality, the municipal council, to decide on the introduction and levying of a tax.
Het is aan het democratisch vertegenwoordigende orgaan van de gemeente, de gemeenteraad, om de beslissing te nemen over de invoering en heffing van een belasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst stukken geheimhield tijdens een rechtszaak

MP Leijten asked why the Tax Administration withheld phone notes in a court case, whether this violates the law, what happens to those responsible, how large toeslagfraud is compared with tax evasion, and whether algorithms cause wrongful blocking of citizens. The State Secretary answered that the case is still pending before the court so he cannot comment on the notes, acknowledged the balance in the childcare benefit case tipped too far against citizens, and gave figures on fraud and staffing.
Under article 8:42 of the General Administrative Law Act, an administrative body must send all documents relating to the case to the administrative judge.
Conform artikel 8:42 Algemene wet bestuursrecht dient een bestuursorgaan alle op de zaak betrekking hebbende stukken aan de bestuursrechter te zenden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het niet delen van interne stukken (telefoonnoties van de belastingtelefoon) met de rechter en over het recht van de burger om de telefoonnotities van de belastingtelefoon te k

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance why Belastingdienst telephone notes are not shared with courts or parties, whether citizens can access them, and about compensation for parents affected by the childcare benefit (toeslagen) affair. The State Secretary answered that administrative bodies must send all case-relevant documents, that phone notes are usually personal working notes not requiring disclosure, that citizens' access rights are legally regulated, and declined to discuss individual cases still before the courts or involving individuals.
Telephone notes are usually no more than personal working notes used as a memory aid for the author.
Telefoonnotities zijn veelal niet meer dan persoonlijke werkaantekeningen die gebruikt worden als geheugensteuntje voor de opsteller.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked the Finance Ministry about the employment and investment effects of abolishing the dividend tax, the Unilever headquarters move, and internal civil-service and CPB analyses questioning the policy. State Secretary Snel answered that the government cannot quantify employment effects, sees the dividend tax abolition as part of a broader fiscal package for the investment climate, and disputed several analyses, while not providing quantified beneficiary breakdowns.
The cabinet has no direct insight into Unilever's personnel policy.
Het kabinet heeft geen direct zicht op het personeelsbeleid van Unilever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over de hoge OZB-rekeningen voor sportverenigingen en andere Sociaal Belang Behartigende Instellingen (SBBI)

CDA MPs asked whether municipalities charging sports clubs property tax (OZB) and then refunding it via subsidy is bureaucratic, whether non-residential OZB burdens on SBBI's are excessive, and whether the Municipalities Act should be amended to allow equal rates or an exemption. The minister answered that OZB rates and subsidies are a local democratic choice, declined to amend the law or grant a blanket exemption, and said no general judgement on burdens is possible.
An amendment of the Municipalities Act is not necessary in my view at this moment.
Een aanpassing van de Gemeentewet vind ik op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Afkoop pensioen dure grap voor ondernemer in het buitenland’

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that entrepreneurs living abroad face very high tax burdens when buying out their own-account pension, asking how many are affected, which countries apply such burdens, and whether the Tax Authority and treaties can resolve it. The State Secretary answered that no cases of a 90% burden are known, that foreign tax treatment cannot be generalised, that Dutch treaties mostly give the source state taxing rights, and that affected entrepreneurs should seek information from foreign authorities or advisers.
I am not aware of any cases in which directors-major shareholders faced a 90% tax burden when buying out their own-account pension.
Mij zijn geen gevallen bekend waarbij dga’s zijn geconfronteerd met een belastingdruk van 90% bij afkoop van hun pensioen in eigen beheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het onderzoek van het CPB “Eenverdieners onder druk”

An MP asks the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the CPB finding that the tax burden gap between single-earner and dual-earner households is widening, and about its fairness, efficiency and international position. The government answers that the individual tax system and progressivity cause the gap, that it is taking measures to lower single-earner burdens, and that it will report annually on the gap in the 2019 budget.
The cabinet will continue to pay attention to the position of single-earner households and will monitor the development of their tax burden and purchasing power.
Het kabinet blijft aandacht houden voor de positie van de eenverdiener en zal daarbij de ontwikkeling van de belastingdruk en de koopkracht van eenverdieners in het oog houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Wörsdörfer over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers

VVD MPs Lodders and Wörsdörfer asked whether self-employed people working from home must publish their home address in the Chamber of Commerce register, how they are protected against identity fraud, and whether the VAT number containing the BSN can be avoided. The government answered that the register publicly shows home and business addresses for sole traders for traceability and legal certainty, that home addresses can be shielded on request, and that it is investigating options for VAT numbers without the BSN.
I have no indications that the public disclosure of this information in the trade register creates an increased risk of identity fraud.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de openbaarheid van deze gegevens in het handelsregister een vergroot risico op identiteitsfraude oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over functioneren van de Belastingdienst

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about delays at the Tax Administration: backlogs in issuing VAT numbers, late publication of the payroll tax handbook and the tax relief tool, and delayed inheritance and gift tax assessments. The State Secretary acknowledged the delays, attributed them to capacity shortages and technical problems, promised a return to five-day processing by mid-May, and said affected taxpayers were informed by letter and no late-payment interest would be charged.
I do not find this desirable. That is why the priority in handling this category has now been raised.
Dit vind ik niet wenselijk. Daarom is de prioriteit in afhandeling van deze categorie inmiddels verhoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht 'US body brokers supply world with torsos, limbs and heads'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about Reuters reports on US body brokers, an FBI raid on a company with a Dutch branch, and infected body parts, asking about Dutch import rules and inspection. The minister answered that the FBI had not contacted the Netherlands, the Dutch branch appears to be administrative, existing rules do not target body-part trade, and the Dutch customs do not inspect for disease, leaving responsibility with the user.
There is no legislation providing for checks on disease in the import or export of body parts.
Er is geen wetgeving die voorziet in controles op het terrein van ziektes bij de import of export van lichaamsdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘verandering fiscale regels dochterbedrijf gaat jaren kosten’

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of the CJEU ruling on the Dutch fiscal unity regime, the number of affected firms, expected costs for SMEs and large companies, timing and content of emergency legislation and a future group regime. The State Secretary answered that about 300,000 entities use the regime, that burdens are expected to be temporary, announced a transitional measure for interest deduction limits up to EUR 100,000 per year and a future group regime to be presented before the end of the cabinet term.
The size of the higher burdens for companies that domestically use fiscal unity benefits depends on the budgetary yield of the bill with the emergency repair measures.

De omvang van de hogere lasten voor bedrijven die binnenlands gebruikmaken van voordelen van de fiscale eenheid hangt samen met de budgettaire opbrengst van het wetsvoorstel met de spoedreparatiemaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Omtzigt en Lodders over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers dat het burgerservicenummer bevat

MPs Van der Molen, Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether the VAT number of sole traders contains the citizen service number (BSN) and whether this is lawful under privacy rules, and asked the government to stop including the BSN in new VAT numbers. The State Secretary of Finance answered that the BSN is part of the VAT number for natural persons for historical and EU-specification reasons, that a legal basis exists under the Wabb and Wet op de omzetbelasting, and that he is open to a different VAT number format, with information to the House before summer 2018 but declined to report on the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
I cannot make any statement about the status of the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Alarm om haast vliegtaks'

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked why the ministry is already preparing an aviation tax, given the coalition agreement's European-route-first approach, and questioned its timing, effects and lessons from the 2008 tax. The State Secretary replied that parallel work on three tracks (European, emissions/noise levy, per-ticket charge) is needed to meet the 2021 budget target, with a letter to parliament before summer and an internet consultation, while answering most sub-questions on process and effects in general terms.
In my fiscal policy agenda I announced that I would send parliament a letter on the three tracks under investigation before summer.
In mijn fiscale beleidsagenda heb ik aangekondigd nog voor de zomer een brief over de drie te onderzoeken sporen naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'GBNED: Belastingdienst lijkt aan koppelverkoop te doen'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Tax Authority's pilot with certified online bookkeeping software for self-employed workers amounts to tied selling, and questioned the selection criteria, error rates and the Tax Authority's role. The State Secretary denied any tied selling, explained the Zeker-OnLine certification process, said the pilot aims to reduce errors and fines, and promised to report on the pilot's results from the 22nd half-year report.
There is therefore no question of tied selling.
Van koppelverkoop is dan ook geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over een financieel nadeel voor docenten die in België wonen en in Nederland hun beroep uitoefenen

Two MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether teachers living in Belgium but working in the Netherlands face a financial disadvantage from double tax-premium coordination, and whether the teacher clause in the Dutch-Belgian tax treaty should be changed. The government confirmed the mismatch under the treaty's two-year residence-state taxation rule, said the Netherlands no longer aims for such clauses, and stated that the issue is being raised in ongoing treaty negotiations with Belgium.
The Netherlands has already raised the issue of the professor clause with the aim of resolving the problem.
Nederland heeft de problematiek met betrekking tot de hooglerarenbepaling al aan de orde gesteld met als doel de genoemde problematiek op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de zwarte en grijze lijst van belastingparadijzen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance why Bahrain, the Marshall Islands and Saint Lucia were not explicitly flagged for removal from the EU blacklist of tax havens, and about transparency of the Code of Conduct Group's procedures, commitment letters, sanctions and the Dutch response. The State Secretary answered that the EU list procedures are confidential but Dutch pressure led to publication of list changes after Coreper, that 35 jurisdictions have consented to publishing their commitment letters, and that Dutch measures (withholding taxes, CFC rules) will target listed or low-tax jurisdictions.
The formal procedures of the Code of Conduct Group state that the work of the Code of Conduct Group is confidential.
De formele procedures van de Gedragscodegroep stellen dat het werk van de Gedragscodegroep vertrouwelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over dat de fiscus zelden antwoord geeft op zzp vragen

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked why the tax authority rarely answers freelancer (zzp) questions on sham self-employment, as the Bovib claimed 85% go unanswered.
