The State Secretary replied that the Tax Authority does not track questions per association, that approved model agreements give legal certainty, and that of 8,026 model-agreement requests, 1,808 were approved and 2,810 rejected, with 3,207 closed for non-response.
It is not always simple to give a judgment (self-employed or sham self-employed) based on the information available in an agreement.
Het is niet eenvoudig om altijd aan de hand van de in een overeenkomst beschikbare informatie een oordeel (zelfstandige/schijnzelfstandige) te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over onvoorziene fiscale gevolgen van de bevingsschade

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether unclear tax treatment of Groningen earthquake damage compensation, including immaterial damage and house value loss, creates uncertainty and how it is taxed for individuals and businesses. The government answered that such compensation is generally not taxable income for private persons, may count in Box 3 wealth depending on use, explained business relocation rules, and promised a publication on the Tax Administration website.
The intention is to include on the Tax Administration website a publication setting out the tax treatment of the compensation schemes.
Het voornemen is om op de website van de Belastingdienst een publicatie op te nemen waarin de fiscale behandeling van de compensatieregelingen is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Hermans over het bericht dat publiek zorggeld van Stichting Buurtzorg naar privébedrijfjes zou zijn gesluisd

MPs Slootweg and Hermans asked whether Stichting Buurtzorg funnelled over a million euros of public care money to private companies linked to its founder, and about oversight, a tax repayment arrangement and foreign activities. The minister answered that providers are responsible for their own governance, that the inspectorate sees no quality problems and is gathering information, that the NZa does not oversee such flows, and that tax confidentiality prevents disclosure of the arrangement.
The NZa does not supervise money flows between care providers and affiliated legal entities.
De NZa houdt geen toezicht op geldstromen tussen zorgaanbieders en gelieerde rechtspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de dalende belastingdruk op multinationals

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the effective tax burden on multinationals keeps falling while burdens on citizens rise, and whether the tax race and related measures would be reconsidered. The State Secretary answered that ATAD 2 and public country-by-country reporting will address avoidance, that data on effective tax rates are not available and a separate study would be needed, and that the government will not reverse the dividend tax abolition or corporate rate cuts, while promising a study on the arm's-length principle.
This data is not in the possession of the Tax Authority.
Deze gegevens zijn niet in het bezit van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rudmer Heerema over de btw-vrijstelling voor denksporten

MPs Bruins Slot, Omtzigt and Rudmer Heerema asked about the VAT exemption for mind sports (bridge, chess, draughts) after the 2017 CJEU ruling that such activities are not 'sport'. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling removes the sports exemption, estimates about EUR 1 million extra VAT revenue, and says talks are underway on possibly listing mind sports under the cultural services exemption, with a letter to the House promised before the summer recess.
However, I aim to inform the House in more detail about this before the summer recess.
Ik streef er echter wel naar uw kamer voor het zomerreces hierover nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak van het hof in Den Bosch in een tipgeverszaak van zwartspaarders

Mr Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Den Bosch appeal court ruling in the informant case involving Luxembourg tax evaders, questioning the timeline of contacts with the informant, whether the tax authority obstructed witness testimony, and the handling of the case. The State Secretary largely refused to go into the substance, citing ongoing litigation, withheld procedural documents and cost information, and rejected calls for an independent review.
The case is still before the courts. The discussion about the ruling of the Den Bosch Court of Appeal will be conducted by my Cassation team before the Supreme Court.
De zaak is nog onder de rechter. De discussie over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof ’s-Hertogenbosch zal door mijn team Cassatie bij de Hoge Raad worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘EU nagelt Nederland aan de schandpaal vanwege 'agressieve belastingplanning'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about EU Commissioner Moscovici's remarks that seven countries, including the Netherlands, enable aggressive tax planning, asking whether the Netherlands would be blacklisted and how the government would respond. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands meets all EU standards for the non-cooperative jurisdictions list, outlined the anti-tax-avoidance measures announced in the 23 February letter, and declined to comment on the Commissioner's intentions or on SGP enforcement beyond general statements.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de werkwijze van de Belastingdienst bij belastingafspraken met multinationals

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Netherlands does not disclose the number of advance pricing agreements with multinationals, how concern financing rulings were handled and continued after the CFA regime ended, and whether the Tax Authority's practice is adequately transparent. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands publishes APA figures annually, that the concern financing rulings expired at the end of 2016 with no further extensions, and that a review of ruling practice and external audits are underway.
The Ministry of Finance does not disclose personal policy views contained in documents prepared for internal deliberation in Wob decisions.
Het Ministerie van Financiën maakt in Wob-besluiten geen persoonlijke beleidsopvattingen ten behoeve van intern beraad openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over een fiscale regeling voor (elektrische) fietsen

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Infrastructure and Finance about encouraging cycling for commuting, the tax treatment of company leasing of bicycles versus cars, and whether tax rules would be changed. The government answered that it supports cycling promotion with employers, that the valuation of private use of company bicycles lacks a flat-rate rule, and that a simpler rule is being examined with the industry for inclusion in Belastingplan 2019.
For this reason, the government is currently examining, in consultation with the industry (including RAI Vereniging), how a clear and simple tax scheme can be designed.
Daarom wordt momenteel in overleg met de branche (waaronder RAI Vereniging) onderzocht op welke wijze een duidelijke en eenvoudige fiscale regeling kan worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over de uitspraak van Het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie op 22 februari 2018 over de verenigbaarheid van het Nederlandse fiscale-eenheidsregime

Rep. Edgar Mulder (PVV) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of the CJEU's 22 February 2018 ruling on the Dutch fiscal unity regime, including the number of firms affected, budgetary effects, the regime's value for tax authorities and the investment climate, and whether a cross-border fiscal unity is feasible. The State Secretary answered that emergency repair measures are needed to protect the tax base, that budgetary effects are still being studied with a bill expected in Q2 2018, and that a cross-border fiscal unity is not a realistic option.
The cabinet is aware that with the chosen emergency repair measures, in principle every existing fiscal unity will have to examine whether the emergency repair measures have consequences.
Het kabinet is zich ervan bewust dat met de gekozen spoedreparatiemaatregelen in beginsel elke bestaande fiscale eenheid na zal moeten gaan of de spoedreparatiemaatregelen gevolgen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over pensioenopbouw van zwangere huisartsen

Two VVD MPs asked why self-employed doctors lose pension accrual in occupational pension schemes during pregnancy and whether this will be fixed. The state secretary explained the causes (lower income and a fiscal part-time factor, visible three years later), noted that self-employed people can compensate via the third pillar, and committed to removing fiscal barriers in the end-of-year decree 2018.

I intend to arrange that there are no fiscal obstacles preventing these self-employed professionals from accruing pension within their own occupational or sector pension scheme on the same income as before the pregnancy.

ben ik voornemens te gaan regelen dat er geen fiscale belemmeringen zijn om deze zelfstandige beroepsbeoefenaren binnen de eigen beroeps- of bedrijfstakpensioenregeling over hetzelfde inkomen pensioen te laten opbouwen als vóór de zwangerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de waterschapslasten

An MP asked the government about rising water board (waterschap) charges, the cost drivers, differences between water boards, and whether the rising costs can be limited. The Minister answered that the increases stem mainly from investment needs, that the 2011 Bestuursakkoord Water sets efficiency targets and is progressing, and that water board charges are cost-covering and set by democratically elected boards, with a tax-system review pending.
Progress is reported annually in the State of Our Water, which is presented to the House in May.
Jaarlijks wordt over de voortgang gerapporteerd in de Staat van ons Water, die in mei aan de Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Fiscus negeerde Europees verbod op afspraken’

Member Nijboer (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press report claiming the tax authority ignored a European ban on rulings, and about how concern financing structures and their tax treatment evolved. The State Secretary answered that the headline was incorrect and corrected, explained the shift from the CFA regime and the evolving transfer pricing view, and said he is committed to fighting tax avoidance.
I have made the fight against tax evasion and tax avoidance a priority of my policy.
Daarom heb ik de strijd tegen belastingontduiking en belastingontwijking tot een speerpunt van mijn beleid gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over moeilijk inbare belastingvorderingen en het afboeken van belastingvorderingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about hard-to-collect tax claims, their write-off amounts across tax types, causes, collection steps, write-off rules and recovery costs. The answer gave outstanding claim figures, a breakdown by tax type, write-off trends (about 180,000 claims written off in 2017 versus about 660,000 in 2013), the collection process and the rule that claims are written off only after all recovery options are exhausted.
How much the collection costs for the various taxes amount to is not known.
Hoeveel de kosten van de invordering bij de verschillende belastingen belopen is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verdwijnen van hulp bij de belastingaangifte

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the declining availability of in-person help with tax returns, the closure of the Gouda help point, and how people without helpers or paid advisers can file. The State Secretary answered that help is available at 30 locations and via library and intermediary networks, and that the Tax Administration will keep help at its 20 planned offices, while stating it provides no fiscal advice.
It is not the case that citizens from Gouda can no longer receive help with their tax return.
Het is niet zo dat burgers uit Gouda geen hulp bij aangifte meer kunnen ontvangen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Slootweg over het niet-opgevolgde advies van het Bureau ICT Toetsing (BIT) om het ICT project Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein gedeeltelijk uit te stellen

Members Omtzigt, Heerma and Slootweg (CDA) asked why the government did not follow the BIT advice to postpone part of the Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein ICT project, why the advice was not sent to parliament within the required four weeks, and about costs, readiness, privacy assessments, staffing and oversight. The minister acknowledged the late transmission, said the deviation was made deliberately after end-to-end testing, and gave detailed assurances on implementation progress, while declining to give a timeline for some cost and readiness details and deferring some answers.
I regret that I was unable to inform your House within the four-week response period.
Ik betreur het dat ik uw Kamer niet binnen de reactietermijn van vier weken heb kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat hoogleraren en fiscalisten pleiten voor openheid belastingafspraken met multinationals

Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether publishing tax rulings with multinationals is needed to remove secrecy, whether rulings can comply with law only if published or stopped, whether they comply with EU Code of Conduct guidelines, and related questions on the 2016 pre-consultation decision, NFIA, the cv/bv structure, transfer pricing and the EU MFF. Snel answered that rulings are exchanged internationally and general frameworks and exemplary APAs/ATRs are published, that individual rulings cannot be published under the AWR, that EU guidelines are soft law with procedural alignment planned by 1 January 2019, and that individual publication adds limited value.
In connection with Article 67 of the General Tax Act, individual rulings cannot be made public.
In verband met artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen kunnen individuele rulings niet publiek gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over partnerschap

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why a child moving in with a parent can make the parent and child legal partners, cutting off childcare and health-related allowances, while inheritance tax treats children differently, and whether partner criteria across laws should be harmonised. The State Secretary defends the objective partner criteria in the AWR and tax/allowance laws, including the household rule for blood relatives in the first degree aged 27 or over, and says there is no need to harmonise partner definitions across social-security schemes.
As I indicated earlier, the basic partner concept also applies to gift and inheritance tax, and because of its specific nature a number of additional requirements apply.
Zoals ik hiervoor al heb aangegeven geldt het basispartnerbegrip ook in de schenk- en erfbelasting en is vanwege het specifieke karakter ervan een aantal aanvullende eisen gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de Belasting van Personenauto's en Motorrijwielen (BPM)-opbrengst fors hoger is

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked whether the 27.4% rise in BPM car tax revenue for 2017 is real, what causes it, when the tariffs will be switched to WLTP-based tables, and how to prevent or compensate overpayment. The Secretary of State says final 2017 figures come in May 2018, attributes the rise mainly to economic growth and consumer preferences for larger cars rather than WLTP (only 128 WLTP cars sold), commits to a budget-neutral switch as soon as possible but not before analysis after summer 2018, and declines to investigate individual overpayment.
I am working to ensure that the BPM revenue (at macro level) does not rise as a result of the WLTP.
Ik zet mij in om de BPM-opbrengst (op macroniveau) niet te laten stijgen als gevolg van de WLTP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanhoudende DDoS-aanvallen op Nederlandse banken en de Belastingdienst

MPs asked the Finance ministers about recent DDoS attacks on Dutch banks and the Tax Authority, including whether data was leaked, how perpetrators are investigated, what measures banks take, whether DNB supervises payment availability, and what the government will do to keep access to money and tax filing secure. The government answered that the attacks caused temporary outages but no data breach or direct financial loss, described a suspect arrested, listed existing protective measures and DNB supervision, and said vigilance will be maintained.
There is no danger to the personal data of customers and/or taxpayers or to the security of their data and money, and there has been no data breach.
Er is geen gevaar voor de persoonsgegevens van klanten en/of belastingplichtigen of voor de veiligheid van hun gegevens en geld, en er is geen sprake geweest van een datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Ondernemers in Nederland met Amerikaans paspoort dupe van belastinghervorming Trump’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether US tax reform, including a one-off 'toll tax', unfairly double-taxes Dutch residents with US citizenship and how the government will respond. The State Secretary confirmed the US taxes citizens worldwide, said the tax treaty offers little relief, and described diplomatic steps and possible coordinated EU action without committing to a concrete remedy.
The cabinet intends to also bring the position of US nationals living in Europe into the broader European discussion on the US tax reform.
Het kabinet is voornemens om de positie van in Europa wonende Amerikaanse onderdanen ook te betrekken in de bredere Europese discussie over de Amerikaanse belastinghervorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het rapport 'mining taxes' van de Stichting Onderzoek Multinationale Ondernemingen (SOMO)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about an SOMO report on tax avoidance by mining companies via the Netherlands and Mongolia's tax treaty with the Netherlands, including the IMF's view, other countries' treaty changes, and four SOMO recommendations. The State Secretary said the IMF only described the Dutch treaty and favoured renegotiation over termination, that the Netherlands is pursuing anti-abuse clauses and substance requirements, and that individual firms receive no tax advantages contrary to law, while not ruling out lower withholding rates in a future treaty.
I cannot comment on the tax position of individual taxpayers.
Over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen kan ik geen uitlatingen doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het bericht 'mining taxes’ van de Stichting Onderzoek Multinationale Ondernemingen (SOMO)

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a SOMO report alleging that Rio Tinto-linked Dutch and Luxembourg conduit companies avoided large taxes in Mongolia and Canada, and asked about treaty renegotiation, anti-abuse rules, withholding taxes and conduit companies. The government answered that no treaty negotiations with Mongolia are ongoing, committed to BEPS-compliant anti-abuse provisions and to excluding conduit companies from investment-treaty protection, and said it would pursue treaty abuse firmly.
The cabinet considers it desirable that only investors carrying out substantial business activities in the Netherlands can use Dutch investment agreements.
Het kabinet vindt het wenselijk dat enkel investeerders die substantiële bedrijfsactiviteiten in Nederland verrichten, gebruik kunnen maken van Nederlandse investeringsakkoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de aantallen belastingplichtigen met lage inkomens die worden geraakt door de uitfasering van de aftrek wegens geen of geringe eigenwoningschuld

An MP asked how many low-income taxpayers (income under 20,000 euro) benefit from the Hillen deduction by WOZ value, given the phase-out of the deduction for homeowners with little or no mortgage debt. The state secretary provided a table showing 173,000 such households, and argued that many have substantial box 3 wealth and that the overall effect is limited once other tax measures are considered.
That table shows, as also presented above by WOZ value, that of the households using the Hillen deduction, 173,000 (19%) had an income up to 20,000 euro.
Uit die tabel blijkt, zoals ook hiervoor weergegeven per WOZ-waarde, dat van de huishoudens die gebruikmaken van de Hillen-aftrek, er 173.000 (19%) een inkomen hadden tot € 20.000.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het verslag van de Ecofinraad van 23 januari 2018

MP Snels asked why Parliament was not informed in advance about the Ecofin agenda item on delisting eight jurisdictions from the EU tax blacklist, why commitments by Panama and others were accepted despite being vague, and whether the minister would press for more transparency. The State Secretary admitted the item was added as an A-item late and that Parliament should have been informed via an agenda supplement, promised to flag expected listing changes in future agendas, defended the adequacy of the commitments, and said that secret assessment details cannot be shared but some correspondence was published and further transparency pleas were made.
It would have been better if Parliament had been informed through a supplement to the annotated agenda of this change to the agenda.
Het was beter geweest als uw Kamer door middel van een aanvulling op de geannoteerde agenda op de hoogte was gebracht van deze wijziging van de agenda
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de consequenties van de hogere belastingheffing voor gepensioneerden in België

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Dutch tax authority's end of the wage-tax exemption for Dutch pensioners living in Belgium, the number affected, how they were informed, and whether double taxation or a transitional rule can be prevented. The State Secretary answered that about 1,300 people were notified, that a bilateral agreement with Belgium was signed on 5 March 2018 that removes double taxation and double non-taxation, and that the Tax Authority can undo double taxation quickly once Belgian information arrives.
Therefore I immediately entered into consultation with Belgium, and this led to a quick positive outcome.
Daarom ben ik direct in overleg getreden met België en dat heeft tot een snelle positieve uitkomst geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over dubbele belastingheffing over pensioenen van grensarbeiders uit België

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why Dutch taxing rights extend to whole pensions from Belgium-resident frontier workers, and about double taxation, indexation of the 25,000 euro threshold, Belgian taxation of Dutch AOW pensions, and treatment of business-owner pension buyouts. The government answered that it has source-state taxing rights under the treaty where Belgium cannot adequately tax, that a bilateral arrangement addresses double taxation, that indexation would need a treaty amendment, and that the buyout concession was implemented via a Belgian circular.
With recently agreed arrangements between Belgium and the Netherlands, a solution has been found for this.
Met recent gemaakte afspraken tussen België en Nederland is hier een oplossing voor gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de stijging van de lokale lasten en het COELO-rapport

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the macronorm for property tax (OZB), its history since 2008, overshoots, the role of COELO, the VNG and the Tax Administration, and the 2014 evaluation. The minister answered that municipalities decide democratically on OZB, that overshoots are offset in later years, that COELO collects only aggregate data, and that the norm will be reconsidered only when the local tax base is revised.

Based on the currently available data, aimed at applying the macronorm to the total revenues of all municipalities together, COELO does not have the data to determine the OZB revenue of individual municipalities.

Op basis van de huidige beschikbare gegevens, met als doel de toepassing van de macronorm op de totale opbrengsten van alle gemeenten tezamen, beschikt het COELO niet over de gegevens om de ozb-opbrengst van individuele gemeenten vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Slootweg over het bericht 'Boer kan fipronil-mest niet kwijt'

MPs Geurts and Slootweg asked why farmers forced to burn fipronil-contaminated manure at an incineration plant must pay waste tax while the Moerdijk plant is exempt, and whether the levy should be waived. The minister confirmed the tax applies by law, rejected a temporary exemption given greening policy in the coalition agreement, and pointed to a protocol and other processing options.
Amending the Wbm to include an exemption or zero rate in the waste tax for incidental cases is not appropriate.
Een aanpassing van de Wbm om in de ASB voor incidentele gevallen een vrijstelling of nihiltarief op te nemen ligt niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Amsterdam over de forfaitaire heffing in de vermogensrendementsheffing

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance how the government would respond to a Amsterdam Court of Appeal ruling that the forfaitaire box 3 wealth tax may breach fair balance, and whether reform was sufficient and a move to actual returns planned. The State Secretary answered that the ruling leaves the assessment intact, that the 2017 reforms and higher exemption are considered sufficient for now, and that a cabinet position on actual-return taxation will be sent to parliament in spring.
The Amsterdam Court of Appeal, however, attached no (legal) consequences to this, and the constitutional position of the judge means the legislature must be given some time to address this situation.

Het hof Amsterdam heeft hier echter geen (juridische) consequenties aan verbonden en de rechtsstatelijke positie van de rechter houdt in dat de wetgever enige tijd moet worden gegund om in deze situatie te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of Brexit for the Netherlands, focusing on a customs impact memo, customs staffing needs (500-800 extra staff), IT readiness and the timing of recruitment. The government answered that the Douane and NVWA are recruiting within existing frameworks, that analyses for internal deliberation will not be shared, and that preparations continue ahead of March 2019.
The analyses requested by your House were, however, prepared for internal deliberation and it is undesirable that they become the subject of political debate.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde analyses zijn echter opgesteld voor intern beraad en het is onwenselijk dat zij onderwerp zijn van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over belasting op een Duitse tegemoetkoming voor betaalde premies voor de zorg

An MP asks why a German Zulage reimbursing Dutch Wlz and Zvw premiums is taxed as income and why this differs from how UWV treats it. The Secretary of State explains that the Zulage is a periodic benefit taxed in box 1, while UWV does not count it for WAO offsetting because the tax and social security income concepts differ in purpose.
The fiscal income concept is broader than the income concept for employee insurance schemes, including the WAO in this case, which is based on wages.
Het fiscale inkomensbegrip is ruimer dan het inkomensbegrip voor de werknemersverzekeringen, waaronder i.c. de WAO dat gebaseerd is op het loon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Lijst taksparadijzen halveert’

An MP from the PvdA asked the Finance Ministry why several jurisdictions were removed from the EU blacklist of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions, why the grey list is not public, and what sanctions are planned for listed countries. The State Secretary referred to the Ecofin report for the delisting reasons, said the grey list is publicly available only in the Council conclusions and that Nederland wants more transparency, and described the agreed mix of fiscal and non-fiscal countermeasures while promising a separate letter on the wider approach.
I refer you for an answer to these questions to the report of the Ecofin Council of 23 January.
Ik verwijs voor een antwoord op deze vragen naar het verslag van de Ecofinraad van 23 januari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de uitspraak dat Nederland een ‘fiscaal zwart gat’ is

The SP MP Leijten asks the government whether it is proud of being called a 'fiscal black hole' by Commissioner Moscovici, how often the Netherlands has been challenged in EU forums on narrowing its tax base, and why Panama and others were removed from the EU tax haven list. State Secretary Snel rejects the characterisation as inappropriate, points to Dutch anti-avoidance measures and EU Code of Conduct reviews, and refers to the Ecofin report on the list, while acknowledging concerns about transparency of the list and promising a separate letter.
I have therefore repeatedly pressed for more transparency from the Code of Conduct Group and specifically regarding the process of the EU list.
Ik heb daarom ook herhaaldelijk aangedrongen op meer transparantie van de Gedragscodegroep en meer specifiek rondom het proces van de EU-lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over dubbele belastingheffing over pensioenen van grensarbeiders uit België

Member Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about Dutch taxation of Belgian residents' Dutch pensions above EUR 25,000, the reasons for this decision, and possible double taxation, and whether consultation with Belgium was planned. The State Secretary answered that the treaty gives the residence state the right to tax such pensions, that Belgian court rulings made it unclear whether Belgium can tax them sufficiently, that about 1300 Belgian residents were notified their exemption ends in 2018, and that the competent authorities will consult shortly to find a solution.
Consultation between the Dutch and Belgian competent authorities will take place in the short term to reach an appropriate solution.
Er vindt op korte termijn een overleg plaats tussen de Nederlandse en de Belgische bevoegde autoriteiten om te komen tot een passende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Nieuwe auto’s duizenden euro’s duurder’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the switch to WLTP testing will raise car registration tax (BPM) and prices, and about greener fleet policy. The State Secretary answered that CO2mpas recalculates WLTP emissions to NEDC values to keep current tables, that the impact cannot yet be judged, and that monitoring with RDW, TNO and industry will be extended, promising to keep the House informed; on fleet renewal the government relies on tax incentives for zero-emission cars rather than targeted fleet renewal.
I hereby undertake to keep your House informed of progress in this complex process.
Ik zeg bij deze toe uw Kamer op de hoogte te houden over de voortgang in dit complexe proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het belastingverdrag Nederland Malawi

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked whether the government will ratify the 2015 Netherlands-Malawi tax treaty without reopening it, whether Malawi's requested changes are being negotiated, and whether anti-abuse provisions are adequate given an ActionAid report on treaty abuse costing Malawi USD 27.5 million. The State Secretary answered that Malawi's requested changes were not taken up, that ratification should proceed with a later amending protocol, that main purpose tests exist, and that the MLI can bring the treaty in line with BEPS.
The cabinet therefore proposed to Malawi that, as is customary, ratification of the tax treaty be completed and that negotiations on an amending protocol follow.

Derhalve heeft het kabinet in zijn reactie aan Malawi voorgesteld om, zoals gebruikelijk is, de ratificatie van het belastingverdrag af te ronden en daarnaast te gaan onderhandelen over een wijzigingsprotocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de stijging van de lokale lasten en het COELO-rapport

An MP from the VVD asked the government about rising local taxes, including a 9.4% OZB increase in Eindhoven, the COELO report, and why the macronorm was exceeded and the agreed compensation never applied. The minister answered that municipal councils decide on OZB rates, that the macronorm was exceeded in 2012-2016 with overruns carried over to the following year, and that individual municipality data on macronorm breaches is not available.
The annual COELO research does not provide data on the number of municipalities that individually exceeded the macronorm.
Uit het jaarlijkse onderzoek van het COELO zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal gemeenten dat op individuele basis de macronorm heeft overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of a hard Brexit for the Netherlands, including the KPMG report on non-tariff trade barriers, planned actions, customs and inspection capacity, and information provision to businesses. The government answered that it is intensifying business information, hiring extra customs and NVWA staff, and that the cost of a hard Brexit is estimated at about 1.2% of GDP, while stressing that the EU-UK arrangements are still under negotiation.
The precise effect on employment is difficult to estimate, because trade can also shift to other countries and new jobs can therefore also arise.
Het precieze effect op de werkgelegenheid is moeilijk in te schatten, omdat handel zich ook kan verplaatsten naar andere landen en er dus ook weer nieuwe banen kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Veldman over het bericht ‘Nieuw innovatiebox-besluit stelt teleur’

MPs Lodders and Veldman asked the State Secretary of Finance about a critical press report on the new innovation box (innovatiebox) decision, including whether the scheme is accessible to entrepreneurs and which open questions remain. The State Secretary answered that entrepreneurs' experiences are largely positive, pointed to the evaluation, the flat-rate option, helpdesks and policy decisions, and acknowledged that some aspects such as aggregation level and IP access criteria are still being clarified, with a supplementary policy decision expected this year.
I therefore expect to supplement the policy decision on the new innovation box this year.
Ik verwacht het beleidsbesluit over de nieuwe innovatiebox dan ook dit jaar nog aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de voorwaarden die worden gesteld bij het afgeven van belastingrulings

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether tax rulings (APAs and ATRs) carry conditions such as substance requirements, how breaches are handled, whether staffing suffices to monitor compliance, whether rulings survive takeovers or mergers, whether companies must repay tax benefits, and how many rulings were revoked. The state secretary answered that standard substance requirements are set in public policy decisions, that non-compliance or changed facts can cause a ruling to lapse, that rulings survive a takeover only under conditions, and that 2016 monitoring led to three ATRs ceasing to apply, with fuller figures promised in a future half-year report.
In the first half-year report of 2018 it will be included how many requests were rejected in 2017, how many were declared inadmissible, how many were withdrawn and on what grounds.

Bij de eerste Halfjaarsrapportage in 2018 zal worden opgenomen hoeveel verzoeken in 2017 zijn afgewezen, hoeveel er buiten behandeling zijn gesteld, hoeveel er zijn ingetrokken en op welke grond dat is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over 16 miljard belastingontwijking van Google via Nederland

The SP MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance whether it is acceptable that Google routes 16 billion euros in royalties through a Dutch subsidiary to Bermuda without tax, whether that subsidiary lacks substance, how many multinationals use similar shells, and whether Ireland and Singapore are harmed. The State Secretary declined to confirm anything about an individual taxpayer or a ruling under the General Tax Act, stated that the government considers such shell companies undesirable and plans a withholding tax on royalties, and rejected the claim that other countries are harmed.
Regarding tax affairs of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make any statements in view of article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de publicatieplicht van moskeeën en kerken die de ANBI-status hebben en de transparantie van geldstromen uit onvrije landen

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the publication duty for ANBI-status churches and mosques, the 632 omissions found, whether published figures reveal money from unfree countries, and how the coalition agreement's transparency of foreign funding will be implemented. The government reported 970 omissions among 2,135 church institutions checked, 884 remedied, and deferred transparency measures on foreign funding to a Justice Minister exploration letter due by Q1 2018.
The publication duty applies to church bodies and their autonomous parts that have been designated as ANBI by group decision, from 1 January 2016.
Voor kerkgenootschappen alsmede hun zelfstandige onderdelen en lichamen waarin zij zijn verenigd die door middel van een groepsbeschikking als ANBI zijn aangemerkt, met ingang van 1 januari 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat de huurtoeslag de komende jaren flink zal dalen

PVV MPs Kops and Mulder asked whether the government knows how many of the 1.4 million rent-allowance households are in debt and how many will fall into financial trouble from cuts to the allowance, and how it can claim households will be better off. The minister answered that the allowance is not being cut but rising slightly less, that debt has multiple causes, that removing the hard income limit and tax cuts leave households better off overall, and that statushouders are treated equally.
It is not known how many of these households receive rent allowance.
Niet bekend is hoeveel van deze huishoudens een huurtoeslag ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Belastingwijziging benadeelt grensarbeiders uit België en Duitsland’

MP Omtzigt asked why Dutch employees living in Germany and cross-border workers cannot claim tax credits through provisional assessments, whether a treaty change is needed, and how affected workers will be informed about the 2019 change. The State Secretary replied that the measure is designed to prevent non-qualifying foreign taxpayers from receiving credits they are not entitled to, that qualifying taxpayers can claim credits via provisional assessments after the first year, that no treaty amendment is strictly necessary but a special provision would be needed to avoid precedent, and that the Tax Administration will write to affected groups in the last quarter of 2018.
During the Eerste Kamer treatment of the Belastingplan 2018 package on 12 December I committed to actively writing to this group about the consequences of this measure.

Antwoord 9, 10 Tijdens de behandeling van het pakket Belastingplan 2018 in de Eerste Kamer op 12 december 4 heb ik de toezegging gedaan deze groep actief aan te schrijven over de gevolgen van deze maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de plotselinge versobering van het nabestaandenpensioen

An MP asked whether the 2017 pension decree quietly tightened survivors' pension rules by allowing a cut in risk-based partner pensions and combining it with a lower franchise, and asked about affected schemes, consent procedures and employee rights. The government answered that the rules were not materially changed, that the cut and lower franchise were already permitted in 2015 and remain allowed, that it lacks data on affected schemes, and that no reversal is needed.
However, the decree does not involve a reduction in survivors' pensions.
Het besluit houdt echter geen versobering van het nabestaandenpensioen in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het aansturen op het telefonisch intrekken van bezwaren door de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Finance how the Tax Administration came to phone taxpayers to withdraw objections, whether informal withdrawals were recorded, and whether the Chamber was given full information on searches and compensation. The State Secretary replies that since October 2016 withdrawals must be confirmed in writing, that 23 affected people responded and no objections remain open, and that data searches were only theoretically possible, but declines to give the full search information and declines to answer some questions.
It therefore cannot be said that the Chamber has been denied insight or (relevant) information about search queries.
Er kan dan ook niet gesteld worden dat de Kamer inzicht of (relevante) informatie over zoekopdrachten is onthouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht ‘Opmerkelijk cadeau van 135.000 euro voor Pechtold’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that D66 leader Pechtold received an apartment worth 135,000 euros as a gift from a Canadian diplomat, and how its value relates to WOZ and market values, which taxes apply, and whether the VvE contribution may be deducted for transfer tax. The State Secretary confirmed the report, declined to comment on the individual tax position citing the confidentiality obligation of article 67 AWR, and gave only general information on transfer tax rules.
Regarding tax matters of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make any statements given the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat niet alle rulings worden uitgewisseld

MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority is failing to exchange all tax rulings with international partners, as required, and how many rulings have been exchanged. The State Secretary denies any intent to withhold information, explains that about 4,000 relevant rulings were identified through file review, says a letter on the status will follow in early 2018, and points to EU and OECD peer-review enforcement mechanisms.
I will inform the House by letter in early 2018 about the status of the exchange of ruling information within the EU and OECD.
Ik zal uw Kamer begin 2018 door middel van een brief informeren over de stand van zaken ten aanzien van de rulinguitwisseling in EU- en OESO-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rulingpraktijk

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why tax rulings with multinationals are not exchanged with other countries as agreed, how many rulings were issued, and how the review of about 4,000 existing rulings is organised, including the Nike ruling and the EU Code of Conduct Group's assessment. The State Secretary answered that about 4,000 existing international rulings will be exchanged by 1 January 2018, that a review will check compliance with the two-signature principle, that the Nike ruling cannot be discussed due to tax secrecy, and that he will report on the review and on EU monitoring in early 2018.
Regarding tax matters of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make public statements given the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act.

Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over weigering van de dienstverlening aan US persons in relatie tot de Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA)

An MP asked whether Dutch banks and insurers refuse services to US persons even when they hold a social security number, and what agreements exist with financial institutions. The State Secretary answered that some banks still refuse some US persons, that banks have no acceptance obligation, that most banks accept US persons with an SSN, that no agreements were made with institutions, and that US persons can turn to the NVB for banks that will serve them.
I regret this, but banks have no obligation to accept customers.
Dit vind ik spijtig maar banken hebben geen acceptatieplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de belastingaanslag van Unilever steeds kleiner wordt

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Unilever's Australian tax bill was shrinking, including intercompany loans shifting profits to the Netherlands, the effectiveness of BEPS measures, country-by-country reporting, a KPMG accounting remark, and KPMG's role in tax planning. The State Secretary largely refused to discuss the individual taxpayer citing confidentiality, stated the arm's length principle and OECD/EU measures are sufficient, and pointed to planned anti-avoidance legislation.
Regarding the tax affairs of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make further statements given the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over Nederland als belastingparadijs voor Amerikaanse bedrijven

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Dutch subsidiaries of many Fortune 500 US companies make the Netherlands a tax-avoidance hub, and whether government should stop encouraging such firms. The State Secretary said he had not verified the ITEP figures, argued the Netherlands has an internationally focused tax system with legitimate uses, and pointed to BEPS, EU anti-avoidance directives and new anti-abuse withholding taxes as responses.
I have not conducted independent research into these figures and therefore cannot say whether they are correct.
Ik heb geen zelfstandig onderzoek gedaan naar deze cijfers en kan dus niet aangeven of deze kloppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het gemak waarmee men als belastingconsulent aangemerkt kan worden

Nijboer asked whether obtaining a tax-consultant registration number (becon) from the Tax Authority is easy, whether it implies reliability, and whether consultants can file returns and claim allowances without authorisation, and what data and safeguards apply. Staatssecretaris Snel answered that the becon is only a registration number that signals nothing about quality, that authorisation is needed for some actions, that data rules apply, and that action is taken against lookalike commercial websites, while declining to add minimum quality or background-check requirements.
The becon number indeed says nothing about the reliability or expertise of a tax consultant or administration office.
Het beconnummer zegt inderdaad niets over de betrouwbaarheid of deskundigheid van een belastingconsulent of administratiekantoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de dividendbelasting

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why abolishing dividend tax yields a net relief of 1.4 billion when gross dividend tax revenue in the annual reports was 2.2 to 3.5 billion per year, and asked about the offsetting, the calculation, the transparency of net revenue, the effect on foreign investors and UK investors. The State Secretary explained that the annual report shows gross revenue, that offsets against income and corporate tax reduce net revenue (about 1.0 to 1.2 billion net in 2010-2014), that the 2018 net estimate of 1.4 billion rests on 48% and 9% offset assumptions, and that he refers to a separate letter on foreign investors and does not know whether UK investors lobbied.
I refer you to my letter of today on this subject.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn brief van heden over dit onderwerp.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lammers en Wilders over het bericht ‘Verbijstering om plan voor ’melk en dadels’ op Amsterdamse stembureaus tijdens ramadan: ’Waanzin’’

Two PVV MPs asked the Interior Minister whether a DENK proposal to offer dates and milk at Amsterdam polling stations during Ramadan, endorsed by the mayor as a 'creative solution', breaches election neutrality. The minister answered that municipalities organise elections and may find creative solutions within the Electoral Act, that voters can vote any time from 7:30 to 21:00, and that no additional facilities are required.
Municipalities are free to devise creative solutions to possible staffing problems, within the framework of the Electoral Act.
Het staat gemeenten vrij om creatieve oplossingen te verzinnen voor mogelijke bezettingsproblemen, binnen de kaders van de Kieswet.
